teaching_sense.en_definition: A question or request for information, clarification, or an answer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获得信息、澄清情况或得到答复而提出的问题或询问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba għal informazzjoni, kjarifika jew tweġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 问题；向别人提出、希望得到回答的话。
询问；为了解某项信息或澄清疑点而提出的问题。

formal.mt: Jekk għandek mistoqsija dwar il-formola, ikkuntattja lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: If you have a question about the form, contact the office.
formal.zh: 如果你对表格有疑问，请联系办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nagħmel mistoqsija? Mark: Iva, x'tixtieq tkun taf?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I ask a question? Mark: Yes, what would you like to know?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以问个问题吗？Mark：可以，你想了解什么？

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以问个问题吗？
messages.en: Can I ask a question?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 可以，你想了解什么？
messages.en: Yes, what would you like to know?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mistoqsija 和举手提问的画面绑定记忆，再成对练习 tagħmel mistoqsija（提问）与 twieġeb mistoqsija（回答问题），用一问一答巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or storage space used to keep straw.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放秸秆的建筑物或储藏空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew post fejn jinħażen it-tiben.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秸秆储藏处；供存放秸秆使用的空间。
存放秸秆的地方；秸秆仓。

collocations.en: a straw store full of straw
the door of the straw store
to store straw in the straw store
collocations.zh: 把秸秆存放在秸秆仓里

formal.mt: It-tiben għandu jinħażen f'mitben niexef biex jibqa' f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Straw should be stored in a dry straw store to keep it in good condition.
formal.zh: 秸秆应存放在干燥的秸秆仓内，以保持良好状态。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn se npoġġu dan it-tiben? Pawlu: Poġġih fil-mitben, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where shall we put this straw? Pawlu: Put it in the straw store, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这些秸秆我们放在哪里？Pawlu：把它放进秸秆仓里，靠门放。

messages.speaker: Mark (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 这些秸秆我们放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put this straw?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.zh: 把它放进秸秆仓里，靠门放。
messages.en: Put it in the straw store, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一间专门存放秸秆的小仓房，在门上贴上 mitben 的词卡；每次想到把秸秆搬进仓里，就复习 fil-mitben（在秸秆仓里）。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 200, equal to twice one hundred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词，表示两百，即两个一百相加所得的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 200, jiġifieri darbtejn mija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个一百，即两组各一百，合计两百。
两百；二百，数值为200。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu baġit ta' mitejn ewro għax-xiri tal-kotba.
formal.en: The project has a budget of two hundred euros for purchasing books.
formal.zh: 该项目有两百欧元的购书预算。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm jiswew iż-żewġ biljetti? Lara: Jiswew mitejn ewro b'kollox. Mark: Mela mitt ewro kull wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much do the two tickets cost? Lara: They cost two hundred euros altogether. Mark: So that's one hundred euros each.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这两张票多少钱？拉拉：一共两百欧元。马克：那就是每张一百欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这两张票多少钱？
messages.en: How much do the two tickets cost?

messages.speaker: Lara (售票员)
messages.zh: 一共两百欧元。
messages.en: They cost two hundred euros altogether.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 那就是每张一百欧元。
messages.en: So that's one hundred euros each.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两张各一百欧元的票，合起来就是 mitejn ewro。把 mitejn 与数字200一起记，再用“两百欧元、两百米、两百年”轮流造句。

gloss_zh: 膨松发酵材料；酵母；酵种

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance, such as yeast or leaven, used to make dough rise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于使面团发起、变得蓬松的材料，如酵母或酵种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza, bħall-ħmira, li tintuża biex l-għaġina togħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使面团发起或蓬松的材料；膨松发酵材料。
酵母；可用于使面团发酵的微生物或其制剂。
酵种；加入面团以促使其发酵膨起的材料。

collocations.en: add the leavening to the dough

formal.mt: Il-mitilgħa tgħin lill-għaġina togħla qabel il-ħami.
formal.en: The leavening helps the dough rise before baking.
formal.zh: 发酵材料帮助面团在烘烤前膨起。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Żidt il-mitilgħa mal-għaġina? Pawlu: Iva, issa rridu nistennew sakemm togħla.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you added the leavening to the dough? Pawlu: Yes, now we need to wait until it rises.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你往面团里加发酵材料了吗？保罗：加了，现在我们得等它发起来。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 你往面团里加发酵材料了吗？
messages.en: Have you added the leavening to the dough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa rridu nistennew sakemm togħla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa rridu nistennew sakemm togħla.
messages.zh: 加了，现在我们得等它发起来。
messages.en: Yes, now we need to wait until it rises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitilgħa 和面团慢慢鼓起来的画面一起记：做面包时加入它，面团就能发起。这个画面用于记忆词义，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place designated for aircraft to take off and land, such as an airport or airfield.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供飞机起飞和降落的指定场所，可指机场或飞机起降场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post maħsub biex l-ajruplani jitilgħu u jinżlu, bħal ajruport jew għalqa tal-inżul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机场；供飞机起降并办理相关航空运输业务的场所。
机场；飞机起降场，可包括设施较简单的飞行场地。

formal.mt: L-ajruplan niżel fil-mitjar fil-ħin skedat.
formal.en: The aircraft landed at the airport at the scheduled time.
formal.zh: 飞机按预定时间降落在机场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se niltaqgħu fil-mitjar fis-sebgħa? Mark: Iva, ħdejn id-daħla. It-titjira tagħna titlaq fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we meet at the airport at seven? Mark: Yes, near the entrance. Our flight leaves at nine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们七点在机场见面好吗？马克：好，在入口附近见。我们的航班九点起飞。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们七点在机场见面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet at the airport at seven?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħdejn id-daħla. It-titjira tagħna titlaq fid-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħdejn id-daħla. It-titjira tagħna titlaq fid-disgħa.
messages.zh: 好，在入口附近见。我们的航班九点起飞。
messages.en: Yes, near the entrance. Our flight leaves at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitjar 和飞机在跑道上起降的画面一起记，再用 fil-mitjar（在机场）练习地点表达；这样也能记住它可指飞机起降场。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mill where grain is ground into flour; in a windmill context, a mill powered by wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把谷物磨成面粉的磨坊；在风车语境中，指利用风力运转的风车磨坊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jintaħan il-qamħ biex isir dqiq; fil-kuntest ta' mitħna tar-riħ, mitħna li taħdem bil-qawwa tar-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨坊，磨碎谷物等原料的场所或设施。
风车磨坊，利用风力带动研磨装置的磨坊。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-mitħna kienet tintuża biex itħan il-qamħ.
formal.en: The report describes how the mill was used to grind wheat.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这座磨坊过去如何用于磨小麦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-bini antik? Pawlu: Dik mitħna antika. Hemm kienu jitħnu l-qamħ. Maja: Nistgħu nidħlu narawha?
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that old building? Pawlu: That's an old mill. They used to grind wheat there. Maja: Can we go inside and have a look?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那座老建筑是什么？保罗：那是一座古老的磨坊。人们以前在那里磨小麦。玛雅：我们可以进去看看吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 那座老建筑是什么？
messages.en: What's that old building?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik mitħna antika. Hemm kienu jitħnu l-qamħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dik mitħna antika. Hemm kienu jitħnu l-qamħ.
messages.zh: 那是一座古老的磨坊。人们以前在那里磨小麦。
messages.en: That's an old mill. They used to grind wheat there.

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 我们可以进去看看吗？
messages.en: Can we go inside and have a look?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitħna 配上一幅“小麦进入磨坊、面粉出来”的画面；再给磨坊添上风车叶片，记住 mitħna tar-riħ 表示风车磨坊。

gloss_zh: 敬拜；致敬；赞颂上帝；履行伊斯兰教规定的礼拜；亵渎神明

teaching_sense.en_definition: To worship or pray, including performing the obligatory prayer in Islam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敬拜或祈祷，也可指履行伊斯兰教规定的礼拜；具体词义需结合语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqim jew jitlob, fosthom billi jwettaq it-talb obbligatorju fl-Iżlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敬拜；崇拜神明
向某人致敬；行礼
赞颂上帝

sense_translations.en_definition: to perform the Islamic obligatory prayer
sense_translations.zh_definition: 履行伊斯兰教规定的礼拜
亵渎神明；说亵渎神明的话

collocations.en: performed prayer five times a day

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi kif il-fidil salla fil-moskea qabel kompla bil-ħidma tiegħu.
formal.en: The text describes how the believer performed prayer in the mosque before continuing his work.
formal.zh: 文章描述了这位信徒如何先在清真寺礼拜，再继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Sami qabel il-laqgħa? Lara: Mar il-moskea u salla hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Sami go before the meeting? Lara: He went to the mosque and prayed there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨米开会前去哪儿了？拉拉：他去了清真寺，在那里做了礼拜。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 萨米开会前去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Sami go before the meeting?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他去了清真寺，在那里做了礼拜。
messages.en: He went to the mosque and prayed there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“在清真寺礼拜”的画面记住 salla，再把致敬、赞神和亵渎分别放进不同语境卡片，尤其不要把赞神与亵渎混为一义。

gloss_zh: 钉十字架；交叉摆放；使人受困扰；折磨；施行钉十字架者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To crucify someone, arrange things crosswise, or figuratively cause someone trouble or torment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人钉在十字架上，或使物体交叉排列；也可比喻给人造成麻烦或折磨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jwaħħal lil xi ħadd ma' salib, iqiegħed affarijiet f'għamla ta' salib, jew, b'mod figurattiv, iġiegħel lil xi ħadd ibati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人钉在十字架上
使交叉排列；摆成十字形
给某人添麻烦；使某人陷入困扰
把别人钉在十字架上的人；施行钉十字架者
折磨；使痛苦不堪

collocations.en: crossed his arms over his chest

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-arti, l-istudent sallab żewġ bsaten biex joħloq għamla ta' salib.
formal.en: In the art exercise, the student placed two sticks crosswise to create a cross shape.
formal.zh: 在美术练习中，这名学生把两根木棍交叉摆放，做成十字形。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu għadu rrabjat? Mark: Jidher li iva; sallab idejh u ma qal xejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Pawlu still angry? Mark: It looks like it; he crossed his arms and said nothing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗还在生气吗？马克：看起来是的；他抱起双臂，一句话也没说。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还在生气吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still angry?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher li iva; sallab idejh u ma qal xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher li iva; sallab idejh u ma qal xejn.
messages.zh: 看起来是的；他抱起双臂，一句话也没说。
messages.en: It looks like it; he crossed his arms and said nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两根木棍交叉的画面记 sallab 的“交叉摆放”，再分别记住“钉十字架”和“折磨”的用法；名词义单独标作执行者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An eel, a fish with a long, slender body; specifically also the European eel, Anguilla anguilla.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鳗鱼，一类身体细长的鱼；也可特指欧洲鳗鲡，学名 Anguilla anguilla。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta b'ġisem twil u rqiq; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għall-ispeċi Anguilla anguilla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鳗鱼
欧洲鳗鲡，学名 Anguilla anguilla

formal.mt: L-istudent identifika l-ħuta fl-istampa bħala sallur Ewropew u kiteb l-isem xjentifiku Anguilla anguilla.
formal.en: The student identified the fish in the picture as a European eel and wrote down the scientific name Anguilla anguilla.
formal.zh: 学生认出图片中的鱼是欧洲鳗鲡，并写下了学名 Anguilla anguilla。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-ħuta twila fl-istampa? Toni: Dik sallur. Maja: Issa naf li mhijiex serp!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that long fish in the picture? Toni: That's an eel. Maja: Now I know it isn't a snake!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里那条长长的鱼是什么？托尼：那是鳗鱼。玛雅：现在我知道它不是蛇了！

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 图片里那条长长的鱼是什么？
messages.en: What is that long fish in the picture?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 那是鳗鱼。
messages.en: That's an eel.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 现在我知道它不是蛇了！
messages.en: Now I know it isn't a snake!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sallur 写在一条细长鳗鱼的图画旁，配上“长长的是鳗鱼”；需要精确到物种时，再加“欧洲鳗鲡”标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reign as a monarch or exercise rule, sometimes in a despotic manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为君主在位，或行使统治权；在某些语境中指专横地统治。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun fuq it-tron jew jeżerċita l-ħakma; f'xi kuntesti, jaħkem b'mod despotiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为君主在位；当政
统治；掌管政权
专横地统治；实行专制统治

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-re saltan għal tletin sena u ħalla t-tron lil bintu.
formal.en: In the novel, the king reigned for thirty years and left the throne to his daughter.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，国王在位三十年，随后把王位留给女儿。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm dam fuq it-tron ir-re f'din l-istorja? Toni: Saltan għal tletin sena. Sara: Mela dam mhux ħażin!
colloquial.en: Sara: How long was the king on the throne in this story? Toni: He reigned for thirty years. Sara: That's quite a long time!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个故事里的国王在位多久？托尼：他在位三十年。萨拉：那可真不短！

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm dam fuq it-tron ir-re f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm dam fuq it-tron ir-re f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的国王在位多久？
messages.en: How long was the king on the throne in this story?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 他在位三十年。
messages.en: He reigned for thirty years.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 那可真不短！
messages.en: That's quite a long time!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象国王坐上王位，旁边的年历不断翻页，用这个动作画面记 saltan“在位、统治”；若出现铁腕语境，再理解为专横统治。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The period during which a monarch reigns, or the kingdom or realm under a monarch's rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 君主在位的时期，也可指其统治的王国或国度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu li fih isaltan monarka, jew ir-renju u l-artijiet taħt il-ħakma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一位君主的在位期；一段统治时期
一个王国
王国；国度；统治的疆域

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, is-saltna kienet tinkludi tliet gżejjer, u l-belt ewlenija kienet fuq l-akbar waħda.
formal.en: In the story, the kingdom comprised three islands, and its main city was on the largest one.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个王国由三座岛屿组成，主要城市位于最大的一座岛上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-mappa turi s-saltna kollha? Lara: Iva, dawn it-tliet gżejjer kollha huma parti minnha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this map show the whole kingdom? Lara: Yes, all three of these islands are part of it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张地图画出了整个王国吗？拉拉：对，这三座岛屿都属于这个王国。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这张地图画出了整个王国吗？
messages.en: Does this map show the whole kingdom?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dawn it-tliet gżejjer kollha huma parti minnha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dawn it-tliet gżejjer kollha huma parti minnha.
messages.zh: 对，这三座岛屿都属于这个王国。
messages.en: Yes, all three of these islands are part of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 saltna 配两张图：年历表示“在位期”，地图表示“王国”。读到时间表达看年历，读到边界和岛屿就看地图。

gloss_zh: 与王国有关的；属于王国的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to, belonging to, or concerning a kingdom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与王国有关、属于王国或涉及王国的，用来修饰名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' saltna jew li jappartjeni għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与王国有关的
属于某个王国的；涉及某个王国的

collocations.en: a symbol associated with a kingdom

formal.mt: Fil-kummentarju, l-aġġettiv 'saltni' jindika li t-territorju deskritt jappartjeni għal saltna.
formal.en: In the commentary, the adjective 'saltni' indicates that the territory described belongs to a kingdom.
formal.zh: 在这段评注中，形容词 saltni 表明所描述的领土属于一个王国。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'saltni' f''territorju saltni'? Toni: Ifisser li dak it-territorju jappartjeni għal saltna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'saltni' mean in 'territorju saltni'? Toni: It means that the territory belongs to a kingdom.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：territorju saltni 里面的 saltni 是什么意思？托尼：意思是那片领土属于一个王国。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: territorju saltni 里面的 saltni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'saltni' mean in 'territorju saltni'?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li dak it-territorju jappartjeni għal saltna.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li dak it-territorju jappartjeni għal saltna.
messages.zh: 意思是那片领土属于一个王国。
messages.en: It means that the territory belongs to a kingdom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saltni 当作贴在领土或象征旁的“王国相关”标签来记；它是修饰名词的形容词，学习时与表示王国的 saltna 分开标注。

gloss_zh: 救人；营救；救赎；挽救或抢救；一种儿童游戏的名称

teaching_sense.en_definition: To save or rescue someone from danger, or salvage something at risk of being lost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人从危险中救出，或抢救、挽救可能失去或受损的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ lil xi ħadd mill-periklu jew jipprevjeni li xi ħaġa tintilef jew issirilha ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 救某人；使某人脱险
营救；救出
救赎；使获得解救
一种儿童游戏的名称
拯救；抢救；挽救；营救

collocations.en: salvaged the documents from the fire

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju miktub, il-pumpier salva tifel minn dar li kienet qed taqbad.
formal.en: In the written example, the firefighter rescued a boy from a burning house.
formal.zh: 在这个书面例句中，消防员从一栋着火的房屋里救出了一个男孩。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kelb waqa' fl-ilma? Mark: Iva, imma Pawlu salva l-kelb u issa jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the dog fall into the water? Mark: Yes, but Pawlu rescued the dog, and it's fine now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：狗掉进水里了吗？马克：是的，不过保罗把狗救上来了，它现在没事了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 狗掉进水里了吗？
messages.en: Did the dog fall into the water?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma Pawlu salva l-kelb u issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma Pawlu salva l-kelb u issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是的，不过保罗把狗救上来了，它现在没事了。
messages.en: Yes, but Pawlu rescued the dog, and it's fine now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人伸手把落水的小狗拉回岸边，用“救回来了”记 salva；救赎义另配精神层面的解救，儿童游戏名则单独记作名词。

gloss_zh: 野蛮的；野生的；粗野的；粗糙的；未经驯化的；野蛮或野生之物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wild or undomesticated; also savage, uncouth, or rough in behaviour or character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 野生或未经驯化的；也可形容行为或性情野蛮、粗野、粗鲁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħix fis-selvaġġ u mhux domestikat; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi mġiba vjolenti, goffa jew bla manjieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野蛮的；凶暴的
野生的；野性的
粗俗无礼的；缺乏教养的
粗野的；粗糙的；不文雅的
未经驯化的；非家养的
野蛮或凶暴的事物
野生或具有野性的事物
野生的；粗野或粗糙的；未经驯化的

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti jqabblu annimal salvaġġ ma' annimal domestiku u jispjegaw id-differenza.
formal.en: In the exercise, the students compare a wild animal with a domestic animal and explain the difference.
formal.zh: 在练习中，学生把野生动物与家养动物作比较，并解释两者的区别。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak l-annimal jgħix ma' xi familja? Lara: Le, huwa annimal salvaġġ. Maja: Mela aħjar narawh mill-bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does that animal live with a family? Lara: No, it's a wild animal. Maja: Then we'd better watch it from a distance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只动物是有人家养的吗？拉拉：不是，它是野生动物。玛雅：那我们还是远远地看吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-annimal jgħix ma' xi familja?
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-annimal jgħix ma' xi familja?
messages.zh: 那只动物是有人家养的吗？
messages.en: Does that animal live with a family?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，它是野生动物。
messages.en: No, it's a wild animal.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们还是远远地看吧。
messages.en: Then we'd better watch it from a distance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 salvaġġ 画两格图：一格是野生动物，另一格是粗野行为，分别记住“野生”和“野蛮”；不要见到动物义就自动理解成凶暴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Farmland supplied with water through irrigation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过灌溉获得水分的农田或耕地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Art agrikola li tingħata l-ilma bit-tisqija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过灌溉的农田；此义项用于农地。
指农田有灌溉供水的。
经过灌溉的；有灌溉供水的。
灌溉地；得到灌溉供水的土地。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-ħsad tas-saqwi ma' dak ta' art li tiddependi biss mix-xita.
formal.en: The report compares the harvest from irrigated land with that from land that depends only on rain.
formal.zh: 报告比较了灌溉地与完全依赖雨水的土地的收成。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan ir-raba' saqwi? Pawlu: Iva, nagħtuh l-ilma anki meta ma tagħmilx xita.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this farmland irrigated? Pawlu: Yes, we water it even when it does not rain.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这块农田有灌溉吗？Pawlu：有，即使不下雨，我们也给它浇水。

messages.speaker: Marija (参观者)
messages.zh: 这块农田有灌溉吗？
messages.en: Is this farmland irrigated?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħtuh l-ilma anki meta ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħtuh l-ilma anki meta ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.zh: 有，即使不下雨，我们也给它浇水。
messages.en: Yes, we water it even when it does not rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块接着水管的农田，把 saqwi 与“有水灌溉的耕地”这一画面绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become or enter a new state, including becoming cooked or ripe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成或进入某种新状态，也可指食物煮熟或果实成熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadda għal stat ieħor, bħal meta l-ikel ikun lest jew il-frott ikun misjur.

sense_translations.en_definition: To become (your current definition is only 'to cook')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变成；成为；表示状态变化，不仅限于烹煮。
被煮熟；烹调至熟。
成熟；指果实等达到成熟状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: To walk, to go away, unused form of II
sense_translations.zh_definition: 行走；离去；所列为第二式的不使用形式。
变成、成为这一变化过程。
变成；成为。

sense_translations.en_definition: to come to; to start to
sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐达到某种状态；开始做某事。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be cooking; to become ready; to be in the oven, on the hob
sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在烹煮；逐渐做好；在烤箱里或炉灶上烹调。

formal.mt: Wara li temm l-istudji tiegħu, Mark sar għalliem fi skola primarja.
formal.en: After completing his studies, Mark became a teacher at a primary school.
formal.zh: 完成学业后，Mark 成为了一所小学的教师。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-ikel sar? Mark: Iva, sar. Ejja nieklu qabel jiksaħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the food cooked? Mark: Yes, it is. Let's eat before it gets cold.
colloquial.zh: Lara：饭做好了吗？Mark：好了。趁还没凉，我们吃吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 饭做好了吗？
messages.en: Is the food cooked?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sar. Ejja nieklu qabel jiksaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sar. Ejja nieklu qabel jiksaħ.
messages.zh: 好了。趁还没凉，我们吃吧。
messages.en: Yes, it is. Let's eat before it gets cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“状态变了”串联 sar：学生成为老师、生食变熟、果实成熟，都能帮助记住核心变化意义。

gloss_zh: 使混乱；惹麻烦；使纠缠；障碍

teaching_sense.en_definition: To confuse, cause trouble, or entangle something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事情混乱、制造麻烦，或使东西纠缠在一起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħawwad, ħoloq l-inkwiet jew ħabbel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使困惑；使混乱。
制造麻烦；引起困扰。
障碍；阻碍进展的事物。
问题；麻烦。
障碍；妨碍；阻力。
使缠结；使卷入纠缠。

formal.mt: It-tibdil mhux mistenni saram il-pjan kollu u wassal għal dewmien fit-tlestija tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The unexpected change disrupted the entire plan and delayed completion of the work.
formal.zh: 意外的变动打乱了整个计划，导致工作延迟完成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sejjer ix-xogħol fid-dar? David: Għad hemm ħafna saram, imma qed insolvu problema wara l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: How is the work on the house going? David: There is still a lot of trouble, but we are solving one problem after another.
colloquial.zh: Nina：房子的工程进展怎么样？David：还有很多麻烦，不过我们正在逐个解决问题。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 房子的工程进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is the work on the house going?

messages.speaker: David (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm ħafna saram, imma qed insolvu problema wara l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm ħafna saram, imma qed insolvu problema wara l-oħra.
messages.zh: 还有很多麻烦，不过我们正在逐个解决问题。
messages.en: There is still a lot of trouble, but we are solving one problem after another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saram 想成一团打结的线：动词表示把事情搅乱，名词表示挡在面前的麻烦和障碍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A covering fitted over an animal's mouth to prevent it from biting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 套在动物嘴部、用于防止其咬人的口套。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata li titqiegħed fuq ħalq annimal biex ma jigdimx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物口套；套在动物嘴部以防咬人的用具。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, il-veterinarju talab li l-kelb jilbes sarima.
formal.en: During the examination, the veterinarian asked for the dog to wear a muzzle.
formal.zh: 检查时，兽医要求给狗戴上口套。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ġibt is-sarima għall-kelb? Karl: Iva, qiegħda fil-basket ħdejn iċ-ċinga.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you bring the muzzle for the dog? Karl: Yes, it is in the basket next to the lead.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你带狗的口套了吗？Karl：带了，在篮子里，牵引绳旁边。

messages.speaker: Rita (兽医助理)
messages.zh: 你带狗的口套了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring the muzzle for the dog?

messages.speaker: Karl (狗主人)
messages.zh: 带了，在篮子里，牵引绳旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it is in the basket next to the lead.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前把 sarima 与牵引绳放在一起，再把画面聚焦到狗嘴上的口套，记住它是具体用具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pack or tie things into a bundle; also to keep anger suppressed and hidden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品打包或捆成一束；也可表示把怒气压在心里而不表露。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabar u rabat affarijiet f'gozz; jista' jfisser ukoll li żamm ir-rabja ġewwa fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打包；收拾装好。
捆成一束；包成一包。
打包；包装这一行为。
捆扎；把东西收拢成束的行为。
打包；把物品收拾包好。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bottle up one's anger (to keep suppressed and hidden)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 压抑怒气；把愤怒藏在心里而不表露。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, Pawlu sarr il-ħwejjeġ f'biċċa drapp u rabathom sew.
formal.en: Before leaving, Pawlu bundled the clothes in a piece of cloth and tied them securely.
formal.zh: 出发前，Pawlu 用一块布把衣物包起来，并扎牢了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min sarr il-ħwejjeġ f'din il-biċċa drapp? Pawlu: Jien, biex inġorrhom kollha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who bundled the clothes in this piece of cloth? Pawlu: I did, so I could carry them all together.
colloquial.zh: Anna：谁用这块布把衣物包起来了？Pawlu：我包的，这样就能一起拿走。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Min sarr il-ħwejjeġ f'din il-biċċa drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Min sarr il-ħwejjeġ f'din il-biċċa drapp?
messages.zh: 谁用这块布把衣物包起来了？
messages.en: Who bundled the clothes in this piece of cloth?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我包的，这样就能一起拿走。
messages.en: I did, so I could carry them all together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“收拢并包住”的画面记 sarr：衣物被包起来，怒气也像被包住一样藏在心里；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of gathering things together and tying or wrapping them into a bundle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品收拢并捆扎或包裹起来的一次行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiġbor affarijiet flimkien u torbothom jew tgeżwirhom f'gozz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次捆扎或打包的行为。
一次打包；一次将物品收拢成束的操作。

formal.mt: Sarra tajba tal-karti żżommhom flimkien waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: Proper bundling keeps the papers together during transport.
formal.zh: 妥善捆扎能使纸张在运输过程中保持整齐、不散开。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'għad fadal qabel nitilqu? Ġanni: Sarra tal-ħwejjeġ biss, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is left to do before we leave? Ġanni: Just bundling up the clothes, and then we will be ready.
colloquial.zh: Marta：出发前还剩什么要做？Ġanni：只剩把衣物打个包，然后就准备好了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 出发前还剩什么要做？
messages.en: What is left to do before we leave?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sarra tal-ħwejjeġ biss, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.mt_standard: Sarra tal-ħwejjeġ biss, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.zh: 只剩把衣物打个包，然后就准备好了。
messages.en: Just bundling up the clothes, and then we will be ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sarra 记成待办清单上的“一次打包”：重点是捆扎这件事，想象完成后在清单上打一个勾。

gloss_zh: 兑换钱币；换零；相当于；钱币兑换商

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exchange money, especially for smaller denominations; also to be equivalent to something or someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 兑换钱币，尤其指把大面额换成小面额；也可表示相当于某物或某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biddel il-flus, speċjalment f'karti jew muniti ta' valur iżgħar; jista' jfisser ukoll li kellu valur ekwivalenti għal xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兑换；换钱。

sense_translations.en_definition: to exchange for smaller denominations (used of money)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把钱换成较小面额；换零。
与……等值；相当于。
钱币兑换商；从事货币兑换的人。
兑换钱币；换钱。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be the equivalent to (something, someone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 相当于某物或某人；与某物或某人等值。

collocations.zh: 把一张五十欧元纸币换开

formal.mt: Qabel il-vjaġġ, il-passiġġier sarraf karta ta' ħamsin ewro f'karti ta' għaxar ewro.
formal.en: Before the journey, the passenger changed a fifty-euro note into ten-euro notes.
formal.zh: 出行前，乘客把一张五十欧元纸币换成了十欧元纸币。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Sarraf din il-karta ta' għoxrin ewro, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Żgur. Trid żewġ karti ta' għaxra?
colloquial.en: Mark: Please change this twenty-euro note. Rita: Certainly. Would you like two ten-euro notes?
colloquial.zh: Mark：请把这张二十欧元纸币换开。Rita：当然。你要两张十欧元的吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Sarraf din il-karta ta' għoxrin ewro, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Sarraf din il-karta ta' għoxrin ewro, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把这张二十欧元纸币换开。
messages.en: Please change this twenty-euro note.

messages.speaker: Rita (收银员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Trid żewġ karti ta' għaxra?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Trid żewġ karti ta' għaxra?
messages.zh: 当然。你要两张十欧元的吗？
messages.en: Certainly. Would you like two ten-euro notes?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 sarraf 时把一张大钞换成几张小钞：面额变了，总值相等；借此联记“换零”和“相当于”。

gloss_zh: 给动物戴口套的人；给动物戴口套；使噤声

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who puts a muzzle on an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给动物戴上口套、限制其张口的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed sarima fuq ħalq annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给动物戴口套的人。
给动物戴上口套。
强令保持沉默；压制言论；使噤声。

collocations.en: the person who muzzles the dog

formal.mt: Is-sarram qiegħed is-sarima fuq ħalq il-kelb qabel il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The person responsible for muzzling the dog put its muzzle on before the journey.
formal.zh: 负责给狗戴口套的人在出发前为它戴好了口套。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu s-sarram tal-kelb? Pawlu: Jien. Se nqiegħedlu s-sarima qabel nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the person who muzzles the dog? Pawlu: I am. I'll put its muzzle on before we leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁负责给狗戴口套？保罗：我负责。我们出发前，我会给它戴好。

messages.speaker: Maja (动物收容所志愿者)
messages.zh: 谁负责给狗戴口套？
messages.en: Who is the person who muzzles the dog?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (动物照护员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Se nqiegħedlu s-sarima qabel nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se nqiegħedlu s-sarima qabel nitilqu.
messages.zh: 我负责。我们出发前，我会给它戴好。
messages.en: I am. I'll put its muzzle on before we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张学习卡区分：人是“戴口套的人”，动作是“给动物戴口套”，言论语境则是“使人噤声”。这是语境记忆法，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather things together and tie or wrap them into a bundle or package.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品聚在一起，捆扎成束或包裹成包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabar affarijiet flimkien u rabathom jew geżwirhom f'sorra jew f'pakkett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把物品捆成一束或包成一包。
把东西分装、包扎成包裹或成束。

collocations.en: wrapped the clothes into a bundle in a piece of cloth
collocations.zh: 用一块布把衣物包成一包

collocations.en: tied the papers into a bundle with string
collocations.zh: 用细绳把纸张捆成一束

formal.mt: L-impjegat sarrar il-karti bi spaga u poġġiehom fil-kaxxa.
formal.en: The employee tied the papers into a bundle with string and placed them in the box.
formal.zh: 员工用细绳把纸张捆成一束，然后放进箱子里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sarrar dawn il-ħwejjeġ? Pawlu: Jien, biex ikun eħfef inġorruhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who bundled up these clothes? Pawlu: I did, to make them easier to carry.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把这些衣服包起来了？保罗：我包的，这样搬起来更方便。

messages.speaker: Maja (搬家的朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把这些衣服包起来了？
messages.en: Who bundled up these clothes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (帮忙搬家的朋友)
messages.zh: 我包的，这样搬起来更方便。
messages.en: I did, to make them easier to carry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象散开的衣服被布包住、散开的纸张被绳捆住；把“零散物品变成一包或一束”的动作画面与 sarrar 一起记。

gloss_zh: 缝制皮革；制作马鞍；马鞍匠；说谎者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sew leather, especially when making or repairing a saddle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缝合皮革，尤其指制作或修补马鞍时的皮革缝制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħiet il-ġilda, speċjalment biex jagħmel jew isewwi sarġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缝制皮革。
制作马鞍。
制作马鞍的工匠；马鞍匠。
说谎的人；骗子。
马鞍制作工匠。
说谎者。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan sarraġ il-ġilda b'attenzjoni biex jagħmel sarġ ġdid.
formal.en: The craftsman carefully sewed the leather to make a new saddle.
formal.zh: 工匠仔细缝制皮革，制作一个新马鞍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sarraġ din il-ġilda? Pawlu: Jien. Qed nagħmel sarġ ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who sewed this leather? Pawlu: I did. I'm making a new saddle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块皮革是谁缝的？保罗：我缝的。我正在做一个新马鞍。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块皮革是谁缝的？
messages.en: Who sewed this leather?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (皮革工匠)
messages.zh: 我缝的。我正在做一个新马鞍。
messages.en: I did. I'm making a new saddle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象工匠用针线缝皮革、做马鞍，记住动词义与工匠名词义；遇到评价人物诚实与否的语境，再辨认“说谎者”义，不要把几个义项硬连成词源故事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who talks a lot; in another sense, a cricket.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话很多、话多的人；另一个义项指蟋蟀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem ħafna; f'tifsira oħra, insett li jinstema' jżarżar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话很多的人；话多的人。
蟋蟀，一种会鸣叫的昆虫。

collocations.en: a chatterbox who never stops talking

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni ta' billejl, l-istudent sema' sarsur fl-għalqa.
formal.en: During the nighttime observation, the student heard a cricket in the field.
formal.zh: 夜间观察时，学生听到了田里的蟋蟀声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu hu sarsur, hux? Mark: Iva, dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jgħid!
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is a chatterbox, isn't he? Mark: Yes, he always has something to say!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗是个话匣子，对吧？马克：是啊，他总有话说！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗是个话匣子，对吧？
messages.en: Pawlu is a chatterbox, isn't he?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jgħid!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jgħid!
messages.zh: 是啊，他总有话说！
messages.en: Yes, he always has something to say!

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排画一个不停说话的人和一只鸣叫的蟋蟀，分别标注两个名词义；这只是借声音画面帮助记忆，不表示两个义项的历史来源。

gloss_zh: 把人卷入事端；编造信息；穿宽松长裤；牵连他人者；编故事者；宽松长裤

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drag someone into an issue; in other senses, to invent false information or to wear pantaloons or baggy trousers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人牵扯进某件事或争端；其他动词义包括编造虚假信息，以及穿宽松长裤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal lil xi ħadd fi kwistjoni; f'tifsiriet oħra, ivvinta informazzjoni falza jew libes qalziet wiesa'.

sense_translations.en_definition: to drag sb. into an issue
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人牵扯进某件事或争端。
编造虚假信息。

sense_translations.en_definition: to wear pantaloons or baggy trousers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿宽松长裤或灯笼裤。
把别人卷入纠纷或麻烦的人。
编造故事或说法的人。
宽大蓬松的长裤；灯笼裤。
宽松肥大的裤子。

collocations.en: dragged his friend into the issue
collocations.zh: 把他的朋友牵扯进这件事

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, Pawlu sarwal lil Mark fi kwistjoni li ma kellu x'jaqsam xejn magħha.
formal.en: In the story, Pawlu dragged Mark into an issue with which Mark had nothing to do.
formal.zh: 在故事中，保罗把马克卷入了一件与马克毫无关系的事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu sarwal lilek ukoll f'din il-kwistjoni? Mark: Iva, semma' ismi, imma jien ma kontx involut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu drag you into this issue too? Mark: Yes, he mentioned my name, but I wasn't involved.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗也把你牵扯进这件事了吗？马克：是的，他提了我的名字，可我根本没有参与。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu sarwal lilek ukoll f'din il-kwistjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu sarwal lilek ukoll f'din il-kwistjoni?
messages.zh: 保罗也把你牵扯进这件事了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu drag you into this issue too?

messages.speaker: Mark (被牵连的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, semma' ismi, imma jien ma kontx involut.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, semma' ismi, imma jien ma kontx involut.
messages.zh: 是的，他提了我的名字，可我根本没有参与。
messages.en: Yes, he mentioned my name, but I wasn't involved.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sarwal 建三格词义卡：“卷入纠纷”“编造信息”“宽松裤子”；每格再分动作与人物或物品，靠句中宾语和词性辨义，不强行编造共同来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seat fitted to an animal's back for riding; a separate sense names serge fabric.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装在动物背上供人骑乘的鞍；另一个独立义项指哔叽布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sedil li jitqiegħed fuq dahar annimal biex wieħed jirkbu; f'tifsira oħra, tip ta' drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哔叽；一种斜纹织物。
鞍；装在马等动物背上供骑乘的座具。

formal.mt: Qabel kull lezzjoni tal-irkib, l-għalliem jiċċekkja li s-sarġ ikun imwaħħal sew.
formal.en: Before every riding lesson, the instructor checks that the saddle is securely fastened.
formal.zh: 每次骑术课前，教练都会检查马鞍是否固定牢靠。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan is-sarġ tal-ġilda hu għal dan iż-żiemel? Toni: Iva, imma ħallini niċċekkja li hu mwaħħal sew qabel titla'.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this leather saddle for this horse? Toni: Yes, but let me check that it is securely fastened before you get on.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个皮马鞍是给这匹马用的吗？Toni：是的，不过你上马前，让我检查一下它是否固定好了。

messages.speaker: Sara (骑术学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-sarġ tal-ġilda hu għal dan iż-żiemel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-sarġ tal-ġilda hu għal dan iż-żiemel?
messages.zh: 这个皮马鞍是给这匹马用的吗？
messages.en: Is this leather saddle for this horse?

messages.speaker: Toni (骑术教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ħallini niċċekkja li hu mwaħħal sew qabel titla'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ħallini niċċekkja li hu mwaħħal sew qabel titla'.
messages.zh: 是的，不过你上马前，让我检查一下它是否固定好了。
messages.en: Yes, but let me check that it is securely fastened before you get on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sarġ 做两张独立图卡：一张画马背上的鞍，一张画哔叽布；用场景区分两个名词义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bucket or pail used to hold or carry water or other materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放或提运水等物品的桶、提桶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex iżomm jew iġorr ilma jew materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提桶；通常带提手的桶。
桶；提桶。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem imla s-satal bl-ilma u ġarru lejn il-ġnien.
formal.en: The worker filled the bucket with water and carried it to the garden.
formal.zh: 工人把桶装满水，提到了花园里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu s-satal? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-bieb. Għadu vojt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the bucket? Pawlu: Next to the door. It's still empty.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桶在哪里？保罗：在门旁边，里面还是空的。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 桶在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bucket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起打理花园的朋友)
messages.zh: 在门旁边，里面还是空的。
messages.en: Next to the door. It's still empty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 satal 写在一幅提桶图旁，再依次想象“空桶、装水、提去浇花”；用具体物体和连续动作记住“桶”，无需拆字猜词源。

gloss_zh: 隐藏；掩盖；隐藏行为；隐匿

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hide or conceal someone or something, or to cover something up so that it is not seen or discovered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或物藏起来，或掩盖某事，使其不被看见或发现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħeba persuna jew ħaġa, jew għatta xi ħaġa biex ma tidhirx jew ma tinkixifx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把人或物藏起来。
隐藏；隐瞒。
隐藏、躲藏或藏匿这一行为或状态。
隐匿；掩盖；隐瞒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to conceal, to cover up, to hide away
sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐藏；掩盖；把东西藏到不易发现的地方。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru satar l-ittra f'kexxun biex ħadd ma jsibha.
formal.en: In the story, the character hid the letter in a drawer so that no one would find it.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物把信藏在抽屉里，免得别人找到。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min satar l-ittra tiegħi? Pawlu: Jien, fil-kexxun ta' fuq. Ridt inżommha 'l bogħod mit-tfal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who hid my letter? Pawlu: I did, in the top drawer. I wanted to keep it away from the children.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把我的信藏起来了？保罗：我藏的，在最上面的抽屉里。我想让孩子们拿不到。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁把我的信藏起来了？
messages.en: Who hid my letter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, fil-kexxun ta' fuq. Ridt inżommha 'l bogħod mit-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, fil-kexxun ta' fuq. Ridt inżommha 'l bogħod mit-tfal.
messages.zh: 我藏的，在最上面的抽屉里。我想让孩子们拿不到。
messages.en: I did, in the top drawer. I wanted to keep it away from the children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想“把信藏进抽屉”的具体动作，再换成“把真相藏起来”的抽象情境；另设名词卡记“隐藏这件事”，避免只记动词而漏掉名词义。

gloss_zh: 隐秘行动；隐藏；因端庄而遮掩自身；端庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: Concealment or acting without being noticed; also covering oneself out of modesty, or modesty itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 隐藏或不引人注意地行动；也指因端庄、羞怯而遮掩自身，以及端庄、矜持本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħabi jew l-aġir mingħajr ma wieħed jiġbed l-attenzjoni; ukoll il-ħabi tal-persuna minħabba l-modestja, jew il-modestja nfisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不让人察觉地行动；隐秘行动。
隐藏；遮掩；隐匿。
出于端庄或羞怯而遮掩自身。
端庄；矜持；不张扬或不过度暴露自身的态度。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-vjaġġaturi telqu taħt is-satra tal-lejl biex ma jiġbdux l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: In the story, the travellers left under cover of night to avoid attracting attention.
formal.zh: 在故事中，旅人们在夜色的掩护下离开，以免引起注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta ħareġ il-qattus? Pawlu: Taħt is-satra tal-lejl! Ħadd ma rah joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: When did the cat go out? Pawlu: Under cover of night! Nobody saw it leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫什么时候跑出去的？保罗：趁着夜色溜出去的！谁也没看见它出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (养猫的朋友)
messages.zh: 猫什么时候跑出去的？
messages.en: When did the cat go out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同住的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt is-satra tal-lejl! Ħadd ma rah joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt is-satra tal-lejl! Ħadd ma rah joħroġ.
messages.zh: 趁着夜色溜出去的！谁也没看见它出去。
messages.en: Under cover of night! Nobody saw it leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画分别记忆：夜色遮住行踪，对应隐秘与隐藏；衣着遮掩自身，对应端庄与矜持。两幅画是学习提示，不用于推断词义演变。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flexible implement used for whipping; also a stroke delivered with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于抽打的柔韧器具，即鞭子；也可指用鞭子抽打的一下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda flessibbli li tintuża biex wieħed isawwat biha; ukoll daqqa mogħtija b'din l-għodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一条鞭子。
一鞭；鞭打的一下。
鞭子；用于抽打的器具。

formal.mt: Fil-mużew hemm sawt tal-ġilda espost ħdejn għodod antiki oħra.
formal.en: In the museum, a leather whip is displayed beside other old tools.
formal.zh: 博物馆里陈列着一条皮鞭，旁边是其他旧式工具。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak wara l-ħġieġ? Pawlu: Dak sawt antik; hawn qed nuruh bħala oġġett storiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that behind the glass? Pawlu: That's an old whip; we're displaying it here as a historical object.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：玻璃后面的那个是什么？保罗：那是一条旧鞭子，我们在这里把它作为历史物件展出。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 玻璃后面的那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that behind the glass?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak sawt antik; hawn qed nuruh bħala oġġett storiku.
messages.mt_standard: Dak sawt antik; hawn qed nuruh bħala oġġett storiku.
messages.zh: 那是一条旧鞭子，我们在这里把它作为历史物件展出。
messages.en: That's an old whip; we're displaying it here as a historical object.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sawt 配上一张博物馆皮鞭的图片，再用 daqqa ta' sawt 记住“一记鞭打”，把器具与动作的一次区分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a liquid flow out of a container or into another place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使液体从容器中流出，或流入另一个地方，即倒出、倒入。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla likwidu joħroġ minn reċipjent jew jidħol f'reċipjent ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒；倾倒液体。
倒液体的人；进行倾倒操作的人。

collocations.en: poured the milk into the cup

formal.mt: L-assistent sawwab l-ilma bil-mod fil-kontenitur biex ma jxerred xejn.
formal.en: The assistant poured the water slowly into the container to avoid spilling any.
formal.zh: 助手把水慢慢倒进容器，以免洒出来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min sawwab il-ħalib fit-tazza tiegħi? Mark: Jien; trid ftit ieħor?
colloquial.en: Lara: Who poured the milk into my cup? Mark: I did; would you like a little more?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把牛奶倒进我的杯子了？马克：我倒的，你还想要一点吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把牛奶倒进我的杯子了？
messages.en: Who poured the milk into my cup?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我倒的，你还想要一点吗？
messages.en: I did; would you like a little more?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sawwab 就想象水从壶口流进杯子：动作是“倒”，名词义则指做这个动作的人，注意用词性区分。

gloss_zh: 用羊毛覆盖；从事羊毛加工的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover something with wool or a layer of wool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某物表面覆盖羊毛，或给它铺上一层羊毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għatta xi ħaġa bis-suf jew b'saff ta' suf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用羊毛覆盖某物。
从事羊毛加工的人；羊毛工。
给某物覆上羊毛；使其表面覆盖羊毛。

formal.mt: Għall-wirja tal-artiġjanat, il-ħaddiem sawwaf mudell ta' nagħġa b'suf abjad.
formal.en: For the craft exhibition, the worker covered a model sheep with white wool.
formal.zh: 为了参加手工艺展，工人给一只绵羊模型覆上了白色羊毛。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min sawwaf din il-pupa? Ġanni: Jien; użajt suf abjad biex tidher qisha nagħġa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who covered this doll with wool? Ġanni: I did; I used white wool to make it look like a sheep.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁给这个玩偶覆上了羊毛？詹尼：我做的，我用了白色羊毛，让它看起来像只绵羊。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 谁给这个玩偶覆上了羊毛？
messages.en: Who covered this doll with wool?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; użajt suf abjad biex tidher qisha nagħġa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; użajt suf abjad biex tidher qisha nagħġa.
messages.zh: 我做的，我用了白色羊毛，让它看起来像只绵羊。
messages.en: I did; I used white wool to make it look like a sheep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“给绵羊模型铺白羊毛”的画面记 sawwaf；动词看覆盖动作，名词看加工羊毛的人。这只是学习联想。

gloss_zh: 塑造；创造；发明；按设计制作物品的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something a shape or form, or to create something through design or imagination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物具有形状或形式；也指通过设计或想象创造出事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta sura jew forma lil xi ħaġa, jew ħoloq xi ħaġa permezz tad-disinn jew tal-immaġinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赋予形状；使成形。
创造；创作。
发明；构想出新的事物。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who fashions things according to a design
sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照设计制作或塑造物品的人。
制作、形成、塑造或创造。

formal.mt: L-artist sawwar it-tafal f'figura żgħira skont id-disinn ippreżentat.
formal.en: The artist shaped the clay into a small figure according to the submitted design.
formal.zh: 艺术家按照提交的设计，把黏土塑造成一个小人像。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min sawwar din il-figura? Toni: Ħija; beda b'biċċa tafal u ħadem fuqha lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who shaped this figure? Toni: My brother; he started with a piece of clay and worked on it yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个人像是谁塑造的？托尼：我哥哥，他从一块黏土开始，昨天动手做的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个人像是谁塑造的？
messages.en: Who shaped this figure?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija; beda b'biċċa tafal u ħadem fuqha lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija; beda b'biċċa tafal u ħadem fuqha lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 我哥哥，他从一块黏土开始，昨天动手做的。
messages.en: My brother; he started with a piece of clay and worked on it yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sawwar 记成“双手让黏土有形”：先记具体的塑形，再联想创作人物、创造事物；名词义指按设计制作的人。

gloss_zh: 殴打；虐待；压迫；鞭打；施打者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hit someone repeatedly, including with a whip; also to mistreat or oppress someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复击打某人，包括用鞭子抽打；也可指虐待或压迫某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqat lil xi ħadd ripetutament, ukoll b'sawt; jew ittratta lil xi ħadd ħażin jew ħaqru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 殴打；反复击打。
恶劣地对待；虐待。
压迫；欺压。
用鞭子抽打。
鞭打或殴打他人的人；施打者。
鞭打；施以鞭笞。

formal.mt: Skont ix-xhieda, ir-raġel sawwat lill-vittma qabel ma waslet il-pulizija.
formal.en: According to the testimony, the man beat the victim before the police arrived.
formal.zh: 根据证词，那名男子在警察到来前殴打了受害者。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex fil-film arrestaw lil dak ir-raġel? David: Għax sawwat lil ġar tiegħu; hekk qalu fix-xena ta' qabel.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did they arrest that man in the film? David: Because he beat a neighbour; that's what they said in the previous scene.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：电影里为什么逮捕了那个男人？戴维：因为他殴打了一位邻居，上一场戏里是这么说的。

messages.speaker: Marta (观影的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex fil-film arrestaw lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex fil-film arrestaw lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 电影里为什么逮捕了那个男人？
messages.en: Why did they arrest that man in the film?

messages.speaker: David (观影的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax sawwat lil ġar tiegħu; hekk qalu fix-xena ta' qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Għax sawwat lil ġar tiegħu; hekk qalu fix-xena ta' qabel.
messages.zh: 因为他殴打了一位邻居，上一场戏里是这么说的。
messages.en: Because he beat a neighbour; that's what they said in the previous scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sawt“鞭子”和 sawwat“鞭打、殴打”并排做词卡，用“器具—动作”的画面帮助区分，再扩展到虐待、压迫义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number seventeen, representing a quantity one greater than sixteen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词“十七”，表示比十六多一的数量，也可单独用于报数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara sittax u qabel tmintax, u li jindika kwantità ta' għaxra u sebgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十七，表示数量的基数词。
十七，数词的独立形式，可单独用于报数或回答数量。

formal.mt: Għall-kors irreġistraw sbatax-il student, u l-lezzjonijiet se jibdew nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: Seventeen students registered for the course, and lessons will begin on Monday.
formal.zh: 十七名学生报名参加了这门课程，星期一开始上课。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm għandna platti għall-festa? Ben: Sbatax. Anna: Tajjeb, għandna biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Anna: How many plates do we have for the party? Ben: Seventeen. Anna: Good, we have enough for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：聚会用的盘子有多少个？本：十七个。安娜：好，够每个人用了。

messages.speaker: Anna (聚会组织者)
messages.zh: 聚会用的盘子有多少个？
messages.en: How many plates do we have for the party?

messages.speaker: Ben (帮忙的朋友)
messages.zh: 十七个。
messages.en: Seventeen.

messages.speaker: Anna (聚会组织者)
messages.zh: 好，够每个人用了。
messages.en: Good, we have enough for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画十个圆点再添七个，指着总数读 sbatax；单独回答用 sbatax，接名词时用 sbatax-il student 这样的词组练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become beautiful or to grow more beautiful than before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得美丽，或比原来更加美丽，强调美的变化过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar sabiħ jew sar isbaħ milli kien qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得更加美丽；越来越美。
黎明；天刚亮的时候。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become beautiful, to grow more beautiful
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变美；变得更加美丽。

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol ta' restawr, il-ġnien sbieħ u reġa' nfetaħ għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: After the restoration work, the garden became more beautiful and reopened to the public.
formal.zh: 修复工程完成后，花园变得更加美丽，并重新向公众开放。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kemm sbieħ il-ġnien minn meta ġejna l-aħħar! Mario: Iva, il-fjuri l-ġodda tawh ħafna kulur.
colloquial.en: Elena: How much more beautiful the garden has become since our last visit! Mario: Yes, the new flowers have given it lots of colour.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：跟我们上次来时相比，花园变美了好多！马里奥：是啊，新种的花让这里多了许多色彩。

messages.speaker: Elena (游园的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm sbieħ il-ġnien minn meta ġejna l-aħħar!
messages.mt_standard: Kemm sbieħ il-ġnien minn meta ġejna l-aħħar!
messages.zh: 跟我们上次来时相比，花园变美了好多！
messages.en: How much more beautiful the garden has become since our last visit!

messages.speaker: Mario (游园的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fjuri l-ġodda tawh ħafna kulur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fjuri l-ġodda tawh ħafna kulur.
messages.zh: 是啊，新种的花让这里多了许多色彩。
messages.en: Yes, the new flowers have given it lots of colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用花园改造前后的两张图记 sbieħ 的动词义“变美”；另用日出图单独记名词义“黎明”，不要把两种词性混读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being beautiful, especially in appearance or in the pleasure something gives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物所具有的美丽特质，尤其指外观之美或带给人的美感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li tkun sabiħa u tagħti pjaċir lil min jaraha jew jesperjenzaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美；美丽；使人感到赏心悦目的特质。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratti fil-wirja juru s-sbuħa naturali tal-kosta u l-varjetà tal-pajsaġġ.
formal.en: The photographs in the exhibition show the coast's natural beauty and the variety of the landscape.
formal.zh: 展览中的照片展现了海岸的自然美以及景观的多样性。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ara x'sbuħa għandu dan il-post! Luqa: Veru, speċjalment b'dan id-dawl ta' filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Marija: Look how beautiful this place is! Luqa: It really is, especially in this evening light.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：看，这个地方多美啊！卢卡：真是，尤其是在这样的暮光下。

messages.speaker: Marija (旅行的朋友)
messages.zh: 看，这个地方多美啊！
messages.en: Look how beautiful this place is!

messages.speaker: Luqa (旅行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, speċjalment b'dan id-dawl ta' filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, speċjalment b'dan id-dawl ta' filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 真是，尤其是在这样的暮光下。
messages.en: It really is, especially in this evening light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一张优美风景照写上 sbuħa，记住它是可以欣赏和描述的“美”这一名词；再用 sbuħa naturali 巩固“自然美”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particle placed before a verb to show that an action or event will happen in the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在动词前，表示动作或事件将要发生的将来时助词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Partiċella li titqiegħed qabel verb biex turi li azzjoni jew ġrajja se sseħħ fil-futur.

sense_translations.en_definition: particle used to indicate future tense
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表示将来时的助词。
表示将来时。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se tibda għada fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will begin tomorrow at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于明天上午九点开始。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se tagħmel għada? Pawlu: Se mmur il-baħar ma' ħuti.
colloquial.en: Marija: What are you going to do tomorrow? Pawlu: I'm going to the seaside with my siblings.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你明天打算做什么？Pawlu：我要和兄弟姐妹一起去海边。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天打算做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和兄弟姐妹一起去海边。
messages.en: I'm going to the seaside with my siblings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 se 想成动词前的一支未来箭头：se mmur 是“我将去”，se nibdew 是“我们将开始”；先找 se，再判断后面的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A finger, one of the separate movable parts of the hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手指，即手上可以分别活动的指状部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed mill-partijiet twal tal-id li jistgħu jitgħawġu u jintużaw biex jaqbdu jew imissu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指。
数词 sebgħa（七）的短定语形式，用于修饰名词。

formal.mt: It-tifel għandu ferita żgħira f'seba' wieħed.
formal.en: The boy has a small wound on one finger.
formal.zh: 这个男孩的一根手指上有一处小伤口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għandek faxxa fuq subgħajk? Mark: Qtajt seba' waqt li kont qed inqatta' l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you have a bandage on your finger? Mark: I cut a finger while I was slicing bread.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你手指上为什么缠着绷带？Mark：我切面包时割伤了一根手指。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你手指上为什么缠着绷带？
messages.en: Why do you have a bandage on your finger?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qtajt seba' waqt li kont qed inqatta' l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Qtajt seba' waqt li kont qed inqatta' l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 我切面包时割伤了一根手指。
messages.en: I cut a finger while I was slicing bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 seba' 配两张情景卡：受伤时想到“手指”，数书时想到“七本”。同一拼写有不同词性，要靠句子辨义，末尾撇号也要记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do better than someone or to go beyond something in achievement, amount, quality, or importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现胜过某人，或在成就、数量、质量、重要性等方面超过某个对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun aħjar minn ħaddieħor jew jaqbeż lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa fil-kisba, fl-ammont, fil-kwalità jew fl-importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做得比别人更好；胜过。
超越；超过。

sense_translations.en_definition: to exceed; to be greater, better or more important than
sense_translations.zh_definition: 超过；比某人或某物更大、更好或更重要。

collocations.zh: 他超越了自己的竞争对手

formal.mt: F'din il-kompetizzjoni, l-istudent sebaq lil sħabu u kiseb l-ogħla marka.
formal.en: In this competition, the student outdid his peers and achieved the highest score.
formal.zh: 在这次比赛中，这名学生胜过了同伴，取得了最高分。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif mar ħuk fil-kompetizzjoni? Toni: Mar tajjeb ħafna! Sebaq lill-kompetituri kollha u rebaħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did your brother do in the competition? Toni: He did very well! He outdid all the competitors and won.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你兄弟在比赛中表现如何？Toni：非常好！他胜过了所有对手，赢了比赛。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟在比赛中表现如何？
messages.en: How did your brother do in the competition?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mar tajjeb ħafna! Sebaq lill-kompetituri kollha u rebaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Mar tajjeb ħafna! Sebaq lill-kompetituri kollha u rebaħ.
messages.zh: 非常好！他胜过了所有对手，赢了比赛。
messages.en: He did very well! He outdid all the competitors and won.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象成绩榜上一个名字升到其他人上方，用 sebaq 记“胜过、超越”。画面只帮助记忆，具体超过的是谁、什么指标，要从句子中找。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form meaning seven, used as the long attributive form before a noun, as in sebat ijiem, seven days.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“七”的形式，是修饰名词时使用的长定语形式，例如 sebat ijiem，意为“七天”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tan-numru sebgħa li tintuża bħala forma attributtiva twila quddiem nom, bħal f'sebat ijiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七。
数词 sebgħa（七）的长定语形式，用于修饰名词。

formal.mt: Il-kors se jdum sebat ijiem u se jinkludi lezzjonijiet prattiċi.
formal.en: The course will last seven days and will include practical lessons.
formal.zh: 课程将持续七天，并包含实践课。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm se ddum Malta? Luqa: Se ndum sebat ijiem, minn nhar it-Tnejn sal-Ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: How long will you stay in Malta? Luqa: I'll stay seven days, from Monday to Sunday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你会在马耳他待多久？Luqa：我会待七天，从星期一到星期日。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会在马耳他待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay in Malta?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ndum sebat ijiem, minn nhar it-Tnejn sal-Ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Se ndum sebat ijiem, minn nhar it-Tnejn sal-Ħadd.
messages.zh: 我会待七天，从星期一到星期日。
messages.en: I'll stay seven days, from Monday to Sunday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sebat ijiem 整块记成“七天”，再用 sebat irġiel 巩固“七名男子”。末尾 t 是辨认这一长定语形式的视觉提示。

gloss_zh: 天亮；清晨醒来；清早已在某处

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become light at the start of the day; also, of a person, to wake in the morning or be somewhere very early.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指黎明到来、天色变亮；用于人时，也可表示早晨醒来，或一大早已在某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jisbaħ u jidher id-dawl tal-jum; dwar persuna, tqum filgħodu jew tkun xi mkien kmieni ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破晓；黎明到来。
天色变亮。
早晨醒来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be up very early, to be (somewhere) in the early morning
sense_translations.zh_definition: 很早便已起身；清晨已在某处。

formal.mt: Meta sebaħ, il-ħaddiema bdew ix-xogħol fl-għalqa.
formal.en: When dawn broke, the workers began work in the field.
formal.zh: 天亮时，工人们开始在田里劳作。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadu d-dlam barra? David: Le, diġà sebaħ. Nistgħu noħorġu nimxu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is it still dark outside? David: No, it's already light. We can go out for a walk.
colloquial.zh: Anna：外面还黑着吗？David：不，天已经亮了。我们可以出去散步了。

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.zh: 外面还黑着吗？
messages.en: Is it still dark outside?

messages.speaker: David (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà sebaħ. Nistgħu noħorġu nimxu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà sebaħ. Nistgħu noħorġu nimxu.
messages.zh: 不，天已经亮了。我们可以出去散步了。
messages.en: No, it's already light. We can go out for a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一段清晨短片记 sebaħ：窗外由黑变亮，人醒来并早早出门。把几个义项都放进清晨场景，但仍按句中主语和上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number seven, used in counting or on its own to state a quantity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词“七”，用于数数，或独立表达数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara sitta u qabel tmienja, u li jista' jintuża waħdu biex juri kwantità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七，基数词。
七，数词的独立形式。

formal.mt: In-numru ta' parteċipanti fil-grupp huwa sebgħa.
formal.en: The number of participants in the group is seven.
formal.zh: 该组的参与人数为七人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm hemm tuffieħ fil-basket? Ben: Sebgħa. Trid waħda?
colloquial.en: Nina: How many apples are there in the basket? Ben: Seven. Would you like one?
colloquial.zh: Nina：篮子里有几个苹果？Ben：七个。你想要一个吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 篮子里有几个苹果？
messages.en: How many apples are there in the basket?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 七个。你想要一个吗？
messages.en: Seven. Would you like one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人问“几个”，你独立回答 Sebgħa，旁边画七个圆点。把独立回答的 sebgħa 与名词前的 seba'、sebat 分开练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number seventy, equal to seven groups of ten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词“七十”，表示七个十的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li juri seba' gruppi ta' għaxra, jiġifieri 70.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七十。

formal.mt: Għal din l-attività rreġistraw sebgħin persuna.
formal.en: Seventy people registered for this activity.
formal.zh: 共有七十人报名参加这项活动。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kemm tiswa din il-ġakketta? Ġużeppi: Sebgħin ewro. Tista' tipprovaha jekk trid.
colloquial.en: Marta: How much does this jacket cost? Ġużeppi: Seventy euros. You can try it on if you like.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这件夹克多少钱？Ġużeppi：七十欧元。你愿意的话可以试穿。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件夹克多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this jacket cost?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sebgħin ewro. Tista' tipprovaha jekk trid.
messages.mt_standard: Sebgħin ewro. Tista' tipprovaha jekk trid.
messages.zh: 七十欧元。你愿意的话可以试穿。
messages.en: Seventy euros. You can try it on if you like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 sebgħin 旁写数字70，再画七捆、每捆十根的小棒。用“七十欧元”和“七十岁”两个场景反复提取，避免与“七”混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The early part of the morning when daylight first begins to appear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一天开始时天光初现的时段，即黎明或拂晓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin kmieni filgħodu meta jibda jidher id-dawl tal-jum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黎明；拂晓，天光开始出现的时段。

formal.mt: Il-grupp beda l-mixja mas-sebħ biex jevita s-sħana ta' nofsinhar.
formal.en: The group began the walk at dawn to avoid the midday heat.
formal.zh: 队伍在黎明时分开始徒步，以避开正午的炎热。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Meta se nitilqu għall-mixja? Samwel: Mas-sebħ, biex naraw ix-xemx tielgħa.
colloquial.en: Elena: When are we leaving for the walk? Samwel: At dawn, so we can watch the sun rise.
colloquial.zh: Elena：我们什么时候出发去散步？Samwel：黎明时分，这样就能看日出了。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候出发去散步？
messages.en: When are we leaving for the walk?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 黎明时分，这样就能看日出了。
messages.en: At dawn, so we can watch the sun rise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sebħ 配一张地平线初亮的照片，记住它是“黎明”这个时段的名词；再用动词 sebaħ“天亮了”作对照，帮助区分词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become distracted or mentally preoccupied, so that one's attention is elsewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因心事或其他干扰而分心，注意力不在眼前的事情上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun moħħu f'xi ħaġa oħra u ma jibqax attent għal dak li jkun qed jiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到烦扰；心神不宁。
分心；注意力受到干扰。
心不在焉；心里想着别的事情。

collocations.en: he became distracted for a moment
he lost focus during the lesson

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Mark seha għal mument u ma semax il-mistoqsija.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mark became distracted for a moment and did not hear the question.
formal.zh: 会议期间，马克走神了一会儿，没有听见问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma weġibx? Lara: Seha għal mument; kien qed jaħseb fl-eżami.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark answer? Lara: He got distracted for a moment; he was thinking about the exam.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么没有回答？拉拉：他走神了一会儿，当时在想着考试。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么没有回答？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark answer?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Seha għal mument; kien qed jaħseb fl-eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Seha għal mument; kien qed jaħseb fl-eżami.
messages.zh: 他走神了一会儿，当时在想着考试。
messages.en: He got distracted for a moment; he was thinking about the exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seha 配上“人坐在课堂，心却想着考试”的画面，记住它表示注意力跑到别处去了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A part that someone has or receives, or the contribution or role someone has in an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人拥有、得到或应得的一份，也指某人在活动中承担的部分或发挥的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti li persuna għandha jew tirċievi minn xi ħaġa, jew il-kontribut tagħha f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 份额；所占或分得的一份。

sense_translations.en_definition: the part one plays in sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某人在某事中承担的部分或发挥的作用。

sense_translations.en_definition: share, portion (part someone has or receives, or that is due them)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某人拥有、获得或应得的份额；分给某人的一份。

collocations.en: he took part in the discussion

formal.mt: Kull membru tat-tim kellu sehem importanti fit-tħejjija tar-rapport.
formal.en: Every team member played an important part in preparing the report.
formal.zh: 每位团队成员都在报告的准备工作中发挥了重要作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tieħu sehem fil-logħba? Mark: Iva, imma spjegali r-regoli l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to take part in the game? Mark: Yes, but explain the rules to me first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想参加游戏吗？马克：想，不过先给我讲讲规则。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想参加游戏吗？
messages.en: Do you want to take part in the game?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，不过先给我讲讲规则。
messages.en: Yes, but explain the rules to me first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家分蛋糕，每人得到一个 sehem；再把“一份”联想到共同做事时自己承担的那一部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lapse of attention or a state of absent-mindedness that may lead to an oversight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 注意力暂时不集中或心不在焉的状态，可能因此产生疏忽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' attenzjoni jew stat ta' moħħ distratt li jista' jwassal biex wieħed jinsa jew jiżbalja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分心；注意力不集中的情况。
分心；心不在焉；因注意力不足而产生的疏忽。

collocations.en: because of a lapse of attention

formal.mt: Minħabba sehwa, l-isem tal-awtur tħalla barra mir-rapport.
formal.en: Because of a lapse of attention, the author's name was omitted from the report.
formal.zh: 由于一时疏忽，报告中漏掉了作者的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ħallejt iċ-ċwievet fil-bieb? Mark: Kien mument ta' sehwa; kelli ħafna affarijiet f'moħħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you leave the keys in the door? Mark: It was a moment of absent-mindedness; I had a lot on my mind.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么把钥匙留在门上了？马克：当时走神了，心里想着很多事。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么把钥匙留在门上了？
messages.en: Why did you leave the keys in the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien mument ta' sehwa; kelli ħafna affarijiet f'moħħi.
messages.mt_standard: Kien mument ta' sehwa; kelli ħafna affarijiet f'moħħi.
messages.zh: 当时走神了，心里想着很多事。
messages.en: It was a moment of absent-mindedness; I had a lot on my mind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“出门后才发现钥匙还在门上”的画面记 sehwa：它是名词，指那一次分心或疏忽。

gloss_zh: 分心的；心不在焉的；不专心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Distracted or absent-minded, with insufficient attention to what is happening or being done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人分心、心不在焉，没有充分留意正在发生或正在做的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu moħħu f'xi ħaġa oħra u ma jagħtix biżżejjed attenzjoni għal dak li jkun qed jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分心的；注意力不集中的。
分心的；心不在焉的；不专心的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem innota li l-istudent kien sehwien waqt l-ispjegazzjoni u rrepeta l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The teacher noticed that the student was inattentive during the explanation and repeated the instructions.
formal.zh: 老师注意到那名学生在讲解时不专心，便重复了一遍指示。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum tidher sehwien. Kollox sew? Mark: Iva, imma qed naħseb fil-vjaġġ ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: You seem distracted today. Is everything all right? Mark: Yes, but I'm thinking about tomorrow's trip.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天看起来心不在焉。还好吗？马克：还好，不过我在想着明天的旅行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天看起来心不在焉。还好吗？
messages.en: You seem distracted today. Is everything all right?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma qed naħseb fil-vjaġġ ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma qed naħseb fil-vjaġġ ta' għada.
messages.zh: 还好，不过我在想着明天的旅行。
messages.en: Yes, but I'm thinking about tomorrow's trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个学生盯着窗外发呆，用 student sehwien 给他贴上“心不在焉的学生”这张形容词标签。

gloss_zh: 一批珍藏；宝藏；珍贵的发现物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A valuable find, especially a collection of treasures or other precious objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发现的一批珍贵物品，尤其指宝物、珍藏或具有价值的发现物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa prezzjuża li tinstab, speċjalment ġabra ta' teżori jew oġġetti ta' valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现的一批珍贵物品；一批珍藏。
发现的一批宝物；宝藏。

formal.mt: Is-sejba ta' muniti antiki ġiet eżaminata mill-esperti qabel ma tqiegħdet għall-wiri fil-mużew.
formal.en: The trove of ancient coins was examined by experts before being put on display in the museum.
formal.zh: 这批出土的古钱币经过专家检验后，才在博物馆展出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'sibt fil-kaxxa tan-nannu? Mark: Sejba prezzjuża: ħafna muniti antiki!
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you find in Grandpa's box? Mark: A valuable find: lots of old coins!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在爷爷的箱子里发现了什么？马克：一批宝贝，好多老钱币！

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你在爷爷的箱子里发现了什么？
messages.en: What did you find in Grandpa's box?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.zh: 一批宝贝，好多老钱币！
messages.en: A valuable find: lots of old coins!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开旧箱子，里面满是古钱币；用 sejba 给“这一批发现的宝贝”命名，记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A weapon with a blade, such as a dagger or sword; in a separate sense, a secure box for keeping valuables.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带刃的武器，可指匕首、短剑或一般的剑；另有独立义项，指存放贵重物品的保险箱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma b'xafra, bħal stallett jew xabla; f'tifsira separata, kaxxa sigura fejn jinżammu oġġetti ta' valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匕首。
匕首；短剑。
剑；泛指剑类武器。
保险箱；用于存放贵重物品的安全箱。

collocations.en: the blade of the dagger or sword

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri sejf antik f'vetrina magħluqa biex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu jaraw ix-xafra tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum displays an old dagger in a closed display case so that visitors can see its blade.
formal.zh: 博物馆将一把古老的匕首陈列在封闭的展柜中，让参观者能够看到它的刃部。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dak sejf veru? Mark: Le, huwa tal-plastik; se nużah fid-dramm tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is that a real sword? Mark: No, it is plastic; I am going to use it in the school play.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那是真剑吗？马克：不是，是塑料的；我要在学校的话剧里用它。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 那是真剑吗？
messages.en: Is that a real sword?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa tal-plastik; se nużah fid-dramm tal-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa tal-plastik; se nużah fid-dramm tal-iskola.
messages.zh: 不是，是塑料的；我要在学校的话剧里用它。
messages.en: No, it is plastic; I am going to use it in the school play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张场景卡分别记忆：展柜中的刀剑与存放现金的保险箱。看到刀刃想到武器义，看到现金与锁想到保险箱义，避免混淆。

gloss_zh: 叫来；召集；派人请来；组织召开

teaching_sense.en_definition: To call someone, ask for someone to come, or arrange for people to gather for a meeting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼叫某人、请某人前来，或安排人们集合并召开会议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlob lil xi ħadd jiġi, jibgħat għalih, jew jiġbor lin-nies għal laqgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叫；呼唤；召唤某人。
召集；正式召集人员参加会议或集会。
派人去请；通知某人前来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to organise (used of a meeting etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 组织召开，指会议等活动。

formal.mt: Id-direttur sejjaħ laqgħa biex il-persunal jiddiskuti l-bidliet fl-iskeda tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The director called a meeting so that the staff could discuss the changes to the work schedule.
formal.zh: 主任召集了一次会议，让员工讨论工作时间表的调整。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min sejjaħ lil Pawlu? Anna: Jien; għandna bżonn l-għajnuna tiegħu biex inċaqilqu l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who called Paul over? Anna: I did; we need his help to move the table.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁把保罗叫来的？安娜：是我；我们需要他帮忙搬桌子。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把保罗叫来的？
messages.en: Who called Paul over?

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; għandna bżonn l-għajnuna tiegħu biex inċaqilqu l-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; għandna bżonn l-għajnuna tiegħu biex inċaqilqu l-mejda.
messages.zh: 是我；我们需要他帮忙搬桌子。
messages.en: I did; we need his help to move the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象负责人招手把大家叫到一起：叫一个人是召唤，叫医生是请来，叫大家开会是召集。与名词 sejħa 对照记忆动作和事件。

gloss_zh: 正在去；要去；正在离开；表示将来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be going somewhere or leaving; with a masculine singular subject, it can also express an intended or future action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示正在前往某处或正在离开；用于阳性单数主语时，也可表达打算进行或将要发生的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri li suġġett maskili singular qiegħed fi triqtu lejn xi mkien jew jitlaq; jista' wkoll juri azzjoni maħsuba jew futura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在去；正前往某处。
去；正在前往。
要去；将要，具体含义取决于后接地点还是动作。
正在离开；即将动身。
阳性形式：在前往某处的路上的；正要去某处的。
前往；离去这一行为或过程。
在前往某处的路上的；正在去某处的。
用于标示将来，表达将要发生的动作。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant sejjer Brussell biex jattendi laqgħa dwar l-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The representative is going to Brussels to attend a meeting about education.
formal.zh: 这位代表正要前往布鲁塞尔，参加一场有关教育的会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn sejjer, Mark? Mark: Sejjer id-dar; għandi bżonn nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are you going, Mark? Mark: I am going home; I need to rest a little.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克，你要去哪儿？马克：我要回家；我需要休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克，你要去哪儿？
messages.en: Where are you going, Mark?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer id-dar; għandi bżonn nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer id-dar; għandi bżonn nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 我要回家；我需要休息一会儿。
messages.en: I am going home; I need to rest a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一个向前的箭头：后面接地点，理解为前往那里；后面接动作，理解为将要做。另记本词形常与阳性单数主语相配。

gloss_zh: 奠基；以……为依据；为……打基础

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lay foundations or establish a basis for something, including supporting a claim with evidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为事物奠定基础；也指把论断建立在证据或其他依据之上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed is-sisien ta' xi ħaġa jew jibni argument jew pretensjoni fuq bażi, bħal provi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奠基；铺设基础。

sense_translations.en_definition: to base one's claims on sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以某事物为自己主张或论断的依据。

sense_translations.en_definition: to base, to lay the foundation of
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使建立在某种基础之上；为……奠定基础。

collocations.en: to base the argument on the evidence
to base the decision on the facts
to lay the building's foundations on rock
collocations.zh: 把建筑的基础奠定在岩石上

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur sejjes l-argument tiegħu fuq provi ċari miġbura waqt l-istudju.
formal.en: The researcher based his argument on clear evidence collected during the study.
formal.zh: 研究者把自己的论证建立在研究过程中收集的明确证据之上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fuq xiex sejjes id-deċiżjoni tiegħu Mark? Pawlu: Fuq il-prezz u l-kwalità; qabbel kollox qabel għażel.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did Mark base his decision on? Paul: On price and quality; he compared everything before choosing.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克是根据什么作出决定的？保罗：根据价格和质量；他在选择之前把各项都比较过了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex sejjes id-deċiżjoni tiegħu Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex sejjes id-deċiżjoni tiegħu Mark?
messages.zh: 马克是根据什么作出决定的？
messages.en: What did Mark base his decision on?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-prezz u l-kwalità; qabbel kollox qabel għażel.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-prezz u l-kwalità; qabbel kollox qabel għażel.
messages.zh: 根据价格和质量；他在选择之前把各项都比较过了。
messages.en: On price and quality; he compared everything before choosing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一座房子铺地基，再把房子换成一个论点：房子靠基础站稳，论点靠证据成立。搭配 fuq 时尤其留意后面的依据。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able or skilled at finding something that is hidden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够或善于找出隐藏起来的东西的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kapaċi jew tas-sengħa biex isib xi ħaġa moħbija.

sense_translations.en_definition: able to find sth. that is hidden
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够找出隐藏事物的。
善于发现藏起来的东西的。

collocations.en: a dog able to find hidden things
collocations.zh: 善于找出隐藏物品的狗

collocations.en: a man skilled at finding hidden things
collocations.zh: 善于找到隐藏事物的男子

formal.mt: Għal din it-tfittxija ntgħażel kelb sejjiebi biex jgħin lit-tim isib l-oġġetti moħbija.
formal.en: A dog skilled at finding hidden things was selected for this search to help the team locate the hidden objects.
formal.zh: 这次搜寻选用了一只善于寻找隐藏物品的狗，帮助团队找到藏起来的物件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-kelb tiegħek sejjiebi? Mark: Iva, isib il-ġugarell anki meta naħbih wara s-sufan.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is your dog good at finding hidden things? Mark: Yes, he finds the toy even when I hide it behind the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的狗擅长找藏起来的东西吗？马克：擅长，就算我把玩具藏在沙发后面，它也能找到。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗擅长找藏起来的东西吗？
messages.en: Is your dog good at finding hidden things?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, isib il-ġugarell anki meta naħbih wara s-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, isib il-ġugarell anki meta naħbih wara s-sufan.
messages.zh: 擅长，就算我把玩具藏在沙发后面，它也能找到。
messages.en: Yes, he finds the toy even when I hide it behind the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它贴在寻物高手的照片旁：别人把玩具藏好，他仍能找到。重点记住这是形容寻找能力的词，尤其针对隐藏起来的东西。

gloss_zh: 呼叫；召唤；传召；圣召；人生志业

teaching_sense.en_definition: A call or summons asking someone to respond or attend, or a strong sense of being drawn to a particular purpose or religious life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求某人回应或到场的呼叫、召唤或传召；也指投身某种人生目标或宗教生活的强烈使命感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba biex xi ħadd iwieġeb jew jattendi, jew ġibda qawwija lejn għan fil-ħajja jew lejn il-ħajja reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次呼叫、呼唤或电话呼叫。
传召；要求某人正式到场的通知。
宗教圣召；投身宗教生活的召唤。
人生志业；内心认定应当追求的人生使命。
志业；对某种职业或事业的强烈使命感。

formal.mt: Il-kandidat irċieva sejħa biex jattendi intervista fl-uffiċċju nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The candidate received a call to attend an interview at the office on Monday.
formal.zh: 应聘者接到通知，要求他星期一到办公室参加面试。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Irċevejt sejħa mingħand Pawlu? Anna: Iva, ċempilli dalgħodu biex niftiehmu fuq il-ħin.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you get a call from Paul? Anna: Yes, he phoned me this morning so we could agree on the time.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你接到保罗的电话了吗？安娜：接到了，他今天早上打给我，和我商量时间。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你接到保罗的电话了吗？
messages.en: Did you get a call from Paul?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ċempilli dalgħodu biex niftiehmu fuq il-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ċempilli dalgħodu biex niftiehmu fuq il-ħin.
messages.zh: 接到了，他今天早上打给我，和我商量时间。
messages.en: Yes, he phoned me this morning so we could agree on the time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把各义项串成一幅学习画面：电话在叫你，通知在召你，内心也在召唤你。外在呼叫与内在志业都可用这个名词表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut something using a knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用刀具切开或切分某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' xi ħaġa b'sikkina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用刀切；拿刀切开或切分。

collocations.en: to cut the meat with a knife
to cut the bread with a knife

formal.mt: Il-kok sekken il-laħam fuq il-bord tat-tqattigħ qabel poġġieh fil-borma.
formal.en: The cook cut the meat with a knife on the chopping board before placing it in the pot.
formal.zh: 厨师先在砧板上用刀切肉，然后把肉放入锅中。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min sekken il-ħobż? Mark: Pawlu; uża sikkina kbira u ħalla l-flieli fuq il-platt.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who cut the bread with a knife? Mark: Paul did; he used a large knife and left the slices on the plate.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁用刀切了面包？马克：保罗切的；他用了一把大刀，把切片放在盘子里了。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 谁用刀切了面包？
messages.en: Who cut the bread with a knife?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu; uża sikkina kbira u ħalla l-flieli fuq il-platt.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu; uża sikkina kbira u ħalla l-flieli fuq il-platt.
messages.zh: 保罗切的；他用了一把大刀，把切片放在盘子里了。
messages.en: Paul did; he used a large knife and left the slices on the plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房动作画面记忆：面包放在砧板上，手拿刀切下薄片。记词时把刀具一起想出来，明确动作是用刀切。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of one hundred years, including a numbered century in a calendar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一百年的时间段；也指历法中有编号的某个世纪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' mitt sena, inkluż perjodu numerat fil-kalendarju bħas-seklu għoxrin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世纪。
一百年；长达一百年的时期。

collocations.en: at the beginning of the century

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif inbidlet il-ħajja ta' kuljum f'Malta matul is-seklu għoxrin.
formal.en: The study examines how everyday life in Malta changed during the twentieth century.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察马耳他在二十世纪期间日常生活的变化。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din id-dar ilha hawn seklu? Mark: Iva, inbniet mitt sena ilu u għadha tintuża.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has this house been here for a century? Mark: Yes, it was built a hundred years ago and is still in use.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这栋房子在这里已经一个世纪了吗？马克：是的，它是一百年前建的，现在还在使用。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 这栋房子在这里已经一个世纪了吗？
messages.en: Has this house been here for a century?

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inbniet mitt sena ilu u għadha tintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inbniet mitt sena ilu u għadha tintuża.
messages.zh: 是的，它是一百年前建的，现在还在使用。
messages.en: Yes, it was built a hundred years ago and is still in use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条时间轴，把一百个年份圈成一组，标上 seklu。遇到编号时读作某世纪，遇到持续时间时理解为一百年。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 秒，时间单位，一分钟的六十分之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' ħin li hija parti waħda minn sittin ta' minuta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秒。
秒，时间计量单位，等于一分钟的六十分之一。
胎盘，妊娠期间连接母体与胎儿、进行物质交换的器官。
二度音程，相邻两个音级之间的音程。

formal.mt: Fit-tellieqa, kull sekonda tista' tagħmel differenza fir-riżultat finali.
formal.en: In the race, every second can make a difference to the final result.
formal.zh: 在比赛中，每一秒都可能影响最终结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tistenna sekonda? Mark: Iva, ħu l-ħin tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you wait a second? Mark: Yes, take your time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能等一秒吗？马克：可以，你慢慢来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能等一秒吗？
messages.en: Can you wait a second?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，你慢慢来。
messages.en: Yes, take your time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象秒针跳动一下就是一 sekonda；再用音乐课和产科场景分别记住二度音程与胎盘的义项。
