teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexually attractive, or giving someone a sexually attractive appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 性感的，形容人具有性吸引力，也可形容使人显得性感的衣着或外观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu attrazzjoni sesswali jew li jagħti dehra b'attrazzjoni sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性感的；具有性吸引力的。
性感的，形容人、衣着或外观具有性吸引力。

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur għażel libsa seksi għall-mudella waqt l-isfilata tal-moda.
formal.en: The designer chose a sexy dress for the model during the fashion show.
formal.zh: 设计师为模特挑选了一条性感的连衣裙，用于时装秀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-libsa tidher seksi wisq għall-ikla? Sara: Le, tidher sabiħa ħafna fuqek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this dress look too sexy for the dinner? Sara: No, it looks lovely on you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条裙子穿去晚餐会不会太性感？萨拉：不会，你穿着很好看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-libsa tidher seksi wisq għall-ikla?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-libsa tidher seksi wisq għall-ikla?
messages.zh: 这条裙子穿去晚餐会不会太性感？
messages.en: Does this dress look too sexy for the dinner?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 不会，你穿着很好看。
messages.en: No, it looks lovely on you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seksi 放进挑选晚宴服装的画面：描述的是性感与吸引力，不只是一般的漂亮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A series of items, events, or actions arranged or occurring in a particular order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照一定顺序排列或发生的一组事物、事件或动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' elementi, ġrajjiet jew azzjonijiet li jiġu wara xulxin f'ordni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 序列；按一定顺序排列或发生的一连串事物、事件或动作。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw ir-regola li tiddetermina s-sekwenza ta' numri.
formal.en: The students should identify the rule that determines the sequence of numbers.
formal.zh: 学生应找出决定这个数列的规律。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu n-numru li jmiss f'din is-sekwenza: tnejn, erbgħa, sitta? Maja: Tmienja, għax kull darba nżidu tnejn.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is the next number in this sequence: two, four, six? Maja: Eight, because we add two each time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个数列里，二、四、六之后是什么？玛雅：八，因为每次都加二。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu n-numru li jmiss f'din is-sekwenza: tnejn, erbgħa, sitta?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu n-numru li jmiss f'din is-sekwenza: tnejn, erbgħa, sitta?
messages.zh: 这个数列里，二、四、六之后是什么？
messages.en: What is the next number in this sequence: two, four, six?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmienja, għax kull darba nżidu tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Tmienja, għax kull darba nżidu tnejn.
messages.zh: 八，因为每次都加二。
messages.en: Eight, because we add two each time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sekwenza 想成排好队的数字二、四、六、八，记忆重点是前后有次序的一整串。

gloss_zh: 剥皮；擦伤或碰伤皮肤；敲诈；蹭取

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove skin from an animal or to bruise or scrape skin; figuratively, to extort or scrounge something from someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剥去动物的皮，或使皮肤碰伤、擦伤；也可引申为敲诈或向别人蹭取东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-ġilda minn annimal jew barax jew benġel il-ġilda; b'mod figurattiv, ħa xi ħaġa mingħand ħaddieħor b'theddid jew billi baqa' jitolbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥皮；除去皮。
使碰伤；使出现瘀伤。
剥去皮；剥皮。
给动物剥皮；剥去动物的皮。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bruise or scrape one's skin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 碰伤或擦伤自己的皮肤。
敲诈；以威胁或强迫的方式索取财物。
蹭取；通过讨要或纠缠从别人那里获取东西。

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ sportiv, l-atleta waqa' u selaħ irkopptu mal-art.
formal.en: During sports training, the athlete fell and scraped his knee on the ground.
formal.zh: 在体育训练中，那名运动员摔倒，膝盖在地面上擦伤了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jibki Pawlu? Mark: Waqa' fil-bitħa u selaħ irkopptu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu crying? Mark: He fell in the yard and scraped his knee.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么在哭？马克：他在院子里摔倒，擦伤了膝盖。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么在哭？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu crying?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 他在院子里摔倒，擦伤了膝盖。
messages.en: He fell in the yard and scraped his knee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅皮肤画面记 selaħ：动物被剥皮、膝盖被擦伤；敲诈和蹭取另外配人物索取东西的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of choosing people or things from a group, or the set that has been chosen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一组人或事物中进行选择、筛选的过程，也指选出的一组人或物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għażla ta' persuni jew affarijiet minn grupp, jew il-grupp li jkun intgħażel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选择；筛选；也指经过挑选的一组人或事物。

collocations.zh: 候选人的筛选；选出的一组候选人

formal.mt: Is-selezzjoni tal-kandidati se ssir skont il-kwalifiki u l-esperjenza tagħhom.
formal.en: The selection of candidates will be based on their qualifications and experience.
formal.zh: 候选人的筛选将依据其资历和经验进行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn selezzjoni sabiħa ta' kotba għat-tfal. Mark: Iva, ejja nagħżlu wieħed għal Maja.
colloquial.en: Sara: There is a lovely selection of children's books here. Mark: Yes, let's choose one for Maja.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里有一批很不错的儿童书。马克：是啊，我们给玛雅挑一本吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn selezzjoni sabiħa ta' kotba għat-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn selezzjoni sabiħa ta' kotba għat-tfal.
messages.zh: 这里有一批很不错的儿童书。
messages.en: There is a lovely selection of children's books here.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nagħżlu wieħed għal Maja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nagħżlu wieħed għal Maja.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们给玛雅挑一本吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's choose one for Maja.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从整架书中挑出几本：挑选的过程和挑好的那一批，都可以用 selezzjoni 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money or another item provided for temporary use, with an obligation to repay or return it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供暂时使用、之后需要偿还的钱款或归还的物品，也可指这种借用安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus jew xi ħaġa oħra mogħtija għal użu temporanju, bil-kundizzjoni li jitħallsu lura jew jiġu rritornati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借款；贷款；借出供暂时使用、之后须归还的钱或物品。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ppreżentat talba għal self biex tixtri tagħmir ġdid.
formal.en: The company submitted a loan application to purchase new equipment.
formal.zh: 公司提交了贷款申请，以购买新设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb tiegħek? Mark: Le, qiegħed għandi b'self mingħand Sara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this book yours? Mark: No, I have it on loan from Sara.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书是你的吗？马克：不是，是萨拉借给我的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this book yours?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qiegħed għandi b'self mingħand Sara.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qiegħed għandi b'self mingħand Sara.
messages.zh: 不是，是萨拉借给我的。
messages.en: No, I have it on loan from Sara.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 self 就想象借书时夹着一张归还日期卡：暂时拿到手，之后必须归还；这里别套用英语的自身义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To greet someone or convey greetings to someone, including on another person's behalf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人打招呼、问好，或代别人转达问候。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta tislima lil xi ħadd jew wassal it-tislijiet ta' persuna lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人打招呼；向某人问好。
转达某人的问候；把问候带给别人。

collocations.en: passed on my greetings to the family
collocations.zh: 代我向家人转达了问候

formal.mt: Qabel beda d-diskors, il-kelliem sella lill-mistednin kollha.
formal.en: Before beginning the speech, the speaker greeted all the guests.
formal.zh: 演讲开始前，发言人向所有来宾致意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark sella lil ommok dalgħodu. Sara: Grazzi, ngħidilha meta naraha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark sent your mother his greetings this morning. Sara: Thanks, I'll tell her when I see her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克今天早上托我向你妈妈问好。萨拉：谢谢，我见到她时会告诉她。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克今天早上托我向你妈妈问好。
messages.en: Mark sent your mother his greetings this morning.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我见到她时会告诉她。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll tell her when I see her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sella 配上挥手问好的画面；再想象朋友捎来一句代我问好，就能连起直接致意与转达问候。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone money or an item for temporary use, expecting repayment or its return.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱或物品暂时交给别人使用，并预期对方之后偿还或归还。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta flus jew xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd għal użu temporanju, bil-ħsieb li jitħallsu lura jew li l-ħaġa tiġi rritornata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借出；把钱或物品借给别人，之后需要偿还或归还。

collocations.en: lent a book to his sister
collocations.zh: 把一本书借给了自己的姐妹

formal.mt: Il-bank sellef lill-kumpanija l-flus meħtieġa biex tixtri t-tagħmir.
formal.en: The bank lent the company the money needed to purchase the equipment.
formal.zh: 银行向公司贷出了购买设备所需的资金。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-pinna tiegħek? Sara: Le, Mark sellef lili din il-pinna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this pen yours? Sara: No, Mark lent me this pen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这支笔是你的吗？萨拉：不是，是马克借给我的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这支笔是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this pen yours?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Mark sellef lili din il-pinna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Mark sellef lili din il-pinna.
messages.zh: 不是，是马克借给我的。
messages.en: No, Mark lent me this pen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sellef 时画一支从物主指向朋友的箭头：主语把东西借出去，接收的人之后要归还。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To acknowledge someone with a greeting or a gesture of respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语或动作向某人打招呼，或以敬礼表示尊重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri li jagħraf lil xi ħadd b'tislima jew b'ġest ta' rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人问好；打招呼。
向某人敬礼；以规定的礼节致敬。

formal.mt: Meta wasal fil-laqgħa, id-direttur sellem lill-parteċipanti kollha.
formal.en: When he arrived at the meeting, the director greeted all the participants.
formal.zh: 主任抵达会场时，向所有与会者致意。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu sellem lilek ukoll? Anna: Iva, qalli bonġu meta għaddejt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Pawlu greet you too? Anna: Yes, he said good morning when I walked past.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗也跟你打招呼了吗？安娜：是的，我走过时，他跟我说了早上好。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗也跟你打招呼了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu greet you too?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我走过时，他跟我说了早上好。
messages.en: Yes, he said good morning when I walked past.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sellem 配上两个动作记忆：见邻居挥手问好，见军官举手敬礼；两种情景都在向人致意。

gloss_zh: 使磨散；扯开；扯下；撕裂衣物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pull material apart or pull a piece off, or to make fabric fray or tear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料扯开、把一部分扯下，或使布料和衣物的纤维散开、撕裂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed materjal biex jifirdu jew jaqla' biċċa minnu, jew iqatta' drapp u jifred il-ħjut tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使布料等的边缘磨散、起毛或散线。
用拉扯的方式使某物分开。
扯开；将附着的部分扯下。
使衣物散线、磨破，或将衣物撕裂。

collocations.en: frayed the edge of the fabric
collocations.zh: 把布料边缘扯得散了线

collocations.en: tore a piece off the shirt

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, il-ħaddiem sellet it-tarf tad-drapp biex juri kif jinfirdu l-ħjut.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the worker frayed the edge of the fabric to show how the threads separate.
formal.zh: 演示时，工人把布料边缘扯散，展示纤维如何分开。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm biċċa nieqsa mill-qmis? Pawlu: It-tifel sellet biċċa minnha waqt il-logħob.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is a piece missing from the shirt? Pawlu: The boy tore a piece off it while playing.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：衬衫怎么缺了一块？保罗：小男孩玩耍时从上面扯下了一块。

messages.speaker: Anna (家长)
messages.zh: 衬衫怎么缺了一块？
messages.en: Why is a piece missing from the shirt?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel sellet biċċa minnha waqt il-logħob.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel sellet biċċa minnha waqt il-logħob.
messages.zh: 小男孩玩耍时从上面扯下了一块。
messages.en: The boy tore a piece off it while playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手拉扯一块布：轻则边缘散线，重则扯开或扯下一片；用这个动作串起 sellet 的各个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure with steps or rungs used for climbing up or down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有一连串横档或踏步、供人上下攀爬的梯子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura bi skaluni li tintuża biex wieħed jitla' jew jinżel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梯子；供人借助横档或踏步攀爬的器具。
标尺；由一系列刻度、等级或层次组成的尺度。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem poġġa sellum ħdejn il-ħajt biex jilħaq it-tieqa ta' fuq.
formal.en: The worker placed a ladder beside the wall to reach the upper window.
formal.zh: 工人把梯子放在墙边，以便够到上方的窗户。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu s-sellum? Pawlu: Fil-garaxx, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the ladder? Pawlu: In the garage, beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：梯子在哪儿？保罗：在车库里，门旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 梯子在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the ladder?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 在车库里，门旁边。
messages.en: In the garage, beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一把有多级横档的梯子，在旁边标上 sellum；再用一级一级的画面辅助记忆等级尺度这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting offered to someone, or a respectful gesture such as a curtsy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向人表达的问候，也可指屈膝行礼这样的致敬动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima lil xi ħadd, jew ġest ta' rispett bħal meta wieħed jgħawweġ l-irkopptejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 问候；向人致意的言语或动作。
屈膝礼；略微屈膝并俯身的行礼动作。
一次问候；一句或一个表示致意的招呼。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iż-żifna, it-tifla għamlet selma lill-udjenza.
formal.en: At the end of the dance, the girl made a curtsy to the audience.
formal.zh: 舞蹈结束时，女孩向观众行了一个屈膝礼。

colloquial.mt: Anna: In-nannu bagħatlek selma. Marija: Kemm hu ħelu! Għidlu li nibgħatlu tislima wkoll.
colloquial.en: Anna: Grandpa sent you a greeting. Marija: How sweet of him! Tell him I send my greetings too.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：爷爷托我向你问好。玛丽亚：他真贴心！也替我向他问好。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 爷爷托我向你问好。
messages.en: Grandpa sent you a greeting.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu ħelu! Għidlu li nibgħatlu tislima wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu ħelu! Għidlu li nibgħatlu tislima wkoll.
messages.zh: 他真贴心！也替我向他问好。
messages.en: How sweet of him! Tell him I send my greetings too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 selma 配两幅礼貌场景：托人捎一句问候，以及舞后屈膝致意；记住它是问候或礼节动作这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chard, a leafy vegetable whose leaves and stalks can be cooked and eaten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 莙荙菜，又称叶用甜菜，是叶片和叶柄可烹食的蔬菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix bil-weraq li l-weraq u z-zkuk tiegħu jistgħu jissajru u jittieklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 此义项未明确，所给释义仅标为问号，无法确定其具体含义。
莙荙菜；叶用甜菜，一种可食用叶片和叶柄的蔬菜。

formal.mt: Aħsel il-weraq tas-selq sew qabel tqattgħu u żżidu mas-soppa.
formal.en: Wash the chard leaves thoroughly before chopping them and adding them to the soup.
formal.zh: 将莙荙菜叶充分洗净后，再切碎加入汤中。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'għandna għall-ikla llum? Pawlu: Soppa bis-selq u l-patata.
colloquial.en: Marija: What are we having for lunch today? Pawlu: Soup with chard and potatoes.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：今天午饭吃什么？保罗：莙荙菜土豆汤。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 今天午饭吃什么？
messages.en: What are we having for lunch today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 莙荙菜土豆汤。
messages.en: Soup with chard and potatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 selq 写在一张大叶蔬菜的图片旁，再想象洗叶、切菜、煮汤三个步骤，牢牢记住它指莙荙菜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Butter, a food fat made from cream and used for spreading or cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黄油，即由奶油制成、可涂抹食物或用于烹调的乳脂食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xaħam tal-ikel magħmul mill-krema tal-ħalib, li jintuża biex jindilek jew fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄油；牛油，由奶油加工制成的乳脂食品。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, dewweb biċċa semen fit-taġen qabel iżżid il-ħaxix.
formal.en: For this recipe, melt a piece of butter in the pan before adding the vegetables.
formal.zh: 按照这道食谱，先在平底锅中融化一块黄油，再加入蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid ħobż bis-semen? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma ftit biss.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like bread with butter? Pawlu: Yes, please, but only a little butter.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你想吃涂黄油的面包吗？保罗：想，谢谢，不过黄油只要一点点。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 你想吃涂黄油的面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like bread with butter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma ftit biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma ftit biss.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢，不过黄油只要一点点。
messages.en: Yes, please, but only a little butter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用早餐画面记 semen：切下一小块黄油，涂在面包上；本词条按马耳他语的黄油义记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance that can cause illness, injury, or death if it enters the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入体内后可能引起疾病、损伤或死亡的有毒物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tista' tikkawża mard, ħsara jew mewt jekk tidħol fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毒药；毒物，能对生物造成中毒或伤害的物质。

formal.mt: It-tikketta fuq il-flixkun tindika li fih hemm is-semm.
formal.en: The label on the bottle indicates that it contains poison.
formal.zh: 瓶上的标签表明里面装有毒药。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'hemm f'dak il-flixkun? Anna: Hemm is-semm; tmissux.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What is in that bottle? Anna: It contains poison; don't touch it.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：那个瓶子里装着什么？安娜：里面是毒药，别碰。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 那个瓶子里装着什么？
messages.en: What is in that bottle?

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 里面是毒药，别碰。
messages.en: It contains poison; don't touch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 semm 写在带骷髅标志的瓶子图片上，建立毒物的视觉联想；再与多一个结尾 a 的动词 semma 分开记。

gloss_zh: 命名；施洗命名；提到；称作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone or something a name, including at a christening, or to mention someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或事物取名，包括在洗礼中命名；也指在说话或写作时提到某人或某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti isem lil persuna jew ħaġa, ukoll fil-magħmudija, jew jirreferi għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa fil-kliem jew fil-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 命名；给人或事物取一个名字。
在基督教洗礼中为某人命名。
提到；在言语或文字中说及某人或某事。
给……取名；把……称作。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-awtur semma tliet problemi li jeħtieġu aktar studju.
formal.en: In his report, the author mentioned three problems that require further study.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中提到了三个需要进一步研究的问题。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mark semma fejn se niltaqgħu? Pawlu: Iva, qal ħdejn il-knisja.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did Mark mention where we are meeting? Pawlu: Yes, he said beside the church.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克提到我们在哪里见面了吗？保罗：提到了，他说在教堂旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克提到我们在哪里见面了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark mention where we are meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 提到了，他说在教堂旁边。
messages.en: Yes, he said beside the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡记 semma：一张是给孩子写名字，另一张是在谈话中提到问题；洗礼命名放在取名字这一组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A practical skill or skilled trade learned through training and experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过训练和经验学会的实用技能，也指以这种技能为基础的手艺或行业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħila prattika li wieħed jitgħallem bit-taħriġ u bl-esperjenza, jew xogħol li jitlob din il-ħila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手艺；需要专门技巧的制作技艺。
技能；熟练完成某项工作的技巧。
能力；做成某件事的本领。

sense_translations.en_definition: trade, craft, sector of skilled work
sense_translations.zh_definition: 技术性职业、手艺或需要专门技能的行业。

formal.mt: Is-sengħa tal-mastrudaxxa titlob taħriġ, paċenzja u attenzjoni għad-dettall.
formal.en: The carpenter's craft requires training, patience and attention to detail.
formal.zh: 木工这门手艺需要训练、耐心以及对细节的关注。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi trid titgħallem wara l-iskola? Mark: Nixtieq nitgħallem sengħa u nagħmel għamara tal-injam.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you want to learn after school? Mark: I'd like to learn a trade and make wooden furniture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你毕业后想学什么？马克：我想学一门手艺，制作木家具。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你毕业后想学什么？
messages.en: What do you want to learn after school?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nitgħallem sengħa u nagħmel għamara tal-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nitgħallem sengħa u nagħmel għamara tal-injam.
messages.zh: 我想学一门手艺，制作木家具。
messages.en: I'd like to learn a trade and make wooden furniture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把木匠反复练习制作桌椅的画面与 sengħa 绑定：练成的是技能，靠它谋生就是一门手艺。

gloss_zh: 使变硬，尤指把面包烤硬

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something hard, especially bread through heating in an oven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变硬，尤其指通过在烤箱中加热使面包变硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa iebsa, speċjalment il-ħobż permezz tas-sħana tal-forn.

sense_translations.en_definition: to harden (especially bread in an oven)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变硬，尤指把面包放在烤箱中烤硬。

collocations.en: hardened the bread in the oven
collocations.zh: 把面包在烤箱里烤硬了

collocations.en: hardened the crust of the bread

formal.mt: Il-furnar senneġ il-qoxra tal-ħobż billi ħallieh aktar fil-forn.
formal.en: The baker hardened the bread's crust by leaving it in the oven longer.
formal.zh: 面包师让面包在烤箱里多烤了一会儿，使外皮变硬。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan il-ħobż daqshekk iebes? Pawlu: Il-furnar senneġ il-ħobż fil-forn; aħjar naqtgħuh f'biċċiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this bread so hard? Pawlu: The baker hardened it in the oven; we'd better cut it into small pieces.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这面包怎么这么硬？保罗：面包师把它烤硬了；我们最好把它切成小块。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 这面包怎么这么硬？
messages.en: Why is this bread so hard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-furnar senneġ il-ħobż fil-forn; aħjar naqtgħuh f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-furnar senneġ il-ħobż fil-forn; aħjar naqtgħuh f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 面包师把它烤硬了；我们最好把它切成小块。
messages.en: The baker hardened it in the oven; we'd better cut it into small pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包在烤箱里逐渐变硬，把 senneġ 记成“使变硬”这个动作，并与表示“硬”的状态区别开。

gloss_zh: 充当中间人；经纪人；房地产中介

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act as an intermediary between parties, including arranging a property sale on someone else's behalf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在各方之间充当中间人、促成交易，也指代表他人安排房地产出售。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaġixxi bħala intermedjarju bejn partijiet, fosthom biex ibiegħ proprjetà f'isem ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充当中间人；在双方之间沟通、牵线。

sense_translations.en_definition: to sell real estate on behalf of a client or firm
sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表客户或公司出售房地产。
房地产经纪人；房产中介。
经纪人；替交易双方进行联系、安排交易的人。
经纪人、代理人或中间人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to broker, to act as a broker
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事经纪活动；居间安排或促成交易。

collocations.en: acted as an intermediary between the buyer and the seller
collocations.zh: 在买卖双方之间充当了中间人

formal.mt: Pawlu sensar bejn ix-xerrej u l-bejjiegħ biex iż-żewġ partijiet jilħqu ftehim dwar il-prezz tad-dar.
formal.en: Pawlu acted as an intermediary between the buyer and the seller so that both parties could agree on the price of the house.
formal.zh: 保罗在买卖双方之间居中协调，帮助双方就房屋价格达成一致。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sensar bejn ix-xerrej u l-bejjiegħ? Mark: Pawlu sensar bejniethom u għenhom jiftiehmu fuq il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who acted as the intermediary between the buyer and the seller? Mark: Pawlu did, and he helped them agree on the price.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁在买卖双方之间牵线的？马克：保罗，他还帮他们谈妥了价格。

messages.speaker: Maja (购房者的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min sensar bejn ix-xerrej u l-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Min sensar bejn ix-xerrej u l-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 是谁在买卖双方之间牵线的？
messages.en: Who acted as the intermediary between the buyer and the seller?

messages.speaker: Mark (购房者)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu sensar bejniethom u għenhom jiftiehmu fuq il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu sensar bejniethom u għenhom jiftiehmu fuq il-prezz.
messages.zh: 保罗，他还帮他们谈妥了价格。
messages.en: Pawlu did, and he helped them agree on the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买家和卖家之间站着一位牵线者：sensar 作动词表示“居中协调”，作名词表示“经纪人”，要结合句子区分。

gloss_zh: 串起；用链连接；引起；受到责怪；绞死

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join separate things into a connected line, for example by threading beads or linking a chain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把分开的东西依次连接起来，例如把珠子串在一起或把链环连接起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad affarijiet waħda wara l-oħra, bħal żibeġ fuq ħajta jew ħoloq ta' katina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把若干东西依次串起来。
用链条连接或拴住。
引起；导致某种结果或情况出现。

sense_translations.en_definition: to chain; to enchain; to string together
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用链条连接、锁住；把东西串在一起。
受到责怪；被归咎于某事。
绞死某人；对某人施以绞刑。

collocations.en: strung the beads onto a thread
linked the rings of a chain
collocations.zh: 把链条的链环连接起来了

formal.mt: L-istudent sensel iż-żibeġ fuq ħajta skont l-ordni tal-kuluri murija fl-eżempju.
formal.en: The student strung the beads onto a thread in the colour order shown in the example.
formal.zh: 学生按照示例所示的颜色顺序，把珠子串到了线上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min sensel dawn iż-żibeġ? Mark: Jien! Għażilt il-kuluri tiegħek biex nagħmillek ġiżirana.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who strung these beads together? Mark: I did! I chose your colours to make you a necklace.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些珠子是谁串的？马克：我串的！我选了你喜欢的颜色，给你做条项链。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些珠子是谁串的？
messages.en: Who strung these beads together?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Għażilt il-kuluri tiegħek biex nagħmillek ġiżirana.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Għażilt il-kuluri tiegħek biex nagħmillek ġiżirana.
messages.zh: 我串的！我选了你喜欢的颜色，给你做条项链。
messages.en: I did! I chose your colours to make you a necklace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“一颗颗珠子串成项链”的画面记 sensel 的串联义；引起、受责怪和绞刑等义另配语境记忆，不强行互推。

gloss_zh: 经纪业务；房地产代理销售

teaching_sense.en_definition: The business or service of acting as a broker, especially selling property on behalf of a client or firm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 充当经纪人所开展的业务或提供的服务，尤其指代表客户或公司出售房地产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol jew is-servizz ta' sensar, speċjalment il-bejgħ ta' proprjetà f'isem klijent jew ditta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经纪业务；居间促成交易的服务。

sense_translations.en_definition: selling of real estate on behalf of a client or firm
sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表客户或公司出售房地产的业务。

formal.mt: Id-ditta toffri servizzi ta' senserija lil klijenti li jixtiequ jbigħu l-proprjetà tagħhom.
formal.en: The firm offers brokerage services to clients who wish to sell their property.
formal.zh: 这家公司为希望出售自有房产的客户提供经纪服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din id-ditta tixtri d-djar hi stess? Pawlu: Le, toffri servizzi ta' senserija u tbigħhom f'isem il-klijenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this firm buy the houses itself? Pawlu: No, it provides brokerage services and sells them on behalf of its clients.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这家公司自己买下这些房子吗？保罗：不，它提供经纪服务，代表客户出售房子。

messages.speaker: Maja (房屋业主)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-ditta tixtri d-djar hi stess?
messages.mt_standard: Din id-ditta tixtri d-djar hi stess?
messages.zh: 这家公司自己买下这些房子吗？
messages.en: Does this firm buy the houses itself?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (经纪公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, toffri servizzi ta' senserija u tbigħhom f'isem il-klijenti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, toffri servizzi ta' senserija u tbigħhom f'isem il-klijenti.
messages.zh: 不，它提供经纪服务，代表客户出售房子。
messages.en: No, it provides brokerage services and sells them on behalf of its clients.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 senserija 放在“经纪公司提供的服务”这个场景中记：关注的是经纪业务本身，而具体经纪人可用 sensar 表示。

gloss_zh: 序列；系列；定期播出的节目；一种茴芹属植物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sequence or series of related things or events, including a regularly broadcast television or radio programme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一组相互关联、依次出现的事物或事件，也指电视或广播中定期播出的系列节目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet jew ġrajjiet marbuta ma' xulxin li jiġu waħda wara l-oħra, jew programm regolari fuq it-televiżjoni jew ir-radju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 序列；按一定次序排列或发生的一组事物。
系列；一组相互关联的事物或活动。

sense_translations.en_definition: a television or radio programme that occurs regularly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 定期播出的电视或广播节目。
系列；连续的一组。
一种茴芹属植物，学名为 Pimpinella saxifraga。

formal.mt: Il-mużew se jorganizza sensiela ta' lezzjonijiet dwar l-arti għal studenti tal-iskola sekondarja.
formal.en: The museum will organise a series of lessons about art for secondary school students.
formal.zh: 博物馆将为中学生举办一系列艺术课程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt l-ewwel episodju tas-sensiela l-ġdida? Mark: Iva, u l-episodju li jmiss jixxandar il-Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you watch the first episode of the new series? Mark: Yes, and the next episode airs on Friday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看了那部新剧的第一集吗？马克：看了，下一集周五播出。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看了那部新剧的第一集吗？
messages.en: Did you watch the first episode of the new series?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-episodju li jmiss jixxandar il-Ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-episodju li jmiss jixxandar il-Ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 看了，下一集周五播出。
messages.en: Yes, and the next episode airs on Friday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课程一节接一节、电视剧一集接一集，把 sensiela 记成“相连的一系列”；植物名称这一义项单独记忆。

gloss_zh: 感官享受的；性感的；丰腴性感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Appealing to the senses and giving physical pleasure, often with a suggestion of sexual attraction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吸引感官、带来身体愉悦的，常带有性感或性吸引力的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jappella għas-sensi u jagħti pjaċir fiżiku, spiss b'element ta' attrazzjoni sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起感官愉悦的；性感的；具有肉体吸引力的。
带来强烈感官享受的；形容人或体态时指丰腴性感的。

formal.mt: Il-kritiku ddeskriva ż-żfin bħala senswali, b'movimenti bil-mod li jsegwu r-ritmu tal-mużika.
formal.en: The critic described the dancing as sensual, with slow movements following the rhythm of the music.
formal.zh: 评论家形容这段舞蹈富有性感魅力，缓慢的动作随着音乐节奏展开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt il-kanzunetta? Lara: Għoġbitni ħafna; il-kantant għandu leħen senswali li jaqbel mal-mużika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you think of the song? Lara: I really liked it; the singer has a sensual voice that suits the music.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这首歌怎么样？拉拉：我很喜欢；歌手的嗓音性感撩人，和音乐很搭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这首歌怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the song?

messages.speaker: Lara (听众)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbitni ħafna; il-kantant għandu leħen senswali li jaqbel mal-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbitni ħafna; il-kantant għandu leħen senswali li jaqbel mal-mużika.
messages.zh: 我很喜欢；歌手的嗓音性感撩人，和音乐很搭。
messages.en: I really liked it; the singer has a sensual voice that suits the music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“撩人的嗓音、性感的舞步”两个画面记 senswali，抓住感官愉悦和身体吸引力，不要仅记成普通的“好听”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grammatically complete unit of words expressing a statement, question or other message; also a court's decision imposing punishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 语法完整、表达陈述、疑问等意思的一组词，即句子；也指法院作出的刑罚判决。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' kliem li jifforma unità grammatikali sħiħa u jwassal messaġġ; ukoll deċiżjoni tal-qorti li timponi piena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 句子；在司法语境中也可指判决或判处的刑罚。
判决；法院作出的、规定刑罚的司法裁定。

sense_translations.en_definition: sentence (grammatically complete series of words consisting of a subject and predicate)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 句子；由主语和谓语构成、语法完整的一组词。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jiktbu sentenza sħiħa għal kull kelma ġdida u jidentifikaw is-suġġett u l-predikat.
formal.en: Students should write a complete sentence for each new word and identify the subject and predicate.
formal.zh: 学生应为每个生词写一个完整句子，并指出主语和谓语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din sentenza sħiħa jew għandi nżid xi ħaġa? Pawlu: Żid verb biex turi x'jagħmel it-tifel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a complete sentence, or should I add something? Pawlu: Add a verb to show what the boy does.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是个完整句子吗，还是需要加点什么？保罗：加一个动词，说明那个男孩做什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din sentenza sħiħa jew għandi nżid xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Din sentenza sħiħa jew għandi nżid xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 这是个完整句子吗，还是需要加点什么？
messages.en: Is this a complete sentence, or should I add something?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid verb biex turi x'jagħmel it-tifel.
messages.mt_standard: Żid verb biex turi x'jagħmel it-tifel.
messages.zh: 加一个动词，说明那个男孩做什么。
messages.en: Add a verb to show what the boy does.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sentenza 配两个场景：课堂里写一个完整句子，法庭里宣布一项判决；看到语法词或法院词，就能选择对应意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long gun, such as a shotgun or rifle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长枪，可指猎枪或步枪，具体类型由语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma tan-nar twila, bħal dik li tintuża għall-kaċċa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 霰弹枪；猎枪。
步枪。
步枪；枪，通常指长枪。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi senter antik flimkien ma' tagħmir ieħor tal-kaċċa.
formal.en: The museum displays an old hunting gun alongside other hunting equipment.
formal.zh: 博物馆将一支旧猎枪与其他狩猎装备一同展出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak x'inhu fil-vetrina? Mark: Senter antik tal-kaċċa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that in the display case? Mark: An old hunting gun.
colloquial.zh: Maja：展柜里那是什么？Mark：一支旧猎枪。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里那是什么？
messages.en: What's that in the display case?

messages.speaker: Mark (博物馆导览员)
messages.zh: 一支旧猎枪。
messages.en: An old hunting gun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 senter 记成博物馆展柜里的一支长枪，再用 tal-kaċċa 联想狩猎用途；究竟是猎枪还是步枪，要看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird of prey described as a falcon or hawk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种猛禽，可指隼或鹰，具体所指由语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża li għandu munqar mgħawweġ u dwiefer qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隼；一种猛禽。
鹰；一种猛禽。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, il-grupp ra seqer itir fuq il-wied.
formal.en: During the birdwatching session, the group saw a falcon flying over the valley.
formal.zh: 观鸟时，小组看到一只隼在山谷上空飞翔。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! Pawlu: Dak seqer. Qed iħares lejn l-għalqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that bird on the branch! Pawlu: That's a hawk. It's looking towards the field.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看树枝上的那只鸟！Pawlu：那是一只鹰，正望着田野。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 看树枝上的那只鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird on the branch!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak seqer. Qed iħares lejn l-għalqa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak seqer. Qed iħares lejn l-għalqa.
messages.zh: 那是一只鹰，正望着田野。
messages.en: That's a hawk. It's looking towards the field.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 seqer 就想象树枝上的猛禽：弯嘴、利爪、俯视田野。用这幅画面同时记住“隼”和“鹰”两个释义。

gloss_zh: 冻疮；寒冷引起的皮肤炎症

teaching_sense.en_definition: Skin inflammation caused by cold weather, known as chilblains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寒冷天气引起的皮肤炎症，即冻疮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infjammazzjoni tal-ġilda minħabba l-kesħa, li tista' ġġib ħmura, nefħa u ħakk.

sense_translations.en_definition: skin inflammation due to chilly weather
sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒冷天气引起的皮肤炎症。
冻疮，可统指多处冻疮。
一处冻疮。

formal.mt: Il-pazjenta rrappurtat li kellha seqi f'idejha wara ġranet ta' kesħa.
formal.en: The patient reported having chilblains on her hands after several cold days.
formal.zh: 这名患者报告说，连续几天天气寒冷后，她的手上出现了冻疮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi seqi f'idejja u qed iħokkni ħafna. Sara: Tridni ngħinek inġorr il-basktijiet?
colloquial.en: Nina: I've got chilblains on my hands, and they're very itchy. Sara: Would you like me to help you carry the bags?
colloquial.zh: Nina：我手上长了冻疮，痒得很。Sara：要我帮你提袋子吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi seqi f'idejja u qed iħokkni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi seqi f'idejja u qed iħokkni ħafna.
messages.zh: 我手上长了冻疮，痒得很。
messages.en: I've got chilblains on my hands, and they're very itchy.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 要我帮你提袋子吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to help you carry the bags?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seqi 和寒天里发红发痒的手脚连成画面，再配合 f'idejja“在我手上”记忆，抓住“冻疮”这个核心意思。

gloss_zh: 紧盯；像鹰般监视；用鹰狩猎

teaching_sense.en_definition: To watch someone's movements very closely, like a hawk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像鹰一样紧盯某人，密切监视其一举一动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tgħasses lil xi ħadd mill-qrib u tosserva kull ċaqliqa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧盯某人的一举一动。
像鹰一般；表现得像鹰一样。

sense_translations.en_definition: to watch the movements of someone like a hawk
sense_translations.zh_definition: 像鹰一样密切监视某人的行动。
用鹰狩猎；放鹰行猎。

collocations.en: he watched his opponent like a hawk
collocations.zh: 他紧盯对手的一举一动

collocations.en: he watched the suspect like a hawk
collocations.zh: 他严密监视嫌疑人的举动

formal.mt: Matul il-partita, il-plejer seqqer lill-avversarju biex jantiċipa kull pass tiegħu.
formal.en: During the match, the player watched his opponent like a hawk to anticipate his every move.
formal.zh: 比赛中，这名球员紧盯对手，以预判对方的每一步行动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma seta' jagħmel xejn bil-ballun? Toni: Għax Pawlu seqqer lil Mark il-ħin kollu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why couldn't Mark do anything with the ball? Toni: Because Pawlu watched Mark like a hawk the whole time!
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 怎么拿着球也施展不开？Toni：因为 Pawlu 一直把他盯得死死的！

messages.speaker: Maja (观赛朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma seta' jagħmel xejn bil-ballun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma seta' jagħmel xejn bil-ballun?
messages.zh: Mark 怎么拿着球也施展不开？
messages.en: Why couldn't Mark do anything with the ball?

messages.speaker: Toni (观赛朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu seqqer lil Mark il-ħin kollu!
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu seqqer lil Mark il-ħin kollu!
messages.zh: 因为 Pawlu 一直把他盯得死死的！
messages.en: Because Pawlu watched Mark like a hawk the whole time!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“鹰眼紧盯每个动作”的画面记住 seqqer 的监视义；另画一幅人与鹰共同狩猎的图，单独记住放鹰行猎义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take something belonging to another person without permission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经允许拿走属于他人的东西，即偷窃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tieħu xi ħaġa ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr permess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷；盗窃他人的东西。
抢劫；劫夺他人的财物。
绑架；劫持某人。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, xi ħadd seraq il-flus mill-uffiċċju matul il-lejl.
formal.en: According to the report, someone stole the money from the office during the night.
formal.zh: 据报告，有人在夜间偷走了办公室里的钱。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu r-rota tiegħek? Mark: Xi ħadd seraq ir-rota tiegħi lbieraħ. Diġà għamilt rapport lill-pulizija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where's your bicycle? Mark: Someone stole my bicycle yesterday. I've already reported it to the police.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的自行车呢？Mark：昨天被人偷走了，我已经报警了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的自行车呢？
messages.en: Where's your bicycle?

messages.speaker: Mark (自行车失主)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd seraq ir-rota tiegħi lbieraħ. Diġà għamilt rapport lill-pulizija.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd seraq ir-rota tiegħi lbieraħ. Diġà għamilt rapport lill-pulizija.
messages.zh: 昨天被人偷走了，我已经报警了。
messages.en: Someone stole my bicycle yesterday. I've already reported it to the police.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“昨天有人偷走了自行车”的小故事记住 seraq；遇到不同宾语时，再区分偷窃、抢劫和绑架三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adult male chicken; a rooster.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成年的雄性鸡，即公鸡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tajr maskili adult tal-istess speċi tat-tiġieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只公鸡。
一只雄鸡；公鸡。
公鸡；雄性的鸡。

formal.mt: Fir-razzett hemm serduq wieħed u għaxar tiġieġ.
formal.en: There is one rooster and ten hens on the farm.
formal.zh: 农场里有一只公鸡和十只母鸡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss dalgħodu? Nannu: Kien is-serduq tal-ġar jidden.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that sound this morning? Grandfather: It was the neighbour's rooster crowing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天早上那是什么声音？爷爷：是邻居家的公鸡在打鸣。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 今天早上那是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound this morning?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.zh: 是邻居家的公鸡在打鸣。
messages.en: It was the neighbour's rooster crowing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serduq 配上一只清晨昂头打鸣的公鸡，再与 tiġieġa“母鸡”成对记忆，牢牢记住它表示雄性的鸡。

gloss_zh: 双轮轻型马车；赛马用双轮车

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light two-wheeled carriage pulled by a horse, often used in horse racing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由马牵引的轻型双轮马车，常用于赛马。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karru ħafif b'żewġ roti, miġbud minn żiemel u spiss użat fit-tiġrijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sulky (two-wheeled horse carriage, often used in horse racing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻型双轮马车，常用于赛马，由马牵引。
轻型双轮马车；赛马用双轮车。

collocations.zh: 一匹配有双轮轻型马车的马

formal.mt: Qabel it-tiġrija, is-sewwieq spezzjona s-serkin u ċċekkja ż-żewġ roti.
formal.en: Before the race, the driver inspected the sulky and checked both wheels.
formal.zh: 比赛前，驾车者检查了双轮轻型马车，并查看了两个车轮。

colloquial.mt: Toni: X'inhu dak il-karru wara ż-żiemel? Pawlu: Dak serkin. Għandu żewġ roti u jużawh fit-tiġrijiet.
colloquial.en: Toni: What's that carriage behind the horse? Pawlu: That's a sulky. It has two wheels, and they use it in races.
colloquial.zh: Toni：马后面那辆车是什么？Pawlu：那是双轮轻型马车，有两个轮子，比赛时会用到。

messages.speaker: Toni (初次观赛者)
messages.zh: 马后面那辆车是什么？
messages.en: What's that carriage behind the horse?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观赛朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak serkin. Għandu żewġ roti u jużawh fit-tiġrijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Dak serkin. Għandu żewġ roti u jużawh fit-tiġrijiet.
messages.zh: 那是双轮轻型马车，有两个轮子，比赛时会用到。
messages.en: That's a sulky. It has two wheels, and they use it in races.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serkin 画成“一匹马、两个车轮、一名驾车者”的赛场小图；抓住轻巧和双轮两个特点，记住这种马车。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long reptile without legs; a snake or serpent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体细长、没有腿的爬行动物，即蛇；也可译为大蛇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rettili b'ġisem twil u bla saqajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛇，一种身体细长、没有腿的爬行动物。
蛇；大蛇，中文可按叙述语境选择译法。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher serp twil fuq ġebla.
formal.en: The photograph shows a long snake on a stone.
formal.zh: 照片中，一条长蛇在石头上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm serp ħdejn il-ħajt! Mark: Rajtu. Ejja nibqgħu ftit 'il bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a snake beside the wall! Mark: I see it. Let's stay a little way back.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，墙边有条蛇！Mark：我看见了。我们离远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，墙边有条蛇！
messages.en: Look, there's a snake beside the wall!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见了。我们离远一点吧。
messages.en: I see it. Let's stay a little way back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serp 和一条细长无脚的蛇画在同一张词卡上，再用 serp twil 记住“长蛇”这个搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act or incident of stealing, including a theft or robbery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偷取他人财物的行为或事件，可依语境指盗窃或抢劫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att jew każ ta' teħid ta' xi ħaġa ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr permess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一起抢劫事件。

sense_translations.en_definition: an instance of stealing, a theft, robbery
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次偷窃行为；一起盗窃或抢劫事件。

formal.mt: Il-pulizija qed tinvestiga serqa minn ħanut fiċ-ċentru.
formal.en: The police are investigating a theft from a shop in the centre.
formal.zh: 警方正在调查市中心一家商店的失窃事件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt bis-serqa fil-ħanut? Pawlu: Iva, is-sid qal li sparixxew xi flus.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you hear about the theft at the shop? Pawlu: Yes, the owner said some money had gone missing.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你听说商店失窃的事了吗？Pawlu：听说了，店主说有些钱不见了。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听说商店失窃的事了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear about the theft at the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-sid qal li sparixxew xi flus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-sid qal li sparixxew xi flus.
messages.zh: 听说了，店主说有些钱不见了。
messages.en: Yes, the owner said some money had gone missing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“店主发现钱不见了”的画面记 serqa：这个词指偷窃或抢劫的事件，先记事情，再按语境选中文译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure kept warm for growing plants; a hothouse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供植物生长、内部保持温暖的建筑或设施，即温室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura li tinżamm sħuna biex jitkabbru fiha l-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温室，用于在温暖环境中栽培植物的设施。
红胸秋沙鸭，学名 Mergus serrator。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xitwa, dawn il-pjanti jinżammu f'serra msaħħna.
formal.en: During winter, these plants are kept in a heated hothouse.
formal.zh: 冬季，这些植物放在有供暖的温室里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-pjanti? Toni: Fis-serra, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put these plants? Toni: In the hothouse, beside the door.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些植物放在哪里？Toni：放在温室里，靠门的位置。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 这些植物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these plants?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.zh: 放在温室里，靠门的位置。
messages.en: In the hothouse, beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 serra 做两张画面词卡：植物住的“温室”和鸟名“红胸秋沙鸭”；两义分开记，遇到上下文再选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to secure a door or another object, usually opened with a key.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于锁住门或其他物品的装置，通常用钥匙开启。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mekkaniżmu li jżomm bieb jew oġġett ieħor magħluq u normalment jinfetaħ b'ċavetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锁；用来锁住门或其他物品的锁具。

formal.mt: Is-serratura tal-bieb trid tinbidel għax iċ-ċavetta ma ddurx fiha.
formal.en: The door lock needs to be replaced because the key will not turn in it.
formal.zh: 门锁需要更换，因为钥匙插进去后转不动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Iċ-ċavetta ma ddurx fis-serratura. Rita: Ipprova ċ-ċavetta l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: The key won't turn in the lock. Rita: Try the other key.
colloquial.zh: Mark：钥匙在锁里转不动。Rita：试试另一把钥匙。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 钥匙在锁里转不动。
messages.en: The key won't turn in the lock.

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 试试另一把钥匙。
messages.en: Try the other key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钥匙插进门锁的动作，把 ċavetta“钥匙”和 serratura“锁”配对记，再读 serratura tal-bieb“门锁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cutting tool with a toothed blade, such as a saw or hacksaw.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有锯齿刀片、用于切割材料的工具，可指锯或钢锯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'xafra bis-snien li tintuża biex taqta' materjal bħall-injam jew il-metall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锯，用带锯齿的刀片切割材料的工具。
钢锯，通常用于锯切金属等材料。
小偷；偷取他人财物的人。
锯，指切割工具。
与 ħalliel 同义，指小偷、窃贼。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża serrieq tal-ħadid biex jaqta' biċċa metall.
formal.en: The worker used a hacksaw to cut a piece of metal.
formal.zh: 工人用钢锯锯开了一块金属。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Tista' tagħtini s-serrieq? Marija: Iva. Trid taqta' din il-biċċa injam?
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Can you pass me the saw? Marija: Yes. Do you want to cut this piece of wood?
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：能把锯递给我吗？Marija：可以。你要锯这块木头吗？

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工)
messages.zh: 能把锯递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the saw?

messages.speaker: Marija (木工助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Trid taqta' din il-biċċa injam?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Trid taqta' din il-biċċa injam?
messages.zh: 可以。你要锯这块木头吗？
messages.en: Yes. Do you want to cut this piece of wood?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serrieq 分成“工具”和“人物”两张词卡：工具画锯齿，人物写“小偷”；用上下文区分，不把两义混成一种意思。

gloss_zh: 服务；端上饭菜；适合某种用途

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide help or a service, to supply food or drink, or to be suitable for a particular use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供帮助或服务；供应、端上食物或饮料；也可指适合某种用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti għajnuna jew servizz, tipprovdi ikel jew xorb, jew tkun adattat għal użu partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务；为他人提供所需的帮助或供应。
适合某事或某种用途；可供某种用途使用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to serve (arrange and provide food or drink)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 备好并供应食物或饮料；上菜、端上饮品。
为某人服务；向某人提供服务。

formal.mt: Matul l-ikla, il-wejter serva s-soppa lill-mistednin.
formal.en: During the meal, the waiter served the soup to the guests.
formal.zh: 用餐时，服务员给客人们端上了汤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-flixkun jista' jservi bħala vażun? Toni: Iva, poġġi ftit ilma u xi fjuri fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can this bottle serve as a vase? Toni: Yes, put a little water and some flowers in it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个瓶子能当花瓶用吗？Toni：能，里面放一点水和几枝花吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flixkun jista' jservi bħala vażun?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flixkun jista' jservi bħala vażun?
messages.zh: 这个瓶子能当花瓶用吗？
messages.en: Can this bottle serve as a vase?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġi ftit ilma u xi fjuri fih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġi ftit ilma u xi fjuri fih.
messages.zh: 能，里面放一点水和几枝花吧。
messages.en: Yes, put a little water and some flowers in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景记 serva：服务员招待顾客、端上汤、瓶子充当花瓶；分别对应“服务、供应、适合用途”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Help or work provided to meet someone's needs, often by a person or an organisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或机构为满足他人需求而提供的帮助或工作，即服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajnuna jew xogħol li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tipprovdi biex taqdi l-ħtiġijiet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务；为满足他人需要而提供的帮助或工作。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tipprovdi servizz lill-klijenti bit-telefon u bl-email.
formal.en: The company provides customer service by telephone and email.
formal.zh: 该公司通过电话和电子邮件提供客户服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien is-servizz fir-restorant? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna. Ġabulna l-ikel malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the service at the restaurant? Mark: Very good. They brought our food quickly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那家餐厅的服务怎么样？Mark：很好，上菜很快。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那家餐厅的服务怎么样？
messages.en: How was the service at the restaurant?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 很好，上菜很快。
messages.en: Very good. They brought our food quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 servizz 写在餐厅评价卡上，旁边写 servizz tajjeb“服务好”；借熟悉的评价场景记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rest or a state of calm and peace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体得到休息，或内心处于平静、安宁的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistrieħ tal-ġisem jew stat ta' kalma u paċi fil-moħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宁静；内心的安宁。
休息、安歇或静止的状态。
休息；歇息。
平静；镇定；安宁。

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata twila ta' xogħol, il-ħaddiema kellhom bżonn ftit serħan.
formal.en: After a long day of work, the workers needed a little rest.
formal.zh: 工作了漫长的一天后，工人们需要休息片刻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid toħroġ magħna llejla? Sara: Illum għandi bżonn ftit serħan. Nibqa' d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come out with us tonight? Sara: I need a little rest today. I'll stay home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚要和我们一起出去吗？Sara：今天我需要休息一下，就待在家里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚要和我们一起出去吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come out with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandi bżonn ftit serħan. Nibqa' d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandi bżonn ftit serħan. Nibqa' d-dar.
messages.zh: 今天我需要休息一下，就待在家里了。
messages.en: I need a little rest today. I'll stay home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两幅 serħan 画面：忙完坐下歇息，担忧解除后安心；前者帮助记“休息”，后者帮助记 serħan tal-moħħ“内心安宁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The biological sex of a person or animal; the word can also refer to gender or sexual intercourse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或动物的生理性别；依语境也可指性别或性交。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karatteristiċi bijoloġiċi li jiddistingwu bejn maskili u femminili; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għall-ġeneru jew għal rapport sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生理性别，即与生物学特征有关的性别。
性别；具体指称依上下文判断。
性交；性行为。

formal.mt: Il-formola titlob l-isem, id-data tat-twelid u s-sess tal-persuna.
formal.en: The form asks for the person's name, date of birth and sex.
formal.zh: 表格要求填写姓名、出生日期和性别。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser 'sess' fuq din il-formola? Rita: Hawn tfisser il-kategorija ta' maskili jew femminili.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'sess' mean on this form? Rita: Here it means the category of male or female.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这张表上的 sess 是什么意思？Rita：这里指男性或女性的性别类别。

messages.speaker: Anna (语言学员)
messages.zh: 这张表上的 sess 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sess' mean on this form?

messages.speaker: Rita (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser il-kategorija ta' maskili jew femminili.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser il-kategorija ta' maskili jew femminili.
messages.zh: 这里指男性或女性的性别类别。
messages.en: Here it means the category of male or female.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 sess 先看上下文：表格中常读作“性别”，谈及性行为时可译“性交”；用两张场景词卡分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to sex, sexual activity, or sexuality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与性、性活动或性特征有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sess, mal-attività sesswali jew mas-sesswalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性的；与性有关的。

formal.mt: Il-kors jipprovdi informazzjoni ċara dwar is-saħħa sesswali.
formal.en: The course provides clear information about sexual health.
formal.zh: 这门课程提供关于性健康的清晰信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex inhi t-taħdita? Lara: Dwar is-saħħa sesswali u fejn tista' ssib parir.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the talk about? Lara: Sexual health and where you can find advice.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这场讲座讲什么？Lara：讲性健康，以及去哪里寻求建议。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这场讲座讲什么？
messages.en: What is the talk about?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar is-saħħa sesswali u fejn tista' ssib parir.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar is-saħħa sesswali u fejn tista' ssib parir.
messages.zh: 讲性健康，以及去哪里寻求建议。
messages.en: Sexual health and where you can find advice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sesswali 记在“性健康”和“性教育”两张学习卡上，看到它就想到修饰名词的“与性有关的”。

gloss_zh: 在性方面；就性活动而言

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that relates to sex or sexual activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从性或性活动的方面来说，用来说明行为或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sess jew mal-attività sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在性方面；以与性有关的方式。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega kif jista' jiġi evitat il-mard trasmess sesswalment.
formal.en: The leaflet explains how sexually transmitted diseases can be prevented.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册说明如何预防性传播疾病。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser 'attiv sesswalment' f'din il-formola? Rita: Tfisser li persuna għandha attività sesswali.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'sexually active' mean on this form? Rita: It means that a person engages in sexual activity.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这张表上的“有性生活”是什么意思？Rita：意思是一个人有性活动。

messages.speaker: Mark (咨询者)
messages.zh: 这张表上的“有性生活”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sexually active' mean on this form?

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li persuna għandha attività sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li persuna għandha attività sesswali.
messages.zh: 意思是一个人有性活动。
messages.en: It means that a person engages in sexual activity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“活跃在哪方面？在性方面”记住 attiv sesswalment；这里的词是在说明状态的方面。

gloss_zh: 房间之间的露天通道；传统住宅的敞廊或露台

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open, unroofed passage between rooms, or a veranda or terrace in a traditional Maltese house.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 房间之间没有屋顶的通道，也可指马耳他传统住宅中的敞廊或露台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passaġġ bla saqaf bejn il-kmamar, jew veranda jew terrazzin f'dar tradizzjonali Maltija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 房间之间没有屋顶的露天通道。
敞廊；外廊。

sense_translations.en_definition: a kind of veranda or terrace in a traditional Maltese house
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他传统住宅中的一种敞廊或露台。

collocations.en: an unroofed passage between the rooms

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tad-dar turi setaħ bla saqaf bejn żewġ kmamar.
formal.en: The house plan shows an unroofed passage between two rooms.
formal.zh: 这张住宅平面图显示，两间房之间有一条露天通道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nasal għall-kamra l-oħra? Pawlu: Għaddi mis-setaħ; il-bieb qiegħed fuq il-lemin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I get to the other room? Pawlu: Go through the unroofed passage; the door is on the right.
colloquial.zh: Maja：另一间房怎么走？Pawlu：穿过露天通道，门就在右边。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 另一间房怎么走？
messages.en: How do I get to the other room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddi mis-setaħ; il-bieb qiegħed fuq il-lemin.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddi mis-setaħ; il-bieb qiegħed fuq il-lemin.
messages.zh: 穿过露天通道，门就在右边。
messages.en: Go through the unroofed passage; the door is on the right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从一间房走向另一间房，途中抬头能看见天空；把这条露天通道和 setaħ 连接起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Power, strength, or authority to act, decide, or influence what happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够采取行动、作出决定或影响事态的力量、权力或权限。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawwa jew awtorità li biha wieħed jista' jaġixxi, jiddeċiedi jew jinfluwenza dak li jiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 力量；权力；影响事物的能力。
权限；作出决定或采取行动的权力。
权力、强大力量或权威。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu s-setgħa li japprova t-talbiet.
formal.en: The committee has the authority to approve applications.
formal.zh: 该委员会有权批准申请。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tapprova t-talba tiegħi? Rita: M'għandix is-setgħa li napprovaha; trid titkellem mal-maniġer.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you approve my application? Rita: I don't have the authority to approve it; you need to speak to the manager.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你能批准我的申请吗？Rita：我没有批准的权限，你需要找经理。

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.zh: 你能批准我的申请吗？
messages.en: Can you approve my application?

messages.speaker: Rita (职员)
messages.mt_spoken: M'għandix is-setgħa li napprovaha; trid titkellem mal-maniġer.
messages.mt_standard: M'għandix is-setgħa li napprovaha; trid titkellem mal-maniġer.
messages.zh: 我没有批准的权限，你需要找经理。
messages.en: I don't have the authority to approve it; you need to speak to the manager.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象审批表旁的一枚授权印章：有 setgħa 就有权作决定，也可用它表示更广义的力量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A religious group with its own particular beliefs or practices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有自身特定信仰或宗教实践的群体，即教派或宗派。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp reliġjuż li għandu twemmin jew prattiki partikolari tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教派；具有特定信仰或宗教实践的宗派。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi t-twemmin u l-prattiki ta' setta reliġjuża.
formal.en: The study describes the beliefs and practices of a religious sect.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了一个宗教派别的信仰与宗教实践。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Mark: Dwar setta reliġjuża u l-ħajja tal-membri tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this book about? Mark: A religious sect and the lives of its members.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这本书讲什么？Mark：讲一个宗教派别及其成员的生活。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar setta reliġjuża u l-ħajja tal-membri tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar setta reliġjuża u l-ħajja tal-membri tagħha.
messages.zh: 讲一个宗教派别及其成员的生活。
messages.en: A religious sect and the lives of its members.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 setta 想成宗教分类图中的一个群体分支，旁边写上“共同信仰与实践”，帮助记住“教派”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong loyalty to one's own sect or group that encourages division or hostility toward other groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过分维护自身宗派或群体，从而助长群体分裂或对其他群体敌意的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lealtà qawwija lejn is-setta jew il-grupp proprju li twassal għal firda jew ostilità lejn gruppi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗派主义；因宗派或群体归属而产生的偏见、排斥或对立。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif is-settariżmu jista' jdgħajjef il-fiduċja bejn il-komunitajiet.
formal.en: The report explains how sectarianism can weaken trust between communities.
formal.zh: 报告说明了宗派主义如何削弱不同社群之间的信任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jitkellmu dwar is-settariżmu? Pawlu: Għax xi nies qed jiġġudikaw lill-oħrajn skont il-grupp tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are they talking about sectarianism? Pawlu: Because some people are judging others by the group they belong to.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们为什么在讨论宗派主义？Pawlu：因为有些人正在根据别人所属的群体来评判他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 他们为什么在讨论宗派主义？
messages.en: Why are they talking about sectarianism?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xi nies qed jiġġudikaw lill-oħrajn skont il-grupp tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xi nies qed jiġġudikaw lill-oħrajn skont il-grupp tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为有些人正在根据别人所属的群体来评判他们。
messages.en: Because some people are judging others by the group they belong to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个群体之间竖起一堵偏见之墙，用 settariżmu 标记这堵墙，记住“宗派主义造成隔阂”。

gloss_zh: 宗派的；与某教派有关的；带宗派偏见的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a sect, or showing loyalty to one group with prejudice against others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某教派有关的，或表现出维护自身群体并偏视其他群体的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' setta, jew li juri lealtà lejn grupp wieħed u preġudizzju kontra oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗派的；具有宗派立场或宗派偏见的。
与某个教派有关的；属于某宗派的。

formal.mt: L-artiklu janalizza l-effett ta' diskors settarju fuq ir-relazzjonijiet bejn il-gruppi.
formal.en: The article analyzes the effect of sectarian speech on relations between groups.
formal.zh: 这篇文章分析了带宗派偏见的言论对群体关系的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjaħt dak il-kumment settarju? Mark: Għax jattakka grupp sħiħ minħabba t-twemmin tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you call that comment sectarian? Mark: Because it attacks an entire group because of its beliefs.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么说那条评论带有宗派偏见？Mark：因为它根据一个群体的信仰攻击了整个群体。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说那条评论带有宗派偏见？
messages.en: Why did you call that comment sectarian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jattakka grupp sħiħ minħabba t-twemmin tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jattakka grupp sħiħ minħabba t-twemmin tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为它根据一个群体的信仰攻击了整个群体。
messages.en: Because it attacks an entire group because of its beliefs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 settarju 当作贴在“言论”或“冲突”旁的形容词标签，提醒自己先看它修饰什么，再判断宗派含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: September, the ninth month of the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 九月，一年中的第九个月。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-disa' xahar tas-sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九月，月份名称。
九月，指一年中的第九个月。

formal.mt: Il-kors jibda fl-ewwel ġimgħa ta' Settembru.
formal.en: The course starts in the first week of September.
formal.zh: 课程于九月的第一周开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se tibda l-kors? Lara: F'Settembru, imma għadni ma nafx id-data eżatta.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you starting the course? Lara: In September, but I don't know the exact date yet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你什么时候开始上这门课？Lara：九月，不过我还不知道确切日期。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候开始上这门课？
messages.en: When are you starting the course?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'Settembru, imma għadni ma nafx id-data eżatta.
messages.mt_standard: F'Settembru, imma għadni ma nafx id-data eżatta.
messages.zh: 九月，不过我还不知道确切日期。
messages.en: In September, but I don't know the exact date yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历第九页写上 Settembru，再用 f'Settembru 练习说“在九月”，把月份名称和时间表达一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a child who behaves mischievously or does things they have been told not to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容孩子爱调皮捣蛋，或做了大人不允许做的事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi tifel li jħobb jagħmel il-praspar jew jagħmel affarijiet li jkun intqallu biex ma jagħmilx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 顽皮的；爱调皮捣蛋的（用于形容孩子）
淘气的；不听话的

formal.mt: It-tifel settier ħeba l-lapsijiet ta' sħabu, iżda wara talabhom skuża.
formal.en: The mischievous boy hid his classmates' pencils, but later apologised to them.
formal.zh: 那个顽皮的男孩藏起了同学们的铅笔，不过后来向他们道了歉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tidħaq? Mark: Ħija ż-żgħir ħeba ż-żraben tiegħi. Kemm hu settier!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you laughing? Mark: My little brother hid my shoes. He's so naughty!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么在笑？Mark：我弟弟把我的鞋藏起来了。他真淘气！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在笑？
messages.en: Why are you laughing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ż-żgħir ħeba ż-żraben tiegħi. Kemm hu settier!
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ż-żgħir ħeba ż-żraben tiegħi. Kemm hu settier!
messages.zh: 我弟弟把我的鞋藏起来了。他真淘气！
messages.en: My little brother hid my shoes. He's so naughty!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 settier 和“孩子藏鞋恶作剧”的画面一起记：tifel settier 就是顽皮的男孩，重点是孩子的淘气表现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distinct part of an economy or an area of organised activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经济或有组织活动中划分出来的一个部门、行业或领域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qasam partikolari tal-ekonomija jew ta' attività organizzata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 部门；行业；领域

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-ħtiġijiet tat-taħriġ fis-settur tat-turiżmu.
formal.en: The report examines training needs in the tourism sector.
formal.zh: 这份报告研究旅游业的培训需求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema settur taħdem? Mark: Naħdem fis-settur privat, ma' kumpanija tat-teknoloġija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which sector do you work in? Mark: I work in the private sector, for a technology company.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在哪个部门领域工作？Mark：我在私营部门工作，任职于一家科技公司。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在哪个部门领域工作？
messages.en: Which sector do you work in?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħdem fis-settur privat, ma' kumpanija tat-teknoloġija.
messages.mt_standard: Naħdem fis-settur privat, ma' kumpanija tat-teknoloġija.
messages.zh: 我在私营部门工作，任职于一家科技公司。
messages.en: I work in the private sector, for a technology company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张经济分区图记 settur：公共部门、私营部门、旅游业各占一块；每一块都是一个行业或活动领域。

gloss_zh: 花费；价值为；有用；使付出代价；获准

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a particular price or value, or to require someone to pay a particular amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物价格或价值为多少，或购买、办理某事需要支付多少钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu prezz jew valur ta' ċertu ammont, jew jitlob il-ħlas ta' ċertu ammont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价格为；需花费
价值为；被估价为
结果派上用场；证明有用

sense_translations.en_definition: to cost, to be worth (to incur a charge, a price)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 花费；值……钱（涉及费用或价格）

sense_translations.en_definition: to cost (to cause something to be lost)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使损失；使付出……的代价
导致；造成
获准；被允许

collocations.en: it cost a lot of money
it was worth the time and effort
collocations.zh: 它值得投入这些时间和精力

formal.mt: It-tagħmir il-ġdid sewa elfejn ewro u ntuża fit-taħriġ tal-persunal.
formal.en: The new equipment cost two thousand euros and was used for staff training.
formal.zh: 新设备花费了两千欧元，并用于员工培训。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm sewa dan il-ktieb? Mark: Sewa tnax-il ewro, u diġà sibt ħafna informazzjoni utli fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much did this book cost? Mark: It cost twelve euros, and I've already found a lot of useful information in it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书花了多少钱？Mark：十二欧元，而且我已经在里面找到了很多有用的信息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书花了多少钱？
messages.en: How much did this book cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewa tnax-il ewro, u diġà sibt ħafna informazzjoni utli fih.
messages.mt_standard: Sewa tnax-il ewro, u diġà sibt ħafna informazzjoni utli fih.
messages.zh: 十二欧元，而且我已经在里面找到了很多有用的信息。
messages.en: It cost twelve euros, and I've already found a lot of useful information in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用问价句 Kemm sewa?（花了多少钱？）记住 sewa，再分别记“价值、用处、损失、许可”等义项；注意它只有一个 w。

gloss_zh: 修理；弥补；正确地；真理；公正的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repair something damaged or put a problem right so that it works or is satisfactory again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修复损坏的东西，或解决问题，使其恢复正常或达到令人满意的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irranġa xi ħaġa bil-ħsara jew solva problema biex kollox jerġa' jkun kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修理；修复
弥补；补偿自己造成的过失或损害
修补；补好
阉割（用于动物，通常指雄性动物）
真理；真实情况
美德；德行

sense_translations.en_definition: that which is true and just; the right thing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 真实而公正的事物；正确的事；正道
正确地；妥当地
很；非常；程度很深地
准确地；确切地；恰好
仅仅；只是
正确的；合宜的
公平的；公正的

sense_translations.en_definition: to mend, to solve (a problem, difficulty)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 解决；处理好（问题、困难）

sense_translations.en_definition: to repair, to restore (something damaged, a loss)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 修复；恢复（受损之物）；弥补（损失）
阉割；去势
调味；给食物加佐料

formal.mt: It-tekniku sewwa l-apparat u mbagħad iċċekkja li kien qed jaħdem sewwa.
formal.en: The technician repaired the device and then checked that it was working properly.
formal.zh: 技术员修好了设备，随后检查它是否运转正常。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sewwa r-rota tiegħek? Mark: Missieri sewwa r-rota lbieraħ. Issa taħdem sewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who repaired your bicycle? Mark: My father repaired it yesterday. It works properly now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁修好了你的自行车？Mark：我爸爸昨天修好了。现在骑起来正常了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁修好了你的自行车？
messages.en: Who repaired your bicycle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri sewwa r-rota lbieraħ. Issa taħdem sewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri sewwa r-rota lbieraħ. Issa taħdem sewwa.
messages.zh: 我爸爸昨天修好了。现在骑起来正常了。
messages.en: My father repaired it yesterday. It works properly now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“修好了，就运转正常”串记两个常用词性：sewwa r-rota 是修好了自行车，taħdem sewwa 是运转正常；双写 ww 也要记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who drives a vehicle, either as a job or on a particular journey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 驾驶车辆的人，可以指职业司机，也可以指某次行程中的驾驶者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssuq vettura, bħala xogħol jew waqt vjaġġ partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 司机；驾驶员；驾驶车辆的人
受雇为他人开车的专职司机

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq tal-linja waqaf fil-waqfa u stenna sakemm telgħu l-passiġġieri kollha.
formal.en: The bus driver stopped at the bus stop and waited until all the passengers had boarded.
formal.zh: 公交车司机在车站停车，等所有乘客都上了车。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu max-xufier? Mark: Is-sewwieq tat-taxi se jistenniena quddiem il-lukanda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we meeting the driver? Mark: The taxi driver will wait for us in front of the hotel.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在哪里和司机碰面？Mark：出租车司机会在酒店门前等我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅客)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里和司机碰面？
messages.en: Where are we meeting the driver?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sewwieq tat-taxi se jistenniena quddiem il-lukanda.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sewwieq tat-taxi se jistenniena quddiem il-lukanda.
messages.zh: 出租车司机会在酒店门前等我们。
messages.en: The taxi driver will wait for us in front of the hotel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sewwieq 贴在驾驶座上的人身上记：出租车司机是 sewwieq tat-taxi，公交车司机是 sewwieq tal-linja，核心都是驾驶者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distinct part of a text, place or organisation, including a department with a particular function.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文章、场所或组织中划分出来的一部分，也可指承担特定职能的部门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti distinta ta' test, post jew organizzazzjoni, li jista' jkollha funzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节；章节；分区
部分；组成部分
部门；科室

formal.mt: Din is-sezzjoni tar-rapport tispjega l-metodu użat biex tinġabar l-informazzjoni.
formal.en: This section of the report explains the method used to collect the information.
formal.zh: 报告的这一部分说明了收集信息所采用的方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nsib kotba għat-tfal? Mark: Fis-sezzjoni tat-tfal, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I find children's books? Mark: In the children's section, next to the window.
colloquial.zh: Maja：在哪里能找到儿童读物？Mark：在儿童区，就在窗户旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (图书馆读者)
messages.zh: 在哪里能找到儿童读物？
messages.en: Where can I find children's books?

messages.speaker: Mark (图书管理员)
messages.zh: 在儿童区，就在窗户旁边。
messages.en: In the children's section, next to the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用分隔线划出 sezzjoni：书里是一节，图书馆里是一个分区，机构里是一个部门；共同点都是整体中的明确部分。

gloss_zh: 使着迷；施魔法；魔力；迷人魅力

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enchant someone through magic or captivate them through charm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用魔法迷住某人，或凭魅力使某人深深着迷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaffaxxina lil xi ħadd bil-maġija jew b'ġibda qawwija li tqanqal ammirazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使着迷；以魅力吸引。
施展魔法；用魔法产生作用。
魔法造成的迷惑或陶醉；令人着迷的状态。
咒语；魔咒。
被深深吸引的状态；入迷；陶醉。
令人无法抗拒的魅力。
具有魔力的咒语；魔咒。
魅力；迷人之处。

formal.mt: Il-kantant seħer lill-udjenza bil-vuċi tiegħu u bl-interpretazzjoni tal-kanzunetti.
formal.en: The singer captivated the audience with his voice and his interpretation of the songs.
formal.zh: 这位歌手以自己的嗓音和对歌曲的演绎使观众着迷。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok il-kunċert? Mark: Ħafna! Il-kantant seħer lil kulħadd bil-vuċi tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you enjoy the concert? Mark: Very much! The singer captivated everyone with his voice.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢这场音乐会吗？马克：非常喜欢！那个歌手的嗓音让所有人都着迷了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这场音乐会吗？
messages.en: Did you enjoy the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafna! Il-kantant seħer lil kulħadd bil-vuċi tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafna! Il-kantant seħer lil kulħadd bil-vuċi tiegħu.
messages.zh: 非常喜欢！那个歌手的嗓音让所有人都着迷了。
messages.en: Very much! The singer captivated everyone with his voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seħer 想成舞台上的歌声像魔法一样抓住观众：作动词记“使着迷”，作名词记“魔力或魅力”。

gloss_zh: 诅咒；使惊呆；惊呆；毁掉；遭毁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curse someone by expressing a wish that misfortune should befall them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 诅咒某人，以言语表达希望对方遭遇不幸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem li bih jixtieq li tiġri xi ħaġa ħażina lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诅咒某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hope that ill fortune will befall sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望某人遭遇厄运或不幸。
使惊呆；使震惊得说不出话。
诅咒；咒骂；以言语祈求灾祸降临。
感到震惊；惊呆；惊愕得说不出话。
毁掉；使遭到毁坏或陷入败落。
被毁掉；遭到毁坏；陷入败落。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel seħet lil min kien qarraq bih u telaq mir-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, the man cursed the person who had deceived him and left the village.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男人诅咒了欺骗自己的人，然后离开了村庄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq ir-raġel fl-aħħar tal-istorja? Mark: Kien irrabjat ħafna; seħet lil min qarraq bih u telaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the man leave at the end of the story? Mark: He was very angry; he cursed the person who deceived him and left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事结尾那个男人为什么离开了？马克：他非常生气，诅咒了欺骗他的人就走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事结尾那个男人为什么离开了？
messages.en: Why did the man leave at the end of the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien irrabjat ħafna; seħet lil min qarraq bih u telaq.
messages.mt_standard: Kien irrabjat ħafna; seħet lil min qarraq bih u telaq.
messages.zh: 他非常生气，诅咒了欺骗他的人就走了。
messages.en: He was very angry; he cursed the person who deceived him and left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用故事里愤怒人物说出诅咒的画面记 seħet，再把“惊呆”和“毁掉”等义项各配一张卡片，按语境辨认。

gloss_zh: 成功；实现；完成；生效；发生

teaching_sense.en_definition: The successful realization or accomplishment of something, including its coming into effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事的成功实现或完成，也可指规定等开始生效。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twettiq jew il-kisba ta' xi ħaġa, jew il-bidu tal-validità ta' regola jew liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成功；取得预期成果。
实现；计划、努力等最终取得成果。
完成；达成；取得的成就。
生效；开始施行。
成为现实；实现。
发生；出现。

collocations.en: he brought the plan to fruition

formal.mt: Id-dħul fis-seħħ tar-regoli l-ġodda huwa previst għall-bidu tas-sena.
formal.en: The new rules are scheduled to come into effect at the beginning of the year.
formal.zh: 新规则预计于年初生效。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta jidħlu fis-seħħ ir-regoli l-ġodda? Mark: Jidħlu fis-seħħ nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: When do the new rules come into effect? Mark: They come into effect on Monday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：新规则什么时候生效？马克：星期一生效。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 新规则什么时候生效？
messages.en: When do the new rules come into effect?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 星期一生效。
messages.en: They come into effect on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seħħ 配上“计划终于落地、规则开始生效”的画面；名词记实现或生效，动词另记发生或成真。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A firm, aromatic fruit called quince, used in cooking and for making jam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为榅桲的果实，质地坚实、有香气，可用于烹饪或制作果酱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott iebes u jfuħ li jintuża fit-tisjir u biex isir il-ġamm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义未明；所给义项仅标为“??”，无法据此确定具体含义。
榅桲（一种质地较硬、有香气的果实）

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aħsel is-sfarġel, qattgħu f'biċċiet u sajru fuq nar baxx.
formal.en: For this recipe, wash the quinces, cut them into pieces and cook them over a low heat.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，先洗净榅桲，切成块，再用小火烹煮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmel b'dan is-sfarġel? Mark: Se nagħmel il-ġamm. Trid tgħinni naħslu?
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to make with these quinces? Mark: I'm going to make jam. Would you like to help me wash them?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你准备用这些榅桲做什么？Mark：我要做果酱。你愿意帮我洗一下吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备用这些榅桲做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to make with these quinces?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħmel il-ġamm. Trid tgħinni naħslu?
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħmel il-ġamm. Trid tgħinni naħslu?
messages.zh: 我要做果酱。你愿意帮我洗一下吗？
messages.en: I'm going to make jam. Would you like to help me wash them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfarġel 和厨房里坚实、有香气的榅桲一起记，再用 ġamm tas-sfarġel（榅桲果酱）巩固；标为“??”的义项保持未明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A perfectly round three-dimensional shape whose surface is equally distant from its centre, or an object with that shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面各点到中心距离相等的三维圆形几何体，也指具有这种形状的物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ġeometrika fi tliet dimensjonijiet li kull punt fuq il-wiċċ tagħha jkun fl-istess distanza miċ-ċentru, jew oġġett b'din il-forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球体；球面
球体；球形物

formal.mt: Biex jiġi kkalkulat il-volum ta' sfera, l-ewwel irid ikun magħruf ir-raġġ tagħha.
formal.en: To calculate the volume of a sphere, its radius must first be known.
formal.zh: 要计算球体的体积，必须先知道它的半径。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'forma għandu dan l-oġġett? Mark: Għandu forma ta' sfera. Qisu ballun żgħir tal-ħġieġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shape is this object? Mark: It's shaped like a sphere. It looks like a little glass ball.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个物体是什么形状的？Mark：它是球形的，看起来像一个小玻璃球。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个物体是什么形状的？
messages.en: What shape is this object?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu forma ta' sfera. Qisu ballun żgħir tal-ħġieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu forma ta' sfera. Qisu ballun żgħir tal-ħġieġ.
messages.zh: 它是球形的，看起来像一个小玻璃球。
messages.en: It's shaped like a sphere. It looks like a little glass ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里转动一颗玻璃球来记 sfera：它有立体体积，也有从中心伸向表面的半径，用这两个特点区别平面圆形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the shape of a sphere, with a surface that is equally distant from its centre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈球体形状的，表面各点到中心的距离相等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma ta' sfera, bil-wiċċ kollu fl-istess distanza miċ-ċentru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球形的；呈球状的。
球形物；呈球状的物体。

formal.mt: L-istudenti użaw mudell sferiku biex jistudjaw id-distanza bejn iċ-ċentru u l-wiċċ.
formal.en: The students used a spherical model to study the distance between the centre and the surface.
formal.zh: 学生们用一个球形模型研究中心与表面之间的距离。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema mudell għandna nagħżlu? Pawlu: Dak sferiku; jixbah ballun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which model should we choose? Pawlu: The spherical one; it looks like a ball.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们该选哪个模型？保罗：那个球形的；它看起来像个球。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我们该选哪个模型？
messages.en: Which model should we choose?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 那个球形的；它看起来像个球。
messages.en: The spherical one; it looks like a ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sferiku 和一个圆球模型放在一起记，边指模型边说 oġġett sferiku，注意它表示立体球形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's ability, determination, or courage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 考验一个人的能力、决心或勇气的困难任务或处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa xogħol jew sitwazzjoni diffiċli li tittestja l-ħila, id-determinazzjoni jew il-kuraġġ ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑战；需要付出努力、发挥能力才能应对的任务或处境。
激将；以挑战的方式要求某人敢于做某事。
向……挑战；要求对方通过比赛或行动证明能力。
公然违抗；抗拒某人的权威、命令或要求。
向……挑战；对……表示抗拒或公然违抗。
抗拒、违抗的态度或行为；向他人提出的挑战。

formal.mt: It-tlestija tal-proġett fi żmien xahar kienet sfida kbira għat-tim.
formal.en: Completing the project within a month was a major challenge for the team.
formal.zh: 在一个月内完成项目，对团队来说是一项重大挑战。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li tista' tlesti t-tiġrija? Mark: Se tkun sfida, imma rrid nipprova.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think you can finish the race? Mark: It will be a challenge, but I want to try.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你觉得自己能跑完全程吗？马克：这会是个挑战，但我想试试。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得自己能跑完全程吗？
messages.en: Do you think you can finish the race?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tkun sfida, imma rrid nipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Se tkun sfida, imma rrid nipprova.
messages.zh: 这会是个挑战，但我想试试。
messages.en: It will be a challenge, but I want to try.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己站在比赛起点说 sfida：眼前是一项挑战；再把画面换成向对手下战书，帮助区分名词和动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The degree to which the parts of a substance or the objects in a space are closely packed together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物质的组成部分或某一空间内的物体聚集得有多紧密的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad ta' kemm il-partijiet ta' sustanza jew l-oġġetti fi spazju jkunu qrib xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 密度；物质或物体分布的密集程度。
变得稠密；变得更加密集。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudent qabbel is-sfieq taż-żewġ materjali.
formal.en: In the report, the student compared the density of the two materials.
formal.zh: 学生在报告中比较了这两种材料的密度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet huma tal-istess daqs. Għaliex waħda hija itqal? Adam: Għax is-sfieq tal-materjal tagħha huwa ogħla.
colloquial.en: Nina: These two pieces are the same size. Why is one heavier? Adam: Because its material has a higher density.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这两块东西一样大，为什么其中一块更重？亚当：因为它的材料密度更高。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet huma tal-istess daqs. Għaliex waħda hija itqal?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet huma tal-istess daqs. Għaliex waħda hija itqal?
messages.zh: 这两块东西一样大，为什么其中一块更重？
messages.en: These two pieces are the same size. Why is one heavier?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax is-sfieq tal-materjal tagħha huwa ogħla.
messages.mt_standard: Għax is-sfieq tal-materjal tagħha huwa ogħla.
messages.zh: 因为它的材料密度更高。
messages.en: Because its material has a higher density.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个同样大的方框，一个点少，一个点挤得很密，用 sfieq 标出密集程度；动词义则想成点逐渐挤密。
