teaching_sense.en_definition: To spoil or damage the shape or appearance of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 损坏人或物原有的形状或外观，使其变形或容貌受损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħassar jew jagħmel ħsara lill-forma jew lid-dehra ta' persuna jew ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变形；使原有形状发生损坏性的改变。
损毁外貌；使容貌或物体外观受损。

formal.mt: L-att vandalu sfigura l-istatwa u ħalla ħsara viżibbli fuq wiċċha.
formal.en: The act of vandalism disfigured the statue and left visible damage on its face.
formal.zh: 这起蓄意破坏行为损毁了雕像的外观，并在其面部留下了明显的损伤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara lil din il-pupa? Toni: Il-kelb gidem rasha u sfigura wiċċha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to this doll? Toni: The dog bit its head and disfigured its face.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个娃娃怎么了？托尼：狗咬了它的头，把它的脸咬坏了。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 这个娃娃怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to this doll?

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb gidem rasha u sfigura wiċċha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb gidem rasha u sfigura wiċċha.
messages.zh: 狗咬了它的头，把它的脸咬坏了。
messages.en: The dog bit its head and disfigured its face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sfigura 配一张物品损坏前后的对照图：原本完整的外形被破坏，记住它强调变形或外貌受损。

gloss_zh: 油炸面点；一种炸面团点心

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of fried dough pastry, similar to Maghrebi sfanj.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种用面团油炸而成的点心，类似马格里布地区的 sfanj。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' għaġina moqlija, simili għall-isfanj tal-Magreb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油炸面点；用面糊或面团炸成的点心。

sense_translations.en_definition: a type of fried pastry, similar to Maghrebi sfanj.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种油炸面点，类似马格里布地区的 sfanj。

formal.mt: Il-menu jiddeskrivi s-sfinġa bħala għaġina moqlija li tiġi servuta sħuna.
formal.en: The menu describes the sfinġa as a fried dough pastry that is served hot.
formal.zh: 菜单将 sfinġa 描述为一种趁热供应的油炸面点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek sfinġa friska? Rita: Iva, għadni kemm qlejtha. Trid waħda?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a freshly made fritter? Rita: Yes, I have just fried it. Would you like one?
colloquial.zh: 马克：有刚做好的油炸面点吗？丽塔：有，我刚炸好。你要一个吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 有刚做好的油炸面点吗？
messages.en: Do you have a freshly made fritter?

messages.speaker: Rita (摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm qlejtha. Trid waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm qlejtha. Trid waħda?
messages.zh: 有，我刚炸好。你要一个吗？
messages.en: Yes, I have just fried it. Would you like one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象摊主递来一个热腾腾的油炸面点，接过时说 sfinġa sħuna，把词形和香热的点心画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of a picture or scene behind the main subject, or the circumstances that help explain an event or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 图片或场景中位于主体后面的部分，也指有助于理解事件或情况的背景条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' stampa jew xena wara s-suġġett ewlieni, jew iċ-ċirkostanzi li jgħinu biex nifhmu ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 背景；画面中主体后方的部分，或事件发生的相关情况。

collocations.en: in the background of the photograph

formal.mt: Il-fotografu għażel sfond abjad biex il-prodott jidher aktar ċar.
formal.en: The photographer chose a white background so that the product would stand out more clearly.
formal.zh: 摄影师选用了白色背景，让产品显得更加清晰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se nieħdu r-ritratt? Lara: Quddiem il-baħar, biex ikollna sfond sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we take the photo? Lara: In front of the sea, so we have a nice background.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里拍照？劳拉：在海边，让大海成为漂亮的背景。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里拍照？
messages.en: Where shall we take the photo?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Quddiem il-baħar, biex ikollna sfond sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Quddiem il-baħar, biex ikollna sfond sabiħ.
messages.zh: 在海边，让大海成为漂亮的背景。
messages.en: In front of the sea, so we have a nice background.

cognitive_memory_aid: 拿一张人物照，把人物后面的景色圈起来写上 sfond；再联想到故事背后的情况，也是帮助理解主体的背景。

gloss_zh: 不幸的；倒霉的；倒霉的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Experiencing bad luck or affected by an unhappy or unfavourable event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭遇坏运气的，或受到不幸、不利事件影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu xorti ħażina jew li jintlaqat minn ġrajja ħażina jew sfavorevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不幸的；令人遗憾的；处于不利境况的。
运气不好的；倒霉的。
倒霉的人；遭遇不幸的人。

formal.mt: Minħabba inċident sfortunat, il-vjaġġ kellu jiġi pospost.
formal.en: Because of an unfortunate accident, the trip had to be postponed.
formal.zh: 由于发生了一起不幸的事故，行程不得不推迟。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja b'minuta! Nina: Kemm kont sfortunat! Ejja nistennew dik li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I missed the bus by a minute! Nina: How unlucky you were! Let's wait for the next one.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我差一分钟就赶上公交车了！妮娜：你真倒霉！我们等下一班吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我差一分钟就赶上公交车了！
messages.en: I missed the bus by a minute!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm kont sfortunat! Ejja nistennew dik li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm kont sfortunat! Ejja nistennew dik li jmiss.
messages.zh: 你真倒霉！我们等下一班吧。
messages.en: How unlucky you were! Let's wait for the next one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfortunat 配上刚错过公交车的表情，记成运气不佳；修饰事故时，可根据语气译成不幸的或令人遗憾的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The physical or mental energy used to do something difficult, or the strain caused by using that energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为完成困难的事情而付出的体力或脑力，也指这种付出造成的负荷或压力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-enerġija fiżika jew mentali li tintuża biex isir xi ħaġa diffiċli, jew it-tensjoni li tirriżulta minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过度用力造成的负担；身体或精神承受的紧张。
努力；为实现目标而进行的认真尝试。
努力；为做成某事而付出的体力或脑力。
负荷、压力；身体或精神因承受要求而产生的紧张。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat jirrifletti l-isforz kontinwu tal-istudenti matul is-sena.
formal.en: The result reflects the students' sustained effort throughout the year.
formal.zh: 这一结果体现了学生们整年来持续付出的努力。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Din il-kaxxa tqila wisq; ma nistax nerfagħha waħdi. Sara: Nerfgħuha flimkien, biex kull wieħed minna jagħmel inqas sforz.
colloquial.en: Toni: This box is too heavy; I can't lift it on my own. Sara: Let's lift it together so that each of us needs to use less effort.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：这个箱子太重了，我一个人抬不起来。萨拉：我们一起抬吧，这样每个人都能少费点力气。

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kaxxa tqila wisq; ma nistax nerfagħha waħdi.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kaxxa tqila wisq; ma nistax nerfagħha waħdi.
messages.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人抬不起来。
messages.en: This box is too heavy; I can't lift it on my own.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nerfgħuha flimkien, biex kull wieħed minna jagħmel inqas sforz.
messages.mt_standard: Nerfgħuha flimkien, biex kull wieħed minna jagħmel inqas sforz.
messages.zh: 我们一起抬吧，这样每个人都能少费点力气。
messages.en: Let's lift it together so that each of us needs to use less effort.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手抬重箱时付出的力气，把 sforz 记成努力与用力；再想象用力过久的紧绷感，连接负荷和压力的义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exert great effort, strain something, or pressure someone into doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用很大的力气或努力；使身体部位过度用力；也指施加压力，迫使某人做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel sforz kbir, għabba parti tal-ġisem iżżejjed, jew ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使过度用力；使承受过大的负荷。
强迫；用强力使某事发生。
催促；力劝某人采取行动。
迫使；使某人不得不做某事。
努力；奋力争取某个目标。
折断；扭伤。
使出力气；尽力而为。

collocations.mt: sforza lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa
collocations.en: he forced someone to do something

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskors, il-kelliem sforza leħnu biex jinstema' minn kulħadd.
formal.en: During the speech, the speaker strained his voice so that everyone could hear him.
formal.zh: 演讲时，发言人为让所有人听见而过度用嗓。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex leħnek hekk illum? Pawlu: Ilbieraħ sforzajt leħni fil-logħba. Għajjatna ħafna!
colloquial.en: Marta: Why does your voice sound like that today? Pawlu: I strained my voice at the match yesterday. We shouted a lot!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你今天的嗓子怎么这样？保罗：昨天看比赛时我喊得太用力了。我们喊了好久！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天的嗓子怎么这样？
messages.en: Why does your voice sound like that today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbieraħ sforzajt leħni fil-logħba. Għajjatna ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Ilbieraħ sforzajt leħni fil-logħba. Għajjatna ħafna!
messages.zh: 昨天看比赛时我喊得太用力了。我们喊了好久！
messages.en: I strained my voice at the match yesterday. We shouted a lot!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和“用力”这一画面绑定：对自己用力是努力，对嗓子用力过头是劳损，对别人施压则是强迫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break something violently into pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用猛烈的撞击或打击把某物弄碎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kisser xi ħaġa f'biċċiet b'daqqa jew b'forza kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砸碎；猛烈撞坏。
使碎裂；打得粉碎。

formal.mt: Il-ġebla laqtet il-ħġieġ b'forza kbira u sfrakassat it-tieqa.
formal.en: The stone struck the glass with great force and shattered the window.
formal.zh: 石头猛烈击中玻璃，把窗户砸碎了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Mark: Il-ballun sfrakassa t-tieqa. Ejja nsejħu lil missieri.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that noise? Mark: The ball smashed the window. Let's call my dad.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刚才那是什么声音？马克：球把窗户打碎了。我们叫我爸爸来吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才那是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ballun sfrakassa t-tieqa. Ejja nsejħu lil missieri.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ballun sfrakassa t-tieqa. Ejja nsejħu lil missieri.
messages.zh: 球把窗户打碎了。我们叫我爸爸来吧。
messages.en: The ball smashed the window. Let's call my dad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花瓶受到重击后碎片四散；这个词强调猛烈地弄碎，可用“砰的一下碎了”来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become unruly or distracted, or to disrupt something or drive someone or something away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得不受控制或注意力分散；也可指打乱安排，或把人、动物赶走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar bla dixxiplina jew tilef il-konċentrazzjoni; ukoll ħarbat pjan jew keċċa lil xi ħadd jew lil xi annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: to go wild (e.g. of an animal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发狂；变得狂躁失控，例如动物突然不受控制。
分心；注意力被转移。
使分心；分散某人的注意力。
变得不守纪律；变得难以管束。
打乱计划；使原有安排无法照常进行。

sense_translations.en_definition: to scare away, to drive away
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吓走；驱赶离开。

formal.mt: Il-maltemp sfratta l-pjan tal-organizzaturi, u l-attività ġiet posposta.
formal.en: The bad weather disrupted the organisers' plan, and the event was postponed.
formal.zh: 恶劣天气打乱了主办方的计划，活动因此延期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma mortux il-baħar? Toni: Ix-xita sfrattat il-pjan tagħna. Bqajna d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you go to the beach? Toni: The rain disrupted our plan. We stayed home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们怎么没去海边？托尼：下雨打乱了我们的计划。我们待在家里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们怎么没去海边？
messages.en: Why didn't you go to the beach?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xita sfrattat il-pjan tagħna. Bqajna d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xita sfrattat il-pjan tagħna. Bqajna d-dar.
messages.zh: 下雨打乱了我们的计划。我们待在家里了。
messages.en: The rain disrupted our plan. We stayed home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原来的秩序散了”串联词义：动物失控、学生分心、计划被打乱、鸟被吓散；具体含义要看主语和宾语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who owns something or has authority over a household or property.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有某物的人，或对家庭、房屋等具有支配权的主人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha xi ħaġa tagħha jew li għandha l-awtorità fuq dar jew proprjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主人；具有支配或管理权的人。
所有者；物主。
领主；主人；所有者，具体含义由上下文决定。

formal.mt: Sid il-ħanut għandu jiżgura li l-prezzijiet jidhru ċar.
formal.en: The shop owner must ensure that the prices are clearly displayed.
formal.zh: 店主必须确保价格标示清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu sid dan il-kelb? Mark: Jien. Jismu Max.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who owns this dog? Mark: I do. His name is Max.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁是这只狗的主人？Mark：是我。它叫Max。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁是这只狗的主人？
messages.en: Who owns this dog?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.zh: 是我。它叫Max。
messages.en: I do. His name is Max.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把房屋钥匙交给主人的画面与 sid 联系起来，再用“房主、店主、物主”三个场景巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The front part of the body between the neck and the abdomen; also a woman's breasts considered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体前侧位于颈部与腹部之间的胸部；也可集合地指女性的乳房。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' quddiem tal-ġisem bejn l-għonq u ż-żaqq; ukoll is-sider tal-mara bħala ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胸部；颈部与腹部之间的身体前侧部分。
乳房；此处指女性乳房。
女性的乳房整体；对女性双乳的集合称呼。

formal.mt: L-istudenti studjaw il-muskoli tas-sider waqt il-lezzjoni tal-anatomija.
formal.en: The students studied the chest muscles during the anatomy lesson.
formal.zh: 学生们在解剖课上学习了胸部肌肉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn trid il-logo fuq il-flokk? Mark: Fuq is-sider, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you want the logo on the shirt? Mark: On the chest, on the left.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想把标志放在上衣的哪个位置？Mark：胸前左侧。

messages.speaker: Maja (印衣店店员)
messages.zh: 你想把标志放在上衣的哪个位置？
messages.en: Where do you want the logo on the shirt?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 胸前左侧。
messages.en: On the chest, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上衣胸前印着 sider：先记“胸部”，再记它也能整体指女性乳房，具体靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the breast or chest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与乳房或胸部有关的，用于修饰相应的身体部位或结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与乳房有关的。
胸部的；胸肌的。
陡峭的；坡度很大的。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-pożizzjoni ta' muskolu sidri fil-ġisem.
formal.en: The diagram shows the position of a pectoral muscle in the body.
formal.zh: 这幅示意图展示了一块胸肌在身体中的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'sidri' hawn? Pawlu: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sider, bħal f''muskolu sidri'.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'sidri' mean here? Pawlu: It means relating to the chest, as in 'pectoral muscle'.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 sidri 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是与胸部有关，比如“胸肌”中的“胸部的”。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 sidri 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sidri' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sider, bħal f''muskolu sidri'.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sider, bħal f''muskolu sidri'.
messages.zh: 意思是与胸部有关，比如“胸肌”中的“胸部的”。
messages.en: It means relating to the chest, as in 'pectoral muscle'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sidri 放在胸肌示意图旁记“胸部的”；另画一条陡坡单独记“陡峭的”，不要把两个义项混成一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sleeveless garment worn over the upper body, such as a waistcoat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在上半身的无袖衣物，如马甲或背心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies mingħajr kmiem li tintlibes fuq il-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马甲；通常穿在衬衫外面的无袖上衣。
无袖背心。
胸甲；保护躯干或胸部的铠甲。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi sidrija tal-ħadid flimkien ma' elmu.
formal.en: The museum displays an iron breastplate together with a helmet.
formal.zh: 博物馆将一件铁制胸甲与一顶头盔一同展出。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din is-sidrija tmur ma' din il-qmis? Lara: Iva, u tista' tilbes ġakketta fuqha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this waistcoat go with this shirt? Lara: Yes, and you can wear a jacket over it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这件马甲配这件衬衫吗？Lara：配，而且外面还可以穿一件夹克。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-sidrija tmur ma' din il-qmis?
messages.mt_standard: Din is-sidrija tmur ma' din il-qmis?
messages.zh: 这件马甲配这件衬衫吗？
messages.en: Does this waistcoat go with this shirt?

messages.speaker: Lara (服装店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u tista' tilbes ġakketta fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u tista' tilbes ġakketta fuqha.
messages.zh: 配，而且外面还可以穿一件夹克。
messages.en: Yes, and you can wear a jacket over it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衣架上挂着无袖马甲，旁边展柜里放着胸甲：用这两个覆盖躯干的物件记住 sidrija 的不同义项。

gloss_zh: 女主人；女性所有者；女士；夫人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who owns something, such as a house or a shop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有房屋、商店或其他物品的女性；女主人或女性所有者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li għandha xi ħaġa tagħha, bħal dar jew ħanut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女性所有者；女主人。
女物主；女性所有者，是 sid 的阴性形式。
女士；夫人，用于指称或尊称女性。

collocations.en: the female owner of the house
the female owner of the shop

formal.mt: Sidt il-ħanut iffirmat il-ftehim il-ġdid.
formal.en: The female shop owner signed the new agreement.
formal.zh: 女店主签署了新的协议。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Int sidt il-ħanut? Rita: Iva. Kif nista' ngħinek?
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you the owner of the shop? Rita: Yes. How can I help you?
colloquial.zh: Mark：您是这家店的女店主吗？Rita：是的。有什么可以帮您？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 您是这家店的女店主吗？
messages.en: Are you the owner of the shop?

messages.speaker: Rita (女店主)
messages.zh: 是的。有什么可以帮您？
messages.en: Yes. How can I help you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sid 与 sidt 做成一对词卡：sid 记主人，sidt 配女店主拿钥匙的画面，突出女性身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to endure waiting, difficulty, or suffering calmly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能平静地忍受等待、困难或痛苦的；有耐心或能忍耐的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiflaħ għat-tbatija jew għall-istennija bil-kalma u bis-sabar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有耐心的；能忍耐等待或困难的。
无奈接受现实的；对难以改变的处境隐忍顺受的。

formal.mt: Minkejja d-dewmien, ir-raġel baqa' sieber u stenna t-tweġiba.
formal.en: Despite the delay, the man remained patient and waited for the reply.
formal.zh: 尽管有所延误，那名男子仍耐心等待答复。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadna rridu nistennew? Pawlu: Iva. Ibqa' sieber, dalwaqt imissna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we still have to wait? Pawlu: Yes. Stay patient; it will be our turn soon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们还得等吗？Pawlu：是的。耐心一点，很快就轮到我们了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还得等吗？
messages.en: Do we still have to wait?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的。耐心一点，很快就轮到我们了。
messages.en: Yes. Stay patient; it will be our turn soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象排队时平静等待的人，把 sieber 与“耐心忍耐”绑定；若语境强调无可奈何，则理解为隐忍接受。

gloss_zh: 谦逊的；卑微的；地位低下的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Humble or modest, without pride or a desire to appear important.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谦逊、不自夸的，不刻意表现自己地位或重要性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Umli, mingħajr kburija u mingħajr ma jiftaħar bih innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谦虚的；不自夸的。
卑微的；身份或地位低下的。
谦卑的；谦逊的；不骄傲自大的。

formal.mt: Minkejja s-suċċess tiegħu, l-awtur baqa' siefel u rringrazzja lil dawk li għenuh.
formal.en: Despite his success, the author remained humble and thanked those who had helped him.
formal.zh: 尽管取得了成功，这位作家仍保持谦逊，并感谢帮助过他的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu rebaħ il-premju u lanqas semmieh! Rita: Iva, hu bniedem siefel; ma jħobbx jiftaħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu won the prize and did not even mention it! Rita: Yes, he is a humble person; he does not like to boast.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu得了奖，居然连提都没提！Rita：是啊，他很谦逊，不喜欢自夸。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu rebaħ il-premju u lanqas semmieh!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu rebaħ il-premju u lanqas semmieh!
messages.zh: Pawlu得了奖，居然连提都没提！
messages.en: Pawlu won the prize and did not even mention it!

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu bniedem siefel; ma jħobbx jiftaħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu bniedem siefel; ma jħobbx jiftaħar.
messages.zh: 是啊，他很谦逊，不喜欢自夸。
messages.en: Yes, he is a humble person; he does not like to boast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“得奖后仍不自夸”的人物画面记 siefel 的谦逊义；另记地位低微义，区分品格与社会处境。

gloss_zh: 出国；旅行；离开；移居国外；去世（委婉语）；出岔子（委婉语）；出口

teaching_sense.en_definition: To travel some distance, generally to another country in the Maltese context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 前往较远的地方旅行；在马耳他语境中通常指到国外去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur fuq vjaġġ lejn post imbiegħed, ġeneralment barra minn Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出国；到国外去。
旅行；出行。
离开；启程离去。
移居国外；迁往另一国家生活。
去世；以委婉方式表示死亡。
出岔子；事情偏离预期或出现问题的委婉说法。

sense_translations.en_definition: to journey, travel, make a trip of some distance (in the Maltese context generally implying going abroad)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 远行；旅行；进行一段距离较远的旅程，在马耳他语境中通常意味着出国。
出口；将货物运往国外。

collocations.en: he travelled abroad with his family

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur siefer lejn l-Italja biex jieħu sehem f'konferenza.
formal.en: The researcher travelled to Italy to take part in a conference.
formal.zh: 这位研究人员前往意大利参加会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Mark? Ilu ma jidher. Pawlu: Siefer mal-familja. Jirritorna nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Mark? We have not seen him for a while. Pawlu: He went abroad with his family. He returns on Monday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark在哪里？有一阵子没见到他了。Pawlu：他和家人出国了，星期一回来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu Mark? Ilu ma jidher.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu Mark? Ilu ma jidher.
messages.zh: Mark在哪里？有一阵子没见到他了。
messages.en: Where is Mark? We have not seen him for a while.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他和家人出国了，星期一回来。
messages.en: He went abroad with his family. He returns on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象提着行李出国的旅客来记 siefer；例句中的 siefer 表示“他出国了”。移民、去世和出岔子等义项须结合具体语境辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of time equal to sixty minutes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小时，等于六十分钟的时间单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' ħin li fiha sittin minuta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小时。
小时，计量时间的单位，等于六十分钟。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ddum siegħa, mid-disgħa sal-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will last an hour, from nine to ten in the morning.
formal.zh: 会议将持续一小时，从上午九点到十点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandna ħin qabel il-film? Mark: Għandna siegħa. Nistgħu nieħdu kafè.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much time do we have before the film? Mark: We have an hour. We can have a coffee.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影开始前还有多久？马克：还有一个小时。我们可以喝杯咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影开始前还有多久？
messages.en: How much time do we have before the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 还有一个小时。我们可以喝杯咖啡。
messages.en: We have an hour. We can have a coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把时钟走完一圈的六十分钟画在脑中，配上 siegħa；再用 nofs siegħa 记住半小时。

gloss_zh: 不说话的；无声的；安静的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not speaking or making a sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不说话或不发出声音的；沉默的，安静的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jitkellimx jew ma jagħmilx ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不能说话的；不出声的。
沉默的；无声的；安静的。

formal.mt: Matul il-preżentazzjoni, Mark baqa' sieket biex ma jfixkilx lill-kelliem.
formal.en: During the presentation, Mark remained silent so as not to disturb the speaker.
formal.zh: 演讲期间，马克一直保持安静，以免打扰发言者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int sieket illum? Mark: Għajjien biss. Qed nisma' dak li qed tgħid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you quiet today? Mark: I am just tired. I am listening to what you are saying.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天怎么这么安静？马克：只是有点累。我在听你说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么安静？
messages.en: Why are you quiet today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għajjien biss. Qed nisma' dak li qed tgħid.
messages.mt_standard: Għajjien biss. Qed nisma' dak li qed tgħid.
messages.zh: 只是有点累。我在听你说话。
messages.en: I am just tired. I am listening to what you are saying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把手指放在嘴边示意安静，给画面贴上 sieket；日常沉默不一定表示不能说话。

gloss_zh: 借出钱款；有钱被人欠着

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lend money, or to be owed money by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱借给别人，或处于别人欠自己钱的状态；具体含义由语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti flus b'self, jew ikollu flus li ħaddieħor għadu jrid iroddlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借出钱款；把钱借给别人。
被人欠钱；别人有钱尚未归还给自己。

collocations.en: to lend money to a friend

formal.mt: Fl-istudju tal-verb 'siel', għandna niddistingwu bejn l-għoti ta' flus b'self u l-fatt li persuna jkollha flus x'tiġbor mingħand ħaddieħor.
formal.en: When studying the verb 'siel', we should distinguish between lending money and having money owed to one by someone else.
formal.zh: 学习动词 siel 时，应区分把钱借出去这一行为，以及别人尚欠自己钱这一状态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Siel' jista' jfisser li xi ħadd għad għandu jieħu flus lura? Mark: Iva, jista' jfisser hekk, u jista' jfisser ukoll li ta flus b'self. Ħares lejn il-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can 'siel' mean that someone still has money to receive back? Mark: Yes, it can mean that, and it can also mean that the person lent money. Look at the context.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：siel 可以表示某人还有借出去的钱没收回来吗？马克：可以，也可以表示他借出了钱。要看语境。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Siel' jista' jfisser li xi ħadd għad għandu jieħu flus lura?
messages.mt_standard: 'Siel' jista' jfisser li xi ħadd għad għandu jieħu flus lura?
messages.zh: siel 可以表示某人还有借出去的钱没收回来吗？
messages.en: Can 'siel' mean that someone still has money to receive back?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jista' jfisser hekk, u jista' jfisser ukoll li ta flus b'self. Ħares lejn il-kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jista' jfisser hekk, u jista' jfisser ukoll li ta flus b'self. Ħares lejn il-kuntest.
messages.zh: 可以，也可以表示他借出了钱。要看语境。
messages.en: Yes, it can mean that, and it can also mean that the person lent money. Look at the context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从自己钱包指向别人的箭头：钱借出后，别人就欠自己钱；用这两个相连画面记住两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A foot, or a leg, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脚，也可指腿；具体所指的身体部位取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġisem li fuqha nirfsu, jew ir-riġel, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脚，身体接触地面并承重的部位。
腿，用于站立和行走的肢体。
脚；腿，具体含义依语境而定。

collocations.zh: 单腿站立；用一条腿支撑

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, it-tabib osserva nefħa fis-sieq tal-lemin tal-pazjent.
formal.en: During the examination, the doctor observed swelling in the patient's right foot.
formal.zh: 检查时，医生发现患者的右脚有肿胀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex neħħejt iż-żarbun? Mark: Għandi ġebla żgħira fih u qed tweġġagħli sieqi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you take your shoe off? Mark: There is a small stone in it, and it is hurting my foot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把鞋脱了？马克：里面有颗小石子，硌得我脚疼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把鞋脱了？
messages.en: Why did you take your shoe off?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ġebla żgħira fih u qed tweġġagħli sieqi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ġebla żgħira fih u qed tweġġagħli sieqi.
messages.zh: 里面有颗小石子，硌得我脚疼。
messages.en: There is a small stone in it, and it is hurting my foot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sieq 放进穿鞋与单腿站立两幅画：穿鞋想到脚，单腿站立想到腿，再由上下文确定范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A channel or aqueduct that carries water from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将水从一处输送到另一处的水渠或输水道，也可指渡槽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanal jew akwedott li jwassal l-ilma minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水渠；供水流通过的渠道。
输水道；渡槽，用于将水输送至另一地点的设施。
输水道；渡槽；水渠。

formal.mt: Is-sieqja twassal l-ilma mill-ġibjun sal-għelieqi għall-irrigazzjoni.
formal.en: The water channel carries water from the reservoir to the fields for irrigation.
formal.zh: 这条水渠把蓄水池的水送到田地，用于灌溉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn jasal l-ilma għal din l-għalqa? Pawlu: Minn dik is-sieqja. Ara kif l-ilma miexi fiha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does the water for this field come from? Pawlu: From that channel. Look at the water flowing through it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块田的水是从哪里来的？保罗：从那条水渠来的。你看，水正沿着它流过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn jasal l-ilma għal din l-għalqa?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn jasal l-ilma għal din l-għalqa?
messages.zh: 这块田的水是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where does the water for this field come from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn dik is-sieqja. Ara kif l-ilma miexi fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Minn dik is-sieqja. Ara kif l-ilma miexi fiha.
messages.zh: 从那条水渠来的。你看，水正沿着它流过来。
messages.en: From that channel. Look at the water flowing through it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给水铺了一条专用道路，从蓄水池一直通向田地；把这条输水的路标成 sieqja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To persist, or to keep following someone closely and persistently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚持不放弃；也可指持续紧跟某人、尾随不离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' jinsisti jew ikompli jsegwi lil xi ħadd bla ma jieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚持；持续不懈。
地基；基础。
基础；根基；作为事物依据或支撑的部分。

sense_translations.en_definition: to follow persistently, to tail after
sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续紧跟；尾随；跟着不离开。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-kelma 'sies', għandna niddistingwu l-verb, li jista' jfisser li wieħed jippersisti jew isegwi lil xi ħadd bla waqfien, min-nom li jfisser bażi jew pedament.
formal.en: When analysing 'sies', we should distinguish the verb, which can mean to persist or follow someone continually, from the noun meaning a basis or foundation.
formal.zh: 分析 sies 时，应区分表示坚持或持续跟随某人的动词，与表示基础或地基的名词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'sies sod' hawn? Mark: Bażi b'saħħitha. Hawnhekk 'sies' huwa nom, iżda jista' jkun ukoll verb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'sies sod' mean here? Mark: A strong foundation. Here 'sies' is a noun, but it can also be a verb.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 sies sod 是什么意思？马克：坚实的基础。这里 sies 是名词，不过它也可以是动词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 sies sod 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sies sod' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Bażi b'saħħitha. Hawnhekk 'sies' huwa nom, iżda jista' jkun ukoll verb.
messages.mt_standard: Bażi b'saħħitha. Hawnhekk 'sies' huwa nom, iżda jista' jkun ukoll verb.
messages.zh: 坚实的基础。这里 sies 是名词，不过它也可以是动词。
messages.en: A strong foundation. Here 'sies' is a noun, but it can also be a verb.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张分开的记忆卡：名词画房屋地基，动词画坚持前行或紧跟的人；同形词要分别记义。

gloss_zh: 结伴；与人合作；朋友；伙伴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join someone as a partner or associate someone with an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人结为伙伴，或使某人作为伙伴参与一项活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaqad ma' xi ħadd bħala sieħeb jew idaħħal lil xi ħadd miegħu f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结成伙伴；与人搭档。
使某人参与或加入；将某人纳为合作伙伴。
朋友。
伙伴；同伴。
搭档；合作伙伴。
同伴；交往或合作的人；伙伴；追随者。

formal.mt: Mark sieħeb lil Pawlu fil-proġett biex jaqsmu x-xogħol u r-responsabbiltà.
formal.en: Mark brought Pawlu into the project as a partner so that they could share the work and responsibility.
formal.zh: 马克让保罗作为伙伴加入项目，以便共同分担工作与责任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu s-sieħeb tiegħek għal dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Pawlu. Se naħdmu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is your partner for this exercise? Mark: Pawlu. We are going to work together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这次练习谁和你搭档？马克：保罗。我们会一起做。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu s-sieħeb tiegħek għal dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu s-sieħeb tiegħek għal dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这次练习谁和你搭档？
messages.en: Who is your partner for this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗。我们会一起做。
messages.en: Pawlu. We are going to work together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人并肩完成任务：作动词是结伴合作，作名词是身旁的伙伴；用场景区分词性。

gloss_zh: 芒；谷穗上须状的细长部分

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slender, bristle-like projection on an ear of grain; an awn or beard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谷穗上像细须一样伸出的细长部分，称为芒或芒须。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti rqiqa u tawwalija, qisha lanżita, li toħroġ mis-sbula ta' xi ċereali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芒；芒须，指谷穗上伸出的须状细长部分。

formal.mt: L-istudent osserva s-sifja tax-xgħir b'lenti u ddeskriva l-għamla twila u rqiqa tagħha.
formal.en: The student examined the barley awn with a magnifying glass and described its long, slender shape.
formal.zh: 学生用放大镜观察大麦的芒，并描述了它细长的形状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-parti twila u rqiqa fuq is-sbula? Pawlu: Dik sifja. Ara kemm hi fina.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that long, thin part on the ear of grain? Pawlu: That is an awn. Look how fine it is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谷穗上那根细长的东西是什么？保罗：那是芒。你看它多细。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-parti twila u rqiqa fuq is-sbula?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-parti twila u rqiqa fuq is-sbula?
messages.zh: 谷穗上那根细长的东西是什么？
messages.en: What is that long, thin part on the ear of grain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik sifja. Ara kemm hi fina.
messages.mt_standard: Dik sifja. Ara kemm hi fina.
messages.zh: 那是芒。你看它多细。
messages.en: That is an awn. Look how fine it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象谷穗长出细细的胡须，把其中一根标成 sifja；这里的 beard 用植物的须状外形来理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small roll of tobacco wrapped in thin paper for smoking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用薄纸包裹烟草、供吸食的小卷，即香烟或卷烟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Roll żgħir tat-tabakk imgeżwer f'karta rqiqa, magħmul biex jitpejjep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香烟；用薄纸卷成的烟草制品。

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur intalab jitfi s-sigarett qabel ma jidħol fil-bini.
formal.en: The visitor was asked to put out his cigarette before entering the building.
formal.zh: 访客被要求在进入大楼前熄灭香烟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek qed tpejjep sigarett? Mark: Le, diġà tfejtu. Nistgħu nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still smoking a cigarette? Mark: No, I've already put it out. We can go in.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还在抽烟吗？Mark：没有，我已经把烟熄灭了。我们可以进去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在抽烟吗？
messages.en: Are you still smoking a cigarette?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，我已经把烟熄灭了。我们可以进去了。
messages.en: No, I've already put it out. We can go in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一支细长、外包白纸的香烟来记sigarett，再连着记抽烟和熄烟两个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A roll of tobacco wrapped in tobacco leaf for smoking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以烟叶包裹烟草制成、供吸食的卷状烟草制品，即雪茄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Roll tat-tabakk imgeżwer f'werqa tat-tabakk, magħmul biex jitpejjep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雪茄；以烟叶包裹烟草制成的烟卷。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, ir-raġel iżomm sigarru f'idu l-leminija.
formal.en: In the photograph, the man holds a cigar in his right hand.
formal.zh: 照片中，那名男子右手拿着一支雪茄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak sigarett jew sigarru? Mark: Sigarru. Ara kemm hu oħxon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a cigarette or a cigar? Mark: A cigar. Look how thick it is.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是香烟还是雪茄？Mark：是雪茄。你看它多粗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是香烟还是雪茄？
messages.en: Is that a cigarette or a cigar?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是雪茄。你看它多粗。
messages.en: A cigar. Look how thick it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把sigarru配上棕色烟叶包裹的雪茄图，再和纸包香烟sigarett并排记忆，帮助区分两词。

gloss_zh: 秘密；秘密的；偷偷摸摸的；阴茎

teaching_sense.en_definition: Information that is kept from other people or shared only with a limited group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不向其他人公开，或只让少数人知道的信息，即秘密。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Informazzjoni li tinżamm moħbija minn oħrajn jew li tkun magħrufa biss minn ftit nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘密；未公开或只让少数人知道的事情。
偷偷摸摸的；为避免被人发现而暗中进行的。
秘密的；不公开的；不让其他人知道的。
阴茎；男性的外生殖器官。

formal.mt: Il-pjan baqa' sigriet sakemm il-kumitat approva l-proposta.
formal.en: The plan remained secret until the committee approved the proposal.
formal.zh: 在委员会批准提案之前，该计划一直保密。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' ngħidlek sigriet? Mark: Żgur. Mhux se ngħidu lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I tell you a secret? Mark: Of course. I won't tell anyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我能告诉你一个秘密吗？Mark：当然。我不会告诉任何人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能告诉你一个秘密吗？
messages.en: Can I tell you a secret?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Mhux se ngħidu lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Mhux se ngħidu lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 当然。我不会告诉任何人。
messages.en: Of course. I won't tell anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用低声说秘密的画面记住sigriet；搭配pjan时表示秘密的。阴茎这一名词义另列记忆，并靠语境辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protection from danger or harm, including measures used to keep people, places, or things secure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 免受危险或伤害的安全状态，也指保障人员、场所或物品安全的措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħarsien mill-periklu jew mill-ħsara, inklużi miżuri biex in-nies, il-postijiet u l-affarijiet ikunu protetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安全；安保；防止危险、伤害或未经许可进入的保障。

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu jsegwi r-regoli tas-sigurtà waqt l-eżerċizzju ta' evakwazzjoni.
formal.en: Staff must follow the safety rules during the evacuation drill.
formal.zh: 工作人员在疏散演习期间必须遵守安全规则。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għas-sigurtà tiegħek, aqfel iċ-ċinturin. Mark: Sewwa, issa nqaflu.
colloquial.en: Maja: For your safety, fasten your seat belt. Mark: All right, I'll fasten it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为了你的安全，把安全带系好。Mark：好的，我现在就系。

messages.speaker: Maja (司机)
messages.zh: 为了你的安全，把安全带系好。
messages.en: For your safety, fasten your seat belt.

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.zh: 好的，我现在就系。
messages.en: All right, I'll fasten it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把sigurtà放在安全带和门口安保的两幅画面中，记住它既能讲人身安全，也能讲保护措施。

gloss_zh: 变得消瘦；变得骨瘦如柴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very thin, especially to the point of looking gaunt or emaciated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得非常瘦，尤其指瘦到显得憔悴或骨瘦如柴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irqiq ħafna, tant li jidher nieqes mil-laħam u dgħajjef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得瘦削憔悴；瘦得面容或身形显得凹陷。
变得很瘦；变得瘦巴巴。
变得极度消瘦；瘦得骨瘦如柴。

collocations.zh: 他因饥饿而变得极度消瘦

collocations.en: he became gaunt after the illness

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel sikem wara żmien twil mingħajr biżżejjed ikel.
formal.en: In the story, the man became emaciated after a long period without enough food.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子长时间吃不饱，变得骨瘦如柴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu sikem ħafna minn meta rajnieh l-aħħar. Mark: Iva, kien marid għal żmien twil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has become very thin since we last saw him. Mark: Yes, he was ill for a long time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：自从我们上次见到Pawlu以后，他消瘦了很多。Mark：是啊，他病了很长时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu sikem ħafna minn meta rajnieh l-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu sikem ħafna minn meta rajnieh l-aħħar.
messages.zh: 自从我们上次见到Pawlu以后，他消瘦了很多。
messages.en: Pawlu has become very thin since we last saw him.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien marid għal żmien twil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien marid għal żmien twil.
messages.zh: 是啊，他病了很长时间。
messages.en: Yes, he was ill for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物从原来体形变得明显消瘦的前后对照图记sikem，重点记住这是变瘦的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become drunk after drinking alcohol; also, of trees, to be overwatered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因饮酒而进入醉酒状态；也用于树木，表示被浇了过多的水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol fis-sakra wara li jixrob l-alkoħol; jintuża wkoll għal siġar li jingħataw wisq ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝醉；因饮酒而进入醉酒状态。
树木被浇水过多；树木受到过量灌溉。

collocations.en: he got drunk at the party

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-mistieden siker waqt l-ikla u telaq kmieni.
formal.en: In the story, the guest got drunk during the meal and left early.
formal.zh: 故事中，那位客人在用餐期间喝醉了，并提早离开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark siker ilbieraħ? Pawlu: Iva, ħadtu d-dar b'taxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark get drunk yesterday? Pawlu: Yes, I took him home in a taxi.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark昨天喝醉了吗？Pawlu：是的，我坐出租车送他回家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark昨天喝醉了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark get drunk yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我坐出租车送他回家了。
messages.en: Yes, I took him home in a taxi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把siker分别配上人喝醉和树木浇水过多的两张词义卡；这是帮助分义的学习画面，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 保持沉默；平静下来；停止或减弱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be silent, to calm down, or, of an activity or disturbance, to cease or abate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不说话或不出声；平静下来；也指活动、响动或扰动停止或减弱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jitkellimx jew ma jagħmilx ħoss; jikkalma; jew, għal attività jew taqlib, jieqaf jew jonqos.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保持沉默；不说话或不出声。
平静下来；安静下来。
停止；平息；强度减弱。

collocations.en: he was silent for a while

formal.mt: Wara li r-riħ siket, il-ħaddiema komplew ix-xogħol barra.
formal.en: After the wind died down, the workers continued their work outside.
formal.zh: 风平息后，工人们继续在室外工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tifel siket issa? Mark: Iva, waqaf jibki u qed jisma' l-istorja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the boy calmed down now? Mark: Yes, he has stopped crying and is listening to the story.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个男孩现在安静下来了吗？Mark：是的，他不哭了，正在听故事。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 那个男孩现在安静下来了吗？
messages.en: Has the boy calmed down now?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waqaf jibki u qed jisma' l-istorja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waqaf jibki u qed jisma' l-istorja.
messages.zh: 是的，他不哭了，正在听故事。
messages.en: Yes, he has stopped crying and is listening to the story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把siket记成声音渐弱的画面：人不说话、孩子不再哭、风声平息，分别对应沉默、平静和停止。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sandbank or submerged rock that may obstruct boats.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水中的沙洲或水面以下的礁石，可能妨碍船只通行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda ta' ramel jew blata taħt wiċċ l-ilma li tista' tfixkel il-passaġġ tad-dgħajjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙洲；水中由沙堆积形成的浅滩。

sense_translations.en_definition: rock below the surface of the water
sense_translations.zh_definition: 水面以下的岩石；水下礁石。
犁；用于翻耕土地的农具。

sense_translations.en_definition: rock below the surface of the sea
sense_translations.zh_definition: 海面以下的岩石；海中暗礁。
犁铧；犁上切入并翻开土壤的部件。
礁；水下岩石；沙洲。

formal.mt: Il-kaptan biddel ir-rotta biex jevita sikka taħt wiċċ il-baħar.
formal.en: The captain changed course to avoid a rock below the sea's surface.
formal.zh: 船长改变航线，以避开海面以下的一处暗礁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqqaft id-dgħajsa? Mark: Hemm sikka quddiemna. Irridu nduru magħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop the boat? Mark: There's a submerged rock ahead of us. We need to go around it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把船停下了？马克：前面有暗礁，我们得绕过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把船停下了？
messages.en: Why did you stop the boat?

messages.speaker: Mark (船主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm sikka quddiemna. Irridu nduru magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm sikka quddiemna. Irridu nduru magħha.
messages.zh: 前面有暗礁，我们得绕过去。
messages.en: There's a submerged rock ahead of us. We need to go around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sikka 放进小船绕开暗礁的画面中记忆；遇到农耕语境时，另外联想犁和犁铧，不把两类词义混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something troublesome or annoying, including persistent demands that bother someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人感到麻烦或厌烦的事情，也可指不断提出要求而造成的纠缠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa li ddejjaq jew toħloq inkonvenjent, inkluża insistenza li tfixkel lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烦人的事物；造成麻烦或不便的人或事。
限制；使行动或选择受到约束的条件。
纠缠不休；令人厌烦的反复请求或强求。

formal.mt: It-telefonati ripetuti saru sikkatura għall-ħaddiema waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The repeated phone calls became a nuisance for the staff during the meeting.
formal.zh: 开会期间，接连不断的电话给员工造成了烦扰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Reġa' ċempel biex jistaqsi l-istess ħaġa! Pawlu: Xi sikkatura! Għidlu li diġà bgħatt it-tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Lara: He called again to ask the same thing! Pawlu: What a nuisance! Tell him you've already sent the answer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他又打电话来问同一个问题了！保罗：真烦人！告诉他，你已经把答复发过去了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Reġa' ċempel biex jistaqsi l-istess ħaġa!
messages.mt_standard: Reġa' ċempel biex jistaqsi l-istess ħaġa!
messages.zh: 他又打电话来问同一个问题了！
messages.en: He called again to ask the same thing!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi sikkatura! Għidlu li diġà bgħatt it-tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Xi sikkatura! Għidlu li diġà bgħatt it-tweġiba.
messages.zh: 真烦人！告诉他，你已经把答复发过去了。
messages.en: What a nuisance! Tell him you've already sent the answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电话一次次响起，你忍不住说“真烦人”；用这个场景记住 sikkatura 的烦扰和纠缠义，再单独记住其限制义。

gloss_zh: 使安静；使噤声；让某人住嘴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone stop speaking or making noise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人停止说话或发出声音；使其安静下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jieqaf jitkellem jew jagħmel l-istorbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使安静；使停止说话或发声。
让某人住嘴；使某人不再说话。
使噤声；使安静下来。

formal.mt: Il-president sikket lill-folla qabel beda d-diskors.
formal.en: The president quieted the crowd before beginning the speech.
formal.zh: 总统开始讲话前，先让人群安静下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sikket lit-tfal? David: Missierhom. Qalilhom li t-tarbija kienet rieqda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who quieted the children? David: Their father. He told them the baby was asleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁让孩子们安静下来了？戴维：他们的爸爸。他告诉他们，小宝宝正在睡觉。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁让孩子们安静下来了？
messages.en: Who quieted the children?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Missierhom. Qalilhom li t-tarbija kienet rieqda.
messages.mt_standard: Missierhom. Qalilhom li t-tarbija kienet rieqda.
messages.zh: 他们的爸爸。他告诉他们，小宝宝正在睡觉。
messages.en: Their father. He told them the baby was asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sikket 记成一个动作画面：大人竖起手指示意安静，孩子停止吵闹；重点是“让别人安静下来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a blade and a handle, used for cutting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有刀刃和手柄、用来切割东西的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'xafra u manku li tintuża biex taqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刀；刀子，用于切割的工具。

formal.mt: Il-kok uża sikkina taqta' biex iqatta' l-ħaxix f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: The cook used a sharp knife to cut the vegetables into small pieces.
formal.zh: 厨师用一把锋利的刀把蔬菜切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hi s-sikkina tal-ħobż? Mark: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, ħdejn l-imgħaref.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where's the bread knife? Mark: In the top drawer, next to the spoons.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：面包刀在哪里？马克：在最上面的抽屉里，勺子旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 面包刀在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the bread knife?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在最上面的抽屉里，勺子旁边。
messages.en: In the top drawer, next to the spoons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sikkina 和厨房里切面包的刀联系起来；边想象刀刃切下面包片，边复述“sikkina，刀子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Often or on many occasions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事发生很多次，频率较高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' spiss; f'ħafna okkażjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常；时常。
经常；频繁地，表示某事发生的次数较多。

formal.mt: L-istudenti li jaqraw sikwit jiltaqgħu ma' kliem ġdid f'kuntesti differenti.
formal.en: Students who read often encounter new words in different contexts.
formal.zh: 经常阅读的学生会在不同语境中接触到新词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tiġi hawn sikwit? Pawlu: Iva, niġi darbtejn jew tliet darbiet fil-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you come here often? Pawlu: Yes, I come two or three times a week.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你经常来这里吗？保罗：是的，我每周来两三次。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你经常来这里吗？
messages.en: Do you come here often?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi darbtejn jew tliet darbiet fil-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi darbtejn jew tliet darbiet fil-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我每周来两三次。
messages.en: Yes, I come two or three times a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上想象同一活动反复出现，用 sikwit 标注“经常”；它说明发生频率，不表示某一次持续很久。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone something temporarily, expecting it to be returned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物暂时交给别人使用，并期望对方归还。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd għal żmien limitat, bil-ħsieb li tingħata lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借出；把钱或物品暂时借给别人，并期望归还。

collocations.en: he lent a book to a friend
he lent the money to his brother

formal.mt: L-għalliem silef ktieb lill-istudent biex ikun jista' jlesti r-riċerka.
formal.en: The teacher lent a book to the student so that he could complete the research.
formal.zh: 老师借给学生一本书，让他能够完成研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġibt dan il-ktieb? Sara: Pawlu silef dan il-ktieb lili. Irrid nagħtihulu lura nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you get this book? Sara: Pawlu lent it to me. I need to give it back to him on Monday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你这本书是从哪里来的？萨拉：保罗借给我的。我得在星期一还给他。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你这本书是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did you get this book?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu silef dan il-ktieb lili. Irrid nagħtihulu lura nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu silef dan il-ktieb lili. Irrid nagħtihulu lura nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 保罗把这本书借给了我。我得在星期一还给他。
messages.en: Pawlu lent this book to me. I need to give it back to him on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己把书递给朋友，并在日历上写好归还日期；silef 的动作方向是从出借人手中交给别人。

gloss_zh: 久别归来；久候后到达；安享平静

teaching_sense.en_definition: To return after a long absence or arrive after a long wait; also to experience a peaceful time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长时间离开后归来，或在漫长等待后到达；也可表示度过平静的时光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' lura wara assenza twila jew jasal wara stennija twila; ukoll jgħaddi żmien fil-paċi.

sense_translations.en_definition: to return after a long absence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 久别归来；在长时间离开之后返回。

sense_translations.en_definition: to go through a peaceful time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 度过一段平静安宁的时光。

sense_translations.en_definition: to arrive after a long wait
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在漫长等待后终于到达。
享有安宁；安享平静的生活或状态。

collocations.en: he returned after a long absence
he arrived after a long wait
collocations.zh: 经过漫长等待，他终于到了

formal.mt: Wara assenza ta' ħafna snin, il-vjaġġatur silem fir-raħal fejn twieled.
formal.en: After an absence of many years, the traveller returned to the village where he was born.
formal.zh: 离开多年后，这位旅行者回到了自己出生的村庄。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ħuk għadu barra minn Malta? Mark: Le, fl-aħħar silem! Wasal ilbieraħ wara tant snin.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is your brother still abroad? Mark: No, he's finally back! He arrived yesterday after so many years.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你兄弟还在国外吗？马克：没有，他终于回来了！隔了这么多年，他昨天到家了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟还在国外吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still abroad?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fl-aħħar silem! Wasal ilbieraħ wara tant snin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fl-aħħar silem! Wasal ilbieraħ wara tant snin.
messages.zh: 没有，他终于回来了！隔了这么多年，他昨天到家了。
messages.en: No, he's finally back! He arrived yesterday after so many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面记 silem：一张是久别亲人终于进门，另一张是安静度日；分别对应归来或到达，以及安享平静。

gloss_zh: 提取；抽出；拔出；使变薄；分离；从中取得；感动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To extract or draw something out, either physically or by obtaining meaning from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物取出、抽出或拔出；也可指从材料或经历中提取意义、结论等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ jew jiġbed xi ħaġa minn ġo xi ħaġa oħra; ukoll jikseb tifsira jew tagħlima minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提取；取出。
抽出；拉出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to extract, draw out, pull out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 提取；抽出；拔出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to thin, to make something thin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变薄；使某物变细。
使分离；使脱离原来连接或附着的地方。
从某处取走；从某物中取得。
在情感上触动；使感动。

collocations.en: he extracted a passage from the book
collocations.zh: 他从书中摘录了一段文字

collocations.en: he drew a lesson from the experience
collocations.zh: 他从这次经历中汲取了教训

formal.mt: L-awtur silet silta minn dokument storiku biex juri kif kienet il-ħajja f'dak iż-żmien.
formal.en: The author extracted a passage from a historical document to show what life was like at that time.
formal.zh: 作者从一份历史文献中摘录了一段文字，用来展示当时的生活状况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel Pawlu wara dak l-iżball? David: Silet tagħlima minnu. Issa jiċċekkja kollox qabel jibda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Pawlu do after that mistake? David: He drew a lesson from it. Now he checks everything before starting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：犯了那个错误以后，保罗做了什么？戴维：他从中吸取了教训。现在他开始之前会把一切都检查一遍。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 犯了那个错误以后，保罗做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do after that mistake?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Silet tagħlima minnu. Issa jiċċekkja kollox qabel jibda.
messages.mt_standard: Silet tagħlima minnu. Issa jiċċekkja kollox qabel jibda.
messages.zh: 他从中吸取了教训。现在他开始之前会把一切都检查一遍。
messages.en: He drew a lesson from it. Now he checks everything before starting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“从书里抽出一段文字、从经历里提取一个教训”记住 silet 的常用义；变薄、分离和感动义则分场景另记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of pronunciation within a word, usually organized around a vowel sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词语发音中的一个单位，通常以一个元音为中心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità fil-pronunzja ta' kelma, ġeneralment mibnija madwar ħoss ta' vokali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音节；词语中可以按发音节拍划分的语音单位。

collocations.en: to divide a word into syllables

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jaqsmu kull kelma f'sillabi u jgħoddu kemm fiha.
formal.en: In the exercise, students should divide each word into syllables and count how many it contains.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应把每个词划分成音节，并数出音节的数量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm fiha sillabi l-kelma 'kelma'? Pawlu: Tnejn: kel-ma. Ċapċap darba għal kull sillaba.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many syllables are there in the word 'kelma'? Pawlu: Two: kel-ma. Clap once for each syllable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“kelma”这个词有几个音节？保罗：两个，kel-ma。每念一个音节就拍一下手。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “kelma”这个词有几个音节？
messages.en: How many syllables are there in the word 'kelma'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnejn: kel-ma. Ċapċap darba għal kull sillaba.
messages.mt_standard: Tnejn: kel-ma. Ċapċap darba għal kull sillaba.
messages.zh: 两个，kel-ma。每念一个音节就拍一下手。
messages.en: Two: kel-ma. Clap once for each syllable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 sillaba 时边念词边拍手：一拍对应一个音节，用嘴巴的节奏帮助记住“音节”这个概念。

gloss_zh: 节选；摘录；小薄片；体态匀称

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short passage taken from a longer text or work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从较长文章或作品中选取的一小段内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti qasira meħuda minn test jew xogħol itwal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节选；从文章、书籍或其他作品中选出的一段。
小薄片；切下的一小片。
摘录；节选；从较长作品中抽取的一部分。
体态匀称；身形优美。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jaqraw is-silta magħżula u jispjegaw l-idea ewlenija tagħha.
formal.en: Students should read the selected passage and explain its main idea.
formal.zh: 学生应阅读选定的段落，并解释其中心思想。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tridni naqra l-istorja kollha? Toni: Le, aqra biss is-silta fl-ewwel paġna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want me to read the whole story? Toni: No, just read the excerpt on the first page.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你要我读完整个故事吗？托尼：不用，只读第一页上的节选就行。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 你要我读完整个故事吗？
messages.en: Do you want me to read the whole story?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, aqra biss is-silta fl-ewwel paġna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, aqra biss is-silta fl-ewwel paġna.
messages.zh: 不用，只读第一页上的节选就行。
messages.en: No, just read the excerpt on the first page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用书中圈出的一小段记住 silta 的“节选”，再另设“小薄片”和“体态匀称”两张词义卡，避免把不同义项混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The dark outline or shape of a person or object seen against a lighter background.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或物在较亮背景前呈现的深色外形或轮廓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma jew il-kontorn skur ta' persuna jew oġġett li jidher fuq sfond aktar ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剪影；衬在明亮背景上的暗色外形或轮廓。

collocations.en: a silhouette against a light background

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher is-silwett ta' siġra fuq l-isfond ċar tas-sema.
formal.en: The photograph shows the silhouette of a tree against the bright sky.
formal.zh: 照片中，一棵树的剪影映衬在明亮的天空前。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hemm ħdejn it-tieqa? Adam: Ma nafx; minn hawn nara biss silwett.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is there by the window? Adam: I don't know; from here I can only see a silhouette.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：窗边是谁？亚当：不知道；从这里我只能看见一个剪影。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边是谁？
messages.en: Who is there by the window?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; minn hawn nara biss silwett.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; minn hawn nara biss silwett.
messages.zh: 不知道；从这里我只能看见一个剪影。
messages.en: I don't know; from here I can only see a silhouette.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 silwett 想成逆光照片中的黑色人形：看得见外轮廓，看不清内部细节，这就是“剪影”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frozen water, especially ice; also snow or hail in weather contexts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 冻结的水，主要指冰；在天气语境中也可指雪或冰雹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma ffriżat; skont il-kuntest, jista' jfisser ukoll borra jew ħalbiet ta' ilma ffriżat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冰；水冻结后形成的固体。
雪；从天空降下的白色冰晶。
冰；冰雹，即从云中降下的冰粒或冰块。

formal.mt: Meta t-temperatura togħla, is-silġ jibda jdub u jinbidel f'ilma.
formal.en: When the temperature rises, the ice begins to melt and turns into water.
formal.zh: 温度升高时，冰开始融化并变成水。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid ftit silġ fl-ilma? Lara: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, żewġ kubi biss.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like some ice in your water? Lara: Yes, please, just two cubes.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你的水里要加点冰吗？拉拉：好的，谢谢，两块就行。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的水里要加点冰吗？
messages.en: Would you like some ice in your water?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, żewġ kubi biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, żewġ kubi biss.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，两块就行。
messages.en: Yes, please, just two cubes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 silġ 放进三个画面记忆：杯中的冰、地上的雪、落下的冰雹；结合天气或饮料语境判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reed or rush vegetation, including the plant known as soft rush.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 芦苇或灯心草类植物，也可特指灯心草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qasab jew pjanti simili tas-simar, fosthom il-pjanta magħrufa bħala Juncus effusus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芦苇；生长于潮湿地带的苇类植物。
灯心草（学名 Juncus effusus）。

collocations.en: reeds or rushes beside the water
the stems of reeds or rushes

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara, l-istudenti osservaw is-simar li kien jikber fil-ħamrija niedja ħdejn l-għadira.
formal.en: During the visit, the students observed the rushes growing in the damp soil beside the pond.
formal.zh: 参观期间，学生们观察了生长在池塘边湿润土壤中的灯心草。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jissejħu dawk il-pjanti ħdejn l-għadira? Pawlu: Dak hu simar. Ejja nħarsu lejh mingħajr ma naqtgħuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are those plants beside the pond called? Pawlu: Those are rushes. Let's look at them without picking them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：池塘边那些植物叫什么？保罗：那是灯心草。我们看看就好，别把它们摘下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jissejħu dawk il-pjanti ħdejn l-għadira?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jissejħu dawk il-pjanti ħdejn l-għadira?
messages.zh: 池塘边那些植物叫什么？
messages.en: What are those plants beside the pond called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu simar. Ejja nħarsu lejh mingħajr ma naqtgħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu simar. Ejja nħarsu lejh mingħajr ma naqtgħuh.
messages.zh: 那是灯心草。我们看看就好，别把它们摘下来。
messages.en: Those are rushes. Let's look at them without picking them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 simar 与池塘边成片直立的植物联系起来；记住它可指芦苇，也有特指灯心草的义项，辨义时结合植物名称和语境。

gloss_zh: 象征性的；具有象征意义的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Representing an idea or meaning through a sign, object, or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过符号、物品或行为表达某种观念或意义的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirrappreżenta idea jew tifsira permezz ta' sinjal, oġġett jew azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 象征性的；表达某种象征意义的。
具有象征意义的；以象征方式表达观念的。

formal.mt: It-tħawwil tas-siġra kien ġest simboliku ta' tama u kooperazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ skejjel.
formal.en: Planting the tree was a symbolic gesture of hope and cooperation between the two schools.
formal.zh: 植树是一个象征希望与两校合作的举动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tajtu dik iċ-ċavetta? Mark: Kien rigal simboliku biex infakkru l-bidu l-ġdid tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you give him that key? Mark: It was a symbolic gift to mark his new beginning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么送他那把钥匙？马克：那是一份有象征意义的礼物，用来纪念他的新开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么送他那把钥匙？
messages.en: Why did you give him that key?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien rigal simboliku biex infakkru l-bidu l-ġdid tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien rigal simboliku biex infakkru l-bidu l-ġdid tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那是一份有象征意义的礼物，用来纪念他的新开始。
messages.en: It was a symbolic gift to mark his new beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“礼物承载心意”的画面记 simboliku：重点在物品或举动表达的意义。搭配 ġest simboliku 一起记，更容易掌握形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sign, object, or image that represents an idea, quality, or other meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表某种观念、性质或其他意义的符号、物品或图像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sinjal, oġġett jew xbieha li jirrappreżenta idea, kwalità jew tifsira oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 符号；象征；用来代表某种意义的标记或事物。

formal.mt: F'dan il-poster, il-ħamiema tintuża bħala simbolu tal-paċi.
formal.en: In this poster, the dove is used as a symbol of peace.
formal.zh: 在这张海报中，鸽子被用作和平的象征。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser dan is-simbolu fuq il-mappa? Toni: Juri fejn hemm sptar.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does this symbol on the map mean? Toni: It shows where there is a hospital.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：地图上的这个符号是什么意思？托尼：它表示医院的位置。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 地图上的这个符号是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this symbol on the map mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.zh: 它表示医院的位置。
messages.en: It shows where there is a hospital.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到地图上的小标记，就联想 simbolu：一个小图形代表一个地点或意义；再用“和平的象征”扩展到抽象用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become fatter or gain weight; also, for a material such as wood, to swell after absorbing water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体变胖或体重增加；也指木材等材料吸水后膨胀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żied fil-piż jew sar aktar oħxon; jingħad ukoll għal injam li nefħet il-forma tiegħu wara li xorob l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变胖；身体逐渐变得肥胖。

sense_translations.en_definition: to swell (e.g. of wood, as a result of water absorption)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 膨胀；例如木材因吸收水分而胀大。

sense_translations.en_definition: to put on weight, to stout
sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重增加；长胖；变得粗壮。

collocations.en: the wood swelled from absorbing water

formal.mt: Wara li assorba l-ilma, l-injam tal-bieb simen u l-bieb ma baqax jingħalaq sew.
formal.en: After absorbing water, the wood of the door swelled, and the door no longer closed properly.
formal.zh: 门的木材吸水后膨胀，导致门无法正常关好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-qalziet ta' Adam għadu jiġih? Lara: Le, simen ftit u issa għandu bżonn wieħed akbar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do Adam's trousers still fit him? Lara: No, he has gained a little weight and now needs a larger pair.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：亚当的裤子还合身吗？拉拉：不合身了，他稍微胖了一点，现在需要一条更大的。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 亚当的裤子还合身吗？
messages.en: Do Adam's trousers still fit him?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, simen ftit u issa għandu bżonn wieħed akbar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, simen ftit u issa għandu bżonn wieħed akbar.
messages.zh: 不合身了，他稍微胖了一点，现在需要一条更大的。
messages.en: No, he has gained a little weight and now needs a larger pair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个“变大”的画面记 simen：人的腰围增加、木门吸水胀大。例句中的 simen 可对应“他变胖了”或“它膨胀了”，看主语判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building material that becomes hard when mixed with water and is used to bind other materials together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种加水后会凝固变硬的建筑材料，用来黏结其他材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal tal-bini li jibbies meta jitħallat mal-ilma u jintuża biex jgħaqqad materjali oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水泥。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema ħalltu s-siment mal-ilma skont l-istruzzjonijiet fuq ix-xkora.
formal.en: The workers mixed the cement with water according to the instructions on the bag.
formal.zh: 工人们按照袋子上的说明将水泥与水混合。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm għandna bżonn siment? Pawlu: Xkora waħda għandha tkun biżżejjed għal din it-tiswija.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much cement do we need? Pawlu: One bag should be enough for this repair.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们需要多少水泥？保罗：这次修补用一袋应该就够了。

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.zh: 我们需要多少水泥？
messages.en: How much cement do we need?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Xkora waħda għandha tkun biżżejjed għal din it-tiswija.
messages.mt_standard: Xkora waħda għandha tkun biżżejjed għal din it-tiswija.
messages.zh: 这次修补用一袋应该就够了。
messages.en: One bag should be enough for this repair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siment 配上“一袋水泥”的工地画面，连同 xkora siment 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The balanced arrangement of parts that match in shape, size, or position on opposite sides or around a centre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各部分在两侧或围绕中心，以形状、大小或位置相互对应的均衡关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament bilanċjat li fih il-partijiet jaqblu fil-forma, fid-daqs jew fil-pożizzjoni fuq naħat opposti jew madwar ċentru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对称；各部分在形状、大小或位置上相互对应的性质。

formal.mt: Id-disinn tal-faċċata juri simetrija bejn in-naħa tax-xellug u dik tal-lemin.
formal.en: The design of the façade shows symmetry between the left and right sides.
formal.zh: 建筑正面的设计呈现出左右两侧的对称。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm simetrija f'dan it-tpinġija? Lara: Iva, iż-żewġ naħat huma l-istess.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there symmetry in this drawing? Lara: Yes, the two sides are the same.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画是对称的吗？拉拉：是的，两边一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这幅画是对称的吗？
messages.en: Is there symmetry in this drawing?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，两边一样。
messages.en: Yes, the two sides are the same.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 simetrija 时想象把蝴蝶沿中线对折，两边重合就是“对称”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Body fat or the condition of being fat or stout; also the process of making a person or animal fatter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体的肥胖、肥壮状态或体脂；也可指使人或动物长胖、育肥的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xaħam tal-ġisem jew l-istat ta' min hu oħxon; ukoll il-proċess li bih persuna jew annimal jissemmnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体的脂肪；肥胖状态。
体态肥壮；身体较胖的状态。
肥胖；使人或动物长胖、育肥的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-simna tal-annimali u l-bidliet fil-piż tagħhom matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report describes the animals' fatness and the changes in their weight over the year.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这些动物的肥胖程度及其一年中的体重变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-veterinarju semma s-simna żejda tal-kelb. Mark: Mela nistaqsuh kemm għandu jiekol kuljum.
colloquial.en: Lara: The vet mentioned the dog's excessive fatness. Mark: Then let's ask him how much the dog should eat each day.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：兽医提到了狗狗过度肥胖的问题。马克：那我们问问他，狗狗每天应该吃多少。

messages.speaker: Lara (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 兽医提到了狗狗过度肥胖的问题。
messages.en: The vet mentioned the dog's excessive fatness.

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nistaqsuh kemm għandu jiekol kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nistaqsuh kemm għandu jiekol kuljum.
messages.zh: 那我们问问他，狗狗每天应该吃多少。
messages.en: Then let's ask him how much the dog should eat each day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 simna 放在体重记录旁记忆：既能说肥胖状态，也能说让动物长胖的育肥过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of understanding and concern for someone, or a feeling of fondness and liking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人的处境表示理解和关切的同情，或对某人某物产生的好感与喜爱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' fehim u mogħdrija lejn xi ħadd, jew ta' għożża u ġibda lejn persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同情；对他人处境的理解与关切。
好感；喜爱；对某人某物的亲近之情。

collocations.en: to have a liking for someone

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera wrew simpatija lejn il-familja li tilfet darha.
formal.en: The volunteers showed sympathy towards the family that had lost its home.
formal.zh: 志愿者们向失去家园的家庭表达了同情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi simpatija kbira għal din l-għalliema. Lara: Jien ukoll, dejjem tismagħna bil-paċenzja.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm very fond of this teacher. Lara: Me too; she always listens to us patiently.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我很喜欢这位老师。拉拉：我也是，她总是耐心听我们说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi simpatija kbira għal din l-għalliema.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi simpatija kbira għal din l-għalliema.
messages.zh: 我很喜欢这位老师。
messages.en: I'm very fond of this teacher.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 我也是，她总是耐心听我们说话。
messages.en: Me too; she always listens to us patiently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 simpatija：安慰遇到困难的人是同情，愿意亲近喜欢的人是好感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Friendly, pleasant, and easy to like.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 待人友善、令人愉快且容易让人产生好感的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu dħuli, ta' kumpanija pjaċevoli u li faċli togħġbok il-personalità tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和蔼可亲的；待人友善的。
和蔼的；讨人喜欢的；容易使人产生好感的。

formal.mt: Il-gwida kien simpatiku u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tal-viżitaturi bil-paċenzja.
formal.en: The guide was amiable and answered the visitors' questions patiently.
formal.zh: 那位导游和蔼可亲，耐心回答了游客们的问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sibt lill-kollega l-ġdid? Maja: Simpatiku ħafna! Għenni mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you think of the new colleague? Maja: Very likeable! He helped me straight away.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得新同事怎么样？玛雅：很讨人喜欢！他马上就帮了我。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你觉得新同事怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the new colleague?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 很讨人喜欢！他马上就帮了我。
messages.en: Very likeable! He helped me straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位微笑着主动帮忙的同事，用 kollega simpatiku 记住“讨人喜欢的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become hard through baking, especially when bread remains in an oven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因烘烤而变硬，尤其指面包在烤箱中被烤硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar iebes minħabba l-ħami, speċjalment meta l-ħobż idum fil-forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烘烤至变硬；烤得发硬。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become hard (especially said of bread in an oven)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变硬，尤指面包在烤箱中因烘烤而变硬。

collocations.en: the bread became hard through baking

formal.mt: Il-ħobż sineġ għax tħalla fil-forn għal ħin twil wisq.
formal.en: The bread became hard because it was left in the oven for too long.
formal.zh: 面包因为在烤箱中放得太久而烤硬了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dan il-ħobż daqshekk iebes? Lara: Sineġ għax insejtu fil-forn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is this bread so hard? Lara: It became hard through baking because I forgot it in the oven.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这面包怎么这么硬？拉拉：我把它忘在烤箱里，烤硬了。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 这面包怎么这么硬？
messages.en: Why is this bread so hard?

messages.speaker: Lara (做饭的家人)
messages.zh: 我把它忘在烤箱里，烤硬了。
messages.en: It became hard through baking because I forgot it in the oven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sineġ 连到面包忘在烤箱里的画面：烘烤时间太长，面包就变硬。

gloss_zh: 路标；标志；迹象；表示；信号

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that gives information or indicates something else, such as a road sign, a visible mark, a token, or a signal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供信息或指示其他事物的东西，如道路标志、可见记号、表达心意的表示或传递信息的信号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħti informazzjoni jew tindika xi ħaġa oħra, bħal tabella fit-triq, marka, ġest jew messaġġ biex xi ħadd jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 道路标志；交通指示牌。
标志；迹象；指示某种情况的事物。
表示；象征某种心意或关系的事物。
标记；记号；可辨认的痕迹。
信号；用于传递信息或指示行动的示意。

formal.mt: Is-sinjal tat-traffiku jindika li s-sewwieqa għandhom jieqfu qabel jidħlu fit-triq prinċipali.
formal.en: The traffic sign indicates that drivers must stop before entering the main road.
formal.zh: 该交通标志指示驾驶员在驶入主路前必须停车。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se nkun naf meta nibda? Lara: Nagħtik sinjal b'idi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How will I know when to start? Lara: I'll give you a signal with my hand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎么知道什么时候开始？拉拉：我会用手给你发信号。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nkun naf meta nibda?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nkun naf meta nibda?
messages.zh: 我怎么知道什么时候开始？
messages.en: How will I know when to start?

messages.speaker: Lara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 我会用手给你发信号。
messages.en: I'll give you a signal with my hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看见它就明白意思”串起 sinjal：路标告诉方向，记号帮助辨认，手势传递信号。

gloss_zh: 先生；绅士；主人；富有的；富人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A polite title placed before a man's name, equivalent to Mr.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在男子姓名前的礼貌称谓，相当于“先生”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlu ta' kortesija li jitqiegħed qabel isem raġel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 先生；置于男子姓名前的称谓。
先生；用于男子姓名前的礼貌称谓。
绅士；有礼貌、举止得体的男子。
先生；对男子的尊称。
富有的；拥有较多财富的。
经济宽裕的；生活富足的。
先生；用于直接称呼男子的礼貌用语。
领主；主人；具有支配地位的人。
富人；有钱的男子。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjur Borg se jattendi l-laqgħa bħala rappreżentant tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: Mr Borg will attend the meeting as the company's representative.
formal.zh: 博尔格先生将作为公司代表出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Bonġu, Sinjur Borg. Għandek appuntament? Mark: Iva, għandi appuntament fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Good morning, Mr Borg. Do you have an appointment? Mark: Yes, I have an appointment at ten.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：早上好，博尔格先生。您有预约吗？马克：有，我约的是十点。

messages.speaker: Maja (接待员)
messages.zh: 早上好，博尔格先生。您有预约吗？
messages.en: Good morning, Mr Borg. Do you have an appointment?

messages.speaker: Mark Borg (访客)
messages.zh: 有，我约的是十点。
messages.en: Yes, I have an appointment at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按位置记 sinjur：姓名前的 Sinjur Borg 是“博尔格先生”，raġel sinjur 中则描述男子“富有”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A basin with a water supply and a drain, used for washing dishes or other objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 配有供水和排水设施、用于洗碗或清洗物品的水槽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħawt b'vit tal-ilma u fossa, li jintuża biex jinħaslu l-platti jew oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水槽；用于洗涤并可排水的槽盆。

formal.mt: Wara l-użu, naddaf is-sink tal-kċina u neħħi l-fdalijiet tal-ikel.
formal.en: After use, clean the kitchen sink and remove any food scraps.
formal.zh: 使用后，请清洁厨房水槽并清除食物残渣。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-platti? Pawlu: Poġġihom fis-sink, jekk jogħġbok. Naħsilhom jien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where should I put these dishes? Pawlu: Put them in the sink, please. I'll wash them.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这些碗碟放在哪里？Pawlu：请放进水槽，我来洗。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 这些碗碟放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these dishes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġihom fis-sink, jekk jogħġbok. Naħsilhom jien.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġihom fis-sink, jekk jogħġbok. Naħsilhom jien.
messages.zh: 请放进水槽，我来洗。
messages.en: Put them in the sink, please. I'll wash them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sink 与厨房洗碗的画面绑定，连着记 is-sink tal-kċina，看到水槽就回想整组词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the hard structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing; also a tooth-shaped part of an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 口腔中用于咬断和咀嚼的牙齿，也可指物体上类似牙齿的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mill-partijiet iebsin fil-ħalq li jintużaw biex niggdim u nomogħdu; ukoll parti ta' oġġett li tixbah sinna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牙齿；口腔中用于咬和咀嚼的坚硬结构。
任何齿状部分，如梳子、锯子或齿轮上的齿。

formal.mt: Id-dentist eżamina s-sinna li kienet qed tweġġa' lill-pazjenta.
formal.en: The dentist examined the tooth that was hurting the patient.
formal.zh: 牙医检查了那位女患者疼痛的牙齿。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qed tweġġagħni sinna. Mark: Ċempel lid-dentist u agħmel appuntament.
colloquial.en: Anna: I have a tooth that hurts. Mark: Call the dentist and make an appointment.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我有颗牙在疼。Mark：给牙医打电话预约吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我有颗牙在疼。
messages.en: I have a tooth that hurts.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 给牙医打电话预约吧。
messages.en: Call the dentist and make an appointment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一颗牙标上 sinna，再画梳子上的一个齿，借共同的齿形同时记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个词意义相同或相近的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li għandha l-istess tifsira jew tifsira qrib ħafna ta' kelma oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同义词；与另一词意义相同或相近的词。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, ikteb sinonimu għal kull kelma fil-lista.
formal.en: In this exercise, write a synonym for each word in the list.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，请为列表中的每个词写一个同义词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taf sinonimu ta' 'ferħan'? David: Iva, 'kuntent' għandu tifsira simili.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you know a synonym of 'ferħan'? David: Yes, 'kuntent' has a similar meaning.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你知道 ferħan 的同义词吗？David：知道，kuntent 的意思相近。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 你知道 ferħan 的同义词吗？
messages.en: Do you know a synonym of 'ferħan'?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 知道，kuntent 的意思相近。
messages.en: Yes, 'kuntent' has a similar meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferħan 和 kuntent 并排写在同一张快乐表情卡上，中间标 sinonimu，记住近义关系。

gloss_zh: 脊柱；支柱；链条；马衔链；系列

teaching_sense.en_definition: The column of bones along the back; also a supporting backbone, a chain, or a connected series.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 背部由椎骨组成的脊柱；也可指起支撑作用的主干、链条或相互关联的系列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kolonna tal-għadam tul id-dahar; ukoll dak li jagħti appoġġ ewlieni, katina jew sensiela ta' affarijiet marbuta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脊柱；沿背部排列、支撑身体的椎骨结构。
脊梁；也可比喻某个组织或事物的支柱、主干。
脊柱；脊梁，即背部的主要骨性支撑结构。
链条；由相互连接的链环组成的物件。
马衔链；马具中置于马下颌处、配合衔铁发挥控制作用的链条。
系列；一连串按顺序或相互关联的事物。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi n-negozji ż-żgħar bħala s-sinsla tal-ekonomija lokali.
formal.en: The report describes small businesses as the backbone of the local economy.
formal.zh: 报告将小企业描述为当地经济的支柱。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi tfisser 'sinsla' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser l-appoġġ ewlieni, bħalma s-sinsla tad-dahar tagħti appoġġ lill-ġisem.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does 'sinsla' mean here? Pawlu: Here it means the main support, just as the spine supports the body.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这里的 sinsla 是什么意思？Pawlu：这里指主要支撑，就像脊柱支撑身体一样。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 sinsla 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sinsla' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser l-appoġġ ewlieni, bħalma s-sinsla tad-dahar tagħti appoġġ lill-ġisem.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser l-appoġġ ewlieni, bħalma s-sinsla tad-dahar tagħti appoġġ lill-ġisem.
messages.zh: 这里指主要支撑，就像脊柱支撑身体一样。
messages.en: Here it means the main support, just as the spine supports the body.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用串联图记忆：椎骨排成脊柱，链环连成链条，事件组成系列；支柱义另联想身体的支撑。这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rules and structures governing how words combine to form phrases and sentences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支配词语如何组合成短语和句子的规则与结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-regoli u l-istrutturi li jirregolaw kif il-kliem jingħaqad biex jifforma frażijiet u sentenzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 句法；语法中研究词语如何组合成短语和句子的部分。
句法；词语或符号按规则组合形成结构的方式。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jispjega s-sintassi tal-Malti permezz ta' eżempji qosra u ċari.
formal.en: This chapter explains Maltese syntax through short, clear examples.
formal.zh: 本章通过简短清晰的例句讲解马耳他语句法。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex din is-sentenza tidher stramba? Mark: Ejja niċċekkjaw is-sintassi u l-ordni tal-kliem.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does this sentence look strange? Mark: Let's check the syntax and the word order.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这句话为什么看起来怪怪的？Mark：我们检查一下句法和词序吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话为什么看起来怪怪的？
messages.en: Why does this sentence look strange?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw is-sintassi u l-ordni tal-kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw is-sintassi u l-ordni tal-kliem.
messages.zh: 我们检查一下句法和词序吧。
messages.en: Let's check the syntax and the word order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把单词写成可移动卡片，排列成句子时说 sintassi，用词语如何组合的动作记住句法。

gloss_zh: 句法（名词义）；句法的（形容词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Syntax: the organization of words into phrases and sentences and the relationships between their parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 句法：词语组成短语和句子的组织方式，以及各部分之间的关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni tal-kliem fi frażijiet u sentenzi u r-relazzjonijiet bejn il-partijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 句法；词语组合成短语、句子时的结构与关系。
句法的；与句子结构、词语组合及其关系有关的。

formal.mt: L-analiżi identifikat żball sintattiku fit-tieni sentenza tal-paragrafu.
formal.en: The analysis identified a syntactic error in the second sentence of the paragraph.
formal.zh: 分析发现该段第二句存在一个句法错误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan żball fl-ortografija? David: Le, huwa żball sintattiku. Il-kliem miktub sew, iżda l-istruttura tas-sentenza trid tinbidel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a spelling error? David: No, it's a syntactic error. The words are spelled correctly, but the sentence structure needs to change.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这是拼写错误吗？David：不是，是句法错误。单词拼写正确，但句子结构需要调整。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这是拼写错误吗？
messages.en: Is this a spelling error?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa żball sintattiku. Il-kliem miktub sew, iżda l-istruttura tas-sentenza trid tinbidel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa żball sintattiku. Il-kliem miktub sew, iżda l-istruttura tas-sentenza trid tinbidel.
messages.zh: 不是，是句法错误。单词拼写正确，但句子结构需要调整。
messages.en: No, it's a syntactic error. The words are spelled correctly, but the sentence structure needs to change.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两栏记词性：名词栏写句法，形容词栏写句法的；再用 żball sintattiku 整组记住形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made artificially by combining substances, especially to produce a material resembling a natural one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过人工组合物质制成的，尤指用来替代或模拟天然材料的合成材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul artifiċjalment billi jingħaqdu sustanzi, speċjalment biex jinħoloq materjal li jixbah wieħed naturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合成的；由人工方法制成的，常用于描述纤维、织物或其他材料。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li l-kisja ta' barra hija magħmula minn materjal sintetiku.
formal.en: The label indicates that the outer covering is made from synthetic material.
formal.zh: 标签注明，外层覆盖物由合成材料制成。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan id-drapp tal-qoton? Pawlu: Le, huwa drapp sintetiku. Ara t-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this cotton fabric? Pawlu: No, it's synthetic fabric. Look at the label.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这是棉布吗？Pawlu：不是，这是合成织物。看看标签。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这是棉布吗？
messages.en: Is this cotton fabric?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa drapp sintetiku. Ara t-tikketta.
