colloquial.en: Maja: Is there room for another chair? Mark: Yes, if we move the table a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：还有地方放一把椅子吗？马克：有，把桌子挪一点就行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 还有地方放一把椅子吗？
messages.en: Is there room for another chair?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，把桌子挪一点就行。
messages.en: Yes, if we move the table a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象挪开桌子后多出一块空地，把这块可用的“空间”标成 spazju，再练习“有足够空间”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having plenty of room for people, furniture, or activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空间充足的，能容纳人、家具或活动的；宽敞的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna wisa' u post għan-nies, għall-għamara jew għall-attivitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宽敞的；空间充足的。

formal.mt: L-appartament jinkludi salott spazjuż b'post biżżejjed għal mejda kbira u żewġ sufani.
formal.en: The apartment includes a spacious living room with enough room for a large table and two sofas.
formal.zh: 这套公寓设有宽敞的客厅，足以摆放一张大桌子和两张沙发。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-appartament il-ġdid? Mark: Huwa spazjuż ħafna; fl-aħħar għandna post għall-kotba kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the new apartment like? Mark: It's very spacious; we finally have room for all the books.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新公寓怎么样？马克：非常宽敞，我们终于有地方放下所有的书了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 新公寓怎么样？
messages.en: What's the new apartment like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa spazjuż ħafna; fl-aħħar għandna post għall-kotba kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa spazjuż ħafna; fl-aħħar għandna post għall-kotba kollha.
messages.zh: 非常宽敞，我们终于有地方放下所有的书了。
messages.en: It's very spacious; we finally have room for all the books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spazju“空间”和 spazjuż“宽敞的”并排记：先看到空地，再想象家具摆进去后仍能轻松走动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To write a word using its letters in the correct order, or to say those letters aloud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按正确顺序写出一个词的字母，或逐个说出这些字母。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikteb kelma bl-ittri tagħha fl-ordni t-tajba, jew tgħid dawk l-ittri waħda waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拼写；逐个说出一个词的字母

sense_translations.en_definition: to spell (write a word in a particular combination of letters; name these letters)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拼写：以特定的字母组合写出一个词，或依次说出这些字母

formal.mt: L-istudent spella l-kelma b'mod korrett waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The student spelled the word correctly during the examination.
formal.zh: 这名学生在考试中正确拼写了这个词。

colloquial.mt: Marta: L-għalliem spella l-kelma? | David: Iva, qal kull ittra bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did the teacher spell the word out? | David: Yes, he said each letter slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：老师把这个词的字母逐个说出来了吗？ | 戴维：说了，他慢慢地说出了每个字母。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 老师把这个词的字母逐个说出来了吗？
messages.en: Did the teacher spell the word out?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 说了，他慢慢地说出了每个字母。
messages.en: Yes, he said each letter slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spella 和英语 spell 并排记忆，再想象老师一边指着字母一边逐个念出来，连接“拼写”和“报字母”两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To want something to happen and feel that it may happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望某件事情发生，并认为它有实现的可能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixtieq li jiġri xi ħaġa u taħseb li hemm ċans li sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；期望某事发生

collocations.en: I hope to see you soon

formal.mt: Il-kumitat spera li l-proġett il-ġdid joħloq aktar opportunitajiet għaż-żgħażagħ.
formal.en: The committee hoped that the new project would create more opportunities for young people.
formal.zh: 委员会希望这个新项目能为年轻人创造更多机会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi eżami għada. | Mark: Nispera li kollox imur tajjeb!
colloquial.en: Lara: I have an exam tomorrow. | Mark: I hope everything goes well!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我明天有考试。 | 马克：希望一切顺利！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我明天有考试。
messages.en: I have an exam tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 希望一切顺利！
messages.en: I hope everything goes well!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Nispera li... 整块记成“我希望……”，每次想到明天的愿望就补上一句话，用期待未来的画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The feeling or belief that something wanted may happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相信或期待所盼望的事情可能发生的心情或信念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sentiment jew it-twemmin li xi ħaġa mixtieqa tista' sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；对所期待之事能够发生的盼望或信念

formal.mt: Il-ftuħ taċ-ċentru l-ġdid ta speranza lill-familji li kienu qed jistennew l-għajnuna.
formal.en: The opening of the new centre gave hope to the families who were waiting for assistance.
formal.zh: 新中心的启用给等待援助的家庭带来了希望。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taħseb li għad hemm speranza li nsibu l-qattus? | Pawlu: Iva, il-ġirien għadhom qed ifittxuh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you think there is still hope of finding the cat? | Pawlu: Yes, the neighbours are still looking for him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得还有希望找到那只猫吗？ | 保罗：有，邻居们还在找它。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li għad hemm speranza li nsibu l-qattus?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li għad hemm speranza li nsibu l-qattus?
messages.zh: 你觉得还有希望找到那只猫吗？
messages.en: Do you think there is still hope of finding the cat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 有，邻居们还在找它。
messages.en: Yes, the neighbours are still looking for him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 speranza 想成心里亮着的一盏“希望之灯”；再用 hemm speranza“还有希望”提醒自己，这里说的是名词“希望”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Semen, the male reproductive fluid containing sperm cells; the word can also refer to the sperm cells themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指含有精子的男性生殖液体，即精液；也可指其中的精子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fluwidu riproduttiv maskili li fih ċelloli riproduttivi; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal dawn iċ-ċelloli nfushom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精子，即男性生殖细胞
精液；精子，具体所指依上下文而定

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju rċieva kampjun ta' sperma għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The laboratory received a semen sample for analysis.
formal.zh: 实验室收到了一份用于分析的精液样本。

colloquial.mt: Mark: L-analiżi tal-kampjun ta' sperma lesta? | Rita: Iva, ir-riżultat jinsab fir-rapport.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the analysis of the semen sample complete? | Rita: Yes, the result is in the report.
colloquial.zh: 马克：精液样本分析完成了吗？ | 丽塔：完成了，结果在报告里。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 精液样本分析完成了吗？
messages.en: Is the analysis of the semen sample complete?

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.zh: 完成了，结果在报告里。
messages.en: Yes, the result is in the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sperma 放进“实验室样本”的画面里记忆：样本中的液体是精液，其中的生殖细胞是精子，阅读时靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a precise or particular way, or especially for a particular purpose or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以具体、明确的方式；也可指专门针对某个目的或群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod preċiż jew partikolari, jew apposta għal għan jew grupp partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具体地；明确地；专门针对某事或某类对象地。

formal.mt: Dan il-kors ġie mfassal speċifikament għal studenti li għadhom jibdew jitgħallmu l-Malti.
formal.en: This course was designed specifically for students who are just beginning to learn Maltese.
formal.zh: 这门课程专门为刚开始学习马耳他语的学生设计。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan il-ktieb? Mark: Għax inkiteb speċifikament għal min għadu jibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this book? Mark: Because it was written specifically for beginners.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么选这本书？马克：因为它是专门为初学者写的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这本书？
messages.en: Why did you choose this book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax inkiteb speċifikament għal min għadu jibda.
messages.mt_standard: Għax inkiteb speċifikament għal min għadu jibda.
messages.zh: 因为它是专门为初学者写的。
messages.en: Because it was written specifically for beginners.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教材封面贴着“专为初学者”标签，用 speċifikament 表达“专门地”，再用“明确提到”练习另一种常见语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clearly identified or limited to a particular person, thing, purpose, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所指明确的，或限于某个特定的人、事物、目的或情境的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa identifikat b'mod ċar jew marbut ma' persuna, ħaġa, għan jew sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具体的；特定的；明确的。

formal.mt: Kull attività għandha għan speċifiku li jgħin lill-istudenti jiżviluppaw il-ħiliet tal-qari.
formal.en: Each activity has a specific goal that helps students develop their reading skills.
formal.zh: 每项活动都有一个具体目标，帮助学生发展阅读能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħtini eżempju speċifiku? Mark: Iva, nistgħu nużaw is-sentenza li qrajna lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you give me a specific example? Mark: Yes, we can use the sentence we read yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能给我一个具体的例子吗？马克：可以，我们可以用昨天读过的那个句子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你能给我一个具体的例子吗？
messages.en: Can you give me a specific example?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nużaw is-sentenza li qrajna lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nużaw is-sentenza li qrajna lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 可以，我们可以用昨天读过的那个句子。
messages.en: Yes, we can use the sentence we read yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师从许多句子中圈出一个明确的例句，把“这个具体的例子”与 eżempju speċifiku 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vegetable with green leaves that are eaten raw or cooked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种以绿色叶片供食用的蔬菜，可生食或烹调，即菠菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix b'weraq aħdar li jittiekel nej jew imsajjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 菠菜

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi soppa bi spinaċi friski u ħaxix ieħor.
formal.en: The menu includes soup with fresh spinach and other vegetables.
formal.zh: 菜单上有一道用新鲜菠菜和其他蔬菜制作的汤。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'se nsajru llum? | Luqa: Għaġin bl-ispinaċi. Għandna spinaċi friski fil-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Anna: What shall we cook today? | Luqa: Pasta with spinach. We have fresh spinach in the fridge.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天我们做什么吃？ | 卢卡：菠菜意面。冰箱里有新鲜菠菜。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 今天我们做什么吃？
messages.en: What shall we cook today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaġin bl-ispinaċi. Għandna spinaċi friski fil-friġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għaġin bl-ispinaċi. Għandna spinaċi friski fil-friġġ.
messages.zh: 菠菜意面。冰箱里有新鲜菠菜。
messages.en: Pasta with spinach. We have fresh spinach in the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spinaċi 与英语 spinach 并排做成一张词卡，配上绿色菠菜叶；再用“菠菜意面”这个完整菜名巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's nonphysical inner being, or a characteristic attitude or enthusiasm; also wit shown through clever, amusing remarks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人的非物质内在存在，即精神或灵魂；也指某种态度、热情，或通过聪明风趣的言语表现出的机智。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-naħa mhux fiżika ta' persuna, jew l-attitudni u l-ħeġġa tagħha; jista' jfisser ukoll dehen li jidher f'kummenti għaqlin u tad-daħk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神；灵魂；某种态度或精神面貌
机智；风趣，尤指巧妙而幽默的言辞

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera ħadmu bi spirtu ta' kooperazzjoni biex jgħinu lill-komunità.
formal.en: The volunteers worked in a spirit of cooperation to help the community.
formal.zh: 志愿者们以合作精神开展工作，为社区提供帮助。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu dejjem isib xi ħaġa tad-daħk x'jgħid. | Ġorġ: Iva, huwa bniedem ta' spirtu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Pawlu always finds something funny to say. | Ġorġ: Yes, he is a witty person.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗总能说出些逗人的话。 | 乔治：是啊，他是个机智风趣的人。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu dejjem isib xi ħaġa tad-daħk x'jgħid.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu dejjem isib xi ħaġa tad-daħk x'jgħid.
messages.zh: 保罗总能说出些逗人的话。
messages.en: Pawlu always finds something funny to say.

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他是个机智风趣的人。
messages.en: Yes, he is a witty person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 spirtu：一幅是大家合作时的“精神”，另一幅是朋友巧妙逗笑众人的“机智”；搭配能帮助判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: On many occasions or at frequent intervals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事多次发生，或发生得较为频繁，即经常、常常。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħafna drabi jew f'intervalli qosra ta' żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常；常常
频繁地；屡次
经常；常常
经常；常常；频繁地

formal.mt: L-istudenti jużaw il-librerija spiss biex jippreparaw għall-eżamijiet.
formal.en: The students often use the library to prepare for examinations.
formal.zh: 学生们经常利用图书馆准备考试。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Tiġi spiss f'dan il-kafè? | Mark: Iva, niġi hawn darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Do you come to this café often? | Mark: Yes, I come here twice a week.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你经常来这家咖啡馆吗？ | 马克：是的，我每周来两次。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你经常来这家咖啡馆吗？
messages.en: Do you come to this café often?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我每周来两次。
messages.en: Yes, I come here twice a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spiss 写在一周日历旁，每出现一次熟悉的活动就画一个点；密集的小点提醒你它表示“经常”，加 ħafna 就是“非常经常”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To finish something or come to an end; also to stop or reach the end of a period of validity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成某事或告一段落；也可表示停止，或有效期限结束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ttemm xi ħaġa jew tasal fit-tmiem; tista' wkoll tieqaf jew tasal fl-aħħar tal-perjodu ta' validità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完成；做完；结束
停止；不再继续
结束；使告一段落
到期；有效期限届满
终止；使结束
停止；中止；不再持续
完成；结束；使告一段落

formal.mt: Il-kors spiċċa fl-aħħar ta' Ġunju, u l-parteċipanti rċevew ċertifikat.
formal.en: The course ended at the end of June, and the participants received a certificate.
formal.zh: 课程于六月底结束，参加者获得了证书。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-film spiċċa? | Ben: Iva, issa nistgħu nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the film ended? | Ben: Yes, we can leave now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：电影结束了吗？ | 本：结束了，我们现在可以走了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影结束了吗？
messages.en: Has the film ended?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 结束了，我们现在可以走了。
messages.en: Yes, we can leave now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影出现片尾字幕，心里说 spiċċa“结束了”；把这个终点画面延伸到工作完成、活动停止和期限届满。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where medicines are prepared or sold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 配制或出售药品的场所，即药房或药店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jitħejjew jew jinbiegħu l-mediċini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 药房；出售或配制药品的地方。

formal.mt: L-ispiżerija tinsab ħdejn il-pjazza u tiftaħ fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The pharmacy is next to the square and opens at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 药房位于广场旁边，上午九点开门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf fejn hemm spiżerija? Mark: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know where there is a pharmacy? Mark: Yes, there is one next to the square.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道哪里有药房吗？Mark：知道，广场旁边有一家。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 你知道哪里有药房吗？
messages.en: Do you know where there is a pharmacy?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.zh: 知道，广场旁边有一家。
messages.en: Yes, there is one next to the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spiżerija 写在脑中的药店门牌上，想象自己进门买药；用“去的地方”这一画面记住它表示药房。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person trained to prepare and supply medicines and explain their use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受过专业训练，负责配制、供应药品并说明用法的人，即药剂师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa biex tħejji u tagħti l-mediċini u tispjega kif jintużaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 药剂师；此处指在药房从事配药和供药工作的人。
药师；药剂师，负责配制或供应药品并解答用药问题的专业人员。

collocations.en: to ask the pharmacist for advice

formal.mt: L-ispiżjar spjega lill-klijent kif jaqra l-informazzjoni fuq il-kaxxa tal-mediċina.
formal.en: The pharmacist explained to the customer how to read the information on the medicine box.
formal.zh: 药剂师向顾客说明了如何阅读药盒上的信息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nitkellem mal-ispiżjar? Rita: Iva, stenna ftit u jiġi hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I speak to the pharmacist? Rita: Yes, wait a moment and he will come here.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我可以和药剂师说几句话吗？Rita：可以，稍等一下，他会过来。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我可以和药剂师说几句话吗？
messages.en: Can I speak to the pharmacist?

messages.speaker: Rita (药房店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, stenna ftit u jiġi hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, stenna ftit u jiġi hawn.
messages.zh: 可以，稍等一下，他会过来。
messages.en: Yes, wait a moment and he will come here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记忆 spiżerija 和 spiżjar：前者配药店门面的图，后者配柜台后药剂师的图，用“地方”和“人”区分。

gloss_zh: 解释；阐述；解读；解释说明

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something clear by describing its meaning, reasons, or details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过说明含义、原因或细节，使某件事变得清楚易懂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid jew tikteb it-tifsira, ir-raġunijiet jew id-dettalji ta' xi ħaġa biex tinftiehem aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释；说明，使人理解某件事或某个意思。
阐述；详细而有条理地说明某个观点或主题。
解读；说明文字、言语或其他内容所表达的意义。
解释；说明，用来帮助理解某事的内容或说法。

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega t-tifsira tal-kelma u ta żewġ eżempji bil-miktub.
formal.en: The teacher explained the meaning of the word and gave two written examples.
formal.zh: 老师解释了这个词的含义，并给出了两个书面例句。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Spjega din is-sentenza, jekk jogħġbok. Pawlu: Tfisser li l-ħanut jagħlaq kmieni llum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Explain this sentence, please. Pawlu: It means that the shop closes early today.
colloquial.zh: Lara：请解释一下这个句子。Pawlu：意思是这家商店今天提早关门。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 请解释一下这个句子。
messages.en: Explain this sentence, please.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-ħanut jagħlaq kmieni llum.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-ħanut jagħlaq kmieni llum.
messages.zh: 意思是这家商店今天提早关门。
messages.en: It means that the shop closes early today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把问号讲成明白的句子：动作是“解释”，写下来的内容是“一段解释”；用同一课堂画面分别记住动词和名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden, violent release of energy, usually with a loud bang.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能量突然猛烈释放、通常伴随巨响的事件，即爆炸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ f'daqqa u b'qawwa ta' enerġija, ġeneralment b'ħoss qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爆炸；能量突然猛烈释放、常伴随巨响的现象。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi splużjoni li seħħet fil-maħżen matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The report describes an explosion that occurred in the warehouse during the night.
formal.zh: 报告描述了夜间在仓库发生的一次爆炸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-ħoss kien splużjoni? Mark: Le, kien ħoss mill-film fuq it-televixin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was that sound an explosion? Mark: No, it was a sound from the film on television.
colloquial.zh: Maja：刚才那声音是爆炸声吗？Mark：不是，是电视里电影的声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才那声音是爆炸声吗？
messages.en: Was that sound an explosion?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien ħoss mill-film fuq it-televixin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien ħoss mill-film fuq it-televixin.
messages.zh: 不是，是电视里电影的声音。
messages.en: No, it was a sound from the film on television.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 splużjoni 放进电影字幕中的“轰！”旁边，联想突然出现的闪光和巨响，用具体场景记住“爆炸”。

gloss_zh: 海鲈；亦有欧洲狼鲈、斑点狼鲈和齿鲷等鱼名义项

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fish name used for sea bass; the supplied senses also include several specific fish species.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鱼名，可指海鲈；所列具体义项还包括欧洲狼鲈、斑点狼鲈和齿鲷，理解时应结合语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' ħuta li, skont is-sens, jista' jirreferi għal Dicentrarchus labrax, Dicentrarchus punctatus jew Dentex dentex.

sense_translations.en_definition: Sea bass a type of fish
sense_translations.zh_definition: 海鲈，一类鱼的名称。
欧洲狼鲈，学名为 Dicentrarchus labrax。
斑点狼鲈，学名为 Dicentrarchus punctatus。
齿鲷，学名为 Dentex dentex。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi spnott moħmi bil-ħaxix, u l-klijent jista' jistaqsi liema speċi tintuża.
formal.en: The menu includes baked sea bass with vegetables, and the customer can ask which species is used.
formal.zh: 菜单上有配蔬菜的烤海鲈，顾客可以询问所用的具体鱼种。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandkom spnott frisk illum? Toni: Iva. Trid wieħed kbir jew wieħed żgħir?
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have fresh sea bass today? Toni: Yes. Would you like a large one or a small one?
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天有新鲜海鲈吗？Toni：有。你要一条大的还是小的？

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜海鲈吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh sea bass today?

messages.speaker: Toni (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Trid wieħed kbir jew wieħed żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Trid wieħed kbir jew wieħed żgħir?
messages.zh: 有。你要一条大的还是小的？
messages.en: Yes. Would you like a large one or a small one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鱼摊上写着 spnott 的标签，先记住它是鱼名；再给不同具体义项各配一张学名卡，避免把所列鱼种混成一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Asparagus, a plant whose young shoots are eaten as a vegetable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 芦笋，嫩茎可作为蔬菜食用的植物，也指这种食材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li r-rimjiet żgħar tagħha jittieklu bħala ħaxix, u l-ħaxix innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芦笋；可食用的嫩茎蔬菜。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aħsel l-ispraġ u qattgħu f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: For this recipe, wash the asparagus and cut it into small pieces.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，先把芦笋洗净，再切成小段。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'se nsajru bl-ispraġ? Ben: Nistgħu nagħmlu soppa għall-pranzu.
colloquial.en: Anna: What shall we cook with the asparagus? Ben: We can make soup for lunch.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们用芦笋做什么？Ben：可以做汤，午饭喝。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 我们用芦笋做什么？
messages.en: What shall we cook with the asparagus?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 可以做汤，午饭喝。
messages.en: We can make soup for lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在一束细长芦笋的图上标注 spraġ，再联想把它切段煮汤的动作；把词和食材外形、做菜场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people receive medical care and may stay for treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为人们提供医疗照护，并可安排住院治疗的场所，即医院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn in-nies jingħataw kura medika u jistgħu jibqgħu għall-kura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 医院；提供诊疗、护理和住院服务的机构。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent għandu appuntament fl-isptar nhar it-Tnejn fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The patient has an appointment at the hospital on Monday at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 这位患者预约了星期一上午九点到医院就诊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema karozza tal-linja tmur l-isptar? Mark: Din tmur hemm. Nistgħu nistennewha hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which bus goes to the hospital? Mark: This one goes there. We can wait for it here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：哪路公交车去医院？Mark：这路车就去。我们可以在这里等。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 哪路公交车去医院？
messages.en: Which bus goes to the hospital?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din tmur hemm. Nistgħu nistennewha hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Din tmur hemm. Nistgħu nistennewha hawn.
messages.zh: 这路车就去。我们可以在这里等。
messages.en: This one goes there. We can wait for it here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公交车目的地牌写着 sptar，车停在医院大门前；用“乘车去医院”的完整场景牢牢记住这个地点名词。

gloss_zh: 西西里的；西西里人；西西里语

teaching_sense.en_definition: From Sicily or relating to Sicily, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自西西里的，或与西西里、当地居民及其语言有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Sqallija jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Sqallija, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西西里的；与西西里、其居民或语言有关的。
西西里人；来自西西里的人。
西西里语；语言名称。

formal.mt: Il-programm kulturali jinkludi mużika Sqallija u qari bis-Sqalli.
formal.en: The cultural programme includes Sicilian music and readings in Sicilian.
formal.zh: 这项文化活动包括西西里音乐和西西里语朗读。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kantant huwa Sqalli? Pawlu: Iva, u f'din il-kanzunetta jkanta bis-Sqalli.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this singer Sicilian? Pawlu: Yes, and in this song he sings in Sicilian.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这位歌手是西西里人吗？Pawlu：是的，而且这首歌他用西西里语唱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这位歌手是西西里人吗？
messages.en: Is this singer Sicilian?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u f'din il-kanzunetta jkanta bis-Sqalli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u f'din il-kanzunetta jkanta bis-Sqalli.
messages.zh: 是的，而且这首歌他用西西里语唱。
messages.en: Yes, and in this song he sings in Sicilian.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三张西西里主题卡：食物卡记“西西里的”，人物卡记“西西里人”，说话卡记“西西里语”；按句中位置区分三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A narrow passage or street between buildings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物之间较窄的通道或街巷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Triq jew passaġġ dejjaq bejn il-bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小巷；胡同。

formal.mt: Il-pjan juri sqaq dejjaq bejn żewġ binjiet.
formal.en: The plan shows a narrow alley between two buildings.
formal.zh: 平面图显示，两栋建筑之间有一条狭窄的小巷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nasal fil-pjazza? Mark: Għaddi minn dan is-sqaq u dawwar lejn ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I get to the square? Mark: Go through this alley and turn left.
colloquial.zh: Maja：去广场怎么走？Mark：穿过这条小巷，然后左转。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 去广场怎么走？
messages.en: How do I get to the square?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddi minn dan is-sqaq u dawwar lejn ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddi minn dan is-sqaq u dawwar lejn ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 穿过这条小巷，然后左转。
messages.en: Go through this alley and turn left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sqaq 写在两排房屋之间的窄缝里，联想只能步行穿过的小巷；再用 sqaq bla ħruġ 记住死胡同。

gloss_zh: 被钉十字架；受折磨；横交放置

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be crucified, to suffer torment or great trouble, or to be arranged cross-wise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被钉在十字架上；受到折磨或遭遇很大麻烦；也可指物体被交叉放置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi msallab fuq salib, jgħaddi minn tbatija jew inkwiet kbir, jew jitqiegħed f'forma ta' salib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被钉在十字架上；被处以十字架刑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be caused a lot of trouble
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得麻烦重重；因某事而大受困扰。
被交叉排列或放置，形成十字形。
sallab 的中动态或被动态形式，表示主体承受被钉十字架、受折磨或被交叉放置等作用。
受到折磨；承受痛苦。

collocations.en: to be crucified on a cross

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija, l-injam ssallab biex jifforma salib.
formal.en: In the drawing, the wood was arranged cross-wise to form a cross.
formal.zh: 在图画中，木料被交叉放置，形成一个十字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dam Pawlu daqshekk? Mark: Ssallab biex isib id-dokument it-tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu take so long? Mark: He had a lot of trouble finding the right document.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 怎么花了这么长时间？Mark：他费了好大劲才找到正确的文件。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 怎么花了这么长时间？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu take so long?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 他费了好大劲才找到正确的文件。
messages.en: He had a lot of trouble finding the right document.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅独立画面记 ssallab：十字架上的人、被烦恼折磨的人、交叉摆放的木料；根据上下文选择对应词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be exchanged, especially into money, or to be equivalent in value to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被兑换或兑现；也指在价值上相当于某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mibdul fi flus jew ikollu valur daqs xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被交换；被兑换。
与某物具有等值或相当的关系。
sarraf 的中动态或被动态形式，表示被兑换、兑现或具有相应的等值。
相当于；等值于。

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru, iċ-ċekk issarraf fil-bank nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: According to the register, the cheque was cashed at the bank on Monday.
formal.zh: 根据登记记录，这张支票已于星期一在银行兑现。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Iċ-ċekk issarraf diġà? Pawlu: Iva, issarraf dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the cheque been cashed yet? Pawlu: Yes, it was cashed this morning.
colloquial.zh: Rita：支票已经兑现了吗？Pawlu：是的，今天早上兑现了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 支票已经兑现了吗？
messages.en: Has the cheque been cashed yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上兑现了。
messages.en: Yes, it was cashed this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把支票换成等值现金：换成另一种形式提示“被兑换”，金额相等提示“等值于”，两幅画面一起记 ssarraf。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be poured out or into a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体等被倒出，或被倒进某个容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitferra' barra jew ġo reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被倾倒；被倒出或倒入。
sawwab 的中动态或被动态形式，表示液体等被倾倒。

collocations.en: to be poured into the pot

formal.mt: Waqt it-tħejjija tal-ikla, il-ħalib ssawwab fil-borma bil-mod.
formal.en: During the preparation of the meal, the milk was poured slowly into the pot.
formal.zh: 准备饭菜时，牛奶被慢慢倒入锅中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn hu l-meraq? Mark: Ssawwab fil-buqar; tista' tieħu tazza.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is the juice? Mark: It has been poured into the jug; you can have a glass.
colloquial.zh: Rita：果汁在哪里？Mark：已经倒进壶里了，你可以喝一杯。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 果汁在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the juice?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 已经倒进壶里了，你可以喝一杯。
messages.en: It has been poured into the jug; you can have a glass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水从壶嘴流进锅里，用箭头标出倒入方向；把被倒进去的水与 ssawwab 联系起来，注意句子关注液体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive something on loan, especially to borrow money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从别人那里借来某物，尤其指借钱或取得贷款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu xi ħaġa b'self mingħand ħaddieħor, speċjalment flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借入；向别人借用。
借款；取得贷款。
sellef 的中动态或被动态形式，在这里表示主体借入或取得借款。

collocations.en: to take a loan from the bank

formal.mt: Pawlu ssellef elf ewro mill-bank biex jixtri tagħmir ġdid.
formal.en: Pawlu borrowed one thousand euros from the bank to buy new equipment.
formal.zh: Pawlu 向银行借了一千欧元，用于购买新设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħallas Mark għat-tiswija? Rita: Ssellef ftit flus mingħand ħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark pay for the repair? Rita: He borrowed some money from his brother.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 怎么付的维修费？Rita：他向兄弟借了点钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 怎么付的维修费？
messages.en: How did Mark pay for the repair?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他向兄弟借了点钱。
messages.en: He borrowed some money from his brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从朋友的钱包指向自己的箭头，在接收端写 ssellef，牢牢记住动作方向是借进来，并搭配 mingħand 说明向谁借。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remain in the air over an area without moving far from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某处上空悬停或盘旋，不远离该区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' fl-ajru fuq post mingħajr ma jitbiegħed ħafna minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬停；在某处上空盘旋。

formal.mt: L-għasfur sseqqer fuq l-għalqa qabel niżel lejn l-art.
formal.en: The bird hovered over the field before descending towards the ground.
formal.zh: 那只鸟在田地上空盘旋，然后向地面降落。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt dak l-għasfur? Mark: Iva, sseqqer fuq l-għalqa għal ftit sekondi.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you see that bird? Mark: Yes, it hovered over the field for a few seconds.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你看到那只鸟了吗？Mark：看到了，它在田地上空悬停了几秒。

messages.speaker: Rita (观鸟爱好者)
messages.zh: 你看到那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that bird?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sseqqer fuq l-għalqa għal ftit sekondi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sseqqer fuq l-għalqa għal ftit sekondi.
messages.zh: 看到了，它在田地上空悬停了几秒。
messages.en: Yes, it hovered over the field for a few seconds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只鸟停留在田地正上方，翅膀仍在动，位置却基本不变；把这幅空中悬停的画面标为 sseqqer。

gloss_zh: 被带走；被冲走；获配引水渠道

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be carried away, or to be supplied with aqueducts or water channels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被带走或随水流冲走；另一个词义是某处获配引水道或输水渠道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġarr lil hinn, jew jiġi mgħammar b'akwedotti jew kanali tal-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被带走；被携走或冲走。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be provided with aqueducts, water channels
sense_translations.zh_definition: 获配引水道、渡槽或输水渠道。

collocations.en: to be carried away by the current
to be provided with water channels

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-ġnien ssewwaq b'kanali tal-ilma biex l-ilma jasal sas-siġar.
formal.en: According to the report, the garden was provided with water channels so that water could reach the trees.
formal.zh: 根据报告，花园配设了输水渠道，使水能够到达树木所在的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar l-injam li kien ħdejn ix-xmara? Mark: Ssewwaq mal-kurrent wara x-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the wood beside the river go? Mark: It was carried away by the current after the rain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：河边的木料去哪儿了？Mark：下雨后被水流冲走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar l-injam li kien ħdejn ix-xmara?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar l-injam li kien ħdejn ix-xmara?
messages.zh: 河边的木料去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the wood beside the river go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 下雨后被水流冲走了。
messages.en: It was carried away by the current after the rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ssewwaq 制作两张义项卡：一张画木料随水漂走，一张画花园铺设水渠；分别记住“被带走”和“获配渠道”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make peace with someone after a disagreement, or to greet someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与发生争执的人重归于好；也可指向人打招呼或致意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel paċi ma' xi ħadd wara tilwima, jew isellem lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人和解。
与某人重归于好，结束彼此的争执。
向人问候、打招呼或致意。

collocations.en: greeted the neighbours when he met them
collocations.zh: 遇见邻居时向他们打了招呼

formal.mt: Wara t-tilwima, Mark ssielem ma' ħuh u t-tnejn qablu li jerġgħu jaħdmu flimkien.
formal.en: After the argument, Mark made peace with his brother, and they both agreed to work together again.
formal.zh: 争执过后，马克与兄弟和解，两人同意再次合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għadu miġġieled ma' ħuh? Lara: Le, ilbieraħ ssielem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark still at odds with his brother? Lara: No, he made peace with him yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克还在和他兄弟闹矛盾吗？拉拉：没有，他昨天已经跟兄弟和解了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还在和他兄弟闹矛盾吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still at odds with his brother?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，他昨天已经跟兄弟和解了。
messages.en: No, he made peace with him yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssielem 记成两个友好场景：吵架后握手是和解，见面时挥手是问候；靠上下文分辨。

gloss_zh: 成为伙伴；加入；成为成员

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become a partner or associate, or to join a group as a member.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为合作伙伴或关联成员；也指加入某个团体，成为其中一员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir sieħeb jew membru ta' grupp jew għaqda, jew jidħol fi sħubija ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为伙伴或合伙人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become an associate of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为某机构、组织等的合作成员或关联成员。
加入；成为成员。

collocations.en: to go into business as a partner with a friend

formal.mt: Pawlu ssieħeb fl-għaqda biex jieħu sehem fil-proġetti tagħha.
formal.en: Pawlu joined the association to take part in its projects.
formal.zh: Pawlu 加入了协会，以参与协会的项目。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Mark ssieħeb fil-klabb tal-qari? Maja: Iva, u se jiġi għal-laqgħa li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did Mark join the reading club? Maja: Yes, and he will come to the next meeting.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Mark 加入读书俱乐部了吗？Maja：是的，他还会来参加下一次聚会。

messages.speaker: Rita (俱乐部成员)
messages.zh: Mark 加入读书俱乐部了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark join the reading club?

messages.speaker: Maja (俱乐部组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u se jiġi għal-laqgħa li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u se jiġi għal-laqgħa li jmiss.
messages.zh: 是的，他还会来参加下一次聚会。
messages.en: Yes, and he will come to the next meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人走进读书俱乐部，随后与大家握手成为成员；用 ssieħeb 记“加入”，再用两人合伙开店的画面记“成为伙伴”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To annoy or put pressure on someone, or to make a law or measure stricter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人厌烦，向人施压或不断催逼；也指收紧法律或措施，使其更加严格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idejjaq lil xi ħadd jew jagħmel pressjoni fuqu, jew jagħmel liġi jew miżura aktar stretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人厌烦、烦恼或感到困扰。
收紧法律或措施，使规定更加严格。
向人施压、催逼或纠缠不休。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ssikka l-miżuri biex inaqqas l-istorbju matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The council tightened the measures to reduce noise during the night.
formal.zh: 议会收紧了相关措施，以减少夜间噪声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu deher imdejjaq? Mark: Ħuh ssikka fuqu biex jagħtih tweġiba mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu seem upset? Mark: His brother pressured him to give an answer straight away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么看起来不高兴？马克：他兄弟逼着他马上给出答复。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么看起来不高兴？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu seem upset?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuh ssikka fuqu biex jagħtih tweġiba mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Ħuh ssikka fuqu biex jagħtih tweġiba mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 他兄弟逼着他马上给出答复。
messages.en: His brother pressured him to give an answer straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“越收越紧”来联想 ssikka：规定收紧就更严格，对人逼得太紧就会让人厌烦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To find comfort in distress, or to bear a difficulty with patience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在悲伤或困境中得到安慰，或耐心地承受困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isib faraġ meta jkun imdejjaq, jew jissaporti diffikultà bil-paċenzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在悲伤或失意时得到安慰。
耐心地忍受或承受某事。
受到安抚，心中得到慰藉。

collocations.en: was comforted by his friend's words
collocations.zh: 从朋友的话中得到了安慰

formal.mt: Wara li rċieva l-aħbar ħażina, Pawlu stabar bil-kliem ta' faraġ tal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: After receiving the bad news, Pawlu was consoled by his family's comforting words.
formal.zh: 收到坏消息后，保罗从家人的宽慰中得到了安慰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-aħbar ħażina? Mark: Għadu mdejjaq, imma stabar ftit meta tkellem ma' ħabibu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Pawlu after the bad news? Mark: He's still upset, but he found some comfort when he spoke to his friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：听到坏消息后，保罗现在怎么样？马克：他还是很难过，不过跟朋友聊过后得到了一些安慰。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-aħbar ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-aħbar ħażina?
messages.zh: 听到坏消息后，保罗现在怎么样？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after the bad news?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mdejjaq, imma stabar ftit meta tkellem ma' ħabibu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mdejjaq, imma stabar ftit meta tkellem ma' ħabibu.
messages.zh: 他还是很难过，不过跟朋友聊过后得到了一些安慰。
messages.en: He's still upset, but he found some comfort when he spoke to his friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象难过的人听完安慰后慢慢平静：stabar 可记“得到安慰”，也可记“耐心承受”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To catch fish, or to hunt animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 捕捉鱼类，也可指猎捕动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbad il-ħut, jew jikkaċċja l-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鱼或钓鱼。
捕鱼，即捕捉鱼类。
打猎，猎捕动物。

formal.mt: Is-sajjied stad bil-qasba ħdejn il-port u qabad żewġ ħutiet.
formal.en: The fisherman fished with a rod near the harbour and caught two fish.
formal.zh: 渔夫在港口附近用钓竿钓鱼，钓到了两条鱼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Mark dalgħodu? Lara: Stad ħdejn il-baħar u ġab żewġ ħutiet id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark do this morning? Lara: He fished by the sea and brought two fish home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克今天早上做什么了？拉拉：他去海边钓鱼，带了两条鱼回家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克今天早上做什么了？
messages.en: What did Mark do this morning?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stad ħdejn il-baħar u ġab żewġ ħutiet id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Stad ħdejn il-baħar u ġab żewġ ħutiet id-dar.
messages.zh: 他去海边钓鱼，带了两条鱼回家。
messages.en: He fished by the sea and brought two fish home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 stad 配一幅捕鱼图，再补一幅打猎图；两种用法都围绕“捕捉”，具体对象看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become blocked or plugged; when referring to a person, to become constipated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通道或开口被堵住；用于人时，也可指发生便秘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħalaq b'xi ħaġa li ma tħallix il-passaġġ ħieles; meta jingħad għal persuna, ikollha stitikezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被堵塞，无法正常通行或流通。
便秘，排便困难。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be plugged, to be stopped
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被塞住或堵住，使通道不再畅通。

formal.mt: Il-pajp stadd bil-ħmieġ, u l-ilma ma setax jgħaddi minnu.
formal.en: The pipe became blocked with dirt, and water could not pass through it.
formal.zh: 管道被污物堵住，水无法从中流过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-ilma mhux nieżel? Mark: Il-pajp stadd. Se nċempel lill-plamer.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't the water draining? Mark: The pipe is blocked. I'll call the plumber.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水怎么排不下去？马克：管道堵了。我来给水管工打电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 水怎么排不下去？
messages.en: Why isn't the water draining?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 管道堵了。我来给水管工打电话。
messages.en: The pipe is blocked. I'll call the plumber.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stadd 末尾的双 d 想成两道挡板，提醒自己是“堵住”；它与表示捕鱼的 stad 拼写不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel surprised, astonished, or full of wonder at something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事而感到惊讶、惊叹或充满赞叹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss sorpriża jew meravilja kbira quddiem xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到十分惊讶或震惊。
充满惊奇或赞叹之情。
感到惊奇、惊讶或意外。

collocations.en: marvelled at the beauty of the place
collocations.zh: 对那个地方的美景赞叹不已

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur stagħġeb bis-sbuħija tal-bini u bid-dettalji tat-tiżjin tiegħu.
formal.en: The visitor marvelled at the beauty of the building and the details of its decoration.
formal.zh: 来访者对建筑之美及其装饰细节赞叹不已。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għoġbitu s-sorpriża? Lara: Iva! Stagħġeb meta ra lil sħabu kollha hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark like the surprise? Lara: Yes! He was amazed when he saw all his friends there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克喜欢这个惊喜吗？拉拉：喜欢！看到朋友们全都在那里时，他惊讶极了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克喜欢这个惊喜吗？
messages.en: Did Mark like the surprise?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Stagħġeb meta ra lil sħabu kollha hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Stagħġeb meta ra lil sħabu kollha hemm.
messages.zh: 喜欢！看到朋友们全都在那里时，他惊讶极了。
messages.en: Yes! He was amazed when he saw all his friends there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 stagħġeb 配上睁大眼睛说“哇”的表情；意外的结果让人惊讶，美景则让人惊叹。

gloss_zh: 马厩；牲畜棚；另作动词表示停下

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or shelter where horses or other farm animals are kept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饲养或安置马匹及其他农场动物的建筑或棚舍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew kenn fejn jinżammu ż-żwiemel jew annimali oħra tar-razzett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马厩；养马的棚舍。

sense_translations.en_definition: stable, sty, barn (building where animals are kept)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马厩、猪圈或牲畜棚，指饲养动物的建筑。
停下；停止。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi naddaf l-istalla u poġġa tiben frisk qabel daħħal iż-żwiemel fiha.
formal.en: The farmer cleaned the stable and put down fresh straw before bringing the horses inside.
formal.zh: 农夫清扫了马厩，铺上新鲜稻草，然后把马牵了进去。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn huma ż-żwiemel? Mark: Fl-istalla. Għadni kemm tajthom l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are the horses? Mark: In the stable. I've just given them water.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马在哪儿？马克：在马厩里。我刚给它们喂了水。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 马在哪儿？
messages.en: Where are the horses?

messages.speaker: Mark (农夫)
messages.zh: 在马厩里。我刚给它们喂了水。
messages.en: In the stable. I've just given them water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stalla 名词义放进农场画面：马回到棚舍休息；另用一张词卡记动词“停下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dagger or short, pointed blade, especially a narrow knife intended for stabbing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有尖头的匕首或短刀，尤指用于刺击的细长刀具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sikkina qasira bil-ponta, speċjalment waħda dejqa maħsuba biex tagħti daqqiet ta' ponta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匕首。
匕首；短剑。
细长尖刃匕首，指用于刺击的刀具。

formal.mt: Il-mużew esebixxa stallett antik f'vetrina tal-ħġieġ, b'deskrizzjoni tax-xafra u tal-manku tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum displayed an antique dagger in a glass case, with a description of its blade and handle.
formal.zh: 博物馆在玻璃展柜中陈列了一把古老的匕首，并附上了刀刃和刀柄的介绍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak fil-vetrina? Pawlu: Stallett antik. Ara kemm hi dejqa x-xafra tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that in the display case? Pawlu: An antique dagger. Look how narrow its blade is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：展柜里那是什么？保罗：一把古老的匕首。你看，它的刀刃多细。

messages.speaker: Maja (博物馆参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里那是什么？
messages.en: What's that in the display case?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stallett antik. Ara kemm hi dejqa x-xafra tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Stallett antik. Ara kemm hi dejqa x-xafra tiegħu.
messages.zh: 一把古老的匕首。你看，它的刀刃多细。
messages.en: An antique dagger. Look how narrow its blade is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stallett 记成博物馆展柜里的尖细短刀，抓住“短、尖、细”的匕首形象。

gloss_zh: 印刷；盖印；另指印刷机、报刊或印刷品

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce text or pictures on paper or another surface by printing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过印刷或打印，把文字或图像呈现在纸张等表面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipproduċi kliem jew stampi fuq karta jew wiċċ ieħor permezz tal-istampar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷；打印。
盖印；压印出印记。
印上；使表面留下印记。
印刷机；报刊或新闻出版界。
印刷品；印出的图像或图样。

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju stampa mitt kopja tar-rapport biex jitqassmu waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The office printed one hundred copies of the report for distribution at the meeting.
formal.zh: 办公室印制了一百份报告，供会议期间分发。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark stampa l-biljetti? Maja: Iva, stampa żewġ kopji. Qegħdin fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark print the tickets? Maja: Yes, he printed two copies. They're on the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克把票打印出来了吗？玛雅：打印了，他打了两份。就在桌上。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把票打印出来了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark print the tickets?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, stampa żewġ kopji. Qegħdin fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, stampa żewġ kopji. Qegħdin fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 打印了，他打了两份。就在桌上。
messages.en: Yes, he printed two copies. They're on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象按下打印键，纸上出现文字：用 stampa 记“印出来”；名词义再联系印刷机和印刷品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A printing establishment where books, leaflets, and other printed materials are produced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作书籍、传单等印刷品的印刷厂或印刷所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jiġu stampati kotba, fuljetti u materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷机；印刷所。
印刷机；印刷厂或印刷所。

collocations.en: sends the files to the printworks

formal.mt: L-iskola bagħtet il-fajls lill-istamperija biex jitħejjew il-fuljetti għall-ġenituri.
formal.en: The school sent the files to the printworks so that the leaflets for parents could be prepared.
formal.zh: 学校把文件发送给印刷厂，以便制作发给家长的宣传册。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Minn fejn se niġbru l-fuljetti? Lara: Mill-istamperija ħdejn l-iskola. Se jkunu lesti għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are we collecting the leaflets from? Lara: From the printworks near the school. They'll be ready tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们去哪里取宣传册？拉拉：去学校附近的印刷厂。明天就能做好。

messages.speaker: Mark (家长志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们去哪里取宣传册？
messages.en: Where are we collecting the leaflets from?

messages.speaker: Lara (学校职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-istamperija ħdejn l-iskola. Se jkunu lesti għada.
messages.mt_standard: Mill-istamperija ħdejn l-iskola. Se jkunu lesti għada.
messages.zh: 去学校附近的印刷厂。明天就能做好。
messages.en: From the printworks near the school. They'll be ready tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 stamperija 配一幅印刷厂画面：文件送进去，成叠的书册印出来，用完整场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of cloth used as a veil, curtain, or covering to conceal someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于遮住人或物的布，包括面纱、帷幕等遮盖物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tintuża bħala velu, purtiera jew għata biex taħbi persuna jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一层面纱或遮盖用的薄布。
裹尸布；覆盖遗体的布。
帷幕；窗帘等悬挂的遮挡布。
面纱；遮盖物。

formal.mt: Star oħxon kien jifred il-parti ta' quddiem tas-sala mill-ispazju fejn kienu jinżammu l-oġġetti.
formal.en: A thick curtain separated the front part of the hall from the space where the objects were stored.
formal.zh: 一道厚帷幕把大厅前部与存放物品的区域隔开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt il-kaxxa? Pawlu: Wara l-istar, ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the box? Pawlu: Behind the curtain, next to the wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把箱子放哪儿了？保罗：帷幕后面，靠墙的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 你把箱子放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 帷幕后面，靠墙的地方。
messages.en: Behind the curtain, next to the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 star 时想象一块遮挡视线的布：挂起来是帷幕，遮脸是面纱，覆盖遗体则是裹尸布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition that a person or thing is in at a particular time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个人或事物在特定时刻所处的状态或状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni li tkun fiha persuna jew ħaġa f'ħin partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 状态；国家，具体含义依语境而定。
状态；状况。
国家；政府；作为政治组织的国家体制。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ikkonferma li l-bini kien fi stat tajjeb u seta' jibqa' jintuża bħala librerija.
formal.en: The report confirmed that the building was in good condition and could continue to be used as a library.
formal.zh: 报告确认，这栋建筑状况良好，可以继续用作图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'liema stat hi r-rota li trid tixtri? Mark: Fi stat tajjeb. Il-brejkijiet jaħdmu u t-tajers huma ġodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What condition is the bicycle you want to buy in? Mark: In good condition. The brakes work and the tyres are new.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想买的那辆自行车状况怎么样？马克：状况很好。刹车能用，轮胎也是新的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema stat hi r-rota li trid tixtri?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema stat hi r-rota li trid tixtri?
messages.zh: 你想买的那辆自行车状况怎么样？
messages.en: What condition is the bicycle you want to buy in?

messages.speaker: Mark (购车者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fi stat tajjeb. Il-brejkijiet jaħdmu u t-tajers huma ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Fi stat tajjeb. Il-brejkijiet jaħdmu u t-tajers huma ġodda.
messages.zh: 状况很好。刹车能用，轮胎也是新的。
messages.en: In good condition. The brakes work and the tyres are new.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 stat 做两张情境卡：看自行车时问“状态”，谈国家元首时记“国家”，靠搭配辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The United States, a country in North America, also called America.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 美国，位于北美洲的国家，正式中文名称为美利坚合众国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Amerika ta' Fuq, magħruf ukoll bħala l-Amerika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美国；美利坚合众国
美国（此处 America 指美国）

sense_translations.en_definition: United States (a country in North America)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 美国（位于北美洲的一个国家）

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jipprevedi kooperazzjoni bejn l-università u istituzzjonijiet fl-Istati Uniti.
formal.en: The agreement provides for cooperation between the university and institutions in the United States.
formal.zh: 该协议规定了这所大学与美国机构之间的合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tistudja s-sena d-dieħla? Mark: Se nistudja fl-Istati Uniti. Maja: U kemm se ddum hemm? Mark: Sena.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going to study next year? Mark: I'm going to study in the United States. Maja: And how long will you stay there? Mark: A year.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明年要去哪里学习？Mark：我要去美国学习。Maja：那你会在那里待多久？Mark：一年。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明年要去哪里学习？
messages.en: Where are you going to study next year?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要去美国学习。
messages.en: I'm going to study in the United States.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你会在那里待多久？
messages.en: And how long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 一年。
messages.en: A year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Stati Uniti 整体作为美国的国名记忆，并配上一张赴美留学的行程卡：Se nistudja fl-Istati Uniti 表示“我要在美国学习”，帮助连同常见表达一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The collection and analysis of numerical data, or the numerical information produced by this work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对数值资料的收集、整理和分析，也指由此得到的统计数据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġbir, l-organizzazzjoni u l-analiżi ta' data numerika, jew l-informazzjoni numerika li tinkiseb minn dan ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统计；统计学；统计数据

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta statistika dwar l-użu tat-trasport pubbliku fil-belt.
formal.en: The report presents statistics on the use of public transport in the city.
formal.zh: 该报告提供了有关市内公共交通使用情况的统计数据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek l-istatistika dwar kemm nies jużaw il-karozzi tal-linja? Mark: Iva, din it-tabella turi n-numru ta' passiġġieri kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have the statistics on how many people use the buses? Mark: Yes, this table shows the number of passengers each month.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有多少人乘坐公交车的统计数据吗？Mark：有，这张表显示了每个月的乘客人数。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek l-istatistika dwar kemm nies jużaw il-karozzi tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek l-istatistika dwar kemm nies jużaw il-karozzi tal-linja?
messages.zh: 你有多少人乘坐公交车的统计数据吗？
messages.en: Do you have the statistics on how many people use the buses?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din it-tabella turi n-numru ta' passiġġieri kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din it-tabella turi n-numru ta' passiġġieri kull xahar.
messages.zh: 有，这张表显示了每个月的乘客人数。
messages.en: Yes, this table shows the number of passengers each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 statistika 与英语 statistics 对照记忆，想象一张按月记录公交乘客人数的表格：表里的数字是统计数据，研究这些数字的方法属于统计学。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A three-dimensional figure of a person or animal, made from a material such as stone, metal, or wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用石头、金属或木材等材料制成的人物或动物立体形象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura ta' persuna jew annimal magħmula minn materjal bħall-ġebel, il-metall jew l-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雕像；人物或动物的立体塑像。

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri statwa tal-irħam fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The museum displays a marble statue in the main hall.
formal.zh: 博物馆在主展厅陈列着一座大理石雕像。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt l-istatwa l-ġdida fil-pjazza? Mark: Iva! Ejja nieħdu ritratt ħdejha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the new statue in the square? Mark: Yes! Let's take a photo beside it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看过广场上那座新雕像了吗？马克：看过！我们在它旁边拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过广场上那座新雕像了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the new statue in the square?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看过！我们在它旁边拍张照吧。
messages.en: Yes! Let's take a photo beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 statwa 和英语 statue 并排记忆，再想象广场上一座可以绕着观看的雕像；这是拼写联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A season of the year, or a period associated with a particular activity or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一年中的一个季节，或某种活动、赛事等集中进行的一段时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed mill-perjodi tas-sena, jew żmien marbut ma' attività jew avveniment partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 季节；也可指某种活动或赛事的季期。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jestendi l-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ matul l-istaġun tas-sajf.
formal.en: The museum extends its opening hours during the summer season.
formal.zh: 博物馆在夏季延长开放时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta jibda l-istaġun tal-futbol? Mark: Ix-xahar id-dieħel. Trid tiġi tara l-ewwel logħba miegħi?
colloquial.en: Maja: When does the football season start? Mark: Next month. Do you want to come and watch the first match with me?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：足球赛季什么时候开始？马克：下个月。你想和我一起去看第一场比赛吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 足球赛季什么时候开始？
messages.en: When does the football season start?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xahar id-dieħel. Trid tiġi tara l-ewwel logħba miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xahar id-dieħel. Trid tiġi tara l-ewwel logħba miegħi?
messages.zh: 下个月。你想和我一起去看第一场比赛吗？
messages.en: Next month. Do you want to come and watch the first match with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日历想成按“季”分块：天气有夏季，足球有赛季；staġun 都表示这样一段时期。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel ashamed, embarrassed, or shy, or to blush from such feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到羞愧、尴尬或害羞，也可指因这些感受而脸红。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss mistħija jew imbarazz, jew jiħmar f'wiċċu minħabba dawn is-sentimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因自己的行为或某种处境而感到羞愧。
因害羞、尴尬等情绪而脸红。
感到害羞或腼腆，不好意思与人交往或表现自己。

sense_translations.en_definition: to blush, to be ashamed, embarrassed, shy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸红，或感到羞愧、尴尬、害羞。

collocations.zh: 为自己的行为感到羞愧

collocations.en: was too shy to speak in front of people

formal.mt: Wara li fehem li kien weġġa' lil sieħbu bi kliemu, Mark staħa minn għemilu u talab skuża.
formal.en: After realising that his words had hurt his friend, Mark felt ashamed of his actions and apologised.
formal.zh: 意识到自己的话伤害了朋友后，马克为自己的行为感到羞愧，并道了歉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma qal xejn fil-laqgħa? Lara: Staħa jitkellem quddiem dawk in-nies kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark say anything at the meeting? Lara: He was too shy to speak in front of all those people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么在会上什么也没说？拉拉：他不好意思当着那么多人的面讲话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma qal xejn fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma qal xejn fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 马克为什么在会上什么也没说？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark say anything at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staħa jitkellem quddiem dawk in-nies kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Staħa jitkellem quddiem dawk in-nies kollha.
messages.zh: 他不好意思当着那么多人的面讲话。
messages.en: He was too shy to speak in front of all those people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 staħa 连到“低头、脸红、不好意思”的画面：做错事可羞愧，面对众人可害羞，情绪也可能表现为脸红。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hide or move out of sight so that other people cannot easily see or find you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 躲到别人不容易看见或找到的地方，隐藏自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħeba jew imur f'post fejn ħaddieħor ma jkunx jista' jarah jew isibu faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐藏；躲藏。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hide (oneself); to go into hiding
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己藏起来；躲入隐蔽处。

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba, it-tifel staħba wara siġra u stenna sakemm sħabu bdew ifittxuh.
formal.en: During the game, the boy hid behind a tree and waited until his friends started looking for him.
formal.zh: 游戏时，男孩躲在一棵树后面，等着朋友们开始找他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar it-tifel? Pawlu: Staħba taħt il-mejda. Qed jilgħab magħna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the boy go? Pawlu: He hid under the table. He's playing with us!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩去哪儿了？保罗：他躲到桌子下面了。他在跟我们玩呢！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the boy go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staħba taħt il-mejda. Qed jilgħab magħna!
messages.mt_standard: Staħba taħt il-mejda. Qed jilgħab magħna!
messages.zh: 他躲到桌子下面了。他在跟我们玩呢！
messages.en: He hid under the table. He's playing with us!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 staħba 和捉迷藏的画面一起记：人躲到树后或桌下，别人暂时看不见。

gloss_zh: 休闲放松；使自己恢复精神

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take some recreation or refresh oneself through a pleasant break.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过休闲活动或愉快的小憩放松身心，恢复精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu ftit mistrieħ jew rikreazzjoni biex jerġa' jħossu frisk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行一些休闲活动；消遣放松。
使自己恢复精神；让自己重新感到舒畅。

collocations.zh: 在花园里放松，恢复精神

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata twila ta' xogħol, Pawlu staħja ftit fil-ġnien qabel kompla bil-qari tiegħu.
formal.en: After a long day of work, Pawlu refreshed himself in the garden before continuing his reading.
formal.zh: 忙碌了一整天后，保罗先在花园里放松片刻、恢复精神，然后继续阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu wara x-xogħol? Lara: Staħja ftit fil-ġnien. Kellu bżonn jieħu pawża.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do after work? Lara: He took a little recreation in the garden. He needed a break.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗下班后做什么了？拉拉：他在花园里放松了一会儿。他需要休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗下班后做什么了？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do after work?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staħja ftit fil-ġnien. Kellu bżonn jieħu pawża.
messages.mt_standard: Staħja ftit fil-ġnien. Kellu bżonn jieħu pawża.
messages.zh: 他在花园里放松了一会儿。他需要休息一下。
messages.en: He took a little recreation in the garden. He needed a break.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 staħja 时想象下班后在花园休闲片刻：身体放松，精神也重新恢复。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A request asking someone to come to a place or take part in an event, or a written message conveying that request.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 请某人到访或参加活动的邀请，也可指传达这类邀请的书面邀请函。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba lil xi ħadd biex jiġi f'post jew jieħu sehem f'avveniment, jew messaġġ miktub li jwassal din it-talba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邀请；请他人到访或参加活动的表示，也可指邀请函。
一次邀请；一份邀请函。

formal.mt: L-iskola bagħtet stedina lill-ġenituri biex jattendu l-laqgħa ta' nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The school sent an invitation to the parents to attend Friday's meeting.
formal.zh: 学校向家长发出邀请，请他们参加星期五的会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Irċevejt l-istedina għall-festa tiegħi? Luqa: Iva, grazzi! Niġi żgur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you get the invitation to my party? Luqa: Yes, thanks! I'll definitely come.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你收到我聚会的邀请了吗？卢卡：收到了，谢谢！我一定来。

messages.speaker: Sara (聚会主人)
messages.zh: 你收到我聚会的邀请了吗？
messages.en: Did you get the invitation to my party?

messages.speaker: Luqa (受邀朋友)
messages.zh: 收到了，谢谢！我一定来。
messages.en: Yes, thanks! I'll definitely come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“收到邀请、接受邀请、前去赴约”的场景记住 stedina；想象一张写着你名字的请柬，把词义与实际动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wake up or become awake after sleeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从睡眠中醒来，进入清醒状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqum mir-raqda u jiġi f'sensih wara li jkun rieqed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 醒来；从睡眠中恢复清醒。
睡醒；由睡着的状态转为醒着的状态。

collocations.en: woke up to the sound of the alarm

formal.mt: It-tifel stenbaħ bil-ħoss tal-allarm fis-sitta ta' filgħodu u beda jħejji ruħu għall-iskola.
formal.en: The boy woke up to the sound of the alarm at six in the morning and began getting ready for school.
formal.zh: 男孩早上六点听到闹铃声醒来，开始准备上学。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tifel għadu rieqed? Mark: Le, stenbaħ ftit ilu. Issa qed jieħu l-kolazzjon. Maja: Tajjeb, mela għandna ħin qabel nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the boy still asleep? Mark: No, he woke up a little while ago. He's having breakfast now. Maja: Good, then we have time before we leave.
colloquial.zh: Maja：孩子还在睡吗？Mark：没有，他刚才醒了。现在正在吃早餐。Maja：好，那我们出发前还有时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子还在睡吗？
messages.en: Is the boy still asleep?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, stenbaħ ftit ilu. Issa qed jieħu l-kolazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Le, stenbaħ ftit ilu. Issa qed jieħu l-kolazzjon.
messages.zh: 没有，他刚才醒了。现在正在吃早餐。
messages.en: No, he woke up a little while ago. He's having breakfast now.

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, mela għandna ħin qabel nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, mela għandna ħin qabel nitilqu.
messages.zh: 好，那我们出发前还有时间。
messages.en: Good, then we have time before we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stenbaħ 配上“闹铃响、睁开眼”的画面，再连读 stenbaħ kmieni，记住“很早醒了”。重点记醒来的那一刻，醒后仍可躺在床上。

gloss_zh: 等待；等候某人或某物；预期；期待

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wait for someone or something, or to expect something to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 等待某人、某物或某件事，也可表示预期或期待某事发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tibqa' sakemm jasal xi ħadd jew jiġri xi ħaġa, jew taħseb li xi ħaġa se tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 等待；暂时停留，直到适当的时刻。
等候某人或某物的到来。
预期；认为某事将会发生。
预期、期待；事先想到或盼望某事发生。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, stenna barra l-uffiċċju sakemm insejħulek.
formal.en: Please wait outside the office until we call you.
formal.zh: 请在办公室外等候，直到我们叫您。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Stenna ftit, għadni mhux lest. Marija: Tajjeb, nistenniek ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Wait a moment, I'm not ready yet. Marija: Okay, I'll wait for you by the door.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：等一下，我还没准备好。Marija：好，我在门边等你。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 等一下，我还没准备好。
messages.en: Wait a moment, I'm not ready yet.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我在门边等你。
messages.en: Okay, I'll wait for you by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stenna ftit 和“等一下”的暂停手势一起记：先想到实际等候，再联系心里预期某事发生的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or period of waiting, or the expectation that something will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 等待这一行为或等候的时间，也可指认为或期待某事将会发生的心理状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew iż-żmien li fih tistenna, jew il-ħsieb li xi ħaġa se tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 等待；等候这一行为或过程。
预期；认为某事将会发生的想法。
动词 stenna 的动名词，表示等待或期待这一行为、过程或状态。
期待、盼望；对即将发生之事的预想或期待之情。

formal.mt: Il-ħin ta' stennija għal dan is-servizz huwa madwar għoxrin minuta.
formal.en: The waiting time for this service is approximately twenty minutes.
formal.zh: 这项服务的等候时间约为二十分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm se ddum l-istennija? Mark: Xi għaxar minuti. Nistgħu noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How long will the wait be? Mark: About ten minutes. We can sit down here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：还要等多久？Mark：大约十分钟。我们可以坐在这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 还要等多久？
messages.en: How long will the wait be?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi għaxar minuti. Nistgħu noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Xi għaxar minuti. Nistgħu noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn.
messages.zh: 大约十分钟。我们可以坐在这里。
messages.en: About ten minutes. We can sit down here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用等候室里的时钟记 stennija：它把“等”当作一段时间或一种状态来谈；连着 ħin ta' stennija“等候时间”一起记更牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate that something is identical, or to emphasize the person or thing being mentioned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事物相同，也可强调所指的人或事物本身，相当于“同一的”“自己”或“亲自”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika li xi ħaġa hija l-istess, jew biex tenfasizza l-persuna jew il-ħaġa msemmija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相同的；同一个的。
本身的；用于强调所指的人或事物自身。
自己；本人，常与人称代词搭配，强调动作由本人完成。
同一；同样的，用于限定所指的是同一个或相同的事物。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti kollha wieġbu l-istess mistoqsijiet, u r-riċerkatur stess ġabar it-tweġibiet.
formal.en: All participants answered the same questions, and the researcher personally collected the responses.
formal.zh: 所有参与者都回答了相同的问题，研究人员亲自收集了答案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna l-istess ktieb! Int stess għażiltu? Mark: Iva, għażiltu jien stess.
colloquial.en: Maja: We have the same book! Did you choose it yourself? Mark: Yes, I chose it myself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有同一本书！是你自己选的吗？马克：对，是我自己选的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna l-istess ktieb! Int stess għażiltu?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna l-istess ktieb! Int stess għażiltu?
messages.zh: 我们有同一本书！是你自己选的吗？
messages.en: We have the same book! Did you choose it yourself?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，是我自己选的。
messages.en: Yes, I chose it myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个位置一起记：l-istess ktieb 是“同一本书”，jien stess 是“我自己”；通过搭配区分“相同”和“本人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A photograph that someone takes of themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由拍摄者给自己拍摄的照片，即自拍照。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ritratt li persuna tieħu tagħha nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自拍；自拍照。
自己给自己拍的照片。
自拍照；由照片中的人自行拍摄的照片。

collocations.zh: 与朋友一起拍的自拍照

collocations.en: a selfie in front of the museum
collocations.zh: 在博物馆前拍的自拍照

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara edukattiva, kull student ħa stessu quddiem il-mużew biex iżommu bħala tifkira.
formal.en: During the educational visit, each student took a selfie in front of the museum to keep as a souvenir.
formal.zh: 在教学参观期间，每位学生都在博物馆前拍了一张自拍照留作纪念。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nieħdu stessu flimkien? Mark: Iva! Żomm it-telefon ftit ogħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we take a selfie together? Mark: Yes! Hold the phone a little higher.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们一起自拍一张好吗？马克：好！把手机举高一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们一起自拍一张好吗？
messages.en: Shall we take a selfie together?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好！把手机举高一点。
messages.en: Yes! Hold the phone a little higher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象举起手机、把自己放进画面的动作，再把 stessu 和“自拍照”绑定；用 nieħu stessu 整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be under a curse, to become speechless with astonishment, or to feel overwhelmed by an experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到诅咒；也可表示因震惊而说不出话，或因某种经历而感到难以承受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun taħt saħta, jibqa' bla kliem bl-istagħġib, jew iħossu megħlub minn xi esperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到诅咒；处于诅咒之下。
惊呆；因极度惊讶或震惊而一时说不出话。
感到难以承受；被强烈的情绪或经历压倒。

collocations.en: was dumbfounded when he heard the news

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-aħbar għall-ewwel darba, ir-raġel steħet u għal ftit mumenti ma setax jitkellem.
formal.en: When he first heard the news, the man was dumbfounded and could not speak for a few moments.
formal.zh: 第一次听到这个消息时，那名男子惊呆了，一时说不出话来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħa l-aħbar Pawlu? Mark: Steħet. Baqa' bla kliem għal ftit. Maja: Nimmaġina! Lanqas jien ma stennejtha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu take the news? Mark: He was dumbfounded. He was speechless for a little while. Maja: I can imagine! I wasn't expecting it either.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu听到消息后有什么反应？Mark：他惊呆了，好一会儿说不出话。Maja：可以想象！我也没料到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu听到消息后有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Pawlu take the news?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Steħet. Baqa' bla kliem għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Steħet. Baqa' bla kliem għal ftit.
messages.zh: 他惊呆了，好一会儿说不出话。
messages.en: He was dumbfounded. He was speechless for a little while.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以想象！我也没料到。
messages.en: I can imagine! I wasn't expecting it either.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张情境卡记住 steħet：故事人物受到诅咒、听到消息惊得失语、情绪太强难以承受。每次根据上下文选义，避免只记成“惊讶”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To benefit from or make use of something; in a negative context, to exploit someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用某种资源、时间或机会并从中获益；在负面语境中，也指为自身利益而剥削或不当利用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża xi ħaġa biex jikseb benefiċċju; f'kuntest negattiv, jieħu vantaġġ minn persuna jew minn xi ħaġa b'mod inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从某事物中受益；利用某事物获得好处。

sense_translations.en_definition: to benefit from, to make use of, to exploit
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从中受益；加以利用；也可指剥削或不当利用，具体褒贬取决于语境。

collocations.en: made use of the free time

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur stgħall id-data disponibbli biex iqabbel ir-riżultati taż-żewġ studji.
formal.en: The researcher made use of the available data to compare the results of the two studies.
formal.zh: 研究人员利用现有数据比较了两项研究的结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Mark waqt il-vaganzi? Sara: Stgħall il-ħin liberu biex jitgħallem iċ-Ċiniż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark do during the holidays? Sara: He used his free time to learn Chinese.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克假期里做了什么？萨拉：他利用空闲时间学中文。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克假期里做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark do during the holidays?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stgħall il-ħin liberu biex jitgħallem iċ-Ċiniż.
messages.mt_standard: Stgħall il-ħin liberu biex jitgħallem iċ-Ċiniż.
messages.zh: 他利用空闲时间学中文。
messages.en: He used his free time to learn Chinese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把资源变成收益”的画面记 stgħall：利用时间可以是好事，利用他人则可能是剥削，褒贬要看宾语和语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strive toward a goal or make a determined effort to do one's utmost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为达到某个目标而努力，强调尽力而为或竭力争取。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz qawwi biex jilħaq għan jew jagħmel dak kollu li jista'.

sense_translations.en_definition: to strive to do one's utmost
sense_translations.zh_definition: 竭力而为；努力做到自己力所能及的最好程度。
努力；奋斗；为某个目标作出积极而坚定的努力。

formal.mt: Minkejja d-diffikultajiet, it-tim stgħan biex itemm il-proġett fiż-żmien miftiehem.
formal.en: Despite the difficulties, the team strove to complete the project within the agreed time.
formal.zh: 尽管困难重重，团队仍竭力争取在约定时间内完成项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ċeda meta sab il-problema diffiċli? Sara: Le, stgħan kemm felaħ biex isolviha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark give up when he found the problem difficult? Sara: No, he tried as hard as he could to solve it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克发现问题很难时放弃了吗？萨拉：没有，他尽了全力去解决。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark ċeda meta sab il-problema diffiċli?
messages.mt_standard: Mark ċeda meta sab il-problema diffiċli?
messages.zh: 马克发现问题很难时放弃了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark give up when he found the problem difficult?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, stgħan kemm felaħ biex isolviha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, stgħan kemm felaħ biex isolviha.
messages.zh: 没有，他尽了全力去解决。
messages.en: No, he tried as hard as he could to solve it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stgħan 配上“遇到难题仍使劲向前”的画面；它强调努力的过程，不能仅凭这个词判断最后是否成功。

gloss_zh: 对某人产生情欲；渴慕某人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel strong sexual desire for someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人产生强烈的性欲或情欲，含义强于一般的喜欢或欣赏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss xewqa sesswali qawwija għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人产生强烈情欲；在性欲层面渴望某人。

collocations.zh: 对一名女子产生了情欲

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist sthewwa għal mara li bilkemm kien jaf; in-narratur jiddistingwi din ix-xewqa mill-imħabba.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist lusted after a woman he barely knew; the narrator distinguishes this desire from love.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公对一名几乎不认识的女子产生了情欲；叙述者将这种欲望与爱情区分开来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tgħid li sthewwa għaliha, tfisser li ħabbha? Mark: Le, hawn tfisser li ħass xewqa sesswali qawwija għaliha.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you say he lusted after her, do you mean he loved her? Mark: No, here it means that he felt strong sexual desire for her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说他对她产生情欲，是说他爱上她了吗？马克：不是，这里是说他对她产生了强烈的性欲。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid li sthewwa għaliha, tfisser li ħabbha?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid li sthewwa għaliha, tfisser li ħabbha?
messages.zh: 你说他对她产生情欲，是说他爱上她了吗？
messages.en: When you say he lusted after her, do you mean he loved her?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn tfisser li ħass xewqa sesswali qawwija għaliha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn tfisser li ħass xewqa sesswali qawwija għaliha.
messages.zh: 不是，这里是说他对她产生了强烈的性欲。
messages.en: No, here it means that he felt strong sexual desire for her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sthewwa 贴上“强烈情欲”的记忆标签，并与普通的喜欢、欣赏和爱情分开，避免把语气强度记轻了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ask someone to come to an event, visit a place, or take part in an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 邀请某人出席活动、到访某处或参与某项事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talab lil xi ħadd biex jiġi għal xi okkażjoni, iżur xi post jew jieħu sehem f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邀请；请某人前来或参加。

collocations.en: invited the neighbours for a meal

formal.mt: Il-kunsill stieden lir-residenti għal laqgħa dwar il-proġett il-ġdid.
formal.en: The council invited the residents to a meeting about the new project.
formal.zh: 委员会邀请居民们参加有关新项目的会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min stieden lil Sara għall-festa? Mark: Jien sted nidtha lbieraħ; qalet li se tiġi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who invited Sara to the party? Mark: I invited her yesterday; she said she would come.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁邀请萨拉来参加聚会的？马克：我昨天邀请了她；她说会来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁邀请萨拉来参加聚会的？
messages.en: Who invited Sara to the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien sted nidtha lbieraħ; qalet li se tiġi.
messages.mt_standard: Jien sted nidtha lbieraħ; qalet li se tiġi.
messages.zh: 我昨天邀请了她；她说会来。
messages.en: I invited her yesterday; she said she would come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把邀请函、受邀的人和活动连成一幅画面：看到 stieden，就想起“请你来参加”。

gloss_zh: 与人熟络；交际；一起消磨时光

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become comfortable with other people through spending time and socialising with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过与别人相处、聊天或一起活动而逐渐熟络，也可表示与人交际、一起消磨时光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar midħla ta' nies oħra billi qatta' ħin magħhom u tkellem jew għamel xi attività magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐与人熟悉、熟络起来。
与人交际、聊天或一起参加社交活动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spend time; to socialise; to hang out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与人一起消磨时光；交际；一起闲聚。

formal.mt: Matul l-ewwel ġimgħa, l-istudent il-ġdid stienes ma' sħabu fil-klassi.
formal.en: During the first week, the new student became familiar with his classmates.
formal.zh: 在第一周里，新同学逐渐与班上的同学们熟络起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar Pawlu mal-ħbieb tiegħek? Sara: Għall-ewwel kien kwiet, imma mbagħad stienes magħna u baqa' jitkellem sal-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu get on with your friends? Sara: He was quiet at first, but then he warmed up to us and kept chatting until the end.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗和你的朋友们相处得怎么样？萨拉：他起初很安静，后来跟我们熟络起来，一直聊到最后。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗和你的朋友们相处得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get on with your friends?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel kien kwiet, imma mbagħad stienes magħna u baqa' jitkellem sal-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel kien kwiet, imma mbagħad stienes magħna u baqa' jitkellem sal-aħħar.
messages.zh: 他起初很安静，后来跟我们熟络起来，一直聊到最后。
messages.en: He was quiet at first, but then he warmed up to us and kept chatting until the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新同学从安静坐着到加入聊天：stienes 把“相处、熟络、一起闲聚”串成一个场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stick or rod, especially a cue used in billiards; in another sense, a small adhesive dressing for a wound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 棍、棒或杆，尤其指台球球杆；另一个义项指贴在小伤口上的创可贴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa twila u rqiqa, bħal dik li tintuża biex tolqot il-boċċi fil-biljard; f'tifsira oħra, faxxa żgħira li teħel biex tgħatti ferita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 台球球杆；击打台球用的长杆。
创可贴；用于覆盖小伤口的黏贴式敷料。
棍；棒；细长的杆状物。

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet il-logħba, il-plejer iċċekkja li l-istikka tal-biljard kienet f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before the game began, the player checked that the billiard cue was in good condition.
formal.zh: 比赛开始前，球员检查了台球球杆，确保其状态良好。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Qtajt subgħajja ftit. Għandek stikka? Marija: Iva, hawn waħda. Aħsel il-ferita qabel twaħħalha.
colloquial.en: Lina: I cut my finger a little. Do you have a band-aid? Marija: Yes, here's one. Wash the wound before putting it on.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我的手指划破了一点。你有创可贴吗？玛丽亚：有，这里有一片。贴之前先清洗伤口。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我的手指划破了一点。你有创可贴吗？
messages.en: I cut my finger a little. Do you have a band-aid?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn waħda. Aħsel il-ferita qabel twaħħalha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn waħda. Aħsel il-ferita qabel twaħħalha.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一片。贴之前先清洗伤口。
messages.en: Yes, here's one. Wash the wound before putting it on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 stikka 配三张场景卡：台球桌旁是球杆，伤口旁是创可贴，木料旁是棍棒；用语境选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A star seen in the sky, understood as a celestial body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天空中的星星，作为一种天体来理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġisem ċelesti li jidher fis-sema bħala punt ta' dawl, speċjalment bil-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 星；星星。
天体；此处指天空中的星体。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw stilla tleqq permezz tat-teleskopju u rreġistraw dak li raw.
formal.en: The students observed a bright star through the telescope and recorded what they saw.
formal.zh: 学生们通过望远镜观察了一颗明亮的星星，并记录了观察结果。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Tara dik l-istilla ħdejn il-qamar? Pawlu: Iva, tidher ċara ħafna llejla.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can you see that star near the moon? Pawlu: Yes, it looks very clear tonight.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你看见月亮旁边的那颗星星了吗？保罗：看见了，今晚看得特别清楚。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见月亮旁边的那颗星星了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that star near the moon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了，今晚看得特别清楚。
messages.en: Yes, it looks very clear tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stilla 写在一颗手绘星星下面，再读 stilla tleqq“明亮的星星”，让词形与夜空画面相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approximate assessment of an amount, cost, or value; also respect or high regard for someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对数量、费用或价值作出的粗略估计、估价；也指对某人的尊重或敬重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kalkolu approssimattiv ta' ammont, spiża jew valur; ukoll rispett jew apprezzament lejn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 估计；估算结果；估价。
尊重；敬重；对某人的重视。
估计；估算；对数量、费用或价值的评估。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta stima tal-ispiża totali tat-tiswijiet.
formal.en: The report presents an estimate of the total cost of the repairs.
formal.zh: 报告列出了维修总费用的估算。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex titkellem daqshekk tajjeb dwar l-għalliema tiegħek? Sara: Għandi stima kbira lejha; dejjem għenitni meta kelli bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you speak so highly of your teacher? Sara: I have great respect for her; she always helped me when I needed it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么对你的老师评价这么高？萨拉：我很敬重她；每当我需要帮助时，她总会帮助我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex titkellem daqshekk tajjeb dwar l-għalliema tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex titkellem daqshekk tajjeb dwar l-għalliema tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你为什么对你的老师评价这么高？
messages.en: Why do you speak so highly of your teacher?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi stima kbira lejha; dejjem għenitni meta kelli bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi stima kbira lejha; dejjem għenitni meta kelli bżonn.
messages.zh: 我很敬重她；每当我需要帮助时，她总会帮助我。
messages.en: I have great respect for her; she always helped me when I needed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个固定场景记 stima：算维修费时是“估价”，谈敬爱的老师时是“敬重”；留意后面的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To encourage or increase activity, interest, thought, or development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刺激或鼓励，使活动、兴趣、思考或发展变得更活跃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħeġġeġ jew żied l-attività, l-interess, il-ħsieb jew l-iżvilupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺激；激发；促使某种活动、兴趣或发展增强。

formal.mt: L-esperiment stimula l-interess tal-istudenti fix-xjenza u wassal għal aktar mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The experiment stimulated the students' interest in science and led to more questions.
formal.zh: 这个实验激发了学生们对科学的兴趣，并引出了更多问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd beda jitkellem wara l-filmat? Mark: Għax stimula d-diskussjoni; kulħadd kellu xi ħaġa xi jgħid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did everyone start talking after the video? Mark: Because it stimulated discussion; everyone had something to say.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么看完视频后大家都开始说话了？马克：因为它带动了讨论；每个人都有话想说。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd beda jitkellem wara l-filmat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd beda jitkellem wara l-filmat?
messages.zh: 为什么看完视频后大家都开始说话了？
messages.en: Why did everyone start talking after the video?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax stimula d-diskussjoni; kulħadd kellu xi ħaġa xi jgħid.
messages.mt_standard: Għax stimula d-diskussjoni; kulħadd kellu xi ħaġa xi jgħid.
messages.zh: 因为它带动了讨论；每个人都有话想说。
