formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi tajprajter antik u jispjega kif kienu jitħejjew id-dokumenti bih.
formal.en: The museum displays an old typewriter and explains how documents used to be prepared with it.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一台旧打字机，并介绍过去如何用它制作文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tajprajter għadu jaħdem? Pawlu: Iva, daħħal karta u agħfas xi tasti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this typewriter still work? Pawlu: Yes, put in a sheet of paper and press a few keys.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这台打字机还能用吗？保罗：能，放一张纸进去，按几个键试试。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 这台打字机还能用吗？
messages.en: Does this typewriter still work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, daħħal karta u agħfas xi tasti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, daħħal karta u agħfas xi tasti.
messages.zh: 能，放一张纸进去，按几个键试试。
messages.en: Yes, put in a sheet of paper and press a few keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tajprajter 与“放纸、按键、纸上出现字母”三个连续动作绑定；记住它指能直接在纸上打字的机器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird; the same word can also refer to a kite or a flight, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟或禽鸟；根据上下文，也可表示风筝或一次飞行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur; skont il-kuntest, il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll ġugarell li jtir marbut ma' ħajta, jew titjira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禽鸟；禽类。
鸟。
风筝。
一次飞行；一趟飞翔。

formal.mt: Matul l-attività, kull student għamel tajra tal-karti u żejjinha b'kuluri differenti.
formal.en: During the activity, each student made a paper kite and decorated it with different colours.
formal.zh: 活动中，每位学生都制作了一只纸风筝，并用不同颜色加以装饰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik it-tajra żgħira fuq il-fergħa! Pawlu: Rajtha! Ejja nibqgħu kwieti biex ma nbeżżgħuhiex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that little bird on the branch! Pawlu: I see it! Let's stay quiet so we don't scare it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树枝上的那只小鸟！保罗：看到了！我们安静一点，别吓着它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik it-tajra żgħira fuq il-fergħa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik it-tajra żgħira fuq il-fergħa!
messages.zh: 看树枝上的那只小鸟！
messages.en: Look at that little bird on the branch!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Ejja nibqgħu kwieti biex ma nbeżżgħuhiex.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Ejja nibqgħu kwieti biex ma nbeżżgħuhiex.
messages.zh: 看到了！我们安静一点，别吓着它。
messages.en: I see it! Let's stay quiet so we don't scare it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tajra 画三张学习图：树上的鸟、牵着线的风筝、表示一次飞行的弧线；靠场景选择词义，这只是记忆联想。

gloss_zh: 走路时用鞋跟踏出响声；用脚跟踏步

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike the ground with the heels while walking or performing a movement, often making a clacking sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路或做动作时用脚跟、鞋跟踏地，常发出清脆的敲击声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot l-art bit-tkaken waqt il-mixi jew waqt moviment bħaż-żfin, spiss b'ħoss ċar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to clack one's heels on the ground as one walks
sense_translations.zh_definition: 走路时用鞋跟敲击地面，发出咔嗒声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to heel (to perform by the use of the heels, as in dancing, running, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用脚跟完成动作，例如在跳舞、跑步等活动中用脚跟踏地。

collocations.en: struck the ground with his heels

formal.mt: Iż-żeffien takkan mal-art skont ir-ritmu tal-mużika.
formal.en: The dancer struck the floor with his heels in time with the music.
formal.zh: 舞者随着音乐节奏用脚跟踏地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħoss fil-kuritur? Pawlu: Iva, Mark takkan mal-art hu u miexi biż-żraben il-ġodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that noise in the corridor? Pawlu: Yes, Mark's heels clacked on the floor as he walked in his new shoes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到走廊里的那个声音了吗？保罗：听到了，马克穿着新鞋走路，鞋跟踩得咔嗒响。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你听到走廊里的那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that noise in the corridor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Mark takkan mal-art hu u miexi biż-żraben il-ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Mark takkan mal-art hu u miexi biż-żraben il-ġodda.
messages.zh: 听到了，马克穿着新鞋走路，鞋跟踩得咔嗒响。
messages.en: Yes, Mark's heels clacked on the floor as he walked in his new shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 听着想象中的“咔嗒、咔嗒”声记 takkan：重点是脚跟踏地这个动作，可发生在走路或跳舞时。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The raised part beneath the back of a shoe that supports the wearer's heel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鞋子后部下方承托脚后跟的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti taħt in-naħa ta' wara taż-żarbun li ssostni l-għarqub tas-sieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞋跟。
鞋子的后跟部分。

formal.mt: Il-klijenta talbet li jissewwa t-takkun miksur taż-żarbun.
formal.en: The customer asked for the broken heel of the shoe to be repaired.
formal.zh: 女顾客要求修好鞋子断掉的鞋跟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-takkun ta' dan iż-żarbun qed jiċċaqlaq. Pawlu: Ħudlu għand min isewwi ż-żraben qabel ma jinkiser.
colloquial.en: Maja: The heel of this shoe is loose. Pawlu: Take it to a shoe repairer before it breaks.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只鞋的鞋跟松了。保罗：趁它还没断，拿去找修鞋师傅修一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-takkun ta' dan iż-żarbun qed jiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: It-takkun ta' dan iż-żarbun qed jiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 这只鞋的鞋跟松了。
messages.en: The heel of this shoe is loose.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħudlu għand min isewwi ż-żraben qabel ma jinkiser.
messages.mt_standard: Ħudlu għand min isewwi ż-żraben qabel ma jinkiser.
messages.zh: 趁它还没断，拿去找修鞋师傅修一下。
messages.en: Take it to a shoe repairer before it breaks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 指着鞋底后方凸起的鞋跟说 takkun，再用 takkun għoli 记“高鞋跟”；把部件名与踏地动作 takkan 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become longer in length or duration, or to continue for a period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长度变长，或时间延长、持续下去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir itwal fit-tul jew fiż-żmien, jew idum għal xi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变长。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become long, to become prolonged, to last
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变长；时间延长；持续。

collocations.en: The speech went on for a long time.

formal.mt: Id-diskors tal aktar milli kien mistenni, u għalhekk il-laqgħa spiċċat tard.
formal.en: The speech lasted longer than expected, so the meeting ended late.
formal.zh: 讲话持续的时间超过预期，因此会议很晚才结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ix-xagħar tiegħek tal ħafna! Pawlu: Iva, ilni ma naqtagħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your hair has grown really long! Pawlu: Yes, I haven't had it cut for a while.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的头发长长了好多！Pawlu：是啊，我有一阵子没剪了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的头发长长了好多！
messages.en: Your hair has grown really long!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我有一阵子没剪了。
messages.en: Yes, I haven't had it cut for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把头发变长和讲话拖长并排想象：本条动词 tal 都可以用“长度或时间拉长”来记。

gloss_zh: 令人惊叹的；惊人的；非凡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing strong surprise or admiration because something is unusual, impressive, or extraordinary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不同寻常、表现出色或非凡而令人惊讶或赞叹的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqajjem sorpriża jew ammirazzjoni kbira għax ikun mhux tas-soltu jew straordinarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人惊叹的；惊人的。
非凡的；不同寻常的。
令人惊叹的；令人震惊的；出人意料的；非凡的。

formal.mt: Il-wirja turi t-talent tal-għaġeb tal-artisti żgħażagħ.
formal.en: The exhibition showcases the amazing talent of the young artists.
formal.zh: 这场展览展示了年轻艺术家们惊人的才华。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara din il-veduta! Mark: Tal-għaġeb! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at this view! Mark: Amazing! Let's take a photo.
colloquial.zh: Sara：看看这景色！Mark：太美了！我们拍张照片吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 看看这景色！
messages.en: Look at this view!

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.zh: 太美了！我们拍张照片吧。
messages.en: Amazing! Let's take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tal-għaġeb 当作看到壮丽景色时的一整句赞叹来练：“太惊人了！”再联想到非凡成果和惊人才华。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ask for something, sometimes earnestly or as a beggar, or to address a prayer to God.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向人请求某物或帮助，也可指乞求、恳求，或向上帝祈祷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlob xi ħaġa jew l-għajnuna, kultant b'insistenza jew bħala tallab, jew jitkellem ma' Alla fit-talb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 请求；提出请求。
乞求；乞讨。
恳求；殷切地请求。
请求得到；向人索求。
祈祷；向上帝祷告。

sense_translations.en_definition: to ask for; to request; to beg
sense_translations.zh_definition: 请求得到；请求；乞求。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pray; to be in prayer
sense_translations.zh_definition: 祈祷；处于祷告之中。

formal.mt: L-istudent talab permess biex juża l-librerija wara l-ħin tal-iskola.
formal.en: The student requested permission to use the library after school hours.
formal.zh: 这名学生请求获准在放学后使用图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu talab l-għajnuna tiegħek? Rita: Iva, talabni ngħinu jġorr il-kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu ask for your help? Rita: Yes, he asked me to help him carry the boxes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 请你帮忙了吗？Rita：是的，他请我帮他搬箱子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 请你帮忙了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu ask for your help?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他请我帮他搬箱子。
messages.en: Yes, he asked me to help him carry the boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个请求对象帮助记忆：向朋友求助、向别人乞求、向上帝祈祷，都围绕“有所求”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of praying, or the activity of begging or requesting something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 祈祷这一活动，也可指乞求或提出请求的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitlob lil Alla, jew l-att li wieħed jitlob xi ħaġa jew l-għajnuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祈祷这一行为或活动。
乞求；乞讨这一行为。
talab 的动名词，表示祈祷、乞求或请求这一行为。
祈祷；祷告。
乞求；提出请求。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi ħin għat-talb u għar-riflessjoni personali.
formal.en: The programme includes time for prayer and personal reflection.
formal.zh: 活动安排包括祈祷和个人反思的时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tagħmel in-nanna? Mark: Qed tgħid it-talb tagħha. Sara: Mela nistennew ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is Grandma doing? Mark: She's saying her prayers. Sara: Then let's wait a little.
colloquial.zh: Sara：奶奶在做什么？Mark：她正在祈祷。Sara：那我们等一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.zh: 奶奶在做什么？
messages.en: What is Grandma doing?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.zh: 她正在祈祷。
messages.en: She's saying her prayers.

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.zh: 那我们等一会儿吧。
messages.en: Then let's wait a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 talb 放进“祈祷时间”这个场景里记：它着眼于祈祷或请求的活动，可与表示一次具体祷告或请求的 talba 对照。

gloss_zh: 一次祈祷；祷文；请求；要求

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual prayer or an individual request or demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次具体的祈祷或一篇祷文，也可指一项具体的请求或要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att wieħed ta' talb jew kliem ta' talb, jew xewqa jew ħtieġa espressa lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel jew jagħti xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祈祷；祷文。
请求；一项请求。
talb 的单体形式，表示一次祈祷或一项请求。

sense_translations.en_definition: a prayer (way or instance of praying)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次祈祷；一种祈祷方式。
一项请求；一项要求。

collocations.zh: 作一次祈祷；念一篇祷文

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irċieva talba bil-miktub biex il-laqgħa ssir f'data oħra.
formal.en: The committee received a written request for the meeting to be held on another date.
formal.zh: 委员会收到一份书面请求，要求将会议改在另一日期举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nagħmillek talba żgħira? Pawlu: Żgur, għidli. Maja: Tista' tagħtini daqqa t'id b'din il-kaxxa?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I make a small request? Pawlu: Of course, tell me. Maja: Can you give me a hand with this box?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我能提个小请求吗？Pawlu：当然，说吧。Maja：你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能提个小请求吗？
messages.en: Can I make a small request?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，说吧。
messages.en: Of course, tell me.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini daqqa t'id b'din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini daqqa t'id b'din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？
messages.en: Can you give me a hand with this box?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里拿着一张请求书，或念完一篇祷文：talba 可以对应“一项请求、一次祈祷”，便于和 talb 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 意大利人；意大利语；意大利的

teaching_sense.en_definition: An Italian person, usually male, or the Italian language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意大利人，通常指男性；也可指意大利语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mill-Italja, ġeneralment raġel, jew il-lingwa Taljana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个意大利人。
意大利语。
意大利的；意大利人的；意大利语的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Italy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自意大利的；与意大利有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Italian (of, from or relating to Italy)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 意大利的，指属于、来自意大利或与意大利有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Italian (native or inhabitant of Italy) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 意大利本国人或居民，通常指男性。
意大利语这一语言的名称。

formal.mt: L-istudent qed jitgħallem it-Taljan biex ikompli l-istudji tiegħu fl-Italja.
formal.en: The student is learning Italian so that he can continue his studies in Italy.
formal.zh: 这名学生正在学习意大利语，以便到意大利继续深造。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Marco huwa Taljan? Pawlu: Iva, u jitkellem bil-Malti wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Marco Italian? Pawlu: Yes, and he speaks Maltese too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Marco 是意大利人吗？Pawlu：是的，而且他也会说马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Marco 是意大利人吗？
messages.en: Is Marco Italian?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，而且他也会说马耳他语。
messages.en: Yes, and he speaks Maltese too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画面区分词性：一个意大利人、一堂意大利语课、一家意大利餐厅；分别帮助记住人、语言和形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to guide a rope or cable or to help lift or pull a load, such as a pulley, winch, or fairlead.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引导绳索或缆绳，或辅助提升、牵拉重物的装置，可指滑轮、绞车或导缆器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jiggwida ħabel jew kejbil, jew jgħin biex tittella' jew tinġibed tagħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑轮；供绳索绕过、用于改变拉力方向或辅助提升的轮形装置。
绞车；通过卷收绳索或缆绳来提升或牵拉重物的装置。
导缆器；用于引导绳索或缆绳走向的装置。

collocations.en: a rope passes through a pulley
lifts a load with a pulley
a pulley attached to the ceiling
collocations.zh: 固定在天花板上的滑轮

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem għadda l-ħabel mit-taljola biex jerfa' l-kaxxa.
formal.en: The worker passed the rope through the pulley to lift the box.
formal.zh: 工人将绳索穿过滑轮，以便把箱子吊起来。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif se ntellgħu din il-kaxxa? Rita: Nużaw it-taljola u dan il-ħabel.
colloquial.en: Mark: How are we going to lift this box? Rita: We'll use the pulley and this rope.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们怎么把这个箱子吊上去？Rita：用这个滑轮和这根绳子。

messages.speaker: Mark (工人)
messages.zh: 我们怎么把这个箱子吊上去？
messages.en: How are we going to lift this box?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 用这个滑轮和这根绳子。
messages.en: We'll use the pulley and this rope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根绳子经过装置把箱子吊起，先记住 taljola 的滑轮义；再按上下文区分卷收绳索的绞车和引导缆绳的导缆器。

gloss_zh: 希望；使人产生希望；希望之情

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wish for a desired outcome and think that it may happen, or to make someone feel such hope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盼望某种结果并认为它有可能实现，也可指使某人产生这样的希望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixtieq li jiġri xi ħaġa tajba u jemmen li tista' sseħħ, jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss tama.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；盼望某事发生。
使人产生希望；使某人有所盼望。
希望；对所盼望的事情可能实现的期待。

formal.mt: Wara li temm il-kors, Pawlu tama li jsib xogħol fil-qasam li studja.
formal.en: After completing the course, Pawlu hoped to find work in the field he had studied.
formal.zh: 完成课程后，Pawlu 希望能在自己所学的领域找到工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu tama li jgħaddi mill-eżami? Rita: Iva, studja ħafna u għad għandu tama.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu hope to pass the exam? Rita: Yes, he studied hard and he still has hope.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 希望能通过考试吗？Rita：是的，他很用功，而且现在仍抱有希望。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu 希望能通过考试吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu hope to pass the exam?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, studja ħafna u għad għandu tama.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, studja ħafna u għad għandu tama.
messages.zh: 是的，他很用功，而且现在仍抱有希望。
messages.en: Yes, he studied hard and he still has hope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把考试前盼望通过的心情作为记忆画面：动词 tama 表示“他曾希望”，名词 tama 表示心中仍有的“希望”。

gloss_zh: 使抱有希望；鼓舞希望；提高期望

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone hope or make someone expect a desired outcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生希望，或使其期待某个理想结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta lil xi ħadd it-tama jew ġiegħlu jistenna riżultat mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人对某事抱有希望。
激发希望；使人受到鼓舞。
提高某人的期望；使某人更加期待。

collocations.en: raised the hopes of the whole family

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat tajjeb tal-ewwel eżami tamma lill-istudent li seta' jtemm il-kors b'suċċess.
formal.en: The good result in the first exam gave the student hope that he could complete the course successfully.
formal.zh: 第一次考试的好成绩使这名学生有了顺利完成课程的希望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-messaġġ ta' Mark tamma lil kulħadd. Lara: Iva, issa għandna aktar tama li l-proġett jirnexxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark's message gave everyone hope. Lara: Yes, now we have more hope that the project will succeed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克的消息让大家都看到了希望。拉拉：是啊，现在我们更有希望把项目做成了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-messaġġ ta' Mark tamma lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Il-messaġġ ta' Mark tamma lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 马克的消息让大家都看到了希望。
messages.en: Mark's message gave everyone hope.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandna aktar tama li l-proġett jirnexxi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandna aktar tama li l-proġett jirnexxi.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在我们更有希望把项目做成了。
messages.en: Yes, now we have more hope that the project will succeed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“好消息让人看见希望”的画面中，记住动作重点是使别人产生期待。

gloss_zh: 生育许多子女；繁衍；生儿育女

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have children or produce offspring, especially to have many children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生育子女、繁衍后代，尤其指生育许多子女。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kellu t-tfal jew nissel ulied, speċjalment ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育许多子女。
繁衍后代；生儿育女。

collocations.en: had children and raised a large family
collocations.zh: 生儿育女，养育了一个大家庭

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont tal-familja jsemmi li n-nannu tammar u kellu sebat itfal.
formal.en: The family account mentions that the grandfather had many children: seven in total.
formal.zh: 这份家族记述提到，祖父生育了许多子女，共有七个孩子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nannuk tammar? Mark: Iva, kellu sebat itfal, u d-dar kienet dejjem mimlija nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did your grandfather have many children? Mark: Yes, he had seven children, and the house was always full of people.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你祖父有很多孩子吗？马克：是啊，他有七个孩子，家里总是热热闹闹的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你祖父有很多孩子吗？
messages.en: Did your grandfather have many children?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu sebat itfal, u d-dar kienet dejjem mimlija nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu sebat itfal, u d-dar kienet dejjem mimlija nies.
messages.zh: 是啊，他有七个孩子，家里总是热热闹闹的。
messages.en: Yes, he had seven children, and the house was always full of people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张坐满孩子的全家福，把这个动词与生儿育女、子女众多的场景联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To beat or play a drum, or to make a loud crashing noise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敲击或演奏鼓，也可指发出响亮的撞击声或轰响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqq it-tanbur jew għamel ħoss qawwi ta' tħabbit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 击鼓；敲鼓。
发出轰响或响亮的撞击声。
打鼓；演奏鼓。

collocations.en: played the drum during the march

formal.mt: Matul il-wirja, il-mużiċist tanbar b'ritmu regolari biex il-grupp iżomm il-pass.
formal.en: During the performance, the musician played the drum with a steady rhythm so that the group could keep time.
formal.zh: 演出期间，乐手以稳定的节奏击鼓，让整个团体保持节拍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min tanbar fil-bitħa dalgħodu? Mark: Ħija; kien qed jipprova ritmu ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who played the drum in the yard this morning? Mark: My brother; he was trying out a new rhythm.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天早上谁在院子里打鼓？马克：我哥哥，他在试一种新节奏。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 今天早上谁在院子里打鼓？
messages.en: Who played the drum in the yard this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija; kien qed jipprova ritmu ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija; kien qed jipprova ritmu ġdid.
messages.zh: 我哥哥，他在试一种新节奏。
messages.en: My brother; he was trying out a new rhythm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手模拟连续击鼓，边做边记 tanbar 表示打鼓这一动作，也可描述响亮的轰响。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or sound of drumming or making a crashing noise; also, brainwashing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 击鼓的活动或声音，也可指制造轰响；另有洗脑之义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-daqq tat-tanbur jew ħoss qawwi ta' tħabbit; ukoll, influwenza ripetuta biex tbiddel il-ħsieb ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 击鼓；打鼓声。
制造轰响或响亮撞击声的行为。
洗脑；通过反复灌输来操纵或改变人的思想。

formal.mt: It-tanbir ritmiku akkumpanja l-purċissjoni tul it-triq prinċipali.
formal.en: Rhythmic drumming accompanied the procession along the main street.
formal.zh: 有节奏的鼓声伴随着队伍沿主街前进。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' dak it-tanbir? Mark: Iva, ġej mis-sala; il-grupp qed jipprova għall-kunċert.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that drumming? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the hall; the group is rehearsing for the concert.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听到那阵鼓声了吗？马克：听到了，是从礼堂传来的，乐团正在为音乐会排练。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵鼓声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that drumming?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mis-sala; il-grupp qed jipprova għall-kunċert.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mis-sala; il-grupp qed jipprova għall-kunċert.
messages.zh: 听到了，是从礼堂传来的，乐团正在为音乐会排练。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the hall; the group is rehearsing for the concert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“听见一阵鼓声”记住名词用法，再把“洗脑”单独做成义项卡，按上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A percussion instrument played by striking a stretched surface with hands or sticks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种打击乐器，通过用手或鼓槌敲击绷紧的鼓面发声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument tal-perkussjoni b'wiċċ miġbud li jindaqq bl-idejn jew bil-bsaten.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一面鼓；一种打击乐器。
鼓。

formal.mt: Il-mużiċist uża tanbur kbir biex jagħti ritmu ċar lill-biċċa mużikali.
formal.en: The musician used a large drum to give the musical piece a clear rhythm.
formal.zh: 乐手用一面大鼓为这首乐曲打出清晰的节奏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu t-tanbur tiegħi? Maja: Ħdejn is-siġġu, bil-bsaten fuqu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is my drum? Maja: Next to the chair, with the drumsticks on top.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我的鼓在哪里？玛雅：在椅子旁边，鼓槌就在鼓上。

messages.speaker: Mark (乐队成员)
messages.zh: 我的鼓在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my drum?

messages.speaker: Maja (乐队成员)
messages.zh: 在椅子旁边，鼓槌就在鼓上。
messages.en: Next to the chair, with the drumsticks on top.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一面鼓并在旁边写 tanbur，把这个词直接贴在乐器上，记住它指可拿取的鼓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A textile floor covering that may cover a large area or form a smaller movable rug.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铺在地面上的织物，可指覆盖较大面积的地毯，也可指较小、可移动的小地毯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kisi tad-drapp li jitqiegħed mal-art, fuq żona kbira jew bħala biċċa iżgħar li tista' titmexxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地毯，常指覆盖较大地面面积的毯子。
小地毯；可移动的铺地毯。
地毯；小地毯。

formal.mt: Tapit tas-suf tqiegħed fiċ-ċentru tal-kamra biex iżid il-kumdità u jnaqqas il-ħoss tal-passi.
formal.en: A wool rug was placed in the center of the room to improve comfort and reduce the sound of footsteps.
formal.zh: 房间中央铺了一张羊毛地毯，以提高舒适度并减轻脚步声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġu t-tapit il-ġdid? Mark: Quddiem is-sufan, taħt il-mejda ż-żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we put the new rug? Mark: In front of the sofa, under the small table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新地毯放在哪里？马克：放在沙发前面的小桌子下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 新地毯放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the new rug?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 放在沙发前面的小桌子下面。
messages.en: In front of the sofa, under the small table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己把写着 tapit 的标签放在脚下地毯上，大面积地毯和小块铺毯都能这样记。

gloss_zh: 使蒙雾；使玻璃起雾；降低透明度；按压；踩踏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make glass or another surface foggy or less transparent; in a separate sense, to press or trample.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使玻璃或其他表面蒙雾、变得不透明；另一个义项是按压或踩踏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel il-ħġieġ jew wiċċ ieħor imċajpar jew inqas trasparenti; f'tifsira oħra, għafas jew rifes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使蒙上雾气；使变得模糊。
使玻璃蒙上一层薄雾。
降低某物的透明度；使其不那么透明。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fog up, to steam up
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使起雾；使因水汽而变得模糊。
按压；踩踏。

formal.mt: Il-fwar mill-ilma sħun tappan il-mera u għamilha diffiċli biex wieħed jara r-rifless tiegħu.
formal.en: Steam from the hot water fogged the mirror and made it difficult to see one's reflection.
formal.zh: 热水产生的蒸汽使镜子起了雾，让人难以看清自己的倒影。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-fwar tappan il-mera kollha! Maja: Iftaħ it-tieqa ftit u mbagħad imsaħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: The steam has fogged up the whole mirror! Maja: Open the window a little and then wipe it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：蒸汽把整面镜子都弄起雾了！玛雅：把窗户开一点，然后擦一下镜子。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 蒸汽把整面镜子都弄起雾了！
messages.en: The steam has fogged up the whole mirror!

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iftaħ it-tieqa ftit u mbagħad imsaħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iftaħ it-tieqa ftit u mbagħad imsaħha.
messages.zh: 把窗户开一点，然后擦一下镜子。
messages.en: Open the window a little and then wipe it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记浴室镜子被蒸汽遮住的画面，对应使起雾；按压、踩踏另列一张卡，避免混淆义项。

gloss_zh: 发出轻快连续的拍打声；轻敲；眨眼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make light repeated tapping sounds or tap something gently; also, to blink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出连续轻快的拍打声，或轻轻敲击某物；也可指眨眼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel ħsejjes ħfief u ripetuti ta' tħabbit jew ħabbat xi ħaġa bil-mod; ukoll, għalaq u fetaħ għajnejh malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出轻快而连续的拍打声，如雨点的嗒嗒声。
轻敲；轻拍。
轻轻敲击；发出连续轻快的拍打声。
眨眼；迅速闭眼再睁开。

formal.mt: Qabel daħal fl-uffiċċju, il-viżitatur taptap fuq il-bieb u stenna tweġiba.
formal.en: Before entering the office, the visitor tapped on the door and waited for a reply.
formal.zh: 进入办公室之前，访客轻轻敲了敲门，等待回应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi ħadd taptap fuq il-bieb. Mark: Kienet Lara; sejħilha tidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Someone tapped on the door. Mark: It was Lara; tell her to come in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有人轻轻敲门了。马克：是拉拉，叫她进来吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 有人轻轻敲门了。
messages.en: Someone tapped on the door.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是拉拉，叫她进来吧。
messages.en: It was Lara; tell her to come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 taptap 时配合两下轻敲，把重复节奏当作记忆提示；另用快速闭眼再睁眼记住眨眼义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a hole in something by piercing, drilling, or perforating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刺、钻等方式在物体上弄出孔洞，或使物体被穿透。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel toqba f'xi ħaġa billi nifidha jew ħaffer fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某物上弄出一个洞；打孔。
使某物穿孔；在材料上打出孔洞。
刺穿；钻孔。

collocations.en: drilled a hole in the wall
made a hole in the paper

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem taqab il-ħajt biex jgħaddi l-kejbil minn ġo fih.
formal.en: The worker drilled a hole in the wall to pass the cable through it.
formal.zh: 工人在墙上钻了一个孔，以便把电缆穿过去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm toqba fil-kaxxa? Mark: Taqab il-kaxxa ħija biex jgħaddi spaga minnha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there a hole in the box? Mark: My brother made a hole in the box to pass some string through it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：盒子上怎么有个洞？马克：我哥哥在盒子上打了个孔，好把绳子穿过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 盒子上怎么有个洞？
messages.en: Why is there a hole in the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taqab il-kaxxa ħija biex jgħaddi spaga minnha.
messages.mt_standard: Taqab il-kaxxa ħija biex jgħaddi spaga minnha.
messages.zh: 我哥哥在盒子上打了个孔，好把绳子穿过去。
messages.en: My brother made a hole in the box to pass some string through it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqab 与“工具穿过表面、留下孔洞”的画面绑定；纸上打孔、墙上钻孔都围绕同一个动作记忆。

gloss_zh: 增加重量或困难的人；使加重；使负担沉重；使复杂

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes things heavier or makes a situation or task more difficult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使东西变得更重，或使事情、任务变得更困难的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel l-affarijiet itqal jew li żżid id-diffikultà ta' sitwazzjoni jew ta' xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使东西变得更重的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who makes things more difficult
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使事情变得更困难的人；增添困难的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to weigh, be heavy on, burden
sense_translations.zh_definition: 重压于；使承受沉重负担。

sense_translations.en_definition: to increase the weight of, make something heavier
sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加某物的重量；使某物变得更重。

sense_translations.en_definition: to complicate, make something more difficult
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使事情复杂化；使某事变得更困难。

formal.mt: Bħala nom, 'taqqal' jista' jirreferi għal persuna li tagħmel ix-xogħol aktar diffiċli għall-oħrajn.
formal.en: As a noun, 'taqqal' can refer to a person who makes work more difficult for others.
formal.zh: 作为名词，taqqal 可以指使别人的工作变得更困难的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħtlu taqqal? Mark: Għax kull darba jżid problema oħra u jagħmel kollox aktar diffiċli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call him someone who makes things harder? Mark: Because every time he adds another problem and makes everything more difficult.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说他是个添麻烦的人？马克：因为他每次都会再添一个问题，让所有事情变得更难。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个添麻烦的人？
messages.en: Why did you call him someone who makes things harder?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba jżid problema oħra u jagħmel kollox aktar diffiċli.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba jżid problema oħra u jagħmel kollox aktar diffiċli.
messages.zh: 因为他每次都会再添一个问题，让所有事情变得更难。
messages.en: Because every time he adds another problem and makes everything more difficult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人不断往行李箱里加东西：重量增加，搬运也更困难；名词记“加重者”，动词记“使加重”。

gloss_zh: 反思；默想；qassat 的动名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of thinking carefully or quietly about something, especially in reflection or meditation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事进行仔细思考或安静默想的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha wieħed jaħseb bir-reqqa jew fis-skiet dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反思；对某事进行仔细思考。
默想；安静而专注的思考。
动词 qassat 的动名词形式。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi ħin għat-taqsit, biex il-parteċipanti jaħsbu dwar dak li jkunu tgħallmu.
formal.en: The programme includes time for reflection so that participants can think about what they have learned.
formal.zh: 活动安排包含反思时间，让参与者思考自己所学的内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi trid tagħmel wara l-laqgħa? Mark: Għandi bżonn ftit ħin għat-taqsit, biex naħseb fuq dak li ntqal.
colloquial.en: Maja: What would you like to do after the meeting? Mark: I need a little time for reflection, to think about what was said.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：开完会你想做什么？马克：我需要一点反思的时间，想想刚才大家说的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 开完会你想做什么？
messages.en: What would you like to do after the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn ftit ħin għat-taqsit, biex naħseb fuq dak li ntqal.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn ftit ħin għat-taqsit, biex naħseb fuq dak li ntqal.
messages.zh: 我需要一点反思的时间，想想刚才大家说的话。
messages.en: I need a little time for reflection, to think about what was said.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqsit 记成“留一段安静时间，把刚才的事情重新想一遍”；重点是反思、默想这一活动。

gloss_zh: 念珠；串珠项链；玫瑰经念珠

teaching_sense.en_definition: A string of beads used for prayer, such as a rosary, or worn as a beaded necklace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 串在一起供祈祷使用的珠子，如玫瑰经念珠，也可指串珠项链。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' żibeġ li tintuża għat-talb, bħal fil-rużarju, jew li tintlibes bħala ġiżirana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诵念玫瑰经时使用的念珠。
用珠子串成的项链。
玫瑰经念珠；用于玫瑰经祈祷的珠串。

collocations.en: a beaded necklace around the neck
collocations.zh: 戴在脖子上的串珠项链

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet titlob, il-mara ħarġet it-taqsita mill-borża u żammitha f'idha.
formal.en: Before she began to pray, the woman took the rosary beads out of her bag and held them in her hand.
formal.zh: 开始祈祷之前，那位女士从包里取出念珠，握在手中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik it-taqsita tużaha għat-talb? Rita: Iva, kienet tan-nanna u dejjem inżommha fil-borża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you use those beads for prayer? Rita: Yes, they belonged to my grandmother, and I always keep them in my bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那串珠子是你祈祷时用的吗？丽塔：是的，那是我祖母留下的，我一直把它放在包里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那串珠子是你祈祷时用的吗？
messages.en: Do you use those beads for prayer?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet tan-nanna u dejjem inżommha fil-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet tan-nanna u dejjem inżommha fil-borża.
messages.zh: 是的，那是我祖母留下的，我一直把它放在包里。
messages.en: Yes, they belonged to my grandmother, and I always keep them in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 taqsita 就想象“一颗颗珠子串成一圈”：拿来祈祷是念珠，戴作饰品是串珠项链，靠场景区分。

gloss_zh: 喋喋不休；咯咯叫或呱呱叫；心悸；心脏重跳

teaching_sense.en_definition: To chatter or prattle, to make a clucking or croaking sound, or, of the heart, to beat heavily or palpitate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喋喋不休地说话，发出咯咯声或呱呱声，也可指心脏沉重地跳动或发生心悸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkellem bla waqfien, għamel ħoss bħal ta' tiġieġa jew żrinġ, jew, meta jingħad għall-qalb, ħabbat bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叽叽喳喳地说话；不停地闲聊。
絮絮叨叨；喋喋不休地说些琐碎的话。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a clucking or croaking sound
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出咯咯声或呱呱声。
心悸；心脏明显而急促地跳动。
沉重地跳动；发生心悸。

formal.mt: Qabel l-eżami, il-qalb tal-istudent bdiet ttaqtaq bil-qawwa minħabba t-tensjoni.
formal.en: Before the examination, the student's heart began to beat heavily because of nervousness.
formal.zh: 考试之前，那名学生因紧张而心脏怦怦直跳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek imbeżża'? Mark: Iva, qalbi għadha ttaqtaq wara dak il-ħoss qawwi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still frightened? Mark: Yes, my heart is still pounding after that loud noise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在害怕吗？马克：是啊，刚才那声巨响之后，我的心还在怦怦跳。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在害怕吗？
messages.en: Are you still frightened?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qalbi għadha ttaqtaq wara dak il-ħoss qawwi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qalbi għadha ttaqtaq wara dak il-ħoss qawwi.
messages.zh: 是啊，刚才那声巨响之后，我的心还在怦怦跳。
messages.en: Yes, my heart is still pounding after that loud noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时可把 taqtaq 的重复音节配上连续节拍：嘴巴不停说、动物连续叫、心脏怦怦跳；这是记忆联想，不是词源说明。

gloss_zh: 飞；乘飞机旅行；出国；时间飞逝；飞快移动；动作迅速

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fly or travel by plane; also to go abroad, move very fast, act quickly, or pass quickly when referring to time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 飞行或乘飞机旅行，也可指出国、快速移动、迅速行动，或表示时间过得很快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexa fl-ajru jew ivvjaġġa bl-ajruplan; jista' jfisser ukoll siefer, mexa jew aġixxa malajr, jew għadda malajr meta jingħad għall-ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞；在空中飞行。
乘飞机旅行。
出国；前往国外。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pass by quickly (used of time)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞快地过去；用于描述时间飞逝。
飞快地移动；疾驰。
动作迅速；做事很快。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur tar lejn Ruma biex jipparteċipa f'konferenza internazzjonali.
formal.en: The researcher flew to Rome to take part in an international conference.
formal.zh: 那位研究人员乘飞机前往罗马，参加一场国际会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà saru l-għaxra? Mark: Iva, il-ħin tar waqt li konna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is it ten o'clock already? Mark: Yes, time flew while we were talking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：已经十点了吗？马克：是啊，我们聊着聊着，时间一下就过去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 已经十点了吗？
messages.en: Is it ten o'clock already?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħin tar waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħin tar waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们聊着聊着，时间一下就过去了。
messages.en: Yes, time flew while we were talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“鸟飞、飞机飞”的具体画面，再联想到“人跑得像飞、时间像飞走”；出国义则结合旅行语境单独确认。

gloss_zh: 塞进屁股里（动词，通常带讽刺意味）；楼梯、台阶（名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To insert something into someone's backside, usually in a sarcastic expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物塞进某人的屁股里，通常用于带讽刺意味的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani ta' xi ħadd, normalment f'espressjoni sarkastika.

sense_translations.en_definition: to insert into one's backside (usually used sarcastically)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞进某人的屁股里，通常用于讽刺性的说法。
楼梯；台阶。

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, 'taraġ' bħala verb ifisser li ddaħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani, normalment b'mod sarkastiku; bħala nom, jirreferi għall-iskaluni li titla' jew tinżel minnhom.
formal.en: In this lesson, 'taraġ' as a verb means to insert something into someone's backside, usually sarcastically; as a noun, it refers to steps used to go up or down.
formal.zh: 在本课中，taraġ 作动词时表示把某物塞进某人的屁股里，通常带讽刺意味；作名词时则指供人上下的楼梯或台阶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt 'taraġ' f'kumment irrabjat. Dejjem ifisser skaluni? Mark: Le, jista' jkun ukoll verb li jfisser li ddaħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani, ħafna drabi b'mod sarkastiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: I read 'taraġ' in an angry comment. Does it always mean stairs? Mark: No, it can also be a verb meaning to insert something into someone's backside, often sarcastically.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在一条愤怒的评论里读到了 taraġ。它总是指楼梯吗？马克：不是，它也可以是动词，意思是把某物塞进某人的屁股里，常带讽刺意味。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt 'taraġ' f'kumment irrabjat. Dejjem ifisser skaluni?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt 'taraġ' f'kumment irrabjat. Dejjem ifisser skaluni?
messages.zh: 我在一条愤怒的评论里读到了 taraġ。它总是指楼梯吗？
messages.en: I read 'taraġ' in an angry comment. Does it always mean stairs?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jista' jkun ukoll verb li jfisser li ddaħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani, ħafna drabi b'mod sarkastiku.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jista' jkun ukoll verb li jfisser li ddaħħal xi ħaġa fil-warrani, ħafna drabi b'mod sarkastiku.
messages.zh: 不是，它也可以是动词，意思是把某物塞进某人的屁股里，常带讽刺意味。
messages.en: No, it can also be a verb meaning to insert something into someone's backside, often sarcastically.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 taraġ 建两张分开的词卡：名词画“楼梯”，动词标“塞进屁股里的讽刺说法”；读句子时先辨词性，再选意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a late hour or after the expected, usual, or suitable time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在较晚的时刻，或晚于预期、通常或合适的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'ħin avvanzat jew wara l-ħin mistenni, tas-soltu jew xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晚；迟；晚于预定或合适的时间。

formal.mt: L-istudent wasal tard għal-lezzjoni minħabba dewmien fit-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: The student arrived late for the lesson because of a delay in public transport.
formal.zh: 由于公共交通延误，那名学生上课迟到了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadu miftuħ il-ħanut? Mark: Le, issa tard wisq. Immorru għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the shop still open? Mark: No, it's too late now. Let's go tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店还开着吗？马克：没有，现在太晚了。我们明天早上去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店还开着吗？
messages.en: Is the shop still open?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa tard wisq. Immorru għada filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa tard wisq. Immorru għada filgħodu.
messages.zh: 没有，现在太晚了。我们明天早上去吧。
messages.en: No, it's too late now. Let's go tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tard 放进三个时间画面记忆：赶到时已迟到、夜里时间很晚、商店关门后已太晚；核心都是“晚于某个时间点”。

gloss_zh: 边缘；边界；尽头；待解决事项

teaching_sense.en_definition: The edge, boundary, or furthest end of something; also a matter that remains to be settled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的边缘、边界或最远端；也可指尚待处理或解决的事项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti fejn tispiċċa xi ħaġa, il-konfini tagħha jew l-aktar punt imbiegħed tagħha; ukoll kwistjoni li għad trid tissolva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 边缘；物体表面或区域的边沿。
边界；分隔两个地方或区域的界线。
尽头；末端；最远处或极端位置。
待办事项；尚未处理完毕或解决的问题。

collocations.en: to the end of the road

formal.mt: Il-kaxxa għandha titqiegħed 'il bogħod minn tarf il-mejda biex ma taqax.
formal.en: The box should be placed away from the edge of the table so that it does not fall.
formal.zh: 箱子应放在远离桌子边缘的位置，以免掉落。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn inpoġġi din it-tazza? Luqa: Hawn fin-nofs, għax qrib tarf il-mejda tista' taqa'.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where should I put this cup? Luqa: Here in the middle, because it could fall if it is near the edge of the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个杯子放在哪里？卢卡：放在这里中间吧，靠近桌边可能会掉下去。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个杯子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this cup?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn fin-nofs, għax qrib tarf il-mejda tista' taqa'.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn fin-nofs, għax qrib tarf il-mejda tista' taqa'.
messages.zh: 放在这里中间吧，靠近桌边可能会掉下去。
messages.en: Here in the middle, because it could fall if it is near the edge of the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarf 和桌边、地图边界、道路尽头三幅画面配对记忆；遇到抽象语境时，再单独联想到尚待解决的事项。

gloss_zh: 嫩的；松软的；土壤湿润的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tender, soft, or mellow rather than tough or hard, especially of meat; also moist when describing soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 柔嫩、松软或柔和而不坚硬的，尤其用于肉；形容土壤时也表示湿润。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artab u mhux iebes, speċjalment meta jingħad għal-laħam; meta jingħad għall-ħamrija, ifisser li fiha l-umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嫩的；用于形容肉质柔嫩、不韧。
湿润的；用于形容土壤含有水分。

sense_translations.en_definition: tender; mellow; not tough or hard
sense_translations.zh_definition: 柔嫩的；柔和的；不坚韧或不坚硬的。

formal.mt: Il-laħam għandu jissajjar bil-mod sakemm ikun tari u jinqata' faċilment.
formal.en: The meat should be cooked slowly until it is tender and easy to cut.
formal.zh: 肉应慢慢烹煮，直到肉质柔嫩、容易切开。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-laħam tari? Mark: Iva, sajjartu bil-mod u sar tari ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this meat tender? Mark: Yes, I cooked it slowly and it became very tender.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这肉嫩吗？马克：嫩，我慢慢煮过，已经变得很嫩了。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 这肉嫩吗？
messages.en: Is this meat tender?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sajjartu bil-mod u sar tari ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sajjartu bil-mod u sar tari ħafna.
messages.zh: 嫩，我慢慢煮过，已经变得很嫩了。
messages.en: Yes, I cooked it slowly and it became very tender.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个搭配画面：餐盘里的 laħam tari 是嫩肉，花盆里的 ħamrija tarija 是湿土；中文释义随所修饰的名词变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shield held or placed in front of someone to protect them from blows or other danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盾牌；举在身前或放在前方，用来抵挡打击或其他危险的防护物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett protettiv li jinżamm jew jitqiegħed quddiem persuna biex jilqagħlha d-daqqiet jew jipproteġiha minn periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盾牌；用于抵挡攻击的防护物。

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija, is-suldat iżomm tarka quddiem sidru biex jipproteġi ruħu.
formal.en: In the drawing, the soldier holds a shield in front of his chest to protect himself.
formal.zh: 图画中，士兵把盾牌举在胸前保护自己。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan is-suldat għandu tarka? Pawlu: Biex jipproteġi ruħu mid-daqqiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does this soldier have a shield? Pawlu: To protect himself from blows.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个士兵为什么拿着盾牌？保罗：为了保护自己，挡住打来的攻击。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个士兵为什么拿着盾牌？
messages.en: Why does this soldier have a shield?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 为了保护自己，挡住打来的攻击。
messages.en: To protect himself from blows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tarka 就想象士兵举起一面盾牌，把攻击挡在身前；用“举盾保护自己”的动作帮助记住词义。

gloss_zh: 放逐；驱逐；暗示；私下透露；放逐者；透露内情者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To banish or exile someone; in another sense, to hint at something or privately let someone in on a secret.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放逐或驱逐某人；另一组意思是间接暗示某事，或私下向某人透露秘密。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikeċċi lil xi ħadd minn pajjiżu jew minn post; f'tifsira oħra, jagħti ħjiel dwar xi ħaġa jew jgħarraf lil xi ħadd b'sigriet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放逐；使某人被迫离开自己的国家或居住地。
驱逐；命令某人离开某地，不准留下。

sense_translations.en_definition: to let someone in on a secret
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人透露秘密；让某人知道内情。
暗示；通过提示而非直接说明来传达意思。
放逐者；将他人放逐的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who lets others in on sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向他人透露内情的人；让别人知道某事的人。
驱逐；放逐；迫使某人离开某地或本国。
间接暗示；不明说而以含蓄方式提示。
私下向某人透露内情；秘密地让某人知悉某事。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur tarraf b'xi bidla fil-pjan, iżda ma ta ebda dettall.
formal.en: In his letter, the author hinted at a change in the plan but gave no details.
formal.zh: 作者在信中暗示计划有所变化，但没有提供任何细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu tarraf b'xi sorpriża għal għada. Lara: Tassew? Qallek x'se tkun?
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu hinted at a surprise for tomorrow. Lara: Really? Did he tell you what it will be?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗暗示明天会有惊喜。拉拉：真的吗？他告诉你是什么了吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tarraf b'xi sorpriża għal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tarraf b'xi sorpriża għal għada.
messages.zh: 保罗暗示明天会有惊喜。
messages.en: Pawlu hinted at a surprise for tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 真的吗？他告诉你是什么了吗？
messages.en: Really? Did he tell you what it will be?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tarraf 做两张情景卡：一张画某人被放逐，一张画朋友低声透露消息；遇到名词用法时，记成执行相应行为的人。

gloss_zh: 使耳聋；震得听不清；使麻木

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone deaf or unable to hear clearly, especially through loud noise; also to numb or reduce sensation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人耳聋或听不清，尤其指受到强烈噪声影响；也表示使麻木或减弱感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd ma jismax jew jisma' ħażin, speċjalment minħabba ħoss qawwi; ukoll itellef jew inaqqas is-sensazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使耳聋；使人因声音过强而听不清。
使麻木；使感觉减弱或消失。
使耳聋；使人丧失听觉。

collocations.zh: 那声音震得我听不清了

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi tal-magna tarrax lil dawk li kienu qrib tagħha.
formal.en: The loud noise of the machine deafened those who were near it.
formal.zh: 机器的强烈噪声震得附近的人听不清了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dak il-ħoss tarraxni! Nina: Ejja mmorru f'post aktar kwiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: That noise deafened me! Nina: Let's go somewhere quieter.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那声音震得我耳朵都听不清了！妮娜：我们去个安静一点的地方吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那声音震得我耳朵都听不清了！
messages.en: That noise deafened me!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去个安静一点的地方吧。
messages.en: Let's go somewhere quieter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“巨响让耳朵听不清”的因果画面记 tarrax；它是表示造成影响的动词，另把“使麻木”的意思单独配卡记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: So loud that it overwhelms the ears or makes other sounds difficult to hear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音强烈到震耳欲聋、使其他声音难以听清的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawwi ħafna fil-ħoss, tant li jdejjaq il-widnejn jew jagħmilha diffiċli li tisma' ħsejjes oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 震耳欲聋的；声音极其响亮的。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss tarraxi tal-magna għamilha diffiċli għall-ħaddiema biex jisimgħu lil xulxin.
formal.en: The machine's deafening sound made it difficult for the workers to hear one another.
formal.zh: 机器震耳欲聋的声音使工人们难以听清彼此说话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ħoss tarraxi! Bilkemm nista' nisimgħek. Ben: Ejja noħorġu ftit biex nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What a deafening sound! I can barely hear you. Ben: Let's step outside for a moment so we can talk.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这声音真是震耳欲聋！我几乎听不见你说话。 ben：我们出去一下，好说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这声音真是震耳欲聋！我几乎听不见你说话。
messages.en: What a deafening sound! I can barely hear you.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们出去一下，好说话。
messages.en: Let's step outside for a moment so we can talk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarraxi 贴在“声音”这张图卡上，记成“震耳欲聋的”；与表示动作的 tarrax 对照练习，帮助区分形容词和动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dockyard or shipyard where ships are built, repaired, or maintained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船厂；进行船舶建造、修理或维护的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jinbnew, jissewwew jew jinżammu f'kundizzjoni tajba l-vapuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船坞工场；修造和维护船舶的船厂。
造船厂；建造或修理船舶的场所。
船厂；用于船舶建造、修理及维护的场所。

collocations.en: repairing a ship at the dockyard

formal.mt: Il-vapur daħal fit-tarzna għal tiswijiet qabel ma kompla l-vjaġġ tiegħu.
formal.en: The ship entered the dockyard for repairs before continuing its voyage.
formal.zh: 这艘船进入船厂维修，之后才继续航行。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn jaħdem ħuk? David: Fit-tarzna. Isewwi l-vapuri.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where does your brother work? David: At the dockyard. He repairs ships.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你哥哥在哪里工作？戴维：在船厂，他修理船舶。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where does your brother work?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 在船厂，他修理船舶。
messages.en: At the dockyard. He repairs ships.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tarzna 时想象一艘正在维修的大船，旁边有工人和工具；把整个工作场所记作“船厂”，并联记 fit-tarzna“在船厂”。

gloss_zh: 斯利马（马耳他海滨城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seaside town in Malta, used as a place name when discussing locations, visits, or travel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他的海滨城镇斯利马；作为地名，用于说明地点、游览目的地或行程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Belt mal-baħar f'Malta; isimha jintuża biex jindika post, destinazzjoni jew żjara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的一座海滨城镇，名为斯利马。

sense_translations.en_definition: Sliema (a town and local council of the Eastern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 斯利马，马耳他东部大区的一座城镇及地方议会辖区。

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi mixja mal-baħar f'Tas-Sliema.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a walk along the seafront in Sliema.
formal.zh: 参访行程包括在斯利马海滨散步。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Immorru Tas-Sliema għada? Mark: Iva, nistgħu nimxu mal-baħar hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go to Sliema tomorrow? Mark: Yes, we can walk along the seafront there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们明天去斯利马好吗？马克：好呀，我们可以在那里沿着海边散步。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去斯利马好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to Sliema tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好呀，我们可以在那里沿着海边散步。
messages.en: Yes, we can walk along the seafront there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Tas-Sliema 当作完整地名记忆：脑中画一张写着“斯利马”的海滨路牌，再配一句“明天去海边散步”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Really, truly, or indeed; used to confirm that something is true or to emphasize a description.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确实、真的；用于确认某事属实，或加强对某种性质和程度的描述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tabilħaqq jew verament; tintuża biex tikkonferma li xi ħaġa hija vera jew biex issaħħaħ deskrizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 的确；确实；用于肯定或强调所说的内容。
真的；确实；用于表示事情真实或加强语气。
真实的；真正的；并非虚构的。
真的；确实地；真实地。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultati juru li dan il-metodu huwa tassew utli għat-tagħlim.
formal.en: The results show that this method is indeed useful for learning.
formal.zh: 结果表明，这种方法确实有助于学习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tassew se tiġi għada? Mark: Iva, tassew. Diġà xtrajt il-biljett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you really coming tomorrow? Mark: Yes, really. I have already bought the ticket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天真的会来吗？马克：是的，真的。我已经买好票了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天真的会来吗？
messages.en: Are you really coming tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，真的。我已经买好票了。
messages.en: Yes, really. I have already bought the ticket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tassew 记成给话语盖上“确实如此”的确认章：提问时可表示“真的？”，加强描述时表示“确实很”；形容词义另记“真实的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A set of keys used to enter text or commands into a computer, or to play a keyboard instrument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由一组按键组成的键盘，可用于向电脑输入文字或指令，也可指键盘乐器的琴键部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' tasti li jintużaw biex jiddaħħlu kliem jew kmandi f'kompjuter, jew biex jindaqq strument mużikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 键盘；电脑等设备的输入按键组，也可指乐器的键盘。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jużaw it-tastiera biex idaħħlu t-tweġibiet tagħhom fil-kompjuter.
formal.en: Participants should use the keyboard to enter their answers into the computer.
formal.zh: 参与者应使用键盘将答案输入电脑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tastiera tiegħi ma taħdimx. Tista' tgħinni? Pawlu: Żgur. L-ewwel niċċekkjaw il-kejbil.
colloquial.en: Sara: My keyboard isn't working. Can you help me? Pawlu: Of course. Let's check the cable first.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我的键盘不能用了。你能帮我吗？保罗：当然。我们先检查一下连接线。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tastiera tiegħi ma taħdimx. Tista' tgħinni?
messages.mt_standard: It-tastiera tiegħi ma taħdimx. Tista' tgħinni?
messages.zh: 我的键盘不能用了。你能帮我吗？
messages.en: My keyboard isn't working. Can you help me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 当然。我们先检查一下连接线。
messages.en: Of course. Let's check the cable first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tastiera 写在键盘旁，每次打字前看一眼并读出单词；用“手指按键、文字出现”的画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 木板；木片板材；西洋跳棋

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plank or sheet of wood; in a separate sense, the board game draughts or checkers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块木板或片状木材；另一个独立义项指西洋跳棋这一棋类游戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa injam ċatta, bħal bord jew folja; f'tifsira oħra, logħba fuq bord magħrufa bħala draughts jew checkers bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长条形木板。
一片薄而平的木板材。
木板；板材。
西洋跳棋；双方在方格棋盘上移动棋子并吃掉对方棋子的游戏。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa qata' tavla tal-injam skont il-qisien mogħtija fil-pjanta.
formal.en: The carpenter cut a wooden plank according to the measurements given in the plan.
formal.zh: 木匠按照图纸标注的尺寸切割了一块木板。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid nilagħbu logħba tavla wara l-ikel? Luqa: Iva, imma l-ewwel fakkarni fir-regoli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we play a game of draughts after the meal? Luqa: Yes, but remind me of the rules first.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：吃完饭我们下局西洋跳棋好吗？卢卡：好，不过先帮我回顾一下规则。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nilagħbu logħba tavla wara l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nilagħbu logħba tavla wara l-ikel?
messages.zh: 吃完饭我们下局西洋跳棋好吗？
messages.en: Shall we play a game of draughts after the meal?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，不过先帮我回顾一下规则。
messages.en: Yes, but remind me of the rules first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tavla 做两张画面卡：一张画木匠手里的木板，一张画西洋跳棋棋盘；分开记两个义项，不把它们当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male peafowl, known for its long, colourful tail feathers that it can spread into a fan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雄孔雀，以能够展开成扇形的修长彩色尾羽著称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur maskili magħruf għar-rix twil u mlewwen ta' denbu, li jista' jiftaħ bħal imrewħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雄孔雀；通常以色彩鲜艳、能够展开的尾羽为特征。

collocations.en: a peacock with its tail spread

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw tawes jiftaħ denbu.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a peacock spread its tail.
formal.zh: 学生们在花园观察时，看到一只孔雀展开尾羽。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Ara dak it-tawes ħdejn is-siġra! Ben: Kemm għandu rix sabiħ! Ejja narawh minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Emma: Look at that peacock beside the tree! Ben: Its feathers are so beautiful! Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：看树旁那只孔雀！本：它的羽毛真漂亮！我们就在这里看吧。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树旁那只孔雀！
messages.en: Look at that peacock beside the tree!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandu rix sabiħ! Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandu rix sabiħ! Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.zh: 它的羽毛真漂亮！我们就在这里看吧。
messages.en: Its feathers are so beautiful! Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 tawes 时想象孔雀把尾羽展开成一把彩色扇子，再把单词写在扇形图案中央，用鲜明画面帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 延长；延续；探身窗外或边缘

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something longer or prolonging it; also the act of leaning out of a window or over an edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变长或使某事持续更久的行为；也指从窗口向外探身或越过边缘探身的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa ssir itwal jew titkompla għal aktar żmien; ukoll l-att li wieħed joħroġ parti minn ġismu minn tieqa jew jitmejjel fuq xifer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加长；使长度增加的行为或过程。

sense_translations.en_definition: leaning out of a window or over an edge
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从窗口向外探身，或越过某个边缘探身的动作。
延长；使一段时间或某项活动持续更久。

collocations.en: a lean out of the window
collocations.zh: 从窗口向外探身的动作

formal.mt: It-tawla bla bżonn tad-diskussjoni ħalliet inqas ħin għall-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The unnecessary prolongation of the discussion left less time for questions.
formal.zh: 讨论被无谓地延长，留给提问的时间因此减少了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għamilt tawla mit-tieqa biex nara min kien qed iċempel. Toni: Kien il-pustier; ħallielek pakkett.
colloquial.en: Rita: I leaned out of the window to see who was ringing the bell. Toni: It was the postman; he left you a parcel.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我从窗口探出身，看看是谁在按门铃。托尼：是邮递员，他给你留了一个包裹。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt tawla mit-tieqa biex nara min kien qed iċempel.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt tawla mit-tieqa biex nara min kien qed iċempel.
messages.zh: 我从窗口探出身，看看是谁在按门铃。
messages.en: I leaned out of the window to see who was ringing the bell.

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 是邮递员，他给你留了一个包裹。
messages.en: It was the postman; he left you a parcel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tawla 配成两幅动作图：时间线向右延长、人物从窗口探身；同时留意它与 tavla 的字母不同，避免把“延长”记成“木板”。

gloss_zh: 公牛；金牛座（星座或黄道星座）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bull; also Taurus as an astrological sign, with a separate name use for the constellation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公牛；也用于占星术中的金牛座，作为名称时还可指天文学中的金牛座星座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal bovin maskili; ukoll is-sinjal tat-Tawr fl-astroloġija, u bħala isem il-kostellazzjoni tat-Tawr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占星术中的金牛座这一黄道星座。
公牛；雄性的牛。
金牛座，天文学中的星座名称。
金牛座，黄道十二星座之一的名称。

formal.mt: Il-mappa tas-sema turi l-kostellazzjoni tat-Tawr u l-ismijiet ta' xi stilel fiha.
formal.en: The sky map shows the constellation Taurus and the names of some of its stars.
formal.zh: 这张星图标出了金牛座及其中一些恒星的名称。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak tawr jew baqra? Ġużeppi: Dak tawr. Il-baqra tinsab ħdejn l-għoġol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that a bull or a cow? Ġużeppi: That's a bull. The cow is beside the calf.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那是公牛还是母牛？朱塞佩：那是公牛。母牛在小牛旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 那是公牛还是母牛？
messages.en: Is that a bull or a cow?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tawr. Il-baqra tinsab ħdejn l-għoġol.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tawr. Il-baqra tinsab ħdejn l-għoġol.
messages.zh: 那是公牛。母牛在小牛旁边。
messages.en: That's a bull. The cow is beside the calf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“地上一头公牛，天上一幅金牛星图”记 tawr；再分别贴上“动物、天文星座、占星符号”标签，帮助区分语境。

gloss_zh: 加长；延长；长篇阐述；说话冗长；使之延长的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something longer in length or duration, or to speak or explain something at considerable length.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物在长度上增加，或使某事持续更久；也指长篇讲解或说话冗长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa itwal fit-tul jew fiż-żmien, jew jitkellem u jispjega fit-tul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加长；使某物的长度增加。
延长；使某事持续更长时间。
长篇阐述；用较长篇幅详细讲解。
使某物变长的人；进行加长工作的人。
使某事延续更久的人；延长某事的人。
加长；延长，使长度或持续时间增加。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be speak in a prolix, verbose manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话冗长啰唆；使用过多言辞讲述。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat tawwal il-laqgħa b'nofs siegħa biex jiddiskuti l-proposti kollha.
formal.en: The committee extended the meeting by half an hour to discuss all the proposals.
formal.zh: 委员会将会议延长了半小时，以讨论所有提案。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-ħajjat tawwal il-kmiem tal-ġakketta? David: Iva, u issa jiġu sew.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the tailor lengthen the jacket sleeves? David: Yes, and now they fit properly.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：裁缝把夹克的袖子加长了吗？戴维：加长了，现在长度正合适。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 裁缝把夹克的袖子加长了吗？
messages.en: Did the tailor lengthen the jacket sleeves?

messages.speaker: David (家人)
messages.zh: 加长了，现在长度正合适。
messages.en: Yes, and now they fit properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tawwal 放进三个画面：袖子加长、会议延时、讲话拉长。名词义另外记成“做这件事的人”，并注意词中连续的两个 w。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A compulsory tax or duty charged by an authority, including excise, or a toll charged for passage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有关机构征收的税或税费，包括消费税；也可指为通行而缴纳的费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas obbligatorju impost minn awtorità, inkluż dazju tas-sisa; ukoll ħlas mitlub għall-passaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 税；由公共机构依法征收的款项。
消费税；对特定商品征收的税。
通行费；为通过道路、桥梁等而缴纳的费用。
税；通行费，具体含义取决于征收对象和使用语境。

collocations.en: a toll for using the bridge

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri l-ammont ta' taxxa mħallsa matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report shows the amount of tax paid during the year.
formal.zh: 报告列出了该年度缴纳的税款金额。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-prezz jinkludi t-taxxa? Mark: Iva, it-taxxa diġà inkluża fil-prezz.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does this price include tax? Mark: Yes, tax is already included in the price.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个价格含税吗？马克：含税，税已经算在价格里了。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个价格含税吗？
messages.en: Does this price include tax?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 含税，税已经算在价格里了。
messages.en: Yes, tax is already included in the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taxxa 写在一张收据的“税额”栏，再画一个收费桥帮助记住“通行费”义；两个 x 一起圈出，提醒自己准确拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cooking pan, especially a shallow pan used for frying food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种烹饪用锅，尤其指用来煎炒食物的浅锅或平底锅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent tat-tisjir, ġeneralment baxx, li jintuża biex jinqela l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煎锅；用来煎食物的浅平底锅。
锅；此处指烹饪用的浅锅。

formal.mt: Saħħan ftit żejt f'taġen u żid il-basal imqatta'.
formal.en: Heat a little oil in a frying pan and add the chopped onion.
formal.zh: 在煎锅中加热少许油，再放入切好的洋葱。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu t-taġen? Rita: Fl-armarju taħt il-forn. Se taqli bajda? Mark: Iva, għall-kolazzjon.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the frying pan? Rita: In the cupboard under the oven. Are you going to fry an egg? Mark: Yes, for breakfast.
colloquial.zh: 马克：煎锅在哪里？丽塔：在烤箱下面的柜子里。你要煎个鸡蛋吗？马克：对，早餐吃。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 煎锅在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the frying pan?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-armarju taħt il-forn. Se taqli bajda?
messages.mt_standard: Fl-armarju taħt il-forn. Se taqli bajda?
messages.zh: 在烤箱下面的柜子里。你要煎个鸡蛋吗？
messages.en: In the cupboard under the oven. Are you going to fry an egg?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 对，早餐吃。
messages.en: Yes, for breakfast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象早餐时把鸡蛋打进 taġen，听到煎蛋的滋滋声，用“煎锅＋鸡蛋”的厨房画面记住它。

gloss_zh: 研磨；捣成粉；打成液状；使疲惫不堪；击打

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grind or pound something into smaller particles or powder, or to blend it into liquid form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西研磨或捣成细粒、粉末，也可指用搅拌方式打成液状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikisser xi ħaġa f'biċċiet żgħar jew fi trab billi jitħanha jew jitgħaffġha, jew jagħmilha likwida bi blender.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 研磨；磨碎。
捣成粉末。
用搅拌器等将食材打成液状或流质。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pound; to smash to powder; to reduce
sense_translations.zh_definition: 捣碎；砸成粉末；使变小或减少。
使精疲力竭；使耗损。
击打；殴打。

collocations.zh: 他把汤打成了细滑的流质

formal.mt: Il-kok taħan il-ħwawar qabel ma żiedhom mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The cook ground the spices before adding them to the mixture.
formal.zh: 厨师先把香料磨碎，再加入混合物中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min taħan il-kafè dalgħodu? Luqa: Mark taħan il-kafè qabel ma ħareġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who ground the coffee this morning? Luqa: Mark ground the coffee before he went out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天早上是谁磨的咖啡豆？卢卡：马克出门前磨的。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 今天早上是谁磨的咖啡豆？
messages.en: Who ground the coffee this morning?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark taħan il-kafè qabel ma ħareġ.
messages.mt_standard: Mark taħan il-kafè qabel ma ħareġ.
messages.zh: 马克出门前磨的。
messages.en: Mark ground the coffee before he went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象咖啡豆被磨碎，抓住 taħan 的具体动作；再分别记住打成流质、使人疲惫和击打等义项，依靠宾语判断，不把所有用法都译成磨粉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of encouraging or tempting someone to do something, or an inducement offered for that purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼓励、劝诱或引诱某人做某事的行为，也可指为此提供的诱因。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tħeġġeġ jew tħajjar lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew dak li jintuża biex iħajru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予激励；通过奖励等方式鼓励行动。
引诱；使人产生尝试或行动欲望的行为。
ħajjar 的动名词，表示鼓动、劝诱或引诱的行为。
诱因；促使或劝诱某人采取行动。

formal.mt: It-taħjir lill-istudenti permezz ta' premjijiet żgħar jista' jżid il-parteċipazzjoni.
formal.en: Encouraging students through small prizes can increase participation.
formal.zh: 用小奖品激励学生，可以提高参与度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-rigal huwa taħjir biex nidħol fil-klabb? Mark: Iva, iridu jħeġġuk tissieħeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this gift an inducement to get me to join the club? Mark: Yes, they want to encourage you to join.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份礼物是为了吸引我加入俱乐部吗？Mark：是的，他们想鼓励你加入。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-rigal huwa taħjir biex nidħol fil-klabb?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-rigal huwa taħjir biex nidħol fil-klabb?
messages.zh: 这份礼物是为了吸引我加入俱乐部吗？
messages.en: Is this gift an inducement to get me to join the club?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他们想鼓励你加入。
messages.en: Yes, they want to encourage you to join.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人拿着小奖品招呼你参加活动：奖品是“诱因”，招呼的过程是“劝诱或激励”。同一画面帮助记住行为与诱因两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of extracting milk from an animal; also the process of filling joints or gaps with grout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从动物身上挤取乳汁的过程；也指用填缝材料灌填接缝或空隙的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jinħareġ il-ħalib minn annimal; ukoll il-mili tal-ġonot jew tax-xquq b'taħlita apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤奶；挤取乳汁的行为。
灌浆；用填缝材料填补接缝或空隙。
ħalleb 的动名词，表示挤奶或灌浆填缝的行为。
挤奶；挤奶过程。

formal.mt: Ir-razzett iżomm rekord tal-ħalib miġbur wara kull taħlib tal-baqar.
formal.en: The farm keeps a record of the milk collected after each milking of the cows.
formal.zh: 农场记录每次给奶牛挤奶后收集到的奶量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Spiċċajt it-taħlib tal-baqar? Mark: Iva, issa se nnaddaf it-tagħmir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished milking the cows? Mark: Yes, now I am going to clean the equipment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你给奶牛挤完奶了吗？Mark：挤完了，我现在要清洗设备。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场同事)
messages.zh: 你给奶牛挤完奶了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished milking the cows?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场工人)
messages.zh: 挤完了，我现在要清洗设备。
messages.en: Yes, now I am going to clean the equipment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 建立两幅分开的场景卡：农场里是“挤奶”，施工时是“灌浆填缝”。看到后面的对象是奶牛还是接缝，就能选择对应词义。

gloss_zh: 研磨；磨碎的动作或过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of grinding something into smaller particles or powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物磨成较小颗粒或粉末的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li xi ħaġa titfarrak fi frak iżgħar jew fi trab permezz tat-tħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 研磨、磨碎的动作。
一次研磨；一番磨碎的过程。

formal.mt: Il-mitħna twettaq it-taħna tal-qamħ biex tipproduċi d-dqiq.
formal.en: The mill carries out the grinding of wheat to produce flour.
formal.zh: 磨坊通过研磨小麦来生产面粉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kafè għandu bżonn taħna aktar fina? Mark: Iva, għal din il-magna rridu taħna fina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the coffee need a finer grind? Mark: Yes, we need a fine grind for this machine.
colloquial.zh: Maja：咖啡需要磨得更细吗？Mark：是的，这台机器需要细磨的咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (咖啡店学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kafè għandu bżonn taħna aktar fina?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kafè għandu bżonn taħna aktar fina?
messages.zh: 咖啡需要磨得更细吗？
messages.en: Does the coffee need a finer grind?

messages.speaker: Mark (咖啡师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għal din il-magna rridu taħna fina.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għal din il-magna rridu taħna fina.
messages.zh: 是的，这台机器需要细磨的咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, we need a fine grind for this machine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小麦或咖啡豆经过磨盘变成细粒，把 taħna 记成这一番“研磨”。再用 fina 的搭配提示自己关注磨得细不细。

gloss_zh: 在……下面；在某人当政时期；在下方

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a position below or underneath something; also during someone's time in power or leadership.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示位于某物下面或底下；也可表示在某人当政或领导的时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'pożizzjoni aktar baxxa minn xi ħaġa jew taħtha; ukoll fi żmien it-tmexxija ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……下方；位置低于……。
在……下面；位于……下方。
在……下面。
在……底下；在……下部。
在某人所处、当政或领导的时期。
在下方；在下面那里。

formal.mt: Il-kaxxi bid-dokumenti tqiegħdu taħt l-ixkaffa l-kbira.
formal.en: The boxes containing the documents were placed under the large shelf.
formal.zh: 装有文件的箱子被放在大架子下面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-borża tiegħi? Mark: Qiegħda taħt il-mejda, ħdejn is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is my bag? Mark: It is under the table, next to the chair.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的包在哪里？Mark：在桌子下面，椅子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的包在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my bag?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在桌子下面，椅子旁边。
messages.en: It is under the table, next to the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 taħt 和“桌子下面的包”绑定；再把“在某人领导之下”作为第二个场景。后接对象时识别介词，单独指下面时识别副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intense fear or panic; also a fluttering movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈的恐惧或慌乱；也可指扑动、颤动一类的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biża' qawwija jew paniku; ukoll moviment ta' tperpir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊恐；强烈的恐惧。
恐慌；惊慌失措。
扑动；轻快而连续的颤动。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi kkawża taħwif fost in-nies li kienu fis-sala.
formal.en: The loud noise caused panic among the people in the hall.
formal.zh: 巨响使大厅里的人们陷入恐慌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak it-taħwif kollu? Mark: Xi ħadd għajjat, u n-nies beżgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was all that panic about? Mark: Someone shouted, and people got frightened.
colloquial.zh: Maja：刚才大家怎么那么慌张？Mark：有人大叫了一声，大家都吓到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 刚才大家怎么那么慌张？
messages.en: What was all that panic about?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd għajjat, u n-nies beżgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd għajjat, u n-nies beżgħu.
messages.zh: 有人大叫了一声，大家都吓到了。
messages.en: Someone shouted, and people got frightened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅动态图记忆：人群听见巨响后“惊恐慌乱”，鸟儿的翅膀不停“扑动”。这是词义联想练习，不表示两个意思存在词源关系。

gloss_zh: 用力或充分研磨（动词）；研磨者；磨坊工人（名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grind something intensively or thoroughly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力、充分或密集地研磨某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħan xi ħaġa b'mod intensiv jew sewwa ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力或充分地研磨。
研磨者；从事磨碎工作的人。
磨坊工人；从事磨谷制粉的人。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem taħħan il-qamħ sewwa ħafna sakemm sar dqiq fin.
formal.en: The worker ground the wheat very thoroughly until it became fine flour.
formal.zh: 工人充分研磨小麦，直到它变成细面粉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-mitħna? Luqa: Dak it-taħħan. Jaħdem hemm kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man beside the mill? Luqa: That's the miller. He works there every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：磨坊旁边的那个男人是谁？卢卡：那是磨坊工人。他每天都在那里工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-mitħna?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-mitħna?
messages.zh: 磨坊旁边的那个男人是谁？

messages.speaker: Luqa (当地朋友)
messages.zh: 那是磨坊工人。他每天都在那里工作。
messages.en: That's the miller. He works there every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用双写 ħħ 提醒自己把 taħħan 与 taħan 的拼写分开记；一句“他充分磨麦”记动词，一句“他是磨坊工人”记名词，再靠句子位置判断词性。

gloss_zh: 给……施行包皮环切术；激烈争辩的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To perform circumcision on a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人施行包皮环切术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twettaq iċ-ċirkonċiżjoni fuq persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……施行包皮环切术。
争辩激烈的人；与人激烈争论的人。

collocations.zh: 给患者施行了包皮环切术
给男孩施行了包皮环切术

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jikkonferma li t-tabib taħħar lill-pazjent.
formal.en: The medical report confirms that the doctor circumcised the patient.
formal.zh: 医疗报告确认，医生给患者施行了包皮环切术。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tabib taħħar lil ħija lbieraħ. Maja: Kif qed iħossu llum?
colloquial.en: Mark: The doctor circumcised my brother yesterday. Maja: How is he feeling today?
colloquial.zh: Mark：医生昨天给我兄弟做了包皮环切术。Maja：他今天感觉怎么样？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生昨天给我兄弟做了包皮环切术。
messages.en: The doctor circumcised my brother yesterday.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他今天感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How is he feeling today?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把同形词分成两张记忆卡：医疗场景记动词“施行包皮环切术”，争论场景记名词“激烈争辩的人”，靠词性和语境区分。

gloss_zh: 压迫；使处于较低地位；降职；放在下面

teaching_sense.en_definition: To oppress someone, lower someone's position or rank, or put something below something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 压迫某人，使其处于较低地位或被降职；也指把某物放在另一物下面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħqar lil xi ħadd, tqiegħdu f'pożizzjoni jew kariga aktar baxxa, jew tqiegħed xi ħaġa taħt oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫；欺压。

sense_translations.en_definition: to put in an inferior position
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使处于较低或从属的地位。
使降职；降低职级。
把……放在下面或底下。

collocations.mt: taħħat lill-impjegat għal kariga aktar baxxa
collocations.en: demoted the employee to a lower post
collocations.zh: 把员工降到了较低的职位

formal.mt: Il-maniġer taħħat lill-impjegat għal kariga aktar baxxa wara l-investigazzjoni.
formal.en: The manager demoted the employee to a lower post after the investigation.
formal.zh: 调查结束后，经理把这名员工降到了较低的职位。

colloquial.zh: Maja：老板把 Pawlu 降职了吗？Mark：是的，他现在的职位更低了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 老板把 Pawlu 降职了吗？
messages.en: Did the boss demote Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandu kariga aktar baxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandu kariga aktar baxxa.
messages.zh: 是的，他现在的职位更低了。
messages.en: Yes, he has a lower post now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“向下放”的画面串联词义：物品放到下面，人的地位被压低，职位被降低。这里只是帮助记忆，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 退化；（植物）杂交、猛长叶子；拼命干活

teaching_sense.en_definition: To degenerate; of plants, to interbreed or produce abundant leaves; also, to work excessively hard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指退化；用于植物时可指杂交或大量长叶；也可指过度劳作、拼命干活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeġenera; fil-każ tal-pjanti, jitħallat ma' pjanti oħra jew joħroġ ħafna weraq; jista' jfisser ukoll li jaħdem iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退化；变得较差。
（用于植物）杂交。

sense_translations.en_definition: to grow lots of leaves (used of plants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （用于植物）长出大量叶子；枝叶繁茂。
干活过于卖力；劳作过度。
极其辛苦地工作；拼命干活。

collocations.en: grew vigorously and produced abundant leaves

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar osserva li l-ħabaq tbagħal u ħareġ ħafna weraq ġdid.
formal.en: The gardener observed that the basil had grown vigorously and produced many new leaves.
formal.zh: 园丁观察到，罗勒生长旺盛，长出了大量新叶。

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么看起来这么累？丽塔：他今天拼命干活，连吃饭都没停下来。

messages.mt_standard: Illum tbagħal bix-xogħol; lanqas waqaf jiekol.
messages.zh: 他今天拼命干活，连吃饭都没停下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become muddy or covered with mud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得泥泞，或因接触泥土而沾上泥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mimli tajn jew jitħammeġ bit-tajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得泥泞；沾满泥。

collocations.zh: 在泥地里弄得满身是泥

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ tbagħtar wara x-xita qawwija, u l-viżitaturi ntalbu jużaw daħla oħra.
formal.en: The path became muddy after the heavy rain, and visitors were asked to use another entrance.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，小路变得泥泞，访客被要求改用另一个入口。

colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Ben have mud all over his clothes? Mark: He played in the garden and got muddy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：本的衣服上怎么到处都是泥？马克：他在花园里玩，弄得满身是泥。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Ben għandu t-tajn ma' ħwejġu kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Ben għandu t-tajn ma' ħwejġu kollha?
messages.zh: 本的衣服上怎么到处都是泥？
messages.en: Why does Ben have mud all over his clothes?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 他在花园里玩，弄得满身是泥。
messages.en: He played in the garden and got muddy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后小路和玩泥巴的孩子，把这个词与“变得满是泥”的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 尽情玩乐；嬉闹；喧闹作乐

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a good time through playful, frivolous, or boisterous amusement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过嬉戏、轻浮的娱乐或热闹的玩乐来寻开心、尽情享乐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu gost, jiċċajta jew jintefa' f'divertiment storbjuż u bla wisq serjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩得开心；尽情享乐。
沉溺于嬉闹或不太严肃的玩乐。
热热闹闹地尽情玩乐；喧闹作乐。
纵情于轻浮、无所用心的娱乐消遣。

collocations.en: had a lively good time with friends
enjoyed himself boisterously at the celebration

formal.mt: Wara li temm l-eżamijiet, Mark tbahrad mal-ħbieb waqt iċ-ċelebrazzjoni.
formal.en: After finishing his exams, Mark enjoyed a lively celebration with his friends.
formal.zh: 考完试后，马克在庆祝活动中和朋友们尽情玩乐。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Mark ħa gost fil-festa? Maja: Iva, tbahrad mal-ħbieb il-lejla kollha!
colloquial.en: Rita: Did Mark enjoy the celebration? Maja: Yes, he had a lively good time with his friends all evening!
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克在庆典上玩得开心吗？玛雅：开心，他整个晚上都和朋友们尽情嬉闹！

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在庆典上玩得开心吗？
messages.en: Did Mark enjoy the celebration?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 开心，他整个晚上都和朋友们尽情嬉闹！
messages.en: Yes, he had a lively good time with his friends all evening!

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想考完试后一群朋友笑闹庆祝；核心画面是尽情玩乐，部分语境带轻浮意味。

gloss_zh: 被迫吞下；被人弄得咽下

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made or forced to swallow something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在他人的促使或强迫下吞咽某物；被迫咽下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun imġiegħel jibla' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to swallow sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人促使或弄得吞下某物。
balla' 的中间被动态形式，表示主语受到使其吞咽的作用，即被弄得吞下某物。
被强迫吞下；被迫咽下。

collocations.en: was made to swallow the syrup
was made to swallow against his will

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel tballa' l-ġulepp kontra qalbu, għax ma kienx jogħġbu t-togħma tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the boy was made to swallow the syrup against his will because he disliked its taste.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩不喜欢糖浆的味道，却被迫吞了下去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tifel ħa l-ġulepp minn jeddu fl-istorja? Rita: Le, tballa' kontra qalbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the boy take the syrup willingly in the story? Rita: No, he was made to swallow it against his will.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的男孩是自愿喝下糖浆的吗？丽塔：不是，他是不情愿地被迫吞下去的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel ħa l-ġulepp minn jeddu fl-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel ħa l-ġulepp minn jeddu fl-istorja?
messages.zh: 故事里的男孩是自愿喝下糖浆的吗？
messages.en: Did the boy take the syrup willingly in the story?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 不是，他是不情愿地被迫吞下去的。
messages.en: No, he was made to swallow it against his will.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“不是自己想吞，而是被弄得吞下”的受事视角，再用不情愿喝糖浆的情景巩固。

gloss_zh: 被打倒、撞倒或砍倒；受到敲打；发出敲击声；倒下

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be knocked, beaten, knocked down, or felled; also, to make a knocking sound or fall over.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到敲打、殴打、撞击而倒下或被砍倒；也可指发出敲击声或翻倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlaqat jew jissawwat, jitwaqqa' jew jaqa'; jista' jfisser ukoll li jagħmel ħoss ta' taħbit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被击倒；被撞倒。
被砍倒；被打倒。
batta 的中间被动态形式，表示主语受到敲打、击打或被打倒等作用。
受到敲打或殴打。
发出敲击声；发出撞击声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be knocked over, to fall
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被碰倒、撞翻；倒下。

collocations.en: was knocked down during the fight

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tax-xhud, raġel tbatta mal-art waqt il-ġlieda.
formal.en: According to the witness's report, a man was knocked to the ground during the fight.
formal.zh: 据目击者的报告，一名男子在打斗中被击倒在地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lis-siġġu? Mark: Tbatta mal-art meta l-kelb ħabat miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the chair? Mark: It was knocked over when the dog bumped into it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：椅子怎么了？马克：狗撞到它，把它撞翻在地了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 椅子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the chair?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbatta mal-art meta l-kelb ħabat miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tbatta mal-art meta l-kelb ħabat miegħu.
messages.zh: 狗撞到它，把它撞翻在地了。
messages.en: It was knocked over when the dog bumped into it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把撞击声和物体倒地连成一段画面：先受敲撞，再可能倒下；具体义看主语和上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To vomit, bringing the contents of the stomach out through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呕吐，即胃里的东西经口吐出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirremetti, jiġifieri joħroġ minn ħalqu dak li jkun hemm fl-istonku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呕吐；把胃里的东西吐出来。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie nnutat li l-passiġġier tbawwa' darbtejn waqt il-vjaġġ bid-dgħajsa.
formal.en: The report noted that the passenger vomited twice during the boat journey.
formal.zh: 报告记载，该乘客在乘船途中呕吐了两次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar Pawlu fil-vjaġġ bid-dgħajsa? Rita: Ħassu ħażin u tbawwa', imma issa aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu get on during the boat trip? Rita: He felt sick and vomited, but he is better now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗坐船时怎么样？丽塔：他觉得恶心，还吐了，不过现在好些了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗坐船时怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get on during the boat trip?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassu ħażin u tbawwa', imma issa aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassu ħażin u tbawwa', imma issa aħjar.
messages.zh: 他觉得恶心，还吐了，不过现在好些了。
messages.en: He felt sick and vomited, but he is better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐船时先觉得恶心，随后把胃里的东西吐出来；用这一完整动作记住呕吐义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend or move lower, become lower or less intense, or humble oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弯下身子或移到较低位置；也指水平、程度下降，或放低姿态、表现谦逊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Niżel jew miel lejn il-baxx, naqas fil-livell jew fl-intensità, jew wera umiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯下身子；俯身。
降到更低的位置或水平。
减少；减弱；降低。
自贬身份；卑躬屈膝。
baxxa 的中被动态形式，表示自身降低或被降低。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lower oneself, to be lowered
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己降低；被降低。

sense_translations.en_definition: to humble oneself, to be humbled
sense_translations.zh_definition: 自谦；放低姿态；受到挫折而变得谦卑。

collocations.en: bent down to pick something up

formal.mt: Wara li nfetaħ il-kanal, il-livell tal-ilma tbaxxa b'mod gradwali.
formal.en: After the channel was opened, the water level gradually fell.
formal.zh: 渠道打开后，水位逐渐下降。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark tbaxxa ħdejn il-mejda? Lina: Biex jiġbor iċ-ċwievet li waqgħulu.
