colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark bend down beside the table? Lina: To pick up the keys he dropped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么在桌子旁弯下身子？莉娜：为了捡起他掉落的钥匙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么在桌子旁弯下身子？
messages.en: Why did Mark bend down beside the table?

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了捡起他掉落的钥匙。
messages.en: To pick up the keys he dropped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“向下”的画面串联记忆：身体向下是俯身，水位向下是下降，姿态放低则可表示自谦；具体褒贬要看语境。

gloss_zh: 冲洗身体；往身上泼水；用水洗脸

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rinse oneself or splash water on oneself, especially on the face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水冲洗自己，或往自己身上泼水，尤其指泼水洗脸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laħlaħ lilu nnifsu jew tefa' l-ilma fuqu, speċjalment fuq wiċċu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冲洗自己的身体。
往自己身上泼水；用水淋湿自己。
往脸上泼水；用水洗脸。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja fis-sħana, il-mixi waqaf ħdejn il-vit u tbaħbaħ bl-ilma frisk.
formal.en: After walking in the heat, the walker stopped by the tap and splashed himself with cool water.
formal.zh: 在炎热天气中步行后，这位行人停在水龙头旁，用凉水冲洗自己。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wiċċ Pawlu kollu ilma? Rita: Għadu kemm tbaħbaħ biex jiffriska ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu's face all wet? Rita: He has just splashed water on his face to cool down a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗的脸怎么全是水？丽塔：他刚刚往脸上泼了水，想凉快一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗的脸怎么全是水？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu's face all wet?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kemm tbaħbaħ biex jiffriska ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kemm tbaħbaħ biex jiffriska ftit.
messages.zh: 他刚刚往脸上泼了水，想凉快一下。
messages.en: He has just splashed water on his face to cool down a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进“捧起凉水往自己脸上泼”的动作里记，注意水落在自己身上。

gloss_zh: 变傻；犯傻；做出愚蠢举动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become foolish or to behave in a foolish way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得愚笨、糊涂，或表现得愚蠢、做出傻事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iblah jew iġib ruħu b'mod iblah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得愚笨或糊涂；变傻。
表现得愚蠢；犯傻；做出傻事。

collocations.en: acted foolishly in front of everyone

collocations.mt: tbaħnan u ħa riskju bla bżonn
collocations.en: acted foolishly and took an unnecessary risk
collocations.zh: 犯傻，冒了不必要的风险

formal.mt: Il-karattru tbaħnan meta injora t-twissija u pprova jaqsam ix-xmara waħdu.
formal.en: The character acted foolishly when he ignored the warning and tried to cross the river alone.
formal.zh: 这个人物不顾警告，试图独自过河，做出了愚蠢的举动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark veru pprova jsewwi l-lampa mingħajr ma qata' d-dawl? Rita: Iva, tbaħnan u ħa riskju bla bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark really try to fix the lamp without turning off the power? Rita: Yes, he acted foolishly and took an unnecessary risk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克真的没断电就想修灯吗？丽塔：是啊，他犯傻了，冒了不必要的风险。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark veru pprova jsewwi l-lampa mingħajr ma qata' d-dawl?
messages.mt_standard: Mark veru pprova jsewwi l-lampa mingħajr ma qata' d-dawl?
messages.zh: 马克真的没断电就想修灯吗？
messages.en: Did Mark really try to fix the lamp without turning off the power?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tbaħnan u ħa riskju bla bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tbaħnan u ħa riskju bla bżonn.
messages.zh: 是啊，他犯傻了，冒了不必要的风险。
messages.en: Yes, he acted foolishly and took an unnecessary risk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“明明有警告却偏要冒险”的小故事记犯傻义；描述行为时留意语气可能带责备。

gloss_zh: 变得精疲力竭；过度劳累；变形

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become exhausted or overtire oneself, or to become disfigured or misshapen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得精疲力竭或使自己过度劳累；也指外形受损、走样或变形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għeja ħafna jew għamel sforz żejjed, jew sarlu tibdil li ħassarlu l-forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得精疲力竭；累得筋疲力尽。
外形变得残损、扭曲或走样。
使自己过度劳累；把自己累坏。
发生变形；形状变得不正常。

formal.mt: Wara sigħat twal ta' xogħol bla mistrieħ, il-ħaddiem tbażwar u kellu jieqaf.
formal.en: After long hours of work without rest, the worker became exhausted and had to stop.
formal.zh: 连续工作很长时间而没有休息后，这名工人精疲力竭，不得不停下来。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif inhu Pawlu wara ċ-ċaqliq? Mark: Tbażwar iġorr il-kaxxi; issa qed jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Lina: How is Pawlu after the move? Mark: He wore himself out carrying the boxes; now he is resting.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：搬家后保罗怎么样？马克：他搬箱子累坏了，现在正在休息。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 搬家后保罗怎么样？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after the move?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbażwar iġorr il-kaxxi; issa qed jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Tbażwar iġorr il-kaxxi; issa qed jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他搬箱子累坏了，现在正在休息。
messages.en: He wore himself out carrying the boxes; now he is resting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两幅图记忆：人搬完箱子累得瘫坐，物件受热后形状走样；分别帮助记住“累坏”和“变形”两组义项。

gloss_zh: 笨拙；搞砸的活儿；混乱失措

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clumsiness in doing something, tasks that have been botched, or a state of confusion and disorientation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事时的笨拙，或被做坏、搞砸的活儿；也可指混乱失措的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ħila jew ta' attenzjoni meta jsir xi ħaġa, xogħol magħmul ħażin, jew stat ta' konfużjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨拙；手忙脚乱。
搞砸的任务；做坏的活儿。
混乱失措；晕头转向；所给用法标记为 [tat-]。

collocations.zh: 工作中的笨拙或瞎折腾

formal.mt: It-tbażwir waqt it-tiswija għamel il-problema agħar u żied l-ispejjeż.
formal.en: The bungling during the repair made the problem worse and increased the costs.
formal.zh: 维修过程中的笨拙操作使问题更加严重，也增加了费用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min waħħal din l-ixkaffa? Mark: Jien, imma wara dan it-tbażwir irrid nerġa' nibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who put up this shelf? Mark: I did, but after this botched job I need to start again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个架子是谁装的？马克：是我，不过这活儿搞砸了，我得重新开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个架子是谁装的？
messages.en: Who put up this shelf?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, imma wara dan it-tbażwir irrid nerġa' nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, imma wara dan it-tbażwir irrid nerġa' nibda.
messages.zh: 是我，不过这活儿搞砸了，我得重新开始。
messages.en: I did, but after this botched job I need to start again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象装架子时手忙脚乱，最后架子还装歪了：动作笨拙、活儿搞砸、脑中混乱，三幅画面对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hold back or hesitate before acting, or to lose confidence and feel demoralised.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行动前有所退缩或犹豫；也指信心受挫、感到气馁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żamm lura milli jagħmel xi ħaġa, qagħad jaħsibha jew tilef il-kuraġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退缩；克制自己而没有行动。
犹豫；迟疑不决。
感到气馁；信心受到打击。

collocations.en: became discouraged in the face of difficulties

formal.mt: Għall-ewwel, l-istudent tbeżża' milli jippreżenta l-ideat tiegħu, iżda l-għalliem inkoraġġieh jitkellem.
formal.en: At first, the student held back from presenting his ideas, but the teacher encouraged him to speak.
formal.zh: 起初，这名学生迟疑着不敢表达自己的想法，但老师鼓励他开口。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex Pawlu ma staqsiex? Maja: Tbeżża' għax ħaseb li l-mistoqsija kienet faċli wisq.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why didn't Pawlu ask? Maja: He hesitated because he thought the question was too easy.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：保罗为什么没有问？玛雅：他觉得这个问题太简单，所以犹豫了。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么没有问？
messages.en: Why didn't Pawlu ask?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbeżża' għax ħaseb li l-mistoqsija kienet faċli wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Tbeżża' għax ħaseb li l-mistoqsija kienet faċli wisq.
messages.zh: 他觉得这个问题太简单，所以犹豫了。
messages.en: He hesitated because he thought the question was too easy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住课堂上想举手却又缩回去的瞬间：动作上是退缩，决定上是犹豫，心情上可能是气馁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or work of printing, including printing as a trade or industry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将文字或图像印制出来的过程或工作，也指印刷这一行业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ix-xogħol li bih jiġu stampati testi u stampi, jew il-qasam ta' dan ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷；印制。
印刷；印刷业。

formal.mt: Il-kwalità tat-tbiegħa hija importanti biex it-test tal-ktieb ikun ċar u faċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: The quality of the printing is important for making the book's text clear and easy to read.
formal.zh: 印刷质量对于保证书中文字清晰、便于阅读十分重要。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif inhi t-tbiegħa ta' dan il-ktieb? Lina: Tajba ħafna; l-ittri huma ċari u r-ritratti jidhru sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is the printing like in this book? Lina: Very good; the lettering is clear and the photographs look good.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书的印刷怎么样？莉娜：很好，文字清晰，照片也印得不错。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhi t-tbiegħa ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhi t-tbiegħa ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书的印刷怎么样？
messages.en: What is the printing like in this book?

messages.speaker: Lina (书店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajba ħafna; l-ittri huma ċari u r-ritratti jidhru sew.
messages.mt_standard: Tajba ħafna; l-ittri huma ċari u r-ritratti jidhru sew.
messages.zh: 很好，文字清晰，照片也印得不错。
messages.en: Very good; the lettering is clear and the photographs look good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在“检查一本书印得清不清楚”的场景里记忆，同时练习“印刷质量”和“印刷流程”两个搭配。

gloss_zh: 天空转阴；变得阴云密布

teaching_sense.en_definition: For the sky to become covered with cloud or turn overcast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指天空被云层遮盖，天气转阴或变得阴云密布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sema mtela bis-sħab u ma baqax ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天空阴云密布；描述天空转阴的情况。
变得阴云密布；天空转阴。

formal.mt: Wara nofsinhar, is-sema tbieq u t-temperatura bdiet tonqos.
formal.en: In the afternoon, the sky became overcast and the temperature began to fall.
formal.zh: 下午，天空转阴，气温开始下降。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Is-sema tbieq. Xorta se noħorġu? Mark: Iva, imma nieħdu umbrella magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: The sky has turned overcast. Are we still going out? Mark: Yes, but let's take an umbrella with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：天阴下来了。我们还出去吗？马克：出去，不过带把伞吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 天阴下来了。我们还出去吗？
messages.en: The sky has turned overcast. Are we still going out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 出去，不过带把伞吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's take an umbrella with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蓝天被一层云慢慢盖住，并整句记住 is-sema tbieq：重点是“天空转阴”这个变化，不必联想到已经下雨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To smile, showing pleasure, friendliness, or another feeling through one's facial expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 微笑，通过面部表情流露愉快、友善或其他感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wera tbissima fuq wiċċu biex jesprimi ferħ, ħbiberija jew sentiment ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微笑；露出笑容。

formal.mt: Meta sema' r-riżultat, l-istudent tbissem u rringrazzja lill-għalliem għall-għajnuna tiegħu.
formal.en: When he heard the result, the student smiled and thanked the teacher for his help.
formal.zh: 听到结果后，这名学生露出微笑，并感谢老师的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Rajt kif tbissem Mark meta ra r-rigal? Maja: Iva, naħseb li għoġbu ħafna!
colloquial.en: Lina: Did you see how Mark smiled when he saw the present? Maja: Yes, I think he really liked it!
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你看到马克看见礼物时笑得多开心了吗？玛雅：看到了，我想他很喜欢！

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif tbissem Mark meta ra r-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif tbissem Mark meta ra r-rigal?
messages.zh: 你看到马克看见礼物时笑得多开心了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how Mark smiled when he saw the present?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，我想他很喜欢！
messages.en: Yes, I think he really liked it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友打开礼物后嘴角上扬的表情，同时默念 tbissem；再用“向谁微笑”和“开心地微笑”练习搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tea: a drink made by steeping tea leaves in hot water, served plain or with additions such as milk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 茶，用热水浸泡茶叶制成的饮品，可以清饮，也可以加入牛奶等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba magħmula billi jitħallew weraq tat-te f'ilma sħun, li tista' tixrobha waħedha jew bil-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茶；茶饮。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa ġie servut te flimkien ma' gallettini u ilma.
formal.en: During the meeting, tea was served along with biscuits and water.
formal.zh: 会议期间提供了茶、饼干和水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid kikkra te? Mark: Iva, bi ftit ħalib u bla zokkor, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a cup of tea? Mark: Yes, with a little milk and no sugar, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想喝杯茶吗？马克：想，请加一点牛奶，不加糖。

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.zh: 你想喝杯茶吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cup of tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bi ftit ħalib u bla zokkor, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bi ftit ħalib u bla zokkor, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，请加一点牛奶，不加糖。
messages.en: Yes, with a little milk and no sugar, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把简短的 te 写在想象中的茶杯标签上，再连起来记 kikkra te“一杯茶”和 te bil-ħalib“加牛奶的茶”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building where plays and other performances are presented, or the art of dramatic performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 上演戏剧等表演的建筑或场所，也指戏剧表演艺术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini fejn jittellgħu drammi u spettakli oħra, jew l-arti tal-interpretazzjoni drammatika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剧院；戏剧艺术。
剧院；戏剧艺术，与 theater 同义。

formal.mt: It-teatru se jiftaħ il-bibien tiegħu siegħa qabel il-bidu tal-ispettaklu.
formal.en: The theatre will open its doors one hour before the performance begins.
formal.zh: 剧院将在演出开始前一小时开放入场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi t-teatru miegħi llejla? Lara: Iva! X'ħin jibda l-ispettaklu?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come to the theatre with me tonight? Lara: Yes! What time does the performance start?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚想和我一起去剧院吗？拉拉：想！演出几点开始？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚想和我一起去剧院吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to the theatre with me tonight?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 想！演出几点开始？
messages.en: Yes! What time does the performance start?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teatru 和舞台、幕布、观众席一起记，再用“今晚去剧院”的完整场景巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To close something tightly, or to fit together properly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物严密地关上，或使相应的部分合得上、彼此吻合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalaq xi ħaġa sewwa, jew qabel sew ma' ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧闭；把某物严严实实地关上。
合适；吻合；与另一部分合得上。

formal.mt: Wara li ħareġ kulħadd, il-ħارس tebaq il-bieb tal-maħżen.
formal.en: After everyone had left, the guard shut the storeroom door tightly.
formal.zh: 所有人离开后，看守把储藏室的门关严了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min tebaq il-bieb? Ma nistax niftħu. Mark: Jien. Stenna, ngħinek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who shut the door so tightly? I can't open it. Mark: I did. Wait, I'll help you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把门关得这么紧？我打不开。马克：我关的。等一下，我来帮你。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min tebaq il-bieb? Ma nistax niftħu.
messages.mt_standard: Min tebaq il-bieb? Ma nistax niftħu.
messages.zh: 谁把门关得这么紧？我打不开。
messages.en: Who shut the door so tightly? I can't open it.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我关的。等一下，我来帮你。
messages.en: I did. Wait, I'll help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门与门框完全贴合：关严时是“紧闭”，尺寸正好时是“吻合”，用同一画面串联两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prepare food by heating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加热来制作食物，即烹饪或煮食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħejja l-ikel billi saħħnu jew poġġieh fuq in-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烹饪；把食物加热煮熟。

formal.mt: Il-kok tebaħ il-laħam fuq nar baxx sakemm sar artab.
formal.en: The cook cooked the meat over low heat until it became tender.
formal.zh: 厨师用小火把肉烹煮至软嫩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min tebaħ il-ħaxix illum? Mark: Missieri. Għadu kemm lestieh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who cooked the vegetables today? Mark: My father. He has just finished preparing them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天的蔬菜是谁煮的？马克：我爸爸。他刚做好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天的蔬菜是谁煮的？
messages.en: Who cooked the vegetables today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爸爸。他刚做好。
messages.en: My father. He has just finished preparing them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tebaħ 放进厨房画面：食材下锅、加热煮熟；用这个动作顺序记住“烹饪”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stain, spot, or visible mark left on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面留下的污渍、斑点或可见印迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka, tikka jew ħmieġ li jibqa' jidher fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污渍；污斑。
污渍；斑点；局部留下的痕迹。
印迹；接触或按压后留下的印痕。

formal.mt: Qabel tnaddaf it-tebgħa, iċċekkja l-istruzzjonijiet tal-ħasil fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: Before cleaning the stain, check the washing instructions on the label.
formal.zh: 清除污渍前，请查看标签上的洗涤说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi tebgħa tal-kafè fuq il-qmis. Lara: Ġib ftit ilma kiesaħ u ċarruta nadifa.
colloquial.en: Maja: I've got a coffee stain on my shirt. Lara: Get some cold water and a clean cloth.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的衬衫上有块咖啡渍。拉拉：拿点冷水和一块干净的布来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的衬衫上有块咖啡渍。
messages.en: I've got a coffee stain on my shirt.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġib ftit ilma kiesaħ u ċarruta nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Ġib ftit ilma kiesaħ u ċarruta nadifa.
messages.zh: 拿点冷水和一块干净的布来。
messages.en: Get some cold water and a clean cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象白衬衫上落下一滴咖啡，留下醒目的 tebgħa；再把污渍扩展到斑点和接触印迹。

gloss_zh: 成对的一部分；门扇；眼睑；一侧臀部；网膜脂肪；一次闭合或眨眼

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of two corresponding or equally sized parts, such as a door leaf or an eyelid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个相对应或大小相同的部分之一，例如门扇或眼睑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda minn żewġ partijiet li jaqblu jew li huma tal-istess daqs, bħal parti ta' bieb jew għata tal-għajn.

sense_translations.en_definition: one of a pair of equally sized parts
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一对大小相同的部分中的一个。

sense_translations.en_definition: one of two corresponding things, especially where one fits or shuts into the other
sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个相对应的物件之一，尤指能够与另一件嵌合或闭合的部分。
门扇，即门上能够开启和关闭的板状部分。
眼睑；眼皮。
一侧臀部。
包裹内脏的网膜；网膜脂肪。

sense_translations.en_definition: an instance of shutting; (especially of the eye) a blink
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次闭合；尤指眼睛的一次眨动。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa se jsewwi t-tebqa tal-bieb li qed togħrok mal-art.
formal.en: The carpenter will repair the door leaf that is rubbing against the floor.
formal.zh: 木匠将修理那块正在蹭地板的门扇。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din it-tebqa tal-bieb ma tingħalaqx sew. Mark: Veru, qed togħrok mal-art. Inċempel lill-mastrudaxxa.
colloquial.en: Lara: This door leaf doesn't close properly. Mark: You're right, it's rubbing against the floor. I'll call the carpenter.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块门扇关不严。马克：确实，它在蹭地板。我给木匠打电话。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tebqa tal-bieb ma tingħalaqx sew.
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tebqa tal-bieb ma tingħalaqx sew.
messages.zh: 这块门扇关不严。
messages.en: This door leaf doesn't close properly.

messages.speaker: Mark (同住者)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, qed togħrok mal-art. Inċempel lill-mastrudaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, qed togħrok mal-art. Inċempel lill-mastrudaxxa.
messages.zh: 确实，它在蹭地板。我给木匠打电话。
messages.en: You're right, it's rubbing against the floor. I'll call the carpenter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 tebqa 记成“对应部分中的一片”，用门扇和眼睑建立画面；臀部、网膜和眨眼义另外配图记忆，避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container in which a dead person's body is placed for burial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安放逝者遗体、供安葬使用的棺材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa li fiha jitqiegħed il-ġisem ta' persuna mejta għad-difna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棺材；安放逝者遗体的棺木。
棺材；此处指安放遗体的棺具。
棺材；灵柩。

formal.mt: It-tebut tqiegħed fil-knisja qabel ma bdiet iċ-ċerimonja tal-funeral.
formal.en: The coffin was placed in the church before the funeral ceremony began.
formal.zh: 葬礼仪式开始前，灵柩被安放在教堂内。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-tebut hu magħmul mill-injam? Rita: Iva, u nistgħu nuruk mudelli oħra wkoll.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this coffin made of wood? Rita: Yes, and we can show you other models as well.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这口棺材是木制的吗？丽塔：是的，我们也可以给您看看其他款式。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这口棺材是木制的吗？
messages.en: Is this coffin made of wood?

messages.speaker: Rita (殡葬服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u nistgħu nuruk mudelli oħra wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u nistgħu nuruk mudelli oħra wkoll.
messages.zh: 是的，我们也可以给您看看其他款式。
messages.en: Yes, and we can show you other models as well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tebut 放入庄重的葬礼场景，联想到安放遗体的棺木；同时对应英语 coffin 和 casket。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go out or turn off, as a fire, light, or device does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指火熄灭、灯灭掉或设备关闭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waqaf jaqbad, jixgħel jew jaħdem, bħal nar, dawl jew apparat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熄灭；使燃烧或发光停止。
关闭；停止运作或发光。
遮蔽光彩；使相形失色。
褪色；失去原有的色彩。
熄灭火焰；使火停止燃烧。
关闭设备；使设备停止运行。

formal.mt: Id-dawl tal-kuritur tefa awtomatikament wara ħames minuti.
formal.en: The corridor light turned off automatically after five minutes.
formal.zh: 走廊的灯在五分钟后自动熄灭了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-televixin tefa waħdu? Mark: Iva, imma nista' nerġa' nixegħlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the television turn off by itself? Mark: Yes, but I can turn it back on.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电视自己关掉了吗？马克：是的，不过我可以再打开。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 电视自己关掉了吗？
messages.en: Did the television turn off by itself?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是的，不过我可以再打开。
messages.en: Yes, but I can turn it back on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见没有末尾撇号的 tefa，就先想“灯灭了”；再联想到光彩消退和颜色褪去，记住相关义项。

gloss_zh: 扔；倾倒；熄灭；分派；投寄；提交；放置

teaching_sense.en_definition: To throw something, or to put or place it somewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物扔出去，或把它放到某个位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waddab xi ħaġa, jew poġġieha f'xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扔；投掷。
倾倒；丢弃。
熄灭；扑灭。
把某物扔出或投出。
分派；指派任务或责任。
投寄；邮寄信件等。
提交；递交申请或文件等。
放；放置到某个位置。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant tefa' l-applikazzjoni qabel l-iskadenza.
formal.en: The representative submitted the application before the deadline.
formal.zh: 代表在截止日期前提交了申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min tefa' l-ballun fil-ġnien? Mark: Jien. Se mmur inġibu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who threw the ball into the garden? Mark: I did. I'll go and get it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把球扔进花园了？马克：我扔的。我去拿回来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把球扔进花园了？
messages.en: Who threw the ball into the garden?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我扔的。我去拿回来。
messages.en: I did. I'll go and get it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tefa' 末尾的撇号想成小球飞出的轨迹，先记“扔”；再用投信、交申请和放东西的场景分别记其他义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of throwing something, such as a ball.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把球等物体抛出或投出的一次动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att wieħed ta' meta xi ħadd jitfa' xi ħaġa, bħal ballun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次投掷；一次抛掷。
投掷动作；某一次把东西投出的行为。

formal.mt: Il-plejer għamel tefgħa preċiża u l-ballun wasal għand sieħbu.
formal.en: The player made an accurate throw, and the ball reached his teammate.
formal.zh: 球员准确地把球投出，球传到了队友手中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dik it-tefgħa? Mark: Iva, il-ballun wasal eżatt għand Sara!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that throw? Mark: Yes, the ball went straight to Sara!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到刚才那一投了吗？马克：看到了，球正好传到了萨拉那里！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到刚才那一投了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that throw?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ballun wasal eżatt għand Sara!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ballun wasal eżatt għand Sara!
messages.zh: 看到了，球正好传到了萨拉那里！
messages.en: Yes, the ball went straight to Sara!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球离开手的那一瞬间，把 tefgħa 记成可以数出来的“一次投掷”，再用“有力的一投”和“准确的一投”巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something better in quality, condition, or performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物的质量、状况或表现变得更好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa aħjar fil-kwalità, fil-qagħda jew fil-prestazzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变得更好；提升。
改善；改进；提高质量或表现。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill tejjeb is-servizz billi żied in-numru ta' ħaddiema disponibbli.
formal.en: The council improved the service by increasing the number of available staff.
formal.zh: 议会通过增加可提供服务的工作人员，改进了服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif nista' ntejjeb il-kitba tiegħi? Pawlu: Aqra ftit kuljum u erġa' aħdem fuq it-testi tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Sara: How can I improve my writing? Pawlu: Read a little every day and revise your texts.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我怎样才能提高写作水平？保罗：每天读一点，再修改自己写的文章。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我怎样才能提高写作水平？
messages.en: How can I improve my writing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqra ftit kuljum u erġa' aħdem fuq it-testi tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Aqra ftit kuljum u erġa' aħdem fuq it-testi tiegħek.
messages.zh: 每天读一点，再修改自己写的文章。
messages.en: Read a little every day and revise your texts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tejjeb 放进“修改前→修改后”的画面：服务更周到、文章更清楚，两个场景都抓住“使变得更好”这个动作。

gloss_zh: 使成婚；把某人嫁出或安排成婚

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause or arrange for someone to marry, including giving someone in marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人成婚或为其安排婚事，也可指把某人嫁出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel jew jirranġa biex xi ħadd jiżżewweġ, jew jagħti lil xi ħadd fiż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人成婚；为某人安排婚事。
把某人嫁出；将某人许配给他人。
使结为夫妻；使成婚。

collocations.en: arranged for his son to marry

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier tejjeġ lil bintu lil raġel minn raħal ieħor.
formal.en: In the story, the father gave his daughter in marriage to a man from another village.
formal.zh: 故事中，父亲把女儿嫁给了另一个村庄的男子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-missier f'din il-parti tal-istorja? Toni: Tejjeġ lil bintu lil raġel minn raħal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the father do in this part of the story? Toni: He gave his daughter in marriage to a man from another village.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：故事这一部分里，父亲做了什么？托尼：他把女儿嫁给了另一个村庄的男子。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 故事这一部分里，父亲做了什么？
messages.en: What did the father do in this part of the story?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tejjeġ lil bintu lil raġel minn raħal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tejjeġ lil bintu lil raġel minn raħal ieħor.
messages.zh: 他把女儿嫁给了另一个村庄的男子。
messages.en: He gave his daughter in marriage to a man from another village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事中的婚事安排来记 tejjeġ：先找安排婚事的人，再找成婚的人，重点记住“使某人成婚”的人物关系。

gloss_zh: 有改善作用的；有改良效果的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that makes a condition, situation, or quality better.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能使状况、处境或质量变得更好的；具有改善作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jagħmel qagħda, sitwazzjoni jew kwalità aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有改善作用的；能带来进步的。
有改良作用的；有助于改善不良状况的。

formal.mt: Il-programm għandu effett tejjiebi fuq il-kwalità tat-tagħlim.
formal.en: The programme has an improving effect on the quality of teaching.
formal.zh: 该计划对教学质量具有改善作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taħseb li dan l-eżerċizzju għandu effett tejjiebi fuq il-kitba tiegħi? David: Iva, jgħinek torganizza l-ideat tiegħek aħjar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you think this exercise has an improving effect on my writing? David: Yes, it helps you organise your ideas better.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得这个练习对我的写作有改善作用吗？戴维：有，它能帮你更好地组织想法。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan l-eżerċizzju għandu effett tejjiebi fuq il-kitba tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan l-eżerċizzju għandu effett tejjiebi fuq il-kitba tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你觉得这个练习对我的写作有改善作用吗？
messages.en: Do you think this exercise has an improving effect on my writing?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jgħinek torganizza l-ideat tiegħek aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jgħinek torganizza l-ideat tiegħek aħjar.
messages.zh: 有，它能帮你更好地组织想法。
messages.en: Yes, it helps you organise your ideas better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给有效的练习贴一张“有改善作用”的标签，用 tejjiebi 描述它带来的效果；记忆重点是性质，而不是一次改善动作。

gloss_zh: 希望；皮肤刺激感；瘙痒；tiekel 的动名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hope that something desired will happen; in separate senses, skin irritation or an itch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对所盼望之事会发生的希望；在另一些独立义项中，也指皮肤刺激感或瘙痒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tama li sseħħ xi ħaġa mixtieqa; f'tifsiriet oħra separati, irritazzjoni jew ħakk fil-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；对所期盼之事能够实现的期待。
皮肤受到刺激而产生的不适感。
痒；瘙痒感。
动词 tiekel 的动名词，表示该动词所指的行为或状态。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma 'tekil' tesprimi tama għal futur aħjar.
formal.en: In this text, the word 'tekil' expresses hope for a better future.
formal.zh: 在这篇文字中，tekil 一词表达了对更美好未来的希望。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Hawnhekk 'tekil' ifisser ħakk? Ġanni: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser tama; ara l-kliem dwar il-futur.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does 'tekil' mean an itch here? Ġanni: No, in this sentence it means hope; look at the words about the future.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这里的 tekil 是指痒吗？詹尼：不是，在这个句子里它表示希望；看看那些谈未来的词。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 tekil 是指痒吗？
messages.en: Does 'tekil' mean an itch here?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser tama; ara l-kliem dwar il-futur.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser tama; ara l-kliem dwar il-futur.
messages.zh: 不是，在这个句子里它表示希望；看看那些谈未来的词。
messages.en: No, in this sentence it means hope; look at the words about the future.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tekil 画两张分开的记忆卡：一张是展望未来的“希望”，一张是想抓挠的“痒”；动名词义另记，不把这些义项编成词源故事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the specialised knowledge, methods, or practical details of a particular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某项活动的专门知识、操作方法或具体技术细节有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-għarfien speċjalizzat, il-metodi jew id-dettalji prattiċi ta' attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 技术的；涉及专门知识或操作细节的。
技术人员；从事设备安装、维护或其他专门技术工作的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jispjega l-kawża tal-ħsara u l-passi meħtieġa għat-tiswija.
formal.en: The technical report explains the cause of the fault and the steps needed for the repair.
formal.zh: 技术报告说明了故障原因以及维修所需的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tekniku ġie jara l-kompjuter? Rita: Iva, sab il-problema u se jerġa' jiġi għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did the technician come to look at the computer? Rita: Yes, he found the problem and will come back tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 马克：技术人员来看过电脑了吗？丽塔：看过了，他找到了问题，明天会再来。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 技术人员来看过电脑了吗？
messages.en: Did the technician come to look at the computer?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sab il-problema u se jerġa' jiġi għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sab il-problema u se jerġa' jiġi għada.
messages.zh: 看过了，他找到了问题，明天会再来。
messages.en: Yes, he found the problem and will come back tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tekniku 放进同一个维修场景：报告是“技术的”，来检查设备的人是“技术人员”；通过它修饰事物还是指人来区分词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Practical knowledge, tools, and systems used to perform tasks or solve problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于完成任务或解决问题的实用知识、工具与系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għarfien prattiku, għodod u sistemi użati biex jitwettqu xogħlijiet jew jissolvew problemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 技术；科技；用于实际工作的技术知识、工具和系统。

formal.mt: L-iskola tuża t-teknoloġija diġitali biex l-istudenti jkollhom aċċess għal aktar materjal edukattiv.
formal.en: The school uses digital technology to give students access to more educational material.
formal.zh: 学校运用数字技术，让学生能够获取更多学习资料。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din it-teknoloġija ġdida se tgħinna fix-xogħol? Samwel: Iva, se nsibu d-dokumenti aktar malajr.
colloquial.en: Anna: Will this new technology help us at work? Samwel: Yes, we will find documents faster.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这项新技术会对我们的工作有帮助吗？萨姆韦尔：会，我们能更快地找到文件。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-teknoloġija ġdida se tgħinna fix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-teknoloġija ġdida se tgħinna fix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 这项新技术会对我们的工作有帮助吗？
messages.en: Will this new technology help us at work?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nsibu d-dokumenti aktar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nsibu d-dokumenti aktar malajr.
messages.zh: 会，我们能更快地找到文件。
messages.en: Yes, we will find documents faster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂屏幕、电子资料和工作工具，把 teknoloġija 记成帮助人完成任务的“技术”；可借英语 technology 的相似外形辅助认词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to technology, its development, or its use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与技术及其发展或应用有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-teknoloġija, mal-iżvilupp tagħha jew mal-użu tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 科技的；与技术的发展或应用有关的。

formal.mt: L-iżvilupp teknoloġiku biddel il-mod kif in-nies jikkomunikaw u jaħdmu.
formal.en: Technological development has changed the way people communicate and work.
formal.zh: 技术发展改变了人们沟通和工作的方式。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan hu eżempju ta' progress teknoloġiku? Luqa: Iva, issa nistgħu nagħmlu sejħa bil-vidjo minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is this an example of technological progress? Luqa: Yes, now we can make a video call from here.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这是科技进步的一个例子吗？卢卡：是的，我们现在可以从这里打视频电话了。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu eżempju ta' progress teknoloġiku?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu eżempju ta' progress teknoloġiku?
messages.zh: 这是科技进步的一个例子吗？
messages.en: Is this an example of technological progress?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nistgħu nagħmlu sejħa bil-vidjo minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nistgħu nagħmlu sejħa bil-vidjo minn hawn.
messages.zh: 是的，我们现在可以从这里打视频电话了。
messages.en: Yes, now we can make a video call from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teknoloġija 记作“技术”这个名词，再用 teknoloġiku 给“发展”和“进步”添加“科技的”这一性质，成对记住名词与形容词的用途。

gloss_zh: 轻敲；滴答作响；小火慢煮

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make light repeated taps or ticking sounds; in cooking, to simmer gently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻轻地反复敲击或发出滴答声；烹饪时指用小火慢煮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel daqqiet ħfief jew ħoss ripetut bħal arloġġ; fit-tisjir, jagħli bil-mod fuq nar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻敲；轻轻拍打。
发出滴答声，例如钟表走动的声音。

sense_translations.en_definition: to simmer (used in a culinary context)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小火慢煮；用微沸的状态炖煮。
指钟表等滴答作响。

formal.mt: Ħalli z-zalza ttektek fuq nar baxx għal għoxrin minuta u ħawwadha kultant.
formal.en: Let the sauce simmer over low heat for twenty minutes, stirring occasionally.
formal.zh: 让酱汁小火慢煮二十分钟，偶尔搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Mark: L-arloġġ qed itektek. Maja: Issa smajtu jien ukoll!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that sound? Mark: The clock is ticking. Maja: Now I can hear it too!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么声音？马克：钟在滴答响。玛雅：现在我也听到了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 钟在滴答响。
messages.en: The clock is ticking.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在我也听到了！
messages.en: Now I can hear it too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tektek 的重复节奏当作记忆提示：手指轻敲、时钟滴答、锅中轻轻冒泡，三幅画面分别连接三个常用义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Television: the medium that broadcasts moving pictures and sound, or the programmes watched through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电视这种传播图像和声音的媒介，也可指观看的电视节目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mezz li jxandar stampi li jiċċaqalqu u ħoss, jew il-programmi li wieħed jara permezz tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电视；电视广播或电视节目。

formal.mt: Dan il-programm tat-televixin jippreżenta tagħrif dwar l-annimali b'lingwaġġ sempliċi għat-tfal.
formal.en: This television programme presents information about animals in language that is simple for children.
formal.zh: 这个电视节目用适合儿童的简单语言介绍动物知识。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tara t-televixin wara l-ikel? Pawlu: Iva, hemm programm dwar il-baħar. Lara: Mela narawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to watch television after dinner? Pawlu: Yes, there's a programme about the sea. Lara: Then let's watch it together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：晚饭后想看电视吗？保罗：想，有个关于海洋的节目。拉拉：那我们一起看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 晚饭后想看电视吗？
messages.en: Do you want to watch television after dinner?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，有个关于海洋的节目。
messages.en: Yes, there's a programme about the sea.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们一起看吧。
messages.en: Then let's watch it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用固定搭配 nara t-televixin 记住“看电视”；把遥控器、屏幕和节目连成一个生活场景，同时留意词尾拼写是 xin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Television as a medium for transmitting moving pictures and sound, including the programmes it broadcasts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 传送动态图像和声音的电视媒介，也包括通过该媒介播出的节目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mezz li jittrażmetti stampi li jiċċaqalqu u ħoss, u l-programmi li jixxandar permezz tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电视；电视广播或电视节目。

formal.mt: L-intervista se tixxandar fuq it-televiżjoni nhar il-Ħadd filgħaxija.
formal.en: The interview will be broadcast on television on Sunday evening.
formal.zh: 这段访谈将于星期日晚上在电视上播出。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt l-intervista fuq it-televiżjoni lbieraħ? David: Le, kont għadni x-xogħol. Nina: Tista' taraha llejla.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see the interview on television yesterday? David: No, I was still at work. Nina: You can watch it tonight.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你昨天在电视上看那段访谈了吗？戴维：没有，我当时还在上班。妮娜：你今晚可以看。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你昨天在电视上看那段访谈了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the interview on television yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 没有，我当时还在上班。
messages.en: No, I was still at work.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你今晚可以看。
messages.en: You can watch it tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 televiżjoni 与“电视画面”绑定，再整块记住 fuq it-televiżjoni＝在电视上；书写时特别看清带点的 ż 和结尾 joni。

gloss_zh: 失败；损失；失去自控；走神

teaching_sense.en_definition: A defeat in a contest or a loss of something valued; in other contexts, a loss of self-control or a lapse of attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比赛或较量中的失败，或失去珍视之物造成的损失；在其他语境中也可指失去自控或走神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riżultat meta wieħed ma jirbaħx f'kompetizzjoni, jew meta jitlef xi ħaġa importanti; tista' tfisser ukoll nuqqas ta' kontroll fuqu nnifsu jew ta' attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失败；在比赛、战斗或较量中落败。
被击败；被对手征服或压倒。
损失；丧失。
一次损失；一项损失，或一场败局。
失去自我控制；情绪或行为失控。
走神；精神不集中。

collocations.en: a heavy defeat or a great loss

formal.mt: Wara t-telfa fil-finali, il-kowċ faħħar l-isforz tal-plejers u wiegħed aktar taħriġ.
formal.en: After the defeat in the final, the coach praised the players' effort and promised more training.
formal.zh: 决赛失利后，教练肯定了球员们的努力，并承诺增加训练。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif marret il-logħba? Sara: Telfa oħra, sfortunatament. Mark: Ħasra, imma għad hemm logħob ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did the match go? Sara: Another defeat, unfortunately. Mark: That's a pity, but there are still more matches.
colloquial.zh: 马克：比赛怎么样？萨拉：可惜，又输了。马克：真遗憾，不过后面还有比赛。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 比赛怎么样？
messages.en: How did the match go?

messages.speaker: Sara (球员)
messages.zh: 可惜，又输了。
messages.en: Another defeat, unfortunately.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħasra, imma għad hemm logħob ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ħasra, imma għad hemm logħob ieħor.
messages.zh: 真遗憾，不过后面还有比赛。
messages.en: That's a pity, but there are still more matches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“一场败局”记住 telfa，再画出损失、失控、走神三张提示卡；遇到它时根据比赛、财物、情绪或注意力的语境选义。

gloss_zh: 丧失；损失；道德上的损失

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loss of something, including loss understood in a moral sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的丧失或损失，也可指道德层面的丧失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-telf ta' xi ħaġa, inkluż dak li jintilef fis-sens morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丧失；损失。
道德层面的丧失或损失。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi t-telfien ta' valuri morali bħala problema li taffettwa l-komunità kollha.
formal.en: The author describes the loss of moral values as a problem affecting the whole community.
formal.zh: 作者将道德价值观的丧失描述为影响整个社区的问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser telfien f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser telfien tal-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb. Lara: Issa fhimt għaliex ma baqgħux jafdaw lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does telfien mean in this sentence? Pawlu: Here it means a loss of trust between friends. Lara: Now I understand why they stopped trusting each other.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个句子里的 telfien 是什么意思？保罗：这里指朋友之间失去了信任。拉拉：现在我明白他们为什么不再互相信任了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 telfien 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does telfien mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser telfien tal-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser telfien tal-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb.
messages.zh: 这里指朋友之间失去了信任。
messages.en: Here it means a loss of trust between friends.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt għaliex ma baqgħux jafdaw lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt għaliex ma baqgħux jafdaw lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 现在我明白他们为什么不再互相信任了。
messages.en: Now I understand why they stopped trusting each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 telfien 写在“原本拥有、后来失去”的箭头旁，再用信任与道德价值作两个例子，记住普通损失和道德丧失两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Uphill or rising, describing ground or a route that slopes upward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 上坡的；形容地面或道路向高处倾斜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitla' 'l fuq, bħal triq jew art b'xaqliba 'l fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山坡；坡地；描述向上倾斜的地势。

sense_translations.en_definition: an ascent, an ascension, a rising, a soaring
sense_translations.zh_definition: 上坡；攀升；上升；升起或腾升。

formal.mt: Ir-rotta tinkludi telgħa wieqfa lejn il-knisja, għalhekk il-mixja teħtieġ aktar ħin.
formal.en: The route includes a steep ascent towards the church, so the walk requires more time.
formal.zh: 这条路线包含一段通往教堂的陡坡，因此步行需要更多时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad fadal ħafna biex naslu? Toni: Wara din it-telgħa naslu ħdejn il-knisja. Maja: Mela ejja nimxu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we still have far to go? Toni: After this ascent, we'll reach the church. Maja: Then let's walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：还有很远才到吗？托尼：走完这段上坡，就到教堂旁边了。玛雅：那我们慢慢走吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (步行同伴)
messages.zh: 还有很远才到吗？
messages.en: Do we still have far to go?

messages.speaker: Toni (步行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara din it-telgħa naslu ħdejn il-knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Wara din it-telgħa naslu ħdejn il-knisja.
messages.zh: 走完这段上坡，就到教堂旁边了。
messages.en: After this ascent, we'll reach the church.

messages.speaker: Maja (步行同伴)
messages.zh: 那我们慢慢走吧。
messages.en: Then let's walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 telgħa 旁画一条向上的坡线：描述地势时联想“上坡的”，作名词理解时联想“一段上坡或一次上升”。

gloss_zh: 举起；建造；上传；组织；干呕等

teaching_sense.en_definition: To raise, lift, or bring something up; depending on context, also to erect, build, upload, organise, or get work done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物举起、抬高或带上来；依语境也可表示搭建、建造、上传、组织或完成工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għolla xi ħaġa jew ġabha 'l fuq; skont il-kuntest, bena, għamel xogħol, poġġa fajl fuq l-internet jew organizza attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 升高；提高；使升起。
竖起；搭起。
把人或物带上来、拿上来。
建造；修建。
完成工作；把事情做成。
干呕；作呕。
在抽奖或彩票中抽取号码或签。
竖起；搭建；建造。

sense_translations.en_definition: to raise, to lift (move something to a higher position)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 举起；抬起；把某物移到更高的位置。
上传；把文件等传到网络或服务器上。
惹人生气；使人发脾气。
组织；筹办活动等。

collocations.en: he uploaded a file to the internet
collocations.zh: 他把一个文件上传到网上

formal.mt: L-għalliem tella' l-materjal tal-lezzjoni fuq is-sit tal-iskola biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jaqrawh id-dar.
formal.en: The teacher uploaded the lesson material to the school website so that students could read it at home.
formal.zh: 老师把课堂资料上传到学校网站，方便学生在家阅读。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nista' nsib ir-ritratti tal-ħarġa? Mark: Pawlu tella' r-ritratti fuq is-sit tal-klabb. Sara: Tajjeb, narahom illejla.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I find the photos from the outing? Mark: Pawlu uploaded the photos to the club website. Sara: Great, I'll look at them tonight.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我在哪里能找到郊游的照片？马克：保罗把照片上传到俱乐部网站了。萨拉：好，我今晚看看。

messages.speaker: Sara (俱乐部成员)
messages.zh: 我在哪里能找到郊游的照片？
messages.en: Where can I find the photos from the outing?

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tella' r-ritratti fuq is-sit tal-klabb.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tella' r-ritratti fuq is-sit tal-klabb.
messages.zh: 保罗把照片上传到俱乐部网站了。
messages.en: Pawlu uploaded the photos to the club website.

messages.speaker: Sara (俱乐部成员)
messages.zh: 好，我今晚看看。
messages.en: Great, I'll look at them tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“手举起来、墙建起来、文件传上去、展览办起来”四幅图记常用义；干呕、抽奖和惹怒另做搭配卡，书写时保留词末撇号。

gloss_zh: 使离开；竞赛；休妻；放风筝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone leave; in other contexts, to race, forsake or divorce one's wife, or fly a kite.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人离开；在其他语境中也可表示竞速、抛弃妻子或与妻子离婚，以及放风筝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlaq; f'kuntesti oħra, ħa sehem f'tellieqa, telaq lil martu jew tajjar tajra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使离开；促使人离去。
竞速；参加速度比赛。

sense_translations.en_definition: to abandon, to forsake one's wife, to divorce
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抛弃妻子；休妻；与妻子离婚。
放飞风筝；放风筝。
让某人离开；使某人离去。

collocations.zh: 他在赛道上参加了竞速比赛

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq tellaq fil-korsa l-ġdida u temm it-tellieqa fit-tielet post.
formal.en: The driver raced on the new track and finished the race in third place.
formal.zh: 这名车手在新赛道上参赛，并以第三名完赛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar ħuk fit-tellieqa lbieraħ? Toni: Tellaq tajjeb ħafna u spiċċa t-tielet. Maja: Prosit! Żgur li kien kuntent.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your brother do in the race yesterday? Toni: He raced very well and finished third. Maja: Well done! He must have been pleased.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥昨天比赛表现怎么样？托尼：他跑得很好，得了第三名。玛雅：真棒！他一定很高兴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥昨天比赛表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother do in the race yesterday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tellaq tajjeb ħafna u spiċċa t-tielet.
messages.mt_standard: Tellaq tajjeb ħafna u spiċċa t-tielet.
messages.zh: 他跑得很好，得了第三名。
messages.en: He raced very well and finished third.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 真棒！他一定很高兴。
messages.en: Well done! He must have been pleased.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tellaq 做四张场景卡：让人离开、赛道竞速、婚姻离弃、放飞风筝；靠句中人物与宾语选义，并留意末尾是 q。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to lose something, miss an opportunity or event, or become distracted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人失去某物、错过机会或活动，或使某人的注意力受到干扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef xi ħaġa jew opportunità, jew ifixkillu l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人失去某物。
使分心；干扰某人的注意力。
使某人错过某事、机会或交通班次。
使某人输掉，或丧失某项权利、资格或所得。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss kontinwu tellef il-konċentrazzjoni tal-istudenti waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The continuous noise disrupted the students' concentration during the examination.
formal.zh: 持续的噪声干扰了学生在考试时的专注。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma spiċċajtx l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Il-ħoss barra tellef il-konċentrazzjoni tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why didn't you finish the exercise? Pawlu: The noise outside disrupted my concentration.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你怎么没做完练习？Pawlu：外面的噪声让我分心了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 你怎么没做完练习？
messages.en: Why didn't you finish the exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 外面的噪声让我分心了。
messages.en: The noise outside disrupted my concentration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“噪声让我失去专注”的画面里：重点是某个因素使人失去、错过或分心。

gloss_zh: 制成三份；重复三次；使增至三倍

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make three copies of something, repeat something three times, or increase it to three times its original amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物制成三份，把某事重复三次，或使数量增至原来的三倍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel tliet kopji ta' xi ħaġa, jirrepetiha tliet darbiet, jew iżid kwantità għal tliet darbiet l-ammont oriġinali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物制成三份。
把某句话、动作或事项重复三次。
使数量或程度增至原来的三倍。

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal tellet id-dokument sabiex kull dipartiment ikollu kopja.
formal.en: The official made the document in triplicate so that each department would have a copy.
formal.zh: 工作人员把文件制成三份，以便每个部门各有一份。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm ħejja kopji Mark? Lara: Tellet id-dokument, waħda għal kull wieħed minna.
colloquial.en: Sara: How many copies did Mark prepare? Lara: He made the document in triplicate, one for each of us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark准备了几份？Lara：他把文件制成了三份，我们每人一份。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: Mark准备了几份？
messages.en: How many copies did Mark prepare?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tellet id-dokument, waħda għal kull wieħed minna.
messages.mt_standard: Tellet id-dokument, waħda għal kull wieħed minna.
messages.zh: 他把文件制成了三份，我们每人一份。
messages.en: He made the document in triplicate, one for each of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“三份、三次、三倍”三张卡片记忆，分别对应复制、重复和数量增加三种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who loses a game, race, contest, or other competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在游戏、赛跑或其他竞赛中落败的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titlef logħba, tellieqa jew kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 输家；在比赛或竞争中落败的人。

formal.mt: It-tellief tal-finali feraħ lir-rebbieħ u rringrazzja lill-organizzaturi.
formal.en: The loser of the final congratulated the winner and thanked the organizers.
formal.zh: 决赛的落败者向获胜者表示祝贺，并感谢了组织者。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien it-tellief illum! Nina: Ma jimpurtax, nilagħbu logħba oħra?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm the loser today! Nina: It doesn't matter; shall we play another game?
colloquial.zh: Mark：今天我是输家！Nina：没关系，我们再玩一局好吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天我是输家！
messages.en: I'm the loser today!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 没关系，我们再玩一局好吗？
messages.en: It doesn't matter; shall we play another game?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象比赛结束后向冠军握手的人，用“这场的落败者”记住它指人，不表示输掉这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Quick and efficient in carrying out work or completing tasks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事速度快、工作效率高的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħdem malajr u b'effiċjenza u jlesti x-xogħol fi żmien qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作效率高的；办事利落的。
动作快的；做事迅速的。
既迅速又高效的。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem il-ġdid huwa telliegħi u jlesti l-kompiti fil-ħin.
formal.en: The new worker is efficient and completes tasks on time.
formal.zh: 新员工工作高效，能按时完成任务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark diġà lesta x-xogħol kollu? Pawlu: Iva, huwa telliegħi ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Mark already finished all the work? Pawlu: Yes, he's very quick and efficient.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark已经把工作全做完了吗？Pawlu：是啊，他做事特别利落。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: Mark已经把工作全做完了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark already finished all the work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 是啊，他做事特别利落。
messages.en: Yes, he's very quick and efficient.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想一位很快完成任务的同事，把这个词贴在“手脚快、效率高”的人物画面上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A race or competition in which participants try to finish first or outperform one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参赛者争取率先完成或取得更好成绩的竞赛，尤其指比速度的比赛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni li fiha l-parteċipanti jippruvaw jaslu jew jispiċċaw qabel l-oħrajn, jew jiksbu l-aħjar riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赛跑或其他以速度决胜负的比赛。
竞速比赛，如赛跑、赛车等。
竞赛；参与者相互争胜的比赛。

formal.mt: It-tellieqa tar-roti se tibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu quddiem il-kunsill lokali.
formal.en: The bicycle race will start at nine in the morning in front of the local council office.
formal.zh: 自行车比赛将于上午九点在地方议会办公处门前开始。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tieħu sehem fit-tellieqa għada? Mark: Iva, imma rrid norqod kmieni llejla.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you taking part in the race tomorrow? Mark: Yes, but I need to go to bed early tonight.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你明天参加比赛吗？Mark：参加，不过我今晚得早点睡。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天参加比赛吗？
messages.en: Are you taking part in the race tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rrid norqod kmieni llejla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rrid norqod kmieni llejla.
messages.zh: 参加，不过我今晚得早点睡。
messages.en: Yes, but I need to go to bed early tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑海中画出起跑线、参赛者和终点线，把整个争先到达的比赛场景对应这个名词。

gloss_zh: 倦怠；无精打采；离开；出发

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of weariness or lack of energy; in another sense, the act of leaving or departing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体疲乏、缺乏精神或活力的状态；另一个义项表示离开或出发这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' għeja jew nuqqas ta' enerġija; f'tifsira oħra, l-att li wieħed jitlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神不振、缺乏活力的状态；倦怠。
一次离开或出发。
动词 telaq 的动名词，表示离开或出发这一行为。
身心疲乏、提不起劲的状态。
离开；出发。

formal.mt: Wara l-vjaġġ twil, il-parteċipanti ħassew għeja u sens ta' telqien.
formal.en: After the long journey, the participants felt tired and lethargic.
formal.zh: 长途旅行后，参与者感到疲惫，提不起精神。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed toqgħod bilqiegħda? Pawlu: Għandi sens ta' telqien illum; għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you sitting down? Pawlu: I feel lethargic today; I need a little rest.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎么坐下了？Pawlu：我今天浑身没劲，需要休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么坐下了？
messages.en: Why are you sitting down?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi sens ta' telqien illum; għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi sens ta' telqien illum; għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 我今天浑身没劲，需要休息一会儿。
messages.en: I feel lethargic today; I need a little rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两张场景卡记忆：疲倦地坐着对应“倦怠”，团队离开对应“出发”；阅读时靠上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The main subject or idea discussed or developed in a conversation, text, work, or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谈话、文章、作品或活动围绕的主要话题或中心思想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-suġġett jew l-idea ewlenija li tiġi diskussa jew żviluppata f'konversazzjoni, test, xogħol jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主题；作品或活动所表达的中心思想。
话题；讨论的主要内容或主题。

formal.mt: It-tema ewlenija tal-konferenza hija l-protezzjoni tal-ambjent.
formal.en: The main theme of the conference is environmental protection.
formal.zh: 会议的主要主题是环境保护。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi t-tema tal-proġett tiegħek? Mark: Il-ħajja fil-baħar; irrid nikteb dwar il-ħut.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's the topic of your project? Mark: Marine life; I want to write about fish.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你的项目主题是什么？Mark：海洋生物，我想写鱼类。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你的项目主题是什么？
messages.en: What's the topic of your project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħajja fil-baħar; irrid nikteb dwar il-ħut.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħajja fil-baħar; irrid nikteb dwar il-ħut.
messages.zh: 海洋生物，我想写鱼类。
messages.en: Marine life; I want to write about fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把文章中心画成一个圆，周围细节都围着它展开；圆心写上 tema，就能联想到主题。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An occasion of eating, or the food eaten on that occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次进餐，或在这次进餐时食用的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba li fiha wieħed jiekol, jew l-ikel li jittiekel f'dik id-darba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一餐；一顿饭，也可指这一餐的食物。
一顿饭；一次进餐。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru joffri temgħa sħuna lill-viżitaturi kuljum f'nofsinhar.
formal.en: The centre offers visitors a hot meal every day at noon.
formal.zh: 中心每天中午为来访者提供一顿热饭。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadek bil-ġuħ? Pawlu: Le, kilt temgħa tajba għand in-nanna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you still hungry? Pawlu: No, I had a good meal at Grandma's.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你还饿吗？Pawlu：不饿，我在奶奶家好好吃了一顿。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 你还饿吗？
messages.en: Are you still hungry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kilt temgħa tajba għand in-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kilt temgħa tajba għand in-nanna.
messages.zh: 不饿，我在奶奶家好好吃了一顿。
messages.en: No, I had a good meal at Grandma's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐到餐桌前，从开吃到吃完算“一顿”；把整次进餐和桌上的饭菜一起记作 temgħa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To finish or complete an activity, or bring something to an end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成某项活动或工作，或使某件事情结束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lesta attività jew xogħol, jew ġab xi ħaġa fi tmiemha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完成；做完。
达成；实现。
使停止；使终止。
结束；终结。
完成；结束；使告一段落。
毁灭；摧毁。
动词 temm 的动名词，表示完成或结束这一行为。
结束；终结。

formal.mt: Id-direttur temm il-laqgħa wara li ġew diskussi l-punti kollha.
formal.en: The director ended the meeting after all the points had been discussed.
formal.zh: 所有议题讨论完毕后，主任结束了会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark temm ix-xogħol? Rita: Iva, temm kollox dalgħodu. Issa jista' jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark finished the work? Rita: Yes, he finished everything this morning. Now he can rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把工作做完了吗？丽塔：是的，他今天上午全做完了。现在他可以休息了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把工作做完了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark finished the work?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, temm kollox dalgħodu. Issa jista' jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, temm kollox dalgħodu. Issa jista' jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 是的，他今天上午全做完了。现在他可以休息了。
messages.en: Yes, he finished everything this morning. Now he can rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象完成任务后画上句号：temm 把事情带到终点。用“完成工作”和“结束会议”两幅画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The conditions outside, such as sunshine, rain, wind, or cold; also climate or grammatical tense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指晴雨、风和冷热等天气状况，也可表示气候或语法中的时态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjonijiet tal-arja, bħax-xemx, ix-xita, ir-riħ jew il-kesħa; jista' jfisser ukoll il-klima jew iż-żmien grammatikali ta' verb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天气；某一时间和地点的晴雨、风及冷热状况。
气候；某一地区长期的典型天气状况。
时态；表示动作或状态时间关系的语法形式。

formal.mt: Minħabba t-temp ħażin, l-attività se ssir ġewwa.
formal.en: Because of the bad weather, the event will take place indoors.
formal.zh: 由于天气恶劣，活动将在室内举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu t-temp barra? Mark: Hemm ix-xemx, imma hemm ukoll ħafna riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the weather like outside? Mark: It's sunny, but it's also very windy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：外面天气怎么样？马克：有太阳，不过风也很大。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 外面天气怎么样？
messages.en: What's the weather like outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ix-xemx, imma hemm ukoll ħafna riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ix-xemx, imma hemm ukoll ħafna riħ.
messages.zh: 有太阳，不过风也很大。
messages.en: It's sunny, but it's also very windy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 temp 配两张学习卡：一张画太阳和雨云，记天气；另一张写过去、现在、将来，记语法时态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's characteristic emotional nature and usual way of reacting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人通常表现出来的情绪特点、性情和反应方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karattru emozzjonali ta' persuna u l-mod kif normalment tirreaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脾气；性情，尤其指情绪反应的特点。
气质；个人较为稳定的情绪和行为倾向。
气质；性情；惯常的心理和情绪倾向。

formal.mt: It-temperament kalm tal-għalliema jgħinha tittratta sitwazzjonijiet diffiċli fil-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher's calm temperament helps her handle difficult situations in the classroom.
formal.zh: 这位教师沉稳的性情有助于她处理课堂上的困难情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jibqa' daqshekk kalm Pawlu? Rita: Għandu temperament kalm. Anki meta jkun hemm problema, jitkellem bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: How does Pawlu stay so calm? Rita: He has a calm temperament. Even when there's a problem, he speaks calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么总能这么冷静？丽塔：他的性情很沉稳。即使出了问题，他说话也很平和。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么总能这么冷静？
messages.en: How does Pawlu stay so calm?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu temperament kalm. Anki meta jkun hemm problema, jitkellem bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu temperament kalm. Anki meta jkun hemm problema, jitkellem bil-mod.
messages.zh: 他的性情很沉稳。即使出了问题，他说话也很平和。
messages.en: He has a calm temperament. Even when there's a problem, he speaks calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 temperament 记成一个人长期使用的“情绪底色”：遇事通常沉稳还是紧张，体现的就是他的性情与气质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measure of how hot or cold something is, including the air or a person's body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衡量物体、空气或人体冷热程度的数值；用于人体时指体温。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' kemm xi ħaġa tkun sħuna jew kiesħa, inklużi l-arja u l-ġisem ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温度；表示冷热程度的量，也可指人体的体温。

formal.mt: L-istudenti kejlu t-temperatura tal-ilma qabel u wara l-esperiment.
formal.en: The students measured the water temperature before and after the experiment.
formal.zh: 学生们在实验前后测量了水温。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi t-temperatura fil-kamra? Mark: Ħamsa u għoxrin grad. Trid tiftaħ it-tieqa?
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the temperature in the room? Mark: Twenty-five degrees. Would you like to open the window?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：房间里多少度？马克：二十五度。你想打开窗户吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 房间里多少度？
messages.en: What's the temperature in the room?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħamsa u għoxrin grad. Trid tiftaħ it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Ħamsa u għoxrin grad. Trid tiftaħ it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 二十五度。你想打开窗户吗？
messages.en: Twenty-five degrees. Would you like to open the window?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 temperatura，就想象温度计旁的数字和度数符号；空气、水和人体都能测温，用同一幅图串起这些用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A storm with strong winds, often accompanied by heavy rain or rough seas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伴有强风的风暴，常同时出现大雨或汹涌海浪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maltemp b'riħ qawwi, spiss flimkien ma' xita qawwija jew baħar imqalleb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 风暴；暴风雨。
猛烈的风暴；狂风暴雨。
风暴；飑，即突然出现的强风，有时伴随降雨。

formal.mt: It-tempesta qawwija kkawżat ħsarat f'diversi dgħajjes fil-port.
formal.en: The violent storm caused damage to several boats in the harbour.
formal.zh: 猛烈的风暴损坏了港内的几艘船。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt ir-riħ matul il-lejl? Mark: Iva, kienet tempesta qawwija. Dalgħodu sibt fergħa kbira fil-bitħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the wind during the night? Mark: Yes, it was a violent storm. This morning I found a large branch in the yard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你昨晚听见风声了吗？马克：听见了，风暴很猛烈。今天早上我在院子里发现了一根大树枝。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你昨晚听见风声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the wind during the night?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet tempesta qawwija. Dalgħodu sibt fergħa kbira fil-bitħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet tempesta qawwija. Dalgħodu sibt fergħa kbira fil-bitħa.
messages.zh: 听见了，风暴很猛烈。今天早上我在院子里发现了一根大树枝。
messages.en: Yes, it was a violent storm. This morning I found a large branch in the yard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tempesta 放进风吹树摇、海浪翻涌的画面中记忆；再与 temp“天气”并排学习，记住这里指具体的强烈风暴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or sacred place used for religious worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于宗教祭祀或礼拜的建筑或神圣场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew post sagru użat għall-qima reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神庙；寺庙；用于宗教祭祀或礼拜的场所。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu josservaw il-fdalijiet tat-tempju mill-mogħdija mmarkata.
formal.en: Visitors can observe the remains of the temple from the marked path.
formal.zh: 游客可以从标示好的步道上观看神庙遗迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi d-daħla tat-tempju? Pawlu: Hemmhekk, ħdejn it-tabella. Ejja nimxu minn din in-naħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the temple entrance? Pawlu: Over there, next to the sign. Let's walk this way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：神庙入口在哪里？保罗：在那边，标牌旁边。我们走这边吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 神庙入口在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the temple entrance?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemmhekk, ħdejn it-tabella. Ejja nimxu minn din in-naħa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemmhekk, ħdejn it-tabella. Ejja nimxu minn din in-naħa.
messages.zh: 在那边，标牌旁边。我们走这边吧。
messages.en: Over there, next to the sign. Let's walk this way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tempju 配一幅有入口和祭祀空间的神庙图，再用“古老神庙”和“神庙入口”两个短语把建筑形象固定下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's mood or temper; also the hardening of a material such as steel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人的心情或脾气；也指使钢等材料变硬的处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-burdata jew il-karattru ta' persuna; ukoll il-proċess li bih materjal bħall-azzar isir aktar iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个人的脾气；个人的性情。
心情；情绪状态；脾气。
硬化处理；使材料变硬的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċess tat-tempra tal-azzar u l-effett tiegħu fuq l-ebusija tal-materjal.
formal.en: The report describes the steel-hardening process and its effect on the hardness of the material.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了钢的硬化处理过程及其对材料硬度的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jitkellem illum? Rita: Naħseb li hu ta' tempra ħażina. Nagħtuh ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Pawlu want to talk today? Rita: I think he's in a bad mood. Let's give him a little time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天为什么不想说话？丽塔：我想他心情不好。我们给他一点时间吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jitkellem illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jitkellem illum?
messages.zh: 保罗今天为什么不想说话？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu want to talk today?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li hu ta' tempra ħażina. Nagħtuh ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li hu ta' tempra ħażina. Nagħtuh ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 我想他心情不好。我们给他一点时间吧。
messages.en: I think he's in a bad mood. Let's give him a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tempra 分设两幅记忆图：一幅是人的心情表情，另一幅是材料变硬的加工场景；分开记义，再靠上下文选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to sharpen pencils; also a small folding knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于削尖铅笔的工具；也可指可折叠的小刀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda biex tnaqqax il-lapsijiet; jista' jfisser ukoll sikkina żgħira li tingħalaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷笔刀；削铅笔器。
小折刀；可折叠并随身携带的小刀。

collocations.en: a pencil sharpener with two holes

formal.mt: Għal-lezzjoni tat-tpinġija, kull student għandu jġib lapes, gomma u temprin.
formal.en: For the drawing lesson, each student should bring a pencil, an eraser, and a pencil sharpener.
formal.zh: 上绘画课时，每位学生应带一支铅笔、一块橡皮和一个卷笔刀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek temprin? Il-ponta tal-lapes inkisret. Mark: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa tal-lapsijiet. Tista' tużah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a pencil sharpener? The pencil tip broke. Mark: Yes, it's in the pencil case. You can use it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有卷笔刀吗？铅笔尖断了。马克：有，在笔盒里。你可以用。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你有卷笔刀吗？铅笔尖断了。
messages.en: Do you have a pencil sharpener? The pencil tip broke.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa tal-lapsijiet. Tista' tużah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa tal-lapsijiet. Tista' tużah.
messages.zh: 有，在笔盒里。你可以用。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the pencil case. You can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象笔盒里铅笔尖断了，你伸手找 temprin 削尖它；另画一把小折刀记住第二义，阅读时用铅笔或刀刃的语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak with repeated sounds or pauses that interrupt the flow of speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时重复某些声音或出现停顿，话语断断续续。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'ripetizzjoni ta' ħsejjes jew b'waqfiet li jinterrompu l-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结结巴巴地说，说话时出现不连贯的停顿或声音重复。
口吃，说话时不自主地重复声音或音节，或发声受阻。

formal.mt: Waqt il-preżentazzjoni, l-istudent temtem ftit, u l-għalliema tatu l-ħin biex ikompli.
formal.en: During the presentation, the student stammered a little, and the teacher gave him time to continue.
formal.zh: 学生在做报告时有些结巴，老师给了他时间，让他继续说下去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft f'nofs is-sentenza? Mark: Temtemt ftit. Agħtini mument u nkompli. Maja: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek, qed nisma'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop halfway through the sentence? Mark: I stammered a little. Give me a moment and I'll continue. Maja: Take your time; I'm listening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说到半句停下来了？马克：我有点结巴。给我一点时间，我接着说。玛雅：慢慢来，我听着呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说到半句停下来了？
messages.en: Why did you stop halfway through the sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Temtemt ftit. Agħtini mument u nkompli.
messages.mt_standard: Temtemt ftit. Agħtini mument u nkompli.
messages.zh: 我有点结巴。给我一点时间，我接着说。
messages.en: I stammered a little. Give me a moment and I'll continue.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 慢慢来，我听着呢。
messages.en: Take your time; I'm listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 temtem 分成 tem—tem 两段来读，想象一句话开头重复、稍作停顿的情景，帮助记住“结巴地说”；这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend paper, cloth, or another flexible material so that one part lies over another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把纸、布等可弯曲的材料折起来，使一部分叠在另一部分上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħawweġ karta, drapp jew materjal ieħor flessibbli biex parti minnu tiġi fuq parti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 折叠，把物体的一部分折到另一部分上。

formal.mt: L-istudent tena l-karta bin-nofs u poġġieha fil-kaxxa skont l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The student folded the paper in half and placed it in the box according to the instructions.
formal.zh: 学生按照说明把纸对折，然后放进盒子里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min tena din il-karta? Pawlu: Jien. Kienet kbira wisq għall-kaxxa. Sara: Tajjeb, issa tidħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who folded this paper? Pawlu: I did. It was too big for the box. Sara: Good, now it fits.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张纸是谁折的？保罗：我折的。它太大了，放不进盒子。萨拉：好，现在放得进了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这张纸是谁折的？
messages.en: Who folded this paper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我折的。它太大了，放不进盒子。
messages.en: I did. It was too big for the box.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 好，现在放得进了。
messages.en: Good, now it fits.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tena 就想象把一张纸对折一次；再与 tenna“重复”对照记忆：单写 n 记折纸，双写 nn 记再说一次。这是拼写助记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become softer, or to fray as the fibres of fabric or rope loosen and separate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得柔软，或指布料、绳索的纤维松开、分散而起毛或散丝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar artab, jew jibdew jinħallu u jinfirdu l-fibri ta' drapp jew ħabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变软，变得较柔软。
起毛、散丝，例如布料或绳索的纤维逐渐松散。
磨损起毛，纤维或线头逐渐散开。

collocations.en: the rope frayed at the end

formal.mt: Wara ħafna użu, il-ħabel tenfex fit-tarf u l-fibri tiegħu bdew jinfirdu.
formal.en: After extensive use, the rope frayed at the end and its fibres began to separate.
formal.zh: 经过长期使用，绳子的末端磨损散丝，纤维开始分开。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara t-tarf ta' dan il-ħabel. Toni: Iva, tenfex. Aħjar nieħdu ieħor. Lara: Hemm wieħed ġdid fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at the end of this rope. Toni: Yes, it has frayed. We'd better get another one. Lara: There's a new one in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看看这根绳子的末端。托尼：是啊，散丝了。我们最好换一根。拉拉：抽屉里有根新的。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 看看这根绳子的末端。
messages.en: Look at the end of this rope.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，散丝了。我们最好换一根。
messages.en: Yes, it has frayed. We'd better get another one.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 抽屉里有根新的。
messages.en: There's a new one in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅触觉画面记 tenfex：一块材料摸起来变软，一根旧绳末端散成细丝。把“变软”和“起毛散丝”分别记住，遇到句子再按语境选择。

gloss_zh: 软化；起毛散丝；脱落的绒屑

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of softening or fraying, or the small bits of fluff shed by fraying fabric.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 软化或磨损起毛的过程，也可指布料起毛散丝时脱落的细小绒屑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir aktar ratba jew jinħallu l-fibri tagħha; ukoll biċċiet żgħar ta' tentuf li jaqgħu minn drapp li qed jitfarfar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 软化，材料变得柔软的过程。

sense_translations.en_definition: bits of fluff falling from fraying fabric
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从起毛、散丝的布料上脱落的小绒屑。
动词 tenfex 的动名词，表示相应的软化或起毛散丝过程。
起毛、散丝，纤维逐渐松散或磨损的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tenfix tad-drapp u l-biċċiet żgħar ta' tentuf li nġabru waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The report describes the fraying of the fabric and the small bits of fluff collected during the examination.
formal.zh: 报告描述了布料起毛散丝的情况，以及检查过程中收集到的小绒屑。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dan fuq il-mejda? Rita: Tenfix minn dik il-biċċa drapp qadima. Nina: Mela nnaddaf il-mejda qabel inkomplu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's this on the table? Rita: Fluff from that old piece of fabric. Nina: Then I'll clean the table before we continue.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：桌上的这些是什么？丽塔：那块旧布掉下来的绒屑。妮娜：那我先把桌子清理一下，我们再继续。

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 桌上的这些是什么？
messages.en: What's this on the table?

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tenfix minn dik il-biċċa drapp qadima.
messages.mt_standard: Tenfix minn dik il-biċċa drapp qadima.
messages.zh: 那块旧布掉下来的绒屑。
messages.en: Fluff from that old piece of fabric.

messages.speaker: Nina (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 那我先把桌子清理一下，我们再继续。
messages.en: Then I'll clean the table before we continue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tenfix 放在“名词盒子”里记：既可装下变软、散丝这一过程，也可装下桌面上的小绒屑。与动词 tenfex 配对时，注意区分过程名称和动作表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant known in English as spurge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语称为 spurge 的大戟类植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala spurge.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大戟类植物。
大戟类植物，指植物名称。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni, l-għalliema wriet ritratt ta' pjanta tat-tengħud u talbet lill-istudenti jiddeskrivu l-weraq tagħha.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher showed a photograph of a spurge plant and asked the students to describe its leaves.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师展示了一张大戟类植物的照片，并请学生描述它的叶子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Lara: Tengħud. L-isem miktub taħtha. Maja: Sewwa, se niktbu ħdejn it-tpinġija tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the name of this plant in the photograph? Lara: Spurge. The name is written underneath it. Maja: Right, I'll write it beside my drawing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这株植物叫什么？拉拉：大戟类植物。名字写在它下面。玛雅：好，我把名字写在我的画旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's the name of this plant in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 大戟类植物。名字写在它下面。
messages.en: Spurge. The name is written underneath it.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, se niktbu ħdejn it-tpinġija tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, se niktbu ħdejn it-tpinġija tiegħi.
messages.zh: 好，我把名字写在我的画旁边。
messages.en: Right, I'll write it beside my drawing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张植物词卡，正面写 tengħud，背面并排写“大戟类植物”和 spurge；想象给植物照片贴上三语标签，整词记忆，不猜测词根。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or do something again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把已经说过的话再说一次，或把已经做过的事再做一次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jgħid jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重复，再说一遍或再做一次。

formal.mt: Il-president tal-laqgħa tenna l-mistoqsija biex il-parteċipanti kollha jkunu jistgħu jisimgħuha.
formal.en: The chair of the meeting repeated the question so that all the participants could hear it.
formal.zh: 会议主持人把问题又说了一遍，让所有与会者都能听到。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'qal l-għalliem? Ma smajtx sew. Mark: Tenna l-istruzzjonijiet: l-ewwel naqraw, imbagħad niktbu. Anna: Issa fhimt, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did the teacher say? I didn't hear clearly. Mark: He repeated the instructions: first we read, then we write. Anna: Now I understand, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：老师说了什么？我没听清。马克：他重复了要求：先读，然后写。安娜：现在明白了，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 老师说了什么？我没听清。
messages.en: What did the teacher say? I didn't hear clearly.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tenna l-istruzzjonijiet: l-ewwel naqraw, imbagħad niktbu.
messages.mt_standard: Tenna l-istruzzjonijiet: l-ewwel naqraw, imbagħad niktbu.
messages.zh: 他重复了要求：先读，然后写。
messages.en: He repeated the instructions: first we read, then we write.

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 现在明白了，谢谢。
messages.en: Now I understand, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: tenna 中的 n 写了两次，可以把这两个 n 当作“再来一次”的视觉提示，记住“重复”；同时对照 tena“折叠”，避免漏写一个 n。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of mental or emotional strain, an uneasy relationship, or a physical pulling force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 心理或情绪上的紧张、关系中的紧张状态，或物体受到拉扯时的张力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nervożiżmu jew ta' relazzjonijiet diffiċli, jew forza li tiġbed ħabel jew materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧张、紧张关系；也可指物理上的张力。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tensjoni bejn iż-żewġ gruppi waqt il-laqgħa u l-isforzi biex jintlaħaq ftehim.
formal.en: The report describes the tension between the two groups during the meeting and the efforts to reach an agreement.
formal.zh: 报告描述了会议期间两个小组之间的紧张关系，以及为达成共识所作的努力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi ħafna tensjoni qabel l-eżami. Pawlu: Trid nirrevedu ftit flimkien? Sara: Iva, hekk inħossni aktar kalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'm feeling a lot of tension before the exam. Pawlu: Shall we review a little together? Sara: Yes, that way I'll feel calmer.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：考试前我很紧张。保罗：要不要一起复习一会儿？萨拉：好，这样我会平静一些。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 考试前我很紧张。
messages.en: I'm feeling a lot of tension before the exam.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 要不要一起复习一会儿？
messages.en: Shall we review a little together?

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 好，这样我会平静一些。
messages.en: Yes, that way I'll feel calmer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tensjoni 与英语 tension 并排记，想象一根拉紧的绳子，再联想到考试前绷紧的心情和人与人之间紧绷的关系，用同一画面串起不同语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong desire to do or have something appealing, especially something one thinks one should avoid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想做或得到某种有吸引力的事物的强烈欲望，尤其指自己觉得应当克制的欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija li tagħmel jew ikollok xi ħaġa li tiġbdek, speċjalment meta taħseb li għandek tevitha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱惑，使人很想做某事或得到某物的吸引力或欲望。

formal.mt: Matul il-ġimgħa tal-eżamijiet, l-istudenta rreżistiet it-tentazzjoni li tqatta' l-lejla kollha tara filmati u kompliet tistudja.
formal.en: During exam week, the student resisted the temptation to spend the whole evening watching videos and continued studying.
formal.zh: 考试周期间，这名学生抵制了整晚看视频的诱惑，继续学习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-kejk tidher tajba ħafna. Għandi t-tentazzjoni nieħu biċċa oħra. Lara: Trid taqsam biċċa miegħi? Maja: Iva, nofs biċċa jkun biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: This cake looks really good. I'm tempted to have another slice. Lara: Do you want to share a slice with me? Maja: Yes, half a slice will be enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个蛋糕看起来真好吃。我忍不住想再吃一块。拉拉：要和我分一块吗？玛雅：好，半块就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kejk tidher tajba ħafna. Għandi t-tentazzjoni nieħu biċċa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kejk tidher tajba ħafna. Għandi t-tentazzjoni nieħu biċċa oħra.
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕看起来真好吃。我忍不住想再吃一块。
messages.en: This cake looks really good. I'm tempted to have another slice.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 要和我分一块吗？
messages.en: Do you want to share a slice with me?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，半块就够了。
messages.en: Yes, half a slice will be enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面前有一块特别诱人的蛋糕，心里冒出“再来一块”的念头，把这个念头贴上 tentazzjoni 标签；再配对记“抵制诱惑”和“经不住诱惑”两个表达。

gloss_zh: 神学的；与神学研究有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to theology, the study of God and religious belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与神学有关的，即涉及对上帝及宗教信仰的系统研究的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mat-teoloġija, jiġifieri mal-istudju ta' Alla u tat-twemmin reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神学的；涉及神学研究的。

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju teoloġiku jeżamina r-relazzjoni bejn il-fidi u r-raġuni.
formal.en: This theological study examines the relationship between faith and reason.
formal.zh: 这项神学研究探讨信仰与理性之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Mark: Huwa ktieb teoloġiku dwar il-fidi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this book about? Mark: It is a theological book about faith.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书讲什么？马克：这是一本探讨信仰的神学书籍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是一本探讨信仰的神学书籍。
messages.en: It is a theological book about faith.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本封面写着“信仰与理性”的神学书，把 teoloġiku 与“神学的”连在一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 理论；解释某种现象的学说

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized explanation or set of ideas used to understand a subject or explain how something works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于理解某一领域或解释事物如何运作的一套有组织的观点或解释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni organizzata jew ġabra ta' ideat li jgħinu biex nifhmu suġġett jew kif taħdem xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理论；用于解释现象或说明原理的一套观点。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi użaw id-data biex jittestjaw it-teorija.
formal.en: The researchers used the data to test the theory.
formal.zh: 研究人员利用数据检验这项理论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fhimt it-teorija? Ben: Iva, imma għandi bżonn eżempju biex nifhem kif napplikaha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you understand the theory? Ben: Yes, but I need an example to understand how to apply it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你理解这个理论了吗？本：理解了，但我需要一个例子才能明白怎么应用它。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你理解这个理论了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand the theory?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għandi bżonn eżempju biex nifhem kif napplikaha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għandi bżonn eżempju biex nifhem kif napplikaha.
messages.zh: 理解了，但我需要一个例子才能明白怎么应用它。
messages.en: Yes, but I need an example to understand how to apply it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teorija 放进“先学理论，再做练习”的课堂画面中；它是可以理解、讨论和检验的一套理论。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on or concerned with theory, rather than direct practical activity or observation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以理论为基础或涉及理论研究的；侧重原理推演而非直接实践或观察的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibbażat fuq teorija jew marbut magħha, aktar milli ma' xogħol prattiku jew osservazzjoni diretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理论的；基于理论推导的；理论上的。

formal.mt: Il-mudell teoriku jipprovdi bażi għall-analiżi tar-riżultati.
formal.en: The theoretical model provides a basis for analyzing the results.
formal.zh: 这个理论模型为分析结果提供了基础。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-eżerċizzju huwa teoriku? Adam: Iva, illum niddiskutu l-prinċipji u għada nagħmlu l-parti prattika.
