colloquial.en: Sara: Is this exercise theoretical? Adam: Yes, today we discuss the principles, and tomorrow we do the practical part.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个练习是理论性的吗？亚当：是的，今天讨论原理，明天做实践部分。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个练习是理论性的吗？
messages.en: Is this exercise theoretical?

messages.speaker: Adam (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum niddiskutu l-prinċipji u għada nagħmlu l-parti prattika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum niddiskutu l-prinċipji u għada nagħmlu l-parti prattika.
messages.zh: 是的，今天讨论原理，明天做实践部分。
messages.en: Yes, today we discuss the principles, and tomorrow we do the practical part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 配对记忆：teorija 是“理论”这个名词，teoriku 用来形容模型、框架或练习“属于理论层面”。

gloss_zh: 治疗学；研究治疗方法的学科

teaching_sense.en_definition: The branch of medicine concerned with methods used to treat illness and relieve symptoms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 医学中研究治疗疾病和缓解症状的方法的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fergħa tal-mediċina li tistudja l-metodi għat-trattament tal-mard u biex jittaffew is-sintomi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治疗学；研究疾病治疗手段及其应用的医学学科。

formal.mt: Il-kors fit-terapewtika jintroduċi l-prinċipji tal-għażla u tal-użu tat-trattamenti.
formal.en: The course in therapeutics introduces the principles of selecting and using treatments.
formal.zh: 这门治疗学课程介绍选择和应用治疗方法的原理。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tistudjaw fit-terapewtika? David: Nistudjaw metodi differenti biex nittrattaw il-mard u ntaffu s-sintomi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What do you study in therapeutics? David: We study different methods for treating illness and relieving symptoms.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们在治疗学里学什么？戴维：我们学习治疗疾病和缓解症状的不同方法。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你们在治疗学里学什么？
messages.en: What do you study in therapeutics?

messages.speaker: David (医学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistudjaw metodi differenti biex nittrattaw il-mard u ntaffu s-sintomi.
messages.mt_standard: Nistudjaw metodi differenti biex nittrattaw il-mard u ntaffu s-sintomi.
messages.zh: 我们学习治疗疾病和缓解症状的不同方法。
messages.en: We study different methods for treating illness and relieving symptoms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象医学院课程表上的“治疗学”：terapewtika 指研究治疗方法的学科，记成一门课的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to treating illness or intended to improve health or well-being.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与疾病治疗有关的，或旨在改善健康与身心状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mat-trattament tal-mard jew maħsub biex itejjeb is-saħħa jew il-benesseri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治疗的；用于治疗的；具有治疗或舒缓作用的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-għan terapewtiku tal-programm u l-metodi użati.
formal.en: The report describes the therapeutic purpose of the program and the methods used.
formal.zh: 报告说明了该项目的治疗目的及所采用的方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-eżerċizzju għandu għan terapewtiku? Toni: Iva, huwa parti mill-programm li ħejja l-fiżjoterapista.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this exercise have a therapeutic purpose? Toni: Yes, it is part of the program prepared by the physiotherapist.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个练习有治疗目的吗？托尼：有，它是物理治疗师制定的方案的一部分。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个练习有治疗目的吗？
messages.en: Does this exercise have a therapeutic purpose?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa parti mill-programm li ħejja l-fiżjoterapista.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa parti mill-programm li ħejja l-fiżjoterapista.
messages.zh: 有，它是物理治疗师制定的方案的一部分。
messages.en: Yes, it is part of the program prepared by the physiotherapist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“治疗学课程”和“治疗效果”配对记忆：terapewtika 是学科名，terapewtiku 修饰效果或目的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To crush something, reduce it to pulp, or strike it with a hammer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过挤压或敲击使物体破碎、变成浆状，或用锤子敲击物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfarrak xi ħaġa, tgħaffeġha sakemm issir polpa, jew tolqotha bil-martell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压碎；捣碎；使物体受力后破碎。
把某物捣成或压成浆状。
用锤子敲击；锤打。

collocations.en: he reduced the fruit to pulp

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem teraq il-ġebla bil-martell sakemm inkisret f'biċċiet iżgħar.
formal.en: The worker hammered the stone until it broke into smaller pieces.
formal.zh: 工人用锤子敲打石头，直到它碎成较小的块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel Mark bit-tadam? Ben: Teraq it-tadam biex jagħmel iz-zalza.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mark do with the tomatoes? Ben: He crushed the tomatoes to make the sauce.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克把番茄怎么处理了？本：他把番茄压碎，用来做酱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把番茄怎么处理了？
messages.en: What did Mark do with the tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 他把番茄压碎，用来做酱。
messages.en: He crushed the tomatoes to make the sauce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个动作画面记 teraq：番茄被压碎、水果变成果泥、锤子敲打石头；根据宾语判断具体意思。

gloss_zh: 敲击石头；走很长的路；修筑道路；反复锤打

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike at stone, walk a long distance, create roads, or hammer repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敲击石头、步行很长的距离、修筑道路，或反复用锤敲打；具体意思由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tolqot il-ġebel, timxi distanza twila, tagħmel toroq, jew tolqot bil-martell għal darba wara l-oħra, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敲击石头；向石料施以敲打。
走很长的路；长距离步行。
修筑道路；开辟道路。
反复锤打；连续用锤敲击。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem terraq il-ġebla b'daqqiet ripetuti tal-martell.
formal.en: The worker struck the stone with repeated blows of the hammer.
formal.zh: 工人用锤子反复敲打石头。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu huwa daqshekk għajjien? Toni: Għax illum terraq għal sigħat sħaħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu so tired? Toni: Because today he walked for hours on end.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么这么累？托尼：因为他今天一连走了好几个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么这么累？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu so tired?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax illum terraq għal sigħat sħaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax illum terraq għal sigħat sħaħ.
messages.zh: 因为他今天一连走了好几个小时。
messages.en: Because today he walked for hours on end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 terraq 分成四张语境卡来记：敲石、远行、修路、反复锤打；看到“好几个小时”就联想长距离步行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement within the Earth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地球内部运动引起的地面突然震动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Theżżiża għal għarrieda tal-art minħabba ċaqliq ġewwa d-Dinja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地震。

collocations.en: the damage caused by the earthquake

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħsara li kkawża t-terremot fl-irħula tal-madwar.
formal.en: The report describes the damage that the earthquake caused in the surrounding villages.
formal.zh: 报告描述了地震对周边村庄造成的损失。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħassejt l-art tiċċaqlaq? Mark: Iva, naħseb li kien terremot żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you feel the ground moving? Mark: Yes, I think it was a small earthquake.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你感觉到地面在动了吗？Mark：感觉到了，我想是一次小地震。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你感觉到地面在动了吗？
messages.en: Did you feel the ground moving?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naħseb li kien terremot żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naħseb li kien terremot żgħir.
messages.zh: 感觉到了，我想是一次小地震。
messages.en: Yes, I think it was a small earthquake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 terremot 和“脚下地面突然摇晃”的画面联系起来，再用 terremot qawwi 记住“强烈地震”的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tear something into small pieces or damage it until it is in tatters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西撕成小碎片，或将其毁坏得破烂不堪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqatta' xi ħaġa f'biċċiet żgħar jew jagħmilha ċraret.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕碎；把东西撕成细小碎片。
撕成碎片；撕得粉碎。
使破烂不堪；撕得只剩破布或碎片。
毁坏，尤指撕碎或弄得破烂不堪。

collocations.en: he tore the paper to pieces
he tore the shirt to tatters
collocations.zh: 他把衬衫撕得破烂不堪

formal.mt: Qabel ma rema l-karta bl-indirizz tiegħu fuqha, tertaqha f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: Before throwing away the paper with his address on it, he tore it into small pieces.
formal.zh: 在扔掉写有自己地址的纸之前，他把它撕成了小碎片。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hi l-lista tax-xiri? Pawlu: It-tifel tertaqha, imma għandi ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the shopping list? Pawlu: The boy tore it to pieces, but I have a photo of it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：购物清单在哪里？Pawlu：小男孩把它撕碎了，不过我有它的照片。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 购物清单在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the shopping list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel tertaqha, imma għandi ritratt tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel tertaqha, imma għandi ritratt tagħha.
messages.zh: 小男孩把它撕碎了，不过我有它的照片。
messages.en: The boy tore it to pieces, but I have a photo of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张完整的纸被撕成满桌碎片，用 tertaq 记住“撕到碎”的动作与结果，而不只是撕开一道口子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shake involuntarily, especially because of cold, fear, or a disturbing feeling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体不由自主地抖动，尤其因寒冷、恐惧或令人不安的感受而发抖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitriegħed bla ma jrid, speċjalment minħabba l-bard, il-biża' jew sensazzjoni kerha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冷得发抖；因寒冷而打寒战。
战栗；因恐惧、厌恶或不安而猛地发抖。
发抖；身体出现不由自主的轻微颤动。

formal.mt: Wara siegħa fix-xita u fir-riħ, ir-raġel terter bil-bard u talab kutra.
formal.en: After an hour in the rain and wind, the man shivered with cold and asked for a blanket.
formal.zh: 在风雨中待了一个小时后，男子冷得发抖，便要了一条毯子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tajt il-kutra lil Mark? Nina: Terter bil-bard malli ħareġ mill-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you give Mark the blanket? Nina: He shivered with cold as soon as he came out of the water.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把毯子给了 Mark？Nina：他一从水里出来就冷得发抖。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把毯子给了 Mark？
messages.en: Why did you give Mark the blanket?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他一从水里出来就冷得发抖。
messages.en: He shivered with cold as soon as he came out of the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 terter 时配合肩膀轻轻发抖，把重复的声音当作记忆节奏；再用 bil-bard 联想到“冷得发抖”。

gloss_zh: 薄膜；摄影胶片；玳瑁材料；碎片

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin membrane or film; in other uses, photographic film, tortoiseshell material, or a torn fragment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 薄膜或膜状薄层；也可指摄影胶片、制作梳子等物品的玳瑁材料，或撕裂后的碎片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rita jew saff irqiq; tista' tfisser ukoll film fotografiku, materjal mill-qoxra tal-fekruna, jew biċċa mqattgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 膜；覆盖表面或分隔组织的薄层。
照相机使用的感光胶片。
用于制作梳子等物品的玳瑁材料。
撕下的小片；破布条；破烂碎片。
极细小的碎片；粉碎后的残片。
供照相机使用的摄影胶片。

formal.mt: Il-fotografu poġġa tertuqa ġdida fil-kamera qabel beda jieħu r-ritratti.
formal.en: The photographer put new film in the camera before starting to take photographs.
formal.zh: 摄影师在开始拍照之前，给照相机装上了新胶片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-kamera tuża tertuqa? Toni: Iva, irridu nixtru waħda qabel il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this camera use film? Toni: Yes, we need to buy some before the trip.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这台照相机用胶片吗？Toni：用，我们得在旅行前买一卷。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这台照相机用胶片吗？
messages.en: Does this camera use film?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu nixtru waħda qabel il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu nixtru waħda qabel il-vjaġġ.

messages.en: Yes, we need to buy some before the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tertuqa 画四张词义卡：薄膜、相机胶片、玳瑁梳子材料、破碎残片；靠场景分别记忆，不强行把各义合成一个意思。

gloss_zh: 说话急促混乱的；小滨鹬

teaching_sense.en_definition: Speaking so rapidly and confusedly that the words are difficult to follow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话速度很快而且条理混乱，以致别人难以听清或跟上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem b'għaġla u b'mod imħawwad, tant li jkun diffiċli tifhmu.

sense_translations.en_definition: speaking in a rapid and confused manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话急促而混乱的；讲话快得让人难以听明白的。
小滨鹬（Calidris minuta），一种鸟。
小滨鹬（Calidris minuta），一种鸟。

collocations.en: a speaker who talks rapidly and confusedly
collocations.zh: 说话急促混乱的发言者

collocations.en: a man who speaks rapidly and confusedly

formal.mt: Il-kelliem kien tertux, u għalhekk il-moderatur talbu jitkellem aktar bil-mod u b'mod aktar ċar.
formal.en: The speaker spoke rapidly and confusedly, so the moderator asked him to speak more slowly and clearly.
formal.zh: 发言者说话急促混乱，因此主持人请他放慢速度，讲得更清楚些。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fhimt x'qal Mark? Lara: Mhux kollox; illum kien tertux wisq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you understand what Mark said? Lara: Not everything; he was speaking far too rapidly and confusedly today.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听懂 Mark 说什么了吗？Lara：没全听懂；他今天说得太急太乱了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你听懂 Mark 说什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand what Mark said?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux kollox; illum kien tertux wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux kollox; illum kien tertux wisq.
messages.zh: 没全听懂；他今天说得太急太乱了。
messages.en: Not everything; he was speaking far too rapidly and confusedly today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把形容词 tertux 配成“话太快、思路乱、听不清”的画面；名词“小滨鹬”另画鸟类词义卡，避免混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 待脱粒的谷堆；腰带或腰巾；祭坛布

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heap of grain awaiting threshing; also a sash, including a traditional waist sash worn by Maltese men, or an altar cloth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一堆等待脱粒的谷物；也可指腰带或腰巾，包括马耳他男子过去佩戴的一种腰巾，另可指祭坛布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munzell ta' qamħ għad-dris; ukoll faxxa li tintlibes mal-qadd, fosthom dik li kienu jilbsu l-irġiel Maltin fl-imgħoddi, jew drapp tal-artal.

sense_translations.en_definition: a heap of grain to be threshed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 待脱粒的谷堆；堆放着准备脱粒的谷物。
腰带；腰巾；作为服饰佩戴的宽布带。
祭坛布；铺在祭坛上的布。

sense_translations.en_definition: a sash, especially a certain kind formerly worn by Maltese men around their waists
sense_translations.zh_definition: 腰巾，尤指马耳他男子过去围在腰间佩戴的某种腰巾。

collocations.en: a heap of grain awaiting threshing

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi terħa li fl-imgħoddi kienet tintlibes mill-irġiel Maltin madwar qaddhom.
formal.en: The museum catalog describes a sash formerly worn by Maltese men around their waists.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录介绍了一种马耳他男子过去围在腰间佩戴的腰巾。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan id-drapp abjad x'inhu? Pawlu: Huwa terħa tal-artal; se nqegħduh fuq l-artal.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this white cloth? Pawlu: It is an altar cloth; we are going to put it on the altar.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这块白布是什么？保罗：这是祭坛布，我们要把它铺在祭坛上。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 这块白布是什么？
messages.en: What is this white cloth?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教堂志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa terħa tal-artal; se nqegħduh fuq l-artal.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa terħa tal-artal; se nqegħduh fuq l-artal.
messages.zh: 这是祭坛布，我们要把它铺在祭坛上。
messages.en: It is an altar cloth; we are going to put it on the altar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 terħa 配三张场景卡：谷场上的谷堆、腰间的布带、祭坛上的布；这些是不同词义，靠语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An examination or trial used to check knowledge, ability, or how well something works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来检查知识、能力或事物运行情况的测验、考试或试验。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami jew prova biex jiġu vverifikati l-għarfien, il-ħila jew kemm taħdem tajjeb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 测验、考试或试验，用于检验知识、能力或效果。
文本；文字内容；文章。
测验；考试。

formal.mt: L-istudenti se jagħmlu test tal-matematika biex l-għalliema tivvaluta kemm fehmu s-suġġett.
formal.en: The students will take a mathematics test so that the teacher can assess how well they have understood the subject.
formal.zh: 学生们将参加一次数学测验，以便老师评估他们对所学内容的理解程度。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandna test għada? Maja: Iva, tal-matematika; ejja nistudjaw flimkien.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do we have a test tomorrow? Maja: Yes, a mathematics test; let's study together.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们明天有测验吗？Maja：有，数学测验；我们一起复习吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我们明天有测验吗？
messages.en: Do we have a test tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 有，数学测验；我们一起复习吧。
messages.en: Yes, a mathematics test; let's study together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 test 先看搭配：数学课堂里通常是“测验”，文学阅读里可以是“文本”；用两张不同场景的卡片区分。

gloss_zh: 折叠；包裹；渴望；感到饥饿

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend something over on itself to make a fold, or to wrap something in a covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西的一部分翻折到另一部分上形成折叠，或用覆盖物将东西包起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilwi parti minn xi ħaġa fuq parti oħra biex jagħmel tinja, jew idawwar xi ħaġa b'għata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 折叠；把纸、布等翻折起来。
包裹；用纸、布等将东西包起来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have a hankering after sth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 渴望某物；很想得到或享用某样东西。
感到饥饿；肚子饿。

formal.mt: L-impjegat tewa l-ittra bir-reqqa u poġġieha f'envelopp qabel bagħatha.
formal.en: The employee carefully folded the letter and put it in an envelope before sending it.
formal.zh: 员工仔细地把信折好，放进信封后寄出。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn qiegħed il-flokk tiegħi? Toni: Mark tewa l-ħwejjeġ kollha u poġġiehom fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is my T-shirt? Toni: Mark folded all the clothes and put them in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我的 T 恤在哪里？Toni：Mark 把所有衣服都叠好放进抽屉了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 我的 T 恤在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my T-shirt?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tewa l-ħwejjeġ kollha u poġġiehom fil-kexxun.
messages.mt_standard: Mark tewa l-ħwejjeġ kollha u poġġiehom fil-kexxun.
messages.zh: Mark 把所有衣服都叠好放进抽屉了。
messages.en: Mark folded all the clothes and put them in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用 tewa l-karta 想象把纸对折，再用叠衣服巩固动作义；“渴望、饥饿”另列词义卡，不自行推导词义来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of repentance or a practice undertaken to express sorrow for wrongdoing, especially in a religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因过错而表示悔悟的行为，或为表达悔意而进行的补赎，尤其用于宗教语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' ndiema jew għemil biex wieħed juri li jiddispjaċih għal dak li għamel ħażin, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忏悔；为表达对罪过或错误的悔意而做的补赎。

collocations.zh: 为罪过而做的忏悔补赎

formal.mt: Wara li għaraf il-ħtija tiegħu, għamel tewba u talab maħfra għal dak li kien għamel.
formal.en: After acknowledging his guilt, he did penance and asked forgiveness for what he had done.
formal.zh: 他承认自己的过错后，做了忏悔补赎，并为自己的行为请求宽恕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titlob maħfra? Mark: Għamilt tewba għal dak li għedt, u rrid nirranġa l-iżball tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you asking for forgiveness? Mark: I have done penance for what I said, and I want to put my mistake right.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么在请求宽恕？Mark：我已经为自己说过的话做了忏悔补赎，也想弥补自己的过错。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在请求宽恕？
messages.en: Why are you asking for forgiveness?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt tewba għal dak li għedt, u rrid nirranġa l-iżball tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt tewba għal dak li għedt, u rrid nirranġa l-iżball tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我已经为自己说过的话做了忏悔补赎，也想弥补自己的过错。
messages.en: I have done penance for what I said, and I want to put my mistake right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tewba 放进“承认过错、表达悔意、采取补赎行动”的场景，连同 għamel tewba 一起记，突出忏悔的行为。

gloss_zh: 双胞胎的；双胞胎中的一个

teaching_sense.en_definition: Born as one of two children from the same pregnancy; twin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指同一次怀孕所生的两个孩子之一的；双胞胎的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li twieled flimkien ma' ħu jew oħt mill-istess tqala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双胞胎的；与另一人同胎出生的。
双胞胎中的一个。

collocations.en: a boy who is a twin

formal.mt: Il-formola titlob lill-ġenitur jindika jekk it-tifel huwiex tewmi.
formal.en: The form asks the parent to indicate whether the boy is a twin.
formal.zh: 表格要求家长注明这个男孩是否为双胞胎之一。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek ħu tewmi? Ben: Iva, imma ma nixbhux ħafna lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a twin brother? Ben: Yes, but we don't look very much alike.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有一个双胞胎兄弟吗？本：有，不过我们长得不太像。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有一个双胞胎兄弟吗？
messages.en: Do you have a twin brother?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma nixbhux ħafna lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma nixbhux ħafna lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 有，不过我们长得不太像。
messages.en: Yes, but we don't look very much alike.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张双胞胎合照，把 tewmi 和“同胎的一个”联系起来；接在 ħu 后面，就记成“双胞胎兄弟”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A band worn around the neck, especially a collar worn by a dog.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在颈部的一圈带状物，尤其指狗戴的项圈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċirku jew faxxa li tintlibes madwar l-għonq, speċjalment ta' kelb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狗戴的项圈。
戴在颈部的圈状物；颈圈或项圈。

formal.mt: Is-sid għandu jiċċekkja li t-tewq tal-kelb ma jkunx issikkat wisq.
formal.en: The owner should check that the dog's collar is not too tight.
formal.zh: 主人应检查狗的项圈是否过紧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu t-tewq tal-kelb? Toni: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn iċ-ċinga.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the dog's collar? Toni: On the table, next to the lead.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：狗的项圈在哪里？托尼：在桌上，牵引绳旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (狗主人)
messages.zh: 狗的项圈在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the dog's collar?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 在桌上，牵引绳旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the lead.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tewq 想成狗脖子上的一圈项圈，再把旁边的牵引绳单独画出来，帮助区分“项圈”和“牵引绳”。

gloss_zh: 使配对；生双胞胎；用蒜调味

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join things in pairs, to give birth to twins, or, in cooking, to season food with garlic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物结成一对；生下双胞胎；在烹饪中也指用大蒜给食物调味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqqad fi tnejn, welled tewmin, jew ta togħma lill-ikel bit-tewm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使结成一对；把两者配对。
生下双胞胎。
用大蒜给食物调味。
加蒜调味。

formal.mt: Il-kok tewwem iz-zalza qabel żiedha mal-għaġin.
formal.en: The cook seasoned the sauce with garlic before adding it to the pasta.
formal.zh: 厨师先给酱汁加蒜调味，再把它加入意面中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min tewwem il-laħam? Mark: Jien; użajt biss sinna tewm waħda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who seasoned the meat with garlic? Mark: I did; I used just one clove of garlic.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁给肉加了蒜？马克：我，只用了一瓣蒜。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 谁给肉加了蒜？
messages.en: Who seasoned the meat with garlic?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; użajt biss sinna tewm waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; użajt biss sinna tewm waħda.
messages.zh: 我，只用了一瓣蒜。
messages.en: I did; I used just one clove of garlic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tewwem 画三幅提示图：物件两两配对、婴儿双胞胎、锅里加蒜。靠语境选义，不把三个意思硬合成一个。

gloss_zh: 被猛掷；被抛出；言语被甩出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown or hurled forcefully; also used of words uttered forcefully, such as insults.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被用力扔出或猛掷；也可指骂语等话语被激烈地甩出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Intefa' b'qawwa; jintuża wkoll għal kliem, bħal insulti, li jingħad b'qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被猛烈地扔出。
fajjar 的中间／被动用法，表示承受猛掷、抛出等动作。
被猛掷；被用力抛出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be thrown about (of words, e.g. swearwords)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指话语被激烈地甩出、肆意说出，例如骂语。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-oġġett tfajjar kontra l-ħajt waqt l-argument.
formal.en: According to the report, the object was hurled against the wall during the argument.
formal.zh: 据报告，该物件在争吵中被猛掷向墙壁。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ġara minn dak il-ktieb? Toni: Tfajjar mal-art waqt il-ġlieda.
colloquial.en: Rita: What happened to that book? Toni: It was hurled to the ground during the fight.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那本书怎么了？托尼：打架时被猛摔到了地上。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 那本书怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to that book?

messages.speaker: Toni (目击者)
messages.zh: 打架时被猛摔到了地上。
messages.en: It was hurled to the ground during the fight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象物件沿着一根粗箭头被猛掷出去，重点记住“承受动作”；换成话语气泡，就联想到被甩出的狠话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young child, whether a boy or a girl; a kid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年幼的孩子，可指小男孩或小女孩；小孩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel jew tifla ta' età żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年幼的男孩或女孩；小孩子。
小孩；孩子。

formal.mt: L-għalliema għenet lil tfajjel isib il-klassi tiegħu fl-ewwel jum tal-iskola.
formal.en: The teacher helped a young child find his classroom on the first day of school.
formal.zh: 开学第一天，老师帮助一个小孩找到了他的教室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak it-tfajjel ħdejn il-bieb? Pawlu: Hu ħija ż-żgħir; qed jistennieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that kid by the door? Pawlu: He's my little brother; he's waiting for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门边那个小孩是谁？保罗：是我弟弟，他在等我。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak it-tfajjel ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak it-tfajjel ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个小孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is that kid by the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孩子的哥哥)
messages.zh: 是我弟弟，他在等我。
messages.en: He's my little brother; he's waiting for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一个背着小书包、站在教室门口的孩子，给画面标上 tfajjel，牢牢记成“小孩”这个人物名词。

gloss_zh: 摆出骄傲姿态；趾高气扬；吹嘘

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave with conspicuous pride, strut, or boast in order to show off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 显得十分骄傲，趾高气扬地行动，或通过吹嘘来炫耀自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġab ruħu bi kburija żejda, mexa b'arja ta' importanza, jew ftaħar biex jimpressjona lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摆出骄傲自大的姿态。
趾高气扬地走动；大摇大摆地行动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to brag, to boast, to show off
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹嘘；夸耀；炫耀自己。

collocations.en: showed off in front of his friends

formal.mt: Wara r-rebħa, il-plejer tfanfar quddiem l-avversarji minflok feraħ lil sħabu.
formal.en: After the victory, the player showed off in front of his opponents instead of congratulating his teammates.
formal.zh: 获胜后，这名球员在对手面前炫耀，而没有向队友表示祝贺。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tfanfar Mark daqshekk? Ben: Rebaħ logħba waħda u diġà jaħseb li hu l-aqwa!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark show off so much? Ben: He won one game and already thinks he's the best!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克刚才怎么那么爱炫耀？本：他才赢了一场，就已经觉得自己最厉害了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克刚才怎么那么爱炫耀？
messages.en: Why did Mark show off so much?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rebaħ logħba waħda u diġà jaħseb li hu l-aqwa!
messages.mt_standard: Rebaħ logħba waħda u diġà jaħseb li hu l-aqwa!
messages.zh: 他才赢了一场，就已经觉得自己最厉害了！
messages.en: He won one game and already thinks he's the best!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人举着奖杯、昂首走动，还不停夸自己；把动作和话语一起记成 tfanfar 的“得意炫耀”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To appear or become visible, or to arrive and be present somewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现、变得可见，或来到某处露面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deher jew sar jidher, jew wasal u deher f'xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来到；露面；出现。
显露出来；出现。

formal.mt: Matul l-analiżi tfaċċa dettall ġdid li jeħtieġ aktar studju.
formal.en: During the analysis, a new detail emerged that requires further study.
formal.zh: 分析过程中出现了一个需要进一步研究的新细节。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tfaċċa Pawlu lbieraħ? Lara: Iva, wasal eżatt qabel l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Pawlu turn up yesterday? Lara: Yes, he arrived just before the meal.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗昨天来了吗？拉拉：来了，刚好在开饭前到。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗昨天来了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu turn up yesterday?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 来了，刚好在开饭前到。
messages.en: Yes, he arrived just before the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本空着的门口突然出现一个人，用 tfaċċa 给这个“从没看见到看见”的瞬间配字幕。

gloss_zh: 口吃；咬舌音；言语发音障碍

teaching_sense.en_definition: Speech marked by stuttering, lisping, or another difficulty in producing speech sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时出现口吃、咬舌音或其他发音困难的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit b'tlaqliq jew b'diffikultà fil-pronunzja ta' ċerti ħsejjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口吃；说话时声音或音节重复、停顿或卡住。
咬舌音；发咝音等声音时出现的特定发音偏差。
说话时存在言语或发音障碍。

collocations.en: stuttering or articulation difficulty in speech
collocations.zh: 言语中的口吃或发音困难

collocations.en: speaks with a stutter or articulation difficulty
collocations.zh: 说话有口吃或发音困难

formal.mt: L-għalliema nnutat tfetfit fid-diskors tat-tifel u tatu ħin biżżejjed biex itemm it-tweġiba.
formal.en: The teacher noticed stuttering in the boy's speech and gave him enough time to finish his answer.
formal.zh: 老师注意到这个男孩说话有口吃，便给了他充分的时间说完答案。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kultant għandi ftit tfetfit meta naqra b'leħen għoli. Nina: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek; qed nisimgħek.
colloquial.en: Marta: Sometimes I stutter a little when I read aloud. Nina: Take your time; I'm listening.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我朗读时有时会有点口吃。妮娜：慢慢来，我在听。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kultant għandi ftit tfetfit meta naqra b'leħen għoli.
messages.mt_standard: Kultant għandi ftit tfetfit meta naqra b'leħen għoli.
messages.zh: 我朗读时有时会有点口吃。
messages.en: Sometimes I stutter a little when I read aloud.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 慢慢来，我在听。
messages.en: Take your time; I'm listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfetfit 放进“朗读时需要多一点时间”的温和场景中记忆；它命名说话的困难，具体是口吃还是发音问题要看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become loose or expand; also, to behave pompously or show off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指东西变松或展开、扩展；用于人的行为时，也可指摆架子、吹嘘或炫耀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir laxk jew jinfirex; jista' wkoll ifisser li wieħed iġib ruħu bil-kburija jew jiftaħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变松；变得不再紧固。
展开；扩展；变得更宽或更大。
摆架子；表现得自大而做作。
吹嘘；炫耀自己拥有的东西或取得的成绩。

collocations.en: a screw that has become loose
he showed off in front of his friends

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li kamin tfettaħ u kellu jerġa' jiġi ssikkat.
formal.en: During the inspection, a screw was found to have become loose and needed to be tightened again.
formal.zh: 检查时发现一颗螺丝变松了，需要重新拧紧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark baqa' jitkellem fuq il-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu? Lara: Tfettaħ ftit quddiem sħabu; ried lil kulħadd jinduna biha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark keep talking about his new car? Lara: He was showing off a little in front of his friends; he wanted everyone to notice it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么一直说他的新车？拉拉：他在朋友面前炫耀了一下，想让大家都注意到那辆车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark baqa' jitkellem fuq il-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark baqa' jitkellem fuq il-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu?
messages.zh: 马克为什么一直说他的新车？
messages.en: Why did Mark keep talking about his new car?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfettaħ ftit quddiem sħabu; ried lil kulħadd jinduna biha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfettaħ ftit quddiem sħabu; ried lil kulħadd jinduna biha.
messages.zh: 他在朋友面前炫耀了一下，想让大家都注意到那辆车。
messages.en: He was showing off a little in front of his friends; he wanted everyone to notice it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记忆：螺丝松开，以及人在朋友面前炫耀；这是帮助区分词义的联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release gas from the stomach through the mouth; to burp or belch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指胃里的气体经口排出，即嗳气、打饱嗝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ arja mill-istonku minn ħalqu, xi drabi b'ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打饱嗝；从口中排出胃里的气体。
嗳气；打出嗝来，常带有声音。
打饱嗝；嗳气，指胃里的气体从口中排出。

collocations.zh: 他吃完饭后打了个饱嗝

formal.mt: Wara li xorob xarba bil-gass, it-tifel tfewwaq u talab skuża.
formal.en: After drinking a fizzy drink, the boy burped and excused himself.
formal.zh: 男孩喝完汽水后打了个饱嗝，并说了声不好意思。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Skużani, għadni kemm tfewwaqt. Maja: Ma jimpurtax; xrobt ix-xarba bil-gass malajr wisq.
colloquial.en: Mark: Excuse me, I just burped. Maja: It's all right; you drank the fizzy drink too quickly.
colloquial.zh: 马克：不好意思，我刚打了个饱嗝。玛雅：没关系，你刚才喝汽水喝得太快了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不好意思，我刚打了个饱嗝。
messages.en: Excuse me, I just burped.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma jimpurtax; xrobt ix-xarba bil-gass malajr wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Ma jimpurtax; xrobt ix-xarba bil-gass malajr wisq.
messages.zh: 没关系，你刚才喝汽水喝得太快了。
messages.en: It's all right; you drank the fizzy drink too quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“喝汽水后，胃里的气从嘴里出来”的画面，记住这里说的是打饱嗝或嗳气。

gloss_zh: 苦苣菜；另有一项释义未明确

teaching_sense.en_definition: Common sow thistle, the plant Sonchus oleraceus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指苦苣菜，学名为 Sonchus oleraceus 的植物；材料中另有一项尚未明确的名词释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Sonchus oleraceus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义未明确：所给材料以“??”标示，无法据此确定这一项的具体词义。
苦苣菜，学名 Sonchus oleraceus。

collocations.en: common sow thistle in the garden

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-ġnien tal-iskola, l-istudenti niżżlu li sabu tfief u kitbu l-isem xjentifiku Sonchus oleraceus.
formal.en: In the school garden report, the students recorded that they had found common sow thistle and wrote down the scientific name Sonchus oleraceus.
formal.zh: 学生们在学校花园报告中记录了发现苦苣菜的情况，并写下学名 Sonchus oleraceus。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Dan tfief; fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Sonchus oleraceus.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called? Pawlu: This is common sow thistle; the label says Sonchus oleraceus.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种植物叫什么？保罗：这是苦苣菜，标签上写着 Sonchus oleraceus。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan tfief; fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Sonchus oleraceus.
messages.mt_standard: Dan tfief; fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Sonchus oleraceus.
messages.zh: 这是苦苣菜，标签上写着 Sonchus oleraceus。
messages.en: This is common sow thistle; the label says Sonchus oleraceus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张植物词卡：正面写 tfief，背面写“苦苣菜”和所给学名；标为问号的义项先保留，不自行补义。

gloss_zh: 被宠坏；受到娇惯；被爱抚；相互依偎

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pampered or become spoiled through indulgence; also, to be caressed or cuddle with another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指受到娇惯、任性要求被满足，因而可能被宠坏；也可指受到爱抚或与他人相互依偎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mħassar billi jaqtgħulu xewqatu; jista' wkoll jirċievi żegħil jew jitgħannaq ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被宠坏；受到过度娇惯。
自己的任性要求得到满足；被人百般迁就。
fissed 的中间被动形式，表示自身受到娇惯、宠爱或爱抚。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be (made) spoilt; to become spoilt; to be pampered
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被惯坏；变得娇纵；受到娇宠或悉心宠爱。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be caressed; to caress one another; to cuddle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到爱抚；相互爱抚；亲昵地拥抱或依偎。

collocations.en: he cuddled in his mother's arms
collocations.zh: 他在母亲怀里亲昵地依偎

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel tfissed iżżejjed għax il-familja kienet taqtagħlu kull xewqa.
formal.en: In the story, the boy was pampered too much because his family granted his every wish.
formal.zh: 故事中的男孩被过分娇惯，因为家人总是满足他的每一个愿望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Ben irid rigal kull darba li noħorġu? Lara: Tfissed iżżejjed; id-dar dejjem jaqtgħulu kull xewqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Ben want a present every time we go out? Lara: He's been spoiled too much; at home they always grant his every wish.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我们每次出门，本都想要礼物？拉拉：他被宠得太厉害了，家里总是对他有求必应。

messages.speaker: Maja (亲属)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Ben irid rigal kull darba li noħorġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Ben irid rigal kull darba li noħorġu?
messages.zh: 为什么我们每次出门，本都想要礼物？
messages.en: Why does Ben want a present every time we go out?

messages.speaker: Lara (亲属)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfissed iżżejjed; id-dar dejjem jaqtgħulu kull xewqa.
messages.mt_standard: Tfissed iżżejjed; id-dar dejjem jaqtgħulu kull xewqa.
messages.zh: 他被宠得太厉害了，家里总是对他有求必应。
messages.en: He's been spoiled too much; at home they always grant his every wish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“被宠”与“被抱”两张画面记忆：前者帮助记住娇惯、宠坏，后者帮助记住爱抚和依偎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act or process of looking for someone, something, or information; also, research into a subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻找人、物品或信息的行动或过程；也可指围绕某一主题进行的研究。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li tfittex persuna, oġġett jew informazzjoni; ukoll riċerka dwar suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寻找；搜索，指设法找到某人、某物或所需信息。
研究；围绕某个主题搜集并探究资料。

formal.mt: It-tfittxija dwar l-istorja tar-raħal kienet tinkludi qari ta' dokumenti u intervisti mar-residenti.
formal.en: The research into the village's history included reading documents and interviewing residents.
formal.zh: 这项关于村庄历史的研究包括阅读文献和访谈居民。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Sibt iċ-ċwievet? Maja: Għadni le; wara tfittxija fil-kċina, issa se nfittex fil-kamra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you find the keys? Maja: Not yet; after a search in the kitchen, I'm going to look in the bedroom now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：找到钥匙了吗？玛雅：还没有，在厨房找了一遍，现在准备去卧室找。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 找到钥匙了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the keys?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le; wara tfittxija fil-kċina, issa se nfittex fil-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le; wara tfittxija fil-kċina, issa se nfittex fil-kamra.
messages.zh: 还没有，在厨房找了一遍，现在准备去卧室找。
messages.en: Not yet; after a search in the kitchen, I'm going to look in the bedroom now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“找钥匙”和“查资料做研究”并排记：两种情境都在寻找所需内容，分别对应搜索义和研究义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The period of a person's life when they are a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人还是孩子时的生命阶段，即童年或儿童时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu tal-ħajja meta persuna tkun għadha tifel jew tifla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 童年；儿童时期，指一个人尚为孩子的那段人生阶段。

formal.mt: Fl-awtobijografija tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi t-tfulija tagħha f'raħal żgħir u l-ewwel snin tal-iskola.
formal.en: In her autobiography, the author describes her childhood in a small village and her first years at school.
formal.zh: 作者在自传中描述了自己在小村庄度过的童年，以及最初几年的学校生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-ritratt ifakkrek fit-tfulija tiegħek? Mark: Iva, konna nilagħbu f'dik il-bitħa kuljum wara l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this photo remind you of your childhood? Mark: Yes, we used to play in that yard every day after school.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张照片让你想起自己的童年了吗？马克：是啊，我们以前每天放学后都在那个院子里玩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张照片让你想起自己的童年了吗？
messages.en: Does this photo remind you of your childhood?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, konna nilagħbu f'dik il-bitħa kuljum wara l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, konna nilagħbu f'dik il-bitħa kuljum wara l-iskola.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们以前每天放学后都在那个院子里玩。
messages.en: Yes, we used to play in that yard every day after school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本装着小时候照片的相册，把 tfulija 写在封面上；这个词指整段童年，而不是某一个孩子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move close to someone or something, often to cuddle, huddle, or snuggle up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人或某物挨近，常指为了亲昵、温暖或舒适而依偎、蜷靠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jersaq qrib persuna jew ħaġa u joqgħod magħfus magħha, spiss għall-faraġ jew għas-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲昵地依偎；贴靠着拥抱。

sense_translations.en_definition: to move close to sb. or sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人或某物挨近；移动到其近旁。
蜷靠；依偎；紧挨着偎过去。

collocations.en: he snuggled up to his mother

formal.mt: Meta beda r-riħ kiesaħ, it-tifel tgeddes ma' ommu u għatta riġlejh bil-kutra.
formal.en: When the cold wind began to blow, the boy snuggled up to his mother and covered his legs with the blanket.
formal.zh: 冷风吹起时，男孩偎到母亲身旁，用毯子盖住双腿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-qattus? Mark: Tgeddes ħdejja fuq is-sufan; ara, qiegħed taħt il-kutra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the cat go? Mark: He snuggled up beside me on the sofa; look, he's under the blanket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫跑到哪里去了？马克：它偎到沙发上的我身旁了；看，就在毯子下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 猫跑到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the cat go?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgeddes ħdejja fuq is-sufan; ara, qiegħed taħt il-kutra.
messages.mt_standard: Tgeddes ħdejja fuq is-sufan; ara, qiegħed taħt il-kutra.
messages.zh: 它偎到沙发上的我身旁了；看，就在毯子下面。
messages.en: He snuggled up beside me on the sofa; look, he's under the blanket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一只猫慢慢挨到你身边、再蜷进毯子的连续画面：先挨近，再依偎，便能串起这些词义。

gloss_zh: 受压迫；克制自己；自我节制

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be oppressed or to restrain oneself by going without something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到压迫，或克制自己的需要与欲望，使自己少享用或放弃某些东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab l-oppressjoni jew jiċċaħħad minn xi ħaġa billi jrażżan ix-xewqat jew il-bżonnijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到压迫或苛待。
使自己放弃或无法享用某种东西；自我剥夺。
għakkes 的中被动态形式，表示自身承受压迫或约束，或对自己施加限制。

sense_translations.en_definition: to restrain oneself; to deprive oneself
sense_translations.zh_definition: 克制自己；使自己少享用或放弃某些东西。

collocations.en: to be oppressed under harsh rule
collocations.zh: 在严酷统治下受到压迫

collocations.en: to go without things in order to save money

formal.mt: Il-poplu tgħakkes għal ħafna snin taħt ħakma ħarxa.
formal.en: The people were oppressed for many years under harsh rule.
formal.zh: 人民在严酷统治下受了多年的压迫。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu qatt ma joħroġ magħna? Rita: Dan l-aħħar tgħakkes ħafna biex ifaddal għal dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does Pawlu never go out with us? Rita: Lately he has been going without a lot to save for a house.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗为什么从不和我们一起出去？丽塔：他最近为了存钱买房，省掉了很多享受。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu qatt ma joħroġ magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu qatt ma joħroġ magħna?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么从不和我们一起出去？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu never go out with us?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-aħħar tgħakkes ħafna biex ifaddal għal dar.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-aħħar tgħakkes ħafna biex ifaddal għal dar.
messages.zh: 他最近为了存钱买房，省掉了很多享受。
messages.en: Lately he has been going without a lot to save for a house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“生活被收紧”的画面记忆：别人施压是受压迫，自己收紧开支则是自我节制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become cunning or crafty in dealing with people or situations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在与人交往或应对事情时变得狡猾、善于耍计谋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir makakk jew juża l-qerq biex jikseb dak li jrid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得像狐狸一样狡猾。
变得狡猾，善于运用计谋。
狐狸。
变得诡计多端、狡黠。

collocations.zh: 随着时间推移而变得狡猾

formal.mt: Il-karattru prinċipali tgħal maż-żmien u beda juża l-qerq biex jikseb dak li ried.
formal.en: The main character became cunning over time and began using deception to get what he wanted.
formal.zh: 主人公逐渐变得狡猾，开始通过欺骗来得到自己想要的东西。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għadu jemmen kull ma jgħidulu? Toni: Le, tgħal! Issa jiċċekkja kollox u ħadd ma jidħaq bih malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does Mark still believe everything people tell him? Toni: No, he has become crafty! Now he checks everything and nobody fools him easily.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克还会相信别人说的每一句话吗？托尼：不会了，他变狡猾了！现在什么都要核实，别人可不容易骗到他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għadu jemmen kull ma jgħidulu?
messages.mt_standard: Mark għadu jemmen kull ma jgħidulu?
messages.zh: 马克还会相信别人说的每一句话吗？
messages.en: Does Mark still believe everything people tell him?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tgħal! Issa jiċċekkja kollox u ħadd ma jidħaq bih malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tgħal! Issa jiċċekkja kollox u ħadd ma jidħaq bih malajr.
messages.zh: 不会了，他变狡猾了！现在什么都要核实，别人可不容易骗到他。
messages.en: No, he has become crafty! Now he checks everything and nobody fools him easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“狐狸”和“变得狡猾”放在两张记忆卡上：动物卡记名词，性格变化卡记动词，注意词性边界。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gain knowledge or a skill through study, practice, or experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过学习、练习或经验获得知识或技能；学会某件事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikseb għarfien jew ħila permezz tal-istudju, tal-prattika jew tal-esperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学习或学会某种知识、内容或技能。
学习；获得知识或掌握技能。

formal.mt: Matul il-kors, l-istudent tgħallem kif jikteb ittra formali bil-Malti.
formal.en: During the course, the student learned how to write a formal letter in Maltese.
formal.zh: 在课程中，这名学生学会了如何用马耳他语写正式信件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif irnexxielu jagħmel dan il-kejk? Ben: Tgħallem minn ommu, u pprattika ħafna.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did he manage to make this cake? Ben: He learned from his mother and practised a lot.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他怎么做出了这个蛋糕？本：他跟妈妈学的，而且练习了很多次。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 他怎么做出了这个蛋糕？
messages.en: How did he manage to make this cake?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħallem minn ommu, u pprattika ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħallem minn ommu, u pprattika ħafna.
messages.zh: 他跟妈妈学的，而且练习了很多次。
messages.en: He learned from his mother and practised a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“先接触，再练习，最后学会”的过程；后面接语言、技能或学习来源，都围绕获得知识。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Food that provides nourishment, including animal feed and cereal grains such as wheat, rice, or oats.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供营养的食物，可指动物饲料，也可指小麦、稻米、燕麦等谷物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel li jagħti n-nutriment, inkluż għalf għall-annimali u ċereali bħall-qamħ, ir-ross jew il-ħafur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供动物食用的饲料。

sense_translations.en_definition: any type of cereal (such as wheat, rice or oats)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何一种谷物，例如小麦、稻米或燕麦。
营养；供给身体养分的食物或滋养物。

collocations.en: a stock of feed or grain

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żamm it-tgħam għall-bhejjem f'maħżen niexef biex ma jitħassarx.
formal.en: The farmer kept the livestock feed in a dry store so that it would not spoil.
formal.zh: 农民把牲畜饲料存放在干燥的仓库里，以免变质。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fadal tgħam għat-tiġieġ? Pawlu: Iva, hemm xkora fil-maħżen.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there any feed left for the chickens? Pawlu: Yes, there is a sack in the store.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：还有喂鸡的饲料吗？保罗：有，仓库里还有一袋。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场主人)
messages.zh: 还有喂鸡的饲料吗？
messages.en: Is there any feed left for the chickens?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场帮手)
messages.zh: 有，仓库里还有一袋。
messages.en: Yes, there is a sack in the store.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仓库里一袋提供养分的粮食：喂牲畜时是饲料，看袋中内容可想到谷物，作用则是滋养。

gloss_zh: 大惊小怪；为小事激动烦躁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a fuss or become worked up about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事大惊小怪、反应过度，或为此变得激动、烦躁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel għaġeb dwar xi ħaġa jew jitħawwad u jinkwieta iżżejjed minħabba fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大惊小怪；对某事表现出过度的激动或不满。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fuss, to get het up
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某事烦躁不安、过分操心；变得激动或恼火。

collocations.en: he made a fuss over nothing
he got worked up over a small matter
collocations.zh: 他为一件小事激动起来

formal.mt: Meta nbidel il-ħin tal-laqgħa b'għaxar minuti, Pawlu tgħaġġeb u beda jilmenta, għalkemm il-bidla ma affettwatx ix-xogħol.
formal.en: When the meeting time changed by ten minutes, Pawlu made a fuss and began complaining, although the change did not affect the work.
formal.zh: 会议时间调整了十分钟，保罗便大惊小怪地抱怨起来，尽管这一调整并未影响工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħaġġibt daqshekk fuq ftit ilma mal-art? Mark: Kont għadni kemm naddaft, imma għandek raġun; mhix ħaġa kbira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you get so worked up over a little water on the floor? Mark: I'd just cleaned, but you're right; it's not a big deal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：地上洒了点水，你怎么就这么激动？马克：我刚打扫完，不过你说得对，也不是什么大事。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħaġġibt daqshekk fuq ftit ilma mal-art?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħaġġibt daqshekk fuq ftit ilma mal-art?
messages.zh: 地上洒了点水，你怎么就这么激动？
messages.en: Why did you get so worked up over a little water on the floor?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont għadni kemm naddaft, imma għandek raġun; mhix ħaġa kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Kont għadni kemm naddaft, imma għandek raġun; mhix ħaġa kbira.
messages.zh: 我刚打扫完，不过你说得对，也不是什么大事。
messages.en: I'd just cleaned, but you're right; it's not a big deal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地上只洒了一点水，有人却急得抱怨不停；用“小事情、大反应”的画面记住所给的大惊小怪义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become lazy or to remain idle instead of making an effort or doing work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得懒惰，或处于懒散、闲着不做事的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir għażżien jew jibqa' bla ma jagħmel xogħol jew sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得懒惰或懒散。
懒惰；闲着不做事。

collocations.en: to become lazy during the holidays

collocations.mt: tgħażżen u ħalla x-xogħol għal wara
collocations.en: to be lazy and leave the work until later
collocations.zh: 因为懒散而把工作拖到以后

formal.mt: Matul il-vaganzi, l-istudent tgħażżen u waqaf jirrevedi l-lezzjonijiet kuljum.
formal.en: During the holidays, the student became lazy and stopped reviewing his lessons every day.
formal.zh: 假期里，这名学生变得懒散，不再每天复习功课。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex għadu ma lestiex kamartu? David: Illum tgħażżen u qatta' l-ħin kollu fuq is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why hasn't he finished tidying his room yet? David: He was lazy today and spent the whole time on the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他怎么还没收拾好房间？戴维：他今天犯懒，一直待在沙发上。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 他怎么还没收拾好房间？
messages.en: Why hasn't he finished tidying his room yet?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum tgħażżen u qatta' l-ħin kollu fuq is-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Illum tgħażżen u qatta' l-ħin kollu fuq is-sufan.
messages.zh: 他今天犯懒，一直待在沙发上。
messages.en: He was lazy today and spent the whole time on the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“待办事项越积越多，人却陷在沙发里”作为记忆画面，同时记住变懒和处于懒散状态两层意思。

gloss_zh: 升起；被抬高；自我抬高；受尊崇

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rise or be raised to a higher position, or to exalt oneself or be exalted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自身升高或被抬到更高的位置；也可指自我抬高，或受到尊崇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitla' jew jittella' għal pożizzjoni ogħla; jista' wkoll ifisser li wieħed jgħolli lilu nnifsu jew jingħata ġieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: għolla 的中被动态形式，表示自身升高或被抬高，也可用于地位、声望等方面。

sense_translations.en_definition: to raise, lift oneself, to be raised, lifted
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自身升起、抬起身子；被升高或抬起。

sense_translations.en_definition: to exalt oneself, to be exalted
sense_translations.zh_definition: 自我抬高、自我尊崇；受到尊崇或被提高地位。

collocations.en: to rise or be raised slightly off the ground
collocations.zh: 稍稍升离地面或被抬离地面

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, il-palk tgħolla ftit mill-art biex il-pubbliku jkun jista' jara aħjar.
formal.en: During the rehearsal, the stage was raised slightly off the ground so that the audience could see better.
formal.zh: 排练时，舞台被稍稍抬离地面，以便观众看得更清楚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-palk kien daqshekk għoli lbieraħ? Mark: Le, illum tgħolla ftit biex kulħadd jara aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was the stage this high yesterday? Mark: No, today it was raised a little so everyone can see better.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天舞台就有这么高吗？马克：没有，今天稍微抬高了一点，让大家都看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (演员)
messages.zh: 昨天舞台就有这么高吗？
messages.en: Was the stage this high yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (舞台工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum tgħolla ftit biex kulħadd jara aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum tgħolla ftit biex kulħadd jara aħjar.
messages.zh: 没有，今天稍微抬高了一点，让大家都看得更清楚。
messages.en: No, today it was raised a little so everyone can see better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象舞台升高，再把同一画面用于人的地位：位置可以被抬高，身份也可以被尊崇。

gloss_zh: 麦秆；稻草；谷类作物的干秆

teaching_sense.en_definition: The dry stalks of cereal plants left after the grain has been removed, often used as bedding for animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谷粒收取后留下的谷类植物干秆，常用来给动物铺垫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iz-zkuk niexfa taċ-ċereali li jibqgħu wara li jitneħħa l-qamħ, u li spiss jintużaw bħala friex għall-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谷类作物去掉谷粒后留下的干秆，如麦秆、稻草。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi firex it-tiben nadif fl-istalla biex l-annimali jkollhom fejn jistrieħu.
formal.en: The farmer spread clean straw in the stable so that the animals would have a place to rest.
formal.zh: 农夫在畜舍里铺上干净的草秆，让动物有地方休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi din il-balla tiben? Pawlu: Poġġiha fil-barn, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall I put this bale of straw? Pawlu: Put it in the barn, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这捆草秆放在哪里？Pawlu：放进谷仓里，靠着门。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 这捆草秆放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put this bale of straw?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.zh: 放进谷仓里，靠着门。
messages.en: Put it in the barn, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收完谷粒后，金黄色的空秆被捆成方块，再铺进畜舍；把这个词和干秆的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 现身；露面；出场这一行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of appearing or making an appearance in a place or before other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某处或他人面前出现、露面或出场这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jidher jew jippreżenta ruħu f'post jew quddiem nies oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of making an appearance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 现身、露面或出场这一行为。
出现于某处或他人面前的行为。

formal.mt: It-tidhir tal-attur fuq il-palk kien qasir, iżda ġibed l-attenzjoni tal-udjenza kollha.
formal.en: The actor's appearance on stage was brief, but it caught the attention of the entire audience.
formal.zh: 这位演员在舞台上露面的时间很短，却吸引了全体观众的注意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ħassejtek waqt l-ewwel tidhir tiegħek fuq il-palk? Mark: Kont nervuż, imma sħabi għenuni nikkalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you feel during your first appearance on stage? Mark: I was nervous, but my friends helped me calm down.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你第一次在舞台上出场时感觉怎么样？Mark：我很紧张，不过朋友们帮我平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek waqt l-ewwel tidhir tiegħek fuq il-palk?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek waqt l-ewwel tidhir tiegħek fuq il-palk?
messages.zh: 你第一次在舞台上出场时感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did you feel during your first appearance on stage?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont nervuż, imma sħabi għenuni nikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Kont nervuż, imma sħabi għenuni nikkalma.
messages.zh: 我很紧张，不过朋友们帮我平静下来了。
messages.en: I was nervous, but my friends helped me calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台幕布拉开，一个人走到灯光下；把这一整个露面动作装进名词框里，帮助记住词性和意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get better in health or condition, or to become good.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 健康或状况有所好转；也指变得好起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħjar fis-saħħa jew fil-qagħda tiegħu, jew isir tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好转，情况或健康有所改善。
变好，变得良好。

formal.mt: Wara ftit jiem ta' mistrieħ, il-pazjent tieb u seta' jerġa' jagħmel l-attivitajiet tiegħu ta' kuljum.
formal.en: After a few days of rest, the patient got better and was able to resume his daily activities.
formal.zh: 休息几天后，病人的情况好转了，能够重新进行日常活动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif inhu missierek illum? Pawlu: Tieb ħafna; dalgħodu anki ħareġ għal mixja qasira.
colloquial.en: Nina: How is your father today? Pawlu: He's much better; this morning he even went out for a short walk.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你爸爸今天怎么样？Pawlu：好多了，今天早上他甚至出门散了一小会儿步。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is your father today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tieb ħafna; dalgħodu anki ħareġ għal mixja qasira.
messages.mt_standard: Tieb ħafna; dalgħodu anki ħareġ għal mixja qasira.
messages.zh: 好多了，今天早上他甚至出门散了一小会儿步。
messages.en: He's much better; this morning he even went out for a short walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条向上的进步箭头：昨天躺着休息，今天能够散步；用前后变化记住好转、变好这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A possessive word indicating that something belongs to or is associated with the one person being addressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物属于正在交谈的一个人，或与这个人有关，即“你的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li turi li xi ħaġa tappartjeni jew għandha x'taqsam mal-persuna waħda li qed inkellmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你的；表示与一个受话人有关或归其所有。
你的；属于你的，所有者为一个受话人。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ikteb l-isem tiegħek fil-parti ta' fuq tal-formola.
formal.en: Please write your name at the top of the form.
formal.zh: 请在表格上方填写你的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-ktieb tiegħek? Mark: Iva, tiegħi. Grazzi talli sibthuli!
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this book yours? Mark: Yes, it's mine. Thanks for finding it for me!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这本书是你的吗？马克：是的，是我的。谢谢你帮我找到它！

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this book yours?

messages.speaker: Mark (书的主人)
messages.zh: 是的，是我的。谢谢你帮我找到它！
messages.en: Yes, it's mine. Thanks for finding it for me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你把书递给面前的一个人，说 il-ktieb tiegħek。把“指向对方”的动作和“你的”绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try food or drink in order to perceive its taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尝试食物或饮料，以感知它的味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iduq ikel jew xorb biex jagħraf it-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 品尝；尝一尝食物或饮料。
尝出或感知食物、饮料的味道。

formal.mt: Il-kok tiegħem is-soppa qabel ma servieha biex jiċċekkja jekk kellhiex bżonn aktar melħ.
formal.en: The cook tasted the soup before serving it to check whether it needed more salt.
formal.zh: 厨师上汤前尝了味道，检查是否需要再加盐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min tiegħem is-soppa? Ben: Missieri. Qal li għandha bżonn ftit melħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who tasted the soup? Ben: My father. He said it needs a little salt.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁尝过这汤了？本：我爸爸。他说还需要加一点盐。

messages.speaker: Lara (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 谁尝过这汤了？
messages.en: Who tasted the soup?

messages.speaker: Ben (帮忙的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri. Qal li għandha bżonn ftit melħ.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri. Qal li għandha bżonn ftit melħ.
messages.zh: 我爸爸。他说还需要加一点盐。
messages.en: My father. He said it needs a little salt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tiegħem 时，想象厨师舀起一小勺汤，尝完才决定是否加盐，用“尝味再判断”的动作帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something belonging to or associated with the speaker, expressed as 'mine'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指属于说话者或与说话者有关的事物，相当于“我的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika xi ħaġa li tappartjeni jew għandha x'taqsam mal-persuna li qed titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我的；属于我的东西，可独立指代前文提到的事物。
我的；表示归说话者所有或与说话者有关。
我的；用于限定名词，说明事物属于说话者或与说话者有关。

formal.mt: Fl-opinjoni tiegħi, il-proposta għandha tiġi diskussa fil-laqgħa li jmiss.
formal.en: In my opinion, the proposal should be discussed at the next meeting.
formal.zh: 我认为，应在下次会议上讨论这项提案。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-borża ta' min hi? Nina: Tiegħi! Ħallejtha hemm dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Whose bag is this? Nina: Mine! I left it there this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个包是谁的？妮娜：我的！我今天早上把它放在那里了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这个包是谁的？
messages.en: Whose bag is this?

messages.speaker: Nina (包的主人)
messages.zh: 我的！我今天早上把它放在那里了。
messages.en: Mine! I left it there this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手放在自己胸前，再指向自己的包，说 tiegħi。用“指自己”的动作记住“我的”，再练 il-borża tiegħi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something belonging to or associated with a male person or a thing already mentioned, expressed as 'his' or 'its'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指属于某个男性或前文提到的事物，或与其有关的东西，即“他的”或“它的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika xi ħaġa li tappartjeni jew għandha x'taqsam ma' raġel jew ma' ħaġa msemmija qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他的；指属于某个男性的事物。
它的；指属于前文所说事物或与其有关的东西。
他的；用于限定名词，表示事物属于某个男性或与他有关。

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jikteb l-isem tiegħu fuq l-ewwel paġna tar-rapport.
formal.en: Each student should write his name on the first page of the report.
formal.zh: 每名学生应在报告首页写上自己的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-ktieb ta' Mark? Luqa: Iva, tiegħu. Ġej jiġbru aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this Mark's book? Luqa: Yes, it's his. He's coming to collect it later.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这是马克的书吗？卢卡：是的，是他的。他晚点会来拿。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 这是马克的书吗？
messages.en: Is this Mark's book?

messages.speaker: Luqa (马克的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tiegħu. Ġej jiġbru aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tiegħu. Ġej jiġbru aktar tard.
messages.zh: 是的，是他的。他晚点会来拿。
messages.en: Yes, it's his. He's coming to collect it later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马克离开后，你指着他的书说 tiegħu；再想象狗抱着它的球。用两个归属场景记住“他的、它的”。

gloss_zh: 使人产生希望；鼓起希望

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone hope or make someone feel more hopeful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人带来希望，使其对情况或未来更有信心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti tama lil xi ħadd jew iqajjem fih aktar tama għall-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人怀有希望；用言语或行动给予希望。
唤起或增强希望；使人产生更积极的期待。

formal.mt: Il-messaġġ tad-direttur tiekel lill-ħaddiema u tahom fiduċja fil-futur tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The director's message raised the workers' hopes and gave them confidence in the company's future.
formal.zh: 主管的讲话使工人们燃起希望，并对公司的未来有了信心。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-kliem tat-tabib tiekel lil missierek? Toni: Iva, issa għandu aktar tama u jħossu aħjar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the doctor's words give your father hope? Toni: Yes, he has more hope now and feels better.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：医生的话给你爸爸带来希望了吗？托尼：是的，他现在更有希望了，感觉也好些了。

messages.speaker: Rita (关心家人的朋友)
messages.zh: 医生的话给你爸爸带来希望了吗？
messages.en: Did the doctor's words give your father hope?

messages.speaker: Toni (病人的儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandu aktar tama u jħossu aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandu aktar tama u jħossu aħjar.
messages.zh: 是的，他现在更有希望了，感觉也好些了。
messages.en: Yes, he has more hope now and feels better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本条把 tiekel 记成一个动作：一句鼓励让垂头的人抬起头。把“给予希望”的前后变化画面与词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of hope or optimism that something good will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 期待好事发生的希望，或对未来持积极态度的乐观心情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' tama jew ottimiżmu li se jiġri xi ħaġa tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；期待愿望实现或情况好转的心情。
乐观；相信未来会出现良好结果的积极态度。

formal.mt: Minkejja d-diffikultajiet, it-tim żamm it-tiekla u kompla jaħdem biex jilħaq l-għan tiegħu.
formal.en: Despite the difficulties, the team maintained its hope and continued working to achieve its goal.
formal.zh: 尽管困难重重，团队仍保持希望，继续努力实现目标。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Kif qed tħossok wara l-laqgħa? David: Għandi tiekla ġdida. Naħseb li nistgħu nsibu soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Ella: How are you feeling after the meeting? David: I have renewed hope. I think we can find a solution.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：开完会后你感觉怎么样？戴维：我又有希望了。我觉得我们能找到解决办法。

messages.speaker: Ella (同事)
messages.zh: 开完会后你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling after the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (项目成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tiekla ġdida. Naħseb li nistgħu nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tiekla ġdida. Naħseb li nistgħu nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 我又有希望了。我觉得我们能找到解决办法。
messages.en: I have renewed hope. I think we can find a solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tiekla 想成心里亮着的一盏灯：遇到困难仍期待好结果。用“心里的希望和乐观”记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ceremony or celebration at which two people get married.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个人结婚时举行的仪式或庆祝活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċerimonja jew festa li fiha żewġ persuni jiżżewġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婚礼；结婚仪式及相关庆祝活动。

formal.mt: It-tieġ se jsir nhar is-Sibt, u l-mistednin huma mitluba jaslu nofs siegħa qabel iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The wedding will take place on Saturday, and guests are asked to arrive half an hour before the ceremony.
formal.zh: 婚礼将于星期六举行，请宾客在仪式开始前半小时到场。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Se tiġi għat-tieġ ta' oħti? Pawlu: Iva! Diġà rċevejt l-istedina.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are you coming to my sister's wedding? Pawlu: Yes! I've already received the invitation.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你会来参加我姐姐的婚礼吗？保罗：会！我已经收到请柬了。

messages.speaker: Marta (新娘的妹妹)
messages.zh: 你会来参加我姐姐的婚礼吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to my sister's wedding?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 会！我已经收到请柬了。
messages.en: Yes! I've already received the invitation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tieġ 放进“收到请柬、参加婚礼”的画面里，连着记 stedina għat-tieġ，就能把词和具体场景联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Words or expressions of approval and admiration, including praise offered to God.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达认可、欣赏或敬意的话语，也可指对上帝的赞美和颂扬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li jesprimi approvazzjoni jew ammirazzjoni, inkluż kliem li bih infaħħru lil Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞扬；称赞，表达认可或欣赏。
对上帝的赞美、颂扬或荣耀。

collocations.en: a song of praise to God

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-għalliema esprimiet tifħir għall-isforz u l-progress tal-istudenti.
formal.en: In her report, the teacher expressed praise for the students' effort and progress.
formal.zh: 老师在报告中赞扬了学生们的努力和进步。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-għalliema kellha kliem ta' tifħir għax-xogħol tiegħek! Adam: Tassew? Ħdimt ħafna fuqu, u ferħan li għoġobha.
colloquial.en: Maja: The teacher had words of praise for your work! Adam: Really? I worked hard on it, and I'm glad she liked it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老师夸奖你的作业了！亚当：真的吗？我在上面下了很多功夫，她喜欢我很高兴。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliema kellha kliem ta' tifħir għax-xogħol tiegħek!
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliema kellha kliem ta' tifħir għax-xogħol tiegħek!
messages.zh: 老师夸奖你的作业了！
messages.en: The teacher had words of praise for your work!

messages.speaker: Adam (完成作业的学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tassew? Ħdimt ħafna fuqu, u ferħan li għoġobha.
messages.mt_standard: Tassew? Ħdimt ħafna fuqu, u ferħan li għoġobha.
messages.zh: 真的吗？我在上面下了很多功夫，她喜欢我很高兴。
messages.en: Really? I worked hard on it, and I'm glad she liked it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tifħir 和“老师夸奖、众人赞美”的声音联系起来；再配上赞美上帝的歌曲，记住日常称赞与宗教颂赞两个场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large wild cat with a striped coat; the word can also refer specifically to a female tiger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身上有条纹的大型野生猫科动物，指老虎，也可专指雌虎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ kbir tal-familja tal-qtates, bil-pil bl-istrixxi; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għan-nagħġa tat-tigri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 老虎。
老虎；雌虎。

formal.mt: It-tigra għandha strixxi fuq il-pil li jgħinuha tinħeba qalb il-veġetazzjoni.
formal.en: The tiger has stripes on its coat that help it hide among vegetation.
formal.zh: 老虎皮毛上的条纹有助于它藏身于植被之间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara t-tigra f'dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Iva, imma għall-ewwel ma rajthiex qalb is-siġar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the tiger in this photo? Mark: Yes, but at first I didn't spot it among the trees.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见这张照片里的老虎了吗？马克：看见了，不过一开始我没发现它藏在树木之间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见这张照片里的老虎了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the tiger in this photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għall-ewwel ma rajthiex qalb is-siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għall-ewwel ma rajthiex qalb is-siġar.
messages.zh: 看见了，不过一开始我没发现它藏在树木之间。
messages.en: Yes, but at first I didn't spot it among the trees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tigra 和照片中带条纹的老虎一起记；它也可以专指雌虎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small dot, spot, or speck; also a very small amount of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个小点、小斑点或微粒，也可表示某物极少的量，即一点儿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Punt, tebgħa jew partiċella żgħira ħafna; ukoll ammont żgħir ħafna ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小圆点；点。
点；一个很小的点状位置或标记。
微粒；极小的一点。
小斑点；小污点。
点；小圆点；小斑点。
一点儿；少许。

formal.mt: Fuq il-mappa, tikka ħamra tindika fejn jinsab il-mużew.
formal.en: On the map, a red dot indicates where the museum is located.
formal.zh: 地图上的一个红点标出了博物馆的位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid aktar melħ fis-soppa? Pawlu: Iva, imma tikka biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like more salt in the soup? Pawlu: Yes, but just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：汤里要再加些盐吗？保罗：要，但请只加一点儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 汤里要再加些盐吗？
messages.en: Would you like more salt in the soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma tikka biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma tikka biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，但请只加一点儿。
messages.en: Yes, but just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想纸上的一个小点，再想一点儿盐：用“小”把 tikka 的形状义和数量义连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wrinkles or creases in skin, cloth, or another surface, or the process of forming them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤、布料或其他表面上的皱纹、褶皱，也可指形成这些皱褶的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-marki u t-tinjiet li jidhru fil-ġilda, fid-drapp jew fuq wiċċ ieħor, u għall-proċess li bih jiffurmaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 褶痕；折皱。
皱纹；皱褶。
起皱；形成皱纹或皱褶的过程。
形成褶痕；起折皱的过程。
皱纹；一道或多道皱褶。

formal.mt: Biex tnaqqas it-tikmix fid-drapp, segwi l-istruzzjonijiet tal-ħasil fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: To reduce wrinkling in the fabric, follow the washing instructions on the label.
formal.zh: 为减少布料起皱，请遵照标签上的洗涤说明。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-qmis għandha ħafna tikmix. David: Għaddiha bil-ħadida qabel tilbesha.
colloquial.en: Marija: This shirt has lots of creases. David: Iron it before you put it on.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这件衬衫有好多褶皱。戴维：穿之前先熨一下。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 这件衬衫有好多褶皱。
messages.en: This shirt has lots of creases.

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 穿之前先熨一下。
messages.en: Iron it before you put it on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tikmix 配上两幅图：脸上的皱纹和衬衫上的褶皱，都是表面不再平整。

gloss_zh: 涂清漆；画布；布料；亚麻布

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply varnish to a surface, for example to protect or finish wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面涂清漆，例如给木材上清漆以保护或修饰表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti saff verniċ lil wiċċ, pereżempju lill-injam, biex tipproteġih jew tagħtih dehra lesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂清漆；给物体表面上清漆。
画布；尤指绘画使用的帆布。
布；布料；亚麻布。
涂清漆；上清漆。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudax tila l-mejda b'verniċ trasparenti biex jipproteġi l-wiċċ tal-injam.
formal.en: The carpenter varnished the table with clear varnish to protect the wooden surface.
formal.zh: 木匠给桌子涂了透明清漆，以保护木质表面。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Missierek tila l-mejda diġà? Luqa: Iva, imma l-verniċ għadu ma nixifx.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has your father varnished the table yet? Luqa: Yes, but the varnish hasn't dried yet.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你爸爸给桌子上清漆了吗？卢卡：上了，不过清漆还没干。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸给桌子上清漆了吗？
messages.en: Has your father varnished the table yet?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-verniċ għadu ma nixifx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-verniċ għadu ma nixifx.
messages.zh: 上了，不过清漆还没干。
messages.en: Yes, but the varnish hasn't dried yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tila 分设两张词性卡：动作卡写“涂清漆”，物品卡写“画布、布料”，按句子判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tray used to carry or serve things; in other contexts, a frame or a casement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于端放或盛放物品的托盘；在其他语境中也可指框架或窗框。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett ċatt li jintuża biex iġġorr jew isservi affarijiet; f'kuntesti oħra jista' jfisser qafas jew il-qafas ta' tieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 托盘；用于盛放或端送物品的盘。
框；框架。
窗框；窗扇框架。

formal.mt: Il-wejter poġġa t-tazzi fuq it-tilar u ġarrhom lejn il-mejda tal-klijenti.
formal.en: The waiter placed the cups on the tray and carried them to the customers' table.
formal.zh: 服务员把杯子放在托盘上，端到了顾客的桌边。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tista' tgħaddili t-tilar, jekk jogħġbok? Toni: Ħu, qiegħed ħdejn it-tazzi.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you pass me the tray, please? Toni: Here you go; it's next to the cups.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：请把托盘递给我，好吗？托尼：给你，就在杯子旁边。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 请把托盘递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the tray, please?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 给你，就在杯子旁边。
messages.en: Here you go; it's next to the cups.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tilar 时先想端杯子的托盘；遇到窗户语境，再切换到“窗框”这张画面。

gloss_zh: 丢失；失去；错过；输掉；看不见

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose something, fail to catch or take an opportunity, or be defeated in a game or contest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丢失或失去某物，错过交通工具或机会，或在比赛中输掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma tibqax issib jew ikollok xi ħaġa, ma tilħaqx mezz ta' trasport jew opportunità, jew ma tirbaħx logħba jew kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丢失；失去。
错过，例如错过一次机会。
失去；不再拥有。
输掉比赛、游戏等。

sense_translations.en_definition: to miss, to be late for
sense_translations.zh_definition: 错过；因迟到而未能赶上。
看不见；失去对某人或某物的视线。

formal.mt: L-istudent tilef l-opportunità li japplika għall-borża ta' studju għax ma bagħatx il-formola fil-ħin.
formal.en: The student missed the opportunity to apply for the scholarship because he did not send the form on time.
formal.zh: 这名学生没有按时提交表格，因此错过了申请奖学金的机会。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex wasalt tard? Elena: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja u kelli nistenna oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you arrive late? Elena: I missed the bus and had to wait for another one.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么迟到了？埃莱娜：我没赶上公共汽车，只好等下一辆。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja u kelli nistenna oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Tlift il-karozza tal-linja u kelli nistenna oħra.
messages.zh: 我没赶上公共汽车，只好等下一辆。
messages.en: I missed the bus and had to wait for another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张场景卡记 tilef：钥匙丢了、机会错过、公交没赶上、比赛输了；逐个搭配练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Vaccination; also the grafting of plants or the act of giving nicknames, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疫苗接种；根据语境，也可指植物嫁接或给人起绰号的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' vaċċin; skont il-kuntest, ukoll it-twaħħil ta' parti minn pjanta ma' oħra biex tikber magħha, jew l-għoti ta' laqmijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嫁接；把植物的一部分接到另一株植物上的操作。
疫苗接种；接种疫苗。
起绰号；给人取外号的行为。
动词 laqqam 的动名词，表示该动词所指的行为或过程；具体含义依语境确定。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett tal-klinika jispjega l-programm ta' tilqim u kif wieħed jista' jagħmel appuntament.
formal.en: The clinic's leaflet explains the vaccination programme and how to make an appointment.
formal.zh: 诊所的宣传单介绍了疫苗接种计划及预约方法。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek appuntament għat-tilqim għada? Ġanni: Iva, fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu fil-klinika.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have a vaccination appointment tomorrow? Ġanni: Yes, at ten in the morning at the clinic.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你约了明天接种疫苗吗？詹尼：是的，上午十点，在诊所。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 你约了明天接种疫苗吗？
messages.en: Do you have a vaccination appointment tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.zh: 是的，上午十点，在诊所。
messages.en: Yes, at ten in the morning at the clinic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tilqim 配三个语境标签：诊所里是接种，园艺中是嫁接，称呼话题中可能是起绰号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A portable shelter made of fabric supported by poles, used for camping or other temporary accommodation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由杆架支撑布料搭成的便携式遮蔽物，用于露营或其他临时住宿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kenn li jista' jinġarr, magħmul minn drapp miżmum b'arbli, użat għall-ikkampjar jew għal akkomodazzjoni temporanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帐篷；以杆架支撑布料搭成的临时遮蔽或住宿设施。

formal.mt: Il-grupp tella' tinda fil-post magħżul għall-ikkampjar u poġġa l-basktijiet ġewwa.
formal.en: The group put up a tent in the designated camping area and placed the bags inside.
formal.zh: 小组在指定露营区搭起了一顶帐篷，并把包放了进去。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se norqdu llejla? Adam: Fit-tinda; diġà tellajtha ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are we sleeping tonight? Adam: In the tent; I've already put it up next to the tree.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们今晚睡在哪里？亚当：睡帐篷里；我已经把它搭在树旁了。

messages.speaker: Nina (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 我们今晚睡在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we sleeping tonight?

messages.speaker: Adam (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 睡帐篷里；我已经把它搭在树旁了。
messages.en: In the tent; I've already put it up next to the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tinda 想成露营时的小布屋：先搭起帐篷，再钻进帐篷睡觉，连成一段画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of finding or discovering something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 找到或发现某个人、事物或信息的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li ssib jew tiskopri lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现；发现某事物这件事。
寻找后找到、发现的行为或过程。

formal.mt: It-tisjib ta' dokumenti ġodda għen lir-riċerkaturi jifhmu aħjar is-suġġett.
formal.en: The discovery of new documents helped the researchers understand the subject better.
formal.zh: 新文件的发现帮助研究人员更好地理解了这一课题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'tisjib'? Mark: Ifisser li ssib xi ħaġa; pereżempju, it-tisjib taċ-ċwievet li tlift.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tisjib' mean? Mark: It means finding something; for example, finding the keys you lost.
colloquial.zh: Maja：tisjib 是什么意思？Mark：就是找到某样东西，比如找到你丢失的钥匙。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: tisjib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tisjib' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ssib xi ħaġa; pereżempju, it-tisjib taċ-ċwievet li tlift.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ssib xi ħaġa; pereżempju, it-tisjib taċ-ċwievet li tlift.
messages.zh: 就是找到某样东西，比如找到你丢失的钥匙。
messages.en: It means finding something; for example, finding the keys you lost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象丢失的钥匙终于被找到，把 tisjib 和“发现、找到这件事”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 信贷；借出钱款；债权状态；动物以后腿站起

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lending of money with the expectation that it will be paid back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱借给他人并预期对方偿还的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' flus b'self lil xi ħadd bil-ħsieb li jitħallsu lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信贷；允许借款或延期付款的信用安排。
借出钱款；向他人提供金钱借贷。

sense_translations.en_definition: rearing of an animal on its hind legs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物抬起前身、用后腿站立的动作。
动词 siel 的动作名词；具体动作含义须结合语境判断。
别人欠自己钱的状态；处于债权人地位。

collocations.zh: 马抬起前身以后腿站立

formal.mt: Il-ftehim dwar it-tisjil tal-flus jindika l-ammont u d-data meta għandhom jitħallsu lura.
formal.en: The agreement concerning the lending of the money states the amount and the date on which it must be repaid.
formal.zh: 这份借款协议注明了金额及应当偿还的日期。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Dawn il-flus huma rigal? Pawlu: Le, dan hu tisjil ta' flus; tħallashomli lura x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is this money a gift? Pawlu: No, this is a loan; you'll pay me back next month.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这些钱是送给我的吗？Pawlu：不是，这是借款；你下个月还给我。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些钱是送给我的吗？
messages.en: Is this money a gift?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu tisjil ta' flus; tħallashomli lura x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu tisjil ta' flus; tħallashomli lura x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 不是，这是借款；你下个月还给我。
messages.en: No, this is a loan; you'll pay me back next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两幅画：借钱后等待归还，以及马抬起前腿站立；同一词的不同义项不要混成一个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spoken or written expression used to greet someone or convey good wishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 见面或通信时向他人打招呼、表达关怀或传达祝愿的话语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li jingħad jew jinkiteb biex issellem lil xi ħadd jew twassallu xewqat tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 问候；见面或联系时说的招呼。
问候与致意，常指托人转达或在信件中表达的心意。
致意语；用于开场、见面或书信中的问候表达。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, id-direttur bagħat tislija mill-qalb lill-istudenti l-ġodda.
formal.en: In his letter, the director sent a heartfelt greeting to the new students.
formal.zh: 主任在信中向新生致以真诚的问候。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tara lil ommok illum? Mark: Iva, wara x-xogħol. Sara: Agħtiha tislija mingħandi!
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you seeing your mother today? Mark: Yes, after work. Sara: Give her my regards!
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天会见到你妈妈吗？Mark：会，下班后见。Sara：替我向她问好！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天会见到你妈妈吗？
messages.en: Are you seeing your mother today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，下班后见。
messages.en: Yes, after work.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 替我向她问好！
messages.en: Give her my regards!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tislija 放进“替我向她问好”的场景：送出去的是一句问候，也是一份致意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making a blade, edge, or point sharper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使刀刃、边缘或尖端变得锋利的加工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xafra, tarf jew ponta jsiru aktar jaqtgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨利；把刀刃、工具边缘或尖端磨得更锋利。

formal.mt: It-tisnin regolari tas-skieken jgħin biex ix-xfafar jibqgħu jaqtgħu sew.
formal.en: Regular knife sharpening helps keep the blades sharp.
formal.zh: 定期磨刀有助于保持刀刃锋利。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew. Toni: Għandha bżonn it-tisnin; ġib il-ġebla u nieħu ħsiebha.
colloquial.en: Maja: This knife doesn't cut well. Toni: It needs sharpening; bring the stone and I'll take care of it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这把刀不好切了。Toni：需要磨一磨；把磨刀石拿来，我来处理。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 这把刀不好切了。
messages.en: This knife doesn't cut well.

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha bżonn it-tisnin; ġib il-ġebla u nieħu ħsiebha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha bżonn it-tisnin; ġib il-ġebla u nieħu ħsiebha.
messages.zh: 需要磨一磨；把磨刀石拿来，我来处理。
messages.en: It needs sharpening; bring the stone and I'll take care of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钝刀在磨刀石上来回磨，最后切得利落；tisnin 记的是“磨利的过程”。

gloss_zh: 标题；书名；头衔；所有权依据

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name given to a book, article, film, or other work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 书籍、文章、电影或其他作品所使用的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem mogħti lil ktieb, artiklu, film jew xogħol ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标题、名称或头衔；具体所指依语境确定。
书名、篇名等作品的标题或名称。

sense_translations.en_definition: title (prefix or suffix added to a name)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加在人名前或人名后的头衔、称号或称谓。
所有权权利；据以主张拥有某项财产的资格或权利依据。

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tar-reċensjoni, l-awtriċi ssemmi t-titlu tal-ktieb u l-isem tal-kittieb.
formal.en: At the beginning of the review, the author mentions the book's title and the writer's name.
formal.zh: 在书评开头，作者提到了这本书的书名和作家的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu t-titlu tal-ktieb li qed taqra? Pawlu: 'Il-Vjaġġ'; trid tara l-qoxra?
colloquial.en: Lina: What's the title of the book you're reading? Pawlu: 'The Journey'; would you like to see the cover?
colloquial.zh: Lina：你正在读的书叫什么名字？Pawlu：《旅程》；你想看看封面吗？

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu t-titlu tal-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu t-titlu tal-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你正在读的书叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's the title of the book you're reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 《旅程》；你想看看封面吗？
messages.en: 'The Journey'; would you like to see the cover?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个位置记 titlu：封面上是书名，人名旁是头衔，财产语境中是所有权。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of forcing someone to leave a country or place as a punishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以惩罚等方式迫使某人离开国家或某个地方的行为，即放逐。
