teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlaq minn pajjiż jew post bħala kastig.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放逐；驱逐某人，使其离开某地。
使人或事物暴露于危险；置于险境。
动词 tarraf 的动作名词；具体动作含义须结合语境判断。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-titrif mill-pajjiż jifred lill-protagonist mill-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, banishment from the country separates the protagonist from his family.
formal.zh: 在故事中，被放逐出国使主人公与家人分离。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-protagonist ma jistax imur lura d-dar? Mark: Minħabba t-titrif mill-pajjiż; ma jħalluhx jidħol lura.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't the protagonist go home? Mark: Because of his banishment from the country; they won't let him back in.
colloquial.zh: Sara：主人公为什么不能回家？Mark：因为他被放逐出国了；他们不让他回来。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-protagonist ma jistax imur lura d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-protagonist ma jistax imur lura d-dar?
messages.zh: 主人公为什么不能回家？
messages.en: Why can't the protagonist go home?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-titrif mill-pajjiż; ma jħalluhx jidħol lura.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-titrif mill-pajjiż; ma jħalluhx jidħol lura.
messages.zh: 因为他被放逐出国了；他们不让他回来。
messages.en: Because of his banishment from the country; they won't let him back in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张场景卡分别记：被迫离乡是“放逐”，被置于险境是“暴露于危险”；不要把两个义项等同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or effect of making someone unable to hear, especially through very loud noise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人听不见或听觉受到影响的行为或效果，尤其指强烈噪声造成的震聋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-effett li bih xi ħadd ma jibqax jisma', speċjalment minħabba storbju qawwi ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 震聋；使人听不见或使听觉受到强烈影响。

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma 'titrix' tiddeskrivi l-effett tal-istorbju qawwi ħafna fuq is-smigħ tal-karattru.
formal.en: In the text, the word 'titrix' describes the effect of extremely loud noise on the character's hearing.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，titrix 一词描述了极强噪声对人物听觉造成的震聋效果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'titrix' f'din is-sentenza? Toni: L-istorbju tant kien qawwi li l-karattru ma setax jisma' sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'titrix' mean in this sentence? Toni: The noise was so loud that the character couldn't hear properly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个句子里的 titrix 是什么意思？Toni：噪声大到使这个人物听不清了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 titrix 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'titrix' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istorbju tant kien qawwi li l-karattru ma setax jisma' sew.
messages.mt_standard: L-istorbju tant kien qawwi li l-karattru ma setax jisma' sew.
messages.zh: 噪声大到使这个人物听不清了。
messages.en: The noise was so loud that the character couldn't hear properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一声巨响后双耳听不清，把 titrix 记成“震聋这一作用”，并注意它是名词。

gloss_zh: 显现；向外探望；变硬；失去新鲜度

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of coming into view or looking out from a place such as a window.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现于视野中，或从窗户等位置向外探望的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tidher jew li tħares 'il barra minn post bħal tieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现；显露；进入视野。

sense_translations.en_definition: looking out of or over sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从某处向外探望，或越过某物向外观看。
动词 xarraf 的动作名词；具体动作含义须结合语境判断。
变硬；硬化的过程。
失去新鲜度；变得不新鲜。

formal.mt: It-tixrif mit-tieqa ppermetta lit-tifel jara l-purċissjoni għaddejja fit-triq.
formal.en: Looking out of the window allowed the boy to see the procession passing along the street.
formal.zh: 男孩从窗户向外探望，得以看见游行队伍经过街道。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex dan il-ħobż sar iebes? Pawlu: Dan hu t-tixrif tal-ħobż; m'għadux frisk bħal meta xtrajnieh.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why has this bread gone hard? Pawlu: That's the bread going stale; it isn't as fresh as when we bought it.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这面包为什么变硬了？Pawlu：这是面包变陈了；已经没有刚买时那么新鲜。

messages.speaker: Lina (家人)
messages.zh: 这面包为什么变硬了？
messages.en: Why has this bread gone hard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu t-tixrif tal-ħobż; m'għadux frisk bħal meta xtrajnieh.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu t-tixrif tal-ħobż; m'għadux frisk bħal meta xtrajnieh.
messages.zh: 这是面包变陈了；已经没有刚买时那么新鲜。
messages.en: That's the bread going stale; it isn't as fresh as when we bought it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义分成两组画面记忆：窗边显现或向外探望，以及面包变硬变陈；这是记忆分组，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To improve in an ability, condition, or quality; to become better or good.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在能力、状况或品质方面有所改善，变得更好或达到良好状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħjar f'ħila, f'qagħda jew fi kwalità, jew isir tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某事上进步；更擅长某事。
变好；变得良好。

formal.mt: Wara xahar ta' taħriġ regolari, l-istudent tjieb ħafna fil-qari.
formal.en: After a month of regular practice, the student improved a lot at reading.
formal.zh: 经过一个月的规律练习，这名学生的阅读能力有了很大进步。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sejjer ħuk fil-qari? Pawlu: Tjieb ħafna; issa jaqra ktieb waħdu.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is your brother doing with reading? Pawlu: He has improved a lot; now he reads a book on his own.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你弟弟阅读学得怎么样？保罗：进步很大；现在他能自己读一本书了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟阅读学得怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother doing with reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Tjieb ħafna; issa jaqra ktieb waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Tjieb ħafna; issa jaqra ktieb waħdu.
messages.zh: 进步很大；现在他能自己读一本书了。
messages.en: He has improved a lot; now he reads a book on his own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tjieb 连同“练习后读得更好”的画面记忆，重点记住从原有状态向好变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being good or kind, especially in the way a person treats others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 善良或仁慈的品质，尤其指待人友善、体谅并愿意帮助别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min hu tajjeb jew qalbu tajba, speċjalment fil-mod kif jittratta lill-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 善；善良或美好的品质。
仁慈；待人的善意与体贴。

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera wrew tjubija u rispett lejn kull persuna li talbet l-għajnuna.
formal.en: The volunteers showed kindness and respect towards every person who asked for help.
formal.zh: 志愿者对每一位求助者都表现出善意与尊重。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ġara ġabitli s-soppa meta kont marida. Lara: Kemm għandha tjubija! Dejjem taħseb fl-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Nina: The neighbour brought me soup when I was ill. Lara: She is so kind! She always thinks of others.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我生病时，邻居给我送来了汤。拉拉：她真善良！总是想着别人。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġara ġabitli s-soppa meta kont marida.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġara ġabitli s-soppa meta kont marida.
messages.zh: 我生病时，邻居给我送来了汤。
messages.en: The neighbour brought me soup when I was ill.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandha tjubija! Dejjem taħseb fl-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandha tjubija! Dejjem taħseb fl-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 她真善良！总是想着别人。
messages.en: She is so kind! She always thinks of others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tjubija 想成邻居送来的一碗热汤，用具体善举记住抽象的“善良、仁慈”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To increase or multiply in number or amount, or to be increased or multiplied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量或总量增加、繁衍增多，也可指被增加或被成倍扩大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fin-numru jew fil-kwantità, jew isir aktar numeruż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被增加；数量或程度得到提升。
被成倍增加；被扩大为更多。
kattar 的中间被动态，表示自身增多或被增加。
繁衍；增多；数量变得更多。

formal.mt: In-numru ta' membri tal-għaqda tkattar matul is-snin.
formal.en: The number of members of the association increased over the years.
formal.zh: 多年来，这个协会的会员人数逐渐增加。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm hawn ħut żgħir fl-għadira! Toni: Iva, il-ħut tkattar ħafna din is-sena.
colloquial.en: Rita: There are so many little fish in the pond! Toni: Yes, the fish have multiplied a lot this year.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：池塘里的小鱼真多！托尼：是啊，今年鱼繁衍了很多。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 池塘里的小鱼真多！
messages.en: There are so many little fish in the pond!

messages.speaker: Toni (池塘主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħut tkattar ħafna din is-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħut tkattar ħafna din is-sena.
messages.zh: 是啊，今年鱼繁衍了很多。
messages.en: Yes, the fish have multiplied a lot this year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象池塘里的鱼从几条变成一大群，把 tkattar 记成数量不断增多的过程。

gloss_zh: 遭妻子不忠；成为被戴绿帽的丈夫

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a husband to be cuckolded through his wife's infidelity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指丈夫因妻子不忠而成为被背叛的一方，即俗称被戴绿帽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisfa mqarraq minn martu minħabba l-infedeltà tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因妻子不忠而被戴绿帽。
成为妻子不忠、遭到背叛的丈夫。

collocations.en: was cuckolded through his wife's infidelity
collocations.zh: 因妻子不忠而被戴绿帽
在不知情的情况下被戴了绿帽

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel tkebbex mingħajr ma kien jaf, u sar jaf bil-verità biss fl-aħħar.
formal.en: In the story, the husband was cuckolded without knowing it and discovered the truth only at the end.
formal.zh: 故事中，丈夫在不知情的情况下遭妻子背叛，直到最后才得知真相。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex jgħidu li r-raġel tkebbex f'din l-istorja? Ġorġ: Għax martu kellha relazzjoni ma' raġel ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why do they say the husband was cuckolded in this story? Ġorġ: Because his wife had a relationship with another man.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：为什么说这个故事里的丈夫被戴了绿帽？乔治：因为他妻子和另一个男人有关系。

messages.speaker: Marta (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex jgħidu li r-raġel tkebbex f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex jgħidu li r-raġel tkebbex f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 为什么说这个故事里的丈夫被戴了绿帽？
messages.en: Why do they say the husband was cuckolded in this story?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax martu kellha relazzjoni ma' raġel ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax martu kellha relazzjoni ma' raġel ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为他妻子和另一个男人有关系。
messages.en: Because his wife had a relationship with another man.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkebbex 放进小说中的婚姻背叛情节来记，明确主语是遭妻子背叛的丈夫。

gloss_zh: 被包裹；被裹尸；穿得厚厚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wrapped or shrouded, or to put on many clothes and wrap oneself up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被包裹或用裹尸布包住；也指穿上很多衣服，把自己裹得严严实实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgeżwer jew jitgħatta b'kefen, jew jilbes ħafna ħwejjeġ u jitgeżwer fihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被包住；被裹起来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to wear a lot of clothing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿上很多衣物；把自己穿裹得很厚。
keffen 的中间被动态，表示被包裹、被裹尸，或把自己裹起来。
被裹上裹尸布；被殓裹。
穿很多件衣服；穿得厚厚的。

collocations.en: was wrapped in a white shroud

collocations.zh: 用衣物把自己裹得严严实实

formal.mt: Qabel id-difna, il-mejjet tkeffen f'kefen abjad.
formal.en: Before the burial, the deceased was wrapped in a white shroud.
formal.zh: 下葬前，死者被白色裹尸布包裹。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark tkeffen daqshekk bil-ħwejjeġ? Rita: Għax illum qed iħoss ħafna bard.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why has Mark wrapped himself up in so many clothes? Rita: Because he is feeling very cold today.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克怎么穿了这么多，把自己裹得这么严？丽塔：因为他今天觉得很冷。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么穿了这么多，把自己裹得这么严？
messages.en: Why has Mark wrapped himself up in so many clothes?

messages.speaker: Rita (马克的姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax illum qed iħoss ħafna bard.
messages.mt_standard: Għax illum qed iħoss ħafna bard.
messages.zh: 因为他今天觉得很冷。
messages.en: Because he is feeling very cold today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“裹得严严实实”连接 tkeffen 的意思：丧葬时是殓裹，日常则可指穿得很厚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become ugly or despicable, to make a face, or to be maligned or denigrated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得丑陋或可鄙；做出怪脸；也可指遭到诋毁或贬损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ikrah jew jistmellu, jagħmel wiċċ ikrah, jew jisfa mċekken bi kliem ħażin dwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变丑；变得难看。
做怪脸；露出表示嫌恶等情绪的表情。
kerrah 的中间被动态，表示变丑、被丑化或遭贬损。
变得丑陋或可鄙。
遭诋毁；被贬低或丑化。

collocations.en: became ugly because of the rubbish

formal.mt: L-isem tal-għalliem tkerrah minħabba xnigħat li aktar tard instabu li kienu foloz.
formal.en: The teacher's name was maligned by rumours that were later found to be false.
formal.zh: 这位教师的名声受到谣言诋毁，而这些谣言后来被证实是假的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tkerrah Mark meta daq is-soppa? Nina: Għax kienet mielħa wisq!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark make a face when he tasted the soup? Nina: Because it was too salty!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克尝汤时为什么做出那副怪表情？妮娜：因为汤太咸了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tkerrah Mark meta daq is-soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tkerrah Mark meta daq is-soppa?
messages.zh: 马克尝汤时为什么做出那副怪表情？
messages.en: Why did Mark make a face when he tasted the soup?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为汤太咸了！
messages.en: Because it was too salty!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkerrah 分成三个画面记忆：环境变丑、尝到咸汤做怪脸、名声被人说坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show off or brag, or to behave in an affected or ostentatious way to impress others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为引人注意或给别人留下印象而炫耀、吹嘘，或表现得装腔作势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiftaħar jew iġib ruħu b'mod affettwat u ostentattiv biex jimpressjona lill-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炫耀；卖弄。

sense_translations.en_definition: to indulge in affected or ostentatious behaviour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 装腔作势；表现得刻意招摇。

sense_translations.en_definition: to brag, to show off; to indulge in affected or ostentatious behaviour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹嘘、炫耀；做出装腔作势或招摇的举动。

collocations.en: shows off in front of his friends

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żagħżugħ tkessaħ quddiem sħabu biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tagħhom.
formal.en: In the story, the young man showed off in front of his friends to attract their attention.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名年轻人在朋友面前炫耀，以引起他们的注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark baqa' jitkellem fuq il-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu? Toni: Qed jitkessaħ biha; irid li kulħadd iħares lejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark keep talking about his new car? Toni: He is showing it off; he wants everyone to look at him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么一直说他的新车？托尼：他在炫耀呢，想让所有人都注意他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark baqa' jitkellem fuq il-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark baqa' jitkellem fuq il-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu?
messages.zh: 马克为什么一直说他的新车？
messages.en: Why did Mark keep talking about his new car?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jitkessaħ biha; irid li kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jitkessaħ biha; irid li kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.zh: 他在炫耀呢，想让所有人都注意他。
messages.en: He is showing it off; he wants everyone to look at him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人不停展示新车、等着大家看他，把 tkessaħ 与“炫耀、摆架子”一起记。

gloss_zh: 生长受阻；变得矮小；发育不良

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be or become stunted, failing to grow to a normal size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生长受到抑制，未能长到正常大小，因而变得矮小或发育不良。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' żgħir jew ma jikbirx kif suppost minħabba xkiel fit-tkabbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生长受阻；处于发育不良、长不大的状态。
因生长受阻而变得矮小或发育不良。

collocations.en: became stunted because of a lack of water

formal.mt: Il-qamħ f'din l-għalqa tkewwes minħabba n-nuqqas ta' ilma matul il-perjodu tat-tkabbir.
formal.en: The wheat in this field became stunted because of a lack of water during the growing period.
formal.zh: 这块田里的小麦在生长期缺水，因此生长受阻。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-qamħ f'din ir-rokna baqa' daqshekk żgħir? Ġużeppi: Tkewwes għax ma wasallux biżżejjed ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why has the wheat in this corner stayed so small? Ġużeppi: It became stunted because it did not get enough water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个角落的小麦为什么一直这么矮小？约瑟夫：因为没有得到足够的水，生长受阻了。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-qamħ f'din ir-rokna baqa' daqshekk żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-qamħ f'din ir-rokna baqa' daqshekk żgħir?
messages.zh: 这个角落的小麦为什么一直这么矮小？
messages.en: Why has the wheat in this corner stayed so small?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkewwes għax ma wasallux biżżejjed ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Tkewwes għax ma wasallux biżżejjed ilma.
messages.zh: 因为没有得到足够的水，生长受阻了。
messages.en: It became stunted because it did not get enough water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一块田里有一角麦子因缺水始终长不高，用这个画面记住 tkewwes 的生长受阻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exchange letters or other written messages with someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人通过信件或其他书面消息保持往来，互相写信。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikteb lil xi ħadd u jirċievi tweġibiet bil-miktub mingħandu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to engage in correspondence with sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人通信，进行书面往来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to correspond, to write to each other
sense_translations.zh_definition: 互相通信，彼此写信。

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara tiegħu barra minn Malta, Pawlu tkieteb regolarment mal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: During his stay outside Malta, Pawlu corresponded regularly with his family.
formal.zh: 在马耳他境外逗留期间，保罗定期与家人通信。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu baqa' f'kuntatt ma' ħabibu? Anna: Iva, tkieteb miegħu għal sena sħiħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Pawlu stay in touch with his friend? Anna: Yes, he corresponded with him for a whole year.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗一直和他的朋友保持联系吗？安娜：是的，他和那位朋友通信了整整一年。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗一直和他的朋友保持联系吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu stay in touch with his friend?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkieteb miegħu għal sena sħiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkieteb miegħu għal sena sħiħa.
messages.zh: 是的，他和那位朋友通信了整整一年。
messages.en: Yes, he corresponded with him for a whole year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人轮流把信放进邮筒：重点是双方有来有往，把 tkieteb 和“互相通信”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To continue or be carried on, especially after a pause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指活动、讨论等继续进行，或在暂停后得到继续。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' għaddej jew jerġa' jibda wara waqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被继续下去，得到延续。
动词 kompla 的中被动形式，表示某事继续进行或得到继续。
继续，接着进行下去。

formal.mt: Wara waqfa qasira, id-dibattitu tkompla fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: After a short break, the debate continued in the main hall.
formal.zh: 短暂休息后，辩论在主厅继续进行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-film waqaf meta nqata' d-dawl? Mark: Iva, imma tkompla meta ġie lura d-dawl.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the film stop when the power went out? Mark: Yes, but it continued when the power came back.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：停电时电影中断了吗？马克：是的，不过来电后又接着放了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 停电时电影中断了吗？
messages.en: Did the film stop when the power went out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma tkompla meta ġie lura d-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma tkompla meta ġie lura d-dawl.
messages.zh: 是的，不过来电后又接着放了。
messages.en: Yes, but it continued when the power came back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tkompla 配上视频暂停后再次播放的画面：事情接着进行，注意句子的主语可以是活动本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stuttering: speech in which sounds or syllables are involuntarily repeated, prolonged, or interrupted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 口吃，指说话时不由自主地重复、拖长某些语音或音节，或出现停顿阻塞的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diffikultà fit-taħdit li fiha persuna tirrepeti jew ittawwal ħsejjes jew sillabi, jew tieqaf bla ma trid.

sense_translations.en_definition: to talk through a speech defect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因言语障碍而说话不流畅、结巴的现象。
口吃；说话时出现不自主的重复、拖音或阻塞。

formal.mt: L-għalliema tat lill-istudent aktar ħin biex jitkellem minħabba t-tlagħligħ tiegħu.
formal.en: The teacher gave the student more time to speak because of his stuttering.
formal.zh: 考虑到这位学生有口吃，老师给了他更多时间发言。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kultant ikolli tlagħligħ meta nitkellem. Marija: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek, qed nisma'.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Sometimes I stutter when I speak. Marija: Take your time, I'm listening.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我说话时有时会结巴。玛丽娅：慢慢说，我在听。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我说话时有时会结巴。
messages.en: Sometimes I stutter when I speak.

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 慢慢说，我在听。
messages.en: Take your time, I'm listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tlagħligħ 放在“耐心听对方说完”的场景中记忆；它是表示口吃现象的名词，不是对人的评价。

gloss_zh: 逗留；闲逛；沿街等候顾客

teaching_sense.en_definition: To linger or loiter in a place, sometimes strolling back and forth without leaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某处逗留、闲逛或来回走动，迟迟不离开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idum f'post jew jimxi 'l hawn u 'l hemm mingħajr ma jitlaq malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗留，迟迟不离开。
在某处闲待、游荡。

sense_translations.en_definition: to loiter, linger, stroll back and forth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲逛、逗留，或来回漫步。

sense_translations.en_definition: to wait for clients, to walk the streets
sense_translations.zh_definition: 等候顾客，沿街走动招徕顾客。

formal.mt: Wara li spiċċat iż-żjara, il-viżitatur tlajja għal ftit ħin fil-bitħa tal-mużew.
formal.en: After the visit ended, the visitor lingered for a while in the museum courtyard.
formal.zh: 参观结束后，这位访客又在博物馆庭院里逗留了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark telaq mill-ewwel? Lara: Le, tlajja ftit quddiem il-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark leave straight away? Lara: No, he lingered outside the shop for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克马上就走了吗？拉拉：没有，他在商店门前又待了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克马上就走了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark leave straight away?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，他在商店门前又待了一会儿。
messages.en: No, he lingered outside the shop for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象已经准备离开，却又在门口来回走了几步：用这个“迟迟未走”的画面记 tlajja，并依上下文判断是否涉及等客。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number thirty, equal to three groups of ten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词三十，表示三个十的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 30, jiġifieri tliet darbiet għaxra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三十，数字30。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom tletin minuta biex ilestu l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The participants have thirty minutes to complete the exercise.
formal.zh: 参与者有三十分钟完成练习。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm jiswa dan il-ktieb? Rita: Tletin ewro. Mark: Tajjeb, neħodlu wieħed lil ħija.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this book cost? Rita: Thirty euros. Mark: All right, I'll get one for my brother.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书多少钱？丽塔：三十欧元。马克：好，我给我兄弟买一本。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这本书多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this book cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 三十欧元。
messages.en: Thirty euros.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我给我兄弟买一本。
messages.en: All right, I'll get one for my brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tletin 写在三组各十个圆点旁边，再读“tletin minuta，三十分钟”，用整十数量帮助区分十三。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number thirteen, used in this form when standing alone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词十三；tlettax 是独立使用时的形式，例如单独回答数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 13, jiġifieri għaxra u tlieta; din il-forma tintuża meta n-numru joqgħod waħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十三，数字13。
十三的独立形式，用于数字单独出现、后面不直接接所数名词时。

formal.mt: Fit-tabella, in-numru tlettax jindika l-għadd ta' tweġibiet korretti.
formal.en: In the table, the number thirteen indicates the number of correct answers.
formal.zh: 在表格中，数字十三表示正确答案的数量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għandna kotba fuq il-mejda? Mark: Tlettax. Lara: Tajjeb, mela għandna tlettax-il ktieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many books do we have on the table? Mark: Thirteen. Lara: Good, so we have thirteen books.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：桌上有多少本书？马克：十三本。拉拉：好，那我们有十三本书。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 桌上有多少本书？
messages.en: How many books do we have on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 十三本。
messages.en: Thirteen.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 好，那我们有十三本书。
messages.en: Good, so we have thirteen books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 tlettax 配成十个圆点加三个圆点；单独报数说 tlettax，接“书”时连着记 tlettax-il ktieb。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To quarrel or argue with someone, expressing disagreement in words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人发生口头争执或争吵，用言语表达分歧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jargumenta jew jiġġieled bil-kliem ma' xi ħadd minħabba nuqqas ta' qbil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争论，发生口头争执。
争吵，吵架。
抱怨，诉说不满。

sense_translations.en_definition: to quarrel, argue (have a verbal fight)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 争吵、争执，即发生言语上的冲突。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-rappreżentant tlewwem mal-organizzatur fuq il-ħin tal-attività.
formal.en: During the meeting, the representative argued with the organiser over the timing of the event.
formal.zh: 会上，代表与组织者就活动时间发生了争执。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark ma jridx ikellem lil ħuh? Sara: Għax ilbieraħ tlewwem miegħu fuq il-flus. Anna: Nispera li jagħmlu paċi dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why doesn't Mark want to talk to his brother? Sara: Because he quarrelled with him over money yesterday. Anna: I hope they make peace soon.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克为什么不想和他的兄弟说话？萨拉：因为他昨天为钱和兄弟吵了一架。安娜：希望他们很快和好。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jridx ikellem lil ħuh?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jridx ikellem lil ħuh?
messages.zh: 马克为什么不想和他的兄弟说话？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark want to talk to his brother?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilbieraħ tlewwem miegħu fuq il-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilbieraħ tlewwem miegħu fuq il-flus.
messages.zh: 因为他昨天为钱和兄弟吵了一架。
messages.en: Because he quarrelled with him over money yesterday.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 希望他们很快和好。
messages.en: I hope they make peace soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人围着一笔钱争执：用 tlewwem ma' 记“和谁吵”，用 tlewwem fuq 记“为哪件事吵”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be voiced or expressed in spoken words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指想法、意见或话语被说出来，以声音或口头语言表达出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad bil-fomm jew jingħata espressjoni bil-vuċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被发声表达出来，尤指意见或感受被说出。
被说出，以口头语言表达。

formal.mt: It-tħassib dwar is-sigurtà tleħħen waqt il-laqgħa tal-kumitat.
formal.en: Concern about safety was voiced during the committee meeting.
formal.zh: 对安全问题的担忧在委员会会议上被表达了出来。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi ħadd semma l-ħsieb tiegħek fil-laqgħa? Pawlu: Iva, il-ħsieb tleħħen fl-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did anyone mention your idea at the meeting? Pawlu: Yes, the idea was voiced at the end.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：有人在会上提到你的想法吗？保罗：有，那个想法在最后被说了出来。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd semma l-ħsieb tiegħek fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd semma l-ħsieb tiegħek fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 有人在会上提到你的想法吗？
messages.en: Did anyone mention your idea at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 有，那个想法在最后被说了出来。
messages.en: Yes, the idea was voiced at the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把脑中的想法画成一个出现文字的说话气泡：tleħħen 强调想法“被说出来”，句子可从被表达的内容说起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play around or engage in lighthearted amusement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻松地玩耍、嬉戏或玩闹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilgħab jew jgħaddi l-ħin fid-divertiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩耍；嬉戏；玩闹。

formal.mt: Wara l-attività, it-tifel tliegħeb ma' sħabu fil-bitħa.
formal.en: After the activity, the boy played around with his friends in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，男孩和朋友们在院子里嬉戏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Leo wara l-iskola? Rita: Tliegħeb ma' sħabu fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Leo do after school? Rita: He played around with his friends in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利奥放学后做了什么？丽塔：他和朋友们在花园里玩闹。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 利奥放学后做了什么？
messages.en: What did Leo do after school?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他和朋友们在花园里玩闹。
messages.en: He played around with his friends in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tliegħeb 配上孩子在花园里嬉戏的画面，记住它表示轻松玩闹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Three, used as the short form of tlieta before a noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词“三”，是 tlieta 放在名词前使用的短形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma qasira ta' tlieta li tintuża quddiem nom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三；三个。
tlieta（“三”）作定语、放在名词前时使用的短形式。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi tliet lezzjonijiet u jintemm fi tliet ijiem.
formal.en: The course includes three lessons and finishes in three days.
formal.zh: 这门课程包含三节课，三天内结束。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm għandna bżonn kotba? Lara: Tliet kotba, wieħed għal kull student.
colloquial.en: Mark: How many books do we need? Lara: Three books, one for each student.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们需要几本书？拉拉：三本书，每个学生一本。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 我们需要几本书？
messages.en: How many books do we need?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tliet kotba, wieħed għal kull student.
messages.mt_standard: Tliet kotba, wieħed għal kull student.
messages.zh: 三本书，每个学生一本。
messages.en: Three books, one for each student.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tliet 和 kotba 连成“三本书”来记：后面带名词时，用这个短形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hilly or steep, describing land or a route with slopes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容地形多山丘，或道路、坡面陡峭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna għoljiet jew telgħat, jew li hu wieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多山丘的；丘陵起伏的。
陡峭的；坡度大的。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ huwa tlugħi, għalhekk il-mixja teħtieġ aktar ħin u sforz.
formal.en: The path is steep, so the walk requires more time and effort.
formal.zh: 这条小路坡度很大，因此步行需要更多时间和体力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-passaġġ faċli? Pawlu: Huwa tlugħi, imma nistgħu nimxu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this path easy? Pawlu: It's steep, but we can walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这条小路好走吗？保罗：坡挺陡的，不过我们可以慢慢走。

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 这条小路好走吗？
messages.en: Is this path easy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa tlugħi, imma nistgħu nimxu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa tlugħi, imma nistgħu nimxu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 坡挺陡的，不过我们可以慢慢走。
messages.en: It's steep, but we can walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tlugħi 就想象一条爬起来费力的山路，同时联系“丘陵起伏”和“坡陡”两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become ill repeatedly; in another sense, to rise up against something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复或经常生病；另一个义项表示起来反抗某事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimrad ta' spiss; f'tifsira oħra, iqum kontra xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become ill on a regular basis
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常生病；隔一段时间就生病。
起来反抗某事物；奋起反对某事。
频繁患病；屡次生病。

formal.mt: Il-poplu tmarrad kontra l-inġustizzja u talab bidla.
formal.en: The people rose up against injustice and demanded change.
formal.zh: 民众起来反抗不公，并要求作出改变。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien Leo din ix-xitwa? Rita: Tmarrad ta' spiss, imma issa jinsab aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was Leo this winter? Rita: He fell ill frequently, but he's better now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：利奥今年冬天怎么样？丽塔：他经常生病，不过现在好多了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 利奥今年冬天怎么样？
messages.en: How was Leo this winter?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmarrad ta' spiss, imma issa jinsab aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Tmarrad ta' spiss, imma issa jinsab aħjar.
messages.zh: 他经常生病，不过现在好多了。
messages.en: He fell ill frequently, but he's better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tmarrad 做两张情景卡：一张是反复生病，一张是反抗不公；分别记忆，避免混淆义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be or become angry, annoyed, or vexed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于生气、恼怒的状态，或因某事而动怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun jew isir irrabjat jew imdejjaq minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生起气来；动怒。
感到恼火；烦恼起来。
生气；处于愤怒状态或变得愤怒。

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, ir-rappreżentant tmasħan meta sema' l-akkuża.
formal.en: During the discussion, the representative became angry when he heard the accusation.
formal.zh: 讨论过程中，这位代表听到指控后动怒了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex telaq Mark? Ben: Tmasħan għax ħadd ma semgħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark leave? Ben: He got angry because nobody listened to him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么走了？本：因为没人听他说话，他生气了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为没人听他说话，他生气了。
messages.en: He got angry because nobody listened to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmasħan 放进“没人听他说话，于是他生气了”的小故事，记住它表示动怒或恼火。

gloss_zh: 倾斜；取笑；不当回事；不在乎；健康衰退

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be tilted; also to mock someone, treat something lightly, not care, or decline in health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示物体倾斜；也可表示取笑别人、对事情不认真、不在乎，或健康状况衰退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu pożizzjoni inklinata; jista' wkoll ifisser li jwaqqa' lil xi ħadd għaċ-ċajt, ma jiħux xi ħaġa bis-serjetà, ma jimpurtahx, jew imur lura f'saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄斜；呈倾斜状态。
取笑某人；拿某人开玩笑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fail to take sth. seriously
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不认真对待某事；不把某事当回事。
嘲弄；取笑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to not care, to not mind
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不在乎；不介意。
健康状况衰退；身体逐渐变差。

collocations.en: failed to take the warning seriously

formal.mt: Il-pannell tmejjel lejn il-lemin wara li nħall wieħed mill-irbit tiegħu.
formal.en: The panel tilted to the right after one of its fastenings came loose.
formal.zh: 其中一个固定件松脱后，面板向右倾斜了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Sam jinsab imdejjaq? Lara: Ben tmejjel bih quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Sam upset? Lara: Ben made fun of him in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨姆为什么不开心？拉拉：本当着大家的面取笑了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 萨姆为什么不开心？
messages.en: Why is Sam upset?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 本当着大家的面取笑了他。
messages.en: Ben made fun of him in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tmejjel 配五幅图：面板倾斜、取笑同伴、轻视警告、毫不在意、身体变差；用上下文选择意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number eighty, equal to eight groups of ten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词“八十”，表示八个十的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jfisser tmien darbiet għaxra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八十（基数词）。
八十。

formal.mt: Il-prezz totali għall-parteċipazzjoni fil-kors huwa ta' tmenin ewro.
formal.en: The total price for participation in the course is eighty euros.
formal.zh: 参加这门课程的总费用为八十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-mejda? Rita: Tmenin ewro, u nistgħu nwassluha għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this table cost? Rita: Eighty euros, and we can deliver it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张桌子多少钱？丽塔：八十欧元，我们明天可以送货。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张桌子多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this table cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmenin ewro, u nistgħu nwassluha għada.
messages.mt_standard: Tmenin ewro, u nistgħu nwassluha għada.
messages.zh: 八十欧元，我们明天可以送货。
messages.en: Eighty euros, and we can deliver it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmenin 写在“80”的价格标签旁，再读 tmenin ewro，用数字和购物场景一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 引人怜悯；变得可怜；变得卑微

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become pitiable or inspire pity; also to become mean or lowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得可怜或引起他人的怜悯；也可表示变得卑微、低贱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ta' ħasra jew iqanqal il-ħasra; jista' wkoll ifisser li jsir baxx jew umli fil-qagħda tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起怜悯；使人觉得可怜。
mesken 的中间被动态形式，表示自身进入或处于相应状态。
变得可怜；陷入令人怜悯的境地。
变得卑微、低贱。

collocations.en: became an object of pity before everyone

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel tmesken wara li tilef daru u kulma kellu.
formal.en: In the story, the man became pitiable after losing his home and everything he owned.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名男子失去住所和全部财产后，境遇变得令人怜悯。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara lir-raġel fl-aħħar tal-istorja? Pawlu: Tmesken wara li tilef kollox, u sħabu għenuh.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to the man at the end of the story? Pawlu: He became pitiable after losing everything, and his friends helped him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：故事结尾那个男人怎么样了？保罗：他失去一切后变得很可怜，朋友们帮助了他。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书伙伴)
messages.zh: 故事结尾那个男人怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the man at the end of the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmesken wara li tilef kollox, u sħabu għenuh.
messages.mt_standard: Tmesken wara li tilef kollox, u sħabu għenuh.
messages.zh: 他失去一切后变得很可怜，朋友们帮助了他。
messages.en: He became pitiable after losing everything, and his friends helped him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tmesken 放进故事人物失去一切、引人怜悯的画面里，连着记“变得可怜”和“引起同情”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become less intense, less interested, or less hopeful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指强度逐渐减弱，或人失去兴趣、热情和信心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jonqos fil-qawwa jew fil-ħeġġa, jew jitlef l-interess jew il-kuraġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐减弱；渐渐平息。
变得冷淡；不再关心。
灰心；失去信心或勇气。

collocations.en: he lost heart after the first difficulties
collocations.zh: 他遇到最初的困难后便灰心了

formal.mt: Wara diversi laqgħat mingħajr riżultat, l-entużjażmu għall-proposta tmewwet.
formal.en: After several meetings without any result, enthusiasm for the proposal died down.
formal.zh: 几次会议都没有取得结果后，大家对这项提案的热情逐渐消退。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu ħerqan li jieħu sehem? Mark: Le, tmewwet wara l-ewwel diffikultajiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still keen to take part? Mark: No, he lost heart after the first difficulties.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗还很想参加吗？马克：不了，他遇到最初的困难后就灰心了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għadu ħerqan li jieħu sehem?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għadu ħerqan li jieħu sehem?
messages.zh: 保罗还很想参加吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still keen to take part?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不了，他遇到最初的困难后就灰心了。
messages.en: No, he lost heart after the first difficulties.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把热情想成慢慢调暗的灯：光变弱对应减弱，人不再关心对应冷淡，想放弃对应灰心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gain money or obtain a benefit from an activity or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某项活动或某种处境中赚取利润，或取得对自己有利的好处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel qligħ jew jikseb vantaġġ minn attività jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获利；赚取利润。
从中取得好处；利用某种情况获得利益。

collocations.en: he made a profit from the sales
he gained an advantage from the situation
collocations.zh: 他从这种局面中取得了好处

formal.mt: In-negozjant tmiegħex mill-bejgħ tal-prodotti lokali matul il-fiera.
formal.en: The merchant made a profit from selling local products during the fair.
formal.zh: 这位商人在展销会期间通过销售本地产品获利。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar il-bejgħ ta' Toni? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna; tmiegħex sew minnu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Toni's sales go? Mark: Very well; he made a good profit from them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：托尼的销售情况怎么样？马克：很好，他从中赚了不少。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼的销售情况怎么样？
messages.en: How did Toni's sales go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 很好，他从中赚了不少。
messages.en: Very well; he made a good profit from them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住交易结束后手里多出的收益：多的是钱，就是获利；多的是机会或便利，就是取得好处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The point at which something ends, its termination, or its final outcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某件事到达的结束点、停止状态，或事情发展后的最终结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-punt meta xi ħaġa tispiċċa, il-waqfien tagħha, jew ir-riżultat finali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结束；末尾；终点。
终止；使某项活动或关系结束。
最终结果；事情发展后的结局。

collocations.en: at the end of the meeting

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-laqgħa, il-kumitat approva l-pjan għall-proġett.
formal.en: At the end of the meeting, the committee approved the plan for the project.
formal.zh: 会议结束时，委员会批准了项目计划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-film? Lara: Iva, imma t-tmiem kien imdejjaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the film? Lara: Yes, but the ending was sad.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这部电影吗？拉拉：喜欢，不过结局很伤感。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过结局很伤感。
messages.en: Yes, but the ending was sad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影最后一幕：时间上是结束，故事上是结局；再把这个画面迁移到会议结束和合同终止。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number eight, used on its own when counting, naming a number, or answering a question about quantity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词“八”，可在数数、说出数字或独立回答数量问题时使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru wara sebgħa u qabel disgħa, użat waħdu fl-għadd jew fi tweġiba dwar kwantità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八，表示数量的基数词。
八的独立形式，用于单独说出数字或回答数量问题。

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru, in-numru ta' parteċipanti fil-grupp huwa tmienja.
formal.en: According to the register, the number of participants in the group is eight.
formal.zh: 根据登记册，该小组的参加人数为八人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandna tuffieħ? Mark: Tmienja. Biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many apples do we have? Mark: Eight. Enough for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有几个苹果？马克：八个，够大家分。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们有几个苹果？
messages.en: How many apples do we have?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 八个，够大家分。
messages.en: Eight. Enough for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出八个苹果，再练习一问一答：问有几个，单独答 tmienja，把完整词形与独立回答一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wander about, play around, or spend time amusing oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意走动、玩耍，或做让自己开心的事情来消遣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur bla għan preċiż, jilgħab, jew iqatta' l-ħin jieħu gost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲逛；漫游；没有明确目的地走动。
玩耍；嬉戏。
自娱；消遣；做让自己开心的事。

collocations.en: he played around in the garden
he amused himself with the other children
collocations.zh: 他和其他孩子一起玩乐

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħin liberu, it-tifel tmieraħ fil-ġnien taħt is-superviżjoni tal-għalliem.
formal.en: During free time, the boy played around in the garden under the teacher's supervision.
formal.zh: 自由活动期间，男孩在老师的看护下在花园里玩耍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel Ben wara l-iskola? Maja: Tmieraħ fil-ġnien mat-tfal l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Ben do after school? Maja: He played around in the garden with the other children.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本放学后做了什么？玛雅：他和其他孩子在花园里玩耍。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 本放学后做了什么？
messages.en: What did Ben do after school?

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 他和其他孩子在花园里玩耍。
messages.en: He played around in the garden with the other children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上自由活动的画面：随意走走是闲逛，和伙伴嬉戏是玩耍，自己找乐趣是自娱。

gloss_zh: 十八；数字十八的独立形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number eighteen, used to express a quantity or to name the number on its own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词“十八”，表示十八的数量，也可单独说出这个数字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru wara sbatax u qabel dsatax, li jindika kwantità jew jingħad waħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十八，表示数量的基数词。
十八的独立形式，用于单独说出数字或回答数量问题。

formal.mt: Tmintax-il student ipparteċipaw fil-programm ta' taħriġ.
formal.en: Eighteen students participated in the training programme.
formal.zh: 十八名学生参加了培训项目。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm għandek sena? Lara: Għandi tmintax. U int?
colloquial.en: Mark: How old are you? Lara: I'm eighteen. And you?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你多大了？拉拉：我十八岁。你呢？

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 你多大了？
messages.en: How old are you?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 我十八岁。你呢？
messages.en: I'm eighteen. And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象十八岁生日蛋糕上的数字十八；把 Għandi tmintax 整句记住，再配读 tmintax-il sena。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hand tool with two opposing jaws, used for gripping, pulling, bending, or holding objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有两个相对钳口的手工具，用来夹持、拉拔、弯折或固定物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'żewġ partijiet li jingħalqu fuq xulxin biex taqbad, tiġbed, tgħawweġ jew iżżomm oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钳子，用于夹持、弯折或拉动物体的工具。
夹钳，用两个相对的夹持部分夹取物体。

sense_translations.en_definition: a pair of pincers, pliers, tongs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一把钳子、拔钳或夹钳。

collocations.en: to grip the wire with pliers

formal.mt: It-tekniku uża tnalja biex iżomm il-wajer waqt it-tiswija.
formal.en: The technician used pliers to hold the wire during the repair.
formal.zh: 技术员在维修时用钳子夹住金属线。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek tnalja? Ma nistax niġbed dan id-dwiefer. Lara: Iva, ħu din. Oqgħod attent.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a pair of pincers? I can't pull out this nail. Lara: Yes, take these. Be careful.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有拔钳吗？我拔不出这颗钉子。拉拉：有，拿这把吧。小心点。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek tnalja? Ma nistax niġbed dan id-dwiefer.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek tnalja? Ma nistax niġbed dan id-dwiefer.
messages.zh: 你有拔钳吗？我拔不出这颗钉子。
messages.en: Do you have a pair of pincers? I can't pull out this nail.

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 有，拿这把吧。小心点。
messages.en: Yes, take these. Be careful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两只钳口合拢夹住一颗钉子，把夹、拉、握三个动作与 tnalja 联系起来，记成一把工具。

gloss_zh: 十二；数字十二的独立形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number twelve, used to express a quantity or to name the number on its own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词“十二”，表示十二的数量，也可单独说出这个数字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru wara ħdax u qabel tlettax, li jindika kwantità jew jingħad waħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十二，表示数量的基数词。
十二的独立形式，用于单独说出数字或回答数量问题。

formal.mt: Il-kors idum tnax-il ġimgħa u jinkludi eżerċizzji prattiċi.
formal.en: The course lasts twelve weeks and includes practical exercises.
formal.zh: 课程为期十二周，并包含实践练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandna bajd għall-kejk? Mark: Tnax. Għandna biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many eggs do we have for the cake? Mark: Twelve. We have enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有几个鸡蛋可以用来做蛋糕？马克：十二个，够用了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们有几个鸡蛋可以用来做蛋糕？
messages.en: How many eggs do we have for the cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 十二个，够用了。
messages.en: Twelve. We have enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把十二个月排成一圈来记 tnax，再用一盒十二个鸡蛋练习：独立答 Tnax，带名词说 tnax-il bajda。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show indifference or contempt, make fun of someone, or treat something without seriousness; a vulgar expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以粗俗口吻表示不在乎、轻蔑，或指取笑、愚弄别人及敷衍某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri nuqqas ta' interess jew disprezz, iwaqqa' lil xi ħadd għaċ-ċajt, jew jieħu xi ħaġa bla serjetà; espressjoni vulgari.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be indifferent to sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事或某人漠不关心；不把某事或某人放在心上。
取笑某人；拿某人开玩笑。
欺骗某人；坑骗某人。
恶化；衰退；变得越来越差。
表现得满不在乎或轻蔑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a fool of (someone), to make fun of
sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚弄某人，使其出丑；嘲弄。
磨蹭；敷衍；不认真对待。

collocations.zh: 敷衍工作；对工作不当回事（粗俗表达）

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-klijent ilmenta li l-bejjiegħ tnejjek bih u ma ħax it-talba tiegħu bis-serjetà.
formal.en: In the story, the customer complained that the seller had made a fool of him and had not taken his request seriously.
formal.zh: 故事中，顾客抱怨卖家愚弄了他，没有认真对待他的要求。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed titnejjek bija? Lara: Le, qed nitkellem bis-serjetà.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you taking the piss out of me? Lara: No, I'm being serious.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你在耍我吗？Lara：没有，我是认真的。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在耍我吗？
messages.en: Are you taking the piss out of me?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，我是认真的。
messages.en: No, I'm being serious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“你在耍我吗”的争执场景记忆：既可涉及取笑、愚弄，也可表示不当回事；语气粗俗，使用前先判断关系和场合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To let out a sigh, moan, or whimper, expressing feelings such as sadness, pain, or tiredness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因悲伤、疼痛或疲惫等情绪或感受而叹气、呻吟或低声呜咽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ nifs jew leħen ta' tnehid, u jesprimi dwejjaq, uġigħ jew għeja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟；发出低沉的哼声。
低声呜咽；发出微弱的哀鸣。
叹气；呻吟。

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata twila ta' xogħol, ir-raġel poġġa bilqiegħda u tniehed bl-għeja.
formal.en: After a long day of work, the man sat down and sighed with tiredness.
formal.zh: 工作了漫长的一天后，那名男子坐下来，疲惫地叹了口气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titniehed? Ben: Għandi ħafna xogħol u ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you sighing? Ben: I have so much work, and I don't know where to start.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么叹气？Ben：我有好多工作，不知道从哪里开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么叹气？
messages.en: Why are you sighing?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna xogħol u ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna xogħol u ma nafx minn fejn nibda.
messages.zh: 我有好多工作，不知道从哪里开始。
messages.en: I have so much work, and I don't know where to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象疲惫的人坐下发出一声长叹，再把声音换成疼痛时的呻吟或委屈时的呜咽，用同一个“情绪发声”画面串起各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To breathe or make a slight movement, sometimes referring to whether someone or something moves at all.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼吸或稍微移动，也可强调某人或某物究竟有没有动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu n-nifs jew jagħmel ċaqliq żgħir, xi drabi b'enfasi fuq jekk ikunx hemm xi ċaqliq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挪动；稍微移动位置。
轻微移动；稍动一下。
呼吸。
稍微移动；有任何一点动静。
发不出声音；处于无声状态。

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, l-istudent tniffes bil-mod u żamm għajnejh magħluqa.
formal.en: During the exercise, the student breathed slowly and kept his eyes closed.
formal.zh: 练习期间，那名学生缓慢呼吸，并保持双眼闭合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Irnexxielek iċċaqlaq l-armarju? Pawlu: Le, imbuttajtu, imma ma tniffes xejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you manage to move the wardrobe? Pawlu: No, I pushed it, but it didn't budge at all.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你把衣柜挪动了吗？Pawlu：没有，我推了它，可它纹丝不动。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你把衣柜挪动了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to move the wardrobe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imbuttajtu, imma ma tniffes xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imbuttajtu, imma ma tniffes xejn.
messages.zh: 没有，我推了它，可它纹丝不动。
messages.en: No, I pushed it, but it didn't budge at all.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面记忆常见义：胸口随呼吸轻轻起伏，沉重衣柜被推却纹丝不动；另将“发不出声音”单列记忆，避免混成同一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To delay or linger instead of getting on with something, including staying in bed or working reluctantly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 迟迟不行动、逗留或磨蹭，也可指赖床，或不情愿地少做工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idum ma jibda jew ma jitlaq, jibqa' jitlajja jew fis-sodda, jew jaħdem ftit u kontra qalbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲逛；逗留；磨蹭着不走。
迟疑不前；拖着不行动。
赖在床上；迟迟不起床。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be workshy, to work little or reluctantly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒于工作；少做工作或不情愿地工作。

sense_translations.en_definition: to loiter, hang around, lie in
sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲逛；逗留；赖床晚起。

collocations.en: stayed in bed instead of getting up

formal.mt: L-istudent tnikker biex jitlaq mid-dar u wasal l-iskola tard.
formal.en: The student dawdled before leaving home and arrived at school late.
formal.zh: 那名学生出门前磨磨蹭蹭，结果上学迟到了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadek fis-sodda? Se nitilqu dalwaqt! Toni: Illum tnikker ftit. Qed inqum issa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you still in bed? We're leaving soon! Toni: I lingered in bed a bit today. I'm getting up now.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你还在床上？我们马上要出发了！Toni：今天赖了会儿床。我现在就起来。

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你还在床上？我们马上要出发了！
messages.en: Are you still in bed? We're leaving soon!

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum tnikker ftit. Qed inqum issa.
messages.mt_standard: Illum tnikker ftit. Qed inqum issa.
messages.zh: 今天赖了会儿床。我现在就起来。
messages.en: I lingered in bed a bit today. I'm getting up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“闹钟响了还不起、出门前还磨蹭、工作时不积极”连成一个拖拖拉拉的早晨，用“不肯马上行动”串联各义。

gloss_zh: 出身于；被孕育；产生；源自

teaching_sense.en_definition: To originate or descend from a family or source, or to be brought into being, generated, or bred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出自某个家族或来源，或被孕育、繁育、产生出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi minn familja jew minn sors, jew jinġieb fid-dinja, jitrabba jew jinħoloq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为……的后裔；出身于……。
被孕育或产生出来。
派生而来；源自某个来源。
nissel 的中间被动态形式，表示被孕育、被产生或由某来源形成。
被繁育；被培育出来。
出身于某个家族；为某家族的后代。

sense_translations.en_definition: to come (from a source), to be brought forth, generated, derived
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自某个来源；被孕育、产生或派生出来。

formal.mt: Minn din l-esperjenza tnissel interess ġdid fl-istudju tal-lingwi.
formal.en: From this experience, a new interest in studying languages arose.
formal.zh: 这次经历使人产生了学习语言的新兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tnissel l-interess tiegħek fil-mużika? Luqa: Meta kont żgħir, kont nisma' lin-nannu jdoqq kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your interest in music develop? Luqa: When I was little, I used to listen to my grandfather play every day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你对音乐的兴趣是怎么产生的？Luqa：小时候，我每天都会听爷爷演奏。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你对音乐的兴趣是怎么产生的？
messages.en: How did your interest in music develop?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta kont żgħir, kont nisma' lin-nannu jdoqq kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Meta kont żgħir, kont nisma' lin-nannu jdoqq kuljum.
messages.zh: 小时候，我每天都会听爷爷演奏。
messages.en: When I was little, I used to listen to my grandfather play every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从源头指向结果的箭头：家族指向后代，经历指向兴趣，繁育指向后代个体；重点记“由哪里来、怎样被产生”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Medicine as a field of knowledge and professional practice, or the medical profession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为知识领域和职业实践的医学、行医，或医疗这一职业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qasam tal-għarfien u tal-prattika medika, jew il-professjoni tat-tobba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 医疗职业；医生这一职业。
医学；医术；医疗实践。

formal.mt: Il-prattika tat-tobbija teħtieġ għarfien xjentifiku, responsabbiltà u rispett lejn il-pazjenti.
formal.en: The practice of medicine requires scientific knowledge, responsibility, and respect for patients.
formal.zh: 行医需要科学知识、责任感以及对患者的尊重。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għażilt it-tobbija? Mark: Għax inħobb ix-xjenza u nixtieq ngħin lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you choose medicine? Mark: Because I like science and want to help people.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么选择医学？Mark：因为我喜欢科学，也希望帮助别人。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么选择医学？
messages.en: Why did you choose medicine?

messages.speaker: Mark (医学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax inħobb ix-xjenza u nixtieq ngħin lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Għax inħobb ix-xjenza u nixtieq ngħin lin-nies.
messages.zh: 因为我喜欢科学，也希望帮助别人。
messages.en: Because I like science and want to help people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件白大褂同时代表课堂里的医学知识和诊室里的行医工作；这里的 medicine 要联想“医学”，不要联想一粒药。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The taste or flavour perceived when eating or drinking something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃东西或喝饮品时感受到的味道、滋味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jinħass fil-ħalq meta wieħed jiekol jew jixrob xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 味道；口中尝到的滋味。
风味；食物或饮品的滋味。
味道；滋味；风味。

formal.mt: Iż-żieda ta' ftit lumi tagħti lis-soppa togħma friska.
formal.en: Adding a little lemon gives the soup a fresh flavour.
formal.zh: 加入少许柠檬会使汤带有清新的风味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhi t-togħma tas-soppa? Ben: Tajba ħafna, imma għandha bżonn ftit melħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does the soup taste? Ben: Very good, but it needs a little salt.
colloquial.zh: Lara：汤的味道怎么样？Ben：很好，不过还需要加一点盐。

messages.speaker: Lara (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 汤的味道怎么样？
messages.en: How does the soup taste?

messages.speaker: Ben (用餐的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajba ħafna, imma għandha bżonn ftit melħ.
messages.mt_standard: Tajba ħafna, imma għandha bżonn ftit melħ.
messages.zh: 很好，不过还需要加一点盐。
messages.en: Very good, but it needs a little salt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 每次尝一口食物就问自己“什么味道”：甜的配 ħelwa，苦的配 morra；用舌尖的实际感受记住 togħma。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A toilet or lavatory, referring to the sanitary fixture or the room containing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人如厕的卫生设施，也可指设有该设施的厕所或洗手间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-apparat sanitarju li jintuża għall-bżonnijiet tal-ġisem, jew il-kamra fejn jinsab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厕所；坐便器等如厕设施。
厕所；洗手间。

formal.mt: It-tojlit pubbliku jinsab fil-pjan terran, ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The public toilet is on the ground floor, next to the main entrance.
formal.zh: 公共洗手间位于底层，靠近主入口。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Skużani, fejn hu t-tojlit? Rita: Fl-aħħar tal-kuritur, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Mark: Excuse me, where is the toilet? Rita: At the end of the corridor, on the left.
colloquial.zh: Mark：打扰一下，洗手间在哪里？Rita：在走廊尽头的左边。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 打扰一下，洗手间在哪里？
messages.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 在走廊尽头的左边。
messages.en: At the end of the corridor, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tojlit 和公共场所的洗手间标志一起记，再完整练习“Skużani, fejn hu t-tojlit?”，让词义直接连上问路场景。

gloss_zh: tomna（土地面积或干容量单位）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit used to measure land area or the dry volume of goods such as grain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于计量土地面积或谷物等干货体积的单位；具体数值须根据计量对象判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità li tintuża biex titkejjel l-art jew il-volum ta' prodotti niexfa bħall-qamħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 土地面积单位 tumolo，马耳他语称 tomna。

sense_translations.en_definition: a unit of dry volume, equivalent to 10 siegħ, that is officially 0.6422 imperial cubic feet (18.18 L).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 干容量单位，等于 10 siegħ；法定值为 0.6422 英制立方英尺，即 18.18 升。

sense_translations.en_definition: a unit of surface area, equivalent to 6 siegħ, that is officially 1,344 imperial square yards (1,124 m2).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 面积单位，等于 6 siegħ；法定值为 1,344 英制平方码，即 1,124 平方米。

formal.mt: L-għalqa għandha erja ta' tomna, jiġifieri 1,124 metru kwadru.
formal.en: The field has an area of one tomna, equivalent to 1,124 square metres.
formal.zh: 这块田的面积为一 tomna，即 1,124 平方米。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn miktub 'tomna qamħ'. Dan kejl tal-art? Pawlu: Le, hawn qed ikejjel il-volum tal-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: It says 'a tomna of wheat' here. Is that a measure of land? Pawlu: No, here it measures the volume of the wheat.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里写着“一 tomna 小麦”。这是土地面积单位吗？保罗：不是，这里计量的是小麦的体积。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'tomna qamħ'. Dan kejl tal-art?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'tomna qamħ'. Dan kejl tal-art?
messages.zh: 这里写着“一 tomna 小麦”。这是土地面积单位吗？
messages.en: It says 'a tomna of wheat' here. Is that a measure of land?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn qed ikejjel il-volum tal-qamħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn qed ikejjel il-volum tal-qamħ.
messages.zh: 不是，这里计量的是小麦的体积。
messages.en: No, here it measures the volume of the wheat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tomna 配成两幅画：一块农田和一袋小麦；看到土地想到面积，看到谷物想到干容量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tuna, either the fish itself or its flesh used as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 金枪鱼，也指作为食物食用的金枪鱼肉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta li tissejjaħ tonn, jew il-laħam tagħha li jittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金枪鱼；金枪鱼肉。

formal.mt: Għal din l-insalata, ħallat it-tonn mat-tadam u żid ftit żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: For this salad, mix the tuna with the tomatoes and add a little olive oil.
formal.zh: 制作这道沙拉时，将金枪鱼与番茄拌匀，再加入少许橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftira bit-tonn? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma mingħajr basal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a ftira with tuna? Mark: Yes, please, but without onions.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想吃金枪鱼馅的马耳他扁面包吗？马克：想，谢谢，不过不要洋葱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃金枪鱼馅的马耳他扁面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like a ftira with tuna?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma mingħajr basal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma mingħajr basal.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢，不过不要洋葱。
messages.en: Yes, please, but without onions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tonn 记在金枪鱼罐头的图画旁，再配上一盘金枪鱼沙拉，同时记住鱼和鱼肉两种指法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hole or opening in a surface or object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体或表面上的洞、孔或开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fetħa f'wiċċ jew f'oġġett, bħal f'ħajt jew f'biċċa drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洞；孔；物体上的开口。

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żebgħa, għandha tissewwa t-toqba fil-ħajt.
formal.en: Before painting, the hole in the wall should be repaired.
formal.zh: 刷漆之前，应先修补墙上的洞。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara, hemm toqba fil-borża! Ben: Mela poġġi kollox f'din il-borża l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look, there's a hole in the bag! Ben: Then put everything in this other bag.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：看，袋子上有个洞！本：那就把东西都放进另一个袋子里吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，袋子上有个洞！
messages.en: Look, there's a hole in the bag!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela poġġi kollox f'din il-borża l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Mela poġġi kollox f'din il-borża l-oħra.
messages.zh: 那就把东西都放进另一个袋子里吧。
messages.en: Then put everything in this other bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象袜子上露出脚趾的小洞，把 toqba 写在洞旁，再联想到墙洞和袋子破洞，统一记成“洞、孔”。

gloss_zh: 用于贬损同性恋者的形容词（冒犯性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An offensive adjective used to disparage someone as homosexual or to mock perceived homosexual traits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有冒犯性的形容词，用于贬损同性恋者，或嘲弄被说话者视为同性恋的特征；不宜用于称呼或评价他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv offensiv u dispreġġjattiv li jintuża biex jinsulta lil xi ħadd b'rabta mal-omosesswalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同性恋的（贬义、冒犯性表达）。
被蔑称为有同性恋特征的；同性恋的（带有侮辱意味）。
用于贬损男同性恋者的辱称性表达；所列英语对应词均带有冒犯性，此处保留形容词分类。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-aġġettiv 'toqbi' huwa diskuss bħala kelma offensiva li m'għandhiex tintuża biex tiddeskrivi persuna.
formal.en: In this exercise, the adjective 'toqbi' is discussed as an offensive word that should not be used to describe a person.
formal.zh: 本练习将形容词“toqbi”作为冒犯性词语加以讨论；不应使用它来描述一个人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'toqbi'? Rita: Hija kelma offensiva marbuta mal-omosesswalità; aħjar ma tużahiex dwar in-nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word 'toqbi' mean? Rita: It's an offensive word connected with homosexuality; it's best not to use it about people.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“toqbi”这个词是什么意思？丽塔：这是一个涉及同性恋的冒犯性词语，最好不要用它来称说别人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “toqbi”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'toqbi' mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija kelma offensiva marbuta mal-omosesswalità; aħjar ma tużahiex dwar in-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Hija kelma offensiva marbuta mal-omosesswalità; aħjar ma tużahiex dwar in-nies.
messages.zh: 这是一个涉及同性恋的冒犯性词语，最好不要用它来称说别人。
messages.en: It's an offensive word connected with homosexuality; it's best not to use it about people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 toqbi 旁画一个红色警示标记：认读时识别贬损语气，表达时避免拿它评价别人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The light frying of ingredients, such as vegetables or onions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将食材轻轻煎炒的烹饪操作，常用于蔬菜、洋葱等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qali ħafif ta' ingredjenti, bħal ħaxix jew basal.

sense_translations.en_definition: light frying (e.g. of vegetables or onions)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻煎、略炒，例如对蔬菜或洋葱进行的轻度煎炒。
轻度煎炒这一烹饪操作。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tibda b'toqlija tal-basal qabel jiżdied it-tadam.
formal.en: The recipe begins with lightly frying the onions before the tomatoes are added.
formal.zh: 这道食谱先略炒洋葱，然后加入番茄。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'nagħmel bil-basal? Pawlu: Agħmillu toqlija, imbagħad żid it-tadam.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should I do with the onions? Pawlu: Fry them lightly, then add the tomatoes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：洋葱该怎么处理？保罗：略炒一下，然后加入番茄。

messages.speaker: Nina (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 洋葱该怎么处理？
messages.en: What should I do with the onions?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (厨师)
messages.zh: 略炒一下，然后加入番茄。
messages.en: Fry them lightly, then add the tomatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锅里轻轻翻动洋葱的画面，把 toqlija 记成一道“略炒”的操作，并连读 toqlija tal-basal。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Weight or heaviness, also used figuratively for difficulty or a burden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体的重量或沉重感，也可比喻困难、压力或需要承担的重担。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-piż ta' xi ħaġa jew il-fatt li tkun tqila; b'mod figurattiv, diffikultà jew piż li wieħed irid iġorr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重量；物体有多重。
沉重；沉甸甸的状态或感觉。
困难；事情难以处理或完成的程度。
重物；负担；需要承受或背负的重担。

formal.mt: It-toqol tar-responsabbiltà jinħass aktar meta d-deċiżjoni taffettwa ħafna nies.
formal.en: The burden of responsibility is felt more strongly when the decision affects many people.
formal.zh: 当决定影响许多人时，责任的重担会显得更加沉重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nistax nerfa' din il-kaxxa minħabba t-toqol tagħha. Mark: Stenna, ngħinek inġorruha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I can't lift this box because of its weight. Mark: Wait, I'll help you; we'll carry it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个箱子太重，我抬不起来。马克：等等，我来帮你，我们一起搬。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax nerfa' din il-kaxxa minħabba t-toqol tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax nerfa' din il-kaxxa minħabba t-toqol tagħha.
messages.zh: 这个箱子太重，我抬不起来。
messages.en: I can't lift this box because of its weight.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 等等，我来帮你，我们一起搬。
messages.en: Wait, I'll help you; we'll carry it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想肩上箱子的重量，再想肩上责任的重担；用同一个“沉重”画面串起 toqol 的实物义和比喻义。

gloss_zh: 土耳其的；土耳其人；另有奥斯曼及冒犯性义项

teaching_sense.en_definition: Turkish: coming from Turkey or relating to its people or culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 土耳其的；来自土耳其的，或与土耳其人民、文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mit-Turkija jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-poplu jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 土耳其的。

sense_translations.en_definition: coming from or related to Turkey
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自土耳其的；与土耳其有关的。
一个土耳其人。
那个土耳其人；所指的土耳其人。
奥斯曼的；与奥斯曼帝国有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: non-Christian or not properly Christian; impious; not (yet) baptised
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非基督徒的，或被认为不符合基督徒规范的；不虔敬的；尚未受洗的。其中涉及宗教评价的表达带有贬损意味，须结合语境理解。
肤色深的；以带有种族歧视色彩的措辞描述黑人外貌特征的。此义具有冒犯性。

formal.mt: Il-programm kulturali jinkludi film Tork b'sottotitli bil-Malti.
formal.en: The cultural programme includes a Turkish film with Maltese subtitles.
formal.zh: 这项文化活动包括一部配有马耳他语字幕的土耳其电影。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid kafè Tork? Ben: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, mingħajr zokkor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like Turkish coffee? Ben: Yes, please, without sugar.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想喝土耳其咖啡吗？本：想，谢谢，不加糖。

messages.speaker: Sara (主人)
messages.zh: 你想喝土耳其咖啡吗？
messages.en: Would you like Turkish coffee?

messages.speaker: Ben (客人)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢，不加糖。
messages.en: Yes, please, without sugar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一杯 kafè Tork 记住“土耳其的”；再用“某个土耳其人”区分名词义，宗教和肤色义另加语境警示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hand tool used to tighten or loosen screws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于拧紧或拧松螺丝的手工工具，即螺丝刀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-idejn li tintuża biex tissikka jew tħoll il-viti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 螺丝刀；用于拧动螺丝的起子。

collocations.en: to tighten a screw with a screwdriver

formal.mt: Uża tornavit adattat biex tissikka l-vit mingħajr ma tagħmel ħsara lir-ras tiegħu.
formal.en: Use a suitable screwdriver to tighten the screw without damaging its head.
formal.zh: 使用合适的螺丝刀拧紧螺丝，避免损坏螺丝头。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tgħaddili t-tornavit? Nina: Żgur, qiegħed ħdejn il-kaxxa tal-għodda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you pass me the screwdriver? Nina: Sure, it's next to the toolbox.
colloquial.zh: 马克：能把螺丝刀递给我吗？妮娜：当然，它就在工具箱旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 能把螺丝刀递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the screwdriver?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，它就在工具箱旁边。
messages.en: Sure, it's next to the toolbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tornavit 写在螺丝刀手柄的想象标签上，边做拧螺丝的手势边读，记住它能拧紧也能拧松。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tall, narrow structure, standing on its own or forming part of a larger building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 独立矗立或作为较大建筑一部分的高而较窄的建筑物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini għoli u dejjaq li jista' jkun waħdu jew jagħmel parti minn bini akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塔；高塔。

formal.mt: It-torri jinsab fuq l-għolja u jidher minn ħafna postijiet fir-raħal.
formal.en: The tower stands on the hill and can be seen from many places in the village.
formal.zh: 这座塔位于山丘上，从村里的许多地方都能看到。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tara dak it-torri? Mark: Iva, hemm fuq l-għolja. Immorru narawh?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see that tower? Mark: Yes, up there on the hill. Shall we go and see it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到那座塔了吗？Mark：看到了，就在山丘上。我们去看看吧？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那座塔了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that tower?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm fuq l-għolja. Immorru narawh?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm fuq l-għolja. Immorru narawh?
messages.zh: 看到了，就在山丘上。我们去看看吧？
messages.en: Yes, up there on the hill. Shall we go and see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 torri 和山丘上高高的塔连在一起记，再用 torri għoli 练习说“一座高塔”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaving or speaking with bold disrespect and little or no embarrassment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言行大胆无礼、放肆，而且很少或完全不感到羞愧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem jew iġib ruħu bla rispett u bla mistħija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厚颜无耻的；明目张胆而不知羞耻的。
放肆的；说话或举止冒失、不够尊重人的。
无礼的；对他人缺乏应有尊重的。
无耻的、厚颜的、猥亵的或肆无忌惮地无礼的。

formal.mt: L-istudent kien tost mal-għalliem u baqa' jitkellem b'nuqqas ta' rispett minkejja t-twissija.
formal.en: The student was impertinent to the teacher and continued speaking disrespectfully despite the warning.
formal.zh: 这名学生对老师出言无礼，受到警告后仍继续用不尊重的口吻说话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt kif kellimni? Pawlu: Iva, kien tost miegħek. Ma kellux għalfejn ikellmek hekk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear how he spoke to me? Pawlu: Yes, he was rude to you. There was no need for him to speak to you like that.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你听见他怎么跟我说话了吗？Pawlu：听见了，他对你太无礼了。他没必要那样跟你说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见他怎么跟我说话了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how he spoke to me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien tost miegħek. Ma kellux għalfejn ikellmek hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien tost miegħek. Ma kellux għalfejn ikellmek hekk.
messages.zh: 听见了，他对你太无礼了。他没必要那样跟你说话。
messages.en: Yes, he was rude to you. There was no need for him to speak to you like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人受了提醒还昂着头说无礼的话，用 tost 给这种厚颜、放肆的态度贴标签。

gloss_zh: 受冷风吹；通风；衣物通风晾放

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exposure to moving or cold air, including ventilation and the airing of clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接触流动空气或冷空气，也指让空间通风或让衣物接触空气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espożizzjoni għall-arja jew għall-kesħa, inkluż id-dħul tal-arja f'post u t-tqegħid tal-ħwejjeġ għall-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴露于寒冷之中；受冷。
通风；使空气流通。
将衣物等放在空气流通处晾放、散气。
让自己暴露在冷空气中；让冷风吹到自己。

formal.mt: It-tperriċ tal-ħwejjeġ isir billi jitqiegħdu f'post fejn tiċċirkola l-arja.
formal.en: Clothes are aired by placing them somewhere with circulating air.
formal.zh: 衣物通风晾放，是把衣物放在空气流通的地方。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ħriġt il-kowtijiet barra? Rita: Għat-tperriċ. Daħħalhom ġewwa aktar tard, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you put the coats outside? Rita: To air them. Please bring them inside later.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么把外套拿到外面去了？Rita：让它们通通风。晚点请把它们拿进来。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把外套拿到外面去了？
messages.en: Why did you put the coats outside?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tperriċ. Daħħalhom ġewwa aktar tard, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tperriċ. Daħħalhom ġewwa aktar tard, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 让它们通通风。晚点请把它们拿进来。
messages.en: To air them. Please bring them inside later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让空气吹到”串起 tperriċ：房间是通风，衣物是散气，人接触冷空气则是受冷风吹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or art of painting or drawing, or a picture produced through that activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绘画这一行为或艺术，也指通过绘画产生的图画或画作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-arti li wieħed ipinġi, jew stampa magħmula b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绘画；绘制的画作。
画图；绘制的图画。
文身；刺在皮肤上的图案。
动词 pinġa 的动名词，表示绘画这一行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: the act or art of painting, drawing, depicting
sense_translations.zh_definition: 绘画、画图或描绘的行为或艺术。
图片、画作或图画。

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni tat-tpinġija, l-istudenti għamlu tpinġija bil-lapes ta' siġra.
formal.en: During the drawing lesson, the students made a pencil drawing of a tree.
formal.zh: 绘画课上，学生们用铅笔画了一棵树。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din it-tpinġija tiegħek? Ben: Iva, għamiltha lbieraħ. Togħġbok?
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this drawing yours? Ben: Yes, I made it yesterday. Do you like it?
colloquial.zh: Sara：这幅画是你画的吗？Ben：是的，我昨天画的。你喜欢吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这幅画是你画的吗？
messages.en: Is this drawing yours?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，我昨天画的。你喜欢吗？
messages.en: Yes, I made it yesterday. Do you like it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“上绘画课”和“拿出一幅画”两个画面：tpinġija 既能指绘画活动，也能指画出来的作品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fight or wrestle with someone, or to struggle determinedly against difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与人搏斗或摔跤，也指面对困难时奋力抗争、努力克服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġġieled jew jissielet ma' xi ħadd, jew jagħmel sforz kbir biex jegħleb id-diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打斗；搏斗。
挣扎；奋力抗争。
在不利条件下奋力争取；迎难而上。
搏斗；摔跤；与人扭打。

collocations.zh: 为取得成功而奋力拼搏

formal.mt: L-atleta tqabad mal-avversarju tiegħu sal-aħħar tal-logħba.
formal.en: The athlete wrestled with his opponent until the end of the match.
formal.zh: 这名运动员与对手一直搏斗到比赛结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kien faċli għal Daniel biex jispiċċa l-kors? Luqa: Le, tqabad ħafna biex jirnexxi, imma fl-aħħar għadda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was it easy for Daniel to finish the course? Luqa: No, he struggled a lot to succeed, but he passed in the end.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Daniel 完成这门课程容易吗？Luqa：不容易，他为了成功付出了很大努力，不过最后通过了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien faċli għal Daniel biex jispiċċa l-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Kien faċli għal Daniel biex jispiċċa l-kors?
messages.zh: Daniel 完成这门课程容易吗？
messages.en: Was it easy for Daniel to finish the course?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tqabad ħafna biex jirnexxi, imma fl-aħħar għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tqabad ħafna biex jirnexxi, imma fl-aħħar għadda.
messages.zh: 不容易，他为了成功付出了很大努力，不过最后通过了。
messages.en: No, he struggled a lot to succeed, but he passed in the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqabad 想成“用力较量”：面对人可以是搏斗，面对困难可以是奋力抗争。

gloss_zh: 变僵硬；因低温开裂；变得像木头一样硬

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become stiff or very hard, or to crack because of low temperature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得僵硬或十分坚硬，也可指因低温而开裂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir riġidu jew iebes ħafna, jew jixxaqqaq minħabba temperatura baxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变僵硬；失去柔韧性。

sense_translations.en_definition: to crack because of low temperature
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因低温而开裂；冻裂。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become as hard as wood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得像木头一样坚硬。

collocations.en: hardened and became as hard as wood
collocations.zh: 变硬，变得像木头一样坚硬

formal.mt: Il-materjal tqaddeb minħabba t-temperatura baxxa u sar diffiċli biex jitgħawweġ.
formal.en: The material stiffened because of the low temperature and became difficult to bend.
formal.zh: 这种材料因低温而变僵硬，变得难以弯曲。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dan il-materjal m'għadux jitgħawweġ? Nina: Tqaddeb bil-kesħa. Issa sar iebes ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why doesn't this material bend anymore? Nina: It stiffened in the cold. Now it is very hard.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这种材料怎么弯不动了？Nina：它受冷变僵硬了。现在变得很硬。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 这种材料怎么弯不动了？
messages.en: Why doesn't this material bend anymore?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tqaddeb bil-kesħa. Issa sar iebes ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Tqaddeb bil-kesħa. Issa sar iebes ħafna.
messages.zh: 它受冷变僵硬了。现在变得很硬。
messages.en: It stiffened in the cold. Now it is very hard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原本能弯，后来硬得像木头”的变化记 tqaddeb；遇到低温语境时，再联系冻裂这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become worn or worn out through use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品因使用而磨损、变旧，或达到破旧不堪的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mikul jew jintlibes ħafna minħabba l-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨损；逐渐用旧或用坏。
被用旧；磨损得很厉害；变得破旧。

collocations.en: a coat that has become worn

formal.mt: Il-kowt tqaddem wara snin ta' użu, u d-drapp tiegħu sar irqiq.
formal.en: The coat became worn after years of use, and its fabric became thin.
formal.zh: 这件外套穿了多年后变得破旧，布料也变薄了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadek tilbes dak il-kowt? Pawlu: Iva, imma tqaddem ħafna. Wasal iż-żmien li nixtri wieħed ġdid.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you still wear that coat? Pawlu: Yes, but it has become very worn. It is time for me to buy a new one.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你还穿那件外套吗？Pawlu：穿，不过已经很旧了。该买件新的了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还穿那件外套吗？
messages.en: Do you still wear that coat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma tqaddem ħafna. Wasal iż-żmien li nixtri wieħed ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma tqaddem ħafna. Wasal iż-żmien li nixtri wieħed ġdid.
messages.zh: 穿，不过已经很旧了。该买件新的了。
messages.en: Yes, but it has become very worn. It is time for me to buy a new one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqaddem 配上一件穿薄了的旧外套，重点记住“经过使用而变旧、磨损”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To increase in weight or become heavy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重量增加，或从较轻的状态变得沉重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fil-piż jew isir tqil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得更重；重量比原来增加。
变重；变得沉重。

formal.mt: Il-basket tqal wara li żdiedu fih diversi kotba.
formal.en: The bag became heavier after several books were added to it.
formal.zh: 袋子里又放进几本书后，袋子变重了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-basket tqal! X'poġġejt fih? Ben: Żidt żewġ kotba. Tridni nġorru jien?
colloquial.en: Sara: The bag has become heavier! What did you put in it? Ben: I added two books. Would you like me to carry it?
colloquial.zh: Sara：袋子变重了！你往里面放了什么？Ben：我又放了两本书。要我来提吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 袋子变重了！你往里面放了什么？
messages.en: The bag has become heavier! What did you put in it?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żidt żewġ kotba. Tridni nġorru jien?
messages.mt_standard: Żidt żewġ kotba. Tridni nġorru jien?
messages.zh: 我又放了两本书。要我来提吗？
messages.en: I added two books. Would you like me to carry it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往袋子里再放两本书，手上立刻更沉：用 tqal 记住“重量发生变化，变重了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition or period of carrying a developing baby in the womb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 女性体内孕育胎儿的状态或时期，即怀孕或妊娠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew il-perjodu li fih mara tkun qed iġġorr tarbija fil-ġuf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀孕；妊娠。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-esperjenzi tan-nisa waqt it-tqala.
formal.en: The report describes women's experiences during pregnancy.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了女性在怀孕期间的经历。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sejra t-tqala? Rita: Sejra tajjeb, grazzi. It-tarbija mistennija f'Mejju.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is the pregnancy going? Rita: It's going well, thanks. The baby is due in May.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：怀孕期间一切怎么样？丽塔：挺好的，谢谢。宝宝预计五月出生。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 怀孕期间一切怎么样？
messages.en: How is the pregnancy going?

messages.speaker: Rita (准妈妈)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejra tajjeb, grazzi. It-tarbija mistennija f'Mejju.
messages.mt_standard: Sejra tajjeb, grazzi. It-tarbija mistennija f'Mejju.
messages.zh: 挺好的，谢谢。宝宝预计五月出生。
messages.en: It's going well, thanks. The baby is due in May.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqala 和孕期日历的画面一起记，搭配 waqt it-tqala 就是在怀孕期间。

gloss_zh: 表现吝啬；变得小气；变得邋遢肮脏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave in a stingy way or become stingy; also, to become shabby and dirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得不愿花钱或给予他人，或变得吝啬；也可指变得破旧、邋遢而肮脏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod xħiħ jew isir xħiħ; jista' jfisser ukoll li jsir mitluq u maħmuġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to act in a miserly way
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得十分吝啬；在花钱或给予方面斤斤计较。
为人小气；不愿花钱或出钱。
变得破旧邋遢、肮脏不整洁。
变得吝啬；变得不愿花钱或给予他人。

collocations.en: acted stingily when it was time to pay
collocations.zh: 到了付钱时就表现得很小气

formal.mt: Meta ntalab jagħti sehem żgħir għall-ispejjeż komuni, tqammel u rrifjuta li jħallas.
formal.en: When asked to make a small contribution to the shared expenses, he acted stingily and refused to pay.
formal.zh: 当被要求为共同开支出一小份钱时，他表现得很吝啬，拒绝付款。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark ħallas sehmu għall-ikel? Nina: Le, tqammel anki fuq żewġ ewro.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark pay his share for the food? Nina: No, he was stingy even over two euros.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克付了自己的饭钱吗？妮娜：没有，连两欧元他都舍不得出。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克付了自己的饭钱吗？
messages.en: Did Mark pay his share for the food?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tqammel anki fuq żewġ ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tqammel anki fuq żewġ ewro.
messages.zh: 没有，连两欧元他都舍不得出。
messages.en: No, he was stingy even over two euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象付账时把钱包紧紧捂住的人，用这个画面记吝啬义；另把邋遢肮脏义单独做一张词义卡。

gloss_zh: 咯咯声；母鸡般的咯咯叫声

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cackling sound, such as the repeated calls made by a hen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咯咯的叫声，例如母鸡发出的连续叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ta' qaqqiq, bħal dak li tagħmel tiġieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咯咯叫声，例如母鸡的叫声。
咯咯声；咯咯的叫声。

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fir-razzett, it-tfal semgħu t-tqaqija tat-tiġieġ mill-bitħa.
formal.en: During the farm visit, the children heard the chickens cackling in the yard.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，孩子们听见了院子里鸡群的咯咯叫声。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'inhu dak il-ħoss mill-ġnien? Sara: Dik it-tqaqija tat-tiġieġa tal-ġar.
colloquial.en: Ben: What's that sound coming from the garden? Sara: That's the cackling of the neighbour's hen.
colloquial.zh: 本：花园里传来的是什么声音？萨拉：那是邻居家的母鸡在咯咯叫。

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 花园里传来的是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound coming from the garden?

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 那是邻居家的母鸡在咯咯叫。
messages.en: That's the cackling of the neighbour's hen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 tqaqija 时配上母鸡咯咯叫的画面，用声音场景帮助记忆；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。
