teaching_sense.en_definition: To become shorter or be made shorter, including when a text is summarised or abridged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变短或被缩短，也可指文字被概括、压缩或删节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iqsar jew jitnaqqas fit-tul; dwar test, jingħata f'forma mqassra jew jitħallew barra xi partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被缩短；长度或持续时间变短。
被概括；内容被整理为较简短的摘要。
被删节；删去部分内容而形成较短的版本。
qassar 的中被动态形式，表示变短或被缩短。

collocations.en: the duration of the meeting was shortened

formal.mt: It-test tqassar għal mitejn kelma biex jidħol fl-ispazju disponibbli.
formal.en: The text was shortened to two hundred words to fit the available space.
formal.zh: 文字被压缩到两百词，以适应现有版面。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex dan l-artiklu hu daqshekk qasir? Pawlu: Tqassar biex jidħol f'paġna waħda.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is this article so short? Pawlu: It was shortened to fit on one page.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这篇文章怎么这么短？保罗：为了放进一页，文章被缩短了。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-artiklu hu daqshekk qasir?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-artiklu hu daqshekk qasir?
messages.zh: 这篇文章怎么这么短？
messages.en: Why is this article so short?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 为了放进一页，文章被缩短了。
messages.en: It was shortened to fit on one page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一篇长文章被压进一页：篇幅缩短、内容概括、版本删节，都可以围绕 tqassar 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fight with another person or take part in a fight with one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人打斗，或指参与者彼此打斗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġġieled ma' persuna oħra, jew jiġġieldu ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打斗；与他人交战。
相互打斗；彼此交战。

collocations.en: got into a fight over money

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, iż-żewġt irġiel tqatlu barra mill-bini qabel waslet il-pulizija.
formal.en: According to the report, the two men fought outside the building before the police arrived.
formal.zh: 据报告，两名男子在警方到达前曾在楼外打斗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark tqatel ma' ħuh? Nina: Minħabba logħba, imma issa għamlu paċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark fight with his brother? Nina: Over a game, but they've made peace now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么和他兄弟打架？妮娜：因为一场游戏，不过他们现在已经和好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么和他兄弟打架？
messages.en: Why did Mark fight with his brother?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba logħba, imma issa għamlu paċi.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba logħba, imma issa għamlu paċi.
messages.zh: 因为一场游戏，不过他们现在已经和好了。
messages.en: Over a game, but they've made peace now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tqatel 放进两个人互相打斗的场景，连着 ma' ħuh 记作和他的兄弟打架，突出双方参与。

gloss_zh: 感到恶心或厌恶；炫耀；吹嘘

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel disgusted or nauseous, or find something repulsive; in another sense, to show off or brag.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到恶心、厌恶，或觉得某事物令人反感；另有炫耀、吹嘘的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss stmerrija jew dardir, jew isib xi ħaġa mistkerrha; f'sens ieħor, jiftaħar jew jiddandan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到厌恶；产生反感。
炫耀；刻意展示自己拥有的东西或本领。
吹嘘；夸耀自己。
qażżeż 的中被动态形式。
感到厌恶、恶心或作呕。
厌恶；觉得某事物可憎或令人反感。

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur tqażżeż bir-riħa qawwija tal-iskart u telaq mill-post.
formal.en: The visitor was disgusted by the strong smell of the rubbish and left the area.
formal.zh: 访客被垃圾的浓烈气味恶心到了，便离开了那里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kulħadd iddejjaq b'Mark ilbieraħ? Ben: Għax tqażżeż bil-flus tiegħu l-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why was everyone annoyed with Mark yesterday? Ben: Because he kept showing off his money.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天大家为什么都烦马克？本：因为他一直在炫耀自己有钱。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天大家为什么都烦马克？
messages.en: Why was everyone annoyed with Mark yesterday?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tqażżeż bil-flus tiegħu l-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tqażżeż bil-flus tiegħu l-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 因为他一直在炫耀自己有钱。
messages.en: Because he kept showing off his money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tqażżeż 配两幅记忆图：闻到臭味而皱眉，以及拿着钱不停炫耀；靠语境区分这两组意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Following customs, practices, or styles passed down over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遵循长期传承的习俗、做法或风格的；具有传统特色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimxi ma' drawwiet, prattiċi jew stili li jgħaddu minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传统的；遵循世代传承的习俗或做法的。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festival jinkludi mużika tradizzjonali u wirja ta' artiġjanat lokali.
formal.en: The festival programme includes traditional music and an exhibition of local crafts.
formal.zh: 节庆活动安排包括传统音乐和本地手工艺展览。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nsajru għall-mistednin? Rita: Nagħmlu xi ikel tradizzjonali, bħalma kienet issajjar in-nanna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we cook for the guests? Rita: Let's make some traditional food, like Grandma used to cook.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：我们给客人做什么吃的？丽塔：做些传统食物吧，就像奶奶以前做的那样。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 我们给客人做什么吃的？
messages.en: What shall we cook for the guests?

messages.speaker: Rita (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu xi ikel tradizzjonali, bħalma kienet issajjar in-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu xi ikel tradizzjonali, bħalma kienet issajjar in-nanna.
messages.zh: 做些传统食物吧，就像奶奶以前做的那样。
messages.en: Let's make some traditional food, like Grandma used to cook.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tradizzjonali 放在奶奶传下来的食谱旁，联想世代沿用的做法；连记传统食物和传统音乐两个搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that follows customs or practices passed down over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照长期流传的风俗或惯例；用于说明人们历来如何做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont drawwiet li għaddew minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传统上；按照世代相传的习俗或长期惯例。

formal.mt: Tradizzjonalment, il-familji jinġabru flimkien biex jiċċelebraw din il-festa.
formal.en: Traditionally, families gather together to celebrate this feast.
formal.zh: 按照传统，各家人会聚在一起庆祝这个节日。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tiċċelebraw din il-festa? Pawlu: Tradizzjonalment, nieklu flimkien għand in-nanna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you celebrate this feast? Pawlu: Traditionally, we eat together at Grandma's.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们怎么庆祝这个节日？保罗：按照传统，我们会一起去奶奶家吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们怎么庆祝这个节日？
messages.en: How do you celebrate this feast?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 按照传统，我们会一起去奶奶家吃饭。
messages.en: Traditionally, we eat together at Grandma's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每年节日都去奶奶家吃饭，用 tradizzjonalment 给整件事加上“按照传统”的说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A custom, belief, or practice passed down within a family or community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 家庭或群体长期传承的习俗、观念或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drawwa, twemmin jew prattika li tgħaddi minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra f'familja jew f'komunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传统；家庭或群体长期传承的习俗、观念或做法。

formal.mt: Il-komunità żżomm din it-tradizzjoni ħajja billi torganizza festa kull sena.
formal.en: The community keeps this tradition alive by organizing a feast every year.
formal.zh: 这个社区每年举办一次节庆活动，使这项传统得以延续。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tagħmlu dan il-ħelu kull sena? Nina: Hija tradizzjoni tal-familja tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you make these sweets every year? Nina: It's a tradition in our family.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们为什么每年都做这些甜食？妮娜：这是我们家的传统。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tagħmlu dan il-ħelu kull sena?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tagħmlu dan il-ħelu kull sena?
messages.zh: 你们为什么每年都做这些甜食？
messages.en: Why do you make these sweets every year?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是我们家的传统。
messages.en: It's a tradition in our family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tradizzjoni 记成全家年年重复、还会教给下一代的习惯；这个名词指“传统”本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of expressing spoken or written content in another language, or the text produced by doing so.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将口头或书面内容转换成另一种语言的行为，也指由此产生的译文或译作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kliem jew test jinqaleb minn lingwa għal oħra, jew it-test li jirriżulta minn dan il-proċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻译这一行为或过程；把一种语言的内容转换成另一种语言。
译作；由另一种语言翻译而成的作品。
翻译；也可指翻译所得的译文。

collocations.en: a translation from Maltese into Chinese
collocations.zh: 从马耳他语译成中文的翻译

formal.mt: It-traduzzjoni ta' dan ir-rapport mill-Malti għall-Ingliż teħtieġ attenzjoni speċjali għat-termini tekniċi.
formal.en: Translating this report from Maltese into English requires special attention to technical terms.
formal.zh: 将这份报告从马耳他语译成英语时，需要特别注意技术术语。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ktieb huwa traduzzjoni? Sara: Iva, huwa traduzzjoni għall-Malti ta' rumanz bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this book a translation? Sara: Yes, it's a Maltese translation of a novel in English.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书是译作吗？萨拉：是的，它是一部英语小说的马耳他语译本。

messages.speaker: Mark (读者)
messages.zh: 这本书是译作吗？
messages.en: Is this book a translation?

messages.speaker: Sara (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa traduzzjoni għall-Malti ta' rumanz bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa traduzzjoni għall-Malti ta' rumanz bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 是的，它是一部英语小说的马耳他语译本。
messages.en: Yes, it's a Maltese translation of a novel in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一本书左右摆着两种语言版本：traduzzjoni 既能指转换语言的过程，也能指完成的译本。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large road vehicle used mainly for carrying goods or heavy loads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要用于在道路上运输货物或重物的大型机动车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura kbira tat-triq li tintuża l-aktar biex iġġorr merkanzija jew tagħbijiet tqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卡车；用于运输货物的大型机动车。
卡车；货车，用于道路货物运输的车辆。

formal.mt: It-trakk wasal fil-maħżen filgħodu biex iwassal il-merkanzija.
formal.en: The truck arrived at the warehouse in the morning to deliver the goods.
formal.zh: 卡车早上抵达仓库运送货物。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Wasal it-trakk tal-kunsinna? Rita: Iva, qiegħed barra ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has the delivery truck arrived? Rita: Yes, it's outside next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 马克：送货卡车到了吗？丽塔：到了，就在外面门旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.zh: 送货卡车到了吗？
messages.en: Has the delivery truck arrived?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 到了，就在外面门旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's outside next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 trakk 就想象一辆装着纸箱的送货卡车，并把词尾双写的 kk 一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The compass direction opposite south, or the northern part of an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与南相对的方位，也可指某个地区的北部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-direzzjoni opposta għan-nofsinhar, jew il-parti ta' żona li tinsab f'dik id-direzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 北；北方；某个地区的北部。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi li r-raħal jinsab fit-tramuntana tal-gżira.
formal.en: The map shows that the village is in the north of the island.
formal.zh: 地图显示，这个村庄位于岛的北部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema direzzjoni għandna nimxu? David: Lejn it-tramuntana, skont il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which direction should we walk in? David: Towards the north, according to the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们该朝哪个方向走？戴维：按地图看，应该向北走。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们该朝哪个方向走？
messages.en: Which direction should we walk in?

messages.speaker: David (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 按地图看，应该向北走。
messages.en: Towards the north, according to the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在指南针的北向箭头旁写 tramuntana，再用 lejn it-tramuntana 练习表达“向北走”的方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal agreement between states, or a detailed written study of a particular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国家之间正式订立的条约，也指详细论述某一专题的著作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim formali bejn stati, jew kitba dettaljata li tittratta suġġett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 条约；国家之间正式订立的协议。
专题论著；系统、详细论述某一主题的著作。

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ pajjiżi ffirmaw trattat ta' paċi wara xhur ta' negozjati.
formal.en: The two countries signed a peace treaty after months of negotiations.
formal.zh: 经过数月谈判，两国签署了一项和平条约。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'qed taqra għall-kors? Mark: Trattat dwar il-filosofija; jispjega s-suġġett fid-dettall.
colloquial.en: Anna: What are you reading for the course? Mark: A treatise on philosophy; it explains the subject in detail.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你在为课程读什么？马克：一部哲学论著，里面详细讲解了这个主题。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你在为课程读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading for the course?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Trattat dwar il-filosofija; jispjega s-suġġett fid-dettall.
messages.mt_standard: Trattat dwar il-filosofija; jispjega s-suġġett fid-dettall.
messages.zh: 一部哲学论著，里面详细讲解了这个主题。
messages.en: A treatise on philosophy; it explains the subject in detail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 trattat 画两张卡片：一张是两国签署的条约，一张是详细讲解哲学的论著，靠语境区分两义。

gloss_zh: 被养育；受到熏陶；经培养而熟练

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be brought up or shaped by an environment, or to develop proficiency through training.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某种环境中成长、受到习惯或观念的熏陶，也可指经过培养而掌握某项技能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tikber f'ambjent li jsawwar id-drawwiet jew il-fehmiet tiegħek, jew li ssir kapaċi f'xi ħaġa bit-taħriġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被养育；在某种环境中长大。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be inculcated with habits or views
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到某些习惯或观念的熏陶；被培养出某种习惯或看法。
rawwem 的中间态或被动态：受到养育、培养或熏陶。
通过学习或训练而熟练掌握某事；练就某种本领。

collocations.en: was brought up in an environment of respect
collocations.zh: 在相互尊重的环境中长大
经过培养而熟练掌握这门手艺

formal.mt: It-tifel trawwem f'ambjent fejn il-qari kien parti mill-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The boy was brought up in an environment where reading was part of everyday life.
formal.zh: 这个男孩成长的环境中，阅读是日常生活的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sar daqshekk tajjeb fit-tisjir? Pawlu: Traw wem ma' nanntu, li kienet issajjar miegħu kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he become so good at cooking? Pawlu: He grew up with his grandmother, who used to cook with him every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他的厨艺怎么变得这么好？保罗：他跟着奶奶长大，奶奶以前每天都和他一起做饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他的厨艺怎么变得这么好？
messages.en: How did he become so good at cooking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Traw wem ma' nanntu, li kienet issajjar miegħu kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Traw wem ma' nanntu, li kienet issajjar miegħu kuljum.
messages.zh: 他跟着奶奶长大，奶奶以前每天都和他一起做饭。
messages.en: He grew up with his grandmother, who used to cook with him every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“环境慢慢塑造人”的画面记忆：从被养育、受熏陶，延伸到经训练而熟练。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mark or sign left by someone or something that shows its presence or passage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人或某物留下的印记或迹象，表明其曾经存在或经过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka jew sinjal li jħalli xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa u li juri li kien hemm jew għadda minn hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痕迹；踪迹；某人或某物留下的迹象。

formal.mt: L-investigaturi sabu traċċa ta' tajn ħdejn it-tieqa miftuħa.
formal.en: The investigators found a trace of mud beside the open window.
formal.zh: 调查人员在敞开的窗户旁发现了一处泥迹。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Min daħal biż-żraben maħmuġin? Hemm traċċa ta' tajn mal-art. Leo: Jien, skużani. Innaddafha issa.
colloquial.en: Mum: Who came in wearing dirty shoes? There's a trace of mud on the floor. Leo: I did, sorry. I'll clean it up now.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：谁穿着脏鞋进来了？地板上有泥迹。莱奥：是我，对不起。我现在就擦干净。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Min daħal biż-żraben maħmuġin? Hemm traċċa ta' tajn mal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Min daħal biż-żraben maħmuġin? Hemm traċċa ta' tajn mal-art.
messages.zh: 谁穿着脏鞋进来了？地板上有泥迹。
messages.en: Who came in wearing dirty shoes? There's a trace of mud on the floor.

messages.speaker: Leo (儿子)
messages.zh: 是我，对不起。我现在就擦干净。
messages.en: I did, sorry. I'll clean it up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 traċċa 与地板上的泥迹连起来：人已经走过，痕迹仍然留下；再记 mingħajr traċċa 表示毫无踪迹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event causing great suffering or loss, or a serious dramatic work with an unhappy ending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成重大痛苦或损失的事件，也指以不幸结局为特点的严肃戏剧作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja li ġġib tbatija jew telf kbir, jew xogħol drammatiku serju b'tmiem ta' niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲剧；造成严重不幸的事件，或以悲惨结局为特点的戏剧作品。

formal.mt: L-għargħar kien traġedja għall-komunità, għax ħafna familji tilfu djarhom.
formal.en: The flood was a tragedy for the community because many families lost their homes.
formal.zh: 这场洪水对社区而言是一场惨剧，因为许多家庭失去了家园。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Id-dramm li rajt ilbieraħ kien kummiedja? David: Le, kien traġedja, u t-tmiem kien ta' niket.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was the play you saw yesterday a comedy? David: No, it was a tragedy, and the ending was sad.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你昨天看的戏是喜剧吗？戴维：不是，是悲剧，结局很悲伤。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dramm li rajt ilbieraħ kien kummiedja?
messages.mt_standard: Id-dramm li rajt ilbieraħ kien kummiedja?
messages.zh: 你昨天看的戏是喜剧吗？
messages.en: Was the play you saw yesterday a comedy?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien traġedja, u t-tmiem kien ta' niket.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien traġedja, u t-tmiem kien ta' niket.
messages.zh: 不是，是悲剧，结局很悲伤。
messages.en: No, it was a tragedy, and the ending was sad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 traġedja 配上悲剧舞台落幕的画面，再联系现实中的重大不幸，记住它可以指作品或事件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing or involving great sadness, suffering, or loss; relating to tragedy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引起或涉及重大悲伤、痛苦或损失的；与悲剧有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib jew jinvolvi niket, tbatija jew telf kbir, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mat-traġedja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲惨的；令人极为悲伤或涉及严重不幸的。
悲剧性的；悲惨的；与悲剧有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-inċident traġiku li fih tilfu ħajjithom żewġ persuni.
formal.en: The report describes the tragic accident in which two people lost their lives.
formal.zh: 报告描述了那起导致两人丧生的悲惨事故。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif spiċċa l-film? Pawlu: Kellu tmiem traġiku; il-karattru prinċipali miet.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the film end? Pawlu: It had a tragic ending; the main character died.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电影最后怎么样了？保罗：结局很悲惨，主角死了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影最后怎么样了？
messages.en: How did the film end?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu tmiem traġiku; il-karattru prinċipali miet.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu tmiem traġiku; il-karattru prinċipali miet.
messages.zh: 结局很悲惨，主角死了。
messages.en: It had a tragic ending; the main character died.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 traġiku 放在 tmiem“结局”后一起记：tmiem traġiku 是“悲惨的结局”，形容词负责说明性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat something to satisfy hunger, especially on an empty stomach or at breakfast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃些东西来填饱肚子，尤其指空腹时进食或吃早餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiekol xi ħaġa biex taqta' l-ġuħ, speċjalment meta tkun għadek ma kiltx jew waqt il-kolazzjon.

sense_translations.en_definition: to eat enough to satisfy one's appetite
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃到满足食欲；吃饱。
rejjaq 的中间态或被动态：自己进食、填饱肚子。

sense_translations.en_definition: to eat (especially on an empty stomach)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 进食；尤其指空着肚子时吃些东西。
吃早餐。

collocations.en: eat some bread and cheese to satisfy hunger
collocations.zh: 吃些面包和奶酪填肚子

collocations.en: have something to eat before work

formal.mt: Qabel beda x-xogħol, trejjaq b'ħobż u ġobon.
formal.en: Before starting work, he ate some bread and cheese.
formal.zh: 开始工作前，他吃了些面包和奶酪填肚子。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għadni ma kilt xejn dalgħodu. Lara: Trejjaq b'xi ħaġa qabel noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Mark: I haven't eaten anything yet this morning. Lara: Have something to eat before we go out.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天早上还什么都没吃。拉拉：我们出门前，你先吃点东西吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天早上还什么都没吃。
messages.en: I haven't eaten anything yet this morning.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们出门前，你先吃点东西吧。
messages.en: Have something to eat before we go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“早晨空腹，先吃一点再出门”的场景，连记进食、吃饱和早餐。

gloss_zh: 蜷缩；缩进角落；畏缩躲藏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To squeeze or huddle into a confined space or corner, sometimes out of fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把身体缩进狭小空间或角落，也可指因害怕而蜷缩、畏缩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tinġabar f'post dejjaq jew f'rokna, xi drabi minħabba l-biża'.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be in a tight space
sense_translations.zh_definition: 处在狭窄、拥挤的空间里；挤在狭小地方。

sense_translations.en_definition: to put oneself in a corner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己缩进角落；躲到角落里。
因恐惧而畏缩；吓得缩起身子。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cower, huddle (in a tight space)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 畏缩或蜷缩着挤在狭小空间里。

formal.mt: Il-qattus trekken f'rokna tal-kaxxa meta sema' l-ħoss qawwi.
formal.en: The cat huddled in a corner of the box when it heard the loud noise.
formal.zh: 猫听到巨响后，蜷缩到了箱子的一个角落里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn mar il-kelb? Toni: Trekken taħt il-mejda għax beża' mir-ragħad.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did the dog go? Toni: He cowered under the table because he was scared of the thunder.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：狗跑哪儿去了？托尼：它怕打雷，缩到桌子下面去了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 狗跑哪儿去了？
messages.en: Where did the dog go?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trekken taħt il-mejda għax beża' mir-ragħad.
messages.mt_standard: Trekken taħt il-mejda għax beża' mir-ragħad.
messages.zh: 它怕打雷，缩到桌子下面去了。
messages.en: He cowered under the table because he was scared of the thunder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只怕雷的小狗把身体缩进桌下角落，用“空间狭小加身体蜷缩”记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression of respect or admiration offered to a person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某个人或群体表达敬意、赞赏的言辞、活动或作品；致敬、献礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Turija ta' ġieħ, rispett jew ammirazzjoni lejn persuna jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 致敬；表达敬意或赞赏的献礼、言辞或举动。
归属；归因；把某事物归于某个人、来源或原因。

formal.mt: Il-kunċert kien tribut lill-għalliema li ħadmu għal ħafna snin fl-iskola.
formal.en: The concert was a tribute to the teachers who had worked at the school for many years.
formal.zh: 这场音乐会向在该校工作多年的教师致敬。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex għażiltu dawn il-kanzunetti? Ġanni: Bħala tribut lin-nannu; kienu l-kanzunetti favoriti tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you choose these songs? Ġanni: As a tribute to Grandpa; they were his favourite songs.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你们为什么选这些歌？詹尼：为了向爷爷致敬；这些都是他最喜欢的歌。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 你们为什么选这些歌？
messages.en: Why did you choose these songs?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħala tribut lin-nannu; kienu l-kanzunetti favoriti tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Bħala tribut lin-nannu; kienu l-kanzunetti favoriti tiegħu.
messages.zh: 为了向爷爷致敬；这些都是他最喜欢的歌。
messages.en: As a tribute to Grandpa; they were his favourite songs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一首献给敬重之人的歌记作 tribut；另把“归属、归因”单独列卡，避免混淆义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A social group whose members share a collective identity, traditions, and often kinship ties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成员具有共同群体认同、传统，并常有亲属联系的社会群体；部落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp soċjali li l-membri tiegħu għandhom identità u tradizzjonijiet komuni, u spiss rabtiet ta' parentela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 部落；具有共同群体认同、传统等联系的社会群体。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-lingwa u d-drawwiet ta' tribù waħda.
formal.en: The study describes the language and customs of one tribe.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了一个部落的语言和习俗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? David: Dwar tribù u t-tradizzjonijiet tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this book about? David: It's about a tribe and its traditions.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书讲什么？戴维：讲一个部落和它的传统。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 讲一个部落和它的传统。
messages.en: It's about a tribe and its traditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“共同身份、共同传统的一群人”搭建部落画面，并把词尾的重音符号一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shake, vibrate, or tremble, whether from an external force or an internal reaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因外部作用或自身反应而震动、颤动或发抖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li titħawwad, tivvibra jew titriegħed minħabba forza minn barra jew reazzjoni tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 震颤；剧烈颤动或发抖。
振动；快速反复颤动。
颤抖；微微发颤。

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ tat-tieqa triegħed meta għadda trakk tqil fit-triq.
formal.en: The window glass vibrated when a heavy truck passed along the road.
formal.zh: 一辆重型卡车驶过马路时，窗玻璃震动了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex triegħed il-ħġieġ? Mark: Għadda trakk kbir minn quddiem id-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the glass vibrate? Mark: A big truck passed in front of the house.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：玻璃刚才怎么震了一下？马克：一辆大卡车从屋前开过去了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 玻璃刚才怎么震了一下？
messages.en: Why did the glass vibrate?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadda trakk kbir minn quddiem id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadda trakk kbir minn quddiem id-dar.
messages.zh: 一辆大卡车从屋前开过去了。
messages.en: A big truck passed in front of the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把身体发抖和窗玻璃振动放在同一张记忆图里，两者都体现反复的小幅颤动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become loose, relaxed, or less tense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由紧绷变得松弛，或使身体进入放松状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ssir inqas miġbud jew inqas imtawwal, jew li tidħol fi stat ta' rilassament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松开；变得不那么紧。
放松；由紧张或紧绷转为松弛。
变松；松弛下来；紧绷程度减弱。

formal.mt: Meta tneħħa l-piż, il-ħabel trieħa u ma baqax miġbud.
formal.en: When the weight was removed, the rope slackened and was no longer taut.
formal.zh: 重物移开后，绳子松弛下来，不再绷紧。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadek tħoss ġismek miġbud? Pawlu: Le, ġismi trieħa wara l-banju sħun.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does your body still feel tense? Pawlu: No, my body relaxed after the warm bath.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你还觉得身体紧绷吗？保罗：不觉得了，泡过温水澡后身体放松了。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 你还觉得身体紧绷吗？
messages.en: Does your body still feel tense?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ġismi trieħa wara l-banju sħun.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ġismi trieħa wara l-banju sħun.
messages.zh: 不觉得了，泡过温水澡后身体放松了。
messages.en: No, my body relaxed after the warm bath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拉紧的绳子慢慢垂下，再联想到肩膀放松，用“紧变松”串联三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A great victory or an outstanding success.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重大的胜利或出色的成功，通常带有喜悦、自豪的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rebħa kbira jew suċċess kbir li jġib ferħ u kburija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大获全胜；辉煌的胜利或重大成功。

formal.mt: Ir-rebħ tal-kampjonat kien trijonf għat-tim kollu wara xhur ta' taħriġ.
formal.en: Winning the championship was a triumph for the whole team after months of training.
formal.zh: 经过数月训练，夺得冠军对全队而言是一次重大胜利。

colloquial.mt: David: Fl-aħħar irbaħna l-finali! Sara: X'trijonf! Dan jixraqlu ċelebrazzjoni.
colloquial.en: David: We finally won the final! Sara: What a triumph! This deserves a celebration.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：我们终于赢了决赛！萨拉：真是一场大胜！这值得庆祝。

messages.speaker: David (队员)
messages.zh: 我们终于赢了决赛！
messages.en: We finally won the final!

messages.speaker: Sara (队友)
messages.zh: 真是一场大胜！这值得庆祝。
messages.en: What a triumph! This deserves a celebration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把举起奖杯、全队欢呼的画面与 trijonf 绑定，记住它强调值得庆祝的大胜或成功。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Three times as large or as much as something else, or consisting of three parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大小或数量为另一事物三倍的，或由三个部分构成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tliet darbiet daqs xi ħaġa oħra, jew magħmul minn tliet partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三倍；三重。
三倍的；试验性的；三重的。

collocations.en: a price three times as high

formal.mt: L-ammont finali huwa triplu tal-ammont oriġinali: żdied minn għoxrin għal sittin.
formal.en: The final amount is triple the original amount: it increased from twenty to sixty.
formal.zh: 最终数量是原来数量的三倍：从二十增加到了六十。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-pakkett fih ammont triplu? Pawlu: Iva, fih tletin biċċa; iż-żgħir fih għaxra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this pack contain three times as much? Pawlu: Yes, it has thirty pieces; the small one has ten.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一包的数量是三倍吗？保罗：对，里面有三十件，小包装里有十件。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这一包的数量是三倍吗？
messages.en: Does this pack contain three times as much?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih tletin biċċa; iż-żgħir fih għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih tletin biċċa; iż-żgħir fih għaxra.
messages.zh: 对，里面有三十件，小包装里有十件。
messages.en: Yes, it has thirty pieces; the small one has ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把十件物品画成三组，共三十件，用这个画面记住 triplu 表示三倍的；表示三重时则想象三个组成部分。

gloss_zh: 小号；双筒望远镜；龙卷风；象鼻；楼梯井；靴筒；蠢人（骂人语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brass musical instrument played by blowing into a mouthpiece, commonly used in bands and orchestras.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通过向吹嘴吹气来演奏的铜管乐器，常用于管乐队和管弦乐队，即小号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tar-ram li jindaqq billi wieħed jonfoħ fih, u li jintuża fil-baned u fl-orkestri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双筒望远镜，用于观察远处的物体。
龙卷风，强烈旋转并伸向地面的风柱。
象鼻，大象用来呼吸、取物等的长鼻子。
楼梯井，建筑物内供楼梯上下贯通的空间。
小号，一种通过吹气演奏的铜管乐器。

sense_translations.en_definition: uppers (part of a boot rising along the calf)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 靴筒，靴子沿小腿向上延伸的部分。
蠢人、笨蛋，用于辱骂他人。

formal.mt: Matul il-kunċert, il-mużiċist daqq it-tromba flimkien mal-orkestra.
formal.en: During the concert, the musician played the trumpet with the orchestra.
formal.zh: 音乐会期间，这位乐手与管弦乐队一起演奏了小号。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'strument iddoqq fil-banda? Mark: Indoqq it-tromba, u nipprattika kuljum.
colloquial.en: Sara: What instrument do you play in the band? Mark: I play the trumpet, and I practise every day.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在乐队里演奏什么乐器？马克：我吹小号，而且每天都练习。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在乐队里演奏什么乐器？
messages.en: What instrument do you play in the band?

messages.speaker: Mark (乐队成员)
messages.zh: 我吹小号，而且每天都练习。
messages.en: I play the trumpet, and I practise every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用吹小号的画面记住 tromba，再把楼梯、象、大风和望远镜分别画成语境卡片；依靠搭配区分词义，不把所有意思混成一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A special ceremonial seat used by a king, queen, or other ruler.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国王、女王或其他统治者在正式仪式中使用的特殊座椅，即王座或宝座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġġu speċjali li fuqu joqgħod re, reġina jew ħakkiem ieħor waqt ċerimonji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 王座、宝座，君主或其他统治者使用的礼仪座椅。

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, ir-re qagħad fuq it-tron fis-sala l-kbira tal-palazz.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the king sat on the throne in the palace's great hall.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，国王坐在宫殿大厅的王座上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak is-siġġu kbir huwa tron? Toni: Iva, kien it-tron tar-re.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that large chair a throne? Toni: Yes, it was the king's throne.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那把大椅子是王座吗？托尼：对，那曾是国王的王座。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 那把大椅子是王座吗？
messages.en: Is that large chair a throne?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.zh: 对，那曾是国王的王座。
messages.en: Yes, it was the king's throne.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象宫殿中央只有君主才能坐的礼仪座椅，把 tron 贴在这把王座上，再用 it-tron tar-re 连同搭配一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to hear, or having very little ability to hear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法听见声音或听觉能力很弱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jismax jew li jisma' ftit ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聋的，无法听见声音或听觉能力很弱的。
重叠的、双辅音化的，指辅音以较长或双重的形式发出。

formal.mt: L-istudent huwa trux u juża l-lingwa tas-sinjali biex jikkomunika ma' sħabu.
formal.en: The student is deaf and uses sign language to communicate with his classmates.
formal.zh: 这名学生是聋人，他使用手语与同学交流。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu huwa trux? Sara: Iva, u meta nitkellmu flimkien nużaw il-lingwa tas-sinjali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu deaf? Sara: Yes, and when we talk together we use sign language.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗是聋人吗？萨拉：是的，我们交谈时使用手语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗是聋人吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu deaf?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u meta nitkellmu flimkien nużaw il-lingwa tas-sinjali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u meta nitkellmu flimkien nużaw il-lingwa tas-sinjali.
messages.zh: 是的，我们交谈时使用手语。
messages.en: Yes, and when we talk together we use sign language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 trux 放进“他是聋人”的人物描述卡片；再与名词 truxija 成对复习，分别记住人的听觉状态和耳聋这一状况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being unable to hear or having very little ability to hear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法听见声音或听觉能力很弱的状况，即耳聋或失聪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' min ma jismax jew jisma' ftit ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳聋、失聪，指听觉缺失或听觉能力严重受限的状况。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi t-truxija u l-importanza ta' mezzi ta' komunikazzjoni aċċessibbli.
formal.en: The text describes deafness and the importance of accessible means of communication.
formal.zh: 这篇文章介绍了耳聋，以及无障碍沟通方式的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser truxija? Mark: Tfisser li persuna ma tismax jew tisma' ftit ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does truxija mean? Mark: It means that a person cannot hear or can hear very little.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：truxija 是什么意思？马克：意思是一个人听不见，或者只能听见很少的声音。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: truxija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does truxija mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li persuna ma tismax jew tisma' ftit ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li persuna ma tismax jew tisma' ftit ħafna.
messages.zh: 意思是一个人听不见，或者只能听见很少的声音。
messages.en: It means that a person cannot hear or can hear very little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张对照卡：trux 写“聋的”，truxija 写“耳聋这一状况”；通过形容词描述人、名词指状况来区分用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sent through the air by someone throwing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受到投掷而在空中移动，即被扔出或被抛出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintrema minn xi ħadd u jgħaddi mill-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔出、被抛出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to elbow (to push with the elbow)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用肘部推挤，以手肘顶推别人。

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, il-ballun ttafa' fl-arja u nqabad minn plejer ieħor.
formal.en: During the exercise, the ball was thrown into the air and caught by another player.
formal.zh: 练习期间，球被抛向空中，随后由另一名队员接住。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Fejn mar il-ballun? Maja: Ttafa' fil-ġnien; qiegħed ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Toni: Where did the ball go? Maja: It was thrown into the garden; it is beside the tree.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：球到哪里去了？玛雅：被扔进花园了，就在树旁边。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 球到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the ball go?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 被扔进花园了，就在树旁边。
messages.en: It was thrown into the garden; it is beside the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜头跟着一个被抛出的球移动，用 ttafa' 记住“被扔出”；另用手肘推挤的独立画面记第二义，书写时保留末尾撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move through the air over a place or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空中从某个地方或物体的上方经过，即飞过或飞越。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħaddi fl-arja minn fuq post jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞过、飞越，从某处或某物上方飞行经过。

formal.mt: L-għasfur ttajar fuq il-baħar u mbagħad niżel fuq blata qrib ix-xatt.
formal.en: The bird flew over the sea and then landed on a rock near the shore.
formal.zh: 那只鸟从海面上飞过，随后落在岸边的一块岩石上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt dak l-għasfur? Pawlu: Iva, ttajar fuq il-ġnien u mar lejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see that bird? Pawlu: Yes, it flew over the garden and headed towards the sea.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到那只鸟了吗？保罗：看到了，它从花园上方飞过，朝海边去了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that bird?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ttajar fuq il-ġnien u mar lejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ttajar fuq il-ġnien u mar lejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 看到了，它从花园上方飞过，朝海边去了。
messages.en: Yes, it flew over the garden and headed towards the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一只鸟从花园上方划过的弧线，把 ttajar 写在飞行轨迹旁，再连读 ttajar fuq il-ġnien，记住从上方飞过的动作。

gloss_zh: 被泥弄脏；被泥覆盖；变得泥泞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become muddy or to be covered or dirtied with mud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得泥泞，或被泥覆盖、被泥弄脏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir mimli tajn jew jitgħatta u jitħammeġ bit-tajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被泥弄脏，沾上泥污。
被泥覆盖，表面沾满泥。
tajjan 的中间被动态形式，表示自身变得泥泞或受到泥污覆盖。
变得泥泞，或逐渐沾上泥污。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, il-passaġġ ttajjan u sar diffiċli biex wieħed jimxi fuqu.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, the path became muddy and difficult to walk on.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，小路变得泥泞，行走也变得困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-qalziet tiegħek huwa daqshekk maħmuġ? Toni: Ttajjan meta waqajt fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are your trousers so dirty? Toni: They got muddy when I fell in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的裤子怎么这么脏？托尼：我在花园里摔了一跤，裤子就沾上泥了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-qalziet tiegħek huwa daqshekk maħmuġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-qalziet tiegħek huwa daqshekk maħmuġ?
messages.zh: 你的裤子怎么这么脏？
messages.en: Why are your trousers so dirty?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在花园里摔了一跤，裤子就沾上泥了。
messages.en: They got muddy when I fell in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后小路从干燥变成泥泞，再想象裤子摔进泥里；两个画面共同帮助记住 ttajjan 的“变泥泞”和“被泥弄脏”。

gloss_zh: 被吹飞；被车辆撞倒；起飞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be carried into the air, to take off, or to be struck and knocked down by a vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被带到空中或吹飞，也可表示起飞；用于交通情境时，表示被车辆撞倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġarr fl-arja jew jitlaq biex itir; f'kuntest tat-traffiku, jintlaqat u jitwaqqa' minn vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被带到空中；被吹飞。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be run over by a vehicle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被车辆撞倒或碾过。
起飞；离地飞起。

collocations.en: was blown away by the wind
was knocked down by a car

formal.mt: Ir-raġel ttajjar minn karozza waqt li kien qed jaqsam it-triq.
formal.en: The man was knocked down by a car while crossing the road.
formal.zh: 那名男子过马路时被一辆汽车撞倒。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn hu l-kappell tiegħek? Pawlu: Ttajjar bir-riħ! Qiegħed ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is your hat? Pawlu: It blew away in the wind! It's beside the tree.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你的帽子在哪里？保罗：被风吹飞了！就在树旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的帽子在哪里？
messages.en: Where is your hat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 被风吹飞了！就在树旁边。
messages.en: It blew away in the wind! It's beside the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想帽子被风卷到空中的画面记住“吹飞”；再看旁边是否出现车辆，判断是否表示“被撞倒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To want something to happen and believe or continue to believe that it is possible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望某事发生，并相信或继续相信它有可能实现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixtieq li jiġri xi ħaġa u jemmen, jew jibqa' jemmen, li tista' sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；盼望某事发生。
仍抱有期望；继续怀有希望。
继续抱有希望；尚未放弃希望。

formal.mt: Wara li bagħat l-applikazzjoni, Mark ttama li jintgħażel għall-kors.
formal.en: After submitting the application, Mark hoped to be selected for the course.
formal.zh: 提交申请后，马克希望自己能被该课程录取。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'qal Mark wara l-eżami? Lara: Qal li ttama li jgħaddi, għax studja ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: What did Mark say after the exam? Lara: He said he hoped to pass because he had studied a lot.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：马克考完试后说了什么？拉拉：他说自己希望能及格，因为他下了很多功夫学习。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 马克考完试后说了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark say after the exam?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li ttama li jgħaddi, għax studja ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li ttama li jgħaddi, għax studja ħafna.
messages.zh: 他说自己希望能及格，因为他下了很多功夫学习。
messages.en: He said he hoped to pass because he had studied a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“交完申请，心里盼着录取”的画面；记住它表达希望，结果还没有确定。

gloss_zh: 被弄得失去或错过；受到干扰而分心

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be caused to lose something or miss something, or to have one's attention distracted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某种影响而失去东西、损失金钱或错过机会，也可表示受到干扰而分心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jitlef xi ħaġa, flus jew opportunità, jew tiġi mfixkla l-attenzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得失去某物；因外在影响而遭受损失。
因某种影响而错过或未能赶上。
受到干扰；注意力被分散。
tellef 的中被动态形式，表示主体受到使其失去、错过或分心的影响。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to lose money
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某种影响而损失金钱；被弄得亏钱。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to miss an opportunity
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某种影响而错失机会。

formal.mt: L-istudent ttellef bl-istorbju fil-kuritur u kellu jerġa' jaqra l-mistoqsija.
formal.en: The student was distracted by the noise in the corridor and had to read the question again.
formal.zh: 那名学生被走廊里的噪声干扰，不得不重新读一遍题目。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex waqaf jaqra Mark? Ben: Ttellef bit-telefon. Issa se jerġa' jibda.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Mark stop reading? Ben: He got distracted by the phone. He's going to start again now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克为什么停下来不读了？本：他被电话弄得分心了。现在要重新开始读。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 马克为什么停下来不读了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop reading?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ttellef bit-telefon. Issa se jerġa' jibda.
messages.mt_standard: Ttellef bit-telefon. Issa se jerġa' jibda.
messages.zh: 他被电话弄得分心了。现在要重新开始读。
messages.en: He got distracted by the phone. He's going to start again now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电话一响，读书的人丢了思路；用“受到影响，失去或错过”串起分心、损失和错失机会。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be softened or become soft, especially of a cushion, or to become frayed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被弄软或逐渐变软，尤其用于靠垫等物品；也可表示材料磨散、起毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirtab jew jiġi mrattab, speċjalment kuxxin, jew jibda jitħassar u jinħall f'ħjut fit-truf.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be softened (especially used of cushions etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄软；尤其指靠垫等物品被弄得松软。
tenfex 的中被动态形式，表示物品被弄软、变软或出现磨散起毛的状态。
变软；变得松软。
磨散；边缘的纤维散开或起毛。

formal.mt: It-tarf tad-drapp ttenfex wara ħafna ħasil.
formal.en: The edge of the fabric became frayed after repeated washing.
formal.zh: 多次洗涤后，布料的边缘磨散起毛了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-kuxxin għadu iebes? Toni: Le, ttenfex u issa hu komdu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this cushion still hard? Toni: No, it has softened and is very comfortable now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个靠垫还是很硬吗？托尼：不硬了，已经变软，现在坐着很舒服。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 这个靠垫还是很硬吗？
messages.en: Is this cushion still hard?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ttenfex u issa hu komdu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ttenfex u issa hu komdu ħafna.
messages.zh: 不硬了，已经变软，现在坐着很舒服。
messages.en: No, it has softened and is very comfortable now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个触觉画面记忆：靠垫摸起来变软，布边摸起来起毛；根据物品区分“变软”和“磨散”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to shiver or to tremble all over.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到寒冷等因素影响而发抖，或全身打颤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jirtogħod, jew jirtogħod b'ġismu kollu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得发抖；受到寒冷等因素影响而打颤。
浑身发抖；全身打颤。

formal.mt: It-tifel tterter bil-bard waqt li kien qed jistenna barra mingħajr kowt.
formal.en: The boy shivered with cold while waiting outside without a coat.
formal.zh: 那个男孩没穿外套在外面等候，冷得浑身发抖。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien Pawlu wara l-għawma? Luqa: Tterter bil-bard, allura tajtu xugaman.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was Pawlu after the swim? Luqa: He was shivering with cold, so I gave him a towel.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗游完泳后怎么样？卢卡：他冷得发抖，所以我给了他一条毛巾。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗游完泳后怎么样？
messages.en: How was Pawlu after the swim?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 他冷得发抖，所以我给了他一条毛巾。
messages.en: He was shivering with cold, so I gave him a towel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读时用连续轻颤的节奏配合想象全身打哆嗦；再用寒冷或害怕的情境记住发抖的原因。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To open the mouth wide and take a deep breath in a yawn, often when tired or bored.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 张大嘴深吸气，做出打哈欠的动作，常见于疲倦或无聊时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiftaħ ħalqu beraħ u jieħu nifs fil-fond, spiss minħabba għeja jew dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打哈欠。

formal.mt: L-istudent ttewweb waqt il-lezzjoni għax kien raqad ftit il-lejl ta' qabel.
formal.en: The student yawned during the lesson because he had slept little the night before.
formal.zh: 那名学生上课时打了个哈欠，因为前一晚睡得很少。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tifel ttewweb darbtejn. Taħseb li għandu ngħas? Omm: Iva, wasal il-ħin li jorqod.
colloquial.en: Nina: The boy yawned twice. Do you think he's sleepy? Mum: Yes, it's time for him to go to bed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：孩子打了两次哈欠。你觉得他困了吗？妈妈：是的，他该睡觉了。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel ttewweb darbtejn. Taħseb li għandu ngħas?
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel ttewweb darbtejn. Taħseb li għandu ngħas?
messages.zh: 孩子打了两次哈欠。你觉得他困了吗？
messages.en: The boy yawned twice. Do you think he's sleepy?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 是的，他该睡觉了。
messages.en: Yes, it's time for him to go to bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和睡前张大嘴、深吸气的动作一起记；看到疲倦或上课情境，就联想到“打哈欠”。

gloss_zh: 受损；被损害效力；遭侵犯

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer damage, to have one's soundness or validity impaired, or to be violated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到损害，完整性或效力遭到破坏，或权利等受到侵犯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab ħsara, tiġi mħassra l-integrità jew il-validità tiegħu, jew jiġi miksur, bħal dritt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受损；遭到损害。
完整性、正当性或效力受到损害。
遭到侵犯或违背。
效力或完整性受损、遭到损害，或受到侵犯。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif id-dritt għall-privatezza ttiefes meta ġiet ippubblikata informazzjoni personali.
formal.en: The report describes how the right to privacy was violated when personal information was published.
formal.zh: 报告说明了个人信息被公开时，隐私权如何受到侵犯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hu mdejjaq Mark? Lara: L-isem tajjeb tiegħu ttiefes b'għajdut falz.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Mark upset? Lara: His good reputation was damaged by false rumours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么难过？拉拉：他的良好声誉被虚假的传言损害了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么难过？
messages.en: Why is Mark upset?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-isem tajjeb tiegħu ttiefes b'għajdut falz.
messages.mt_standard: L-isem tajjeb tiegħu ttiefes b'għajdut falz.
messages.zh: 他的良好声誉被虚假的传言损害了。
messages.en: His good reputation was damaged by false rumours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原本完整的东西受到破坏”串起词义：物品是受损，效力是受损害，权利则是受到侵犯。

gloss_zh: 被吃掉；被侵蚀或磨损；寄予希望

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be eaten or gradually worn away by erosion or weathering; also, to place one's hope in someone or something, sometimes through misplaced trust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被吃掉，或因侵蚀、风化和磨耗而逐渐损耗；也可表示把希望寄托于某人或某事，其中有的用法含有受蒙蔽而寄望的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi kkunsmat bħala ikel jew jitnaqqar u jintlibes bil-mod; ukoll, iqiegħed it-tama tiegħu f'xi ħadd jew f'xi ħaġa, kultant għax ikun imqarraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被吃掉；被食用。
被侵蚀；被逐渐蚀去。
被风化；因长期暴露于自然环境而损耗。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be deluded into putting one's hope on sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到蒙蔽，误把希望寄托于某事或某人。
kiel 的中被动态形式，表示被吃掉，也可用于被侵蚀或损耗的情境。
被磨损；因使用或摩擦而逐渐损耗。
寄予希望；把自己的希望寄托于某人或某事。

collocations.en: the rock was eroded by the waves

formal.mt: Il-blat tul il-kosta ttiekel bil-mewġ matul ħafna snin.
formal.en: The rock along the coast was eroded by the waves over many years.
formal.zh: 海岸沿线的岩石经过多年海浪冲刷而受到侵蚀。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fadal ħobż għall-pranzu? Pawlu: Le, ttiekel kollu dalgħodu. Se nixtri aktar.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is there any bread left for lunch? Pawlu: No, it was all eaten this morning. I'll buy some more.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：还有面包留着午饭吃吗？保罗：没有了，今天早上全吃完了。我会再买一些。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 还有面包留着午饭吃吗？
messages.en: Is there any bread left for lunch?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ttiekel kollu dalgħodu. Se nixtri aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ttiekel kollu dalgħodu. Se nixtri aktar.
messages.zh: 没有了，今天早上全吃完了。我会再买一些。
messages.en: No, it was all eaten this morning. I'll buy some more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想面包被吃掉，再想岩石被海浪一点点“吃掉”，帮助记住侵蚀和磨损；寄望义另配“把希望交给别人”的画面。

gloss_zh: 长度；高度；时长；在整个……期间

teaching_sense.en_definition: The extent of something from one end to the other, a person's height, or the amount of time something lasts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物从一端到另一端的长度，也可指人的身高或某事持续的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' xi ħaġa minn tarf għall-ieħor, il-kejl ta' persuna minn saqajha sa rasha, jew iż-żmien li ddum xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高度；身高。
长度；从一端到另一端的距离。
持续时间；时长。
空间上的长度或时间上的长度；持续时间。

sense_translations.en_definition: throughout, for the length of, for many
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在整个……期间；沿着……的全长；持续许多……，如许多年。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika t-tul tal-pont u t-tul taż-żmien meħtieġ għat-tiswija tiegħu.
formal.en: The report states the length of the bridge and the time required to repair it.
formal.zh: 报告列明了桥梁的长度及其维修所需的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu t-tul ta' din il-mejda? Mark: Żewġ metri. Għandna biżżejjed spazju għaliha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long is this table? Mark: Two metres. We have enough space for it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张桌子有多长？马克：两米。我们有足够的空间放它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张桌子有多长？
messages.en: How long is this table?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ metri. Għandna biżżejjed spazju għaliha.
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ metri. Għandna biżżejjed spazju għaliha.
messages.zh: 两米。我们有足够的空间放它。
messages.en: Two metres. We have enough space for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tul 想成一把可横放、竖放，也可放到时间轴上的尺：分别量长度、身高和时长；作介词时联想尺子覆盖整个期间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving something up or ceding a right, possession, or territory to another party.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放弃某物，或将权利、财产、领土等让给另一方的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iċedi xi ħaġa jew jgħaddi dritt, proprjetà jew territorju lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放弃；不再保有某物或坚持某项要求的行为。
让出；将权利、财产或控制权交给另一方的行为。
让与；割让，尤指权利或领土的正式转让。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi t-tulija tad-drittijiet lil parti oħra.
formal.en: The document describes the ceding of rights to another party.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了向另一方让与权利的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tulija' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Tfisser li xi ħadd iċedi xi ħaġa, bħal dritt, lil ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tulija' mean in this sentence? Mark: It means someone gives something, such as a right, over to someone else.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 tulija 是什么意思？马克：指某人把某样东西，比如一项权利，让给别人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 tulija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tulija' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li xi ħadd iċedi xi ħaġa, bħal dritt, lil ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li xi ħadd iċedi xi ħaġa, bħal dritt, lil ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 指某人把某样东西，比如一项权利，让给别人。
messages.en: It means someone gives something, such as a right, over to someone else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tulija 时画一只松开的手：东西不再握在自己手中，就是放弃；若交到另一方手中，就是让出或让与。这是情景记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forced removal from one's country or home, or the condition of living away because one has been banished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被迫离开自己的国家或家园的放逐行为，也指遭放逐后在外生活的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkeċċija ta' persuna minn pajjiżha jew minn darha, jew il-qagħda li tgħix 'il bogħod għax ġiet imkeċċija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流放；被迫远离祖国或家园的状态。
放逐；将某人驱逐出某地并令其离开的行为。
流放；放逐；被驱离家园的行为或由此形成的生活状态。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist iqatta' għaxar snin ta' turfien 'il bogħod minn pajjiżu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist spends ten years in exile away from his country.
formal.zh: 小说中，主人公远离祖国，度过了十年的流放生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru ma jistax imur lura d-dar? Mark: Għax ġie kkundannat għat-turfien u ma jistax jirritorna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't the character go back home? Mark: Because he was sentenced to banishment and cannot return.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个人物为什么不能回家？马克：因为他被判处放逐，不能返回。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru ma jistax imur lura d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru ma jistax imur lura d-dar?
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么不能回家？
messages.en: Why can't the character go back home?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ġie kkundannat għat-turfien u ma jistax jirritorna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ġie kkundannat għat-turfien u ma jistax jirritorna.
messages.zh: 因为他被判处放逐，不能返回。
messages.en: Because he was sentenced to banishment and cannot return.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 turfien 配上一幅远望家园却不能返回的画面，抓住被迫离开这一点，记住流放、放逐的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blue-green gemstone used in jewellery and decorative objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种呈蓝绿色、用于首饰和装饰品的宝石，即绿松石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġra prezzjuża ta' lewn bejn l-ikħal u l-aħdar, li tintuża fil-ġojjelli u fl-oġġetti dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿松石。
绿松石，一种蓝绿色宝石。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi ċurkett tal-fidda b'ħaġra tat-turkin fin-nofs.
formal.en: The catalogue describes a silver ring with a turquoise gemstone in the centre.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了一枚中央镶有绿松石的银戒指。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-ħaġra f'dan iċ-ċurkett? Mark: Hija turkin. Jogħġbok il-kulur tagħha?
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the stone in this ring? Mark: It is turquoise. Do you like its colour?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这枚戒指上的石头是什么？马克：是绿松石。你喜欢它的颜色吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这枚戒指上的石头是什么？
messages.en: What is the stone in this ring?

messages.speaker: Mark (珠宝店员)
messages.zh: 是绿松石。你喜欢它的颜色吗？
messages.en: It is turquoise. Do you like its colour?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 turkin 写在一枚蓝绿色宝石戒指旁，看到宝石就读词，建立绿松石与词形的直接联系；这是图像联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Severe physical or mental suffering, or something that causes such suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或精神上强烈的痛苦、折磨，也可指造成这种痛苦的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbatija kbira tal-ġisem jew tal-moħħ, jew xi ħaġa li ġġib tbatija bħal din.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 折磨；煎熬；强烈的身体或精神痛苦，也可指造成痛苦的事物。

formal.mt: Il-poeżija tesprimi t-turment ta' persuna li ma tafx x'sar mill-familja tagħha.
formal.en: The poem expresses the torment of a person who does not know what has happened to their family.
formal.zh: 这首诗表达了一个人因不知家人下落而承受的煎熬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek qed tistenna l-aħbar? Mark: Iva, dan l-istennija hu turment. Ma nistax norqod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still waiting for the news? Mark: Yes, this waiting is torment. I can't sleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在等消息吗？马克：是啊，这样等着真煎熬。我都睡不着。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在等消息吗？
messages.en: Are you still waiting for the news?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan l-istennija hu turment. Ma nistax norqod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan l-istennija hu turment. Ma nistax norqod.
messages.zh: 是啊，这样等着真煎熬。我都睡不着。
messages.en: Yes, this waiting is torment. I can't sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 turment 与英语 torment 并排记忆，再联想等重要消息时坐立不安的情景，记住它表示强烈折磨或煎熬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An herb whose green leaves are used to flavour or garnish food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种用绿色叶片给食物调味或作点缀的香草，即欧芹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa aromatika li l-weraq aħdar tagħha jintuża biex jagħti t-togħma lill-ikel jew iżejnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧芹；叶片可用于调味或装饰菜肴的香草。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tat-tisjir, żid ftit tursin imqatta' u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: At the end of cooking, add a little chopped parsley and stir well.
formal.zh: 烹饪快结束时，加入少许切碎的欧芹并充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna tursin għas-soppa? Mark: Iva, hemm ftit tursin frisk fil-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have parsley for the soup? Mark: Yes, there is some fresh parsley in the fridge.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有煮汤用的欧芹吗？马克：有，冰箱里有一些新鲜欧芹。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有煮汤用的欧芹吗？
messages.en: Do we have parsley for the soup?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit tursin frisk fil-friġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit tursin frisk fil-friġġ.
messages.zh: 有，冰箱里有一些新鲜欧芹。
messages.en: Yes, there is some fresh parsley in the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在汤面撒上一撮切碎的绿色欧芹，同时读出 tursin；用撒香草的动作把词形和食材联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to hear, or having very little ability to hear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 听不见声音的，或听觉能力很有限的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jismax jew li għandu ħila limitata ħafna li jisma'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聋的；无法听见声音或听觉能力很有限的。

formal.mt: L-iskola tipprovdi appoġġ fil-komunikazzjoni lil student turxan.
formal.en: The school provides communication support for a deaf student.
formal.zh: 学校为一名失聪学生提供沟通支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jippreferi jikkomunika Pawlu? Mark: Pawlu hu turxan u jippreferi li niktbulu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How does Pawlu prefer to communicate? Mark: Pawlu is deaf and prefers us to write to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗喜欢用什么方式交流？马克：保罗听不见，他更喜欢我们用文字与他交流。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗喜欢用什么方式交流？
messages.en: How does Pawlu prefer to communicate?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu hu turxan u jippreferi li niktbulu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu hu turxan u jippreferi li niktbulu.
messages.zh: 保罗听不见，他更喜欢我们用文字与他交流。
messages.en: Pawlu is deaf and prefers us to write to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 turxan 放进完整短句 Pawlu hu turxan，联想双方用文字交流的画面，记住这是描述听觉状况的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who teaches or supports a learner, often individually; also a person responsible for another person's care as a guardian.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为学习者授课或提供辅导的人，常进行个别指导；也可指负责照护他人的监护人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħallem jew tgħin lil student fit-tagħlim, spiss b'mod individwali; ukoll persuna responsabbli mill-ħarsien ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辅导教师；导师，尤指给予个别学习指导的人。
监护人；负责照护另一人的人。
辅导教师；教师；教授知识或指导学习的人。

formal.mt: It-tutur jgħin lill-istudent jippjana l-istudju tiegħu u jifhem is-suġġetti diffiċli.
formal.en: The tutor helps the student plan his studies and understand difficult subjects.
formal.zh: 辅导教师帮助这名学生规划学习，并理解有难度的科目内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgħinek bil-matematika? Mark: Għandi lezzjoni mat-tutur tiegħi għada. Se nirrevedu l-frazzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to help you with mathematics? Mark: I have a lesson with my tutor tomorrow. We will review fractions.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来帮你学数学？马克：明天我有辅导老师的课。我们会复习分数。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 谁来帮你学数学？
messages.en: Who is going to help you with mathematics?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi lezzjoni mat-tutur tiegħi għada. Se nirrevedu l-frazzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi lezzjoni mat-tutur tiegħi għada. Se nirrevedu l-frazzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 明天我有辅导老师的课。我们会复习分数。
messages.en: I have a lesson with my tutor tomorrow. We will review fractions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tutur 与英语 tutor 并排记，再配两张情景卡：课堂上指导学习的是辅导教师，照护事务中承担监护责任的是监护人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group or quantity of twelve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十二个组成的一组或一个数量单位，即一打。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp jew kwantità ta' tnax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打；表示十二个的数量单位。
一打；十二个。

formal.mt: Għall-attività tal-iskola, kull familja għandha ġġib tużżana gallettini.
formal.en: For the school activity, each family should bring a dozen biscuits.
formal.zh: 学校活动要求每个家庭带十二块饼干。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm bajd nixtru? Mark: Nieħdu tużżana. Maja: Sewwa, hekk ikollna tnax.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many eggs shall we buy? Mark: Let's get a dozen. Maja: Okay, then we'll have twelve.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们买多少个鸡蛋？Mark：买一打吧。Maja：好，那就是十二个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们买多少个鸡蛋？
messages.en: How many eggs shall we buy?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 买一打吧。
messages.en: Let's get a dozen.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那就是十二个。
messages.en: Okay, then we'll have twelve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象装满十二个鸡蛋的盒子，把 tużżana 和“一打十二个”一起记；半盒就是 nofs tużżana。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cloth spread over a table to protect or decorate it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铺在桌面上、用于保护或装饰桌子的布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li titqiegħed fuq mejda biex tipproteġiha jew iżżejjinha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桌布；铺在桌面上的布。
桌布；用于覆盖、保护或装饰桌面的布。

formal.mt: Qabel il-pranzu, il-persunal poġġa tvalja nadifa fuq kull mejda.
formal.en: Before lunch, the staff placed a clean tablecloth on each table.
formal.zh: 午餐前，工作人员在每张桌子上都铺了干净的桌布。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema tvalja nużaw għall-ikla? Pawlu: Il-bajda, jekk hi nadifa. Sara: Iva, ħsiltha lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which tablecloth shall we use for the meal? Pawlu: The white one, if it's clean. Sara: Yes, I washed it yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：吃饭时我们用哪块桌布？Pawlu：白色的那块吧，如果干净的话。Sara：干净，我昨天洗过了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 吃饭时我们用哪块桌布？
messages.en: Which tablecloth shall we use for the meal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 白色的那块吧，如果干净的话。
messages.en: The white one, if it's clean.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 干净，我昨天洗过了。
messages.en: Yes, I washed it yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把铺桌、摆盘、开饭连成一个画面：铺在桌面上的那块布就是 tvalja，再用 tvalja bajda 记住“白色桌布”。

gloss_zh: 心地善良的；和善的；还不错的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kind and good-hearted; also somewhat good, with a diminutive sense of tajjeb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人心地善良、待人和善；也可表示有些好、还不错，是 tajjeb 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' qalb tajba u ġentili; jista' jfisser ukoll kemxejn tajjeb, bħala diminuttiv ta' tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和善的；亲切的。
tajjeb 的指小形式，可带有亲切或程度较轻的意味。
有些好的；还不错的。
心地善良的；仁厚的；待人友善的。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, id-direttriċi ddeskriviet lil Pawlu bħala raġel twajjeb li dejjem lest jgħin lill-oħrajn.
formal.en: In her letter, the director described Pawlu as a kind-hearted man who is always ready to help others.
formal.zh: 主任在信中将 Pawlu 描述为一个心地善良、随时愿意帮助他人的人。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif inhu l-ġar il-ġdid? Ġanni: Twajjeb ħafna. Ilbieraħ għenni nġorr il-basktijiet. Marta: Kemm hu ġentili!
colloquial.en: Marta: What's the new neighbour like? Ġanni: Very kind. Yesterday he helped me carry the bags. Marta: How thoughtful of him!
colloquial.zh: Marta：新邻居人怎么样？Ġanni：很和善。昨天他帮我提袋子。Marta：他真体贴！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 新邻居人怎么样？
messages.en: What's the new neighbour like?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Twajjeb ħafna. Ilbieraħ għenni nġorr il-basktijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Twajjeb ħafna. Ilbieraħ għenni nġorr il-basktijiet.
messages.zh: 很和善。昨天他帮我提袋子。
messages.en: Very kind. Yesterday he helped me carry the bags.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 他真体贴！
messages.en: How thoughtful of him!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twajjeb 放进“热心邻居帮忙提袋子”的画面，先记“心善、和气”；再联系 tajjeb 的指小形式，记住也可表示“有些好”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To increase in height or length, or to become longer in duration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 高度或长度增加，或持续时间变长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fl-għoli jew fit-tul, jew jibda jdum aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长高；身高增加。
变长；长度或持续时间增加。
变长或长高；在长度或高度上有所增加。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena skolastika, it-tifel twal b'ħames ċentimetri.
formal.en: During the school year, the boy grew five centimetres taller.
formal.zh: 这个男孩在该学年长高了五厘米。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm twal ibnek! Marija: Iva, il-qalziet li xtrajtlu s-sena l-oħra sar qasir. Rita: Wasal iż-żmien li tixtrilu wieħed ġdid.
colloquial.en: Rita: Your son has grown so much taller! Marija: Yes, the trousers I bought him last year have become too short. Rita: It's time to buy him a new pair.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你儿子长高了好多！Marija：是啊，我去年给他买的裤子已经短了。Rita：该给他买条新的了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你儿子长高了好多！
messages.en: Your son has grown so much taller!

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-qalziet li xtrajtlu s-sena l-oħra sar qasir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-qalziet li xtrajtlu s-sena l-oħra sar qasir.
messages.zh: 是啊，我去年给他买的裤子已经短了。
messages.en: Yes, the trousers I bought him last year have become too short.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasal iż-żmien li tixtrilu wieħed ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Wasal iż-żmien li tixtrilu wieħed ġdid.
messages.zh: 该给他买条新的了。
messages.en: It's time to buy him a new pair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象墙上的身高刻度从去年升到今年：it-tifel twal 是“孩子长高了”。再把画面换成长头发，记住同一动词也表示“变长”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become one whole by joining or coming together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过结合或聚合而成为一个整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ħaġa waħda billi jingħaqad ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合而为一；结合成为一个整体。

formal.mt: Wara xhur ta' ħidma flimkien, it-tim twaħħad u beda jaħdem b'għan komuni.
formal.en: After months of working together, the team became united and began working towards a common goal.
formal.zh: 经过数月的共同工作，团队融为一体，开始为共同目标努力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer it-tim il-ġdid? David: Tajjeb ħafna. Wara l-vjaġġ flimkien, it-tim twaħħad. Lara: Mela issa tħossukom grupp wieħed.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the new team doing? David: Very well. After the trip together, the team became united. Lara: So now you feel like one group.
colloquial.zh: Lara：新团队怎么样？David：很好。一起出游后，团队融为一体了。Lara：那你们现在感觉是一个整体了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 新团队怎么样？
messages.en: How is the new team doing?

messages.speaker: David (团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna. Wara l-vjaġġ flimkien, it-tim twaħħad.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna. Wara l-vjaġġ flimkien, it-tim twaħħad.
messages.zh: 很好。一起出游后，团队融为一体了。
messages.en: Very well. After the trip together, the team became united.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你们现在感觉是一个整体了。
messages.en: So now you feel like one group.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几块拼图最终拼成一幅完整的图，用 twaħħad 记住“合为一体”这个变化过程，而不只是摆在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frightened, shocked, or horrified by something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事而受到惊吓、感到震惊或恐惧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss biża' jew xokk qawwi minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到惊吓；感到害怕。
感到震惊；受到强烈的心理冲击。
感到惊骇；因可怕或令人震骇的事情而恐惧。
waħħax 的中间被动态，表示自身受到惊吓或感到震骇。
害怕；心中感到恐惧。

collocations.en: was horrified by what he saw

formal.mt: Ix-xhud twaħħax b'dak li ra fuq il-post tal-inċident.
formal.en: The witness was horrified by what he saw at the scene of the accident.
formal.zh: 目击者对事故现场的所见感到惊骇。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex telaq jiġri Mark? Luqa: Twaħħax bil-ħoss tal-bieb. Nina: Kien ir-riħ li għalaq il-bieb!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark run off? Luqa: He was frightened by the sound of the door. Nina: It was the wind that shut the door!
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mark 为什么跑开了？Luqa：他被门的响声吓到了。Nina：是风把门吹关了呀！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么跑开了？
messages.en: Why did Mark run off?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 他被门的响声吓到了。
messages.en: He was frightened by the sound of the door.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 是风把门吹关了呀！
messages.en: It was the wind that shut the door!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门突然砰地关上，一个人吓得跳起来：twaħħax 关注的是“他受惊了”；换成可怕的消息，也能表达震惊或惊骇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming one or the joining of separate things into a connected whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 合而为一的过程，或把分开的事物结合、连接成整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih affarijiet separati jingħaqdu jew isiru ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统一；使分开的部分成为一个整体的过程。
连接；不同事物之间的结合或联系。
动词 twaħħad 的动名词，表示合而为一或结合的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-passi meħtieġa għat-twaħħid taż-żewġ gruppi f'organizzazzjoni waħda.
formal.en: The report describes the steps needed to unify the two groups into one organization.
formal.zh: 报告说明了将两个群体统一为一个组织所需的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'sar mill-pjan taż-żewġ klabbs? Ben: It-twaħħid tagħhom se jsir ix-xahar id-dieħel. Anna: Allura se jkollna klabb wieħed.
colloquial.en: Anna: What happened to the plan for the two clubs? Ben: Their unification will take place next month. Anna: So we'll have one club.
colloquial.zh: Anna：那两个俱乐部的计划怎么样了？Ben：它们下个月会合并。Anna：那我们就会有一个俱乐部了。

messages.speaker: Anna (俱乐部会员)
messages.zh: 那两个俱乐部的计划怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the plan for the two clubs?

messages.speaker: Ben (俱乐部负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-twaħħid tagħhom se jsir ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: It-twaħħid tagħhom se jsir ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 它们下个月会合并。
messages.en: Their unification will take place next month.

messages.speaker: Anna (俱乐部会员)
messages.zh: 那我们就会有一个俱乐部了。
messages.en: So we'll have one club.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个圆合成一个圆的过程写成标题“twaħħid”：它是名词，给“统一、结合”这件事命名；twaħħad 则表达发生这个变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The birth of a baby, or figuratively the first emergence of an idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 婴儿的出生；也可比喻一个想法最初的产生或萌生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li tarbija titwieled; b'mod figurattiv, il-bidu ta' idea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出生；诞生。
想法的萌生；一个构想最初的形成。

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tiddeskrivi kif konverżazzjoni ma' studenta wasslet għat-twelid ta' idea ġdida.
formal.en: The author describes how a conversation with a student led to the birth of a new idea.
formal.zh: 作者描述了与一名学生的交谈如何促成一个新想法的诞生。

colloquial.mt: Emma: X'għandi nġib għar-reġistrazzjoni? Mark: Iċ-ċertifikat tat-twelid u ritratt. Emma: Sewwa, inġibhom għada.
colloquial.en: Emma: What should I bring for registration? Mark: Your birth certificate and a photograph. Emma: Okay, I'll bring them tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Emma：登记时我应该带什么？Mark：你的出生证明和一张照片。Emma：好，我明天带来。

messages.speaker: Emma (申请人)
messages.zh: 登记时我应该带什么？
messages.en: What should I bring for registration?

messages.speaker: Mark (登记处职员)
messages.zh: 你的出生证明和一张照片。
messages.en: Your birth certificate and a photograph.

messages.speaker: Emma (申请人)
messages.zh: 好，我明天带来。
messages.en: Okay, I'll bring them tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象新生婴儿和刚冒出的新点子：twelid 都可用“诞生”来理解；出生证明记作 ċertifikat tat-twelid。

gloss_zh: 所有权转让；权利转让；租赁；让与

teaching_sense.en_definition: The transfer of ownership or rights to another party; also a lease or cession, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把所有权或其他权利转交给另一方的行为；依语境也可指租赁或让与。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' proprjetà jew drittijiet lil parti oħra; skont il-kuntest, ukoll kiri jew ċessjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所有权的转让
权利的转让
租赁；出租或承租的安排
让与；向另一方转交权利或权益

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jiddeskrivi t-twellija tad-drittijiet minn parti għal oħra.
formal.en: The agreement describes the transfer of rights from one party to another.
formal.zh: 协议说明了权利从一方向另一方的转让。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'twellija' f'dan il-ftehim? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser li d-drittijiet jgħaddu minn persuna għal oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'twellija' mean in this agreement? Pawlu: Here it means that the rights pass from one person to another.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份协议里的 twellija 是什么意思？Pawlu：这里指权利从一个人转交给另一个人。

messages.speaker: Lara (客户)
messages.zh: 这份协议里的 twellija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'twellija' mean in this agreement?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li d-drittijiet jgħaddu minn persuna għal oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li d-drittijiet jgħaddu minn persuna għal oħra.
messages.zh: 这里指权利从一个人转交给另一个人。
messages.en: Here it means that the rights pass from one person to another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件上的权利人由甲换成乙，用这个交接画面记住 twellija；遇到具体文本，再分辨是所有权转让、权利让与还是租赁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A belief or faith that a person holds, including religious belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人所持有的信念或信仰，也包括宗教信仰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li persuna temmen fih, kemm bħala konvinzjoni personali kif ukoll bħala fidi reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信念；所相信的看法
信仰；坚定的信赖
宗教信仰
信念；信仰

formal.mt: Id-diskussjoni għandha ssir b'rispett lejn it-twemmin ta' kull persuna.
formal.en: The discussion should be conducted with respect for each person's beliefs.
formal.zh: 讨论应尊重每个人的信念与信仰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandkom l-istess twemmin? Mark: Le, imma nirrispettaw lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you share the same beliefs? Mark: No, but we respect each other.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们的信仰相同吗？Mark：不同，不过我们彼此尊重。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们的信仰相同吗？
messages.en: Do you share the same beliefs?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不同，不过我们彼此尊重。
messages.en: No, but we respect each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twemmin 放进“心里相信的东西”这个记忆格：日常可以是个人信念，谈宗教时则是信仰。

gloss_zh: 得到安慰；感到安心；与人相处感到自在

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive comfort or feel at ease, especially in another person's company.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到安慰或感到安心，尤其指有人陪伴时觉得自在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed isib faraġ jew iħossu komdu u mistrieħ, speċjalment fil-kumpanija ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到安慰；受到慰藉
感到安心、自在

sense_translations.en_definition: to feel at ease in someone's company
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某人的陪伴下感到自在

collocations.zh: 与朋友在一起感到自在

formal.mt: Wara l-aħbar ħażina, Pawlu twennes bil-kliem ta' appoġġ tal-familja.
formal.en: After the bad news, Pawlu was consoled by his family's supportive words.
formal.zh: 听到坏消息后，Pawlu 从家人支持的话语中得到了安慰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien Pietru meta ġie għandkom? Nina: Għall-ewwel kien kwiet, imma mbagħad twennes magħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was Pietru when he came to your place? Nina: At first he was quiet, but then he felt at ease with us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pietru 来你们家时怎么样？Nina：起初他不怎么说话，不过后来和我们相处就自在了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien Pietru meta ġie għandkom?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien Pietru meta ġie għandkom?
messages.zh: Pietru 来你们家时怎么样？
messages.en: How was Pietru when he came to your place?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel kien kwiet, imma mbagħad twennes magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel kien kwiet, imma mbagħad twennes magħna.
messages.zh: 起初他不怎么说话，不过后来和我们相处就自在了。
messages.en: At first he was quiet, but then he felt at ease with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一个从拘谨到放松的画面：朋友坐下来陪着他，他终于安心了。twennes 强调这个人得到安慰或变得自在。

gloss_zh: 慰藉；安心；陪伴扶助；相处自在的感觉

teaching_sense.en_definition: Comfort or peace of mind, including the reassurance and ease that come from supportive company.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 慰藉或安心，也指有人陪伴扶助时获得的安定与自在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faraġ jew serħan il-moħħ, inkluż dak li wieħed iħoss meta xi ħadd ikun miegħu biex jagħtih appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰；慰藉
心里安定；没有挂虑的状态

sense_translations.en_definition: being with sb. to offer succour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 陪伴某人并给予扶助或慰藉

sense_translations.en_definition: feeling at ease in someone's company
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某人的陪伴下感到自在

formal.mt: Iż-żjarat regolari tal-voluntiera jagħtu twennis lil persuni li jgħixu waħedhom.
formal.en: Regular visits by volunteers provide comfort to people who live alone.
formal.zh: 志愿者定期探访，为独居者带来慰藉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għenitek iż-żjara ta' Marija? Toni: Iva, tatni ħafna twennis; kelli bżonn lil xi ħadd jismagħni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Marija's visit help you? Toni: Yes, it gave me a lot of comfort; I needed someone to listen to me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Marija 的探望对你有帮助吗？Toni：有，给了我很多安慰；我当时需要有人听我说说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Marija 的探望对你有帮助吗？
messages.en: Did Marija's visit help you?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tatni ħafna twennis; kelli bżonn lil xi ħadd jismagħni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tatni ħafna twennis; kelli bżonn lil xi ħadd jismagħni.
messages.zh: 有，给了我很多安慰；我当时需要有人听我说说话。
messages.en: Yes, it gave me a lot of comfort; I needed someone to listen to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 twennis 想成朋友陪坐时送来的“一份安心”。它是名词，指慰藉或安心的状态；可与表示得到安慰的动词 twennes 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 行走困难；两腿张开地走；大腿脱臼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk with difficulty or with the legs wide apart; also to dislocate one's thighs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行走困难或两腿张开地行走；也可指大腿发生脱臼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jimxi b'diffikultà jew b'riġlejh miftuħin; ukoll li l-koxox joħorġulu minn posthom.

sense_translations.en_definition: to walk with difficulty, or with one's legs wide
sense_translations.zh_definition: 行走困难，或两腿张开地走
使自己的大腿脱臼；大腿发生脱臼

collocations.en: walked with difficulty along the street
walked with difficulty all the way home

formal.mt: Ir-raġel twerrek sal-bieb, fejn waqaf biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: The man walked with difficulty to the door, where he stopped to rest.
formal.zh: 那名男子艰难地走到门边，停下来休息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif wasal Toni sad-dar? Pawlu: Twerrek bil-mod; jien imxejt miegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Toni get home? Pawlu: He walked slowly and with difficulty; I walked with him.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Toni 是怎么到家的？Pawlu：他慢慢地艰难走回去；我陪他一起走。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni 是怎么到家的？
messages.en: How did Toni get home?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他慢慢地艰难走回去；我陪他一起走。
messages.en: He walked slowly and with difficulty; I walked with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象一个人两腿分开、一步一步艰难前进，记住 twerrek 的步态义；另把“大腿脱臼”单列为第二义，不把两种情形自动画等号。

gloss_zh: 斜视；变成斜眼；惊呆；受到震惊

teaching_sense.en_definition: To squint or become squint-eyed; also to become shocked or flabbergasted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 斜视或变成斜眼；也可指受到震惊、惊得目瞪口呆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed ikollu għajnejh ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni; ukoll li jibqa' mistagħġeb ħafna jew maħsud.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斜视；眼睛视线偏斜
惊得目瞪口呆或受到震惊
werreċ 的中间被动态形式，表示自身出现斜视或受到震惊
变成斜眼；出现斜视
受到震惊；变得惊愕

collocations.en: was shocked when he heard the news

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant twerreċ meta sar jaf bl-ispiża totali tal-proġett.
formal.en: The representative was flabbergasted when he learned the project's total cost.
formal.zh: 代表得知项目的总费用时惊得目瞪口呆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta ra l-kont? Sara: Twerreċ! Ma stenniex somma daqshekk kbira.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark react when he saw the bill? Sara: He was flabbergasted! He wasn't expecting such a large amount.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 看到账单时是什么反应？Sara：他惊呆了！他没想到金额会这么大。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta ra l-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta ra l-kont?
messages.zh: Mark 看到账单时是什么反应？
messages.en: How did Mark react when he saw the bill?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Twerreċ! Ma stenniex somma daqshekk kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Twerreċ! Ma stenniex somma daqshekk kbira.
messages.zh: 他惊呆了！他没想到金额会这么大。
messages.en: He was flabbergasted! He wasn't expecting such a large amount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立画面记住 twerreċ：一张表示斜视的眼睛图，一张看到巨额账单后惊呆的脸。两义分开记，再靠语境选择。

gloss_zh: 斜视状态；变成对眼；斜视

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of having a squint, or the process of going cross-eyed; strabismus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眼睛斜视的状态，或变成对眼的过程；亦指斜视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda jew il-bidla li fiha l-għajnejn ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni; strabiżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有斜视的状态
变成对眼；出现双眼向内偏斜的状态
斜视

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-eżami jiddeskrivi t-twerriċ u l-pożizzjoni taż-żewġ għajnejn.
formal.en: The examination report describes the strabismus and the position of both eyes.
formal.zh: 检查报告描述了斜视情况及双眼的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'twerriċ' hawn? Mark: Tfisser li ż-żewġ għajnejn ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'twerriċ' mean here? Mark: It means that the two eyes do not look in the same direction.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 twerriċ 是什么意思？Mark：指两只眼睛没有朝同一个方向看。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 twerriċ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'twerriċ' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li ż-żewġ għajnejn ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li ż-żewġ għajnejn ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.
messages.zh: 指两只眼睛没有朝同一个方向看。
messages.en: It means that the two eyes do not look in the same direction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两条没有对齐的视线，并在图下写 twerriċ，把它记作斜视这一状态的名词；“变成对眼”也归在这个词条下记忆。

gloss_zh: 完成；实现；得到确认；发生

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be accomplished, completed, or confirmed; also to materialize or take place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到完成、实现或确认；也可指事情成为现实或实际发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa ssir jew titlesta, tiġi kkonfermata, jew isseħħ fil-fatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得以完成；得以实现
被完成；告完成
得到确认；得到证实
wettaq 的中间被动态形式，表示某事得以完成、实现或确认
成为现实；发生；举行

formal.mt: Il-proġett twettaq skont il-pjan u tlesta fiż-żmien stabbilit.
formal.en: The project was carried out according to plan and completed within the agreed time.
formal.zh: 项目按计划实施，并在约定的期限内完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fl-aħħar twettaq il-pjan tal-vjaġġ? Toni: Iva! Morna Għawdex ilbieraħ u ħadna gost ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the trip plan finally become a reality? Toni: Yes! We went to Gozo yesterday and had a great time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：旅行计划终于实现了吗？Toni：实现了！我们昨天去了戈佐岛，玩得很开心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 旅行计划终于实现了吗？
messages.en: Did the trip plan finally become a reality?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Morna Għawdex ilbieraħ u ħadna gost ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Morna Għawdex ilbieraħ u ħadna gost ħafna.
messages.zh: 实现了！我们昨天去了戈佐岛，玩得很开心。
messages.en: Yes! We went to Gozo yesterday and had a great time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象计划表上的事项终于打上完成勾，用 twettaq 记住“事情落实了”。搭配项目可表示完成，搭配梦想可表示实现，确认义则依具体语境辨认。

gloss_zh: 鸟鸣；叽叽喳喳；喋喋不休

teaching_sense.en_definition: The singing of birds, or excessive and continuous talking by people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟儿的鸣叫，也可指人持续不断、喋喋不休的说话声或说话行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kant tal-għasafar, jew diskors żejjed u kontinwu tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟鸣声；鸟儿的鸣唱。
叽叽喳喳的说话声；不停的闲谈。
