动词 wetwet 的动名词，表示鸣叫或喋喋不休这一行为。
鸟儿鸣唱这一行为。
没完没了地说话；喋喋不休。

formal.mt: It-twetwit tal-għasafar jinstema' fil-ġnien kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: Birdsong can be heard in the garden early in the morning.
formal.zh: 清晨可以听见花园里的鸟鸣声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' t-twetwit tal-għasafar? Pawlu: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nisimgħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear the birds singing? Pawlu: Yes, let's sit here and listen for a while.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听见鸟儿叽叽喳喳地叫了吗？Pawlu：听见了，我们坐在这里听一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见鸟儿叽叽喳喳地叫了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the birds singing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nisimgħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nisimgħu ftit.
messages.zh: 听见了，我们坐在这里听一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's sit here and listen for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把场景分成树上鸟儿叫、桌边人闲聊：两种连续的叽叽喳喳都可帮助记住 twetwit。

gloss_zh: 感到受伤；怀恨；因怨愤而激动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel emotionally hurt, bear a grudge, or become stirred by resentment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因言语或遭遇而感到心里受伤，心怀怨恨，或因怨愤而激动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħossu mweġġa' f'sentimenti tiegħu, iżomm f'qalbu, jew jitqanqal bir-rabja u l-imrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到心里受伤；觉得受到冒犯。
怀恨在心；对受到的冒犯耿耿于怀。
因怨恨或愤懑而激动起来。

collocations.en: felt hurt by the words he heard
collocations.zh: 因听到的话而感到受伤

formal.mt: Pawlu tweżweż bil-kumment li sar dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Pawlu felt hurt by the comment made about his work during the meeting.
formal.zh: 会上有人评论了 Pawlu 的工作，使他感到受伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jiġi magħna? Pawlu: Tweżweż bil-kumment tiegħi tal-bieraħ; se nitlob skuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Mark want to come with us? Pawlu: He felt hurt by my comment yesterday; I'm going to apologize.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么不愿意和我们一起去？Pawlu：我昨天的话伤了他的心；我要向他道歉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jiġi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jiġi magħna?
messages.zh: Mark 为什么不愿意和我们一起去？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark want to come with us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tweżweż bil-kumment tiegħi tal-bieraħ; se nitlob skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Tweżweż bil-kumment tiegħi tal-bieraħ; se nitlob skuża.
messages.zh: 我昨天的话伤了他的心；我要向他道歉。
messages.en: He felt hurt by my comment yesterday; I'm going to apologize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句难听的话留在心里：先觉得受伤，再耿耿于怀，最后生出怨愤，用这条情绪线记住三个义项。

gloss_zh: 受到警告；受到训诫；受到劝勉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a warning, admonishment, or earnest encouragement to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到别人的警告、告诫，或受到促使自己采取行动的恳切劝勉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi twissija, ċanfira, jew parir serju li jħeġġu jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到警告；被提醒注意危险或后果。
受到告诫或训诫。
受到恳切劝勉；被敦促采取行动。
widdeb 的中被动态形式，表示受到警告、训诫或劝勉。

collocations.zh: 因自己的行为受到告诫

formal.mt: L-istudent twiddeb mill-għalliem dwar l-importanza li josserva r-regoli tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The student was admonished by the teacher about the importance of following the safety rules.
formal.zh: 老师告诫这名学生，强调遵守安全规定的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ħareġ mill-klassi daqshekk kwiet? Pawlu: Twiddeb mill-għalliem għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave the classroom so quietly? Pawlu: He was admonished by the teacher because he kept talking during the lesson.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 怎么这么安静地走出了教室？Pawlu：他上课一直讲话，受到老师训诫了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ħareġ mill-klassi daqshekk kwiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ħareġ mill-klassi daqshekk kwiet?
messages.zh: Mark 怎么这么安静地走出了教室？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the classroom so quietly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Twiddeb mill-għalliem għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Twiddeb mill-għalliem għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 他上课一直讲话，受到老师训诫了。
messages.en: He was admonished by the teacher because he kept talking during the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准接受告诫的人：他受到警告、训诫或劝勉。这样记住 twiddeb 的受事视角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warning, admonishment, or earnest exhortation, or the act of giving one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 警告、训诫或恳切劝勉，也指进行这些言语行为的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twissija, ċanfira jew tħeġġiġ serju, jew l-att li tagħti dawn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警告；提醒对方注意风险或不良后果的话。
告诫；针对错误或不当行为的训诫。
劝勉；恳切敦促对方采取行动的话。
告诫或训诫他人的行为。

formal.mt: It-twiddib tal-għalliem kien maħsub biex jgħin lill-istudenti jifhmu l-konsegwenzi tal-imġiba tagħhom.
formal.en: The teacher's admonishment was intended to help the students understand the consequences of their behavior.
formal.zh: 老师的训诫旨在帮助学生理解自身行为的后果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qallek l-għalliem? Pawlu: Qalli kliem ta' twiddib għax erġajt wasalt tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the teacher say to you? Pawlu: He gave me a talking-to because I was late again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：老师对你说了什么？Pawlu：我又迟到了，他告诫了我一番。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 老师对你说了什么？
messages.en: What did the teacher say to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli kliem ta' twiddib għax erġajt wasalt tard.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli kliem ta' twiddib għax erġajt wasalt tard.
messages.zh: 我又迟到了，他告诫了我一番。
messages.en: He gave me a talking-to because I was late again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一对句意区分：twiddeb 是某人受到告诫，twiddib 是那番告诫或告诫行为；后者当名词记。

gloss_zh: 高的；长的；持续时间长的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a large extent in height, length, or duration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在高度、长度或持续时间上较大的，即高的、长的或时间久的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tul kbir fl-għoli, fid-distanza jew fiż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高的；身材或物体高度较大的。
长的；长度或延伸距离较大的。
长的；高的，具体取决于所描述对象的方向和性质。
持续时间长的；历时久的。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jeħtieġ żmien twil biex jitlesta minħabba l-ammont ta' xogħol meħtieġ.
formal.en: The project requires a long time to complete because of the amount of work involved.
formal.zh: 由于所需工作量大，这个项目需要很长时间才能完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħabel twil biżżejjed? Pawlu: Iva, jasal sas-siġra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this rope long enough? Pawlu: Yes, it reaches the tree.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这根绳子够长吗？Pawlu：够，能一直伸到那棵树。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这根绳子够长吗？
messages.en: Is this rope long enough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 够，能一直伸到那棵树。
messages.en: Yes, it reaches the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象三条拉长的线：竖着量是高，横着量是长，放在时间轴上是久；三个方向都能联想到 twil。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a strong effort, work hard, or struggle to achieve something, sometimes through physical exertion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为达成目标而努力、苦干或奋力挣扎，也可指身体上费力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz kbir jew jaħdem bis-sħiħ biex jilħaq għan, xi drabi bi sforz fiżiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为实现目标而努力、奋斗。
努力工作；苦干。
奋力应对困难；挣扎或艰难奋斗。
身体上用力、费力；付出体力。
尽力尝试；努力争取达成目标。

collocations.en: to struggle to lift a heavy box
collocations.zh: 费力地抬起沉重的箱子

formal.mt: Minkejja d-diffikultajiet finanzjarji, l-istudent tħabat biex itemm l-istudji tiegħu.
formal.en: Despite financial difficulties, the student worked hard to complete his studies.
formal.zh: 尽管经济困难，这名学生仍努力完成学业。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Mark jidher daqshekk għajjien? Pawlu: Tħabat biex itella' l-kaxxi kollha fuq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does Mark look so tired? Pawlu: He struggled to carry all the boxes upstairs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克怎么看起来这么累？保罗：他费了好大劲才把所有箱子搬上楼。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么看起来这么累？
messages.en: Why does Mark look so tired?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħabat biex itella' l-kaxxi kollha fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Tħabat biex itella' l-kaxxi kollha fuq.
messages.zh: 他费了好大劲才把所有箱子搬上楼。
messages.en: He struggled to carry all the boxes upstairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“顶着困难往前推”的画面：推的是重箱子，就是体力费劲；推的是人生目标，就是努力奋斗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak or take part in a conversation, often with someone or about a particular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话或与人交谈，常用于表达与谁谈话或谈论什么话题。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem jew jieħu sehem f'konversazzjoni, ma' xi ħadd jew dwar suġġett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与人交谈；进行聊天。
说话；发言。
说话；与人交谈。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, id-direttur tħaddet dwar il-ħtieġa ta' aktar taħriġ għall-ħaddiema.
formal.en: During the meeting, the director spoke about the need for more training for employees.
formal.zh: 会议期间，主管谈到了为员工提供更多培训的必要性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma' min tħaddet Pawlu wara l-ikel? Lara: Ma' Ġanni. Tkellmu dwar il-vaganza tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who did Pawlu chat with after the meal? Lara: With Ġanni. They talked about their holiday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗饭后和谁聊天了？拉拉：和詹尼。他们聊了自己的假期。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min tħaddet Pawlu wara l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min tħaddet Pawlu wara l-ikel?
messages.zh: 保罗饭后和谁聊天了？
messages.en: Who did Pawlu chat with after the meal?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' Ġanni. Tkellmu dwar il-vaganza tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Ma' Ġanni. Tkellmu dwar il-vaganza tagħhom.
messages.zh: 和詹尼。他们聊了自己的假期。
messages.en: With Ġanni. They talked about their holiday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个问题串联记忆：“和谁谈？”对应交谈对象，“谈什么？”对应话题，核心都是开口交流。

gloss_zh: 被促使产奶；被灌浆；屋顶被作防水处理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to produce or yield milk; also, of a surface or roof, to undergo grouting or waterproofing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被促使产奶或出奶；也可指表面被灌浆，或屋顶被作防水处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jagħti l-ħalib; jista' wkoll jirreferi għal wiċċ li jimtela bil-ħalib tal-ġir jew għal saqaf li jiġi protett kontra l-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to produce milk
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被促使产奶。
被灌浆或作填缝处理。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be waterproofed (used of a roof)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被作防水处理，用于屋顶。
ħalleb 的中间被动态形式，表示相关动作作用于主语自身或由主语承受。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to yield milk
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被促使出奶。

collocations.en: the cow was made to yield milk

formal.mt: Is-saqaf tħalleb qabel l-istaġun tax-xita biex l-ilma ma jidħolx fil-bini.
formal.en: The roof was waterproofed before the rainy season to prevent water from entering the building.
formal.zh: 屋顶在雨季前作了防水处理，以防雨水进入建筑物。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Is-saqaf tħalleb diġà? Toni: Iva, ilbieraħ; issa nistgħu nlestu l-kamra.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has the roof been waterproofed yet? Toni: Yes, yesterday; now we can finish the room.
colloquial.zh: Marta：屋顶已经作好防水了吗？Toni：是的，昨天作好了；现在我们可以把房间收拾完了。

messages.speaker: Marta (屋主)
messages.zh: 屋顶已经作好防水了吗？
messages.en: Has the roof been waterproofed yet?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilbieraħ; issa nistgħu nlestu l-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilbieraħ; issa nistgħu nlestu l-kamra.
messages.zh: 是的，昨天作好了；现在我们可以把房间收拾完了。
messages.en: Yes, yesterday; now we can finish the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：母牛被促使出奶，屋顶被涂覆防水材料；共同注意主语承受处理，具体意思由语境决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To defend or protect one another, with each person supporting the other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此保护或为对方辩护，强调双方相互支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddefendu jew jipproteġu lil xulxin, b'kull wieħed jagħti appoġġ lill-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相互保护或辩护，强调动作的相互性。
彼此维护，为对方辩护。

collocations.en: they defended one another against the accusations
collocations.zh: 他们面对指控时互相辩护

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ kollegi tħamew meta ġew akkużati bla raġuni, u kull wieħed spjega x'kien għamel l-ieħor.
formal.en: The two colleagues defended one another when they were accused without reason, and each explained what the other had done.
formal.zh: 两位同事遭到无端指控时互相辩护，各自说明了对方所做的事情。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamlu Mark u Pawlu meta semgħu l-akkużi? Nina: Tħamew; kull wieħed tkellem favur l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mark and Pawlu do when they heard the accusations? Nina: They defended one another; each spoke up for the other.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 和 Pawlu 听到那些指控后做了什么？Nina：他们互相辩护，各自为对方说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamlu Mark u Pawlu meta semgħu l-akkużi?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamlu Mark u Pawlu meta semgħu l-akkużi?
messages.zh: Mark 和 Pawlu 听到那些指控后做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark and Pawlu do when they heard the accusations?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħamew; kull wieħed tkellem favur l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tħamew; kull wieħed tkellem favur l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 他们互相辩护，各自为对方说话。
messages.en: They defended one another; each spoke up for the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两位朋友背靠背站着，你保护我、我保护你；用双向箭头记住这个词强调相互维护。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become red or be made red; also to be fried in oil or fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变红或被弄红；也指食物被放在油脂中煎炸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħmar jew jiġi magħmul aħmar; jista' wkoll ifisser li ikel jiġi moqli fiż-żejt jew fix-xaħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变红，被弄红。
被煎炸。

collocations.en: the fish was fried in oil

formal.mt: Il-ħut tħammar fiż-żejt sħun u mbagħad tqiegħed fuq karta biex jitneħħa ż-żejt żejjed.
formal.en: The fish was fried in hot oil and then placed on paper to remove the excess oil.
formal.zh: 鱼在热油中煎炸后被放在纸上，以吸去多余的油。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex wiċċ Mark tħammar hekk? Lara: Qagħad wisq fix-xemx waqt il-mixja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why has Mark's face become so red? Lara: He spent too long in the sun during the walk.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 的脸怎么变得这么红？Lara：他散步时晒太阳晒得太久了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 的脸怎么变得这么红？
messages.en: Why has Mark's face become so red?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他散步时晒太阳晒得太久了。
messages.en: He spent too long in the sun during the walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记两张学习图片：一张是晒红的脸，一张是油锅里的鱼；看到人脸想到变红，看到油锅想到煎炸。

gloss_zh: 吃得过量；大吃大喝；行为失态

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat far too much or pig out; also to behave in a disgraceful way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃得过多、放纵地大吃大喝；也可指做出丢脸或失态的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol iżżejjed jew bla rażan; jista' wkoll ifisser li jġib ruħu b'mod ta' għajb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃得过量，吃得太多。
放开肚皮大吃大喝，带有口语色彩。
行为失态，做出丢脸或可耻的举动。

collocations.zh: 他放纵地吃了大量甜食

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla tal-familja, Pawlu tħanżer u wara ħassu tqil wisq biex joħroġ jimxi.
formal.en: During the family meal, Pawlu overate and afterwards felt too full to go out for a walk.
formal.zh: 家庭聚餐时，Pawlu 吃得过多，之后撑得不想出门散步。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu għaliex ma jridx deżerta? Toni: Tħanżer bil-pizza u issa ma jiflaħ jiekol xejn iżjed.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why doesn't Pawlu want dessert? Toni: He pigged out on pizza and now he can't eat anything else.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 为什么不要甜点？Toni：他刚才披萨吃得太多，现在什么也吃不下了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么不要甜点？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu want dessert?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħanżer bil-pizza u issa ma jiflaħ jiekol xejn iżjed.
messages.mt_standard: Tħanżer bil-pizza u issa ma jiflaħ jiekol xejn iżjed.
messages.zh: 他刚才披萨吃得太多，现在什么也吃不下了。
messages.en: He pigged out on pizza and now he can't eat anything else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚餐时盘子堆成小山，吃完撑得靠在椅背上；记住吃过量的画面，再另记行为失态这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of grinding something into smaller particles or liquidising food into a liquid or smooth mixture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西研磨成细小颗粒的过程；也指把食物搅打成液状或均匀糊状的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titfarrak f'partiċelli żgħar, jew ikel jinħadem sakemm isir likwidu jew taħlita lixxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 研磨、磨碎的过程。
将食物搅打成液状或均匀糊状的过程。

formal.mt: It-tħin tal-qamħ huwa pass importanti fil-produzzjoni tad-dqiq, għax inaqqas il-ħbub f'partiċelli żgħar.
formal.en: Grinding wheat is an important step in flour production because it reduces the grains to small particles.
formal.zh: 研磨小麦是面粉生产的重要步骤，因为这一过程把麦粒磨成细小颗粒。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lest it-tħin tal-ħaxix għas-soppa? Mark: Iva, issa t-taħlita lixxa u nistgħu nsaħħnuha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you finished liquidising the vegetables for the soup? Mark: Yes, the mixture is smooth now and we can heat it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：做汤用的蔬菜搅打好了吗？Mark：好了，现在已经很细滑，可以加热了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 做汤用的蔬菜搅打好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished liquidising the vegetables for the soup?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa t-taħlita lixxa u nistgħu nsaħħnuha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa t-taħlita lixxa u nistgħu nsaħħnuha.
messages.zh: 好了，现在已经很细滑，可以加热了。
messages.en: Yes, the mixture is smooth now and we can heat it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房两台机器记忆：磨粉机把麦粒磨细，搅拌机把蔬菜打成汤；这个名词说的是加工过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connects words or clauses meaning 'and'; after a personal pronoun, it can introduce an ongoing action meaning 'when' or 'while'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连接词语或分句，表示“和、并且”；在人称代词后接主动分词或未完成式动词时，也可表示“当……时、在……期间”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad kliem jew sentenzi; wara pronom personali u qabel partiċipju attiv jew verb fl-imperfett, tista' tfisser 'waqt li'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和；与；并且，用于连接并列成分。

sense_translations.en_definition: and; used to connect words, phrases, etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 和；并且，用于连接词、短语等成分。

sense_translations.en_definition: when, as; used after a personal pronoun and followed by an active participle or imperfect verb
sense_translations.zh_definition: 当……时；在……期间，用在人称代词之后，后接主动分词或未完成式动词。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw it-test u wieġbu l-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The students read the text and answered the questions.
formal.zh: 学生们阅读了课文，并回答了问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi trid mill-ħanut? Pawlu: Ħobż u ħalib, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you want from the shop? Pawlu: Bread and milk, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想让我从商店买什么？Pawlu：请买面包和牛奶。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你想让我从商店买什么？
messages.en: What do you want from the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 请买面包和牛奶。
messages.en: Bread and milk, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 u 想成连接两样东西的小桥，先记“和”；再整块记 jien u miexi，理解为“我走路的时候”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person holding a position of authority or responsibility in an organization, such as the police or armed forces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在机构中担任具有职权或责任的职位的人，如官员、警官或军官。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha kariga ta' awtorità jew responsabbiltà f'organizzazzjoni, bħal fil-pulizija jew fil-forzi armati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 官员；军官；警官，具体称谓取决于任职机构。

collocations.zh: 一名高级官员或高级军官

formal.mt: Uffiċjal tal-pulizija ħejja rapport dwar l-inċident wara li sema' lix-xhieda.
formal.en: A police officer prepared a report on the incident after hearing the witnesses.
formal.zh: 一名警官听取证人陈述后，就该事件撰写了报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar il-borża li tlift? Pawlu: Hemm uffiċjal tal-pulizija ħdejn il-bieb; staqsi lilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can I ask about the bag I lost? Pawlu: There's a police officer by the door; ask him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我丢了包，可以找谁询问？Pawlu：门旁边有一名警官，问问他吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar il-borża li tlift?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nista' nistaqsi dwar il-borża li tlift?
messages.zh: 我丢了包，可以找谁询问？
messages.en: Who can I ask about the bag I lost?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm uffiċjal tal-pulizija ħdejn il-bieb; staqsi lilu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm uffiċjal tal-pulizija ħdejn il-bieb; staqsi lilu.
messages.zh: 门旁边有一名警官，问问他吧。
messages.en: There's a police officer by the door; ask him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面区分相近词：uffiċjal 指一位有职务的人，想象佩戴工作证的警官；先牢牢记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Issued, authorized, or recognized by an authority or organization in its formal capacity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有关机关或机构以正式身份发布、批准或认可的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħruġ, awtorizzat jew rikonoxxut minn awtorità jew organizzazzjoni fil-kapaċità formali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 官方的；正式的；经有关机关或机构认可的。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ippubblika avviż uffiċjali dwar il-bidla fil-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: The council published an official notice about the change in opening hours.
formal.zh: 委员会就开放时间的调整发布了正式通知。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt li l-laqgħa nbidlet għall-Ġimgħa. Huwa uffiċjali? Pawlu: Iva, wasal l-avviż uffiċjali dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I heard the meeting has been moved to Friday. Is it official? Pawlu: Yes, the official notice arrived this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我听说会议改到星期五了。正式确定了吗？Pawlu：是的，正式通知今天早上已经收到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li l-laqgħa nbidlet għall-Ġimgħa. Huwa uffiċjali?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li l-laqgħa nbidlet għall-Ġimgħa. Huwa uffiċjali?
messages.zh: 我听说会议改到星期五了。正式确定了吗？
messages.en: I heard the meeting has been moved to Friday. Is it official?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，正式通知今天早上已经收到了。
messages.en: Yes, the official notice arrived this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uffiċjali 贴在盖章的通知或文件上，记成“官方的、正式的”；与指人的名词 uffiċjal 分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a formal or officially recognized way, especially through an authorized announcement or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以正式或获官方认可的方式，常用于公告、决定或身份的确认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod formali jew rikonoxxut minn awtorità, speċjalment f'avviż jew deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式地；官方地；经正式确认地

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ħabbar uffiċjalment li l-librerija se tiftaħ nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The council officially announced that the library will open on Monday.
formal.zh: 委员会正式宣布，图书馆将于星期一开放。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut il-ġdid fetaħ uffiċjalment? Mark: Iva, fetaħ ilbieraħ. Immorru narawh?
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the new shop officially opened? Mark: Yes, it opened yesterday. Shall we go and have a look?
colloquial.zh: Maja：那家新店正式开业了吗？Mark：是的，昨天开业了。我们去看看吧？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那家新店正式开业了吗？
messages.en: Has the new shop officially opened?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，昨天开业了。我们去看看吧？
messages.en: Yes, it opened yesterday. Shall we go and have a look?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“正式宣布”和“正式开业”两个场景，记住它修饰事情如何得到正式确认。

gloss_zh: 相等；平等；相等的；平等的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equality: the state of being the same in value, amount, or status.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相等或平等，即数值、数量或地位相同的状态；所给名词义带有待确认标记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat li fih żewġ affarijiet jew aktar għandhom l-istess valur, kwantità jew status.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相等；平等（所给名词义带有待确认标记）
相等的；相同数量或价值的；地位平等的

formal.mt: Ir-regolament jiggarantixxi drittijiet ugwali lill-membri kollha tal-assoċjazzjoni.
formal.en: The regulation guarantees equal rights to all members of the association.
formal.zh: 该规章保障协会所有成员享有平等权利。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Naqsmu l-kejk f'erba' biċċiet ugwali? Ben: Iva, hekk kulħadd jieħu l-istess ammont.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we cut the cake into four equal pieces? Ben: Yes, that way everyone gets the same amount.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们把蛋糕切成大小相等的四块好吗？Ben：好，这样每个人分到的一样多。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们把蛋糕切成大小相等的四块好吗？
messages.en: Shall we cut the cake into four equal pieces?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk kulħadd jieħu l-istess ammont.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk kulħadd jieħu l-istess ammont.
messages.zh: 好，这样每个人分到的一样多。
messages.en: Yes, that way everyone gets the same amount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蛋糕切成完全一样的四块，再联想到人人享有同等权利，把数量相等和地位平等一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being equal, especially in rights, status, or opportunities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于平等或相等的状态，尤其指权利、地位或机会上的平等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat li fih persuni għandhom l-istess drittijiet, status jew opportunitajiet, jew affarijiet għandhom l-istess valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平等；相等；同等的状态

formal.mt: Il-politika tal-iskola tippromwovi l-ugwaljanza bejn l-istudenti kollha.
formal.en: The school's policy promotes equality among all students.
formal.zh: 学校的政策促进全体学生之间的平等。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd għandu l-istess ħin biex jitkellem? Mark: Għax irridu l-ugwaljanza fil-grupp; kulħadd għandu jkollu ċans jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does everyone have the same amount of time to speak? Mark: Because we want equality in the group; everyone should have a chance to speak.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么每个人的发言时间都一样？Mark：因为我们希望小组里人人平等，每个人都应该有机会发言。

messages.speaker: Maja (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd għandu l-istess ħin biex jitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd għandu l-istess ħin biex jitkellem?
messages.zh: 为什么每个人的发言时间都一样？
messages.en: Why does everyone have the same amount of time to speak?

messages.speaker: Mark (小组主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irridu l-ugwaljanza fil-grupp; kulħadd għandu jkollu ċans jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irridu l-ugwaljanza fil-grupp; kulħadd għandu jkollu ċans jitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为我们希望小组里人人平等，每个人都应该有机会发言。
messages.en: Because we want equality in the group; everyone should have a chance to speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“人人有同样的发言机会”记住这个抽象名词：它说的是平等这种状态或原则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to add another person, thing, action, or fact to what has already been mentioned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于补充另一个人、事物、动作或事实，表示“也”“还”或“同样”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li żżid persuna, ħaġa, azzjoni jew fatt ma' dak li jkun diġà ssemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 也；还；另外也
也；同样
也；还；同样也
也；还；同样也，用于补充同类信息

collocations.en: there is also; there are also

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi lezzjonijiet tal-grammatika u joffri wkoll eżerċizzji tal-konversazzjoni.
formal.en: The course includes grammar lessons and also offers conversation exercises.
formal.zh: 这门课程包含语法课，也提供会话练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Jien se mmur il-librerija wara x-xogħol. Pawlu: Jien ukoll! Nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'm going to the library after work. Pawlu: Me too! We can go together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我下班后要去图书馆。Pawlu：我也去！我们可以一起走。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se mmur il-librerija wara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Jien se mmur il-librerija wara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 我下班后要去图书馆。
messages.en: I'm going to the library after work.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我也去！我们可以一起走。
messages.en: Me too! We can go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jien ukoll 整块记成“我也是”，每当别人说完而你想补上自己，就联想这个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of giving birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产下婴儿的行为或过程，即分娩、生产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li fih mara twelled tarbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分娩；生产，指产下婴儿这一事件
分娩的行为；产下婴儿的过程

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-appoġġ li rċeviet l-omm waqt l-ulieda.
formal.en: The report describes the support the mother received during childbirth.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了母亲在分娩期间获得的支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgħinek id-dar wara l-ulieda? Sara: Ommi se toqgħod magħna għal ftit jiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will help you at home after childbirth? Sara: My mother will stay with us for a few days.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你生完孩子后，谁会在家帮你？Sara：我妈妈会来和我们住几天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgħinek id-dar wara l-ulieda?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgħinek id-dar wara l-ulieda?
messages.zh: 你生完孩子后，谁会在家帮你？
messages.en: Who will help you at home after childbirth?

messages.speaker: Sara (准妈妈)
messages.mt_spoken: Ommi se toqgħod magħna għal ftit jiem.
messages.mt_standard: Ommi se toqgħod magħna għal ftit jiem.
messages.zh: 我妈妈会来和我们住几天。
messages.en: My mother will stay with us for a few days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出“产前、分娩期间、产后”三格时间线，把这个词放在中间，记住它表示生产过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to people or characteristic of human beings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与人或人类有关的，或具有人类特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-bniedem jew li huwa karatteristiku tal-bnedmin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人的；人类的；具有人类特征的
人；人类个体（所给词性标为形容词，中文释义表达其所指的人）

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jispjega kif il-ġisem uman juża l-enerġija mill-ikel.
formal.en: This chapter explains how the human body uses energy from food.
formal.zh: 本章解释人体如何利用食物中的能量。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm data ħażina fuq il-biljett? Lara: Kien żball uman; daħħalt ix-xahar ħażin. Nirranġah issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is there an incorrect date on the ticket? Lara: It was human error; I entered the wrong month. I'll fix it now.
colloquial.zh: Mark：票上的日期为什么错了？Lara：是人为失误，我把月份输错了。我现在就改。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm data ħażina fuq il-biljett?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm data ħażina fuq il-biljett?
messages.zh: 票上的日期为什么错了？
messages.en: Why is there an incorrect date on the ticket?

messages.speaker: Lara (售票员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien żball uman; daħħalt ix-xahar ħażin. Nirranġah issa.
messages.mt_standard: Kien żball uman; daħħalt ix-xahar ħażin. Nirranġah issa.
messages.zh: 是人为失误，我把月份输错了。我现在就改。
messages.en: It was human error; I entered the wrong month. I'll fix it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“人体”和“人为失误”并排记忆：一个关联人的身体，一个关联人的行为，共同提示“与人有关”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: All human beings collectively; also, kindness and compassion towards others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 全体人类；也指对他人表现出的仁爱、同情心和人道精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bnedmin kollha flimkien; ukoll, il-ħniena u t-tjubija li nuru ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人类，作为整体的全体人。
人性中的仁爱与同情心；人道精神。

formal.mt: Il-protezzjoni tal-ambjent hija essenzjali għall-futur tal-umanità.
formal.en: Protecting the environment is essential for the future of humanity.
formal.zh: 保护环境对人类的未来至关重要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt kif għen lil dak ir-raġel anzjan? Pawlu: Iva, wera ħafna umanità.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see how he helped that elderly man? Pawlu: Yes, he showed a lot of compassion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到他怎么帮助那位老人了吗？保罗：看到了，他很有仁爱之心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif għen lil dak ir-raġel anzjan?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif għen lil dak ir-raġel anzjan?
messages.zh: 你看到他怎么帮助那位老人了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how he helped that elderly man?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，他很有仁爱之心。
messages.en: Yes, he showed a lot of compassion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：地球上的所有人表示“人类”，伸手帮助他人表示“仁爱”；同一个词连接这两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object with a handle and a folding cover, held above the head to protect against rain or sun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有手柄和可折叠伞面的用具，撑在头顶以遮雨或遮阳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett b'manku u għata li tinfetaħ u tingħalaq, li żżommu fuq rasek biex tipproteġi ruħek mix-xita jew mix-xemx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伞；撑在头顶用来遮雨或遮阳的用具。

formal.mt: F'każ ta' xita, il-viżitaturi għandhom iġibu umbrella magħhom.
formal.en: In case of rain, visitors should bring an umbrella with them.
formal.zh: 为防下雨，访客应随身携带雨伞。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Għandek umbrella? Mark: Iva, ejja taħt l-umbrella tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: It's raining. Do you have an umbrella? Mark: Yes, come under my umbrella.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：下雨了。你带伞了吗？马克：带了，来我的伞下吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 下雨了。你带伞了吗？
messages.en: It's raining. Do you have an umbrella?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 带了，来我的伞下吧。
messages.en: Yes, come under my umbrella.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 umbrella 写在一幅撑伞图旁，再配合“打开伞”和“躲到伞下”两个动作记忆，建立词语与实物的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slightly wet, or containing a noticeable amount of moisture in the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 略带水分的、潮湿的；也形容空气中湿气较重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ftit ilma jew ħafna fwar tal-ilma, bħal drapp li għadu ma nixifx jew arja mimlija umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潮湿的；略微湿润、尚未完全干燥的。
湿度高的；空气中含有较多水汽的。
潮湿的、湿润的；可形容物体、地方或空气。
潮气；湿气；潮湿的状态或空气中的湿度。

formal.mt: Il-ħajt għadu umdu u jrid jinxef qabel ma jinżebagħ.
formal.en: The wall is still damp and must dry before it is painted.
formal.zh: 墙壁仍然潮湿，必须干燥后才能粉刷。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nilbes dan il-flokk? Omm: Għadu umdu. Ħu wieħed niexef mill-armarju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I wear this shirt? Mother: It's still damp. Take a dry one from the wardrobe.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我能穿这件上衣吗？妈妈：它还潮着呢。去衣柜里拿一件干的。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我能穿这件上衣吗？
messages.en: Can I wear this shirt?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu umdu. Ħu wieħed niexef mill-armarju.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu umdu. Ħu wieħed niexef mill-armarju.
messages.zh: 它还潮着呢。去衣柜里拿一件干的。
messages.en: It's still damp. Take a dry one from the wardrobe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象摸到一件尚未晾干的上衣，手上感觉微潮，就说 umdu；再把同样的湿气感延伸到天气和墙壁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel ashamed or lose their dignity through degrading treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以贬低或侮辱的方式对待某人，使其感到羞耻或失去尊严。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mistħi jew imċekken billi tittrattah b'mod li jneħħilu d-dinjità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羞辱某人；使某人感到受辱、难堪或失去尊严。

collocations.mt: umilja lil xi ħadd quddiem kulħadd
collocations.en: he humiliated someone in front of everyone

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-maniġer umilja lill-impjegat quddiem il-kollegi tiegħu.
formal.en: According to the report, the manager humiliated the employee in front of his colleagues.
formal.zh: 据报告所述，经理当着同事的面羞辱了那名员工。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Mark telaq daqshekk kmieni? Karl: Xi ħadd umiljah quddiem kulħadd, u ħassu ħażin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark leave so early? Karl: Someone humiliated him in front of everyone, and he felt upset.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克为什么那么早就走了？卡尔：有人当众羞辱了他，他很难受。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么那么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave so early?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd umiljah quddiem kulħadd, u ħassu ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd umiljah quddiem kulħadd, u ħassu ħażin.
messages.zh: 有人当众羞辱了他，他很难受。
messages.en: Someone humiliated him in front of everyone, and he felt upset.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个动作场景记忆：某人当众贬低别人，被针对的人低下头；umilja 表示造成这种受辱感的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of humiliating someone, or the painful feeling of shame and loss of dignity that results.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 羞辱他人的行为；也指由此产生的羞耻、难堪和尊严受损的感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih xi ħadd jiġi mċekken jew imċaħħad mid-dinjità tiegħu, jew is-sens ta' mistħija li jirriżulta minn dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羞辱；受辱；因尊严受到贬损而产生的屈辱感。

formal.mt: L-iskola għandha tipproteġi lill-istudenti mill-umiljazzjoni pubblika.
formal.en: The school should protect students from public humiliation.
formal.zh: 学校应保护学生免遭公开羞辱。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif ħassejtek meta qalu hekk quddiem kulħadd? Toni: Ħassejt sens ta' umiljazzjoni, imma mbagħad ħabib tiegħi ġie jkellimni.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did you feel when they said that in front of everyone? Toni: I felt humiliated, but then a friend came to talk to me.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：他们当众那样说时，你是什么感受？托尼：我感到很屈辱，不过后来有个朋友过来和我说话。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta qalu hekk quddiem kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta qalu hekk quddiem kulħadd?
messages.zh: 他们当众那样说时，你是什么感受？
messages.en: How did you feel when they said that in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt sens ta' umiljazzjoni, imma mbagħad ħabib tiegħi ġie jkellimni.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt sens ta' umiljazzjoni, imma mbagħad ħabib tiegħi ġie jkellimni.
messages.zh: 我感到很屈辱，不过后来有个朋友过来和我说话。
messages.en: I felt humiliated, but then a friend came to talk to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词放进“屈辱感”这个小盒子里记忆：umiljazzjoni 可以指羞辱事件，也可以指事件留下的受辱感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Modest about one's abilities or achievements and not behaving as if one is more important than others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对自己的能力或成就保持谦逊，不表现得比别人高贵或重要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jitkabbarx bil-ħiliet jew bis-suċċessi tiegħu u ma jqisx lilu nnifsu aqwa minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谦逊的；不自夸、不自大的。
谦卑的；态度谦和、不把自己看得高于他人的。

formal.mt: Minkejja s-suċċess internazzjonali tiegħu, l-awtur baqa' umli u dejjem irringrazzja lil dawk li għenuh.
formal.en: Despite his international success, the author remained humble and always thanked those who helped him.
formal.zh: 尽管取得了国际上的成功，这位作家仍然保持谦逊，并始终感谢帮助过他的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rebaħ il-premju u xorta qal li kellu ħafna x'jitgħallem. Ben: Iva, hu tassew umli.
colloquial.en: Maja: He won the prize and still said he had a lot to learn. Ben: Yes, he's really humble.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他得了奖，却还是说自己有很多东西要学。本：是啊，他确实很谦逊。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rebaħ il-premju u xorta qal li kellu ħafna x'jitgħallem.
messages.mt_standard: Rebaħ il-premju u xorta qal li kellu ħafna x'jitgħallem.
messages.zh: 他得了奖，却还是说自己有很多东西要学。
messages.en: He won the prize and still said he had a lot to learn.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他确实很谦逊。
messages.en: Yes, he's really humble.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象领奖的人把掌声分给帮助过自己的伙伴；用“有成绩也不自夸”的画面，把 umli 牢牢记成“谦逊的”。

gloss_zh: 匈牙利的；匈牙利人；匈牙利语

teaching_sense.en_definition: From Hungary, or relating to Hungary, its people, language or culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自匈牙利的；与匈牙利及其人民、语言或文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Ungerija jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ungerija, man-nies tagħha, mal-lingwa tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匈牙利的；与匈牙利有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Hungary
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自匈牙利的；属于匈牙利或与匈牙利相关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Hungarian (of, from or relating to Hungary)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 匈牙利的；来自匈牙利或与匈牙利有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Hungarian (native or inhabitant of Hungary) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 匈牙利人，指出生于匈牙利或居住在匈牙利的人，通常指男性。
匈牙利语。

formal.mt: Il-festival se jippreżenta film ungeriż b'sottotitli bil-Malti.
formal.en: The festival will present a Hungarian film with Maltese subtitles.
formal.zh: 电影节将放映一部配有马耳他语字幕的匈牙利电影。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak il-kittieb Ungeriż? Mark: Iva, u l-ktieb tiegħu qed naqrah bl-Ungeriż.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is that writer Hungarian? Mark: Yes, and I'm reading his book in Hungarian.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那位作家是匈牙利人吗？马克：是的，而且我正在读他的书的匈牙利语版。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那位作家是匈牙利人吗？
messages.en: Is that writer Hungarian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-ktieb tiegħu qed naqrah bl-Ungeriż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-ktieb tiegħu qed naqrah bl-Ungeriż.
messages.zh: 是的，而且我正在读他的书的匈牙利语版。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm reading his book in Hungarian.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张匈牙利主题卡：国旗下放一个人、一本书和一部电影，分别提示“匈牙利人”“匈牙利语”和“匈牙利的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distinctive set of clothes worn by members of an organization or group to show that they belong to it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个组织或群体成员穿着的统一服装，用来表明其身份或所属群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies speċjali li jilbsu l-membri ta' organizzazzjoni jew grupp biex juru li jagħmlu parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制服；某个组织、职业或学校成员统一穿着的服装。
统一的；一致的；均匀的，指各处或各部分没有明显差异。

sense_translations.en_definition: uniform (distinctive outfit as a means of identifying members of a group)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 制服；用于识别某个群体成员身份的特定服装。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jilbsu l-uniformi tal-iskola waqt iż-żjarat edukattivi.
formal.en: Students should wear the school uniform during educational visits.
formal.zh: 学生在参加教学参观活动时应穿着校服。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-uniformi tiegħi? Omm: Fl-armarju. Hija nadifa u lesta għal għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is my uniform? Mother: In the wardrobe. It's clean and ready for tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我的校服在哪里？妈妈：在衣柜里。已经洗干净了，明天可以穿。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我的校服在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my uniform?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-armarju. Hija nadifa u lesta għal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-armarju. Hija nadifa u lesta għal għada.
messages.zh: 在衣柜里。已经洗干净了，明天可以穿。
messages.en: In the wardrobe. It's clean and ready for tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排学生穿着颜色一致的校服：衣服本身提示名词“制服”，整齐一致的颜色提示形容词“统一的、均匀的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Being the only one of its kind or having qualities that make it distinctly different from others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同类中独一无二的，或具有与其他事物明显不同的特点的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu waħdu tat-tip tiegħu jew għandu kwalitajiet li jagħmluh differenti minn oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独一无二的；具有独特特点的。

formal.mt: Dan il-bini għandu disinn uniku li jiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-viżitaturi.
formal.en: This building has a unique design that attracts visitors' attention.
formal.zh: 这座建筑拥有独特的设计，吸引着参观者的注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan iċ-ċirku? Lara: Għax għandu disinn uniku; qatt ma rajt ieħor bħalu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this ring? Lara: Because it has a unique design; I have never seen another like it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么选这枚戒指？拉拉：因为它的设计独一无二，我从来没见过另一枚这样的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这枚戒指？
messages.en: Why did you choose this ring?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu disinn uniku; qatt ma rajt ieħor bħalu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu disinn uniku; qatt ma rajt ieħor bħalu.
messages.zh: 因为它的设计独一无二，我从来没见过另一枚这样的。
messages.en: Because it has a unique design; I have never seen another like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uniku 和英语 unique 配对记忆，再想象一枚找不到第二枚的戒指，记住“独一无二的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of forming a united or coherent whole, or one distinct part used for counting, measuring, or organizing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形成统一、团结或连贯整体的状态；也指用于计数、计量或组织内容的一个单位或单元。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' persuni jew partijiet li jiffurmaw ħaġa waħda magħquda jew koerenti; ukoll parti waħda li tintuża għall-għadd, il-kejl jew l-organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 团结；统一；多个成员或部分结合成一个整体的状态。
连贯性；各部分相互衔接、构成协调一致整体的性质。
一个单位或单元；可独立辨认、计数或组织的一个部分。
单位；单元，尤指计量的标准量或整体中的一个组成部分。

formal.mt: Kull riżultat għandu jinkludi n-numru u l-unità ta' kejl użata.
formal.en: Each result must include the number and the unit of measurement used.
formal.zh: 每项结果都必须包含数值以及所使用的计量单位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema unità nużaw biex inkejlu t-tul tal-mejda? Mark: Nużaw iċ-ċentimetru; il-mejda hija twila mija u għoxrin ċentimetru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which unit do we use to measure the length of the table? Mark: We use the centimetre; the table is one hundred and twenty centimetres long.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们用什么单位量桌子的长度？马克：用厘米；这张桌子长一百二十厘米。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema unità nużaw biex inkejlu t-tul tal-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Liema unità nużaw biex inkejlu t-tul tal-mejda?
messages.zh: 我们用什么单位量桌子的长度？
messages.en: Which unit do we use to measure the length of the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nużaw iċ-ċentimetru; il-mejda hija twila mija u għoxrin ċentimetru.
messages.mt_standard: Nużaw iċ-ċentimetru; il-mejda hija twila mija u għoxrin ċentimetru.
messages.zh: 用厘米；这张桌子长一百二十厘米。
messages.en: We use the centimetre; the table is one hundred and twenty centimetres long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“合成一个整体”和“取出一个单位”两幅图记 unità：前者帮助记团结与连贯，后者帮助记单位与单元。

teaching_sense.en_definition: All of space and everything that exists in it, including matter, energy, stars, and galaxies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 全部空间以及其中存在的一切，包括物质、能量、恒星和星系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ispazju kollu u dak kollu li jeżisti fih, inklużi l-materja, l-enerġija, l-istilel u l-galassji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宇宙；全部空间及其中一切存在的总体。

formal.mt: L-istudju tal-univers jgħinna nifhmu aħjar kif jiffurmaw l-istilel u l-galassji.
formal.en: The study of the universe helps us better understand how stars and galaxies form.
formal.zh: 研究宇宙有助于我们更好地理解恒星和星系如何形成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-ktieb huwa dwar l-univers? Pawlu: Iva, u fih stampi sbieħ ta' stilel u galassji.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this book about the universe? Pawlu: Yes, and it has beautiful pictures of stars and galaxies.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这本书是讲宇宙的吗？保罗：是的，里面还有漂亮的恒星和星系图片。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书是讲宇宙的吗？
messages.en: Is this book about the universe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u fih stampi sbieħ ta' stilel u galassji.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u fih stampi sbieħ ta' stilel u galassji.
messages.zh: 是的，里面还有漂亮的恒星和星系图片。
messages.en: Yes, and it has beautiful pictures of stars and galaxies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 univers 与英语 universe 并排看，再想象铺满恒星和星系的整片空间，直接联结“宇宙”。

gloss_zh: 普遍的；通用的；适用于所有人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Applying to everyone or everything within the relevant scope, or shared by all members of a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在相关范围内适用于所有人或所有事物的，或由全体成员共同具有的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li japplika għal kulħadd jew għal kollox fil-qasam rilevanti, jew li hu komuni għall-membri kollha ta' grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普遍的；通用的；在有关范围内适用于所有人或所有事物的。

collocations.zh: 人人均可获得的使用机会；普遍可及性

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu l-għan li jipprovdi aċċess universali għall-materjal edukattiv.
formal.en: The project aims to provide universal access to educational material.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在让所有人都能获取教育资料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri aċċess universali għal dan il-kors? David: Jiġifieri li kulħadd jista' jaċċessa l-lezzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does universal access to this course mean? David: It means that everyone can access the lessons.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这门课程的“人人均可获取”是什么意思？戴维：意思是每个人都能获取课程内容。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri aċċess universali għal dan il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri aċċess universali għal dan il-kors?
messages.zh: 这门课程的“人人均可获取”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does universal access to this course mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li kulħadd jista' jaċċessa l-lezzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li kulħadd jista' jaċċessa l-lezzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 意思是每个人都能获取课程内容。
messages.en: It means that everyone can access the lessons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 universali 与英语 universal 配对，心里画一张覆盖所有人的大网，提醒自己它表示“普遍适用的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An institution of higher education where students study for degrees and academic research is carried out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供学位课程并开展学术研究的高等教育机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Istituzzjoni ta' edukazzjoni għolja fejn l-istudenti jistudjaw għal lawrji u ssir riċerka akkademika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大学；提供高等教育、授予学位并开展研究的机构。

formal.mt: L-università toffri korsijiet fil-lingwi u tmexxi proġetti ta' riċerka.
formal.en: The university offers language courses and conducts research projects.
formal.zh: 这所大学提供语言课程，并开展研究项目。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se tistudja fl-università? Sara: Se nistudja l-lingwi għax inħobb nitgħallem kif jitkellmu n-nies.
colloquial.en: Mark: What will you study at university? Sara: I will study languages because I enjoy learning how people speak.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你上大学打算学什么？萨拉：我要学语言，因为我喜欢了解人们怎么说话。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你上大学打算学什么？
messages.en: What will you study at university?

messages.speaker: Sara (准大学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nistudja l-lingwi għax inħobb nitgħallem kif jitkellmu n-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Se nistudja l-lingwi għax inħobb nitgħallem kif jitkellmu n-nies.
messages.zh: 我要学语言，因为我喜欢了解人们怎么说话。
messages.en: I will study languages because I enjoy learning how people speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 università 与英语 university 配对，想象自己走进大学教室；书写时特别留意末尾带重音符号的 à。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A joining of people, groups, or things into a whole, or the bond that keeps them together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人、团体或事物结合为一个整体的联合，也指使各成员紧密联系的凝聚状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għaqda ta' persuni, gruppi jew affarijiet f'ħaġa waħda, jew ir-rabta li żżommhom flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联合；结合；由多个成员或团体组成的联盟。
凝聚；团结；成员或部分紧密联系、维持整体的状态。

formal.mt: L-unjoni bejn iż-żewġ gruppi ppermettiet li jaqsmu r-riżorsi u jaħdmu lejn għan komuni.
formal.en: The union between the two groups enabled them to share resources and work towards a common goal.
formal.zh: 两个团体的联合使它们能够共享资源，并朝着共同目标努力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed norganizzaw din l-ikla tal-familja? Pawlu: Biex insaħħu l-unjoni tal-familja u nqattgħu ftit ħin flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we organizing this family meal? Pawlu: To strengthen family cohesion and spend some time together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们为什么要组织这次家庭聚餐？保罗：为了增进家庭团结，也一起待上一会儿。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed norganizzaw din l-ikla tal-familja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed norganizzaw din l-ikla tal-familja?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要组织这次家庭聚餐？
messages.en: Why are we organizing this family meal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex insaħħu l-unjoni tal-familja u nqattgħu ftit ħin flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Biex insaħħu l-unjoni tal-familja u nqattgħu ftit ħin flimkien.
messages.zh: 为了增进家庭团结，也一起待上一会儿。
messages.en: To strengthen family cohesion and spend some time together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 union 作拼写联想，再画几只紧握的手：结合起来是“联合”，持续紧密相连是“凝聚”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Respect or recognition given for someone's qualities or actions, or the privilege of being chosen for something valued.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人的品格或行为而给予的敬重与荣誉，也指获选参与受重视之事的荣幸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rispett jew ir-rikonoxximent mogħti lil xi ħadd għall-kwalitajiet jew l-għemil tiegħu; ukoll il-privileġġ li jintgħażel għal xi ħaġa ta' valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荣誉；敬重；受到重视或获得某种机会时的荣幸。
荣誉；敬重；荣幸，与 honor 所表达的意义相同。

formal.mt: Huwa unur kbir għalija li nirċievi dan il-premju f'isem it-tim kollu.
formal.en: It is a great honour for me to receive this award on behalf of the whole team.
formal.zh: 能够代表整个团队领取这个奖项，我深感荣幸。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Talbuni nkanta fil-festa tal-iskola! Maja: Xi ħaġa sabiħa! Dak unur kbir.
colloquial.en: Lara: They asked me to sing at the school celebration! Maja: How lovely! That is a great honour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们请我在学校庆祝活动上唱歌！玛雅：真好！那可是莫大的荣幸。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 他们请我在学校庆祝活动上唱歌！
messages.en: They asked me to sing at the school celebration!

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħaġa sabiħa! Dak unur kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħaġa sabiħa! Dak unur kbir.
messages.zh: 真好！那可是莫大的荣幸。
messages.en: How lovely! That is a great honour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己代表全班上台领奖，并说 unur kbir；把“受到敬重的荣誉”和“获选时的荣幸”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The usefulness or practical value of something in meeting a need or achieving a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物在满足需要或实现目的方面具有的用处、实用性或效用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur prattiku ta' xi ħaġa u kemm din tgħin biex tintlaħaq mira jew tiġi sodisfatta ħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 效用；实用性；某事物能够满足需要或帮助完成任务的实际用处。

collocations.zh: 很有用的；具有很大实用价值的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jevalwa l-utilità tal-għodda fit-tnaqqis tal-ħin meħtieġ biex jitlesta x-xogħol.
formal.en: The report evaluates the utility of the tool in reducing the time needed to complete the work.
formal.zh: 该报告评估了这一工具在缩短工作所需时间方面的效用。

colloquial.mt: David: Din il-mappa se tkun ta' utilità għalina? Sara: Iva, turina t-toroq kollha u fejn hemm l-eqreb waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: David: Will this map be useful to us? Sara: Yes, it shows us all the streets and where the nearest bus stop is.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：这张地图对我们有用吗？萨拉：有用，它能让我们看到所有街道，还有最近的公交车站在哪里。

messages.speaker: David (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-mappa se tkun ta' utilità għalina?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-mappa se tkun ta' utilità għalina?
messages.zh: 这张地图对我们有用吗？
messages.en: Will this map be useful to us?

messages.speaker: Sara (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, turina t-toroq kollha u fejn hemm l-eqreb waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, turina t-toroq kollha u fejn hemm l-eqreb waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 有用，它能让我们看到所有街道，还有最近的公交车站在哪里。
messages.en: Yes, it shows us all the streets and where the nearest bus stop is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 utilità 与英语 utility 配对，想象一张真正帮你找到车站的地图，用“能帮上什么忙”记住实用性与效用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make practical use of something for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某个具体目的利用或运用某种资源、工具或方法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża xi ħaġa għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用；运用。
为实现某个目的而利用或运用。

formal.mt: It-tim għandu jutilizza r-riżorsi disponibbli biex itemm il-proġett.
formal.en: The team should utilize the available resources to complete the project.
formal.zh: 团队应利用现有资源完成项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' norganizza l-kotba? Mark: Utilizza l-ixkaffa vojta ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I organize the books? Mark: Use the empty shelf next to the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以怎么整理这些书？Mark：利用门旁边那个空书架吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以怎么整理这些书？
messages.en: How can I organize the books?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 利用门旁边那个空书架吧。
messages.en: Use the empty shelf next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把空书架利用起来：看到 utilِizza 的词形时，联想“把现有东西派上用场”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small cup that holds a boiled egg upright for eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来竖放带壳煮蛋、方便食用的小杯状器皿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent żgħir li jżomm bajda mgħollija wieqfa biex tkun tista' tiekolha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛋杯；用来竖放带壳煮蛋的小器皿。

collocations.en: put the egg in the eggcup

formal.mt: Poġġi l-bajda mgħollija fl-uviera qabel isservi l-kolazzjon.
formal.en: Place the boiled egg in the eggcup before serving breakfast.
formal.zh: 端上早餐前，把煮蛋放入蛋杯中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-uviera tiegħi? Omm: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-kuċċarina.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is my eggcup? Mum: On the table, next to the teaspoon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我的蛋杯在哪里？妈妈：在桌上，小勺旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我的蛋杯在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my eggcup?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 在桌上，小勺旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the teaspoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 uviera 想成早餐桌上的“鸡蛋小座椅”：鸡蛋竖着坐在杯里，就记住了蛋杯。

gloss_zh: 疼痛；痛楚；情感上的剧烈波动

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physical pain or aching, or emotional pain and distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体上的疼痛、酸痛，也可指内心的痛楚或情绪上的剧烈波动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' tbatija fil-ġisem, jew tbatija u taqlib emozzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续的隐痛或酸痛
疼痛；痛楚
情感上的剧烈波动；内心的痛苦与动荡
疼痛；酸痛；隐痛

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta uġigħ fid-dahar li beda jumejn ilu.
formal.en: The patient reported back pain that began two days ago.
formal.zh: 患者报告说，背部疼痛始于两天前。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi uġigħ ta' ras u ma nistax nikkonċentra. Mark: Trid nintefa' r-radju biex ikun hemm ftit kwiet?
colloquial.en: Maja: I have a headache and I can't concentrate. Mark: Would you like me to turn off the radio so it's a little quieter?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我头痛，没法集中注意力。Mark：要我关掉收音机，让这里安静一点吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi uġigħ ta' ras u ma nistax nikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi uġigħ ta' ras u ma nistax nikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 我头痛，没法集中注意力。
messages.en: I have a headache and I can't concentrate.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nintefa' r-radju biex ikun hemm ftit kwiet?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nintefa' r-radju biex ikun hemm ftit kwiet?
messages.zh: 要我关掉收音机，让这里安静一点吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to turn off the radio so it's a little quieter?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“我有头痛”这个完整表达，再把头换成背等部位；情感用法则联想“心里也会痛”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pain or aching in the stomach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃部出现的疼痛或隐痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' tbatija jew skumdità fl-istonku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胃痛；胃部疼痛

formal.mt: Il-pazjenta qalet lit-tabib li kellha uġigħ fl-istonku wara l-ikel.
formal.en: The patient told the doctor that she had stomach pain after eating.
formal.zh: 这位女患者告诉医生，她饭后胃痛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma nixtieqx niekol issa; għandi uġigħ fl-istonku. Pawlu: Tajjeb, inżommlek l-ikel għal aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Sara: I don't feel like eating now; I have a stomach ache. Pawlu: All right, I'll save your food for later.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我现在不想吃东西，我胃痛。Pawlu：好，我把你的饭留着，晚点再吃。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nixtieqx niekol issa; għandi uġigħ fl-istonku.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nixtieqx niekol issa; għandi uġigħ fl-istonku.
messages.zh: 我现在不想吃东西，我胃痛。
messages.en: I don't feel like eating now; I have a stomach ache.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inżommlek l-ikel għal aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inżommlek l-ikel għal aktar tard.
messages.zh: 好，我把你的饭留着，晚点再吃。
messages.en: All right, I'll save your food for later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语当作“疼痛在胃里”来记，开头说疼痛，后半段指出疼痛的位置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To employ a thing, method, or resource for a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了某个目的使用物品、采用方法或运用资源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqeda b'oġġett, b'metodu jew b'riżorsa għal xi skop.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用某物。
运用；采用；把工具、方法或知识应用于某个目的。

formal.mt: Uża pinna sewda biex timla l-formola.
formal.en: Use a black pen to complete the form.
formal.zh: 请用黑色笔填写表格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nuża l-pinna tiegħek? Pawlu: Iva, uża dik blu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I use your pen? Pawlu: Yes, use the blue one.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我可以用一下你的笔吗？Pawlu：可以，用那支蓝色的吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 我可以用一下你的笔吗？
messages.en: Can I use your pen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，用那支蓝色的吧。
messages.en: Yes, use the blue one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 拿起一支笔时默念“uża l-pinna，使用这支笔”，把词义和实际使用动作连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customary practice or tradition followed by a group or community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个群体或社群长期遵循的习俗、传统做法或惯例。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drawwa jew prattika li grupp jew komunità jsegwu u jgħaddu minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 习俗；某个群体普遍遵循的惯常做法。
传统；代代相传的做法或习惯。
惯例；习俗；约定俗成的行为方式。

formal.mt: F'din il-familja, l-ikla flimkien nhar ta' Ħadd hija użanza li għadha tinżamm.
formal.en: In this family, sharing a meal on Sundays is a custom that is still observed.
formal.zh: 在这个家庭中，星期日聚餐是一项仍然保留着的习俗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex niltaqgħu kull nhar ta' Ħadd? Nannu: Hija użanza tal-familja tagħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do we meet every Sunday? Grandpa: It is a custom in our family.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们为什么每个星期日都聚在一起？爷爷：这是我们家的传统。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex niltaqgħu kull nhar ta' Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex niltaqgħu kull nhar ta' Ħadd?
messages.zh: 我们为什么每个星期日都聚在一起？
messages.en: Why do we meet every Sunday?

messages.speaker: Nannu (祖父)
messages.zh: 这是我们家的传统。
messages.en: It is a custom in our family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到一家人每周固定聚餐的画面，用 użanza 标记“大家一直这样做的习俗”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or manner of using something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用某物的行为或方式，也可指某物的使用情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-mod kif tintuża xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用；用法；某物或某个词语被使用的方式。
使用；利用某物的行为。
惯例；习俗；惯常采用的做法。
磨损；物品因使用而产生的损耗。

formal.mt: Aqra l-istruzzjonijiet għall-użu qabel tħaddem l-apparat.
formal.en: Read the instructions for use before operating the appliance.
formal.zh: 操作设备前，请阅读使用说明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-borża ġdida? Rita: Le, għandha xi sinjali ta' użu, imma għadha tajba.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this bag new? Rita: No, it has some signs of wear, but it is still in good condition.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个包是新的吗？Rita：不是，有些使用磨损的痕迹，不过还很好。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个包是新的吗？
messages.en: Is this bag new?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandha xi sinjali ta' użu, imma għadha tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandha xi sinjali ta' użu, imma għadha tajba.
messages.zh: 不是，有些使用磨损的痕迹，不过还很好。
messages.en: No, it has some signs of wear, but it is still in good condition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一个旧书包串联记忆：użu 可以是“使用”，包上的使用痕迹又帮助记住“磨损”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The right to use property belonging to someone else and enjoy its benefits while preserving its substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在保全他人财产本体的前提下，使用该财产并享有其收益的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dritt li tuża proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor u tgawdi l-benefiċċji tagħha filwaqt li żżomm is-sustanza tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用益权；在保全他人财产本体的前提下使用该财产并取得收益的权利。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jagħti lil Marija l-użufrutt fuq id-dar għal għaxar snin.
formal.en: The contract grants Marija usufruct over the house for ten years.
formal.zh: 合同授予 Marija 对该房屋为期十年的用益权。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser użufrutt? David: Dritt li tuża proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor u tgawdi l-benefiċċji tagħha mingħajr ma ssir is-sid.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does usufruct mean? David: A right to use someone else's property and enjoy its benefits without becoming the owner.
colloquial.zh: Anna：用益权是什么意思？David：就是使用他人的财产并享有其收益的权利，而所有权并不因此归你。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 用益权是什么意思？
messages.en: What does usufruct mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dritt li tuża proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor u tgawdi l-benefiċċji tagħha mingħajr ma ssir is-sid.
messages.mt_standard: Dritt li tuża proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor u tgawdi l-benefiċċji tagħha mingħajr ma ssir is-sid.
messages.zh: 就是使用他人的财产并享有其收益的权利，而所有权并不因此归你。
messages.en: A right to use someone else's property and enjoy its benefits without becoming the owner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“用”和“益”两个字：użufrutt 让人使用财产、享有收益，同时需要保全财产本体。

gloss_zh: 用益权的；与用益权有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the right to use another person's property and enjoy its benefits while preserving its substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与用益权有关的，即涉及在保全他人财产本体的前提下使用该财产并享有收益的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mad-dritt li tuża proprjetà ta' ħaddieħor u tgawdi l-benefiċċji tagħha filwaqt li żżomm is-sustanza tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用益权的；与使用他人财产并享有其收益的权利有关的。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi d-dritt użufruttwarju mogħti lil Marija fuq il-proprjetà.
formal.en: The text describes the usufructuary right granted to Marija over the property.
formal.zh: 文本说明了授予 Marija 的有关该财产的用益权。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'użufruttwarju' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser marbut mal-użufrutt; hawn qed jiddeskrivi d-dritt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'usufructuary' mean in this sentence? Mark: It means relating to usufruct; here it describes the right.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这句话里的“użufruttwarju”是什么意思？Mark：意思是与用益权有关的；这里用它来修饰那项权利。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的“użufruttwarju”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'usufructuary' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser marbut mal-użufrutt; hawn qed jiddeskrivi d-dritt.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser marbut mal-użufrutt; hawn qed jiddeskrivi d-dritt.
messages.zh: 意思是与用益权有关的；这里用它来修饰那项权利。
messages.en: It means relating to usufruct; here it describes the right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dritt użufruttwarju 整组记成“用益性质的权利”，注意这里的 użufruttwarju 是修饰名词的形容词。

gloss_zh: 漫游；被移至新地点；变为空缺

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wander from place to place over a wide area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在较大范围内从一处游走到另一处，四处漫游。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddur minn post għal ieħor fuq medda wiesgħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be moved to a new location
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被移至新的地点。
四处漫游；到广泛的地区游走。
变为空缺；空出来。

collocations.en: he roamed from one town to another
collocations.zh: 他从一座城镇漫游到另一座城镇

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġatur vaga għal ġimgħat sħaħ minn belt għal oħra, mingħajr destinazzjoni fissa.
formal.en: The traveller roamed from town to town for weeks, without a fixed destination.
formal.zh: 这位旅行者连续数周在各座城镇之间漫游，没有固定目的地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Pawlu waqt il-vaganza? Mark: Vaga fil-kampanja għal ftit jiem u ħa ħafna ritratti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Pawlu go during the holiday? Mark: He roamed through the countryside for a few days and took lots of photos.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗度假时去了哪里？马克：他在乡间漫游了几天，还拍了很多照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗度假时去了哪里？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go during the holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Vaga fil-kampanja għal ftit jiem u ħa ħafna ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Vaga fil-kampanja għal ftit jiem u ħa ħafna ritratti.
messages.zh: 他在乡间漫游了几天，还拍了很多照片。
messages.en: He roamed through the countryside for a few days and took lots of photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用地图上四处游走的路线记 vaga 的“漫游”义；另把“被移至新地点”和“变为空缺”分别配情境记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period away from work or study for rest, enjoyment, or travel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时离开工作或学习，用于休息、娱乐或旅行的一段时间；假期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' mistrieħ mix-xogħol jew mill-istudju, għat-tgawdija jew għall-ivvjaġġar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假期；休假的日子。
休假；度假期间。
假期；暂停工作或学习的休息时间；休假。
空缺；尚无人占据的位置或职位。

formal.mt: Il-familja ppjanat vaganza ta' ġimgħa f'Għawdex biex tistrieħ wara perjodu impenjattiv.
formal.en: The family planned a week-long holiday in Gozo to rest after a busy period.
formal.zh: 这家人计划去戈佐岛度假一周，在忙碌了一段时间后休息一下。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tmur vaganza dan is-sajf? Pawlu: Iva, se nqatta' ġimgħa Għawdex mal-familja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you going on holiday this summer? Pawlu: Yes, I'm going to spend a week in Gozo with my family.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今年夏天会去度假吗？保罗：会，我要和家人去戈佐岛待一周。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今年夏天会去度假吗？
messages.en: Are you going on holiday this summer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nqatta' ġimgħa Għawdex mal-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nqatta' ġimgħa Għawdex mal-familja.
messages.zh: 会，我要和家人去戈佐岛待一周。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to spend a week in Gozo with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上圈出一周，写上 vaganza，联想放下工作去度假；遇到职位语境时，再辨认它的“空缺”义。

gloss_zh: 有效的；成立的；有根据的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Accepted as effective or usable, or supported by sound reasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认可为有效或可使用的；也指理由充分、能够成立的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa aċċettat bħala effettiv jew jista' jintuża, jew li għandu bażi soda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有效的；成立的；有根据的。
有效的；可使用的；理由充分的。

collocations.zh: 成立的论点；有根据的论证

formal.mt: Kull passiġġier għandu jippreżenta biljett validu qabel jitla' fuq il-ferrovija.
formal.en: Every passenger must present a valid ticket before boarding the train.
formal.zh: 每位乘客上火车前都必须出示有效车票。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-biljett għadu validu llum? Rita: Iva, tista' tużah sa nofsillejl.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this ticket still valid today? Rita: Yes, you can use it until midnight.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张票今天还有效吗？丽塔：有效，你可以用到午夜。

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.zh: 这张票今天还有效吗？
messages.en: Is this ticket still valid today?

messages.speaker: Rita (售票员)
messages.zh: 有效，你可以用到午夜。
messages.en: Yes, you can use it until midnight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 validu 配上“检票通过”的画面记“有效”；再配上“理由说得通”的画面记“成立、有根据”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A case used to carry clothes and other belongings when travelling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旅行时用来装衣物和其他随身物品的箱子；旅行箱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa b'manku li tintuża biex iġġorr il-ħwejjeġ u oġġetti oħra waqt vjaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旅行携带的行李。
旅行箱；装旅行衣物和用品的箱子。
手提旅行箱。

formal.mt: Il-passiġġiera poġġiet il-valiġġa fuq il-miżien qabel ma tat il-passaport lill-impjegat.
formal.en: The passenger placed her suitcase on the scales before handing her passport to the employee.
formal.zh: 这位女乘客先把旅行箱放到秤上，然后把护照递给工作人员。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi l-valiġġa tiegħi? David: Ħdejn il-bieb; diġà poġġejt il-ħwejjeġ fiha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is my suitcase? David: By the door; I've already put the clothes in it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我的旅行箱在哪里？戴维：在门旁边；我已经把衣服放进去了。

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.zh: 我的旅行箱在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my suitcase?

messages.speaker: David (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb; diġà poġġejt il-ħwejjeġ fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb; diġà poġġejt il-ħwejjeġ fiha.
messages.zh: 在门旁边；我已经把衣服放进去了。
messages.en: By the door; I've already put the clothes in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前把衣服装进带轮子的箱子，给箱子贴上 valiġġa；用“装箱、提箱、拉箱”的动作加深记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The worth, importance, or numerical amount of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物的价值、重要性，或用数字表示的量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kemm tiswa xi ħaġa, l-importanza tagħha, jew il-kwantità tagħha espressa b'numru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价值；重要性；数值。
英勇；勇武，尤指面对危险时表现出的勇气。

formal.mt: L-arloġġ għandu valur monetarju baxx, iżda għall-familja għandu valur sentimentali kbir.
formal.en: The watch has little monetary value, but it has great sentimental value for the family.
formal.zh: 这块手表的货币价值不高，但对这个家庭来说具有很大的纪念意义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadek iżżomm dan l-arloġġ qadim? Luqa: Kien tan-nannu, u għalija għandu valur kbir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you still keep this old watch? Luqa: It belonged to my grandfather, and it means a lot to me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么还留着这块旧手表？卢卡：它是我爷爷的，对我来说很有价值。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadek iżżomm dan l-arloġġ qadim?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadek iżżomm dan l-arloġġ qadim?
messages.zh: 你为什么还留着这块旧手表？
messages.en: Why do you still keep this old watch?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien tan-nannu, u għalija għandu valur kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Kien tan-nannu, u għalija għandu valur kbir.
messages.zh: 它是我爷爷的，对我来说很有价值。
messages.en: It belonged to my grandfather, and it means a lot to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用旧手表的“价格”和“纪念意义”记 valur 的价值义；再单独用勇敢面对危险的画面记它的英勇义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bright, strong flame or blaze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 明亮而猛烈的火焰；烈焰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjamma qawwija u tiddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烈焰；猛烈燃烧的火。
火焰。

formal.mt: Meta l-injam niexef ħa n-nar, vampa qawwija telgħet mill-fuklar.
formal.en: When the dry wood caught fire, a strong flame rose from the fireplace.
formal.zh: 干木柴燃烧起来时，一股猛烈的火焰从壁炉中蹿起。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt dik il-vampa fil-fuklar? Toni: Iva, l-injam niexef ħa n-nar malajr.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see that flame in the fireplace? Toni: Yes, the dry wood caught fire quickly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到壁炉里那股火焰了吗？托尼：看到了，干木柴一下就烧起来了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到壁炉里那股火焰了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that flame in the fireplace?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-injam niexef ħa n-nar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-injam niexef ħa n-nar malajr.
messages.zh: 看到了，干木柴一下就烧起来了。
messages.en: Yes, the dry wood caught fire quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象干木柴点燃后猛地蹿起一团亮火，把这一瞬间标成 vampa，连同“猛烈的火焰”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive pride in one's appearance, abilities, or achievements, often with a desire for admiration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过分看重自己的外貌、能力或成就，并常希望得到别人赞赏的心理；虚荣、自负。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kburija żejda bid-dehra, bil-ħiliet jew bil-kisbiet tiegħek, spiss bix-xewqa li ħaddieħor jammirak.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚荣；对自己的外貌或成就过分自得，并渴望赞赏。
自负；对自己的能力或重要性评价过高。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-vanità tal-karattru tidher fix-xewqa kontinwa tiegħu li jirċievi tifħir mingħand kulħadd.
formal.en: In the novel, the character's vanity is shown by his constant desire to receive praise from everyone.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，这个人物不断渴望得到所有人的赞扬，表现出他的虚荣心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark jibqa' jitkellem biss dwar is-suċċessi tiegħu? Nina: Naħseb li hi vanità; irid lil kulħadd ifaħħru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does Mark keep talking only about his own successes? Nina: I think it's vanity; he wants everyone to praise him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么总是只谈自己的成就？妮娜：我觉得是虚荣心作祟；他想让所有人都夸他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark jibqa' jitkellem biss dwar is-suċċessi tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark jibqa' jitkellem biss dwar is-suċċessi tiegħu?
messages.zh: 马克为什么总是只谈自己的成就？
messages.en: Why does Mark keep talking only about his own successes?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li hi vanità; irid lil kulħadd ifaħħru.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li hi vanità; irid lil kulħadd ifaħħru.
messages.zh: 我觉得是虚荣心作祟；他想让所有人都夸他。
messages.en: I think it's vanity; he wants everyone to praise him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人反复展示自己的成就，只等别人夸奖，用这个场景记 vanità 的“虚荣、自负”，留意词尾的 à。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition or quality that helps someone succeed or puts them in a better position than others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有助于取得成功，或使某人比其他人处于更有利地位的条件或特点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni jew kwalità li tgħin lil xi ħadd jirnexxi jew tkun ta' ġid għalih meta mqabbel ma' oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 优势；有利条件；使人处于较有利地位的因素。

collocations.en: to have an advantage over someone else

formal.mt: L-għarfien ta' diversi lingwi jagħti vantaġġ lill-kandidati li japplikaw għal dan l-impjieg.
formal.en: Knowledge of several languages gives an advantage to candidates applying for this job.
formal.zh: 掌握多种语言能使申请这份工作的候选人更具优势。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Diġà ħdimt f'ħanut. Dan jgħinni fl-intervista? Mark: Iva, dik l-esperjenza tagħtik vantaġġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: I've worked in a shop before. Will that help me in the interview? Mark: Yes, that experience gives you an advantage.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我以前在商店工作过。这对面试有帮助吗？马克：有，这段经验能让你更有优势。

messages.speaker: Lara (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà ħdimt f'ħanut. Dan jgħinni fl-intervista?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà ħdimt f'ħanut. Dan jgħinni fl-intervista?
messages.zh: 我以前在商店工作过。这对面试有帮助吗？
messages.en: I've worked in a shop before. Will that help me in the interview?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，这段经验能让你更有优势。
messages.en: Yes, that experience gives you an advantage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面试时你多掌握一门语言，这张额外的能力牌就是 vantaġġ，表示优势。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large boat or ship, especially one powered by an engine, used to carry people or goods across water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在水上运送人员或货物的大型船只，尤其指由发动机驱动的轮船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment kbir, speċjalment wieħed li jaħdem b'mutur, li jġorr nies jew merkanzija fuq l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮船；大型船只。
船舶；此处指水上航行的船只。

sense_translations.en_definition: a ship driven by a motor (of any kind)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由某种发动机或马达驱动的船。

formal.mt: Il-vapur tal-merkanzija daħal fil-port kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: The cargo ship entered the harbour early in the morning.
formal.zh: 货轮在清晨驶入了港口。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak il-vapur jieħu l-passiġġieri? Pawlu: Iva, imma rridu nixtru l-biljetti qabel nitilgħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does that ship carry passengers? Pawlu: Yes, but we need to buy tickets before we board.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那艘船载客吗？保罗：载客，不过我们得先买票再上船。

messages.speaker: Nina (旅客)
messages.zh: 那艘船载客吗？
messages.en: Does that ship carry passengers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rridu nixtru l-biljetti qabel nitilgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rridu nixtru l-biljetti qabel nitilgħu.
messages.zh: 载客，不过我们得先买票再上船。
messages.en: Yes, but we need to buy tickets before we board.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vapur 放进港口画面：一边是载人的客轮，一边是装货的货轮，两种都是船舶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change or different form of something; in music, an altered treatment of a theme or an improvised passage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物的变化或不同形式；在音乐中，也可指主题的变奏或即兴发挥的乐段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla jew forma differenti ta' xi ħaġa; fil-mużika, tibdil fuq tema jew silta maħluqa dak il-ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变化；变动；与原有形式有所不同的版本。
音乐变奏；在保留主题联系的同时，改变旋律、节奏或其他音乐要素的形式。
即兴发挥；未经事先完整安排而当场进行的演奏或创作。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-biċċa, il-pjanista daqq varjazzjoni fuq it-tema prinċipali.
formal.en: At the end of the piece, the pianist played a variation on the main theme.
formal.zh: 在乐曲结尾，钢琴家演奏了一段主旋律的变奏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din l-istess melodija bħal qabel? Toni: Kważi, imma din varjazzjoni b'ritmu differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this the same melody as before? Toni: Almost, but this is a variation with a different rhythm.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这和刚才是同一段旋律吗？托尼：差不多，不过这是一段节奏不同的变奏。

messages.speaker: Sara (音乐学生)
messages.zh: 这和刚才是同一段旋律吗？
messages.en: Is this the same melody as before?

messages.speaker: Toni (音乐老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi, imma din varjazzjoni b'ritmu differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi, imma din varjazzjoni b'ritmu differenti.
messages.zh: 差不多，不过这是一段节奏不同的变奏。
messages.en: Almost, but this is a variation with a different rhythm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把熟悉的旋律换一种节奏再唱，记作 varjazzjoni；从旋律的变化联想到一般变化和即兴发挥。

gloss_zh: 多样性；种类；电视综艺节目

teaching_sense.en_definition: A range of different things or a particular kind; also a television entertainment show with varied acts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不同事物构成的多样性，或其中的某一种类；也可指包含多种表演的电视综艺节目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għażla ta' affarijiet differenti jew tip partikolari; ukoll programm televiżiv ta' divertiment b'numri differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多样性；多种多样的选择；也可指某一种类或品种。
电视节目；在此可指包含歌唱、舞蹈等多种表演的综艺节目。

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' varjetà jinkludi kant, żfin u wirjiet qosra ta' kummiedja.
formal.en: The variety show includes singing, dancing and short comedy performances.
formal.zh: 这档综艺节目包含歌唱、舞蹈和简短的喜剧表演。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'nixtru għad-deżerta? Leo: Ejja nieħdu varjetà ta' frott, biex kulħadd isib xi ħaġa li jħobb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we buy for dessert? Leo: Let's get a variety of fruit so everyone can find something they like.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们买什么当甜点？利奥：买几种水果吧，这样每个人都能找到自己喜欢的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们买什么当甜点？
messages.en: What shall we buy for dessert?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu varjetà ta' frott, biex kulħadd isib xi ħaġa li jħobb.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu varjetà ta' frott, biex kulħadd isib xi ħaġa li jħobb.
messages.zh: 买几种水果吧，这样每个人都能找到自己喜欢的。
messages.en: Let's get a variety of fruit so everyone can find something they like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一盘多种水果，再想象一台多种表演的综艺节目，用“种类丰富”串起 varjetà 的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Warsaw, a city in Poland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 华沙，波兰的一座城市；马耳他语地名写作 Varsavja。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Belt fil-Polonja li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ Warsaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 华沙，城市专名。
华沙，位于波兰的一座城市的名称。

formal.mt: Il-grupp se jżur Varsavja bħala parti minn vjaġġ edukattiv fil-Polonja.
formal.en: The group will visit Warsaw as part of an educational trip to Poland.
formal.zh: 该团体将在波兰的教育旅行中参观华沙。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? David: Se mmur Varsavja ma' żewġ ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are you going on holiday? David: I'm going to Warsaw with two friends.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你打算去哪里度假？戴维：我要和两个朋友去华沙。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: David (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur Varsavja ma' żewġ ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur Varsavja ma' żewġ ħbieb.
messages.zh: 我要和两个朋友去华沙。
messages.en: I'm going to Warsaw with two friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在旅行卡片上并排写下 Varsavja、Warsaw、华沙，配一张波兰地图；作为地名，首字母写大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A preparation given to stimulate the body's immune protection against a particular disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于激发人体针对某种疾病产生免疫保护的制剂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preparat li jingħata biex jistimula l-protezzjoni immunitarja tal-ġisem kontra marda partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疫苗；用于激发人体对特定疾病产生免疫保护的制剂。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-vaċċin u kif jingħata.
formal.en: The leaflet provides information about the vaccine and how it is administered.
formal.zh: 宣传册提供有关该疫苗及其接种方式的信息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi appuntament għall-vaċċin għada. Pawlu: F'liema ħin? Nina: Fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: I have an appointment for the vaccine tomorrow. Pawlu: At what time? Nina: At nine in the morning.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我预约了明天接种疫苗。Pawlu：几点？Nina：上午九点。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我预约了明天接种疫苗。
messages.en: I have an appointment for the vaccine tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 几点？
messages.en: At what time?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 上午九点。
messages.en: At nine in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 vaċċin 与“疫苗预约”和“一剂疫苗”两个场景联系起来，看到这个词就想到免疫保护。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The muscular canal of the reproductive system that extends from the cervix to the external opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生殖系统中从子宫颈延伸至体外开口的肌性管道，即阴道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kanal muskolari tal-apparat riproduttiv li jestendi mill-għonq tal-utru sal-ftuħ estern.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴道。
