teaching_sense.en_definition: To give up or transfer property, rights, or control to someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把财产、权利或控制权让给别人，或放弃自己原有的占有和掌握。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi proprjetà, drittijiet jew kontroll lil ħaddieħor, jew iċedi dak li kellu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让出；把所有权、权利或控制权交给别人。
转让财产；把财产转到他人名下。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lease (used of a shop or business, when leased)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 出租店铺或生意，把它交给他人租用经营。

sense_translations.en_definition: to renounce, to give up, to surrender, to cede
sense_translations.zh_definition: 放弃；交出；让渡；让出。
死亡；去世。

collocations.en: transfer the property to his son
hand over the shop to his daughter

formal.mt: Is-sid wella l-proprjetà lil ibnu, u t-trasferiment ġie rreġistrat bil-miktub.
formal.en: The owner transferred the property to his son, and the transfer was recorded in writing.
formal.zh: 业主把财产转让给了儿子，并以书面形式记录了这次转让。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Missierek għadu jmexxi l-ħanut? Mark: Le, wella l-ħanut lil oħti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your father still run the shop? Mark: No, he handed the shop over to my sister.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你爸爸还在经营那家店吗？Mark：没有，他把店铺转交给我姐姐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸还在经营那家店吗？
messages.en: Does your father still run the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主的儿子)
messages.zh: 没有，他把店铺转交给我姐姐了。
messages.en: No, he handed the shop over to my sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把店铺钥匙交到别人手中”的画面记住让出和转交；出租要结合租赁语境辨认，“去世”则单独记为另一义项，不从钥匙画面推导。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give birth or assist in delivering a baby; figuratively, to produce an idea or bring something into existence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生育孩子或帮助接生；也可比喻产生想法、创造事物或促使事物出现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib tarbija fid-dinja jew jgħin fit-twelid; f'sens figurattiv, joħloq idea jew iġib xi ħaġa ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生孩子；分娩。
产生一个想法；想出主意。
在分娩过程中协助；帮助接生。

sense_translations.en_definition: to create, bring forth, cause to exist
sense_translations.zh_definition: 创造、产生或使某事物出现。
生育；生下孩子。
接生或分娩，具体含义取决于主语和语境。

formal.mt: Id-djalogu bejn ir-riċerkaturi welled idea ġdida għal proġett konġunt.
formal.en: The dialogue between the researchers generated a new idea for a joint project.
formal.zh: 研究人员之间的交流产生了一个开展联合项目的新想法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min welled din l-idea? Pawlu: Ħija, waqt li konna nitkellmu fuq il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who came up with this idea? Pawlu: My brother, while we were talking about the trip.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个主意是谁想出来的？保罗：我哥哥，我们聊旅行的时候他想出来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个主意是谁想出来的？
messages.en: Who came up with this idea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija, waqt li konna nitkellmu fuq il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija, waqt li konna nitkellmu fuq il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 我哥哥，我们聊旅行的时候他想出来的。
messages.en: My brother, while we were talking about the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让新东西来到世界”串联记忆：可以是孩子出生，也可以是新主意产生；具体译法看主语和宾语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who cedes something, such as rights, or leases property to another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物或某项权利让与他人的人；也可指出租财产的一方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ċċedi xi ħaġa jew xi dritt, jew li tagħti proprjetà b'kera lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某物或权利让与他人的人。
将财产出租给他人的人；出租人。
让与人，即把某物让给他人的一方。

formal.mt: Il-wellej iffirma d-dokument biex iċedi d-drittijiet tiegħu lill-għaqda.
formal.en: The person ceding the rights signed the document to transfer his rights to the association.
formal.zh: 让与人签署了文件，将自己的权利转让给该协会。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-wellej tal-garaxx? Mark: Is-Sur Borg; hu li se jikrih lilna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the lessor of the garage? Mark: Mr Borg; he is the one who will rent it to us.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个车库的出租人是谁？马克：博格先生，就是他要把车库租给我们。

messages.speaker: Sara (租客)
messages.zh: 这个车库的出租人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the lessor of the garage?

messages.speaker: Mark (合租伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-Sur Borg; hu li se jikrih lilna.
messages.mt_standard: Is-Sur Borg; hu li se jikrih lilna.
messages.zh: 博格先生，就是他要把车库租给我们。
messages.en: Mr Borg; he is the one who will rent it to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进签约场景记忆：交出权利的是让与人，把房产租给别人的是出租人，都指作出让出行为的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Faith or belief in God, a person, or something regarded as true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对神、某个人或某种被认为真实的事物所持的信仰或信念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fidi jew twemmin f'Alla, f'persuna jew f'xi ħaġa meqjusa bħala vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信仰；对所信对象的坚定信赖。
信仰或信念；相信某事为真的观念。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi l-wemen f'Alla bħala għajn ta' tama.
formal.en: In his letter, the author describes faith in God as a source of hope.
formal.zh: 作者在信中将对上帝的信仰描述为希望的源泉。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jagħtik tama meta tkun imdejjaq? Ġużeppi: Il-wemen tiegħi f'Alla u l-għajnuna tal-familja.
colloquial.en: Marija: What gives you hope when you feel down? Ġużeppi: My faith in God and my family's support.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你难过的时候，是什么给你希望？朱塞佩：我对上帝的信仰，还有家人的支持。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你难过的时候，是什么给你希望？
messages.en: What gives you hope when you feel down?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-wemen tiegħi f'Alla u l-għajnuna tal-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Il-wemen tiegħi f'Alla u l-għajnuna tal-familja.
messages.zh: 我对上帝的信仰，还有家人的支持。
messages.en: My faith in God and my family's support.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wemen 记成心中持有的“信念”这个名词；再与多一个 m 的 wemmen 对照，后者表示使别人相信的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to believe something or convince someone that it is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人相信某事，或说服某人接受某事为真。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jemmen xi ħaġa jew jikkonvinċih li hija vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人相信某事。
说服；使某人信服。
使某个人相信。

collocations.mt: wemmen lil ħabibu li kien veru
collocations.en: convinced his friend that it was true

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dettaljat wemmen lill-kumitat li l-proġett seta' jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: The detailed report convinced the committee that the project could be completed on time.
formal.zh: 这份详细报告使委员会相信，该项目可以按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'wemmen lil Mark li l-istorja kienet vera? Nina: Ir-ritratt; fih għaraf lil ħuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: What convinced Mark that the story was true? Nina: The photograph; he recognized his brother in it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：是什么让马克相信那个故事是真的？妮娜：那张照片，他在里面认出了自己的哥哥。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'wemmen lil Mark li l-istorja kienet vera?
messages.mt_standard: X'wemmen lil Mark li l-istorja kienet vera?
messages.zh: 是什么让马克相信那个故事是真的？
messages.en: What convinced Mark that the story was true?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那张照片，他在里面认出了自己的哥哥。
messages.en: The photograph; he recognized his brother in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时给 wemmen 配一幅“拿出证据，让对方点头相信”的画面；双写 m 作为拼写提示，与名词 wemen 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of peace and ease, or pleasant company that brings comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内心安宁、放松的感受，也可指使人舒心、得到慰藉的陪伴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' serħan u kwiet, jew kumpanija sabiħa li tagħti faraġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安心；内心的安宁。
安适；让人放松和休息的状态。
投契、舒心的陪伴；令人愉快的相处。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru joffri spazju fejn l-anzjani jsibu wens u kumpanija.
formal.en: The centre offers a space where older people can find comfort and company.
formal.zh: 该中心提供一个让老年人获得慰藉和陪伴的空间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tridni noqgħod ftit miegħek? Anna: Iva, il-preżenza tiegħek tagħtini wens.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like me to stay with you for a while? Anna: Yes, having you here comforts me.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你想让我留下来陪你一会儿吗？安娜：想，你在这里让我很安心。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想让我留下来陪你一会儿吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to stay with you for a while?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，你在这里让我很安心。
messages.en: Yes, having you here comforts me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象熟悉的人安静坐在身边，心里渐渐踏实：wens 可以指这份安宁，也可以指带来安宁的舒心陪伴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something visible, display or expose it, or explain it so that someone understands.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物展示给人看，使其显露出来；也可通过展示或讲解使人明白。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa tidher, jesponiha jew jippreżentaha; ukoll jispjegaha biex xi ħadd jifhimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给人看；展示。
使显露；暴露或揭露。
展示；陈列。
解释；说明，使人理解。

formal.mt: L-għalliem wera lill-istudenti kif isolvu l-problema pass pass.
formal.en: The teacher showed the students how to solve the problem step by step.
formal.zh: 老师向学生逐步讲解了如何解决这道题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu wera lilek ukoll ir-ritratti tal-vjaġġ? Sara: Iva, rajthom ilbieraħ. Dak tal-baħar għoġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu show you the trip photos too? Sara: Yes, I saw them yesterday. I really liked the one of the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗也给你看旅行照片了吗？萨拉：看了，我昨天看的。我特别喜欢拍海的那张。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu wera lilek ukoll ir-ritratti tal-vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu wera lilek ukoll ir-ritratti tal-vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 保罗也给你看旅行照片了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu show you the trip photos too?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajthom ilbieraħ. Dak tal-baħar għoġobni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajthom ilbieraħ. Dak tal-baħar għoġobni ħafna.
messages.zh: 看了，我昨天看的。我特别喜欢拍海的那张。
messages.en: Yes, I saw them yesterday. I really liked the one of the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让人看见，也让人看懂”记忆 wera：拿出照片是展示，逐步演示解题则是说明。

gloss_zh: 索引；目录；食指；指示物；示范者

teaching_sense.en_definition: An index or table of contents that helps readers find material; also an index finger, a pointer, or a person who demonstrates something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助读者查找内容的索引或目录；也可指食指、指示物或进行示范的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lista li tgħin lill-qarrej isib il-kontenut; ukoll is-saba' ħdejn il-kbir, għodda li tipponta, jew persuna li turi kif issir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 索引，按词目等排列并指明相关内容位置的查找表。
目录，按顺序列出书籍或文件各部分及其位置的列表。
食指，紧邻拇指、常用来指点的手指。
指示物，用来指向某处或某项内容的工具或标记。
示范者，展示某物或演示操作方法的人。

collocations.zh: 按字母顺序排列的索引

formal.mt: Il-werrej fil-bidu tal-ktieb jagħti t-titli tal-kapitli u n-numri tal-paġni.
formal.en: The table of contents at the beginning of the book gives the chapter titles and page numbers.
formal.zh: 书前的目录列出了各章标题和页码。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-kapitlu dwar il-baħar? Mark: Ħares lejn il-werrej fil-bidu tal-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the chapter about the sea? Mark: Look at the table of contents at the beginning of the book.
colloquial.zh: Maja：关于海洋的那一章在哪里？Mark：看看书前的目录。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 关于海洋的那一章在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the chapter about the sea?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 看看书前的目录。
messages.en: Look at the table of contents at the beginning of the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把目录、索引和食指都想成“帮你指出位置”的东西，再联想到指示物与示范者；这是串联词义的学习画面。

gloss_zh: 遗赠；把财产留给继承人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave property or possessions to someone as an inheritance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将财产或物品作为遗产留给某人，使其继承。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla proprjetà jew oġġetti lil xi ħadd bħala wirt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗赠，把财产作为遗产留给他人。
留下遗产，供他人继承。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bequeath; to devise; to leave (to an heir)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗赠；以遗嘱遗赠财产；将财产留给继承人。

collocations.en: he bequeathed the house to his daughter
collocations.zh: 他把房子遗赠给了女儿

collocations.en: he left his wealth to his children

formal.mt: Fit-testment tiegħu, is-Sur Borg werret id-dar lil bintu u l-kotba lil ibnu.
formal.en: In his will, Mr Borg bequeathed the house to his daughter and the books to his son.
formal.zh: 博格先生在遗嘱中把房子遗赠给女儿，把书留给儿子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħallielek din id-dar? Mark: In-nannu werret id-dar lili.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who left you this house? Mark: My grandfather bequeathed the house to me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这房子是谁留给你的？Mark：祖父把房子遗赠给了我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这房子是谁留给你的？
messages.en: Who left you this house?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 祖父把房子遗赠给了我。
messages.en: My grandfather bequeathed the house to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象遗嘱上画着一支从长辈指向晚辈的箭头：werret 记的是长辈“把遗产留给别人”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to squint or become cross-eyed; also, to shock or disturb someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人出现斜视或变得斜眼；也可指使人震惊或心神不安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iwerreċ għajnejh jew isir werċ; ukoll jaħsad jew iħawwad lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人斜视；使眼睛呈斜视状态。
使震惊、受惊或心神不安。
使人变得斜眼；使其出现斜视。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont tax-xhud werreċ lil dawk li kienu qed jisimgħu.
formal.en: The witness's account shocked those who were listening.
formal.zh: 证人的叙述使在场听众感到震惊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-rakkont werreċ lil kulħadd. Pawlu: Veru, għadni mħawwad b'dak li smajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: That account shocked everyone. Pawlu: True, I am still shaken by what I heard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那段叙述把大家都震住了。保罗：确实，我听完到现在心里还不平静。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那段叙述把大家都震住了。
messages.en: That account shocked everyone.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, għadni mħawwad b'dak li smajt.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, għadni mħawwad b'dak li smajt.
messages.zh: 确实，我听完到现在心里还不平静。
messages.en: True, I am still shaken by what I heard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 werċ 的“斜视状态”和 werreċ 的“使人发生变化”并排记；再单独配一幅听到惊人消息的画面，记住“使震惊”的义项。

gloss_zh: 令人眯眼的；令人震惊的；令人不安的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to squint, or causing shock or emotional disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人眯眼的；也形容让人震惊、心神不安的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd idejjaq għajnejh, jew li jqajjem xokk jew taqlib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人眯起眼睛的。
令人震惊的，使人受到强烈心理冲击的。
令人不安的，使人心绪受到扰动的。
使人眯眼的，令眼睛不由自主地眯起来的。

formal.mt: Id-dawl werrieċi fil-kamra ġiegħel lill-qarrej idejjaq għajnejh.
formal.en: The light in the room made the reader squint.
formal.zh: 房间里的光使读者眯起了眼睛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-film? Mark: Kien werrieċi. Xi xeni ħallewni bla kliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the film? Mark: It was shocking. Some scenes left me speechless.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影怎么样？Mark：挺令人震惊的，有些场景让我说不出话来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影怎么样？
messages.en: How was the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien werrieċi. Xi xeni ħallewni bla kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Kien werrieċi. Xi xeni ħallewni bla kliem.
messages.zh: 挺令人震惊的，有些场景让我说不出话来。
messages.en: It was shocking. Some scenes left me speechless.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个反应画面记忆：光线让眼睛眯起来，震撼场景让心里一紧；分别对应身体反应和心理感受。

gloss_zh: 吓唬；使惊恐；使惊愕或心烦

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel afraid, terrified, dismayed, or upset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人害怕、惊恐、惊愕或心烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beżża' lil xi ħadd jew qanqal fih biża', skoss jew taqlib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吓唬；使人害怕。
使人惊愕、沮丧或因意外而不安。
使人心烦、难过或心绪不宁。
使人害怕；使人极度惊恐。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi tal-isplużjoni werwer lir-residenti tal-inħawi.
formal.en: The loud noise of the explosion terrified the residents of the area.
formal.zh: 爆炸的巨响使附近居民惊恐不已。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jibki t-tifel? Mark: Ħuh werwer lit-tifel b'maskra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the boy crying? Mark: His brother scared him with a mask.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那男孩为什么在哭？Mark：他哥哥戴着面具吓到了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 那男孩为什么在哭？
messages.en: Why is the boy crying?

messages.speaker: Mark (男孩的父亲)
messages.zh: 他哥哥戴着面具吓到了他。
messages.en: His brother scared him with a mask.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 werwer 的重复外形，就想象突然被吓后心跳连跳两下；用这个学习画面记住“使人惊恐”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having eyes that do not look in the same direction; cross-eyed or squinting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容双眼视线方向不一致、呈斜视状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-għajnejn ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斜视的；眼睛呈斜视状态的。
双眼视线不一致的；对眼的。
有斜视的人。
斜视者；眼睛呈斜视状态的人。
斜眼的；双眼不能朝同一方向注视的。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-karattru, l-awtur jgħid li r-raġel kien werċ.
formal.en: In the character description, the author says that the man had a squint.
formal.zh: 在人物描写中，作者说这名男子有斜视。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma werċ hawn? Toni: Tfisser li l-karattru għandu l-għajnejn ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word werċ mean here? Toni: It means that the character's eyes do not look in the same direction.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 werċ 是什么意思？托尼：意思是这个人物有斜视，两只眼睛看的方向不一致。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 werċ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word werċ mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-karattru għandu l-għajnejn ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-karattru għandu l-għajnejn ma jħarsux fl-istess direzzjoni.
messages.zh: 意思是这个人物有斜视，两只眼睛看的方向不一致。
messages.en: It means that the character's eyes do not look in the same direction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两条方向不一致的视线来记 werċ；修饰人物时是形容词“斜视的”，直接指人时则是名词“斜视者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cricket or cicada; also a person who screams.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指蟋蟀或蝉，也可用来称呼尖叫的人；具体意思由语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett bħal grillu jew ċikada; ukoll persuna li tgħajjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蟋蟀，一种会鸣叫的昆虫。
尖叫的人，发出尖厉叫声的人。
蝉，一种会发出响亮鸣声的昆虫。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, l-istudenti semgħu l-għanja ta' werżieq fil-ħaxix.
formal.en: During the night, the students heard a cricket singing in the grass.
formal.zh: 夜里，学生们听见一只蟋蟀在草丛中鸣叫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-ħaxix? Mark: Hemm werżieq hemmhekk. Isma' ftit!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that sound in the grass? Mark: There's a cricket there. Listen for a moment!
colloquial.zh: Maja：草丛里是什么声音？Mark：那里有只蟋蟀。听一会儿！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 草丛里是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound in the grass?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那里有只蟋蟀。听一会儿！
messages.en: There's a cricket there. Listen for a moment!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听到响亮叫声”串联蟋蟀、蝉和尖叫的人，但记住它们是不同义项，不能仅凭声音判断是哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cicada, an insect known for its loud calling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蝉，俗称知了，以响亮的鸣声为人熟知的昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċikada, insett magħruf għall-ħoss qawwi li jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蝉，俗称知了。
蝉，一种以响亮鸣声为人熟知的昆虫。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw werżieq ta' binhar fuq iz-zokk ta' siġra.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a cicada on a tree trunk.
formal.zh: 在花园里进行观察时，学生们在树干上看到了一只蝉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak l-insett fuq is-siġra? Mark: Dak werżieq ta' binhar. Tisma' l-ħoss tiegħu?
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that insect on the tree? Mark: That's a cicada. Can you hear its sound?
colloquial.zh: Maja：树上那是什么昆虫？Mark：那是蝉。你听见它的叫声了吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 树上那是什么昆虫？
messages.en: What's that insect on the tree?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak werżieq ta' binhar. Tisma' l-ħoss tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Dak werżieq ta' binhar. Tisma' l-ħoss tiegħu?
messages.zh: 那是蝉。你听见它的叫声了吗？
messages.en: That's a cicada. Can you hear its sound?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“白天树上传来知了声”的画面绑定记忆，整组记作“蝉”，避免只记前一个词而混淆义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open area of land or space, including a square among buildings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一片空旷或开阔的地方，也可指建筑物之间的广场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post miftuħ jew spazju vojt, inkluża pjazza bejn il-bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一片空地或开阔地。

sense_translations.en_definition: square (open space in a built-up area)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 广场，建筑密集区域中的一片开阔场地。
泛指空旷空间或开阔场地。

collocations.en: an open space in front of the church
an open space between the buildings
collocations.zh: 建筑物之间的开阔场地

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi wesgħa bejn il-bini fejn ir-residenti jistgħu jiltaqgħu.
formal.en: The plan includes an open space between the buildings where residents can meet.
formal.zh: 规划在建筑物之间设置了一片开阔场地，供居民相聚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: Fil-wesgħa quddiem il-knisja, ħdejn il-bank.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Mark: In the open space in front of the church, beside the bench.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在哪里碰面？Mark：在教堂前的空地上，长椅旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在教堂前的空地上，长椅旁边。
messages.en: In the open space in front of the church, beside the bench.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走出狭窄街道，眼前突然展开一片能让人聚集的空地；用“眼前开阔的一块地方”记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strengthening or renewal of vigour, or a confirmation that reinforces something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使力量或信心增强的加强、振奋；也指对某事的确认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tisħiħ li jagħti saħħa ġdida, jew konferma li ssaħħaħ dak li jkun intqal jew miftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加强，增添力量或使某事更加稳固。
一次振奋或力量的恢复；确认，对某事的肯定。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies l-ittra bħala wetqa tal-ftehim bejn iż-żewġ naħat.
formal.en: The committee regarded the letter as confirmation of the agreement between the two sides.
formal.zh: 委员会将这封信视为对双方协议的确认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għenek il-kliem tal-għalliem? Mark: Iva, tani wetqa ġdida. Issa għandi aktar fiduċja fija nnifsi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the teacher's words help you? Mark: Yes, they gave me renewed strength. Now I have more confidence in myself.
colloquial.zh: Maja：老师的话对你有帮助吗？Mark：有，让我重新有了力量。现在我对自己更有信心了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 老师的话对你有帮助吗？
messages.en: Did the teacher's words help you?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tani wetqa ġdida. Issa għandi aktar fiduċja fija nnifsi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tani wetqa ġdida. Issa għandi aktar fiduċja fija nnifsi.
messages.zh: 有，让我重新有了力量。现在我对自己更有信心了。
messages.en: Yes, they gave me renewed strength. Now I have more confidence in myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“心里更有底”串联词义：受到鼓励后力量增强，得到确认后事情更稳；这是帮助区分语境的记忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry out an action or plan, complete a task, or confirm something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 执行行动或计划，完成任务；也可表示确认某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel dak li jkun ippjanat, itemm xogħol jew jikkonferma xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完成；达成某项目标。
完成；把事情做完。
确认；证实。

sense_translations.en_definition: to do, perform, accomplish, realise, put into practice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 做；执行；完成；实现；付诸实践。

formal.mt: It-tim wettaq il-proġett skont il-pjan u temm ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team carried out the project according to the plan and finished the work on time.
formal.zh: 团队按计划实施了项目，并按时完成了工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark wettaq dak li wiegħed? Lara: Iva, sewwa r-rota kif qal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark do what he promised? Lara: Yes, he fixed the bicycle as he said he would.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克兑现承诺了吗？拉拉：兑现了，他按说好的把自行车修好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克兑现承诺了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark do what he promised?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 兑现了，他按说好的把自行车修好了。
messages.en: Yes, he fixed the bicycle as he said he would.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wettaq 联想成在任务清单上打勾：计划落实、任务完成、承诺兑现。这个画面用于记义，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 鸟鸣；叽喳说话；喋喋不休

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or chirp, of certain birds; also to chatter or talk excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些鸟鸣叫；也指人叽叽喳喳地说话或喋喋不休。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħanni, meta jingħad għal ċerti għasafar; ukoll jitkellem ħafna jew iżżejjed.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱；用于某些种类的鸟。
叽叽喳喳地说话；絮叨。
鸣叫；鸣唱，指鸟。
多嘴乱说；喋喋不休。

formal.mt: L-għasfur wetwet fuq fergħa ħdejn it-tieqa tal-klassi.
formal.en: The bird sang on a branch beside the classroom window.
formal.zh: 鸟儿在教室窗旁的树枝上鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu wetwet il-ħin kollu fuq il-karozza tal-linja! Mark: Veru, tkellem minn meta rkibna sa meta nżilna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Paul chattered the whole time on the bus! Mark: True, he talked from the moment we got on until we got off.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在公交车上一路说个不停！马克：确实，从我们上车一直说到下车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu wetwet il-ħin kollu fuq il-karozza tal-linja!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu wetwet il-ħin kollu fuq il-karozza tal-linja!
messages.zh: 保罗在公交车上一路说个不停！
messages.en: Paul chattered the whole time on the bus!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, tkellem minn meta rkibna sa meta nżilna.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, tkellem minn meta rkibna sa meta nżilna.
messages.zh: 确实，从我们上车一直说到下车。
messages.en: True, he talked from the moment we got on until we got off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 wetwet 重复的字形，就想象连续不断的声音：树上鸟儿啾啾，车上朋友叽喳。这只是帮助区分两类用法的记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause physical pain, injury, or emotional hurt to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人身体疼痛、受伤，或在感情上受到伤害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkawża wġigħ jew ferita lil xi ħadd, jew iweġġagħlu s-sentimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄痛；使受伤或感到难过。
弄伤；使身体受到损伤。
折磨；使承受痛苦。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hurt (cause someone physical or emotional pain)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伤害，使某人感到身体或情感上的痛苦。
损害；对人或事物产生不利影响。

formal.mt: Il-kumment pubbliku weġġa' s-sentimenti tal-istudenta, u l-għalliem talab apoloġija.
formal.en: The public comment hurt the student's feelings, and the teacher asked for an apology.
formal.zh: 那番公开评论伤害了这名女学生的感情，老师要求道歉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Anna telqet daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Dak il-kumment weġġa' lil Anna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Anna leave so early? Mark: That comment hurt Anna.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Anna为什么这么早就走了？Mark：那句话伤了Anna的心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Anna为什么这么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Anna leave so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那句话伤了Anna的心。
messages.en: That comment hurt Anna.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“碰伤手”和“听到伤心话”并排画在记忆卡上，提醒自己身体和感情都能受伤；书写时保留词尾撇号，并与 weġġaħ 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show someone respect or esteem, or to honour them for their qualities or contribution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人表示尊重或敬意，或因其品质、贡献而给予表彰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri rispett u stima lejn xi ħadd, jew jagħtih ġieħ għall-kwalitajiet jew il-ħidma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尊重；敬重。
赞扬；称赞。

sense_translations.en_definition: to respect; to honour; to esteem appropriately
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尊重；给予荣誉；给予相称的敬意和重视。

collocations.zh: 表达对她的追思与敬意

formal.mt: Il-kunsill weġġaħ lill-voluntiera b'ċerimonja ta' rikonoxximent għall-ħidma tagħhom.
formal.en: The council honoured the volunteers with a ceremony recognising their work.
formal.zh: 议会举行仪式，表彰志愿者所做的工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex taw ċertifikat lin-nannu? Pawlu: Il-klabb weġġaħ lin-nannu għas-snin kollha ta' għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did they give Grandpa a certificate? Pawlu: The club honoured Grandpa for all his years of help.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他们为什么给爷爷颁证书？Pawlu：俱乐部表彰爷爷多年来提供的帮助。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.zh: 他们为什么给爷爷颁证书？
messages.en: Why did they give Grandpa a certificate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-klabb weġġaħ lin-nannu għas-snin kollha ta' għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-klabb weġġaħ lin-nannu għas-snin kollha ta' għajnuna.
messages.zh: 俱乐部表彰爷爷多年来提供的帮助。
messages.en: The club honoured Grandpa for all his years of help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“颁发证书、起立致敬”的画面记住尊重和表彰；把词尾 ħ 圈出来，与表示伤害、词尾带撇号的 weġġa' 做拼写辨认练习。

gloss_zh: 卡住；被定罪或受罚；背上责任

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get stuck and be unable to move or proceed; also to receive blame or a penalty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 陷住、卡住而无法移动或继续；也可指受到责备或处罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqabad f'post u ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq jew ikompli; ukoll jingħata tort jew piena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卡住；陷住；无法继续前进。
被判有罪；被定罪。
受到责备；被归咎。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be sentenced, to be given a penalty
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被判刑；被处以某种处罚。
发生非意愿妊娠；意外怀孕。
停止来月经；月经停来。
被认定应负责任；背上过错。

formal.mt: It-trakk weħel fit-tajn, u l-kunsinna waslet sagħtejn tard.
formal.en: The truck got stuck in the mud, and the delivery arrived two hours late.
formal.zh: 卡车陷在泥里，货物因此晚到了两个小时。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark għadu ma wasalx? Sara: Weħel fit-traffiku; se jasal aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why hasn't Mark arrived yet? Sara: He got stuck in traffic; he'll arrive later.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark怎么还没到？Sara：他堵在路上了，会晚一点到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark怎么还没到？
messages.en: Why hasn't Mark arrived yet?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Weħel fit-traffiku; se jasal aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Weħel fit-traffiku; se jasal aktar tard.
messages.zh: 他堵在路上了，会晚一点到。
messages.en: He got stuck in traffic; he'll arrive later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“车轮陷进泥里”记住卡住，再把受罚和背责分别配例句练习；涉及怀孕和停经的义项另列记忆卡，避免把不同语境混用。

gloss_zh: 激起怨愤；表现偏执；云雀鸣唱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arouse resentment or show bigotry, especially religious bigotry; also to sing, of a skylark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 激起怨愤，或表现出偏执、尤其是宗教偏执；也可指云雀鸣唱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem riżentiment jew juri intolleranza, speċjalment reliġjuża; jingħad ukoll għall-għana tal-alwetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激起怨愤；引发不满和愤恨。
表现出偏执或排斥异己的态度，尤指宗教方面。
持偏执态度；固执而不容异己。
鸣唱，指云雀。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem weżweż lin-nies kontra l-ġirien tagħhom, u d-diskors tiegħu qajjem tensjoni fil-komunità.
formal.en: The speaker stirred up people's resentment against their neighbours, and his speech caused tension in the community.
formal.zh: 发言者煽起了人们对邻居的怨愤，他的讲话使社区气氛紧张起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt l-alwetta? Weżwżet għal ftit ħin. Mark: Iva, smajtha minn ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the skylark? It sang for a little while. Mark: Yes, I heard it from beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见云雀了吗？它刚才唱了一小会儿。马克：听见了，我在窗边听到的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt l-alwetta? Weżwżet għal ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt l-alwetta? Weżwżet għal ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 你听见云雀了吗？它刚才唱了一小会儿。
messages.en: Did you hear the skylark? It sang for a little while.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，我在窗边听到的。
messages.en: Yes, I heard it from beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 weżweż 画两张记忆卡：一张是激起怨愤或表现偏执的人，另一张是鸣唱的云雀。按语境选卡，不把这些义项硬凑成词源故事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To warn someone, admonish them about their behaviour, or urge them strongly to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人提出警告，告诫其注意行为，或郑重劝勉其采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti twissija lil xi ħadd, iwissih dwar l-imġiba tiegħu jew iħeġġu bis-serjetà biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警告；提醒注意危险或不良后果。
告诫；郑重指出行为中的问题并劝其改正。
劝勉；恳切或郑重地敦促。
告诫；劝勉；郑重敦促。

formal.mt: Id-direttur widdeb lill-ħaddiema biex josservaw ir-regoli tas-sigurtà waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The director admonished the workers to observe the safety rules while working.
formal.zh: 主管郑重告诫工人们在工作时遵守安全规定。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Għaliex l-għalliem widdeb lil Pawlu? Maja: Għax kien jiġri fit-taraġ; seta' jaqa'.
colloquial.en: Ben: Why did the teacher admonish Paul? Maja: Because he was running on the stairs; he could have fallen.
colloquial.zh: 本：老师为什么告诫保罗？玛雅：因为他在楼梯上跑，可能会摔倒。

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 老师为什么告诫保罗？
messages.en: Why did the teacher admonish Paul?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien jiġri fit-taraġ; seta' jaqa'.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien jiġri fit-taraġ; seta' jaqa'.
messages.zh: 因为他在楼梯上跑，可能会摔倒。
messages.en: Because he was running on the stairs; he could have fallen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 widdeb 时想象老师举手提醒楼梯上奔跑的学生：先警告危险，再告诫行为，也可以郑重劝勉。用同一课堂画面串起三个意思。

gloss_zh: 耳朵；密探或线人；锅的耳状把手

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ear; also a spy or informant, or an ear-shaped handle on a pot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 耳朵；也可指密探或线人，以及锅上形似耳朵的把手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organu tas-smigħ; ukoll spija jew informatur, jew manku ta' borma li jixbah widna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳朵；听觉器官。
密探；线人；提供情报的人。
锅上形似耳朵的把手；锅耳。

collocations.en: the ear-shaped handle of the pot

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, it-tabib sab li l-widna tax-xellug kienet infjammata.
formal.en: During the examination, the doctor found that the left ear was inflamed.
formal.zh: 检查时，医生发现左耳发炎了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A valley or vale, an area of low land between higher ground; also a torrent.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Art baxxa bejn għoljiet jew artijiet ogħla; ukoll ilma li jiġri bil-qawwa.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tell someone that you will do something or that something will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人保证自己会做某事，或保证某事会发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti kelmtu lil xi ħadd li se jagħmel xi ħaġa jew li xi ħaġa se sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 答应；承诺；保证会做某事

formal.mt: Id-direttur wiegħed li jwieġeb għall-mistoqsijiet kollha qabel tmiem il-laqgħa.

formal.zh: 主任承诺在会议结束前回答所有问题。

阻挠；妨碍进行
扰乱；干扰正常进行

formal.zh: 设备不足妨碍了团队的工作，并延误了项目的完成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give birth to a baby or to young animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生下婴儿或动物幼崽；进行分娩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib tarbija jew frieħ fid-dinja permezz tat-twelid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分娩；生孩子或产下幼崽
生育；生下婴儿或幼崽
生产；分娩

formal.zh: 这位妇女在医院生下一个婴儿，母婴情况都很好。

gloss_zh: 站立的；直立的；静止的；傲慢的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Standing or held upright; also stationary or motionless, and in another sense haughty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或物站立、直立或保持垂直，也可表示静止不动；另有傲慢的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a large distance from one side to the other, or extending over a large area.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的子女还和你一起住吗？
messages.en: Do your children still live with you?

messages.speaker: Toni (父亲)
messages.zh: 是的，两个都还住在家里。
messages.en: Yes, both of them are still at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wild 放在家庭合照旁记忆：父母身边的子女，以及延续下去的后代。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or event of giving birth, or a group of young animals born together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分娩或出生这一事件；也指动物一次生产的一窝幼崽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ġrajja tat-twelid, jew grupp ta' frieħ li jitwieldu flimkien minn annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分娩；出生这一过程或事件。
一窝幼崽；动物同一次生产所生的幼小动物。

formal.mt: Wara l-wilda, il-kelba u l-ġriewi tagħha kellhom bżonn post sħun u kwiet.
formal.en: After giving birth, the dog and her puppies needed a warm, quiet place.
formal.zh: 分娩后，母狗和它的小狗需要一个温暖、安静的地方。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm hemm ġriewi f'din il-wilda? Pawlu: Ħamsa, u kollha jinsabu tajbin.
colloquial.en: Sara: How many puppies are in this litter? Pawlu: Five, and they are all doing well.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这一窝有几只小狗？Pawlu：五只，而且都很好。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 这一窝有几只小狗？
messages.en: How many puppies are in this litter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (狗主人)
messages.zh: 五只，而且都很好。
messages.en: Five, and they are all doing well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象母狗生产后身旁的一窝小狗：wilda 既可记生产事件，也可记这一窝幼崽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To conceive or bring a child into the world; figuratively, to conceive ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 孕育或生下孩子；比喻构思、孕育想法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed inissel jew iġib tarbija fid-dinja; b'mod figurattiv, li jnissel ideat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受孕；孕育新生命。
生育孩子；有了孩子。
构思想法；在头脑中孕育新的观念。
生下；生产出孩子或幼崽。
分娩；把孩子生下来。

collocations.en: she gave birth to a baby

formal.mt: L-omm wildet tarbija b'saħħitha fl-isptar u rċeviet il-kura meħtieġa.
formal.en: The mother gave birth to a healthy baby in hospital and received the necessary care.
formal.zh: 这位母亲在医院生下了一个健康的婴儿，并得到了所需的护理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Oħtok wildet? Mark: Iva, wildet tifla dalgħodu. It-tnejn jinsabu tajbin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has your sister given birth? Mark: Yes, she had a girl this morning. They are both doing well.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你姐姐生了吗？Mark：生了，今天早上生了个女孩。母女都很好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你姐姐生了吗？
messages.en: Has your sister given birth?

messages.speaker: Mark (产妇的弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wildet tifla dalgħodu. It-tnejn jinsabu tajbin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wildet tifla dalgħodu. It-tnejn jinsabu tajbin.
messages.zh: 生了，今天早上生了个女孩。母女都很好。
messages.en: Yes, she had a girl this morning. They are both doing well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 wiled：生命在腹中孕育，想法在脑中孕育；再联系生下孩子的动作。

gloss_zh: 大片田野；山谷上方的田地

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large stretch of fields, particularly an area of fields above a valley.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一大片田野，尤其指位于山谷上方的一片田地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda kbira ta' għelieqi, speċjalment għelieqi li jinsabu fuq wied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大片田野；面积较大的一片农田。

sense_translations.en_definition: area of fields over a valley
sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于山谷上方的一片田地。

formal.mt: Il-bdiewa jkabbru l-ħxejjex fil-wilġa fertili li tinsab fuq il-wied.
formal.en: The farmers grow vegetables in the fertile stretch of fields above the valley.
formal.zh: 农民们在山谷上方那片肥沃的田地里种植蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm fuq il-wied? Ġużeppi: Hemm wilġa kbira; minn hawn tista' tara l-għelieqi kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is above the valley? Ġużeppi: There is a large stretch of fields; from here you can see all of them.
colloquial.zh: Nina：山谷上方有什么？Ġużeppi：有一大片田野；从这里可以看到所有的田地。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 山谷上方有什么？
messages.en: What is above the valley?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (当地农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm wilġa kbira; minn hawn tista' tara l-għelieqi kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm wilġa kbira; minn hawn tista' tara l-għelieqi kollha.
messages.zh: 有一大片田野；从这里可以看到所有的田地。
messages.en: There is a large stretch of fields; from here you can see all of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 wilġa 时想象站在谷边向上看：视野里铺开一大片田地，把地形与词义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive property from someone who has died, or to receive genetically transmitted traits from one's parents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从去世的人那里继承财产，或通过遗传获得父母的特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jirċievi ġid mingħand persuna li mietet, jew karatteristiċi ġenetiċi mingħand il-ġenituri tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继承；承受逝者留下的财产等。

sense_translations.en_definition: to acquire features or characteristics which are genetically transmitted
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过遗传获得特征或性状。

collocations.en: he inherited his mother's eye colour
collocations.zh: 他遗传了母亲的眼睛颜色

formal.mt: Wara l-mewt ta' zijuh, Daniel wiret id-dar u l-art ta' madwarha.
formal.en: After his uncle's death, Daniel inherited the house and the land around it.
formal.zh: 叔叔去世后，Daniel 继承了那所房子及其周围的土地。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ibnek għandu għajnejn ħodor bħalek! Rita: Iva, wiret il-kulur tal-għajnejn tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Marta: Your son has green eyes like you! Rita: Yes, he inherited my eye colour.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你儿子和你一样有绿色的眼睛！Rita：是啊，他遗传了我的眼睛颜色。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你儿子和你一样有绿色的眼睛！
messages.en: Your son has green eyes like you!

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，他遗传了我的眼睛颜色。
messages.en: Yes, he inherited my eye colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 wiret 配两张图：接过长辈留下的房屋钥匙，以及拥有父母同色的眼睛，分别记继承和遗传。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exhibition or show in which artworks, objects, or other items are presented for people to see.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把艺术作品、物品等陈列出来供人观看的展览或展示活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività li fiha jitqiegħdu xogħlijiet tal-arti, oġġetti jew affarijiet oħra biex jarahom in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 展览；集中陈列作品或物品供人参观的活动。
展示；展览；供公众观看的陈列活动。

formal.mt: Il-mużew se jiftaħ wirja tar-ritratti li turi l-ħajja ta' kuljum fil-belt.
formal.en: The museum will open a photography exhibition showing everyday life in the city.
formal.zh: 博物馆将举办一场摄影展，展示这座城市的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid tiġi tara l-wirja miegħi għada? Ben: Iva! X'ħin jiftaħ il-mużew?
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like to come and see the exhibition with me tomorrow? Ben: Yes! What time does the museum open?
colloquial.zh: Anna：明天想和我一起去看展览吗？Ben：想！博物馆几点开门？

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara l-wirja miegħi għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara l-wirja miegħi għada?
messages.zh: 明天想和我一起去看展览吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come and see the exhibition with me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 想！博物馆几点开门？
messages.en: Yes! What time does the museum open?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走进展厅，一幅幅作品排在眼前；把 wirja 和买票看展的完整场景绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Property passed on after someone's death, or cultural traditions and other valued things handed down from earlier generations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逝者留下并由他人继承的财产；也指前代传下来的文化、传统等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġid li jitħalla minn persuna wara mewtha, jew kultura, tradizzjonijiet u affarijiet ta' valur li jgħaddu minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗产；从逝者那里继承的财产。
传承；由前代留下来的文化、传统或其他共同财富。

sense_translations.en_definition: inheritance; legacy (that which is bequeathed and inherited)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗产；遗赠物；由前人留下并由后人继承的东西。

collocations.en: to leave a house as an inheritance
collocations.zh: 把一所房子作为遗产留下

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu l-għan li jħares il-wirt kulturali tar-raħal għall-ġenerazzjonijiet futuri.
formal.en: The project aims to preserve the village's cultural heritage for future generations.
formal.zh: 这个项目旨在为后代保护村庄的文化遗产。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din id-dar xtrajtha? David: Le, in-nannu ħallieha lili bħala wirt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you buy this house? David: No, my grandfather left it to me as an inheritance.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这所房子是你买的吗？David：不是，是爷爷作为遗产留给我的。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 这所房子是你买的吗？
messages.en: Did you buy this house?

messages.speaker: David (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, in-nannu ħallieha lili bħala wirt.
messages.mt_standard: Le, in-nannu ħallieha lili bħala wirt.
messages.zh: 不是，是爷爷作为遗产留给我的。
messages.en: No, my grandfather left it to me as an inheritance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wirt 想成前人交给后人的传承箱：里面既能放房产契约，也能放文化和传统。

gloss_zh: 宽度；宽广程度；空间；活动余地

teaching_sense.en_definition: The extent of something from side to side, or the space available for movement, use, or comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体或区域从一侧到另一侧的宽度；也指可供活动、使用或舒展的空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' xi ħaġa minn naħa għall-oħra, jew l-ispazju disponibbli biex wieħed jiċċaqlaq, jużah jew joqgħod komdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宽度；从一侧到另一侧的尺寸。
宽幅；横向展开的宽度。
空间；可供容纳物品或活动的位置。
舒展的空间；不感到拥挤或受限的活动余地。

sense_translations.en_definition: width, breadth (quality or degree of being wide, broad)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宽度；宽广程度；某物有多宽的性质或程度。

formal.mt: Il-wisa' tal-bieb għandu jkun biżżejjed biex siġġu tar-roti jgħaddi mingħajr diffikultà.
formal.en: The width of the door should be sufficient for a wheelchair to pass through without difficulty.
formal.zh: 门的宽度应足以让轮椅顺利通过。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Hemm biżżejjed wisa' għal mejda oħra? Samwel: Iva, jekk inressqu s-sufan ftit lejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is there enough space for another table? Samwel: Yes, if we move the sofa a little towards the window.
colloquial.zh: Elena：还有足够的空间再放一张桌子吗？Samwel：有，把沙发往窗边挪一点就行。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm biżżejjed wisa' għal mejda oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm biżżejjed wisa' għal mejda oħra?
messages.zh: 还有足够的空间再放一张桌子吗？
messages.en: Is there enough space for another table?

messages.speaker: Samwel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk inressqu s-sufan ftit lejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk inressqu s-sufan ftit lejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 有，把沙发往窗边挪一点就行。
messages.en: Yes, if we move the sofa a little towards the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 张开双臂量横向宽度，再想象挪开家具腾出空间；用这两个动作记住 wisa' 的主要义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alcoholic spirit called whisky, served on its own or in mixed drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 威士忌，一种可单独饮用或用于调制饮品的烈酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika qawwija li tissejjaħ whisky bl-Ingliż, u li tista' tinxtorob waħedha jew f'taħlita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 威士忌。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi diversi tipi ta' wiski, li jistgħu jiġu servuti bis-silġ.
formal.en: The menu includes several types of whisky, which can be served with ice.
formal.zh: 菜单列有多种威士忌，可加冰供应。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq tazza wiski, jekk jogħġbok. Lara: Tridu bis-silġ? Mark: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a glass of whisky, please. Lara: Would you like it with ice? Mark: Yes, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 马克：请给我一杯威士忌。拉拉：要加冰吗？马克：要，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一杯威士忌。
messages.en: I'd like a glass of whisky, please.

messages.speaker: Lara (服务员)
messages.zh: 要加冰吗？
messages.en: Would you like it with ice?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wiski 和英语 whisky 对照记忆，再联想一杯加冰的威士忌，连同 tazza wiski 一起背。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To an excessive degree or in an excessive amount; in some contexts, very much or extremely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示程度或数量超过合适范围，相当于“太、过多”；在某些语境中也表示“非常、极其”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod jew f'ammont li jaqbeż dak li hu xieraq; f'xi kuntesti jfisser ukoll ħafna jew ferm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过多；太多。
过度地；过量地。

sense_translations.en_definition: too, too much (more than is appropriate)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 太；过于；太多，指超过适当的程度或数量。
非常；极其；很大程度上。

formal.mt: Il-proposta ġiet miċħuda għax kienet teħtieġ wisq flus u wisq ħin.
formal.en: The proposal was rejected because it required too much money and too much time.
formal.zh: 该提案因所需资金过多、耗时过长而被否决。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kafè sħun wisq! Pawlu: Stenna ftit qabel tixorbu. Maja: Iva, se nħallih jiksaħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: This coffee is too hot! Pawlu: Wait a little before drinking it. Maja: Yes, I'll let it cool.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这咖啡太烫了！保罗：等一会儿再喝。玛雅：好，我让它凉一凉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这咖啡太烫了！
messages.en: This coffee is too hot!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 等一会儿再喝。
messages.en: Wait a little before drinking it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我让它凉一凉。
messages.en: Yes, I'll let it cool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象温度计越过舒适线：sħun wisq 就是“太热”；再用“非常感激”的语境记住它也能加强程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To warn someone about danger or consequences, or to give firm advice or a reprimand about their behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提醒某人注意危险或后果，或针对其行为给予郑重劝告、告诫或训斥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' xi ħadd għal periklu jew konsegwenzi, jew jagħtih parir serju jew ċanfira dwar l-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警告；提醒注意危险或不良后果。
告诫；郑重劝诫。
训斥；责备。
劝告；给予建议。
警告；提醒小心。
告诫；训诫；责备。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill wissa lir-residenti biex jevitaw it-triq magħluqa waqt ix-xogħlijiet.
formal.en: The council warned residents to avoid the closed road during the works.
formal.zh: 地方议会提醒居民在施工期间避开封闭道路。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi qallek il-kowċ? Mark: Wissa lili biex ma nerġax nasal tard. Sara: Mela aħjar titlaq ftit qabel għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did the coach tell you? Mark: He warned me not to arrive late again. Sara: Then you'd better leave a little earlier tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：教练跟你说什么了？马克：他告诫我别再迟到。萨拉：那你明天最好早点出门。

messages.speaker: Sara (队友)
messages.zh: 教练跟你说什么了？
messages.en: What did the coach tell you?

messages.speaker: Mark (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Wissa lili biex ma nerġax nasal tard.
messages.mt_standard: Wissa lili biex ma nerġax nasal tard.
messages.zh: 他告诫我别再迟到。
messages.en: He warned me not to arrive late again.

messages.speaker: Sara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela aħjar titlaq ftit qabel għada.
messages.mt_standard: Mela aħjar titlaq ftit qabel għada.
messages.zh: 那你明天最好早点出门。
messages.en: Then you'd better leave a little earlier tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wissa 放进“教练郑重提醒别迟到”的画面：语气轻是劝告，语气重可到警告或训斥。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of flat or level land, such as a plain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地势平坦的一片土地，可指平地或平原。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda ta' art ċatta jew invellata, bħal pjanura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平地；平坦的地面。
地势平坦的平原。
平坦地区；平原地带。

formal.mt: Il-bdiewa kabbru l-qamħ fuq il-wita ħdejn ix-xmara.
formal.en: The farmers grew wheat on the plain beside the river.
formal.zh: 农民在河边的平原上种植小麦。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se npoġġu t-tinda? Toni: Fuq il-wita ħdejn dawk is-siġar. Lara: Tajjeb, hemm l-art ċatta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we put the tent? Toni: On the flat ground beside those trees. Lara: Good, the ground is level there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们把帐篷搭在哪里？托尼：搭在那些树旁的平地上。拉拉：好，那里的地面平坦。

messages.speaker: Lara (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 我们把帐篷搭在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the tent?

messages.speaker: Toni (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 搭在那些树旁的平地上。
messages.en: On the flat ground beside those trees.

messages.speaker: Lara (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 好，那里的地面平坦。
messages.en: Good, the ground is level there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用露营画面记 wita：找一片平地搭帐篷。再与双写 t 的动词 witta 对照，区分“平地”和“整平”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make ground or a path level, to raze a structure, or figuratively to make a situation easier or facilitate progress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把地面或道路整平，把建筑物夷平；也可比喻消除阻碍，使事情更容易或进展更顺利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel art jew mogħdija ċatta, iwaqqa' struttura għal kollox, jew, b'mod figurattiv, jagħmel sitwazzjoni eħfef jew jiffaċilita l-progress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 整平；使平坦。
夷为平地；彻底拆毁。
促成；使更容易进行。
整平、修平道路或小径。

sense_translations.en_definition: to tear down, raze (a structure etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆毁、夷平建筑物等结构。
缓解局面；使问题更易处理；为事情创造便利。

collocations.en: paved the way for an agreement
collocations.zh: 为达成协议铺平了道路

collocations.en: razed the building to the ground

formal.mt: Id-djalogu bejn iż-żewġ naħat witta t-triq għal ftehim ġdid.
formal.en: Dialogue between the two sides paved the way for a new agreement.
formal.zh: 双方的对话为达成新协议铺平了道路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Issa nistgħu npoġġu l-mejda hawn? Pawlu: Iva, il-ħaddiem witta l-art dalgħodu. Maja: Tajjeb, hekk il-mejda tibqa' dritta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we put the table here now? Pawlu: Yes, the worker levelled the ground this morning. Maja: Good, that way the table will stay level.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：现在可以把桌子放在这里了吗？保罗：可以，工人今天早上把地面整平了。玛雅：好，这样桌子就能放平了。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 现在可以把桌子放在这里了吗？
messages.en: Can we put the table here now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 可以，工人今天早上把地面整平了。
messages.en: Yes, the worker levelled the ground this morning.

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 好，这样桌子就能放平了。
messages.en: Good, that way the table will stay level.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 witta 的两个 t 想象成两把整地工具：先整平地面，再联想到“为协议铺平道路”；这只是拼写联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The front part of the head, including the eyes, nose and mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头部的正面，包括眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，即脸或面孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' quddiem tar-ras, fejn hemm l-għajnejn, l-imnieħer u l-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸；面孔。

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija, wiċċ it-tifel jesprimi ferħ u kurżità.
formal.en: In the drawing, the boy's face expresses happiness and curiosity.
formal.zh: 画中男孩的脸上流露出喜悦和好奇。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Għandek iċ-ċikkulata fuq wiċċek! Ben: Fejn? Omm: Ħdejn ħalqek; imsaħha b'din.
colloquial.en: Mum: You've got chocolate on your face! Ben: Where? Mum: Beside your mouth; wipe it off with this.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你脸上沾着巧克力呢！本：在哪里？妈妈：嘴巴旁边，用这个擦掉。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 你脸上沾着巧克力呢！
messages.en: You've got chocolate on your face!

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 在哪里？
messages.en: Where?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 嘴巴旁边，用这个擦掉。
messages.en: Beside your mouth; wipe it off with this.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wiċċ 写在镜子旁边，每次看见自己的眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，就说一次这个词；再用面对面的画面记住 wiċċ imb wiċċ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To measure how heavy something is, to have a particular weight, or figuratively to consider something carefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 测量某物的重量，表示某物重达多少；也可比喻仔细考虑、权衡意见或选择。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikejjel kemm hi tqila xi ħaġa, ikollu piż partikolari, jew, b'mod figurattiv, iqis xi ħaġa bir-reqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 称重；有某一重量。
考虑；仔细斟酌。
重达；具有某一重量。
称量；测定重量。

sense_translations.en_definition: to consider, to weigh (e.g. an argument)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 考虑、权衡，例如斟酌某个论点。
一个重量；一份重量。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat wiżen l-argumenti kollha qabel ħa d-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: The committee weighed all the arguments before making the final decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出最终决定前权衡了所有论点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-bejjiegħ wiżen il-patata? Mark: Iva, u poġġieha f'borża. Lara: Tajjeb, mela nistgħu nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the seller weigh the potatoes? Mark: Yes, and he put them in a bag. Lara: Good, then we can leave.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：摊主称过土豆了吗？马克：称过了，还装进了袋子。拉拉：好，那我们可以走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (购物者)
messages.zh: 摊主称过土豆了吗？
messages.en: Did the seller weigh the potatoes?

messages.speaker: Mark (购物同伴)
messages.zh: 称过了，还装进了袋子。
messages.en: Yes, and he put them in a bag.

messages.speaker: Lara (购物者)
messages.zh: 好，那我们可以走了。
messages.en: Good, then we can leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天平先称土豆，再称两边的理由：wiżen 可以称实际重量，也可以在心里权衡；另把名词义单独记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional unit of weight; its intended kilogram equivalent should be made clear in the context of use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种传统重量单位；使用时应根据具体语境明确其所指的公斤数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità tradizzjonali tal-piż; meta tintuża, għandu jkun ċar kemm-il kilogramma tfisser fil-kuntest.

sense_translations.en_definition: rotolo, a traditional unit of weight, where five rotolos are roughly equivalent to a kilogram
sense_translations.zh_definition: rotolo，一种传统重量单位；五个 rotolo 约等于一公斤。

sense_translations.en_definition: a traditional unit of weight, still used e.g. in farming and household contexts, equivalent to 5 ratal, that is officially 8.75 imperial pounds (3.969 kg), now widely metrified informally to mean 4 kilogrammes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种传统重量单位，仍用于农业、家庭等场景；等于五个 ratal，正式换算为8.75英磅，即3.969公斤，如今在非正式使用中广泛按四公斤计算。

formal.mt: F'dan il-ftehim, wiżna patata tfisser erba' kilogrammi.
formal.en: In this agreement, a wiżna of potatoes means four kilograms.
formal.zh: 在本协议中，一 wiżna 土豆指四公斤土豆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta tgħid wiżna patata, kemm qed tfisser? Toni: Hawn qed nużaw wiżna għal erba' kilogrammi. Maja: Tajjeb, agħtini erba' kilogrammi, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you say a wiżna of potatoes, how much do you mean? Toni: Here we're using a wiżna to mean four kilograms. Maja: All right, give me four kilograms, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说一 wiżna 土豆，是指多少？托尼：我们这里用一 wiżna 表示四公斤。玛雅：好，请给我四公斤。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid wiżna patata, kemm qed tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid wiżna patata, kemm qed tfisser?
messages.zh: 你说一 wiżna 土豆，是指多少？
messages.en: When you say a wiżna of potatoes, how much do you mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn qed nużaw wiżna għal erba' kilogrammi.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed nużaw wiżna għal erba' kilogrammi.
messages.zh: 我们这里用一 wiżna 表示四公斤。
messages.en: Here we're using a wiżna to mean four kilograms.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, agħtini erba' kilogrammi, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, agħtini erba' kilogrammi, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好，请给我四公斤。
messages.en: All right, give me four kilograms, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wiżna 记成市场上的传统称重标签：看到标签先想到“重量单位”，再问清这一语境具体折合多少公斤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A goose or geese: large water birds with long necks, also kept on farms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹅，可表示一只鹅或多只鹅；这类水鸟颈部较长，也常见于农场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ilma b'għonq twil, li jitrabba wkoll fl-irziezet; il-kelma tista' tirreferi għal wieħed jew għal aktar minn wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹅；一只鹅。
鹅，指多只鹅。

formal.mt: Fl-għadira ħdejn ir-razzett, it-tfal osservaw qatgħa wiżż.
formal.en: In the pond beside the farm, the children observed a flock of geese.
formal.zh: 孩子们在农场旁的池塘里观察到一群鹅。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara l-wiżż ħdejn l-ilma! Pawlu: Iva, qed jgħumu flimkien. Nina: Ejja narawhom minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at the geese by the water! Pawlu: Yes, they're swimming together. Nina: Let's watch them from here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看水边的鹅！保罗：是啊，它们正一起游泳。妮娜：我们就在这里看它们吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 看水边的鹅！
messages.en: Look at the geese by the water!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，它们正一起游泳。
messages.en: Yes, they're swimming together.

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我们就在这里看它们吧。
messages.en: Let's watch them from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wiżż 末尾两个带点的 ż 想象成并排游泳的两只鹅，帮助记住拼写；单只还是多只要结合语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Also; used to add another person, thing, or action to what has already been mentioned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 也；还，用来补充另一个人、事物或动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avverbju li jżid persuna, ħaġa jew azzjoni oħra ma' dak li diġà ssemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 也；还。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-vocalic and alternative basic form of ukoll
sense_translations.zh_definition: ukoll 用于元音之后的形式，也是其另一种基本形式。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jaqraw it-test u jwieġbu wkoll il-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The students should read the text and also answer the questions.
formal.zh: 学生应阅读课文，并回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se mmur il-librerija wara nofsinhar. Mark: Jiena wkoll. Nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm going to the library this afternoon. Mark: Me too. We can go together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我今天下午要去图书馆。Mark：我也去。我们可以一起走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天下午要去图书馆。
messages.en: I'm going to the library this afternoon.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也去。我们可以一起走。
messages.en: Me too. We can go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jiena wkoll 整块记成“我也一样”，想象朋友举手说“我也去”的场景。

gloss_zh: 公山羊；粗鲁的人；瓦特；白羊座

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male goat; in other senses, an uncouth person or a watt, a unit of power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公山羊；其他义项可指粗鲁的人，或功率单位瓦特。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-maskil tal-mogħża; f'tifsiriet oħra, persuna goffa jew unità tal-qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公山羊。
粗鲁、缺乏教养的人。
瓦特，功率单位。
公山羊。
白羊座，天文学中的星座名称。
白羊座，占星术中的黄道十二宫之一。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żamm il-wott f'post separat mill-mogħoż l-oħra.
formal.en: The farmer kept the male goat in a place separate from the other goats.
formal.zh: 农夫把公山羊安置在与其他山羊分开的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak wott? Mark: Iva, u dik ħdejh hija mogħża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a male goat? Mark: Yes, and the one beside him is a female goat.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是一只公山羊吗？Mark：是的，旁边那只是一只母山羊。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.zh: 那是一只公山羊吗？
messages.en: Is that a male goat?

messages.speaker: Mark (农夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u dik ħdejh hija mogħża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u dik ħdejh hija mogħża.
messages.zh: 是的，旁边那只是一只母山羊。
messages.en: Yes, and the one beside him is a female goat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用山羊、功率表和星图分别建立记忆卡；遇到 wott，先看语境再选择对应含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become full after eating, or to feel that one has had enough of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃饱、感到饱足；也可指对某事已经受够了。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiel biżżejjed u ma baqax bil-ġuħ; jew ħass li kellu biżżejjed minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃饱；感到饱足。
已经受够；觉得已经足够。
丰足；充裕。

collocations.en: he had had enough of waiting

formal.mt: It-tifel xaba' wara li kiel is-soppa u l-ħobż.
formal.en: The boy was full after eating the soup and bread.
formal.zh: 男孩喝了汤、吃了面包后就饱了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma jridx aktar ikel? Rita: Għax xaba'. Kiel platt kbir għaġin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Mark want any more food? Rita: Because he's full. He ate a large plate of pasta.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么不想再吃了？Rita：因为他吃饱了。他吃了一大盘意面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jridx aktar ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jridx aktar ikel?
messages.zh: Mark 为什么不想再吃了？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark want any more food?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xaba'. Kiel platt kbir għaġin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xaba'. Kiel platt kbir għaġin.
messages.zh: 因为他吃饱了。他吃了一大盘意面。
messages.en: Because he's full. He ate a large plate of pasta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“肚子已经够了”的吃饱画面，再把“够了”的感觉联系到等得受够；词尾撇号一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sword or sabre: a weapon with a long blade and a handle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剑或军刀，具有长刀身和握柄的武器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma b'xafra twila u manku, li tintuża biex taqta' jew tiġġieled.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军刀；马刀。
剑。
军刀，通常呈弯曲形的轻型刀剑。
带鱼。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi xabla antika f'kaxxa tal-ħġieġ.
formal.en: The museum displays an old sword in a glass case.
formal.zh: 博物馆在玻璃展柜中陈列着一把古剑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik ix-xabla fil-vetrina! Mark: Iva, għandha manku sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that sword in the display case! Mark: Yes, it has a very beautiful handle.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看展柜里的那把剑！Mark：是啊，它的剑柄非常漂亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (博物馆参观者)
messages.zh: 看展柜里的那把剑！
messages.en: Look at that sword in the display case!

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，它的剑柄非常漂亮。
messages.en: Yes, it has a very beautiful handle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xabla 放在博物馆展柜的画面里记作整把剑；鱼类义另配带鱼图片，分开练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A monkey or an ape, an animal with grasping hands and some human-like features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猴或猿，具有能抓握物体的手和一些类似人类特征的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li għandu idejn li bihom jaqbad l-affarijiet u xi karatteristiċi li jixbhu lil dawk tal-bniedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猴；猴子。
猿。
猴或猿。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher xadin bilqiegħda fuq fergħa.
formal.en: The picture shows a monkey sitting on a branch.
formal.zh: 图片中有一只坐在树枝上的猴子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu x-xadin fl-istampa? Mark: Hemm fuq, bejn il-weraq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the monkey in the picture? Mark: Up there, among the leaves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：图片里的猴子在哪里？Mark：在上面，树叶之间。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里的猴子在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the monkey in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 在上面，树叶之间。
messages.en: Up there, among the leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象树叶之间伸出一双抓握的手，把 xadin 与猴、猿两张图片一起记忆，阅读时再按语境细分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cutting blade of a tool or weapon, or a thin blade used for shaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工具或武器上用于切割的刀片、刀刃，也可指剃须用的薄刀片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti li taqta' ta' għodda jew arma, jew biċċa rqiqa li tintuża għat-tqaxxir tal-leħja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刀片；刀刃。
剃须刀片。

formal.mt: Ix-xafra tas-sikkina għandha titnaddaf wara kull użu.
formal.en: The knife blade should be cleaned after each use.
formal.zh: 刀的刀身每次使用后都应清洁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din ix-xafra għadha taqta'? Rita: Le, trid tinbidel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this blade still sharp? Rita: No, it needs replacing.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这片刀片还锋利吗？Rita：不锋利了，需要更换。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这片刀片还锋利吗？
messages.en: Is this blade still sharp?

messages.speaker: Rita (理发师)
messages.zh: 不锋利了，需要更换。
messages.en: No, it needs replacing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时用手指在图片上指出真正切割的部分，把 xafra 对应到刀片，再用剃须刀片作第二个例子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hair, especially the hair on a person's head, considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 毛发，尤其指作为整体来谈论的人的头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħjut irqaq li jikbru fuq ir-ras jew fuq il-ġisem, meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头发；毛发。
毛发；许多根头发或毛的合称。

formal.mt: L-istampa turi persuna b'xagħar twil u kaboċċi.
formal.en: The picture shows a person with long, curly hair.
formal.zh: 图片中是一位留着长卷发的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xagħrek jidher sabiħ illum. Rita: Grazzi! Ħsiltu dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your hair looks lovely today. Rita: Thanks! I washed it this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的头发今天看起来真好看。Rita：谢谢！我今天早上洗了头发。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的头发今天看起来真好看。
messages.en: Your hair looks lovely today.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢！我今天早上洗了头发。
messages.en: Thanks! I washed it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象梳子梳过一整头头发，把 xagħar 作为毛发整体来记，再搭配“长发”和“卷发”反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dry or arid through a lack or loss of moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因缺少或失去水分而变干、变得干旱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar niexef jew aridu minħabba nuqqas jew telf ta' ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得干旱；变得干燥。
变干；干涸。
毛毛虫。
毛虫；毛毛虫。

formal.mt: Il-wied xagħat wara xhur mingħajr xita.
formal.en: The valley became dry after months without rain.
formal.zh: 数月没有降雨后，山谷变得干旱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak fuq il-werqa? Mark: Dak xagħat. Ara kif miexi bil-mod!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that on the leaf? Mark: That's a caterpillar. Look how slowly it's moving!
colloquial.zh: Maja：叶子上那个是什么？Mark：那是毛毛虫。看，它爬得多慢！

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 叶子上那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that on the leaf?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak xagħat. Ara kif miexi bil-mod!
messages.mt_standard: Dak xagħat. Ara kif miexi bil-mod!
messages.zh: 那是毛毛虫。看，它爬得多慢！
messages.en: That's a caterpillar. Look how slowly it's moving!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xagħat 做两张不同词性卡：动词画干旱山谷，名词画叶上毛虫；同形分别记，避免混成一个意思。

gloss_zh: 月；月份；每月领取的养老金

teaching_sense.en_definition: A calendar month, one of the twelve divisions of a year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 月，月份，指一年划分成的十二个时间单位之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mit-tnax-il taqsima tas-sena fil-kalendarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 月；月份。
每月领取的养老金；按月发放的退休金。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat jiltaqa' darba fix-xahar biex jiddiskuti l-progress tal-proġett.
formal.en: The committee meets once a month to discuss the project's progress.
formal.zh: 委员会每月开会一次，讨论项目进展。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se tibda l-kors? Mark: Ix-xahar id-dieħel. Għad għandi ftit żmien biex nipprepara.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you starting the course? Mark: Next month. I still have a little time to prepare.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你什么时候开始上这门课？马克：下个月。我还有一点时间准备。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候开始上这门课？
messages.en: When are you starting the course?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xahar id-dieħel. Għad għandi ftit żmien biex nipprepara.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xahar id-dieħel. Għad għandi ftit żmien biex nipprepara.
messages.zh: 下个月。我还有一点时间准备。
messages.en: Next month. I still have a little time to prepare.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历翻过一整页，把 xahar 和“一个月”绑在一起；再用“养老金每月到账”记住其按月退休金义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of cloth worn over the shoulders for warmth or decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 披在肩上的布料，用于保暖或装饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tintlibes fuq l-ispallejn biex issaħħan jew iżżejjen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 披肩，披在肩部用于保暖或装饰的织物。

formal.mt: Il-mara libset xall tas-suf fuq l-ispallejn waqt iċ-ċerimonja fil-beraħ.
formal.en: The woman wore a woollen shawl over her shoulders during the outdoor ceremony.
formal.zh: 这位女士参加户外仪式时，在肩上披了一条羊毛披肩。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qed inħoss il-bard fuq spallejja. Anna: Ħu dan ix-xall u għattihom bih.
colloquial.en: Rita: My shoulders feel cold. Anna: Take this shawl and cover them with it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我的肩膀有点冷。安娜：拿这条披肩，把肩膀盖上吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的肩膀有点冷。
messages.en: My shoulders feel cold.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu dan ix-xall u għattihom bih.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu dan ix-xall u għattihom bih.
messages.zh: 拿这条披肩，把肩膀盖上吧。
messages.en: Take this shawl and cover them with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xall 末尾的两个 l 想象成左右两肩，披肩横搭其上；见到 xall 就先回忆“盖住肩膀”的穿戴动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A length of cloth worn around the neck for warmth or decoration; the word can also mean a necktie.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在脖子上保暖或装饰的长条织物；该词也可表示领带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp twila li tintlibes madwar l-għonq biex issaħħan jew iżżejjen; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll ingravata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 围巾；围在颈部用于保暖或装饰的长条织物。
领带，系在衬衫领口处的长条饰物。

formal.mt: Għall-mixja fix-xitwa, il-parteċipanti għandhom iġibu kowt u xalpa tas-suf.
formal.en: For the winter walk, participants should bring a coat and a woollen scarf.
formal.zh: 参加冬季步行活动的人应携带外套和羊毛围巾。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Ilbes xalpa qabel toħroġ; illum hawn ħafna riħ. Sam: Tajjeb, se nilbes il-waħda l-blu.
colloquial.en: Mother: Put on a scarf before you go out; it's very windy today. Sam: All right, I'll wear the blue one.
colloquial.zh: 母亲：出门前围上围巾，今天风很大。萨姆：好的，我戴那条蓝色的。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbes xalpa qabel toħroġ; illum hawn ħafna riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ilbes xalpa qabel toħroġ; illum hawn ħafna riħ.
messages.zh: 出门前围上围巾，今天风很大。
messages.en: Put on a scarf before you go out; it's very windy today.

messages.speaker: Sam (儿子)
messages.zh: 好的，我戴那条蓝色的。
messages.en: All right, I'll wear the blue one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xalpa 写在脖子旁，画一条长布绕颈一圈，记住“围巾”；再画衬衫领口的领带，提示同一词还有另一穿戴义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To perceive an odour with the nose; figuratively, to sense that something is the case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用鼻子闻到气味；也可比喻凭直觉察觉某种情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass riħa b'imnieħru; f'sens figurattiv, ħass li xi ħaġa kienet hekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闻；闻到气味。

sense_translations.en_definition: to intuit or have a feeling that sth. is the case
sense_translations.zh_definition: 凭直觉察觉；隐约觉得某种情况属实。
闻、嗅的动作。
嗅觉；辨别气味的感官能力。

collocations.mt: xamm li kien hemm xi ħaġa ħażina

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem xamm riħa ta' ħruq u informa lill-persuna responsabbli minnufih.
formal.en: The worker smelled a burning smell and immediately informed the person in charge.
formal.zh: 工人闻到烧焦味后，立即通知了负责人。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-kelb xamm l-ikel? Pawlu: Iva, u ġie jiġri lejn il-kċina!
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the dog smell the food? Pawlu: Yes, and he came running towards the kitchen!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：狗闻到食物的味道了吗？保罗：闻到了，还朝厨房跑来了！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗闻到食物的味道了吗？
messages.en: Did the dog smell the food?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ġie jiġri lejn il-kċina!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ġie jiġri lejn il-kċina!
messages.zh: 闻到了，还朝厨房跑来了！
messages.en: Yes, and he came running towards the kitchen!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把鼻子闻到烧焦味的画面与 xamm 联系起来，再联想到中文“嗅出不对劲”，帮助记住它也能表示直觉察觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply wax to a surface or object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把蜡涂在物体或表面上，给其上蜡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesa wiċċ jew oġġett b'saff ta' xama'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……上蜡；在表面涂蜡。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem xamma' l-art wara li naddafha u ħallieha tinxef.
formal.en: The worker waxed the floor after cleaning it and allowing it to dry.
formal.zh: 工人把地板清洁并晾干后，给地板打了蜡。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min xamma' l-mejda? Mark: Missieri xamma' l-mejda dalgħodu. Ara kemm tleqq!
colloquial.en: Sara: Who waxed the table? Mark: My father waxed the table this morning. Look how shiny it is!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁给桌子上蜡了？马克：我爸爸今天早上给桌子上了蜡。你看多亮！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给桌子上蜡了？
messages.en: Who waxed the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri xamma' l-mejda dalgħodu. Ara kemm tleqq!
messages.mt_standard: Missieri xamma' l-mejda dalgħodu. Ara kemm tleqq!
messages.zh: 我爸爸今天早上给桌子上了蜡。你看多亮！
messages.en: My father waxed the table this morning. Look how shiny it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象给桌面涂蜡、擦出光泽的动作，把完整拼写 xamma' 连同末尾撇号一起记住，避免与表示“闻”的 xamm 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To roll or tuck something up or back, especially part of a garment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西卷起、掖起或向后卷折，尤其指衣服的一部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għolla jew dawwar lura parti minn ħaġa, speċjalment minn libsa, billi gerbibha jew deffes it-tarf tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷起；向上卷拢。
掖入；把边缘折好塞入。
向后卷；向后卷折。
把衣物等向上掖起或收起。

formal.mt: Il-voluntier xammar il-kmiem qabel beda jaħsel il-platti.
formal.en: The volunteer rolled up his sleeves before starting to wash the dishes.
formal.zh: 志愿者开始洗碗前卷起了袖子。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Xammar il-kmiem qabel taħsel idejk. Ben: Sewwa, hekk ma jixxarrbux.
colloquial.en: Mum: Roll up your sleeves before washing your hands. Ben: Okay, that way they won't get wet.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：洗手前把袖子卷起来。本：好，这样袖子就不会湿了。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 洗手前把袖子卷起来。
messages.en: Roll up your sleeves before washing your hands.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，这样袖子就不会湿了。
messages.en: Okay, that way they won't get wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象洗手前把袖口一圈圈卷上去，用“卷袖子”这个具体动作记住 xammar，再扩展到掖起衣物和向后卷折。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sniff at something, or to cause another person to smell something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凑近某物嗅闻，或让别人闻到某种气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Resaq b'imnieħru lejn xi ħaġa biex ixommha, jew ġiegħel lil xi ħadd ixomm xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凑近嗅闻；对着某物闻一闻。
让某人闻某物；使某人闻到气味。

formal.mt: Il-kelb xammem il-bagalja qabel kompla lejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The dog sniffed at the suitcase before continuing towards the door.
formal.zh: 狗凑近嗅了嗅行李箱，然后继续朝门口走去。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-qattus xammem l-ikel u telaq? Toni: Forsi ma għoġbitux ir-riħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the cat sniff at the food and walk away? Toni: Maybe it didn't like the smell.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：猫为什么闻了闻食物就走了？托尼：也许它不喜欢那个气味。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-qattus xammem l-ikel u telaq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-qattus xammem l-ikel u telaq?
messages.zh: 猫为什么闻了闻食物就走了？
messages.en: Why did the cat sniff at the food and walk away?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 也许它不喜欢那个气味。
messages.en: Maybe it didn't like the smell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用猫凑近食物嗅一嗅的画面记住 xammem；另配“把花递给别人闻”的画面，分别记牢“嗅闻”和“让人闻”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 宣传；播出；传播；透露；广播者；广播公司

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make information known by publicising, circulating or broadcasting it; also to reveal information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过宣传、传播或广播使信息为人所知；也可指透露消息或秘密。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għarraf lill-oħrajn b'informazzjoni permezz ta' pubbliċità, tixrid jew xandir; ukoll kixef informazzjoni jew sigriet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为……做广告；宣传推广。
公开宣传；使公众知晓。
广播；通过广播或电视播出。
传播；使消息等流传。
透露；揭露原先不为人知的事情。
广播者；从事广播或电视播出工作的人。
广播公司；经营广播或电视播出业务的机构。
传播、宣传或播报新闻消息。
泄露、透露秘密。

formal.mt: L-istazzjon xandar programm edukattiv dwar il-ħarsien tal-baħar.
formal.en: The station broadcast an educational programme about protecting the sea.
formal.zh: 该广播电视台播出了一档有关海洋保护的教育节目。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min xandar l-aħbar dwar il-kunċert? Luqa: L-istazzjon lokali. Smajtha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who broadcast the news about the concert? Luqa: The local station. I heard it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁播出了音乐会的消息？卢卡：本地电台。我今天早上听到了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁播出了音乐会的消息？
messages.en: Who broadcast the news about the concert?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 本地电台。我今天早上听到了。
messages.en: The local station. I heard it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xandar 放在“让更多人知道”的场景里记忆：广告宣传、新闻播出、秘密泄露。遇到名词用法时，再判断它指广播者还是广播公司。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lean or tilt, to tip something over, or figuratively to favour a particular view or option.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾身或倾斜，使某物倾倒；也可比喻倾向某种观点或选择。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejjel ġismu jew xi ħaġa lejn naħa, waqqa' xi ħaġa billi mejjilha, jew wera preferenza għal fehma jew għażla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾身；向某一侧倾斜。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be inclined towards sth (e.g. a particular political view)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向某事物，例如某种政治观点。
使翻倒；把某物倾覆。
使倾斜；把某物斜过来。

formal.mt: Wara li qara ż-żewġ rapporti, il-kumitat xaqleb lejn it-tieni proposta.
formal.en: After reading both reports, the committee leaned towards the second proposal.
formal.zh: 委员会阅读两份报告后，倾向于第二项提案。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex xaqleb il-barmil? Pietru: Biex iferra' l-ilma fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did he tilt the bucket? Pietru: To pour the water into the garden.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他为什么把桶斜过来？彼得：为了把水倒进花园里。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 他为什么把桶斜过来？
messages.en: Why did he tilt the bucket?

messages.speaker: Pietru (邻居)
messages.zh: 为了把水倒进花园里。
messages.en: To pour the water into the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象桶向一侧倾斜，再想象意见的天平偏向某个方案，用同一个“向一边偏”的画面连接 xaqleb 的具体义和比喻义。

gloss_zh: 劈开；裂开；裂缝；狭缝；冒出或流出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To split or crack something open; in particular expressions, to break out or flow, as sweat does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物劈开、裂开或切开；在特定表达中，也指汗等冒出或流出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qasam jew fetaħ xi ħaġa billi għamel qasma; f'ċerti espressjonijiet, ħareġ jew beda jnixxi, bħall-għaraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使裂开；使产生裂口。
劈开；分裂。
出汗；用于 xaqq l-għaraq 这一表达。
切开；切出一个开口。
裂缝；裂纹。
狭缝；细长的开口。
劈开；使开裂。
冒出；涌出或流出。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem xaqq il-biċċa injam f'żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: The worker split the piece of wood into two parts.
formal.zh: 工人把那块木头劈成了两半。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Rajt dak ix-xaqq fil-ħajt? David: Iva, ħdejn it-tieqa. Irridu nuruh lis-sid.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you see that crack in the wall? David: Yes, near the window. We need to show it to the landlord.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你看见墙上那道裂缝了吗？戴维：看见了，就在窗户旁边。我们得给房东看看。

messages.speaker: Marta (合租室友)
messages.zh: 你看见墙上那道裂缝了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that crack in the wall?

messages.speaker: David (合租室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħdejn it-tieqa. Irridu nuruh lis-sid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħdejn it-tieqa. Irridu nuruh lis-sid.
messages.zh: 看见了，就在窗户旁边。我们得给房东看看。
messages.en: Yes, near the window. We need to show it to the landlord.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“劈开木头后出现裂缝”串联 xaqq 的动词和名词用法；表示出汗时，把 xaqq l-għaraq 作为完整短语单独记忆。

gloss_zh: 使开裂；开一条缝；切开一道口子

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something crack or split, to open it slightly, or to make an incision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物开裂或裂开，把它打开一条缝，或切出一道口子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel qasma f'xi ħaġa, fetaħha ftit, jew għamel qatgħa fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使开裂；使出现裂纹或裂口。
打开一条缝；稍微打开。
切开一道口子；作切口。

sense_translations.en_definition: to split, to make an incision
sense_translations.zh_definition: 劈开、裂开；切出一道口子。

formal.mt: L-għalliem xaqqaq it-tieqa biex tidħol ftit arja friska fil-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher opened the window a crack to let some fresh air into the classroom.
formal.zh: 老师把窗户打开了一条缝，让一些新鲜空气进入教室。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Hawn ħafna sħana. Xaqqaq it-tieqa, jekk jogħġbok. Samwel: Sewwa, niftaħha ftit biss għax barra hemm ir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Elena: It's very hot in here. Open the window a crack, please. Samwel: Okay, I'll open it just a little because it's windy outside.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这里很热。请把窗户开一条缝。萨姆韦尔：好，外面有风，我只开一点。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ħafna sħana. Xaqqaq it-tieqa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ħafna sħana. Xaqqaq it-tieqa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 这里很热。请把窗户开一条缝。
messages.en: It's very hot in here. Open the window a crack, please.

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, niftaħha ftit biss għax barra hemm ir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, niftaħha ftit biss għax barra hemm ir-riħ.
messages.zh: 好，外面有风，我只开一点。
messages.en: Okay, I'll open it just a little because it's windy outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手把窗户轻轻推开一条细缝，把 xaqqaq 与“制造一个开口”相连；再用木头裂口和刀切口的画面记住其他义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clay or pottery, including broken pieces of pottery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 陶土、用陶土制成的陶器，也可指破碎的陶器残片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tafal jew oġġetti magħmula minnu, inklużi biċċiet miksura ta' dawn l-oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏土；陶土。
陶器；陶制品。
陶土碎块；陶器碎片。
陶器残片；一片碎陶片。

formal.mt: L-istudenti poġġew il-biċċiet tax-xaqquf fuq il-mejda biex jeżaminawhom.
formal.en: The students placed the pottery fragments on the table to examine them.
formal.zh: 学生们把陶片放在桌上进行观察。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi din il-biċċa? Pawlu: Din biċċa xaqquf; poġġiha fil-kaxxa bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is this piece? Pawlu: It's a piece of pottery; put it gently in the box.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这是什么碎片？Pawlu：这是一块陶片，轻轻放进盒子里。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这是什么碎片？
messages.en: What is this piece?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din biċċa xaqquf; poġġiha fil-kaxxa bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Din biċċa xaqquf; poġġiha fil-kaxxa bil-mod.
messages.zh: 这是一块陶片，轻轻放进盒子里。
messages.en: It's a piece of pottery; put it gently in the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把陶土、完整陶器和碎陶片放在同一张学习图里，用 xaqquf 串起这些相关意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large road vehicle that carries passengers, for example on a regular route or an excursion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在道路上运送乘客的大型车辆，如公共汽车或游览客车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura kbira tat-triq li ġġorr il-passiġġieri, pereżempju fuq rotta regolari jew fuq ħarġa.
