messages.en: Do you have any evidence that the parcel arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi ritratt tal-pakkett quddiem il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi ritratt tal-pakkett quddiem il-bieb.
messages.zh: 有，我有一张包裹放在门前的照片。
messages.en: Yes, I have a photo of the parcel in front of the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把xhieda与“拿出证据、说出证词”的场景绑定；记住它指证明事情的内容，再与指作证之人的xhud对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has seen an event or can give testimony about facts they know.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亲眼看见某件事，或能够就自己知道的事实提供证词的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li rat ġrajja jew li tista' tagħti xhieda dwar fatti li taf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 证人；目击者。
一名证人；一名亲眼见到事件或能够作证的人。

formal.mt: Kull xhud għandu jiddeskrivi biss dak li ra jew sema' personalment.
formal.en: Every witness should describe only what they personally saw or heard.
formal.zh: 每位证人都应只描述自己亲眼看见或亲耳听见的事情。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi ħadd ra l-inċident? Pawlu: Iva, hemm xhud fil-ħanut ta' faċċata.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did anyone see the accident? Pawlu: Yes, there is a witness in the shop opposite.
colloquial.zh: Sara：有人看见那起事故吗？Pawlu：有，对面的商店里有一名目击者。

messages.speaker: Sara (路人)
messages.zh: 有人看见那起事故吗？
messages.en: Did anyone see the accident?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm xhud fil-ħanut ta' faċċata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm xhud fil-ħanut ta' faċċata.
messages.zh: 有，对面的商店里有一名目击者。
messages.en: Yes, there is a witness in the shop opposite.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象法庭里站着一名xhud，他说出的内容是xhieda；用“人”和“证词”这组画面对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A determiner used for an unspecified person, thing, or amount, for an indefinite item in a question, or in exclamations meaning 'what'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 限定词，表示不确定的人、事物或数量，如“一些”；在问句中可表示“任何”，在感叹结构中可表示“多么、什么样的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika persuna, ħaġa jew kwantità mhux speċifikata, tintuża f'mistoqsijiet, u tidħol ukoll f'esklamazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一些；某个；表示数量或对象不确定。
什么；在感叹结构中可译为“多么”或“好一个”。
任何；一些，常用于询问是否存在某人、某物或某种数量。

collocations.zh: 某件事；某样东西；任何东西

formal.mt: Jekk għandek xi mistoqsijiet dwar il-kors, ikkuntattja lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: If you have any questions about the course, contact the office.
formal.zh: 如果你对课程有任何疑问，请联系办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek xi ħaġa x'nieklu? Mark: Iva, hemm xi frott fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have anything for us to eat? Mark: Yes, there is some fruit in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有什么东西可以给我们吃吗？Mark：有，厨房里有一些水果。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有什么东西可以给我们吃吗？
messages.en: Do you have anything for us to eat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，厨房里有一些水果。
messages.en: Yes, there is some fruit in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把xi看作“不把对象说死”的提示牌：陈述里常是“一些”，问句里常是“有没有任何”，感叹时再联系“多么”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short span, especially the distance between the tips of the thumb and little finger when the hand is fully spread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短短的一段距离，尤其指手完全张开时拇指尖到小指尖之间的一拃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda qasira, speċjalment id-distanza bejn it-tarf tas-saba' l-kbir u t-tarf tas-saba' ż-żgħir meta l-id tkun miftuħa beraħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短短的一段距离；很小的跨度。

sense_translations.en_definition: the span between one's extended little finger and thumb
sense_translations.zh_definition: 手张开时小指尖与拇指尖之间的跨度；一拃。

sense_translations.en_definition: span (the measure of the hand), officially 10 5⁄16 imperial inches or ~26.19 m.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拃，以手的跨度计量的长度单位；此处列为10又5⁄16英寸。该英寸数约合26.19厘米，所列“约26.19米”的单位与之不符。

formal.mt: Għal kejl approssimattiv, l-istudent fetaħ idu u kejjel xiber bejn iż-żewġ marki.
formal.en: For an approximate measurement, the student spread his hand and measured a handspan between the two marks.
formal.zh: 为了进行粗略测量，这名学生张开手，量出两个标记之间相距一拃。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm inħalli spazju bejn dawn iż-żewġ qsari? Pawlu: Ħalli xiber bejniethom, hekk il-weraq ikollu fejn jikber.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much space should I leave between these two pots? Pawlu: Leave a handspan between them so the leaves have room to grow.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这两个花盆之间要留多少空间？Pawlu：留一拃，这样叶子才有生长的空间。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm inħalli spazju bejn dawn iż-żewġ qsari?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm inħalli spazju bejn dawn iż-żewġ qsari?
messages.zh: 这两个花盆之间要留多少空间？
messages.en: How much space should I leave between these two pots?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalli xiber bejniethom, hekk il-weraq ikollu fejn jikber.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalli xiber bejniethom, hekk il-weraq ikollu fejn jikber.
messages.zh: 留一拃，这样叶子才有生长的空间。
messages.en: Leave a handspan between them so the leaves have room to grow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到xiber就张开一只手，看看拇指尖到小指尖的距离；用这个动作记住“一拃”，再联想到短短一段距离。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A net used to catch or hold things; also a trap or a connected group of people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来捕捉或兜住东西的网；也可指圈套，或彼此联系的一群人所构成的网络。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett magħmul minn ħjut marbutin b'fetħiet bejniethom biex jaqbad jew iżomm affarijiet; ukoll nasba jew grupp ta' nies marbutin bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渔网；用来捕鱼的网。
网；由线绳等交织成、带有网眼的物件。
陷阱；圈套；用来诱捕或使人受困的安排。
网，例如渔网。
人际网络；由相互联系的人组成的群体。

formal.mt: L-għaqda ħolqot xibka ta' voluntiera biex tgħin lill-anzjani li jgħixu waħedhom.
formal.en: The organization created a network of volunteers to help elderly people who live alone.
formal.zh: 该组织建立了一个志愿者网络，帮助独居老人。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Għaliex il-ħut qed joħroġ mix-xibka? Marija: Hemm toqba fiha. Irridu nsewwuha qabel nerġgħu nużawha.
colloquial.en: Luca: Why are the fish getting out of the net? Marija: There is a hole in it. We need to mend it before using it again.
colloquial.zh: Luca：鱼为什么从网里跑出来了？Marija：网破了一个洞。我们得先补好，再拿来用。

messages.speaker: Luca (捕鱼初学者)
messages.zh: 鱼为什么从网里跑出来了？
messages.en: Why are the fish getting out of the net?

messages.speaker: Marija (渔民)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm toqba fiha. Irridu nsewwuha qabel nerġgħu nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm toqba fiha. Irridu nsewwuha qabel nerġgħu nużawha.
messages.zh: 网破了一个洞。我们得先补好，再拿来用。
messages.en: There is a hole in it. We need to mend it before using it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象一张有网眼的xibka：捕鱼时是渔网，困住人时是圈套，把彼此联系的人画成网状时就是人际网络。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To discourage or dissuade someone from doing something; also, to cause trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人打消做某事的念头或不敢继续；也可指制造麻烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jaqta' qalbu jew jibdel fehmtu dwar xi ħaġa; jista' jfisser ukoll li joħloq l-inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使却步；使因顾虑而不去做某事。
劝阻；使某人打消原有的打算。
惹麻烦；制造困扰或事端。

collocations.en: a price that deterred the buyer
noise that caused trouble for the neighbours
collocations.zh: 给邻居造成困扰的噪声

formal.mt: Il-prezz għoli xiegħeb lix-xerrej milli jkompli bin-negozjati.
formal.en: The high price deterred the buyer from continuing the negotiations.
formal.zh: 高昂的价格使买家却步，不再继续谈判。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma xtrajtx il-biljett? Mark: Il-prezz xiegħeb lili wkoll; kien għoli wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't you buy the ticket? Mark: The price put me off too; it was far too high.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么没买票？马克：价格也让我打了退堂鼓，实在太贵了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么没买票？
messages.en: Why didn't you buy the ticket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezz xiegħeb lili wkoll; kien għoli wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezz xiegħeb lili wkoll; kien għoli wisq.
messages.zh: 价格也让我打了退堂鼓，实在太贵了。
messages.en: The price put me off too; it was far too high.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“看到高价便退步”的画面里记忆：可表示使却步、劝阻；另用“噪声惹麻烦”单独记住第三义。

gloss_zh: 使后悔；使某人为某事懊悔

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel regret about something they did, chose, or experienced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人对自己做过、选择过或经历过的事情感到后悔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiddispjaċih għal xi ħaġa li għamel, għażel jew għadda minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使后悔；引起懊悔的感受。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause someone to regret something
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人为某件事情感到后悔。

collocations.en: a mistake that made the author feel regret

collocations.mt: kliem li xiegħef lil min qalu
collocations.en: words that made their speaker regret saying them
collocations.zh: 让说话者后悔说出口的话

formal.mt: L-iżball fir-rapport xiegħef lill-awtur, li mbagħad talab li ssir korrezzjoni.
formal.en: The mistake in the report made the author regret it, and he then requested a correction.
formal.zh: 报告中的错误使作者感到后悔，他随后要求作出更正。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kliem xiegħef lil Mark? Lara: Iva, issa jiddispjaċih li qal hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did those words make Mark regret saying them? Lara: Yes, now he's sorry he said that.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那些话让马克后悔说出口了吗？拉拉：是啊，他现在后悔那样说了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那些话让马克后悔说出口了吗？
messages.en: Did those words make Mark regret saying them?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jiddispjaċih li qal hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jiddispjaċih li qal hekk.
messages.zh: 是啊，他现在后悔那样说了。
messages.en: Yes, now he's sorry he said that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成一条因果链：“说错话或做错事→让人后悔”。重点是“使别人产生后悔”，而不只是描述后悔的心情。

gloss_zh: 点燃；转移；雇用；使忙于；使安静

teaching_sense.en_definition: To kindle a fire; in other senses, to divert, employ, keep someone occupied or distracted, or quieten someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 点燃火；其他义项包括转移、雇用、使某人忙于某事或分散其注意力，以及使其安静。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqabbad nar; f'tifsiriet oħra, ibiddel id-direzzjoni, jagħti xogħol, iżomm lil xi ħadd okkupat jew jaljenah, jew jikkalmah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点燃；使火开始燃烧。
转移；使方向或注意力转向别处。
雇用；给某人工作。
使忙于某事；分散注意力。
使安静下来；使平静。

collocations.en: kept the children occupied with a game
collocations.zh: 用游戏让孩子们有事可做

formal.mt: Il-gwida xiegħel in-nar biex il-grupp ikun jista' jissaħħan.
formal.en: The guide kindled the fire so that the group could warm up.
formal.zh: 向导点燃了火，让大家可以取暖。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif għaddew il-ħin it-tfal waqt li kienu qed jistennew? Mark: Pawlu xiegħel lit-tfal b'logħba, u l-ħin għadda malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the children pass the time while they were waiting? Mark: Pawlu kept them occupied with a game, and the time passed quickly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：孩子们等候时怎么打发时间的？马克：保罗带他们玩游戏，时间很快就过去了。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għaddew il-ħin it-tfal waqt li kienu qed jistennew?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għaddew il-ħin it-tfal waqt li kienu qed jistennew?
messages.zh: 孩子们等候时怎么打发时间的？
messages.en: How did the children pass the time while they were waiting?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu xiegħel lit-tfal b'logħba, u l-ħin għadda malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu xiegħel lit-tfal b'logħba, u l-ħin għadda malajr.
messages.zh: 保罗带他们玩游戏，时间很快就过去了。
messages.en: Pawlu kept the children occupied with a game, and the time passed quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用五张情境卡分别记：点火、转移、雇人、安排活动、安抚。每张卡配一个对象，避免把不同义项机械混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage a hard surface or object by chipping off a small piece or making a crack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使坚硬物体或表面崩掉一小块，或使其出现裂纹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqla' biċċa żgħira minn oġġett iebes jew jagħmel qasma fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使崩掉小块；使边缘出现缺口。
使开裂；使出现裂纹。

collocations.en: chipped the edge of the tile

formal.mt: Il-martell xiegħer it-tarf tal-maduma waqt ix-xogħol, għalhekk il-ħaddiem biddilha.
formal.en: The hammer chipped the edge of the tile during the work, so the worker replaced it.
formal.zh: 施工时，锤子碰缺了瓷砖的边缘，因此工人更换了这块瓷砖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-martell xiegħer din il-maduma? Pawlu: Iva, ara t-tarf: hemm biċċa żgħira nieqsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the hammer chip this tile? Pawlu: Yes, look at the edge: a small piece is missing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块瓷砖是被锤子碰缺的吗？保罗：是的，看边上，少了一小块。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 这块瓷砖是被锤子碰缺的吗？
messages.en: Did the hammer chip this tile?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara t-tarf: hemm biċċa żgħira nieqsa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara t-tarf: hemm biċċa żgħira nieqsa.
messages.zh: 是的，看边上，少了一小块。
messages.en: Yes, look at the edge: a small piece is missing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象瓷砖受撞后的两种结果：边上缺一小块是“崩缺”，表面出现一道线是“开裂”，两幅图一起记这个词。

gloss_zh: 不新鲜的；硬的；皮厚的；难嚼的；冷漠的；老旧的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something stale, hard, tough to chew, thick-skinned, or old; it can also describe an insensitive person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容东西不新鲜、坚硬、难嚼、皮厚或老旧；也可形容人对他人感受不敏感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li mhix friska, li hi iebsa, diffiċli biex tomgħodha, b'qoxra ħoxna jew qadima; jista' jiddeskrivi wkoll persuna bla sensittività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不新鲜的；放久了而失去新鲜口感的。
硬的；质地坚硬的。
皮厚的；有厚实外皮的。
韧硬难嚼的；不容易咀嚼的。
冷漠的；对别人的感受不敏感的。
老的；年久或陈旧的。

formal.mt: Il-ħobż kien xieref u iebes wisq biex jittiekel mingħajr ma jixxarrab.
formal.en: The bread was stale and too hard to eat without soaking it.
formal.zh: 面包已经不新鲜，而且太硬，需要浸软才能吃。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-laħam xieref; qed insibha diffiċli biex nomgħodu. Lara: Ħu biċċa oħra, din tidher aktar ratba.
colloquial.en: Mark: This meat is tough; I'm finding it hard to chew. Lara: Have another piece; this one looks softer.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这肉太硬了，我嚼着费劲。拉拉：换一块吧，这块看起来软一些。

messages.speaker: Mark (用餐者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-laħam xieref; qed insibha diffiċli biex nomgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-laħam xieref; qed insibha diffiċli biex nomgħodu.
messages.zh: 这肉太硬了，我嚼着费劲。
messages.en: This meat is tough; I'm finding it hard to chew.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu biċċa oħra, din tidher aktar ratba.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu biċċa oħra, din tidher aktar ratba.
messages.zh: 换一块吧，这块看起来软一些。
messages.en: Have another piece; this one looks softer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“旧面包变硬、肉难嚼”记住具体口感，再把“皮厚、冷漠、老旧”分别配图；这些是记忆分组，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An interrogative word meaning 'what?', used to ask for information or clarification.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“什么”的疑问词，用来询问信息或要求对方说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma interrogattiva li tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar xi ħaġa jew titlob kjarifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 什么；用于提出疑问或请求说明的疑问副词。
什么；指代所询问的事物，常用于介词之后。

formal.mt: Dwar xiex se ssir id-diskussjoni fil-laqgħa ta' għada?
formal.en: What will the discussion at tomorrow's meeting be about?
formal.zh: 明天会议上的讨论将围绕什么展开？

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex qed taqra? Mark: Qed naqra dwar l-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading about? Mark: I'm reading about birds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你正在读什么方面的内容？马克：我正在读关于鸟类的内容。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你正在读什么方面的内容？
messages.en: What are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我正在读关于鸟类的内容。
messages.en: I'm reading about birds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xiex 当作“什么”的问号卡：前面放 dwar 就问“关于什么”，放 b' 就问“用什么”，连同整个短语一起记。

gloss_zh: 锥子；鞋匠或填缝工用锥；反嘴鹬；角贝壳

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pointed tool used to pierce small holes, such as an awl used by a shoemaker or caulker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来刺出小孔的尖头工具，如鞋匠或填缝工使用的锥子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda bil-ponta li tintuża biex tagħmel toqob żgħar, bħal dik li juża skarpan jew ħaddiem li jagħlaq ix-xquq tad-dgħajjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锥子；用于刺孔的尖头工具。
鞋匠或船体填缝工使用的锥子。
反嘴鹬（学名 Recurvirostra avosetta）。

sense_translations.en_definition: tusk shell, especially of the genus Dentalium
sense_translations.zh_definition: 角贝壳；尤指角贝属（Dentalium）动物的贝壳。

collocations.en: pierce the leather with an awl

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża xifa biex jagħmel toqob żgħar fil-ġilda qabel ma beda jħit.
formal.en: The worker used an awl to make small holes in the leather before he began sewing.
formal.zh: 工人在开始缝制之前，用锥子在皮革上刺出小孔。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek xifa biex nagħmel toqba f'din iċ-ċintura? Mark: Iva, qiegħda fil-kaxxa tal-għodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have an awl so I can make a hole in this belt? Mark: Yes, it's in the toolbox.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有锥子吗？我想在这条腰带上打个孔。马克：有，在工具箱里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xifa biex nagħmel toqba f'din iċ-ċintura?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xifa biex nagħmel toqba f'din iċ-ċintura?
messages.zh: 你有锥子吗？我想在这条腰带上打个孔。
messages.en: Do you have an awl so I can make a hole in this belt?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，在工具箱里。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the toolbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 主画面记“锥子给皮带刺孔”；另做“反嘴鹬”和“角贝壳”两张独立词卡，避免把同形的动物名称误当工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The outermost edge or verge of something, including the sharp cutting edge of a tool such as a knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体最外侧的边缘或边沿；也指刀等切削工具锋利的刃口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti l-aktar fuq barra ta' xi ħaġa, jew il-parti li taqta' ta' għodda bħal sikkina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 边缘；物体外侧的边。
边沿；接近某处界限的边缘地带。

sense_translations.en_definition: sharp edge of a cutting implement such as a knife
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刀等切削工具的锋利刃口。
边缘；任何事物最外侧的部分。

collocations.en: the cutting edge of the knife
on the edge of the table

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, il-ħaddiem eżamina xifer is-sikkina biex jiżgura li kien jaqta' sew.
formal.en: Before use, the worker examined the knife's cutting edge to make sure it was sharp enough.
formal.zh: 使用前，工人检查了刀的刃口，确认其足够锋利。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tazza qiegħda fuq ix-xifer tal-mejda. Mark: Għandek raġun; se nressaqha lejn in-nofs biex ma taqax.
colloquial.en: Maja: The cup is on the edge of the table. Mark: You're right; I'll move it towards the middle so it doesn't fall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：杯子放在桌子边上了。马克：你说得对，我把它往中间挪，免得掉下去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 杯子放在桌子边上了。
messages.en: The cup is on the edge of the table.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; se nressaqha lejn in-nofs biex ma taqax.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; se nressaqha lejn in-nofs biex ma taqax.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我把它往中间挪，免得掉下去。
messages.en: You're right; I'll move it towards the middle so it doesn't fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 沿着桌子的最外沿画一条线，再沿刀刃画一条线：同一个“边”的概念，遇到桌子译边缘，遇到刀具译刃口。

gloss_zh: 冬天的；寒冬般的；适合冬季的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to winter, resembling winter weather, or suitable for use in winter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与冬季有关的、具有冬日寒冷特点的，或适合在冬季使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut max-xitwa, li jfakkar fit-temp tax-xitwa, jew adattat għall-użu fix-xitwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒冬般的；具有冬日寒冷气息的。
冬季的；与冬季有关的。
适合冬季的，例如适宜冬天穿着的衣物。

formal.mt: Minħabba t-temp xitwi, il-parteċipanti għandhom jilbsu ħwejjeġ sħan.
formal.en: Because of the wintry weather, participants should wear warm clothes.
formal.zh: 由于天气寒冷，具有冬日特点，参与者应穿着保暖衣物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum it-temp xitwi sew! Mark: Iva, ħu kowt qabel toħroġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: The weather is really wintry today! Mark: Yes, take a coat before you go out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天真有寒冬的感觉！马克：是啊，出门前带件大衣。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天真有寒冬的感觉！
messages.en: The weather is really wintry today!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，出门前带件大衣。
messages.en: Yes, take a coat before you go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把寒冷天气和厚冬衣放进同一幅冬日画面：xitwi既能描述冬日气候，也能说明衣物适合冬季。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to science or using methods based on observation, evidence, and testing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与科学有关的，或采用观察、证据和检验等科学方法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut max-xjenza jew ibbażat fuq metodi ta' osservazzjoni, ġbir ta' evidenza u ttestjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 科学的；与科学研究或科学方法有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju xjentifiku jqabbel ir-riżultati ta' żewġ esperimenti.
formal.en: The scientific study compares the results of two experiments.
formal.zh: 这项科学研究比较了两个实验的结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-artiklu hu xjentifiku? Pawlu: Iva, jispjega esperiment u jippreżenta r-riżultati.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a scientific article? Pawlu: Yes, it explains an experiment and presents the results.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是一篇科学文章吗？保罗：是的，它介绍了一个实验，并展示了结果。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这是一篇科学文章吗？
messages.en: Is this a scientific article?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jispjega esperiment u jippreżenta r-riżultati.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jispjega esperiment u jippreżenta r-riżultati.
messages.zh: 是的，它介绍了一个实验，并展示了结果。
messages.en: Yes, it explains an experiment and presents the results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把xjentifiku贴在实验报告旁边，联想观察、证据和检验；记住它是形容词，用来说明某事物具有科学性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The systematic study of the world through observation, evidence, and experiments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过观察、证据和实验等方式，有系统地研究世界的知识与活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju sistematiku tad-dinja permezz tal-osservazzjoni, l-evidenza u l-esperimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 科学；通过系统观察、研究和实验认识世界的知识体系与研究活动。

formal.mt: Il-mużew tax-xjenza joffri attivitajiet li jgħinu lit-tfal jifhmu l-esperimenti.
formal.en: The science museum offers activities that help children understand experiments.
formal.zh: 科学博物馆提供帮助儿童理解实验的活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tħobb ix-xjenza? Ben: Iva, speċjalment meta nagħmlu esperimenti fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like science? Ben: Yes, especially when we do experiments in class.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢科学吗？本：喜欢，尤其喜欢我们在课堂上做实验的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你喜欢科学吗？
messages.en: Do you like science?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta nagħmlu esperimenti fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta nagħmlu esperimenti fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其喜欢我们在课堂上做实验的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when we do experiments in class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象科学课堂上的实验台，用xjenza给整门学科命名；再与表示“科学的”的xjentifiku配对，区分名词和形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become older or show the effects of advancing age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随着年龄增长而变老，或逐渐显出年老的特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar anzjan jew jibda juri s-sinjali taż-żmien li għadda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变老；随着岁月流逝而逐渐衰老。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb xjieħ, iżda baqa' jikteb kuljum.
formal.en: The writer grew old, but continued to write every day.
formal.zh: 这位作家年纪大了，但仍然每天写作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: In-nannu xjieħ, imma għadu jħobb il-ġnien. Adam: Iva, ilbieraħ ħawwilna l-fjuri flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Grandpa has grown old, but he still loves the garden. Adam: Yes, yesterday we planted flowers together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：爷爷年纪大了，可他还是很喜欢花园。亚当：是啊，昨天我们还一起种花了。

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu xjieħ, imma għadu jħobb il-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu xjieħ, imma għadu jħobb il-ġnien.
messages.zh: 爷爷年纪大了，可他还是很喜欢花园。
messages.en: Grandpa has grown old, but he still loves the garden.

messages.speaker: Adam (孙子)
messages.zh: 是啊，昨天我们还一起种花了。
messages.en: Yes, yesterday we planted flowers together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把同一个人年轻与年老的照片连成时间线，箭头表示“变老”这一变化。词条xjieħ在例句中可表示“他变老了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The later stage of life when a person is old, or the condition of being old.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人生中年纪较大的阶段，或处于年老状态这一情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu tal-ħajja meta persuna tkun anzjana, jew il-qagħda ta' min ikun xjaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 老年；晚年；年老的状态。

formal.mt: L-appoġġ tal-familja jista' jagħmel differenza kbira fil-ħajja ta' persuna fix-xjuħija.
formal.en: Family support can make a great difference to a person's life in old age.
formal.zh: 家庭支持能对一个人的老年生活产生很大影响。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif tixtieq tqatta' x-xjuħija tiegħek? Ġużeppi: Qrib il-familja, b'ħafna ħin għall-qari.
colloquial.en: Marija: How would you like to spend your old age? Ġużeppi: Close to the family, with plenty of time for reading.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你希望怎样度过晚年？朱塞佩：住得离家人近些，还能有很多时间读书。

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.zh: 你希望怎样度过晚年？
messages.en: How would you like to spend your old age?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (丈夫)
messages.zh: 住得离家人近些，还能有很多时间读书。
messages.en: Close to the family, with plenty of time for reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人生时间轴的晚年部分写上xjuħija，记住它是阶段或状态的名词；与表示“变老”这一变化的动词xjieħ配对学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat board or surface on a wall or inside furniture used for holding objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装在墙上或家具内、用来放置物品的平板或搁板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bord jew wiċċ ċatt imwaħħal mal-ħajt jew ġewwa għamara biex jitqiegħdu oġġetti fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搁板；架板；用于放置书籍或其他物品的一层平板。

formal.mt: Il-kotba ta' referenza għandhom jitqiegħdu fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: The reference books should be placed on the shelf beside the window.
formal.zh: 参考书应放在窗边的搁板上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn poġġejt il-ktieb tiegħi? Lara: Fuq l-ixkaffa, ħdejn il-kaxxa l-ħamra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where did you put my book? Lara: On the shelf, beside the red box.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你把我的书放在哪里了？拉拉：在搁板上，红盒子旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 你把我的书放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put my book?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 在搁板上，红盒子旁边。
messages.en: On the shelf, beside the red box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一本书放到墙上的一块平板上，每放一次就说xkaffa；用具体的一层搁板来记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that blocks progress or makes an action or goal harder to achieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阻挡进展，或使某项行动、某个目标更难完成的事物或因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li twaqqaf il-progress jew tagħmel azzjoni jew għan aktar diffiċli biex jitwettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阻碍；妨碍行动或进展的因素。
妨碍；使事情难以顺利进行的人、事物或情况。
障碍；挡在前方或阻止目标实现的事物。
不利条件；限制能力、表现或成功机会的因素。
妨碍、障碍或阻碍；使行动或进展受阻的因素。

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' fondi huwa xkiel serju għat-twettiq tal-proġett.
formal.en: The lack of funds is a serious obstacle to carrying out the project.
formal.zh: 资金不足是实施这个项目的一大障碍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-kaxxa qed tkun ta' xkiel fil-bieb. Ben: Se nċaqlaqha biex tkun tista' tgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Sara: This box is getting in the way at the door. Ben: I'll move it so you can get through.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个箱子挡在门口了。本：我把它挪开，好让你过去。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kaxxa qed tkun ta' xkiel fil-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kaxxa qed tkun ta' xkiel fil-bieb.
messages.zh: 这个箱子挡在门口了。
messages.en: This box is getting in the way at the door.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nċaqlaqha biex tkun tista' tgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Se nċaqlaqha biex tkun tista' tgħaddi.
messages.zh: 我把它挪开，好让你过去。
messages.en: I'll move it so you can get through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把门口挡路的箱子想成xkiel，再把画面扩展到资金不足等抽象困难：凡是使进展受阻的因素，都可围绕“障碍”来理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large bag used to hold or carry goods; also a large, protruding belly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛装或搬运物品的大袋子；也可指明显隆起的大肚腩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża kbira biex jinżammu jew jinġarru oġġetti; tista' tfisser ukoll żaqq kbira u mqabbża 'l barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大袋；麻袋；用于盛装或搬运物品的袋子。
大袋子；袋；用于装物品的容器。
大肚腩；向外明显隆起的腹部。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem poġġa xkora dqiq fuq il-miżien qabel ħażinha fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The worker placed a sack of flour on the scales before storing it in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 工人把一大袋面粉放在秤上称重，然后将它存入库房。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tista' tgħinni nġorr din ix-xkora patata? Pawlu: Żgur, ejja nġorruha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you help me carry this sack of potatoes? Pawlu: Of course, let's carry it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你能帮我搬这袋土豆吗？保罗：当然，我们一起搬吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni nġorr din ix-xkora patata?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni nġorr din ix-xkora patata?
messages.zh: 你能帮我搬这袋土豆吗？
messages.en: Can you help me carry this sack of potatoes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 当然，我们一起搬吧。
messages.en: Of course, let's carry it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用装满土豆、鼓鼓的大袋子记住xkora的常见义，再以鼓起的轮廓联想“大肚腩”义；这只是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A firearm, especially a long-barrelled gun such as a rifle or shotgun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 枪械，尤其指步枪、猎枪等长枪管枪械。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma tan-nar, speċjalment waħda b'kanna twila, li tintuża għall-isparar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枪；枪械。
步枪。
枪；步枪。
霰弹枪；常用于狩猎的猎枪。

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri xkubetta antika flimkien ma' tagħrif dwar l-użu tagħha.
formal.en: The museum displays an old gun together with information about its use.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一支旧式枪械，并附有关于其用途的介绍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak wara l-ħġieġ? Mark: Dik xkubetta antika; ejja naqraw it-tabella.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that behind the glass? Mark: That's an old gun; let's read the label.
colloquial.zh: Maja：玻璃后面那是什么？Mark：那是一支旧式枪械，我们看看说明牌吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 玻璃后面那是什么？
messages.en: What's that behind the glass?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik xkubetta antika; ejja naqraw it-tabella.
messages.mt_standard: Dik xkubetta antika; ejja naqraw it-tabella.
messages.zh: 那是一支旧式枪械，我们看看说明牌吧。
messages.en: That's an old gun; let's read the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xkubetta 放进“博物馆里的长枪”画面中记忆，再用 xkubetta tal-kaċċa 联想到猎枪；具体枪种要结合语境判断。

gloss_zh: 扫帚；拖把；小扫刷；背信弃义的女人（贬义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cleaning tool with a handle and bristles or twigs, used for sweeping floors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扫帚，有柄和刷毛或枝条，用于清扫地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'manku u b'lanżit jew friegħi, li tintuża biex tinkines l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扫帚；用于扫地的清洁工具。
拖把；用于擦洗地面的清洁工具。
小扫刷；用于掸扫的轻便刷具。
背信弃义、阴险不可信的女人；属于贬义称呼。

formal.mt: Wara l-attività, il-voluntiera użaw xkupa biex neħħew it-trab u l-biċċiet tal-karti mill-art.
formal.en: After the activity, the volunteers used a broom to remove dust and scraps of paper from the floor.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，志愿者用扫帚清除了地上的灰尘和纸屑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-ixkupa? Hemm ħafna trab hawn. Pawlu: Wara l-bieb; se nġibhielek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's the broom? There's a lot of dust here. Pawlu: Behind the door; I'll get it for you.
colloquial.zh: Lara：扫帚在哪里？这里灰尘好多。Pawlu：在门后面，我给你拿来。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-ixkupa? Hemm ħafna trab hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-ixkupa? Hemm ħafna trab hawn.
messages.zh: 扫帚在哪里？这里灰尘好多。
messages.en: Where's the broom? There's a lot of dust here.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在门后面，我给你拿来。
messages.en: Behind the door; I'll get it for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门后放着一把 xkupa，需要扫地时就拿出来。先用清洁场景记住基本义，指人的贬义用法另作辨认。

gloss_zh: 刷子；小扫刷；用刷子刷掉

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with bristles used for cleaning, grooming, or brushing a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刷子，带有刷毛，用于清洁、梳理或刷拭物体表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'lanżit li tintuża biex tnaddaf, tirranġa x-xagħar jew togħrok wiċċ ta' oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刷子；用于清洁、梳理或刷拭的工具。
小扫刷；用于掸扫的轻便刷具。

sense_translations.en_definition: to brush off (to remove with a brush)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用刷子刷掉、刷除；指清除灰尘等附着物。

formal.mt: Għat-tindif ta' dan il-wiċċ, uża xkupilja ratba biex tneħħi t-trab.
formal.en: To clean this surface, use a soft brush to remove the dust.
formal.zh: 清洁此表面时，请使用软毛刷清除灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek xkupilja għaż-żraben? Tumas: Iva, hawn waħda; tista' tużaha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a shoe brush? Tumas: Yes, here's one; you can use it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你有鞋刷吗？Tumas：有，这里有一把，你可以用。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 你有鞋刷吗？
messages.en: Do you have a shoe brush?

messages.speaker: Tumas (家人)
messages.zh: 有，这里有一把，你可以用。
messages.en: Yes, here's one; you can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xkupilja 与“刷子刷掉鞋上灰尘”的动作连起来记：名词是工具，动词义是用刷子清除，两种词性分开辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small brush used to clean the teeth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牙刷，用于清洁牙齿的小刷子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xkupilja żgħira li tintuża biex jitnaddfu s-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牙刷；刷牙时使用的清洁工具。

formal.mt: Il-lista għall-vjaġġ tinkludi xkupilja tas-snien, pejst tas-snien u xugaman żgħir.
formal.en: The travel checklist includes a toothbrush, toothpaste, and a small towel.
formal.zh: 旅行物品清单包括牙刷、牙膏和一条小毛巾。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Insejt ix-xkupilja tas-snien id-dar. Mark: Għandi waħda ġdida fil-pakkett; tista' teħodha.
colloquial.en: Sara: I left my toothbrush at home. Mark: I have a new one in its packaging; you can have it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我把牙刷忘在家里了。Mark：我有一支还在包装里的新牙刷，给你用吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅行同伴)
messages.zh: 我把牙刷忘在家里了。
messages.en: I left my toothbrush at home.

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi waħda ġdida fil-pakkett; tista' teħodha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi waħda ġdida fil-pakkett; tista' teħodha.
messages.zh: 我有一支还在包装里的新牙刷，给你用吧。
messages.en: I have a new one in its packaging; you can have it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“刷子＋牙齿”理解整个短语：xkupilja 是刷子，snien 是牙齿。想到洗漱杯里的牙刷，就复习 xkupilja tas-snien。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brush used to smooth, detangle, or arrange the hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发刷，用来梳顺、解开发结或整理头发的刷子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xkupilja li tintuża biex jitneħħew l-għoqiedi mix-xagħar u biex jiġi rranġat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发刷；用来梳理头发的刷子。

formal.mt: Wara l-użu, neħħi x-xagħar li jkun baqa' fix-xkupilja tax-xagħar.
formal.en: After use, remove any hair left in the hairbrush.
formal.zh: 使用后，请清除留在发刷中的头发。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt ix-xkupilja tax-xagħar tiegħi? Nina: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-mera fil-kamra tal-banju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you seen my hairbrush? Nina: Yes, it's beside the mirror in the bathroom.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到我的发刷了吗？Nina：看到了，在浴室镜子旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐妹)
messages.zh: 你看到我的发刷了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my hairbrush?

messages.speaker: Nina (姐妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-mera fil-kamra tal-banju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-mera fil-kamra tal-banju.
messages.zh: 看到了，在浴室镜子旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's beside the mirror in the bathroom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜子、头发和发刷放在同一幅画面里：xagħar 是头发，xkupilja tax-xagħar 就是梳理头发的刷子，可与牙刷短语对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin, strong line used for fishing, or nylon thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钓鱼用的细而结实的线，也可指尼龙线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajt irqiq u b'saħħtu li jintuża għas-sajd, jew ħajt tan-najlon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钓鱼线；用于连接鱼钩等钓具的线。
尼龙线；以尼龙制成的细线。

formal.mt: Qabel is-sajd, iċċekkja li ma jkunx hemm għoqiedi fix-xlief.
formal.en: Before fishing, check that there are no knots in the fishing line.
formal.zh: 钓鱼前，请检查钓鱼线是否有打结的地方。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għandek roll xlief ieħor? Tumas: Iva, fil-borża; ħudu minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Do you have another spool of fishing line? Tumas: Yes, in the bag; take it from there.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：你还有一卷钓鱼线吗？Tumas：有，在包里，从那里拿吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (钓友)
messages.zh: 你还有一卷钓鱼线吗？
messages.en: Do you have another spool of fishing line?

messages.speaker: Tumas (钓友)
messages.zh: 有，在包里，从那里拿吧。
messages.en: Yes, in the bag; take it from there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从线轴拉出一段透明细线，再把它接到鱼钩上；用 roll xlief 记“一卷鱼线”，用 biċċa xlief 记“一段鱼线”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The direction halfway between south and east; also a wind blowing from that direction, especially a hot sirocco.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 东南，即正南与正东之间的方向；也指来自该方向的风，尤其是炎热的东南风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-direzzjoni bejn in-nofsinhar u l-lvant; ukoll ir-riħ li jiġi minn dik id-direzzjoni, speċjalment meta jkun sħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 东南；正南与正东之间的方向。
西洛可风；炎热的东南风。
东南风；从东南方向吹来的风。
西洛可风；炎热的东南风。
东南方；东南方向或东南部。

formal.mt: Fuq il-mappa, ix-xlokk jinsab bejn in-nofsinhar u l-lvant.
formal.en: On the map, southeast lies between south and east.
formal.zh: 在地图上，东南方位于正南与正东之间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġej ir-riħ illum? Mark: Mix-xlokk; qed jidħol mill-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the wind coming from today? Mark: From the southeast; it's coming in from the sea.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天的风是从哪里吹来的？Mark：从东南方，正从海上吹过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天的风是从哪里吹来的？
messages.en: Where is the wind coming from today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 从东南方，正从海上吹过来。
messages.en: From the southeast; it's coming in from the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先在上北下南的地图上找到右下方，把 xlokk 放在那里；再画一支从东南吹来的箭头，同时记住方向义和风名义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A natural flow of water that follows a channel through the land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 河流，沿着陆地上的天然河道流动的水体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kurrent naturali ta' ilma li jgħaddi f'kanal fl-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 河；沿天然河道流动的河流。

formal.mt: Il-pont il-ġdid jippermetti lir-residenti jaqsmu x-xmara bil-mixi.
formal.en: The new bridge allows residents to cross the river on foot.
formal.zh: 新桥让居民可以步行过河。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se naqsmu x-xmara? Pawlu: Hemm pont ftit aktar 'il quddiem; ejja nimxu sa hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: How are we going to cross the river? Pawlu: There's a bridge a little further ahead; let's walk there.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们怎么过河？Pawlu：再往前一点有座桥，我们走到那里吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (步行同伴)
messages.zh: 我们怎么过河？
messages.en: How are we going to cross the river?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (步行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm pont ftit aktar 'il quddiem; ejja nimxu sa hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm pont ftit aktar 'il quddiem; ejja nimxu sa hemm.
messages.zh: 再往前一点有座桥，我们走到那里吧。
messages.en: There's a bridge a little further ahead; let's walk there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条 xmara 从桥下流过：站在旁边是 xatt ix-xmara，走到对岸是 taqsam ix-xmara，用河岸和过河两个画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The direction north, or the northern part of an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 北这一方向，也可指某一地区的北部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-direzzjoni tat-tramuntana jew il-parti tat-tramuntana ta' żona.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 北；北方这一方向。
北方；某一地区的北部。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġaturi komplew mexjin lejn ix-xmiel sakemm waslu ħdejn il-baħar.
formal.en: The travellers continued walking north until they reached the sea.
formal.zh: 旅人们继续向北走，直到来到海边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lejn fejn sejrin issa? Mark: Lejn ix-xmiel, imbagħad induru lejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which way are we going now? Mark: North, then we turn towards the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们现在往哪个方向走？马克：向北，然后转向海边。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 我们现在往哪个方向走？
messages.en: Which way are we going now?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lejn ix-xmiel, imbagħad induru lejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Lejn ix-xmiel, imbagħad induru lejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 向北，然后转向海边。
messages.en: North, then we turn towards the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上把 xmiel 写在向上的北向箭头旁，再配着 lejn ix-xmiel 练习说“向北”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male personal name, Xmun, corresponding to Simon in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男子人名 Xmun，对应英语 Simon，通常译作“西蒙”；相关经文语境也可译作“西默盎”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-isem Simon bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西默盎？或指圣者？（路加福音2:25；原释义带有疑问，所指未定。）

sense_translations.en_definition: a male given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English Simon
sense_translations.zh_definition: 男子名，相当于英语 Simon（西蒙）；所给释义将其来源依次追溯至西西里语、拉丁语、古希腊语和希伯来语。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tal-iskola, l-istudent huwa mniżżel bl-isem Xmun.
formal.en: In the school register, the student is listed under the name Xmun.
formal.zh: 在学校名册上，这名学生登记的名字是西蒙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu ħuk? Lara: Jismu Xmun, u llum ġej magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is your brother's name? Lara: His name is Xmun, and he is coming with us today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你兄弟叫什么名字？拉拉：他叫西蒙，今天会跟我们一起去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟叫什么名字？
messages.en: What is your brother's name?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Xmun, u llum ġej magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Xmun, u llum ġej magħna.
messages.zh: 他叫西蒙，今天会跟我们一起去。
messages.en: His name is Xmun, and he is coming with us today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Xmun 放进人物名牌里，与英语 Simon 对照记忆；作为人名书写时保留大写 X。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unverified story passed between people, often concerning someone's private life or a scandal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在人们之间传播、尚未证实的说法，常涉及他人私生活或丑闻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Storja mhux ikkonfermata li tgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra, spiss dwar il-ħajja privata ta' xi ħadd jew dwar skandlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传闻；流言。
丑闻；引起公众非议的事情。
未经证实而流传的消息；谣传。
关于他人私事的闲话；流言蜚语。

formal.mt: L-iskola ċaħdet ix-xniegħa li l-lezzjonijiet kienu se jitwaqqfu.
formal.en: The school denied the rumour that lessons were going to be suspended.
formal.zh: 学校否认了即将停课的传闻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt li l-ħanut se jagħlaq? Mark: Smajtha wkoll, imma s'issa hija biss xniegħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you heard that the shop is going to close? Mark: I heard that too, but so far it is only a rumour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听说那家店要关门了吗？马克：我也听说了，不过目前还只是传闻。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听说那家店要关门了吗？
messages.en: Have you heard that the shop is going to close?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajtha wkoll, imma s'issa hija biss xniegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Smajtha wkoll, imma s'issa hija biss xniegħa.
messages.zh: 我也听说了，不过目前还只是传闻。
messages.en: I heard that too, but so far it is only a rumour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句未经证实的话在人群中传来传去，把 xniegħa 和“先求证，再转述”的场景一起记住。

gloss_zh: 嘴唇；器皿口沿；边缘；兽吻

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lip of the mouth, or the rim or edge around the opening of a vessel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嘴部的一片嘴唇，也可指器皿开口周围的口沿或边缘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ partijiet li jdawru l-fetħa tal-ħalq, jew it-tarf madwar il-fetħa ta' reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘴唇；上唇或下唇。

sense_translations.en_definition: edge of a hollow vessel or container
sense_translations.zh_definition: 中空器皿或容器的口沿。
边沿；边缘。
动物的吻部；突出的口鼻部。

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, iċċekkja li x-xoffa tat-tazza ma tkunx miksura.
formal.en: Before use, check that the rim of the cup is not chipped or broken.
formal.zh: 使用前，请检查杯沿是否有缺口或破损。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tixrobx minn dik it-tazza? Mark: Għandha x-xoffa miksura; se nieħu oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why aren't you drinking from that cup? Mark: Its rim is broken; I'll get another one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么不用那个杯子喝水？马克：它的杯沿破了，我去拿另一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tixrobx minn dik it-tazza?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tixrobx minn dik it-tazza?
messages.zh: 你怎么不用那个杯子喝水？
messages.en: Why aren't you drinking from that cup?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha x-xoffa miksura; se nieħu oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha x-xoffa miksura; se nieħu oħra.
messages.zh: 它的杯沿破了，我去拿另一个。
messages.en: Its rim is broken; I'll get another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人的嘴唇和杯子的口沿画在一起，用“围着开口的一圈”联想 xoffa 的两个常见教学义。

gloss_zh: 懊悔；令人后悔的痛苦经历

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of regret, or a bitter experience that leaves someone feeling regretful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 懊悔的感受，也可指使人产生懊悔的痛苦经历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa li ġrat jew saret, jew esperjenza qarsa li tqanqal dan is-sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懊悔；遗憾。（阴性名词。）

sense_translations.en_definition: a bitter experience that causes regret
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人后悔的痛苦经历；令人懊悔的苦涩遭遇。

formal.mt: It-telf ta' dik l-opportunità ħalla xogħfa kbira f'qalbu.
formal.en: The loss of that opportunity left him with deep regret.
formal.zh: 错失那次机会，在他心中留下了深深的遗憾。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek taħseb f'dik id-deċiżjoni? Pawlu: Iva, għad għandi xogħfa kbira għax ma aċċettajtx l-offerta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you still think about that decision? Pawlu: Yes, I still feel deep regret because I didn't accept the offer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你还在想着那个决定吗？保罗：是啊，我没接受那个提议，到现在还很后悔。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在想着那个决定吗？
messages.en: Do you still think about that decision?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għad għandi xogħfa kbira għax ma aċċettajtx l-offerta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għad għandi xogħfa kbira għax ma aċċettajtx l-offerta.
messages.zh: 是啊，我没接受那个提议，到现在还很后悔。
messages.en: Yes, I still feel deep regret because I didn't accept the offer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xogħfa 记成心里留下的一份“懊悔”，再用 xogħfa kbira 记住阴性名词与形容词的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel regret or sorrow about something that happened or something one did.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对发生的事情或自己的行为感到后悔、懊悔或难过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass dispjaċir jew niket għal xi ħaġa li ġrat jew li għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 后悔；对某事感到懊悔。
感到难过、遗憾或过意不去。

collocations.zh: 他感到过意不去，并道了歉

formal.mt: Wara li fehem il-konsegwenzi tad-deċiżjoni tiegħu, Pawlu xogħof għal dak li għamel.
formal.en: After understanding the consequences of his decision, Pawlu regretted what he had done.
formal.zh: 明白自己的决定造成了什么后果后，保罗对自己的所作所为感到后悔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħassu Pawlu wara li qal dak il-kliem? Mark: Xogħof, u mar jitlob skuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu feel after saying those words? Mark: He felt sorry and went to apologise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗说了那些话以后是什么感受？马克：他很过意不去，就去道歉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassu Pawlu wara li qal dak il-kliem?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassu Pawlu wara li qal dak il-kliem?
messages.zh: 保罗说了那些话以后是什么感受？
messages.en: How did Pawlu feel after saying those words?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他很过意不去，就去道歉了。
messages.en: He felt sorry and went to apologise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他说错话，后来后悔了”的连续画面记 xogħof；把它放在人物主语后，记住这里学的是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden strong emotional or physical reaction caused by an unexpected event, impact, or electric current.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因意外事件、撞击或电流而产生的突然且强烈的心理或身体反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reazzjoni qawwija u f'daqqa għal ġrajja mhux mistennija, daqqa jew kurrent elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 震惊；冲击；电击，具体含义由语境决定。

formal.mt: L-aħbar tal-għeluq tal-fabbrika kienet xokk kbir għall-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The news of the factory's closure was a great shock to the workers.
formal.zh: 工厂关闭的消息令工人们深感震惊。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kont taf li l-ħanut għalaq? Mark: Le! Din l-aħbar kienet xokk għalija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you know that the shop closed? Mark: No! That news came as a shock to me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你知道那家店关门了吗？马克：不知道！这个消息让我很震惊。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你知道那家店关门了吗？
messages.en: Did you know that the shop closed?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le! Din l-aħbar kienet xokk għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Le! Din l-aħbar kienet xokk għalija.
messages.zh: 不知道！这个消息让我很震惊。
messages.en: No! That news came as a shock to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xokk 配上突然睁大眼睛的表情记“震惊”，再加一个闪电图标记住 xokk elettriku“电击”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cloth or fabric, including linen, used for making or covering things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来制作物品或覆盖物体的布、布料，也可特指亚麻布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp li jintuża biex isiru jew jitgħattew affarijiet, u li jista' jkun magħmul mill-għażel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布；布料。
亚麻布；亚麻织物。

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata għażlet xoqqa bajda biex tagħmel il-purtieri tal-kamra.
formal.en: The seamstress chose white cloth to make the curtains for the room.
formal.zh: 裁缝选了白布来制作房间的窗帘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek biċċa xoqqa biex ngħatti din il-kaxxa? Lara: Iva, ħu din il-biċċa bajda; hija kbira biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a piece of cloth I can use to cover this box? Lara: Yes, take this white piece; it is big enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有块布可以让我盖住这个盒子吗？拉拉：有，拿这块白的吧，够大了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek biċċa xoqqa biex ngħatti din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek biċċa xoqqa biex ngħatti din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你有块布可以让我盖住这个盒子吗？
messages.en: Do you have a piece of cloth I can use to cover this box?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din il-biċċa bajda; hija kbira biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din il-biċċa bajda; hija kbira biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 有，拿这块白的吧，够大了。
messages.en: Yes, take this white piece; it is big enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裁缝展开一块白布，把 xoqqa 与 biċċa xoqqa“一块布”一起记；遇到具体材质语境再理解为亚麻布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Drinks or beverages; also the act of drinking, or alcoholic drinks in particular.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人饮用的饮料；也可指喝东西这一行为，或专指酒类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidi li wieħed jixrob; ukoll l-att li wieħed jixrob, jew b'mod partikolari xorb alkoħoliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饮料。
饮用；喝东西这一行为。
酒；含酒精的饮料。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa se jkun hemm ilma u xorb ieħor għall-parteċipanti.
formal.en: Water and other drinks will be available for participants during the meeting.
formal.zh: 会议期间将为与会者提供水及其他饮料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ġibt xi xorb għall-festa? Mark: Iva, ġibt ilma u meraq tal-larinġ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you bring any drinks for the party? Mark: Yes, I brought water and orange juice.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你给聚会带饮料了吗？马克：带了，我带了水和橙汁。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xorb 放在聚会饮料桌的画面里记：桌上各种饮料统称 xorb，加上 alkoħoliku 就明确指酒精饮料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The liquid left when milk separates into curds during cheese making.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作奶酪时，牛奶凝结成凝乳后分离出来的液体，即乳清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-likwidu li jifred mill-baqta meta l-ħalib jinqata' waqt il-produzzjoni tal-ġobon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳清，即牛奶凝结后与凝乳分离的液体。
乳清；酪乳。

formal.mt: Ix-xorrox jinġabar separatament mill-baqta waqt il-produzzjoni tal-ġobon.
formal.en: The whey is collected separately from the curds during cheese making.
formal.zh: 制作奶酪时，乳清与凝乳分开收集。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan il-likwidu li baqa' mill-ħalib? Pawlu: Dan hu xorrox; tista' tużah biex tagħmel il-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this liquid left from the milk? Pawlu: This is whey; you can use it to make bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：牛奶剩下的这种液体是什么？保罗：这是乳清，你可以用它做面包。

messages.speaker: Maja (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan il-likwidu li baqa' mill-ħalib?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan il-likwidu li baqa' mill-ħalib?
messages.zh: 牛奶剩下的这种液体是什么？
messages.en: What is this liquid left from the milk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu xorrox; tista' tużah biex tagħmel il-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu xorrox; tista' tużah biex tagħmel il-ħobż.
messages.zh: 这是乳清，你可以用它做面包。
messages.en: This is whey; you can use it to make bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象奶酪制作时分成两部分：凝成块的是凝乳，旁边分离出的液体是 xorrox，用这个画面记住乳清。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kind or sort of something, grouped by shared characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种事物的种类或类别，表示具有共同特点的一类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip jew kategorija ta' affarijiet li għandhom karatteristiċi komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种类；类别。
仍然；尽管如此还是。
同样地；照样。
种类；类型。
仍然；尽管如此；照样。

formal.mt: Din ix-xorta ta' karta tintuża għall-istampar ta' dokumenti uffiċjali.
formal.en: This kind of paper is used for printing official documents.
formal.zh: 这种纸用于印制正式文件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Se mmorru xorta? Toni: Iva, immorru xorta waħda; nieħdu umbrella.
colloquial.en: Lara: It's raining. Are we still going? Toni: Yes, we'll go anyway; we'll take an umbrella.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：下雨了。我们还去吗？托尼：去，我们照样去，带把伞。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Se mmorru xorta?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Se mmorru xorta?

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅场景记 xorta：挑面包时问种类，遇到下雨还出门时说照样去；前者是名词，后者是副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Luck or fortune affecting what happens to someone; also their fate or destiny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 影响一个人遭遇的运气或际遇；也可指命运。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xorti tajba jew ħażina li tolqot lil xi ħadd, jew id-destin tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 命运；一个人被认为注定会经历的人生道路。
命运；被认为无法避免的遭遇或结局。
运势；际遇；命运。
运气。

formal.mt: Is-suċċess tal-proġett jiddependi fuq ippjanar tajjeb u mhux biss fuq ix-xorti.
formal.en: The project's success depends on good planning and not only on luck.
formal.zh: 项目的成功取决于良好的规划，而不只是运气。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi eżami għada u ninsab nervuża. Sara: Xorti tajba! Int studjajt ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: I have an exam tomorrow and I'm nervous. Sara: Good luck! You've studied a lot.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我明天有考试，心里很紧张。萨拉：祝你好运！你已经学了很多。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi eżami għada u ninsab nervuża.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi eżami għada u ninsab nervuża.
messages.zh: 我明天有考试，心里很紧张。
messages.en: I have an exam tomorrow and I'm nervous.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 祝你好运！你已经学了很多。
messages.en: Good luck! You've studied a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xorti 记成考前朋友送来的好运祝福：xorti tajba 是好运，xorti ħażina 是坏运气，谈人生时还可表示命运。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Short trousers, usually worn in warm weather, that end at or above the knees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常在暖和天气穿、裤腿到膝部或膝部以上的短裤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qliezet qosra li jaslu sa l-irkopptejn jew aktar 'il fuq, u li jintlibsu l-aktar fis-sajf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短裤。

sense_translations.en_definition: shorts (pants worn primarily in the summer that do not go lower than the knees)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 短裤，主要在夏季穿着，裤腿不超过膝部。

formal.mt: Għall-attività sportiva, kull parteċipant għandu jġib par xorz u żraben adattati.
formal.en: For the sports activity, each participant should bring a pair of shorts and suitable shoes.
formal.zh: 参加这项体育活动时，每位参与者应携带一条短裤和合适的鞋子。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se tilbes għall-mixja? Lara: Se nilbes xorz u flokk, għax illum sħun.
colloquial.en: Mark: What are you going to wear for the walk? Lara: I'll wear shorts and a T-shirt because it's hot today.
colloquial.zh: 马克：散步你打算穿什么？拉拉：我会穿短裤和T恤，因为今天很热。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.zh: 我会穿短裤和T恤，因为今天很热。
messages.en: I'll wear shorts and a T-shirt because it's hot today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用夏日穿衣画面记 xorz：上身是T恤，下身是露出小腿的短裤；连着 par xorz 一起记，表示一条短裤。

gloss_zh: 干的；少量的；简短生硬的；射门

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dry, with little or no moisture; also scant, or brief and abrupt in manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 干的，缺少水分的；也可形容数量少，或说话简短而生硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla ilma jew umdità, jew bi ftit minnhom; ukoll skars, jew qasir u nieqes mill-kordjalità fil-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干的；干燥的。
少量的；不足的。
简短生硬的；语气冷淡的。
简短生硬的；简短的。

sense_translations.en_definition: shot (launching of a ball or similar object toward a goal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 射门；将球或类似物体射向球门的动作。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu jinżamm f'post xott sakemm jibda l-eżami.
formal.en: The sample should be kept in a dry place until the examination begins.
formal.zh: 样品应存放在干燥处，直至检查开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ix-xugaman għadu mxarrab? Toni: Le, issa xott; tista' tużah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this towel still wet? Toni: No, it's dry now; you can use it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条毛巾还湿着吗？托尼：不，现在干了，你可以用了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这条毛巾还湿着吗？
messages.en: Is this towel still wet?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 不，现在干了，你可以用了。
messages.en: No, it's dry now; you can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用晾干的毛巾记 xott 的干燥义，再用干巴巴的语气联想简短生硬义；足球语境里的名词射门义单独记。

gloss_zh: 变得不新鲜；变硬；衰老；变得冷酷

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose freshness or become tough; also to grow old, become less kind, or develop a thick skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去新鲜度或变硬；也可指变老、变得不友善，或对批评和打击变得不敏感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-freskezza jew isir iebes; ukoll jixjieħ, isir inqas ġentili, jew jitgħallem ma jintlaqatx faċilment mill-kritika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得不新鲜；失去原有的新鲜状态。
变得不易因批评或冒犯而受伤；变得不敏感。
变得不友善；变得刻薄。
蔬菜、肉类等失去新鲜度。
变硬，通常指肉质变硬。
变老；衰老。
变得刻薄、粗暴或残酷。
逐渐变得不易受批评或打击影响；练就厚脸皮。

collocations.en: the meat lost its freshness or became tough
collocations.zh: 肉失去了新鲜度或变硬了
他随着时间推移变老了

formal.mt: Il-laħam xraf waqt il-ħażna u ma baqax frisk.
formal.en: The meat lost its freshness during storage and was no longer fresh.
formal.zh: 肉在储存期间失去了新鲜度，已不再新鲜。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-laħam għadu frisk? Mark: Le, xraf u sar iebes; nużaw laħam frisk għall-ikla.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this meat still fresh? Mark: No, it has lost its freshness and become tough; we'll use fresh meat for the meal.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块肉还新鲜吗？马克：不，已经不新鲜，也变硬了；这顿饭我们用新鲜的肉。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 这块肉还新鲜吗？
messages.en: Is this meat still fresh?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, xraf u sar iebes; nużaw laħam frisk għall-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Le, xraf u sar iebes; nużaw laħam frisk għall-ikla.
messages.zh: 不，已经不新鲜，也变硬了；这顿饭我们用新鲜的肉。
messages.en: No, it has lost its freshness and become tough; we'll use fresh meat for the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面串记 xraf：食物失去鲜嫩，人逐渐衰老或内心变硬。这只是记忆联想，具体含义仍要看食物或人物语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who shares an activity, project, or business with another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人共同参与活动、项目或经营业务的人，即伙伴或合伙人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu sehem ma' oħra f'attività, fi proġett jew f'negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伙伴；共同参与某事的人；合伙人。

formal.mt: Kull xrik għandu japprova l-ftehim qabel ma jiġi ffirmat.
formal.en: Each partner must approve the agreement before it is signed.
formal.zh: 协议签署前，每位合伙人都必须表示同意。

colloquial.en: Nina: Who is your partner in the shop? Toni: Pawlu. He handles sales and I handle the accounts.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：和你合伙开店的是谁？托尼：保罗。他负责销售，我负责账目。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 和你合伙开店的是谁？
messages.en: Who is your partner in the shop?

messages.speaker: Toni (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu. Hu jieħu ħsieb il-bejgħ u jien nieħu ħsieb il-kontijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu. Hu jieħu ħsieb il-bejgħ u jien nieħu ħsieb il-kontijiet.
messages.zh: 保罗。他负责销售，我负责账目。
messages.en: Pawlu. He handles sales and I handle the accounts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人共同开店，一个管销售，一个管账目：一起承担工作的人就是 xrik，把它和合伙人的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hair on a person's head, especially when it is long.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人头上的头发，尤其指较长的头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xagħar tar-ras ta' persuna, speċjalment meta jkun twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头发。

sense_translations.en_definition: the hair of the head, especially when long
sense_translations.zh_definition: 头上的头发，尤其指长头发。

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija, it-tifla tidher b'xuxa twila li taslilha sa spallejha.
formal.en: In the drawing, the girl is shown with long hair reaching her shoulders.
formal.zh: 画中的女孩留着长头发，发梢垂到肩膀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iddum quddiem il-mera? Lara: Għandi xuxa mħabbla u qed nipprova nirranġaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you taking so long in front of the mirror? Lara: My hair is tangled, and I'm trying to tidy it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么在镜子前待这么久？拉拉：我的头发打结了，我正试着把它理顺。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么在镜子前待这么久？
messages.en: Why are you taking so long in front of the mirror?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi xuxa mħabbla u qed nipprova nirranġaha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi xuxa mħabbla u qed nipprova nirranġaha.
messages.zh: 我的头发打结了，我正试着把它理顺。
messages.en: My hair is tangled, and I'm trying to tidy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 xuxa，就想象一头垂到肩膀的长发；把 xuxa twila 和“长头发”一起记，突出它指头上的头发。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To climb onto or up something, or to peer over an edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 攀上或爬上某物；也可指探头越过边缘向另一侧看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitla' billi juża jdejh u saqajh, jew jittawwal minn fuq xi tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 攀爬；爬上。
探头越过边缘向外或向另一侧看。

collocations.mt: xxabbat biex jara minn fuq il-ħajt
collocations.en: climbed up to see over the wall

formal.mt: It-tifel xxabbat ma' siġra biex jara aħjar il-bejta bejn il-friegħi.
formal.en: The boy climbed a tree to get a better view of the nest among the branches.
formal.zh: 男孩爬上了一棵树，以便更清楚地看见枝丫间的鸟巢。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ra Mark x'kien hemm wara l-ħajt? Luqa: Xxabbat fuq il-kaxxa u ttawwal minn fuq il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark see what was behind the wall? Luqa: He climbed onto the box and peered over the wall.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克怎么看到墙后面有什么的？卢卡：他爬上箱子，探头越过墙头看了看。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ra Mark x'kien hemm wara l-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ra Mark x'kien hemm wara l-ħajt?
messages.zh: 马克怎么看到墙后面有什么的？
messages.en: How did Mark see what was behind the wall?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxabbat fuq il-kaxxa u ttawwal minn fuq il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Xxabbat fuq il-kaxxa u ttawwal minn fuq il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 他爬上箱子，探头越过墙头看了看。
messages.en: He climbed onto the box and peered over the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先爬上箱子，再探头看墙外”的连续画面记 xxabbat，把“攀爬”和“越过边缘看”两个义项联系起来。

gloss_zh: 尽情玩乐；玩得十分开心；纵情享受

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enjoy oneself thoroughly or indulge in pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尽情享受、玩得非常开心；也可带有纵情享乐的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeverti ħafna u jgawdi l-pjaċiri bis-sħiħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩得很开心；度过非常愉快的时光。
尽情享受；玩个痛快。
纵情享乐；尽情满足自己对快乐和享受的追求。

collocations.en: had a great time at the feast
collocations.zh: 在庆典上玩得十分开心

formal.mt: Matul iċ-ċelebrazzjoni, Pawlu xxala mal-ħbieb tiegħu u gawda l-mużika sa tard billejl.
formal.en: During the celebration, Pawlu had a great time with his friends and enjoyed the music until late at night.
formal.zh: 庆祝活动期间，保罗和朋友们玩得非常开心，一直欣赏音乐到深夜。
