colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark get on at the party yesterday? Maja: He had a fantastic time! He danced and laughed all evening.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克昨天在聚会上玩得怎么样？玛雅：他玩得可痛快了！整个晚上都在跳舞、说笑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克昨天在聚会上玩得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark get on at the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxala! Żifen u daħak il-lejla kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Xxala! Żifen u daħak il-lejla kollha.
messages.zh: 他玩得可痛快了！整个晚上都在跳舞、说笑。
messages.en: He had a fantastic time! He danced and laughed all evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxala 放进一场音乐、跳舞和笑声不断的聚会，记住它比普通的“开心”更强调尽兴；有些语境还带纵情享乐之意。

gloss_zh: 弄湿；淋湿；湿透；产生性兴奋

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get wet or become soaked; in a sexual sense, to become aroused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变湿、被淋湿或湿透；在性语境中也可表示产生性兴奋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imxarrab jew jixxarrab għalkollox; f'sens sesswali, jitqanqal sesswalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变湿；被弄湿或淋湿。
产生性兴奋；被唤起性欲。
动词 xarrab 的中被动态形式，表示自身变湿或被弄湿等，具体含义取决于语境。
被浸透；全身或整体湿透。

formal.mt: Matul il-maltemp, il-ħaddiem xxarrab sal-ġilda waqt li kien qed jagħlaq il-bieb tal-maħżen.
formal.en: During the storm, the worker got soaked to the skin while closing the warehouse door.
formal.zh: 暴风雨中，那名工人在关闭仓库大门时被淋得浑身湿透。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark mar ibiddel ħwejġu? Lara: Xxarrab bix-xita fi triqtu lejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark go to change his clothes? Lara: He got wet in the rain on his way home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么去换衣服了？拉拉：他回家的路上被雨淋湿了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么去换衣服了？
messages.en: Why did Mark go to change his clothes?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxarrab bix-xita fi triqtu lejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Xxarrab bix-xita fi triqtu lejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 他回家的路上被雨淋湿了。
messages.en: He got wet in the rain on his way home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“雨水把衣服一直浸到皮肤”的画面记 xxarrab sal-ġilda，建立“变湿—湿透”的程度联系；性兴奋义另用语境区分。

gloss_zh: 被加脂；被养肥或变胖；被贿赂或收受贿赂

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become fat or be fattened; also to be larded, or to be bribed or receive bribes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变胖或被养肥；也可指肉被加入肥脂，以及人被贿赂或收受贿赂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imxaħħam jew jitħaxxen; jingħad ukoll għal laħam li jiżdiedlu x-xaħam, jew għal persuna li tiġi mixtrija bit-tixħim jew taċċetta tixħim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加入、嵌入或涂上肥脂，通常指肉类烹调。
被养肥；被喂得肥胖。
被贿赂；被人以财物收买。
动词 xaħħam 的中被动态形式，可表示被加脂、被养肥或被贿赂，具体含义取决于语境。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become fat, to be fattened
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变胖；被养肥。
收受贿赂；接受他人为收买自己而给予的财物。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-uffiċjal xxaħħam bit-tixħim u ta vantaġġi lil min ħallsu.
formal.en: In the story, the official was corrupted by bribes and gave advantages to those who paid him.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名官员被贿赂收买，向给他钱的人提供了便利。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-qattus jidher ikbar minn qabel. Mark: Iva, xxaħħam minn mindu beda jiekol aktar.
colloquial.en: Sara: The cat looks bigger than before. Mark: Yes, he's grown fat since he started eating more.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这只猫看起来比以前大了。马克：是啊，自从吃得更多以后，它就长胖了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只猫看起来比以前大了。
messages.en: The cat looks bigger than before.

messages.speaker: Mark (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xxaħħam minn mindu beda jiekol aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xxaħħam minn mindu beda jiekol aktar.
messages.zh: 是啊，自从吃得更多以后，它就长胖了。
messages.en: Yes, he's grown fat since he started eating more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xxaħħam 配三张记忆卡：肉中加脂、动物养肥、官员受贿。用不同场景区分义项；这只是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 变得十分节俭；变得吝啬；吝于花费或给予

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very economical or miserly, or to be sparing in what one spends or gives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得非常节省，甚至吝啬；在花费或给予方面十分节制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ifaddal ħafna jew xħiħ, jew joqgħod lura milli jonfoq jew jagħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得非常节俭；开始极力节省开支。
变得吝啬；越来越舍不得花钱或给予。
吝于花费或给予；节省着使用。

collocations.en: became very economical in his spending
collocations.zh: 在开支上变得十分节省

formal.mt: Wara li naqas id-dħul tiegħu, Pawlu xxaħħaħ fl-infiq u beda jirreġistra kull xirja.
formal.en: After his income fell, Pawlu became very economical in his spending and began recording every purchase.
formal.zh: 收入减少后，保罗在开支上变得十分节省，并开始记录每一笔购物支出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jixtri kafè? Lara: Dan l-aħħar xxaħħaħ ħafna; issa jagħmel il-kafè d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Pawlu want to buy a coffee? Lara: He's become very tight with money lately; now he makes coffee at home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么不愿意买杯咖啡？拉拉：他最近变得特别抠，现在都在家自己煮咖啡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jixtri kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jixtri kafè?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不愿意买杯咖啡？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu want to buy a coffee?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-aħħar xxaħħaħ ħafna; issa jagħmel il-kafè d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-aħħar xxaħħaħ ħafna; issa jagħmel il-kafè d-dar.
messages.zh: 他最近变得特别抠，现在都在家自己煮咖啡。
messages.en: He's become very tight with money lately; now he makes coffee at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxaħħaħ 想成一个人越来越紧地捂住钱包：既能表示非常节省，也能带出舍不得花钱或给予的吝啬意味。

gloss_zh: 使自己忙起来；让心思有所寄托

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep oneself or one's mind occupied with an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过某项活动让自己有事可做，或让心思有所寄托。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm ruħu jew moħħu okkupat b'xi attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让心思有所寄托；使头脑有事可想。
动词 xiegħel 的中被动态形式，在此表示使自己或自己的心思有所忙碌。
让自己有事可做；使自己保持忙碌。

collocations.zh: 通过阅读让自己有事可做

collocations.en: kept himself occupied with a crossword
collocations.zh: 做填字游戏来打发时间

formal.mt: Waqt il-vjaġġ twil bil-ferrovija, Pawlu xxiegħel bil-qari ta' ktieb dwar l-istorja.
formal.en: During the long train journey, Pawlu kept himself occupied by reading a book about history.
formal.zh: 在漫长的火车旅途中，保罗读了一本历史书，让自己有事可做。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għamel in-nannu waqt li kien qed jistenna? Luqa: Xxiegħel b'tisliba u l-ħin għadda malajr.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Grandpa do while he was waiting? Luqa: He kept himself occupied with a crossword, and the time passed quickly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：爷爷等候的时候做了什么？卢卡：他做填字游戏打发时间，时间很快就过去了。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel in-nannu waqt li kien qed jistenna?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel in-nannu waqt li kien qed jistenna?
messages.zh: 爷爷等候的时候做了什么？
messages.en: What did Grandpa do while he was waiting?

messages.speaker: Luqa (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Xxiegħel b'tisliba u l-ħin għadda malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Xxiegħel b'tisliba u l-ħin għadda malajr.
messages.zh: 他做填字游戏打发时间，时间很快就过去了。
messages.en: He kept himself occupied with a crossword, and the time passed quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxiegħel 和候车时的一本书、一张填字游戏联系起来：重点是给自己或头脑找点事做，让等待不再空白。

gloss_zh: 变干；变得干旱；遭毛毛虫侵害

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dry or arid, or to become infested with caterpillars.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得干燥或干旱；也可指遭毛毛虫侵害、布满毛毛虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir niexef jew aridu, jew jimtela b'dud li jiekol il-weraq u jsir friefet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得干旱；因缺乏水分而变得干燥贫瘠。
遭毛毛虫侵害；出现大量毛毛虫。
变干；失去水分。
布满毛毛虫；遭毛毛虫严重侵害。

collocations.en: the garden became infested with caterpillars

formal.mt: Minħabba n-nuqqas ta' xita, l-għalqa xxiegħet u l-ħamrija tilfet ħafna mill-umdità tagħha.
formal.en: Because of the lack of rain, the field became arid and the soil lost much of its moisture.
formal.zh: 由于缺少降雨，田地变得干旱，土壤失去了大量水分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm tant toqob fil-weraq? Mark: Il-ġnien xxiegħet bid-dud; ara kemm hemm fuq din il-werqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there so many holes in the leaves? Mark: The garden has become infested with caterpillars; look how many there are on this leaf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：叶子上怎么有这么多洞？马克：花园闹毛毛虫了；你看这片叶子上有多少只。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 叶子上怎么有这么多洞？
messages.en: Why are there so many holes in the leaves?

messages.speaker: Mark (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġnien xxiegħet bid-dud; ara kemm hemm fuq din il-werqa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġnien xxiegħet bid-dud; ara kemm hemm fuq din il-werqa.
messages.zh: 花园闹毛毛虫了；你看这片叶子上有多少只。
messages.en: The garden has become infested with caterpillars; look how many there are on this leaf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xxiegħet 画两格田园图：一格是缺雨而干裂的土地，一格是爬满毛毛虫的叶片。分别记住干旱义与虫害义，不把两者混为因果。

gloss_zh: 变得贪婪；变得贪得无厌

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become greedy or rapacious, wanting increasingly more wealth, possessions, or advantages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得贪婪或贪得无厌，越来越想占有财富、物品或利益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar rgħib u beda jrid dejjem aktar flus, ġid jew vantaġġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得贪得无厌；开始一味攫取财物或利益。
变得贪婪；开始对财富、物品或利益索求过多。

collocations.en: became greedy and wanted everything for himself
collocations.zh: 变得贪婪，想把一切据为己有

formal.mt: Wara li kiseb il-poter, il-mexxej xħaħ u beda jieħu l-ġid tan-nies għalih.
formal.en: After gaining power, the leader became rapacious and began taking the people's wealth for himself.
formal.zh: 掌权后，这位领导者变得贪得无厌，开始把民众的财富据为己有。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Ben irid il-premju kollu għalih? Toni: Minn meta rebaħ l-ewwel darba, xħaħ u ma jridx jaqsam ma' ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does Ben want the whole prize for himself? Toni: Since he won the first time, he has become greedy and does not want to share with anyone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Ben为什么想独占全部奖金？Toni：自从第一次赢了以后，他就变得贪婪，不愿意和任何人分享。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Ben irid il-premju kollu għalih?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Ben irid il-premju kollu għalih?
messages.zh: Ben为什么想独占全部奖金？
messages.en: Why does Ben want the whole prize for himself?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn meta rebaħ l-ewwel darba, xħaħ u ma jridx jaqsam ma' ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Minn meta rebaħ l-ewwel darba, xħaħ u ma jridx jaqsam ma' ħadd.
messages.zh: 自从第一次赢了以后，他就变得贪婪，不愿意和任何人分享。
messages.en: Since he won the first time, he has become greedy and does not want to share with anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把xħaħ放进“原先愿意分享，后来什么都想要”的前后变化画面；本条是动词，重点记住“变得贪婪”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of throwing; also used for vomiting or damage, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 投掷这一动作；在不同语境中也可表示呕吐或损害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li titfa' xi ħaġa; skont il-kuntest, jista' jfisser ukoll rimettar jew ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 损害；破坏。
动词xeħet的动作名词；表示该动词所指的行为。
投掷；抛掷这一动作。
呕吐；将胃内容物从口中吐出的行为。

formal.mt: Ix-xħit ta' ġebel lejn il-vetturi jista' jikkawża ġrieħi serji.
formal.en: Throwing stones at vehicles can cause serious injuries.
formal.zh: 向车辆投掷石块可能造成严重伤害。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Nistgħu nitfgħu l-ballun hawn? Rita: Le, hawn wisq twieqi. Ix-xħit tal-ballun nagħmluh fil-grawnd.
colloquial.en: Luca: Can we throw the ball here? Rita: No, there are too many windows here. We will do the ball throwing on the playing field.
colloquial.zh: Luca：我们可以在这里扔球吗？Rita：不行，这里的窗户太多了。我们去球场练习投球吧。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.zh: 我们可以在这里扔球吗？
messages.en: Can we throw the ball here?

messages.speaker: Rita (体育老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn wisq twieqi. Ix-xħit tal-ballun nagħmluh fil-grawnd.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn wisq twieqi. Ix-xħit tal-ballun nagħmluh fil-grawnd.
messages.zh: 不行，这里的窗户太多了。我们去球场练习投球吧。
messages.en: No, there are too many windows here. We will do the ball throwing on the playing field.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“投掷石块”记住xħit的动作名词用法，再分别建立“呕吐”和“损害”的语境卡片，靠上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unwilling to spend or share, or excessively eager to possess wealth and other things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不愿花钱或与人分享的；也可指过分渴望占有财富等事物的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jridx jonfoq jew jaqsam ma' ħaddieħor, jew li jixtieq iżomm u jikseb dejjem aktar ġid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吝啬的；过分舍不得花钱或给予他人的。
手紧的；不肯花钱或出钱的。
贪得无厌的；一味攫取财物或利益的。
小气的、贪财的、贪婪的，尤其指一心想占有财物的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, in-negozjant huwa xħiħ: għandu ħafna flus iżda jirrifjuta li jgħin lill-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the merchant is miserly: he has plenty of money but refuses to help his family.
formal.zh: 小说中的商人十分吝啬：他有很多钱，却拒绝帮助自己的家人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark lanqas ried iħallas sehmu għall-ikel. Sara: Kemm hu xħiħ! Kulħadd ħallas ħlief hu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark would not even pay his share of the food. Sara: He is so stingy! Everyone paid except him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark连自己的那份饭钱都不愿意付。Sara：他真小气！除了他，大家都付了钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark lanqas ried iħallas sehmu għall-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Mark lanqas ried iħallas sehmu għall-ikel.
messages.zh: Mark连自己的那份饭钱都不愿意付。
messages.en: Mark would not even pay his share of the food.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu xħiħ! Kulħadd ħallas ħlief hu.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu xħiħ! Kulħadd ħallas ħlief hu.
messages.zh: 他真小气！除了他，大家都付了钱。
messages.en: He is so stingy! Everyone paid except him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个紧握钱包、什么也不肯分享的人，把xħiħ记成他的性格标签；与表示“变得贪婪”的动词xħaħ对照。

gloss_zh: 拆开；拆除；关店停业；退出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take something apart or dismantle it; also to close an establishment or quit an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物件拆成部件或拆除设施；也可指店铺停业，或退出某项活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred xi ħaġa f'partijiet jew ineħħi struttura; ukoll jagħlaq ħanut jew jieqaf minn attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆开，把物件分解成部件。
拆卸；拆除已组装的物件或结构。

sense_translations.en_definition: to shut down (used of a shop or other establishment)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 关闭、结束营业，指商店或其他经营场所。
退出；停止从事某项活动。
拆开；拆卸；拆除。

formal.mt: It-tekniku żarma l-magna biex jeżamina l-partijiet ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The technician took the machine apart to examine its internal parts.
formal.zh: 技术员拆开机器，以检查内部零件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi nżarma l-mejda biex noħroġha mill-kamra? Rita: Iva, żarma s-saqajn l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Should I take the table apart to get it out of the room? Rita: Yes, take the legs off first.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我得把桌子拆开才能搬出房间吗？丽塔：对，先把桌腿拆下来。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nżarma l-mejda biex noħroġha mill-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nżarma l-mejda biex noħroġha mill-kamra?
messages.zh: 我得把桌子拆开才能搬出房间吗？
messages.en: Should I take the table apart to get it out of the room?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 对，先把桌腿拆下来。
messages.en: Yes, take the legs off first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先把帐篷一根根拆下，再把店铺收起来关门；用“拆开”和“收场”两个画面记住不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small or young rabbit, often called a bunny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体型小或年幼的兔子，即小兔、幼兔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fenek żgħir jew għadu żgħir fl-età.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小兔，带有亲昵语气的兔子称呼。
小兔，体型较小的兔子。
小兔；幼兔，年幼的兔子。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher żarmuġ abjad ħdejn ommu.
formal.en: The picture shows a white young rabbit beside its mother.
formal.zh: 图中有一只白色幼兔，待在妈妈身旁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak iż-żarmuġ taħt is-siġra! Pawlu: Rajtu! Qiegħed ħdejn ommu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that bunny under the tree! Pawlu: I see it! It's beside its mother.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树下那只小兔！保罗：看到了！它在妈妈旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树下那只小兔！
messages.en: Look at that bunny under the tree!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！它在妈妈旁边。
messages.en: I see it! It's beside its mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一张兔妈妈旁边有只小兔的图，看到小小身影就回想“小兔、幼兔”。

gloss_zh: 嘎嘎作响；嗡鸣；哼唱；发出刺耳响声；发声物或声音尖高的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a rattling, buzzing, humming, or harshly loud sound; also to sing, as a finch does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出嘎嘎声、嗡嗡声、哼鸣声或刺耳的大声；也可指雀鸟鸣唱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ta' ċekċik, żanżin jew tnehdim, jew ħoss qawwi u aħrax; jingħad ukoll għall-għana ta' għasfur bħall-isponsun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出嘎嘎声、咔嗒声等连续碰撞声。
发出嗡嗡声。
发出嗡嗡声或嘎嘎声的东西。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who plays the trumpet aloudly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大声吹奏小号的人。
嗓音尖高的人。
哼唱；发出低而连续的哼鸣声。
鸣唱，指雀鸟发出歌声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bray, to blare, to make a harshly loud sound
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出驴叫般的粗响；鸣响；发出刺耳的大声。

collocations.en: a motor that buzzes or rattles
collocations.zh: 嗡嗡或嘎嘎作响的马达

formal.mt: Waqt it-test, il-mutur beda jżarżar u t-tekniku waqqfu biex jeżaminah.
formal.en: During the test, the motor began to rattle, and the technician stopped it to examine it.
formal.zh: 测试时，马达开始嘎嘎作响，技术员将它停下进行检查。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' l-mutur jżarżar? Toni: Iva, itfih u ejja niċċekkjawh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear the motor rattling? Toni: Yes, switch it off and let's check it.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你听到马达嘎嘎响了吗？托尼：听到了，把它关掉，我们检查一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你听到马达嘎嘎响了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the motor rattling?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 听到了，把它关掉，我们检查一下。
messages.en: Yes, switch it off and let's check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复的字形当作反复响起的声音提示，串起嘎嘎、嗡嗡、哼唱；再单独记住名词可指发声物或人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A moth, including a tiger moth; in a separate sense, a spindle used for spinning thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蛾，也可具体指灯蛾；另一个独立义项是纺线用的纺锤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Farfett tal-lejl; f'tifsira oħra, magħżel li jintuża biex jinħadem il-ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灯蛾，一类蛾。
纺锤，纺线时使用的工具。
蛾；飞蛾。

formal.mt: L-istudent osserva żarżur fuq it-tieqa u għamel tpinġija tiegħu.
formal.en: The student observed a moth on the window and made a drawing of it.
formal.zh: 学生观察了窗上的一只蛾，并把它画了下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm żarżur ħdejn il-lampa. Ben: Narah. Iftaħ it-tieqa biex ikun jista' joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: There's a moth beside the lamp. Ben: I see it. Open the window so it can get out.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：灯旁有只飞蛾。本：我看到了。打开窗户，让它能飞出去。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 灯旁有只飞蛾。
messages.en: There's a moth beside the lamp.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Narah. Iftaħ it-tieqa biex ikun jista' joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Narah. Iftaħ it-tieqa biex ikun jista' joħroġ.
messages.zh: 我看到了。打开窗户，让它能飞出去。
messages.en: I see it. Open the window so it can get out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张同词卡：一张画灯旁的飞蛾，一张画纺线的纺锤；用不同场景分开记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove someone or something from a place or position, or to banish someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或物从某处或某个位置移走；也可指驱逐、放逐某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa minn post jew minn kariga, jew jibgħat lil xi ħadd fl-eżilju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移除；移走；使离开原来的位置。
放逐；驱逐，使某人被迫离开。
卑劣的人；品行恶劣的人，带有贬义。

formal.mt: Il-kap żawwal lill-uffiċjal mill-kariga tiegħu wara l-investigazzjoni.
formal.en: The head removed the official from his post after the investigation.
formal.zh: 调查结束后，负责人免去了该官员的职务。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Żawwal dik il-kaxxa minn hawn, jekk jogħġbok. Luqa: Iva, inpoġġiha ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marta: Please move that box away from here. Luqa: Yes, I'll put it beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：请把那个箱子从这里移走。卢卡：好，我把它放到门旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Żawwal dik il-kaxxa minn hawn, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Żawwal dik il-kaxxa minn hawn, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把那个箱子从这里移走。
messages.en: Please move that box away from here.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我把它放到门旁边。
messages.en: Yes, I'll put it beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把箱子移出房间，再把人物移出职位或国境，记住动词“移除、放逐”；名词“卑劣的人”另做一张卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that is incorrect in an action, answer, calculation, or piece of writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为、答案、计算或文字中不正确的地方，即错误或差错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mhux korretta f'azzjoni, tweġiba, kalkolu jew kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 错误；差错。
错误；做错或判断错的地方。
错误；失误；差错。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport fih żball fil-kalkolu tat-total, u għalhekk jeħtieġ korrezzjoni.
formal.en: The report contains an error in the calculation of the total and therefore requires correction.
formal.zh: 报告中合计数的计算有误，因此需要更正。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għamilt żball fin-numru tat-telefon. Adam: Tinkwetax, ikkoreġih qabel tibgħat il-messaġġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: I made a mistake in the phone number. Adam: Don't worry, correct it before you send the message.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我把电话号码写错了。亚当：别担心，发消息前改过来就行。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我把电话号码写错了。
messages.en: I made a mistake in the phone number.

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 别担心，发消息前改过来就行。
messages.en: Don't worry, correct it before you send the message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在练习本上圈出一个写错的数字，旁边标上 żball；把“发现错误”和“纠正错误”连成一幅记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clear a place by removing objects, clutter, or unwanted things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 移走物品、杂物或不需要的东西，使某处整洁或腾空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi oġġetti, imbarazz jew affarijiet mhux meħtieġa minn post biex iħallih nadif jew vojt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清理；收拾，移走杂物使地方整洁。

sense_translations.en_definition: to clear out, to rid of
sense_translations.zh_definition: 清空；清除，移走不需要或占地方的东西。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żbarazza l-kamra u neħħa l-kaxxi kollha qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The worker cleared out the room and removed all the boxes before the meeting.
formal.zh: 工作人员在会议前清理了房间，搬走了所有箱子。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Żbarazza l-mejda, jekk jogħġbok; dalwaqt nieklu. Mark: Tajjeb, inneħħi l-kotba u npoġġihom fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Mother: Please clear the table; we'll be eating soon. Mark: Okay, I'll remove the books and put them on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：请把桌子收拾一下，我们快吃饭了。马克：好，我把书拿走，放到书架上。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Żbarazza l-mejda, jekk jogħġbok; dalwaqt nieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Żbarazza l-mejda, jekk jogħġbok; dalwaqt nieklu.
messages.zh: 请把桌子收拾一下，我们快吃饭了。
messages.en: Please clear the table; we'll be eating soon.

messages.speaker: Mark (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inneħħi l-kotba u npoġġihom fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inneħħi l-kotba u npoġġihom fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 好，我把书拿走，放到书架上。
messages.en: Okay, I'll remove the books and put them on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象吃饭前把桌上的书本杂物全部搬走，桌面一下空出来；用这个动作记住“清理、清空”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dried grapes, eaten on their own or used in cooking and baking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 晒干或烘干的葡萄，可直接食用，也可用于烹饪和烘焙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għeneb imnixxef li jittiekel waħdu jew jintuża fit-tisjir u fil-ħami.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄干，通常统称多颗或一定量的葡萄干。
葡萄干；可对应英语单数或复数的葡萄干。

formal.mt: Skont ir-riċetta, żid mitt gramma żbib mat-taħlita qabel tpoġġiha fil-forn.
formal.en: According to the recipe, add one hundred grams of raisins to the mixture before putting it in the oven.
formal.zh: 按照食谱，在把混合物放入烤箱前，加入一百克葡萄干。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid iż-żbib fil-kejk? Pawlu: Iva, żid ponn żbib, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want raisins in the cake? Pawlu: Yes, add a handful of raisins, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想在蛋糕里加葡萄干吗？保罗：想，请加一把葡萄干。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想在蛋糕里加葡萄干吗？
messages.en: Do you want raisins in the cake?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żid ponn żbib, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żid ponn żbib, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，请加一把葡萄干。
messages.en: Yes, add a handful of raisins, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一把皱皱的葡萄干撒进蛋糕面糊，边做动作边念 żbib，用味觉和画面一起记忆。
